attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); CAN-SPAM Act; SAP IS-U BP Communication Method; Oracle CC&B Contact Preference

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer profile record was first created in the source CIS system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Represents the customer's initial enrollment date with the utility. Stored in yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX format per model conventions.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U BP Creation Date; Oracle CC&B Person Created Date; GDPR Article 5(1)(e)

attributes.name: credit_classification
attributes.description: Internal credit risk classification assigned to the customer based on payment history, credit bureau data, and utility-specific scoring. Drives deposit requirements, payment plan eligibility, and collections treatment. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA credit segment or Oracle CC&B credit rating.
attributes.references: FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act); State PUC Deposit Rules; SAP IS-U FICA Credit Segment; Oracle CC&B Credit Rating

attributes.name: credit_score
attributes.description: Numeric credit score obtained from a third-party credit bureau or internal scoring model. Range typically 300–850 for FICO-based scores. Used for deposit waiver decisions, payment arrangement eligibility, and collections prioritization. Null if no credit history exists.
attributes.references: FCRA (Fair Credit Reporting Act); FICO Score Standards; SAP IS-U FICA Credit Score

attributes.name: customer_segment
attributes.description: Primary market segment classification of the customer. Drives rate schedule eligibility, billing treatment, and regulatory reporting. Residential covers individual households; commercial covers small-to-medium businesses; industrial covers large-load manufacturing and processing facilities; agricultural covers farming operations; government covers public sector entities.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Schedule Definitions; SAP IS-U Customer Class

attributes.name: customer_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is a natural person (individual) or a legal organization (business entity). Determines which identity attributes are applicable and governs data handling obligations under privacy regulations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP IS-U BP Category (Person/Organization)

attributes.name: date_of_birth
attributes.description: Date of birth of the residential customer individual. Used for identity verification, age-based eligibility programs (e.g., senior discount rates), and credit assessment. Null for organization customers. Stored in yyyy-MM-dd format per model conventions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 9; CCPA §1798.140; SAP IS-U BP Date of Birth

attributes.name: demand_response_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is actively enrolled in a Demand Response (DR) program, authorizing the utility or ISO/RTO to curtail or shift the customer's load during peak demand events. Drives DR dispatch eligibility in DERMS and EMS systems.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; NERC BAL-002; State PUC DR Program Rules; Oracle CC&B Program Enrollment

attributes.name: deposit_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is required to pay a security deposit based on credit classification, payment history, or state PUC rules. True triggers deposit collection workflow in SAP IS-U FICA or Oracle CC&B.
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Regulations; SAP IS-U FICA Deposit Management; Oracle CC&B Deposit

attributes.name: der_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has one or more Distributed Energy Resources (DER) — such as rooftop solar, battery storage, or EV chargers — enrolled in the utility's DERMS platform. Enables participation in virtual power plant (VPP) programs and demand response dispatch.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; IEEE 1547; NERC BAL-002; DERMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: do_not_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has requested to be excluded from non-essential marketing and outreach communications. Does not suppress legally required notices (e.g., disconnection warnings, safety alerts). Enforced in CRM and outbound communication systems.
attributes.references: TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); CCPA §1798.120

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the customer used for electronic bill delivery, outage notifications, demand response program communications, and account alerts. Sourced from SAP IS-U BP email or Oracle CC&B Person email.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act; SAP IS-U BP Email

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the residential customer individual. Null for commercial/industrial entity customers. Sourced from SAP IS-U BP first name or Oracle CC&B Person first name field.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP IS-U BP Name Fields

attributes.name: government_id_masked
attributes.description: Masked representation of the government-issued identification number, retaining only the last four digits (e.g., ***-**-1234 for SSN). Full ID is stored only in the source CIS system under restricted access. Used for identity confirmation without exposing the full identifier.
attributes.references: CCPA §1798.140; GDPR Article 9; PCI DSS Tokenization Guidance; SAP IS-U BP ID Number

attributes.name: government_id_type
attributes.description: Type of government-issued identification document provided by the customer for identity verification. SSN and ITIN apply to US individuals; EIN applies to business entities; passport and drivers_license apply to individuals. Paired with masked government_id_masked field.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004; CCPA §1798.140; GDPR Article 9; SAP IS-U BP ID Type

attributes.name: identity_verification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer's identity verification process. Verified indicates successful validation against government ID or third-party identity service; unverified indicates not yet validated; pending indicates verification in progress; failed indicates verification attempt was unsuccessful; waived indicates verification requirement was formally waived (e.g., for government accounts).
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004; FERC Standards of Conduct; SAP IS-U BP Verification Status

attributes.name: identity_verified_date
attributes.description: Date on which the customer's identity was most recently successfully verified. Used for compliance audit trails and periodic re-verification scheduling. Null if identity_verification_status is unverified or pending.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004; GDPR Article 5(1)(f); SAP IS-U BP Verification Date

attributes.name: income_tier
attributes.description: Income tier classification assigned to the customer based on self-reported or verified household income relative to the federal poverty level (FPL). Used for low-income rate program eligibility, LIHEAP enrollment, and CARE/FERA program qualification. Tier 1 represents lowest income bracket.
attributes.references: LIHEAP (Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program); State PUC CARE/FERA Program Rules; FERC Low-Income Provisions

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Customer's preferred language for all communications, bills, and notices. Stored as ISO 639-1 two-letter language code (e.g., en, es, zh, fr, vi). Drives multi-language bill rendering and outage notification language selection in CIS and OMS systems.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; State PUC Language Access Requirements; SAP IS-U BP Language

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name of the residential customer individual. Null for commercial/industrial entity customers. Sourced from SAP IS-U BP last name or Oracle CC&B Person last name field.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; SAP IS-U BP Name Fields

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the customer profile record in the source CIS system. Used for change data capture (CDC) processing in the Silver Layer ETL pipeline and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U BP Change Date; Oracle CC&B Person Last Modified; GDPR Article 5(1)(f)

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the customer as registered with the utility. For residential customers this is the individual's full name; for commercial/industrial customers this is the registered business entity name. Used for billing, regulatory correspondence, and identity verification.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; SAP IS-U BP Name Fields

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current state of the customer profile in its lifecycle. Active indicates a current utility customer; inactive indicates a former customer with no active service agreements; pending indicates a new customer application in progress; suspended indicates temporary hold due to credit or compliance issues; deceased indicates confirmed death of a residential customer; merged indicates the profile was consolidated into another record.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U BP Status; Oracle CC&B Person Status; State PUC Customer Service Rules

attributes.name: low_income_assistance_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has been determined eligible for low-income energy assistance programs such as CARE (California Alternate Rates for Energy), FERA, LIHEAP, or equivalent state-specific programs. Drives discounted rate application in billing.
attributes.references: LIHEAP Federal Program; State PUC CARE/FERA Rules; DOE Weatherization Assistance Program; Oracle CC&B Program Enrollment

attributes.name: low_income_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific low-income assistance program the customer is enrolled in (e.g., CARE, FERA, LIHEAP, HEAP, REACH). Null if low_income_assistance_eligible is false. Used for rate discount application and regulatory reporting to state PUC.
attributes.references: State PUC Low-Income Program Definitions; LIHEAP; DOE Weatherization Assistance Program

attributes.name: marketing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications about energy efficiency programs, new rate plans, and utility products. Required under GDPR opt-in rules for EU-adjacent operations and CCPA for California customers.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); CCPA §1798.120; TCPA; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: medical_baseline_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer qualifies for a medical baseline allowance due to a life-threatening illness or condition requiring life-support equipment. Triggers additional baseline energy allocation at the lowest rate tier and special disconnection protections under state PUC rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; CPUC Rule 11; Oracle CC&B Medical Baseline Program

attributes.name: mobile_phone_number
attributes.description: Mobile telephone number for the customer, used specifically for SMS-based outage alerts, two-factor authentication, and demand response text notifications. Distinct from primary phone which may be a landline. Stored in E.164 format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; TCPA; SAP IS-U BP Mobile Number

attributes.name: nem_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer participates in a Net Energy Metering (NEM) program, meaning they have behind-the-meter (BTM) generation (typically solar PV) and receive credits for excess energy exported to the grid. Drives bidirectional metering requirements and NEM tariff application.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC NEM Tariff Rules; PURPA; SAP IS-U NEM Rate Category

attributes.name: paperless_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted into electronic (paperless) bill delivery, suppressing physical mail generation. Drives bill rendering workflow in SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B billing engine.
attributes.references: State PUC Electronic Bill Delivery Rules; SAP IS-U Bill Print Suppression; Oracle CC&B eBill

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact telephone number for the customer. Used for outage notifications, payment reminders, demand response alerts, and field crew coordination. Stored in E.164 international format.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA §1798.140; TCPA; SAP IS-U BP Phone Number

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this customer profile was sourced. SAP_IS_U indicates SAP Industry Solution for Utilities; ORACLE_CCB indicates Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing; MANUAL indicates manually entered records; MIGRATION indicates records loaded during a system migration event. Used for data lineage tracking and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle CC&B; Enterprise Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: tax_id_number
attributes.description: Federal tax identification number for commercial/industrial customers (EIN) or individual taxpayer identification for sole proprietors. Used for 1099 reporting, tax exemption validation, and regulatory filings. Masked in analytics layer; full value retained in source CIS.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1635; SOX Section 302; SAP S/4HANA Tax Number

attributes.name: third_party_data_sharing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has consented to sharing their energy usage and profile data with authorized third parties (e.g., solar installers, EV charging providers, energy management platforms) under Green Button Connect My Data or similar data access frameworks.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA §1798.100; Green Button Connect My Data Standard; NAESB REQ.21

products.name: premise
products.description: Master entity representing a physical service location (premise) where utility service is delivered. Captures premise address, premise type (residential, commercial, industrial, agricultural), GIS coordinates (latitude/longitude), service territory code, distribution feeder ID, transformer bank ID, meter socket count, premise classification (single-family, multi-family, high-rise, substation-fed), load profile class, climate zone, and premise construction year. SSOT for all premise-level metering, billing, and outage management references.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Premise / Oracle CC&B Premise / Esri ArcGIS Utility Network Service Location

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the physical service location (premise) within the utility's Customer Information System (CIS). Primary key for all premise-level metering, billing, and outage management references. Role: MASTER_RESOURCE.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise Object; Oracle CC&B Premise Entity

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Premises must be assigned to balancing authority control areas for load forecasting, interchange scheduling, regulatory jurisdiction determination, and NERC compliance reporting. Essential for operati

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Premises are mapped to distribution cost centers for territorial cost allocation and service area profitability tracking. Critical for distribution cost management, rate design, and territorial P&L re

attributes.name: distribution_feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder circuit supplying power to the premise, as modeled in the utility's Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) and GIS. Critical for outage management, load balancing, Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR), and Volt-VAR optimization in GE PowerOn ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC FAC-001/FAC-002 Facility Standards

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution substation supplying the feeder that serves this premise. Used for hierarchical network topology analysis, outage impact scoping, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC TPL Transmission Planning Standards

attributes.name: distribution_transformer_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution transformer bank serving the premise, as recorded in the utility's asset management system (Ventyx Asset Suite) and GIS. Used for transformer loading analysis, outage impact assessment, and asset maintenance planning.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; IEEE C57 Transformer Standards

attributes.name: forecast_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Premises must be mapped to forecast zones for distribution load planning, capacity requirement allocation, outage impact analysis, and DER penetration forecasting. Essential for translating zone-level

attributes.name: meter_reading_route_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the meter reading route to which the premise is assigned for field meter reading operations. Used for route optimization, meter reader scheduling, and AMI walk-by/drive-by reading coordination in Oracle Utilities MDM.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM Meter Reading Route; SAP IS-U Meter Reading Order

attributes.name: primary_warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse. Business justification: Premises are assigned to primary warehouses based on service territory geography for emergency restoration material dispatch, routine maintenance supply, and storm response logistics. Critical for SAI

attributes.name: ami_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise is eligible for Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) smart meter deployment based on infrastructure readiness, service voltage, and utility AMI rollout program criteria. Drives meter deployment prioritization in Oracle Utilities MDM.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM AMI Deployment; DOE Smart Grid Investment Grant Standards; State PUC AMI Deployment Orders

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle to which the premise is assigned, determining meter reading schedule and bill generation frequency. Sourced from SAP IS-U Billing Cycle or Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle configuration.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Cycle; Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle; State PUC Billing Frequency Rules

attributes.name: classification
attributes.description: Detailed structural classification of the premise beyond the high-level premise type. Used for load profile modeling, infrastructure planning, and demand response program eligibility. Examples: single-family, multi-family, high-rise, substation-fed. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: single_family|multi_family|high_rise|substation_fed|mobile_home|commercial_strip|warehouse|manufacturing|farm — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Premise Classification; SAP IS-U Premise Category Detail

attributes.name: climate_zone
attributes.description: Climate zone designation assigned to the premise based on geographic location and DOE/ASHRAE climate classification. Used for energy efficiency program targeting, demand response (DR) program design, Integrated Resource Planning (IRP), and Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance analysis.
attributes.references: DOE Building Energy Codes; ASHRAE 90.1 Climate Zone Map; State PUC Energy Efficiency Program Rules

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year the premise structure was originally constructed. Used for energy efficiency program eligibility assessment, weatherization program targeting, load profile modeling, and infrastructure age analysis. Sourced from county assessor records or customer-provided data.
attributes.references: DOE Weatherization Assistance Program; State PUC Energy Efficiency Program Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the premise record was first created in the source CIS system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Provides audit trail for data governance, regulatory compliance, and data lineage tracking in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; NERC CIP-007 System Security Management; SAP IS-U Audit Log

attributes.name: critical_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise is designated as a critical facility (e.g., hospital, emergency services, water treatment plant, telecommunications hub) requiring priority restoration during outages. Drives outage management system (OMS) prioritization and mutual aid planning.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Critical Customer; NERC CIP Critical Infrastructure Protection; State PUC Critical Facility Designation Rules

attributes.name: der_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise has an active Distributed Energy Resource (DER) enrollment, including rooftop solar, battery storage, or other behind-the-meter (BTM) generation assets registered in the utility's Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). Supports Virtual Power Plant (VPP) aggregation and demand response programs.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222 DER Aggregation; State PUC DER Interconnection Rules; IEEE 1547; DERMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: ev_charging_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise has a registered electric vehicle (EV) charging installation. Used for distribution load forecasting, EV rate schedule eligibility, demand response program targeting, and grid modernization planning.
attributes.references: State PUC EV Rate Tariffs; DOE EV Infrastructure Standards; IEEE 2030.1.1 EV Charging Standards

attributes.name: floor_area_sqft
attributes.description: Total conditioned floor area of the premise structure in square feet. Used for energy intensity benchmarking (kWh per square foot), energy efficiency program eligibility, demand response capacity estimation, and load profile normalization.
attributes.references: DOE Commercial Buildings Energy Consumption Survey (CBECS); EPA ENERGY STAR Portfolio Manager

attributes.name: gis_parcel_reference
attributes.description: Assessor's parcel number or GIS parcel identifier linking the premise to the county tax assessor's spatial parcel layer in Esri ArcGIS Utility Network. Enables land-use analysis, property boundary correlation, and infrastructure planning.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; County Assessor Parcel Standards

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent utility field inspection of the premise's service entrance, metering equipment, or electrical infrastructure. Used for compliance tracking, safety program management, and asset maintenance scheduling in Ventyx Asset Suite.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Electrical Safety Standards; State PUC Safety Inspection Requirements; Ventyx Asset Suite Inspection Records

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the premise record in the source CIS system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change data capture (CDC), and audit trail maintenance per SOX and NERC CIP requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; NERC CIP-007; SAP IS-U Change Document; Oracle CC&B Audit Log

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the physical service location as recorded in the utility's Geographic Information System (GIS). Used for outage management spatial analysis, field crew routing, and distribution network modeling in Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standards

attributes.name: life_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a registered life-support equipment user resides at the premise. Triggers disconnection protection, priority outage notification, and special field crew protocols per state PUC regulations. Distinct from medical_baseline_flag which governs billing treatment.
attributes.references: State PUC Life Support Equipment Rules; CPUC General Order 111-G; Oracle CC&B Life Support Configuration

attributes.name: lifecycle_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the premise within the utility's service portfolio. Drives eligibility for new service connections, billing activation, and outage management inclusion. Active premises are energized and receiving service; decommissioned premises have been permanently removed from service.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise Status; Oracle CC&B Premise Status

attributes.name: load_profile_class
attributes.description: Utility-assigned load profile class code used to model the premise's expected energy consumption pattern for billing, forecasting, and settlement purposes. Applied to non-interval-metered customers for load research and wholesale market settlement. Sourced from Oracle Utilities MDM or SAP IS-U.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM Load Profile; NERC Load Forecasting Standards; FERC Settlement Procedures

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (WGS84 decimal degrees) of the physical service location as recorded in the utility's Geographic Information System (GIS). Used in conjunction with latitude for spatial analysis, outage polygon mapping, and DER interconnection planning.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS84 Coordinate Reference System; IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standards

attributes.name: medical_baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise has a registered medical baseline allowance due to a life-support or medical necessity condition. Triggers special billing treatment, outage notification priority, and disconnection protection protocols per state PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff Rules; CPUC Rule 11 (California); Oracle CC&B Medical Baseline Configuration

attributes.name: meter_socket_count
attributes.description: Number of meter sockets (meter points) installed at the premise. Multi-socket premises include multi-family dwellings, commercial complexes, and industrial facilities with multiple service points. Drives meter deployment planning in Oracle Utilities MDM and SAP IS-U Device Management.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management; ANSI C12.1 Electric Meters Standards

attributes.name: nem_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise is eligible for Net Energy Metering (NEM) based on service territory rules, interconnection capacity, and applicable state PUC tariff provisions. Supports Distributed Energy Resource (DER) enrollment and behind-the-meter (BTM) generation tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff Rules; FERC PURPA; IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard; SAP IS-U NEM Configuration

attributes.name: num_units
attributes.description: Number of individual dwelling or tenant units within the premise. Applicable to multi-family, high-rise, and mixed-use premises. Used for per-unit load analysis, master-metered billing allocation, and demand response program enrollment capacity.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Multi-Unit Premise Configuration; SAP IS-U Premise Unit Count

attributes.name: peak_demand_kw
attributes.description: Recorded or estimated peak electrical demand in kilowatts (kW) for the premise. Used for transformer sizing, distribution capacity planning, demand charge billing, and demand response (DR) program baseline establishment. Sourced from Oracle Utilities MDM interval data or SAP IS-U demand registers.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Demand Register; NERC Load Forecasting; State PUC Demand Charge Tariffs

attributes.name: premise_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the premise as assigned by the utility's CIS (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Used in field operations, customer correspondence, and cross-system integration. Corresponds to SAP IS-U Premise Number or Oracle CC&B Premise ID.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise Number; Oracle Utilities CC&B Premise Identifier

attributes.name: premise_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the premise by customer segment and land use. Drives rate schedule eligibility, load profile assignment, and regulatory reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: residential|commercial|industrial|agricultural|municipal|mixed_use — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; EIA-861 Customer Class Definitions; SAP IS-U Premise Category

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: Utility tariff rate schedule code applicable to the premise, as defined in the state PUC-approved tariff and configured in SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B. Determines energy charge structure, demand charges, TOU periods, and applicable riders.
attributes.references: State PUC Approved Tariff Schedules; SAP IS-U Rate Category; Oracle CC&B Rate Schedule

attributes.name: service_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Premise has embedded address fields that should be normalized to reference the address table. The premise table has address_line1, address_line2, city, state_code, postal_code, county, country_code wh

attributes.name: service_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which utility service was permanently terminated at the premise (e.g., demolition, decommissioning). Null for active premises. Used for premise lifecycle management and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Connection Object; Oracle CC&B Premise Deactivation; State PUC Service Termination Rules

attributes.name: service_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which utility service was first activated at the premise. Establishes the premise's service history baseline for billing, regulatory reporting, and infrastructure age analysis.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Connection Object; Oracle CC&B Premise Service Start; State PUC Service Commencement Rules

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Utility-defined code identifying the franchised service territory zone in which the premise is located. Determines applicable tariff schedules, regulatory jurisdiction (PUC), and operational responsibility. Sourced from SAP IS-U Division or Oracle CC&B Service Territory.
attributes.references: State PUC Franchise Territory Certificates (CPCN); FERC Open Access Transmission Tariff (OATT); SAP IS-U Division

attributes.name: service_voltage_class
attributes.description: Nominal voltage class at which electric service is delivered to the premise. Determines applicable tariff rate schedule, metering configuration, and interconnection requirements. Critical for rate design and OATT compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: secondary_120v|secondary_240v|primary_4kv|primary_12kv|primary_25kv|transmission — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC OATT; State PUC Rate Schedules; IEEE C84.1 Voltage Standards; ANSI C12.1

attributes.name: tou_rate_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise qualifies for Time of Use (TOU) or Critical Peak Pricing (CPP) rate schedules based on metering capability (AMI), service class, and applicable PUC tariff provisions. Drives rate schedule assignment and customer enrollment workflows.
attributes.references: State PUC TOU/CPP Tariff Schedules; Oracle CC&B Rate Schedule Eligibility; SAP IS-U Rate Determination

products.name: customer_service_agreement
products.description: Master entity representing the contractual service agreement between a utility and a customer account for a specific premise and rate schedule. Captures agreement start and end dates, rate schedule code, service type (electric, gas, water), TOU plan assignment, budget billing flag, auto-pay flag, paperless billing flag, deposit amount, deposit waiver reason, and agreement status. References NEM agreement type and DER interconnection ID as contractual entitlements (detailed program participation attributes are managed in enrollment). Sourced from SAP IS-U Contract and Oracle CC&B Service Agreement. SSOT for rate schedule assignment and service entitlement at the account-premise level.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Contract / Oracle CC&B Service Agreement

attributes.name: customer_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer service agreement. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Every service agreement is held by an account. This is a core CIS relationship — service_agreement.account_id → account.account_id. Without this, service agreements are orphaned.

attributes.name: customer_premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical premise where service is delivered under this agreement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Installation / Oracle CC&B Service Point

attributes.name: der_interconnection_point_id
attributes.description: Interconnection agreement identifier for customers with DER (Distributed Energy Resource) such as solar, wind, or battery storage. Links to detailed interconnection application and technical specifications. Null for customers without DER.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.ppa_contract. Business justification: Behind-the-meter PPA agreements are service agreements requiring direct linkage for billing integration, rate schedule coordination, and customer account management. Critical for community solar and t

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.premise.premise_id — Every service agreement delivers service at a specific premise. service_agreement.premise_id → premise.premise_id. This is the core CIS triad: account ↔ service agreement ↔ premise.

attributes.name: primary_customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account that holds this service agreement.

attributes.name: service_delivery_asset_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Delivery Asset Registry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Service agreements reference specific service delivery assets (transformer, switchgear) for capacity allocation, load management, and contract demand enforcement. Required for distribution capacity pl

attributes.name: service_level_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.service_level_agreement. Business justification: Each customer service agreement is governed by a Service Level Agreement; adding FK captures this relationship and provides inbound link to service_level_agreement.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the competitive energy supplier or Community Choice Aggregator (CCA) providing generation service in deregulated markets. Null for bundled service where utility provides both delivery and generation.
attributes.references: FERC Open Access Rules / State Retail Choice Programs

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier for the service agreement, used in customer communications and billing statements.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Number / Oracle CC&B Service Agreement ID

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the service agreement. Draft indicates agreement is being prepared; pending approval awaiting credit or regulatory review; active means service is being delivered; suspended for temporary service interruption; terminated for completed agreements; cancelled for agreements that never went active.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Status / Oracle CC&B Service Agreement Status

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the service agreement. Standard represents typical utility service; NEM (Net Energy Metering) for customers with behind-the-meter generation; DER interconnection for Distributed Energy Resource participants; community solar for shared renewable programs; green tariff for voluntary renewable energy purchase; special contract for negotiated large customer agreements.
attributes.references: PURPA / State PUC Net Metering Rules

attributes.name: auto_pay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic payment is enabled for this service agreement, allowing bills to be paid automatically from customer bank account or credit card.

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Billing cycle assignment determining when meter reads occur and bills are generated. Typically represents a monthly cycle number (e.g., cycle 01 reads on 1st of month, cycle 15 reads on 15th).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Schedule / Oracle CC&B Bill Cycle

attributes.name: budget_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is enrolled in budget billing program, which averages annual usage to provide consistent monthly payment amounts.

attributes.name: care_program_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Alternate Rates for Energy (CARE) Program Flag
attributes.description: Indicates enrollment in CARE or similar low-income assistance program providing discounted rates. CARE is California-specific; other states have equivalent programs (e.g., LIHEAP).

attributes.name: contract_demand_kw
attributes.description: Contracted maximum demand in kilowatts (kW) for large commercial and industrial customers with demand-based rate schedules. Customer pays for this capacity regardless of actual usage. Null for non-demand customers.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service agreement record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of security deposit held for this service agreement, typically required for customers with poor credit or no credit history. Null if no deposit required.

attributes.name: deposit_waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason why security deposit was waived if deposit amount is zero. Good credit for customers meeting credit score threshold; senior citizen, low income, or military for protected classes; prior customer for returning customers with good payment history; none if deposit was not waived.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when service agreement terminates and service delivery ends. Null for open-ended agreements. Populated when customer requests disconnection or agreement reaches contracted term end.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract End Date / Oracle CC&B Stop Date

attributes.name: life_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether premise has registered life support or medical equipment requiring continuous electric service. Provides special protections against disconnection and priority restoration during outages.

attributes.name: load_profile_code
attributes.description: Statistical load profile classification used for non-interval metered customers to estimate hourly usage patterns for settlement and forecasting. Based on customer class and historical usage patterns.

attributes.name: master_metered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agreement covers master-metered service where a single meter serves multiple dwelling units (e.g., apartment building) and the property owner sub-meters or allocates costs to tenants.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this service agreement record was last modified. Audit field for change tracking and compliance.

attributes.name: nem_agreement_type
attributes.description: Specific NEM (Net Energy Metering) program version if customer has behind-the-meter generation. NEM 1.0, 2.0, 3.0 represent California program generations; VNEM for virtual net metering; NEMBAT for NEM with battery storage. Not applicable for customers without generation.
attributes.references: CPUC NEM Tariff / State Net Metering Rules

attributes.name: paperless_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer has opted for electronic bill delivery instead of paper statements.

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer currently has an active payment arrangement or installment plan for past due balances.

attributes.name: power_factor_requirement
attributes.description: Minimum power factor (ratio of real to apparent power) required for large industrial customers. Typically 0.90 or higher. Customers below threshold may incur penalties. Null for customers without power factor requirements.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: Tariff rate schedule code assigned to this agreement, determining pricing structure and billing rules. Examples include residential flat rate, commercial TOU (Time of Use), industrial demand-based, or CPP (Critical Peak Pricing) schedules.
attributes.references: State PUC Approved Tariff / FERC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: seasonal_service_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a seasonal service agreement (e.g., vacation home, agricultural operation) with predictable periods of no usage and special billing rules.

attributes.name: service_class
attributes.description: Customer segment classification for regulatory reporting and rate design. Residential for households; commercial for businesses; industrial for manufacturing; agricultural for farms; municipal for government facilities; street lighting for public infrastructure.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 / State PUC Customer Class Definitions

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of utility commodity delivered under this agreement. Electric for electricity service; gas for natural gas; water for potable water; steam and chilled water for district energy systems.

attributes.name: service_voltage_level
attributes.description: Voltage level at which electric service is delivered. Secondary for residential/small commercial (120/240V); primary for larger commercial (4-35kV); subtransmission (35-138kV); transmission for industrial customers (>138kV). Null for non-electric services.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this service agreement was sourced. SAP IS-U for SAP Industry Solution for Utilities; Oracle CC&B for Oracle Customer Care and Billing; legacy CIS for older customer information systems being migrated.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of this service agreement in the source operational system. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: Date when service agreement becomes effective and service delivery begins. Corresponds to service turn-on date for new customers or agreement renewal date for existing customers.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Start Date / Oracle CC&B Start Date

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for service agreement termination. Customer request for voluntary disconnection; move out when customer relocates; non-payment for involuntary disconnection; death of account holder; foreclosure for property repossession; service transfer when service moves to new account; contract expiration for fixed-term agreements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|move_out|non_payment|death|foreclosure|service_transfer|contract_expiration — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: third_party_notification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer has designated a third party (family member, social worker, advocate) to receive copies of disconnection notices and other critical communications.

attributes.name: tou_plan_code
attributes.description: Specific TOU (Time of Use) pricing plan code if the rate schedule includes time-differentiated pricing. Defines peak, off-peak, and shoulder period pricing structures.

products.name: contact
products.description: Master entity capturing all contact points and notification preferences associated with a customer profile or account. Stores contact type (primary, billing, emergency, authorized third party), contact channel (phone, email, SMS, postal mail, push notification), contact value (phone number, email address), opt-in/opt-out status per channel, contact verification status, preferred contact time window, contact role (account holder, co-applicant, property manager, landlord), and notification preferences including notification type (outage, billing alert, payment reminder, DR event, regulatory), preferred notification channel, notification frequency, quiet hours, and language preference. Supports multi-channel engagement tracking, AMI outage notification, OMS customer alerting, and demand response event dispatch within CIS platforms.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Business Partner Contact / Oracle CC&B Contact

attributes.name: contact_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contact record. Primary key.

attributes.name: contact_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service account associated with this contact. Supports account-level contact management for multi-account customers.

attributes.name: contact_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer profile or account to which this contact belongs. Links contact to customer master entity in CIS (SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B).

attributes.name: postal_address_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.address. Business justification: Contact has embedded postal address fields that should be normalized to reference the address table. The contact table has postal_address_line1, postal_address_line2, postal_city, postal_state_provinc

attributes.name: to_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Some contacts are account-level (billing contact, emergency contact) rather than profile-level. Required for account-specific notification routing.

attributes.name: to_profile_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.profile.profile_id — Contact points belong to a customer profile. contact.profile_id → profile.profile_id. Essential for multi-channel engagement.

attributes.name: bounce_count
attributes.description: Number of failed delivery attempts (email bounces, SMS failures, undeliverable mail) for this contact. High bounce counts trigger contact verification workflows.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Primary communication channel or medium for this contact point. Determines delivery method for notifications and alerts.

attributes.name: contact_role
attributes.description: Specific role or relationship of the contact to the account holder. Defines authorization level for account actions and information access.

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Determines whether the contact is eligible for notifications and communications.

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Classification of the contact role within the customer relationship. Determines contact authority and notification eligibility.

attributes.name: contact_value
attributes.description: The actual contact information value (phone number, email address, postal address, device token). Format varies by contact_channel. Classified as restricted PII.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was first created in the CIS system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact record expires or is no longer valid for communications. Null indicates an open-ended contact.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact record becomes active and eligible for use in communications.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for electronic communication. Used for billing statements, outage alerts, DR (Demand Response) event notifications, and regulatory communications.

attributes.name: language_preference
attributes.description: Two-letter ISO 639-1 language code indicating the customers preferred language for communications through this contact channel.

attributes.name: last_bounce_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent failed delivery attempt for this contact channel.

attributes.name: last_contact_date
attributes.description: Date when this contact channel was last successfully used for customer communication. Supports contact hygiene and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contact record was last updated. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: notification_frequency
attributes.description: Preferred frequency for non-critical notifications through this contact channel. Critical alerts (outages, safety) are always sent in real-time.

attributes.name: notification_preference_billing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive billing alerts and payment reminders through this contact channel.

attributes.name: notification_preference_dr_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive DR event dispatch notifications through this contact channel. Supports demand response program participation.
attributes.references: CIS (Customer Information System) Business Rules, FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: notification_preference_marketing
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive marketing communications, promotional offers, and energy efficiency program information through this contact channel.
attributes.references: CIS (Customer Information System) Business Rules, CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: notification_preference_outage
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive outage notifications through this contact channel. Supports OMS (Outage Management System) alerting.

attributes.name: notification_preference_regulatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer wants to receive regulatory notices and compliance communications through this contact channel. Some regulatory notices are mandatory regardless of preference.
attributes.references: CIS (Customer Information System) Business Rules, PUC (Public Utility Commission) Requirements

attributes.name: opt_in_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer provided consent to receive communications through this contact channel.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: opt_in_status
attributes.description: Customer consent status for receiving communications through this contact channel. Supports TCPA and CAN-SPAM compliance.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer withdrew consent or unsubscribed from communications through this contact channel.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act), CAN-SPAM Act, GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary telephone number for voice contact. Supports outage notifications, billing alerts, and customer service callbacks.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the customers preferred contact method for general communications. True if preferred, False otherwise.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_end
attributes.description: End time of the customers preferred contact window in HH:MM format (24-hour). Used for outbound calls and scheduled notifications.

attributes.name: preferred_contact_time_start
attributes.description: Start time of the customers preferred contact window in HH:MM format (24-hour). Used for outbound calls and scheduled notifications.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of this contact within the customers contact list. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for cascading notification logic.

attributes.name: quiet_hours_end
attributes.description: End time of the do-not-disturb period in HH:MM format (24-hour). Notifications resume after quiet hours end.

attributes.name: quiet_hours_start
attributes.description: Start time of the do-not-disturb period in HH:MM format (24-hour). Notifications are suppressed during quiet hours unless critical.

attributes.name: sms_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for SMS text message notifications. Supports real-time outage alerts, payment reminders, and DR event dispatch.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Originating system or channel where this contact record was created or last updated. Supports data lineage and multi-channel integration.

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the contact information was last successfully verified by the customer.

attributes.name: verification_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact information has been validated through confirmation process (email click, SMS reply, phone verification).

products.name: address
products.description: Master entity representing a standardized postal address used for billing, mailing, or service delivery. Captures address line 1 and 2, city, state/province, postal code, country, address type (service, mailing, billing, third-party notification), USPS validation status, USPS standardized form, geocode latitude/longitude, census tract, and address effective date. Supports address normalization and deduplication across CIS and GIS systems.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Address / Oracle CC&B Address / Esri ArcGIS Address

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the address record. Primary key.

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.premise.premise_id — Service addresses are associated with premises. address.premise_id → premise.premise_id (for service address type). Critical for GIS integration and field operations.

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address: active (in use), inactive (not currently used), pending_validation (awaiting verification), retired (no longer valid), or seasonal (used only during specific periods).

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of address usage: service (physical service delivery location), mailing (correspondence destination), billing (invoice destination), third_party_notification (authorized third-party contact), premise (metered location), or correspondence (general communication).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner Address Types

attributes.name: carrier_route_code
attributes.description: USPS carrier route code identifying the mail delivery route for this address.

attributes.name: census_block_group
attributes.description: US Census Bureau block group identifier for granular demographic and socioeconomic analysis.

attributes.name: census_tract
attributes.description: US Census Bureau tract identifier for demographic analysis, regulatory reporting, and low-income program eligibility (e.g., LIHEAP, energy assistance programs).

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name for the address.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code (e.g., USA, CAN, MEX).

attributes.name: county_name
attributes.description: County or parish name for regulatory jurisdiction, tax district assignment, and Public Utility Commission (PUC) reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_point_barcode
attributes.description: USPS Delivery Point Barcode (DPBC) for automated mail sorting and delivery accuracy.

attributes.name: distribution_planning_area
attributes.description: Distribution system planning zone or district for load forecasting, capacity planning, and Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) analysis.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this address ceased to be effective. Null for currently active addresses.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this address became effective and available for use in customer service agreements and billing.

attributes.name: geocode_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of geocoding: rooftop (exact building), parcel (property boundary), street (street segment), zip_centroid (postal code center), city_centroid (city center), or unknown (not geocoded).

attributes.name: geocode_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate in decimal degrees for GIS integration and outage management. Supports spatial analysis and proximity calculations.

attributes.name: geocode_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate in decimal degrees for GIS integration and outage management. Supports spatial analysis and proximity calculations.

attributes.name: gis_feature_reference
attributes.description: Geographic Information System (GIS) feature identifier linking this address to the utility network model in Esri ArcGIS or equivalent GIS platform.

attributes.name: is_primary_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary address for the associated customer or premise. True if primary, False otherwise.

attributes.name: is_seasonal_address
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is used seasonally (e.g., vacation homes, seasonal businesses). True if seasonal, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including street number, street name, and street type (e.g., 123 Main Street).

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for apartment, suite, unit, building, floor, or other location identifiers.

attributes.name: municipality_name
attributes.description: Incorporated city, town, or municipal district name for franchise agreement tracking and local regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: outage_management_zone
attributes.description: Outage Management System (OMS) zone identifier for outage tracking, crew dispatch, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the address. Supports 5-digit, ZIP+4, and international postal code formats.

attributes.name: seasonal_end_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal occupancy typically ends. Null for non-seasonal addresses.

attributes.name: seasonal_start_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when seasonal occupancy typically begins. Null for non-seasonal addresses.

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Utility service territory identifier indicating the geographic area and regulatory jurisdiction for service delivery. Used for Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) compliance.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Source system or application that created or maintains this address record (e.g., SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B, GIS, MDM).

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this address in the source system of record. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code (e.g., CA for California, ON for Ontario).

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, America/Los_Angeles). Used for Time of Use (TOU) rate scheduling and Demand Response (DR) event timing.

attributes.name: usps_standardized_address
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Postal Service (USPS) Standardized Address
attributes.description: USPS-standardized full address string in CASS-certified format for delivery accuracy.

attributes.name: usps_validation_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: United States Postal Service (USPS) Validation Status
attributes.description: Status of USPS address validation: validated (confirmed by USPS), invalid (rejected by USPS), not_validated (not yet checked), corrected (USPS suggested correction applied), or ambiguous (multiple matches found).

attributes.name: verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the address was last verified or validated through USPS, field inspection, or customer confirmation.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: Method used to verify the address: usps_api (USPS web service), field_inspection (physical site visit), customer_confirmation (customer-provided), gis_validation (GIS system match), or third_party_service (external validation service).

products.name: account_premise_link
products.description: Association entity and SSOT for all relationships between customer accounts and premises, including active service relationships, landlord-tenant relationships, and property management roles. Stores link start date, link end date, link type (primary service, secondary service, landlord-of-record, property manager, master-metered tenant), landlord account reference, tenant account reference, move-in/move-out order references, vacancy billing flag, notification authorization flag, and link status. Enables historical tracking of which accounts have been served at a given premise, supports premise-to-account resolution for outage notifications and field operations, manages multi-family residential and commercial property management scenarios, and tracks landlord-tenant billing and notification workflows. SSOT for all account-to-premise and landlord-tenant relationship data.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Connection Object / Oracle CC&B Account-Premise Relationship

attributes.name: account_premise_link_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the account-premise relationship record. Primary key for the account_premise_link entity.

attributes.name: account_premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service premise associated with this account. Links to the premise entity representing the physical service location.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Installation, Oracle CC&B Service Point

attributes.name: customer_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the formal service agreement governing this account-premise relationship. Links to the contract or service agreement entity.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Contract Account, Oracle CC&B Service Agreement

attributes.name: forwarding_address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the forwarding address for final bill delivery and correspondence after account-premise relationship termination. Used in move-out processing.

attributes.name: primary_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with this premise. Links to the account entity in the Customer Information System (CIS).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner, Oracle CC&B Account

attributes.name: primary_account_move_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service order that initiated this account-premise relationship. Links to the move-in or service connection order.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Service Order, Oracle CC&B Field Activity

attributes.name: tertiary_tenant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the tenant account when this link represents a landlord-of-record relationship. Used to track tenant accounts associated with a landlord premise. Null for non-landlord relationships.

attributes.name: to_premise_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.premise.premise_id — The association entity must reference the premise it links. account_premise_link.premise_id → premise.premise_id.

attributes.name: billing_responsibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account has billing responsibility for the premise. In master-metered or landlord scenarios, multiple accounts may be linked to a premise but only one has billing responsibility.

attributes.name: contact_preference
attributes.description: Preferred communication channel for outage notifications and service alerts for this account-premise relationship. Used by OMS and customer engagement systems.

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: Security deposit amount collected for this account-premise relationship. Null if no deposit was required. Expressed in local currency.

attributes.name: deposit_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a security deposit was required for this account-premise relationship based on credit classification and service territory regulations.

attributes.name: der_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account-premise relationship is enrolled in a Distributed Energy Resource (DER) program such as demand response, virtual power plant, or distributed generation program.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222, State PUC DER Programs

attributes.name: final_bill_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a final bill has been issued for this account-premise relationship upon termination. Used in move-out and service disconnection workflows.

attributes.name: link_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account-premise link record was first created in the Customer Information System (CIS). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: link_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the account-premise relationship was terminated. Represents move-out date or service disconnection date. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: link_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this account-premise link record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking in customer relationship management.

attributes.name: link_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments regarding this account-premise relationship. Used by customer service representatives to document special circumstances, arrangements, or historical context.

attributes.name: link_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the account-premise relationship became effective. Represents move-in date or service initiation date for the account at this premise.

attributes.name: link_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the account-premise relationship. Indicates whether the link is currently in effect or has been terminated.

attributes.name: link_termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for termination of the account-premise relationship. Provides business context for why the link was ended. Null for active relationships.

attributes.name: link_type
attributes.description: Classification of the relationship between the account and premise. Defines the role and responsibility of the account holder at the service location.

attributes.name: master_metered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this relationship involves a master-metered configuration where a single meter serves multiple tenant accounts. Common in multi-family residential and commercial properties.

attributes.name: nem_participant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account-premise relationship involves a Net Energy Metering (NEM) participant with Behind the Meter (BTM) generation. Used to identify customers with distributed energy resources.
attributes.references: FERC Net Metering Policy, State PUC NEM Tariffs

attributes.name: notification_authorization_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the account holder has authorized receipt of outage notifications and service alerts for this premise. Used by Outage Management System (OMS) for customer communication.

attributes.name: occupancy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the occupancy status for this account-premise relationship. Indicates whether the account holder is an owner, tenant, or if the premise is vacant.

attributes.name: priority_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric ranking of this account-premise link when multiple accounts are associated with a single premise. Used to determine primary contact for outage notifications and field operations.

attributes.name: property_management_company_code
attributes.description: Reference to the property management company responsible for this premise when the link type is property manager. Used in commercial and multi-family property management scenarios.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record that originated this account-premise link. Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: source_system_key
attributes.description: Original primary key or unique identifier from the source system. Used for data reconciliation and bidirectional synchronization with operational systems.

attributes.name: vacancy_billing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether vacancy billing is active for this account-premise relationship. When true, the landlord or property manager is billed for usage during tenant vacancy periods.

products.name: credit_profile
products.description: Master entity capturing the credit classification and financial risk attributes of a customer account as managed within the CIS. Stores credit class code (excellent, good, fair, poor, new), credit score band, deposit requirement flag, deposit amount, deposit type (cash, surety bond, letter of credit), deposit waiver reason, credit review date, number of late payments in rolling 12 months, disconnection history count, bankruptcy flag, low-income program enrollment flag, and collections stage. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA credit management and Oracle CC&B credit configuration. Used by billing and collections domains for deposit calculation, disconnection eligibility, and payment arrangement qualification.
products.reference: SAP IS-U FICA Credit Management / Oracle CC&B Credit Profile

attributes.name: credit_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the credit profile record. Primary key for the credit profile entity.

attributes.name: credit_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account to which this credit profile applies. Links credit assessment to the billing account in CIS (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Contract Account; Oracle CC&B Account

attributes.name: to_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Credit classification is assessed per account. credit_profile.account_id → account.account_id.

attributes.name: average_monthly_payment_amount
attributes.description: Average monthly payment amount over the past 12 months. Used for deposit calculation and payment arrangement sizing.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment History Analysis

attributes.name: bankruptcy_discharge_date
attributes.description: Date the bankruptcy was discharged or dismissed. Credit profile may be eligible for upgrade after discharge and demonstration of payment performance.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Bankruptcy Code

attributes.name: bankruptcy_filing_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent bankruptcy filing. Used to determine if bankruptcy is still active and impacts credit classification duration.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); Bankruptcy Code

attributes.name: bankruptcy_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has an active or recent bankruptcy filing. Impacts collections strategy and may trigger automatic deposit requirement per PUC rules.
attributes.references: Fair Credit Reporting Act (FCRA); SAP IS-U FICA Bankruptcy Indicator

attributes.name: broken_arrangement_count
attributes.description: Number of payment arrangements that were broken (customer failed to make scheduled payments). Impacts future payment arrangement eligibility and credit classification.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Installment Plan Compliance; Oracle CC&B Payment Plan History

attributes.name: collections_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the collections process for past-due balances. Drives automated dunning notices, disconnection scheduling, and external collections referral. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: current|reminder|final_notice|disconnection_pending|disconnected|write_off|legal_action — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Collections Management; Oracle CC&B Collections Process

attributes.name: created_timestamp
