attributes.references: PUC Complaint Reporting Requirements; FERC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: contact_center_site
attributes.description: Identifier for the physical or virtual contact center site that handled this interaction (e.g., 'Phoenix_AZ', 'Virtual_Home_Agent', 'Offshore_Partner_Manila'). Supports site-level performance benchmarking and cost allocation.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Agent Management; SAP S/4HANA HR/HCM

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interaction record was first created in the source CIS/CRM system. Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and Silver layer ingestion tracking.

attributes.name: customer_satisfaction_score
attributes.description: Post-interaction customer satisfaction score collected via IVR survey, email survey, or SMS (typically 1–5 scale). Null when no survey response was received. Supports CRM analytics and PUC service quality reporting.
attributes.references: PUC Service Quality Standards; Oracle CC&B CRM Analytics

attributes.name: demand_response_enrollment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer enrolled in or modified a Demand Response (DR) or energy efficiency program during this interaction. True = DR enrollment action taken. Supports DERMS integration and regulatory DR program reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; NERC Demand Response Standards; DOE Energy Efficiency Programs

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interaction was initiated by the customer (inbound) or by the utility (outbound, e.g., proactive outage notification, collections call, demand response enrollment outreach).
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; NAESB Business Practice Standards

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time of the interaction in seconds from start to end. For calls, this is the total call handle time including hold time. Used for SLA compliance measurement and workforce management analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer interaction concluded (call disconnected, chat session closed, email response sent, visit ended). Used to compute handle time and duration metrics.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; NAESB Business Practice Standards

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction was escalated to a supervisor, specialist team, or regulatory complaint handler during or after the session. True = escalated. Supports regulatory complaint tracking required by PUC reporting.
attributes.references: PUC Complaint Reporting Requirements; Oracle CC&B Case Management

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason for escalation when escalation_flag is True (e.g., 'customer_requested_supervisor', 'regulatory_complaint', 'unresolved_billing_dispute'). Required for PUC complaint tracking and quality assurance.
attributes.references: PUC Complaint Reporting Requirements; FERC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: first_contact_resolution_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's issue was fully resolved during this single interaction without requiring a follow-up contact. True = resolved at first contact. Key CRM KPI and PUC service quality metric.
attributes.references: PUC Service Quality Standards; Oracle CC&B CRM Analytics

attributes.name: hold_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total time in seconds the customer was placed on hold during a call interaction. Contributes to customer experience scoring and agent performance metrics. Applicable primarily to inbound and outbound call channels.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM

attributes.name: interaction_category
attributes.description: High-level business category classifying the primary purpose of the interaction. 'outage_report' links to OMS event tracking. 'meter_inquiry' relates to AMI/MDM data. 'billing_inquiry' is the most frequent category in utility CRM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing_inquiry|outage_report|payment|complaint|general_inquiry|service_request|meter_inquiry|demand_response|new_service|disconnect_request — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM; PUC Complaint Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: interaction_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the interaction occurred, derived from interaction_start_timestamp. Stored as a separate DATE field to support efficient date-partitioned queries, daily reporting, and regulatory complaint date tracking.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; PUC Complaint Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: interaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interaction record. 'abandoned' applies to IVR or chat sessions where the customer disconnected before resolution. 'escalated' indicates transfer to a higher-tier agent or supervisor.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM

attributes.name: ivr_containment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's need was fully resolved within the IVR self-service system without requiring transfer to a live agent. True = IVR-contained; False = transferred to agent or unresolved. Key metric for IVR optimization and cost-to-serve analysis.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B IVR Integration; SAP IS-U CRM

attributes.name: ivr_menu_path
attributes.description: Sequence of IVR menu selections made by the customer during the interaction (e.g., '1>3>2' representing the menu tree traversal). Used for IVR design optimization and self-service analytics.

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code for the language used during the interaction (e.g., 'en', 'es', 'zh-TW'). Supports multilingual service analytics and compliance with state language access requirements for utility customers.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; State PUC Language Access Requirements

attributes.name: nem_inquiry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interaction involved a Net Energy Metering (NEM) inquiry, application, or billing question related to a customer's behind-the-meter (BTM) distributed energy resource (DER) such as rooftop solar. Supports NEM program analytics.
attributes.references: FERC PURPA; State PUC NEM Tariff Rules; DOE DER Integration Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the agent summarizing the interaction, customer concerns, actions taken, and follow-up commitments. Confidential as may contain sensitive account or personal context. Stored in Oracle CC&B or SAP IS-U CRM activity log.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM Activity; GDPR Article 5 (data minimization)

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: The result or disposition of the interaction at its conclusion. 'follow_up_required' triggers a subsequent outbound contact. 'callback_scheduled' indicates a scheduled return call was arranged. Used for first-contact resolution (FCR) measurement.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM; PUC Service Quality Standards

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment arrangement or deferred payment plan was established during this interaction. True = payment arrangement created. Supports collections analytics and FICA (Financial Customer Accounting) integration in SAP IS-U.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA; Oracle CC&B Collections Management; PUC Low-Income Customer Protection Rules

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this interaction, communicated to the customer as a confirmation or tracking number (e.g., from Oracle CC&B or SAP IS-U interaction log).
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM Activity

attributes.name: sentiment_classification
attributes.description: Customer sentiment assessed during or after the interaction, derived from speech analytics, text analysis, or agent classification. Supports CRM analytics, churn risk modeling, and regulatory complaint identification. 'highly_negative' may trigger proactive follow-up.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B CRM Analytics; SAP IS-U CRM

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this interaction record originated (e.g., SAP IS-U CRM, Oracle CC&B, Genesys telephony platform). Supports data lineage and Silver layer reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CRM; Oracle CC&B; NAESB Data Exchange Standards

attributes.name: source_system_interaction_reference
attributes.description: The native interaction identifier from the originating source system (e.g., Oracle CC&B interaction log ID, SAP IS-U activity number, Genesys call GUID). Enables traceability back to the system of record for audit and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CRM; Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer interaction began (call connected, chat session opened, email received, in-person visit commenced). Principal business event timestamp per TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Stored in ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; NAESB Business Practice Standards

attributes.name: subcategory
attributes.description: Granular sub-classification of the interaction within its category (e.g., 'high_bill_dispute' under billing_inquiry, 'payment_arrangement' under payment, 'tree_contact' under outage_report). Supports root-cause analytics and agent training.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM Activity

attributes.name: survey_response_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer completed a post-interaction satisfaction survey. True = survey completed. Used to calculate survey response rates and validate CSAT score population.
attributes.references: PUC Service Quality Standards; Oracle CC&B CRM Analytics

attributes.name: tou_rate_inquiry_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interaction involved a Time-of-Use (TOU) or Critical Peak Pricing (CPP) rate plan inquiry, enrollment, or change request. Supports rate analytics and AMI-enabled pricing program adoption tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Tariff; Oracle CC&B Rates Management; SAP IS-U Billing

attributes.name: transfer_count
attributes.description: Number of times the interaction was transferred between agents, queues, or departments during a single session. High transfer counts indicate routing inefficiency and negatively impact customer satisfaction scores.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Interaction History; SAP IS-U CRM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this interaction record in the source system. Used for incremental data pipeline processing and audit trail compliance.

products.name: complaint
products.description: Transactional entity capturing formal customer complaints filed through regulatory channels (PUC/PSC), internal escalation paths, or third-party mediators. Stores complaint date, complaint type (billing dispute, service quality, outage response, disconnection, rate dispute, discrimination, safety), complaint source (customer direct, PUC referral, BBB, social media, legislative inquiry), assigned resolution owner, regulatory docket number, PUC/PSC case reference, resolution deadline, resolution date, resolution type (upheld, dismissed, settled, withdrawn), customer satisfaction outcome, and escalation tier. Required for FERC, PUC, and state PSC regulatory reporting on complaint volumes, resolution rates, and response times.

products.name: customer_enrollment
products.description: Transactional entity and SSOT for all customer program participation across the utility. Captures enrollments in demand response (DR), time-of-use (TOU) rate plans, critical peak pricing (CPP) tariffs, budget billing, auto-pay, paperless billing, Net Energy Metering (NEM 1.0/2.0/3.0/NEM-ST) including interconnection application date, approval date, permission-to-operate date, installed capacity (kW-DC), inverter type, technology type (PV, wind, CHP), export compensation rate, annual true-up month, and cumulative export credits. Captures DER/VPP aggregation program enrollments including DER asset type (rooftop solar, battery storage, EV charger, smart thermostat, generator), DER registration ID, DERMS system reference, aggregator name, VPP program code, telemetry availability flag, communication protocol (IEEE 2030.5, OpenADR, Modbus), and dispatch authorization level. Captures medical baseline allowance certifications including certification type (life support, medical baseline allowance), qualifying condition, physician certification date, certification expiration, renewal reminder date, approved additional baseline kWh per day, and life-support equipment type (oxygen concentrator, dialysis, ventilator). Captures low-income assistance program enrollments (LIHEAP, CARE, FERA), green energy programs, EV charging incentive programs, and arrearage management plans. Stores program code, enrollment date, enrollment channel, enrollment status, effective start and end dates, opt-out date and reason, and all program-specific eligibility and technical attributes. Supports FERC Order 2222 compliance, PUC medical baseline tariff compliance, disconnection protection rules, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.description: The calendar month (1–12) in which the customer's annual NEM true-up billing cycle is settled. Determines when net export credits are reconciled against consumption charges for the 12-month period.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which the enrollment application was formally approved by the utility or regulatory authority. Relevant for NEM interconnection approvals, medical baseline certifications, and low-income program eligibility approvals.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U; FERC; State PUC

attributes.name: arrearage_forgiveness_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of past-due balance forgiven under an arrearage management program. [Moved from assistance_program: Arrearage forgiveness is applied at enrollment time and varies by account based on outstanding balance, making it enrollment-specific.]
attributes.references: State PUC Arrearage Management Program Rules

attributes.name: arrearage_forgiveness_date
attributes.description: Date when the arrearage forgiveness was applied to the customer account. [Moved from assistance_program: The date arrearage forgiveness was applied is specific to each enrollment instance.]
attributes.references: State PUC Arrearage Management Program Rules

attributes.name: arrearage_plan_balance
attributes.description: The outstanding balance (in USD) enrolled in the customer's Arrearage Management Plan (AMP). Tracks the deferred debt amount being managed under the structured repayment program. Null for non-AMP enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC Arrearage Management Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the medical baseline or life-support certification expires and must be renewed. Used to trigger renewal reminder notifications and manage disconnection protection eligibility.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff; CPUC General Order 111-G

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The channel through which the customer enrolled in the program. Supports multi-channel engagement analytics and channel effectiveness reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile_app|ivr|call_center|field_agent|mail|third_party|auto_enrolled — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: The communication protocol used for telemetry and dispatch signaling between the utility/DERMS and the customer's DER device. Determines interoperability requirements for demand response and VPP dispatch.
attributes.references: IEEE 2030.5; OpenADR Alliance; FERC Order 2222; IEC 61968

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the enrollment record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage, regulatory compliance, and SOX internal controls.
attributes.references: SOX; Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: cumulative_export_credits
attributes.description: The running balance of net energy export credits (in kWh) accumulated by the customer under the NEM program since the last annual true-up. Used for billing reconciliation and NEM settlement calculations.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; Oracle Utilities CC&B MDM

attributes.name: demand_response_program
attributes.description: Code identifying the Demand Response (DR) program in which this account is enrolled, such as interruptible load, direct load control, or automated demand response. Null if not enrolled. Drives DR dispatch eligibility and incentive payment calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: interruptible_load|direct_load_control|auto_dr|peak_time_rebate|emergency_dr|none — promote to reference product] [Moved from account: This code identifies a single DR program but does not support enrollment in multiple DR programs simultaneously, nor does it capture enrollment dates, participation level, or tier. Should be replaced by enrollment records linking to DR program records.]
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; State PUC DR Tariff; NERC BAL-002; NAESB WEQ

attributes.name: der_enrollment_status
attributes.description: Enrollment status of this account in a Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS) or Virtual Power Plant (VPP) program. Enrolled accounts may have their DER assets dispatched by the utility or grid operator for demand response, frequency regulation, or capacity services. [Moved from account: This status field indicates DER program enrollment status but belongs to the specific account-program enrollment relationship, not to the account itself. An account may be enrolled in multiple DER programs with different statuses. Should be captured as enrollment.status for DER program enrollments.]
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC DERMS Rules; NERC BAL-002; IEEE 2030.5

attributes.name: der_technology_type
attributes.description: The technology type of the customer's Distributed Energy Resource (DER) asset enrolled in the program. Used for DERMS registration, VPP aggregation, and FERC Order 2222 compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pv_solar|wind|chp|battery_storage|ev_charger|smart_thermostat|generator|fuel_cell — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; DERMS; State PUC; IEEE 2030.5

attributes.name: disconnection_protected
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer's account is protected from service disconnection due to medical baseline, life-support, or low-income program enrollment. True = disconnection protection active; False = no protection. Critical for collections and field operations.
attributes.references: State PUC Disconnection Rules; CPUC General Order 111-G

attributes.name: discount_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage discount applied to the customer bill under the assistance program (e.g., 20.00 for 20% discount). [Moved from assistance_program: While programs may have standard discount rates, the actual discount applied can vary by account based on rate class, usage tier, or household size, making it enrollment-specific.]

attributes.name: dispatch_authorization_level
attributes.description: The level of dispatch authority granted by the customer for their DER asset in demand response or VPP programs. 'full_auto' = utility can dispatch without customer action; 'semi_auto' = customer notified before dispatch; 'manual' = customer initiates; 'opt_in_only' = customer must opt in per event.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; OpenADR Alliance; State PUC DR Tariff

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the enrollment ceases to be effective. Null for open-ended enrollments. Used for term-limited programs, certification expirations, and contract end dates.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the enrollment becomes operationally effective and the customer begins receiving program benefits, rates, or obligations. May differ from enrollment_date due to billing cycle alignment or approval processing.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when customer eligibility was verified for the assistance program. [Moved from assistance_program: Verification date varies by enrollment instance based on when the customer submitted documentation.]

attributes.name: eligibility_verification_status
attributes.description: Current status of the customer eligibility verification process for the assistance program. [Moved from assistance_program: Verification status is specific to each account's enrollment application and documentation submission.]

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the customer submitted or was enrolled in the program. Represents the principal business event date (application/enrollment action date), distinct from the effective start date when benefits begin.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the enrollment record. 'pending' = application submitted, awaiting approval; 'active' = currently participating; 'suspended' = temporarily paused (e.g., medical review); 'cancelled' = voluntarily withdrawn; 'expired' = past effective end date; 'rejected' = application denied.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the enrollment expires and requires re-certification or renewal. [Moved from assistance_program: Enrollment expiration is specific to each account-program enrollment, not to the program definition.]

attributes.name: export_compensation_rate
attributes.description: The per-kilowatt-hour ($/kWh) rate at which the utility compensates the customer for net energy exported to the grid under the NEM tariff. Rate is locked at enrollment for grandfathered NEM versions. Null for non-NEM enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; PURPA; FERC

attributes.name: green_energy_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the customer's energy supply sourced from renewable energy under a green energy program enrollment (0–100%). Used for Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) allocation and Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC RPS; REC Registry; DOE

attributes.name: household_size
attributes.description: Number of individuals in the customer household used for eligibility determination. [Moved from assistance_program: Household size is captured at enrollment time for eligibility determination and may change between recertifications, making it enrollment-specific.]

attributes.name: income_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer's income eligibility was last verified for low-income assistance programs (CARE, FERA, LIHEAP). Used for periodic re-certification compliance and audit trails.
attributes.references: State PUC Low-Income Tariff; LIHEAP Federal Program; DOE

attributes.name: installed_capacity_kw_dc
attributes.description: The nameplate DC capacity in kilowatts (kW-DC) of the customer's installed distributed generation or storage system. Used for NEM eligibility sizing, export limit calculations, and DERMS registration. Applicable to NEM and DER/VPP enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; FERC Order 2222; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: interconnection_application_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer submitted the interconnection application for a distributed generation system (e.g., rooftop solar, battery storage). Applicable to NEM and DER enrollments. Required for FERC Order 2222 and state PUC interconnection tracking.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC Interconnection Rules; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: inverter_type
attributes.description: The type of inverter installed with the customer's solar PV or battery storage system. Relevant for NEM technical review, grid interconnection safety assessment, and DERMS telemetry compatibility.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547; State PUC Interconnection Rules; UL 1741

attributes.name: last_recertification_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent eligibility recertification completed by the customer. [Moved from assistance_program: Recertification history is specific to each account's enrollment, not to the program.]

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the enrollment record was most recently modified. Used for change data capture (CDC), audit trails, and downstream incremental processing in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX; Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: life_support_equipment_type
attributes.description: The type of electrically powered life-support medical equipment used by the customer or household member. Determines disconnection protection rules and priority restoration status during outages. Null for non-life-support enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff; CPUC General Order 111-G; OSHA

attributes.name: low_income_program
attributes.description: Code identifying the low-income assistance program in which this account is enrolled, such as CARE (California Alternate Rates for Energy), FERA (Family Electric Rate Assistance), LIHEAP, or utility-specific low-income discount programs. Drives rate discounts and disconnection protections. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: care|fera|liheap|utility_discount|none — promote to reference product] [Moved from account: This code identifies a single low-income program (CARE/FERA) but does not support enrollment in multiple assistance programs, nor does it capture enrollment date, eligibility verification date, tier assignment, or recertification schedule. Should be replaced by enrollment records.]
attributes.references: State PUC Low Income Tariff; LIHEAP (42 U.S.C. § 8621); California PUC CARE Program; State PUC

attributes.name: med_certification_type
attributes.description: The type of medical program certification for the customer. 'life_support' = customer or household member depends on electrically powered life-support equipment; 'medical_baseline_allowance' = customer qualifies for additional baseline energy allowance due to medical condition. Null for non-medical enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff; CPUC General Order 111-G

attributes.name: medical_baseline
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account has been approved for a Medical Baseline Allowance, providing additional low-cost energy allocation to customers with qualifying medical conditions that require life-support equipment or climate control. Governs disconnection protections and rate adjustments per PUC rules. [Moved from account: This boolean flag indicates medical baseline approval but does not capture approval date, expiration date, recertification schedule, or participation level. Should be replaced by enrollment records linking to the Medical Baseline Program with full lifecycle attributes.]
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; California PUC Rule 11; ADA; HIPAA (indirect)

attributes.name: monthly_credit_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monthly credit amount applied to the customer bill under the assistance program. [Moved from assistance_program: The monthly credit amount may vary by enrollment based on account characteristics, usage patterns, or tiered benefit structures.]

attributes.name: nem_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is enrolled in a Net Energy Metering (NEM) program, meaning the customer has behind-the-meter generation (typically solar PV) and receives bill credits for excess energy exported to the grid. Drives bidirectional metering requirements and NEM tariff application. [Moved from account: This boolean flag indicates NEM program participation but does not capture which NEM program, enrollment dates, or participation level. The flag should be replaced by enrollment records in the enrollment association that link to specific NEM program records with full lifecycle tracking.]
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; FERC PURPA; California PUC Rule 21; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: nem_version
attributes.description: The version of the Net Energy Metering tariff under which the customer is enrolled. Determines export compensation rate structure and true-up methodology. Null for non-NEM enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; CPUC Decision; PURPA

attributes.name: opt_out_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer voluntarily opted out of the program. Null if the customer has not opted out. Distinct from effective_end_date which may be system-driven.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: opt_out_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for the customer's voluntary withdrawal from the program. Used for churn analysis, program improvement, and regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: customer_request|moved|rate_change|financial_hardship|program_change|ineligible|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U; State PUC Tariff

attributes.name: permission_to_operate_date
attributes.description: The date on which the utility granted Permission to Operate (PTO) for the customer's distributed energy resource (DER) system. Marks the official start of NEM or DER export eligibility.
attributes.references: State PUC Interconnection Rules; FERC Order 2222; IEEE 1547

attributes.name: physician_certification_date
attributes.description: The date on which a licensed physician certified the customer's medical condition for the medical baseline allowance or life-support program. Required for PUC medical tariff compliance.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff; CPUC General Order 111-G

attributes.name: qualifying_condition
attributes.description: The medical condition or diagnosis that qualifies the customer for the medical baseline allowance or life-support program. Protected Health Information (PHI) — classified as restricted. Null for non-medical enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff; HIPAA; CPUC General Order 111-G

attributes.name: recertification_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the customer must complete eligibility recertification to maintain program enrollment. [Moved from assistance_program: Recertification cycles are specific to each enrollment instance based on initial enrollment date and program rules.]

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_date
attributes.description: The date on which the utility should send a renewal reminder notification to the customer for medical baseline or life-support certification renewal. Typically set a defined number of days before certification_expiration_date.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Tariff; CPUC General Order 111-G

attributes.name: telemetry_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time telemetry data is available from the customer's DER device for DERMS monitoring and dispatch. True = telemetry enabled; False = no real-time telemetry (manual or estimated dispatch).

attributes.name: total_benefit_received_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative total benefit amount the customer has received to date under the current enrollment. [Moved from assistance_program: This is a cumulative metric specific to each account's enrollment, tracking total benefits received to date for this enrollment instance.]

attributes.name: tou_rate_plan_code
attributes.description: The specific Time-of-Use (TOU) or Critical Peak Pricing (CPP) rate plan code assigned to the customer under this enrollment. Maps to the tariff schedule in the billing system. Null for non-rate-plan enrollments.
attributes.references: State PUC TOU Tariff; Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: vpp_program_code
attributes.description: The utility-assigned code for the Virtual Power Plant (VPP) aggregation program in which the customer's DER is enrolled. Used for dispatch scheduling, settlement, and FERC Order 2222 reporting.

products.name: move_order
products.description: Transactional entity capturing move-in, move-out, and transfer-of-service orders that initiate or terminate service at a premise. Stores order type (move-in, move-out, transfer), requested date, actual effective date, prior account reference, new account reference, premise reference, meter read date at move, final read value, deposit disposition, and order status. Sourced from SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out and Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service. Triggers meter read scheduling and final bill generation in downstream domains.
products.reference: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out / Oracle CC&B Start-Stop Service

attributes.name: move_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the move order record in the Silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: customer_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.customer_service_agreement. Business justification: Move order (move-in, move-out, transfer) should reference the service agreement being initiated or terminated. Currently move_order has account_id and premise_id but no service_agreement_id. This FK e

attributes.name: field_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field work order created in the asset/workforce management system (Ventyx Asset Suite) to execute the physical service connection, disconnection, or meter read associated with this move order. Links the CIS move order to the field operations domain.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the meter device installed at the service point at the time of the move order. Used to schedule move-in/move-out meter reads and link final read values to the correct device record in the Metering domain.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle Utilities MDM; AMI infrastructure standards

attributes.name: meter_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service point (metering point / point of delivery) at the premise where service is being initiated or terminated. A premise may have multiple service points (e.g., electric and gas).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Connection Object; Oracle CC&B Service Point; NAESB Retail Electric Provider standards

attributes.name: move_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Move orders initiate/terminate service for an account. move_order.account_id → account.account_id.

attributes.name: move_premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service premise (physical location) at which the move order is being executed. Central linkage to the premise master record for address, meter, and distribution asset context.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Premise Management; Oracle CC&B Premise; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: primary_move_prior_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the existing service account being closed or vacated as part of this move order. Populated for move-out and transfer order types. Used to trigger final bill generation and deposit disposition in the billing domain.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U EVER; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer party initiating the move order. Links to the customer master record in the Customer domain. For a transfer, this is the incoming customer (move-in party).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner; Oracle CC&B Customer Management

attributes.name: tertiary_move_prior_occupant_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the account of the previous occupant at the premise, if known at the time of the move-in order. Used to coordinate final bill issuance for the departing customer and to identify any outstanding balance or deposit transfer obligations.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: to_premise_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.premise.premise_id — Move orders reference the premise where service starts/stops. move_order.premise_id → premise.premise_id.

attributes.name: budget_billing_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is enrolled in a budget billing (levelized payment) plan at the time of the move order. When true, the final bill calculation must account for any budget billing true-up balance upon move-out.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing; Oracle CC&B Billing; State PUC budget billing tariff rules

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded reason explaining why the move order was cancelled or rejected. Populated only when order_status is 'cancelled' or 'rejected'. Used for operational quality analysis and customer service improvement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The customer engagement channel through which the move order was submitted. Supports multi-channel analytics and CRM reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web_portal|mobile_app|call_center|walk_in|field_crew|ivr|third_party — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Customer Management; SAP IS-U CIS; CRM channel analytics standards

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the move order was fully completed and all downstream actions (meter read, billing, account activation/deactivation) were confirmed. Distinct from effective_date (the business date of service change) and submitted_timestamp (when the order was placed).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; State PUC SLA requirements

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this move order record was first created in the Silver layer data store. Distinct from submitted_timestamp which reflects the business event time.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007 audit logging requirements

attributes.name: credit_check_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a credit check was required for this move-in or transfer order based on the customer's credit classification or account history. When true, the move order may be held pending credit review and deposit determination per SAP IS-U FICA or Oracle CC&B Collections rules.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA; Oracle CC&B Collections; State PUC credit and deposit regulations

attributes.name: credit_check_status
attributes.description: The outcome of the credit check performed for this move order. Not_required: credit check was not triggered. Passed: customer met credit criteria. Failed: customer did not meet criteria (deposit required). Pending: check in progress. Waived: credit check bypassed per business rules (e.g., existing customer in good standing).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA; Oracle CC&B Collections; State PUC credit regulations

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this move order (deposit_amount, final_bill_amount). Typically USD for North American utilities. Supports multi-currency operations for utilities with international operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; FERC financial reporting standards; SOX

attributes.name: demand_response_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer or premise is enrolled in a Demand Response (DR) program at the time of the move order. When true, the DR program administrator must be notified to update enrollment records and avoid erroneous dispatch signals.
attributes.references: FERC Order 745; State PUC DR program rules; DOE demand response guidelines

attributes.name: deposit_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the security deposit associated with the prior or new account at the time of the move order. Used to determine deposit disposition (refund, transfer, or application to final bill balance) upon move-out or transfer.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA; Oracle CC&B Collections; State PUC deposit regulations

attributes.name: deposit_disposition
attributes.description: The outcome or planned treatment of the security deposit upon move-out or transfer. Refund: returned to customer. Applied_to_balance: offset against outstanding final bill. Transferred: moved to new account. Forfeited: retained by utility per tariff terms. Pending: disposition not yet determined.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA; Oracle CC&B Collections; State PUC deposit regulations

attributes.name: der_enrolled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the premise associated with this move order has an active Distributed Energy Resource (DER) enrollment (e.g., battery storage, EV charger, demand response program). When true, triggers DERMS notification and DER agreement review upon move-out or transfer.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC DER interconnection rules; DERMS integration standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the service change (move-in, move-out, or transfer) became effective at the premise. Used as the billing boundary date for final bill generation and new account activation. May differ from requested_date due to scheduling constraints or field execution timing.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U EVER; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; FERC billing standards; State PUC tariff requirements

attributes.name: final_bill_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary amount of the final bill generated as a result of the move-out or transfer order. Represents the net amount owed by or to the customer after applying the final meter read, applicable tariff rates, taxes, and deposit disposition.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing; Oracle CC&B Billing; State PUC tariff requirements; SOX financial reporting

attributes.name: final_read_value
attributes.description: The meter register reading (in kWh or applicable unit) captured at the time of the move order. For move-out, this is the closing read used to calculate the final bill. For move-in, this is the opening read establishing the new billing baseline.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle Utilities MDM; ANSI C12.20 metering accuracy standards

attributes.name: landlord_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the property owner or landlord must be notified of the service change per tariff rules or regulatory requirements. Relevant for rental properties where the landlord has a standing notification agreement with the utility.
attributes.references: State PUC landlord notification tariff rules; Oracle CC&B Customer Management

attributes.name: landlord_notified_date
attributes.description: The date on which the landlord or property owner was notified of the service change associated with this move order. Populated only when landlord_notification_required is true. Used for regulatory compliance documentation.
attributes.references: State PUC landlord notification tariff rules; Oracle CC&B Customer Management

attributes.name: medical_baseline
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has an approved medical baseline allowance (life support or medical necessity designation) that requires special handling during service disconnection or move-out. When true, additional notification and regulatory compliance steps are required before service termination.
attributes.references: State PUC medical baseline tariff rules; CPUC Rule 14; DOE energy assistance guidelines

attributes.name: meter_read_date
attributes.description: The date on which the meter was physically or remotely read in connection with this move order. Used as the billing cut-off date for the final bill (move-out) or the start-of-service read date (move-in). Sourced from Oracle Utilities MDM or SAP IS-U Device Management.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle Utilities MDM; State PUC metering standards

attributes.name: nem_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer associated with this move order is enrolled in a Net Energy Metering (NEM) program, typically due to rooftop solar or other behind-the-meter (BTM) generation. When true, triggers specialized NEM billing and interconnection review processes upon move-in or move-out.
attributes.references: FERC PURPA; State PUC NEM tariff rules; CPUC NEM 2.0/3.0 regulations

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the move order, assigned by the source system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Used for customer-facing correspondence and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the move order workflow. Pending: submitted but not yet processed. In_progress: actively being executed (meter read scheduled, field crew dispatched). Completed: service change fully effected. Cancelled: withdrawn before execution. Rejected: failed validation or business rules.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the service order: move_in (new service activation at a premise), move_out (service termination at a premise), transfer (simultaneous move-out and move-in for a change of occupant), reconnect (restoration of previously disconnected service), or disconnect (non-payment or voluntary disconnection). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: move_in|move_out|transfer|reconnect|disconnect — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP IS-U EVER; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; NAESB Retail Electric Provider standards

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: The tariff rate schedule code assigned to the new service account upon move-in or transfer. Determines the billing rate class (e.g., residential, small commercial, large industrial, TOU, CPP). Sourced from the applicable PUC-approved tariff.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Rate Management; Oracle CC&B Rates; State PUC tariff filings; FERC OATT

attributes.name: read_type
attributes.description: Indicates how the move-order meter read was obtained: actual (field technician physical read), estimated (calculated based on usage history when actual read is unavailable), AMI_remote (automated read via Advanced Metering Infrastructure), or customer_self_read (customer-reported reading).
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE rules; SAP IS-U Device Management; State PUC metering standards

attributes.name: read_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the final_read_value. Typically kWh for electric meters, but may be therms, CCF, or MCF for gas service points. Ensures correct interpretation of the meter read value across commodity types.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle Utilities MDM; ANSI C12.20; NAESB standards

attributes.name: remarks
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or exceptions associated with this move order. May include field crew instructions, customer-specific handling notes, or escalation details entered by customer service representatives.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: requested_date
attributes.description: The date the customer requested the service change to take effect. This is the customer-stated desired effective date, which may differ from the actual effective date after scheduling and field execution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U EVER; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; State PUC service connection standards

attributes.name: scheduled_read_date
attributes.description: The date on which the meter read associated with this move order is scheduled to be performed. May differ from meter_read_date (actual read date) if the read is rescheduled or delayed. Used for field crew scheduling and MDM read request management.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management; State PUC metering standards

attributes.name: service_class
attributes.description: Customer service classification at the time of the move order, determining applicable tariff, billing rules, and regulatory reporting category. Residential, small commercial, large commercial, industrial, agricultural, or lighting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Rate Management; Oracle CC&B Customer Class; State PUC tariff classifications; FERC Form 1

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the utility's regulated service territory within which the premise is located. Used for regulatory reporting to State PUCs, FERC Form 1 filings, and NERC reliability reporting. Determines applicable tariff jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC service territory maps; NERC reliability reporting

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this move order record was sourced. SAP_IS-U: SAP Industry Solution for Utilities. Oracle_CCB: Oracle Utilities Customer Care and Billing. Manual: entered directly into the data platform. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle CC&B; Enterprise Data Governance standards

attributes.name: source_system_order_reference
attributes.description: The native primary key or order identifier from the originating operational system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Enables traceability back to the source system record for audit, reconciliation, and issue resolution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service; SOX audit trail requirements

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the move order was first submitted into the CIS system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Represents the principal business event timestamp for order creation. Used for SLA tracking and order aging analysis.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Move-In/Move-Out; Oracle CC&B Start/Stop Service

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this move order record was most recently modified in the Silver layer data store. Used for change data capture and incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007 audit logging requirements

products.name: third_party_authorization
products.description: Master entity and SSOT for all customer-granted authorizations, explicit consent events, and data-sharing permissions. Captures third-party access authorizations including authorized party name, authorization type (view-only, full access, notification-only, landlord, property manager, aggregator, DERMS provider), and authorization scope. Captures all consent events including consent for data sharing, marketing communications, Green Button data access, electronic signature agreements, and third-party aggregator authorization. Stores consent type and version, consent channel (web portal, mobile app, IVR, paper, written, electronic, verbal with recording reference), consent date and time, consent text version reference, IP address or session token, authorization start and end dates, revocation/withdrawal date and reason. Required for FERC Order 2222 DER aggregator access, Green Button data sharing compliance, GDPR, CCPA, and state PUC data privacy requirements.
products.reference: Oracle CC&B Third Party Access / Green Button Connect My Data

attributes.name: third_party_authorization_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each third-party authorization or consent record. Primary key for the third_party_authorization data product within the customer domain SSOT.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U CIS

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Third-party authorizations are granted per account. third_party_authorization.account_id → account.account_id.

attributes.name: customer_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the DER program enrollment record associated with this authorization. Populated when the authorization grants a DERMS provider or aggregator access to dispatch or monitor a customer's distributed energy resource (solar, battery, EV charger, etc.).
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC DER Rules; NAESB

attributes.name: dr_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the demand response program for which this authorization grants aggregator or DERMS provider access. Links the authorization to a specific DR or Virtual Power Plant (VPP) program managed by the utility or ISO/RTO.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC DR Rules; NAESB

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee or agent identifier of the utility customer service representative who processed or witnessed this authorization on behalf of the customer (e.g., for paper, verbal, or IVR-assisted consents). Null for fully self-service digital consents.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B; State PUC Customer Service Rules

attributes.name: ferc_aggregator_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Aggregator ID
attributes.description: FERC-registered identifier for the demand response or DER aggregator authorized under FERC Order 2222. Required when authorization_type is 'aggregator' or 'derms_provider'. Enables regulatory traceability of aggregator participation in wholesale markets.

attributes.name: notification_preference_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.notification_preference. Business justification: Third‑party authorizations reference a notification preference code; replace with FK to notification_preference to normalize and give inbound link to notification_preference.

attributes.name: ppa_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.ppa_contract. Business justification: Third-party PPA agreements require explicit customer authorization for data sharing, billing coordination, and account access. Critical for community solar subscriptions and third-party ownership mode

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service premise (physical location) covered by this authorization. Relevant for landlord, property manager, and aggregator authorizations scoped to a specific service address.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U CIS

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account holder who granted this authorization or consent. Links to the master customer record in the CIS (SAP IS-U / Oracle CC&B).
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U CIS

attributes.name: third_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific utility service account to which this authorization applies. A customer may have multiple accounts (residential, commercial, NEM, DER-enrolled) and authorizations are scoped at the account level.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U CIS

attributes.name: to_account_id
attributes.description: FK to customer.account.account_id — Authorizations and consent records are granted by a customer account. Required for FERC Order 2222 aggregator access, Green Button compliance, and CCPA/GDPR data sharing.

attributes.name: authorization_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this authorization record, used in customer correspondence, audit trails, and regulatory submissions. Formatted as AUTH- followed by a 10-digit sequence.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; NAESB

attributes.name: authorization_scope
attributes.description: Textual description of the specific data, services, or actions covered by this authorization. Examples include: interval usage data, billing history, account balance, demand response enrollment, Green Button data, DER dispatch commands. Captures the granular scope agreed to by the customer.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; Green Button Alliance; CCPA; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the authorization record. Active indicates the authorization is in force; pending indicates awaiting customer confirmation; suspended indicates temporarily paused; revoked indicates customer-initiated withdrawal; expired indicates the authorization end date has passed.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; CCPA; GDPR Article 7; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: authorization_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the access level or relationship type granted to the third party. Determines what actions the authorized party may perform: view_only (read-only data access), full_access (read and transact), notification_only (receive alerts), landlord (property owner access), property_manager (delegated property management), aggregator (demand response or VPP aggregator per FERC Order 2222), derms_provider (Distributed Energy Resource Management System provider access). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: view_only|full_access|notification_only|landlord|property_manager|aggregator|derms_provider — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; NERC CIP; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; NAESB

attributes.name: authorized_party_identifier
attributes.description: External registration or license number identifying the authorized third party, such as a FERC-registered aggregator ID, state PUC license number, or business registration number. Used for regulatory verification and audit.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; NAESB

attributes.name: authorized_party_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the third party (individual, company, or organization) to whom access or authority has been granted. May be a landlord, property management company, demand response aggregator, DERMS provider, or other authorized entity.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; CCPA; GDPR Article 4; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: authorized_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the authorized third party entity type. Distinguishes between individual persons (e.g., family member, tenant), commercial companies (e.g., property management firm), aggregators (demand response or VPP aggregators per FERC Order 2222), government agencies, and non-profit organizations.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; NAESB; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization record is subject to CCPA consumer rights obligations (right to know, right to delete, right to opt-out of sale). Relevant for California utility customers and California-regulated service territories.
attributes.references: CCPA; California PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: consent_channel
attributes.description: The channel or medium through which the customer provided consent or authorization. Captures: web_portal (online self-service), mobile_app (utility mobile application), ivr (Interactive Voice Response system), paper (physical form), written (written correspondence), electronic (email or e-sign), verbal (recorded phone call). Required for regulatory proof of consent method. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web_portal|mobile_app|ivr|paper|written|electronic|verbal — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; NAESB

attributes.name: consent_text_reference
attributes.description: Document reference or URL pointing to the exact consent language text presented to the customer. Used for legal and regulatory audit to confirm the precise wording agreed to at the time of consent.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: consent_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time (with timezone) at which the customer provided consent or authorization. This is the principal real-world event time for the consent act, distinct from the record creation audit timestamp. Critical for GDPR, CCPA, and state PUC compliance audit trails.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the consent event captured in this record. Covers: data_sharing (general data access consent), marketing (communications consent), green_button (Green Button Connect My Data consent), electronic_signature (e-sign agreement), aggregator (third-party aggregator authorization), der_enrollment (DER program enrollment consent), nem_participation (Net Energy Metering participation consent). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: data_sharing|marketing|green_button|electronic_signature|aggregator|der_enrollment|nem_participation|demand_response — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Green Button Alliance; FERC Order 2222; CCPA; GDPR Article 7; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; PURPA; NEM Tariff

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent text or terms presented to the customer at the time of consent capture. Enables tracking of which version of the consent language was agreed to, supporting regulatory audit and re-consent workflows when terms change.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this authorization record was first created in the system. Audit timestamp for data lineage and regulatory record-keeping. Distinct from consent_timestamp, which captures the real-world consent event time.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: data_access_end_date
attributes.description: The latest date through which data may be accessed by the authorized third party. Defines the forward boundary of the data sharing window. Distinct from effective_end_date, which governs the authorization itself; this field governs the data time range.
attributes.references: Green Button Alliance; FERC Order 2222; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: data_access_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date from which historical usage or account data may be accessed by the authorized third party under this authorization. Defines the lookback window for Green Button data sharing, aggregator access, and DERMS data feeds.
attributes.references: Green Button Alliance; FERC Order 2222; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this authorization or consent expires and the authorized party's access terminates. Nullable for open-ended authorizations. When populated, the system must enforce access revocation on or after this date.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; CCPA; GDPR Article 7; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which this authorization or consent becomes effective and the authorized party may begin exercising the granted access or permissions. May differ from consent_timestamp if a future start date was agreed.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; NAESB

attributes.name: electronic_signature_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the electronic signature record associated with this authorization, stored in the e-signature platform. Provides legal proof of customer agreement for electronically executed authorizations. Populated when consent_channel is 'electronic' or 'electronic_signature'.
attributes.references: ESIGN Act; UETA; GDPR Article 7; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization record is subject to GDPR data subject rights obligations (right to access, right to erasure, right to portability). Relevant for utility customers in GDPR-applicable jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; GDPR Article 7; GDPR Article 17

attributes.name: green_button_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization enables Green Button Connect My Data (CMD) access for the authorized third party. When true, the authorized party may retrieve interval energy usage data via the Green Button API. Supports DOE Green Button initiative compliance.
attributes.references: Green Button Alliance; DOE Green Button Initiative; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which the customer submitted the consent or authorization via a digital channel (web portal or mobile app). Used for fraud detection, audit trail, and regulatory proof of digital consent. Null for non-digital channels (paper, IVR, verbal).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: last_reviewed_date
attributes.description: The most recent date on which the customer confirmed, reviewed, or re-consented to this authorization. Used to track the currency of consent and trigger re-consent workflows when the review interval has elapsed.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this authorization record was most recently modified in the system. Supports change data capture, audit trails, and incremental lakehouse processing.
attributes.references: SOX; GDPR Article 5; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: marketing_consent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has provided explicit consent to receive marketing communications from the utility or its authorized partners. Distinct from data sharing consent. Required for GDPR Article 6 and CCPA opt-in/opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; CAN-SPAM Act; State PUC Customer Service Rules

attributes.name: nem_participant
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization is associated with a Net Energy Metering (NEM) enrolled customer account. When true, the authorization may cover behind-the-meter (BTM) generation data sharing with aggregators or DERMS providers.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; PURPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: paper_form_reference
attributes.description: Document management reference or scan identifier for the physical paper authorization form submitted by the customer. Populated when consent_channel is 'paper' or 'written'. Enables retrieval of the original signed document for audit.
attributes.references: State PUC Data Privacy Rules; SOX; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: puc_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) jurisdiction governing this authorization. Determines which state-specific data privacy and customer authorization rules apply. Required for multi-state utility operations.
attributes.references: State PUC Data Privacy Rules; NAESB; NERC

attributes.name: renewal_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between required authorization renewals when renewal_required is true. Common values are 365 (annual) or 730 (biennial) per state PUC requirements. Drives automated renewal reminder workflows in the CIS.
attributes.references: State PUC Data Privacy Rules; FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: renewal_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this authorization requires periodic renewal by the customer. When true, the system must generate renewal notifications before the effective_end_date. Supports compliance with state PUC rules requiring periodic re-consent for ongoing data sharing.
attributes.references: State PUC Data Privacy Rules; FERC Order 2222; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the customer withdrew or revoked this authorization prior to its scheduled end date. Populated only when the customer initiates early termination. Triggers downstream access revocation in CIS, DERMS, and Green Button systems.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why this authorization was revoked or withdrawn. Supports regulatory reporting and customer service analytics. Values: customer_request (voluntary withdrawal), account_closure (account terminated), fraud_reported (suspected unauthorized access), regulatory_order (PUC or FERC directive), system_expiry (automated expiry), other.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: session_token
attributes.description: Authenticated session token or transaction reference from the digital channel (web portal or mobile app) at the time of consent capture. Provides a cryptographic audit trail linking the consent event to a verified authenticated session. Null for non-digital channels.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA; State PUC Data Privacy Rules; NIST SP 800-63

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system of record from which this authorization record originated. Identifies whether the record was created in SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B, the customer web portal, mobile app, IVR system, or via manual data entry. Supports data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B; NAESB

attributes.name: source_system_reference_code
attributes.description: The native identifier of this authorization record in the originating operational system (SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the CIS system of record.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: verbal_recording_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the call recording in which verbal consent was captured (e.g., IVR or agent-assisted phone call). Links to the call recording archive for regulatory audit. Populated only when consent_channel is 'verbal' or 'ivr'.
attributes.references: State PUC Data Privacy Rules; CCPA; GDPR Article 7

products.name: incentive_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between a utility customer account and a renewable energy incentive program. It captures the application, approval, payment tracking, and compliance verification lifecycle for each account's participation in each incentive program. Each record links one account to one incentive program with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific enrollment relationship, including application details, approved funding amounts, payment schedules, disbursement tracking, and ongoing compliance status.. Existence Justification: In utility renewable energy operations, a customer account can simultaneously participate in multiple incentive programs (e.g., a residential customer with solar PV enrolled in both an ITC rebate program and an SREC program, plus a separate battery storage incentive). Conversely, each incentive program serves hundreds or thousands of customer accounts. The utility actively manages these enrollments as operational business entities, tracking application workflows, approval processes, payment disbursements, compliance verification, and budget allocation for each account-program combination.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: incentive_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this incentive program enrollment record. Primary key for the association.

attributes.name: account_id
