products.name: rate_schedule
products.description: Master reference entity defining tariff rate schedules and their granular charge components applicable to customer accounts. At the schedule level: stores rate code, effective dates, rate class, voltage level, applicable customer segments, regulatory approval references, and jurisdiction. At the component level: captures individual charge elements including energy charges ($/kWh), demand charges ($/kW), customer charges, fuel adjustment clauses, distribution charges, transmission charges, and riders with component type, unit of measure, tier thresholds, seasonal applicability, time-of-use period mapping, and calculation formula. Sourced from SAP IS-U and Oracle CC&B rate configuration modules. SSOT for all rate definitions and charge component structures used in bill calculation. Supports rate case filings and regulatory tariff compliance.

Flat applies a single rate, tiered uses progressive rate steps, block uses declining block rates, TOU (time-of-use) varies by time period, CPP (critical peak pricing) applies premium rates during peak events, real-time uses dynamic pricing, formula uses a custom calculation expression. attributes.description: Classification of the rate component indicating the nature of the charge. attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this rate component expires and is no longer applied to customer bills. Null indicates the component is currently active with no planned end date.

attributes.description: Date when this rate component becomes effective and can be applied to customer bills. Aligns with PUC rate case approval dates.

attributes.name: gl_account_code

attributes.name: index_reference
attributes.description: External market index or benchmark used to calculate this component if it is formula-based or indexed (e.g., Henry Hub natural gas price, PJM LMP, CPI). Null for fixed-rate components.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate component record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: maximum_charge
attributes.description: Maximum charge cap for this component. Used to limit exposure for certain rate components or to comply with regulatory caps.

attributes.name: minimum_charge
attributes.description: Minimum charge amount that must be applied for this component regardless of usage. Common for customer charges and demand charges with minimum billing requirements.

attributes.name: print_on_bill_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate component should appear as a separate line item on customer bills. True for customer-visible charges, False for internal calculation components that roll up into other line items.

attributes.name: proration_method
attributes.description: Method used to prorate charges for partial billing periods (e.g., when a customer starts or stops service mid-cycle). Daily proration divides by days in period, calendar uses actual calendar days, billing uses billing cycle days.

attributes.name: puc_docket_number
attributes.description: Public Utility Commission docket or case number associated with the rate case that approved this component. Used for regulatory compliance tracking and audit trails.

attributes.name: rate_value

attributes.name: regulatory_account_code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code or state regulatory accounting code used for revenue recognition and regulatory reporting of charges from this component.

attributes.name: revenue_class
attributes.description: Classification of revenue type for financial and regulatory reporting. Aligns with FERC revenue categories and state regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: rider_code
attributes.description: Short code identifying the rider or surcharge if this component is a supplemental charge (e.g., FAC for Fuel Adjustment Clause, EEC for Energy Efficiency Charge, REC for Renewable Energy Charge). Null for base rate components.

attributes.name: rounding_rule
attributes.description: Rounding method applied to calculated charges for this component. Round_half_up is standard commercial rounding, round_down always rounds down, round_up always rounds up, truncate drops decimals.

attributes.name: seasonal_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates which season or time period this rate component applies to. Many utilities have different rates for summer (high cooling demand) versus winter periods. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: year_round|summer|winter|spring|fall|peak_season|off_peak_season — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: tariff_sheet_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific tariff sheet number or section in the official tariff book where this rate component is documented. Used for regulatory compliance and customer inquiries.

attributes.name: tax_exempt_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate component is exempt from sales tax or other taxes. True if exempt, False if taxable.

attributes.name: tier_sequence
attributes.description: Sequence number for tiered or block rate structures, indicating the order of rate tiers (1 for first tier, 2 for second tier, etc.). Null for non-tiered components.

attributes.name: tier_threshold_max
attributes.description: Maximum usage threshold for this tier in the specified unit of measure. Null indicates no upper limit (open-ended tier). Null for non-tiered components.

attributes.name: tier_threshold_min
attributes.description: Minimum usage threshold for this tier in the specified unit of measure. For example, tier 1 might be 0 kWh, tier 2 might be 500 kWh. Null for non-tiered components.

attributes.name: tou_end_time
attributes.description: End time for the TOU period in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). For example, on-peak might end at 21:00. Null for non-TOU components.

attributes.name: tou_period
attributes.description: Time-of-use period classification for TOU rate structures. On-peak represents highest demand periods, off-peak represents lowest demand periods, critical-peak represents emergency high-demand events.

attributes.name: tou_start_time
attributes.description: Start time for the TOU period in HH:MM format (24-hour clock). For example, on-peak might start at 14:00. Null for non-TOU components.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit of measure for this rate component. Common values include kWh (kilowatt-hour) for energy consumption, kW (kilowatt) for demand, account for fixed customer charges, day/month for time-based charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: kWh|kW|MWh|MW|account|day|month|therm|ccf — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

products.name: invoice
products.description: Core transactional entity representing a utility bill issued to a customer for a billing period, including header-level totals and granular line-item charge detail. At the header level: captures invoice number, billing period dates, due date, total amount due, energy consumed (kWh/MWh), demand (kW), prior balance, current charges, taxes, adjustments, and payment status. At the line level: captures individual charge components including energy charges, demand charges, customer charges, fuel adjustment clauses, distribution riders, taxes, and credits with rate component reference, quantity, unit rate, calculated amount, and applicable billing determinant. Generated from Oracle CC&B and SAP IS-U billing engine. SSOT for all customer-facing billing documents and their charge detail. Supports SOX AR controls, granular revenue recognition, rate component-level analysis, and regulatory rate case evidence.

products.name: payment
products.description: Transactional record of all customer payment activity including inbound payments received and outbound refunds disbursed against outstanding invoices or account balances. For inbound payments: captures payment date, amount, method (check, ACH, credit card, cash, online, auto-pay), channel (IVR, web, walk-in, mail), reference number, bank routing details, and application status. For outbound refunds: captures refund date, amount, disbursement method (check, ACH, account credit), reason code (overpayment, deposit return, credit balance, billing error), originating credit source, approval status, and disbursement confirmation. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA and Oracle CC&B payment processing. SSOT for all cash receipts and disbursements in the revenue cycle. Supports cash application controls and SOX compliance.

attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Tracks progression from initial receipt through clearing and application to customer account balance.

attributes.name: payment_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment transaction was recorded in the billing system. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls - IT General Controls

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment transaction direction and purpose. Inbound payments represent cash receipts from customers; outbound refunds represent disbursements to customers.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Accounting date when the payment transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from payment_date due to batch processing timing or period-end cutoffs.
attributes.references: GAAP Financial Reporting, SAP S/4HANA FI-GL

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or confirmation code for the payment transaction. May include check number, ACH trace number, credit card authorization code, or online payment confirmation ID.

attributes.name: refund_approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow status for refund approval process. Tracks management review and authorization for outbound refund disbursements. Null for inbound payments.

attributes.name: refund_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the refund was approved for disbursement. Part of the audit trail for financial controls. Null for inbound payments.

attributes.name: refund_approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the employee who authorized the refund disbursement. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail. Null for inbound payments.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method by which the refund is disbursed to the customer. May be check, ACH transfer, account credit, or reversal to original payment method. Null for inbound payments.

attributes.name: refund_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for issuing a refund to the customer. Null for inbound payments. Used for refund analytics and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Refund Processing, State PUC Reporting

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment was reversed. Null if payment has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payment transaction has been reversed due to NSF (non-sufficient funds), chargeback, or administrative correction. True if reversed, false otherwise.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Return Codes, Card Network Chargeback Rules

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for payment reversal. Includes NSF returns, chargebacks, disputes, and administrative corrections. Null if payment has not been reversed.
attributes.references: NACHA ACH Return Reason Codes, Card Network Chargeback Reason Codes

attributes.name: service_agreement
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Payments may be applied at the account/service agreement level when not tied to a specific invoice (e.g., prepayments, deposits).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the source system or module that originated the payment transaction record. Examples include SAP IS-U FICA, Oracle CC&B, payment gateway integration, or third-party payment processor.

attributes.name: to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Payments are received for a customer service agreement. Needed when payments are applied at account level rather than invoice level.

attributes.name: transaction_reference
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor. Used for reconciliation, chargebacks, and technical support inquiries.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that remains unapplied and held as account credit. Occurs when payment exceeds outstanding balance or when application is suspended pending dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Unapplied Cash Management

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created this payment record. May be a customer service representative, automated batch process, or payment gateway integration.

products.name: payment_arrangement
products.description: Master entity representing a formal installment or deferred payment plan negotiated with a customer to resolve past-due balances. Captures arrangement type, total amount owed, number of installments, installment amounts, scheduled payment dates, down payment, arrangement status, breach conditions, and associated collections case. Managed within SAP IS-U FICA and Oracle CC&B collections modules.
products.reference: Payment Plan / Installment Agreement

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment arrangement. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Contract Account Management

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which this payment arrangement was established.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer service representative or collections agent who approved the payment arrangement terms.

attributes.name: interconnection_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.application. Business justification: High interconnection costs (impact studies, network upgrades, inspection fees) often require payment arrangements. Business process: Customers unable to pay upfront interconnection fees negotiate inst

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment arrangement was formally approved and became binding.

attributes.name: arrangement_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when the final installment is due and the arrangement is expected to be completed. Nullable for open-ended arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Installment Plan End Date

attributes.name: arrangement_for_collections_case
attributes.description: FK to billing.collections_case.collections_case_id — Payment arrangements are negotiated to resolve a collections case. This FK links the installment plan to the delinquent balance being resolved.

attributes.name: arrangement_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the payment arrangement, typically displayed on customer correspondence and used in collections workflows.

attributes.name: arrangement_start_date
attributes.description: Effective date when the payment arrangement becomes binding and the first installment schedule begins.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Installment Plan Start Date

attributes.name: arrangement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the payment arrangement. Draft indicates pending approval; active means in effect and customer is making payments; completed when all obligations fulfilled; breached when customer missed payment(s) per terms; cancelled when voided before completion; suspended when temporarily paused by mutual agreement.

attributes.name: arrangement_to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Payment arrangements are established for a specific service agreement with past-due balances.

attributes.name: arrangement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment arrangement structure. Installment plan spreads balance over fixed payments; deferred payment postpones full payment to future date; settlement agreement resolves disputed balance; budget billing equalizes monthly payments; hardship plan offers reduced terms for financial distress; promise to pay is short-term commitment.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment Arrangement Category

attributes.name: auto_pay_enrolled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer enrolled in automatic payment processing for installments, reducing risk of missed payments.

attributes.name: breach_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment arrangement was breached due to missed payments exceeding the threshold. Nullable if arrangement has not been breached.

attributes.name: breach_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the arrangement was breached, typically referencing specific missed payments or violation of terms. Nullable if not breached.

attributes.name: breach_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum number of missed installments allowed before the arrangement is automatically breached and collections actions resume. Typically 1 or 2 missed payments.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Payment Arrangement Breach Rule

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the payment arrangement was cancelled before completion. Nullable if arrangement was not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the arrangement was cancelled, such as customer request, account closure, or administrative error. Nullable if not cancelled.

attributes.name: completion_date
attributes.description: Date when all installment obligations were fulfilled and the arrangement was successfully completed. Nullable if not yet completed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment arrangement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this arrangement. Typically USD for US utilities.

attributes.name: customer_signature_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer signature or electronic acceptance was obtained for the arrangement terms, required for enforceability.

attributes.name: down_payment_amount
attributes.description: Initial payment required at arrangement establishment to demonstrate good faith and reduce the principal balance before installments begin. Zero if no down payment required.

attributes.name: down_payment_received_date
attributes.description: Date when the down payment was actually received and posted to the account. Nullable if down payment not yet received or not required.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment Document Date

attributes.name: first_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the first scheduled installment payment is due, typically 30 days after arrangement start date or aligned with customer billing cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA First Due Date

attributes.name: installment_amount
attributes.description: Fixed amount due for each regular installment payment. Calculated by dividing remaining balance after down payment by number of installments.

attributes.name: installment_frequency
attributes.description: Cadence at which installment payments are scheduled. Monthly is most common for utility payment arrangements.

attributes.name: installments_missed_count
attributes.description: Number of scheduled installment payments that were not received by their due date. Exceeding the allowed threshold triggers breach status.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Missed Payment Count

attributes.name: installments_paid_count
attributes.description: Number of installment payments successfully received and posted to date. Used to track customer compliance with arrangement terms.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Payment Plan Paid Count

attributes.name: interest_accrued_amount
attributes.description: Total interest charges accumulated on the outstanding balance since arrangement start. Updated periodically based on interest calculation schedule.

attributes.name: interest_rate
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the outstanding balance, expressed as a percentage. Zero if arrangement is interest-free per utility policy or regulatory requirement.

attributes.name: last_installment_due_date
attributes.description: Date when the final installment payment is due, marking the scheduled completion of the arrangement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Final Due Date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment arrangement record was most recently updated, reflecting status changes, payment postings, or term modifications.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Total late payment fees assessed for missed or delayed installments. May be waived under hardship arrangements.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Late Payment Charge

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for customer service representatives to document special circumstances, negotiation details, or customer commitments related to the arrangement.

attributes.name: notification_preference
attributes.description: Customer preferred channel for receiving payment reminders and arrangement status updates.

attributes.name: number_of_installments
attributes.description: Total count of scheduled installment payments in the arrangement. Typically ranges from 3 to 24 months depending on utility policy and customer circumstances.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Payment Plan Installment Count

attributes.name: payment_method_code
attributes.description: Primary payment instrument the customer will use for installment payments.

attributes.name: remaining_balance
attributes.description: Current outstanding balance under the payment arrangement after subtracting down payment and any installments paid to date. Updated as payments are received.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Open Item Balance

attributes.name: service_agreement
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Payment arrangements are established for a specific service agreement/account.

attributes.name: total_amount_owed
attributes.description: Total outstanding balance at the time the payment arrangement was established, representing the principal amount to be repaid through the arrangement.

attributes.name: waived_fees_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of late fees, interest, or other charges waived as part of the arrangement negotiation or hardship consideration.

products.name: determinant
products.description: Calculated billing determinant records derived from validated meter interval data for a specific service agreement and billing period. Stores total kWh, on-peak/off-peak kWh, peak demand (kW), reactive demand (kVAR), power factor, billing multiplier, and TOU period breakdowns. Bridges metering domain MDM output to the billing engine for rate calculation. Critical for TOU, CPP, and demand-based rate schedules.
products.reference: Billing Determinant / Usage Summary

attributes.name: determinant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing determinant record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: billing_period_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing period for which these determinants apply. Defines the start and end dates of the consumption window used for rate calculation.

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the service agreement for which this billing determinant was calculated. Links to the customer service agreement that defines the rate schedule and billing terms.

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_cycle. Business justification: Billing determinants are calculated for a specific billing cycle execution. Currently billing_determinant has billing_cycle_code (STRING) but no FK to billing_cycle. This FK enables joining to retriev

attributes.name: der_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.der_registry. Business justification: Billing determinants calculate net metering export/import quantities from specific DER installations. Required to attribute generation, apply correct export rates, calculate demand charges with DER of

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: Billing determinants for DER customers must account for system-specific characteristics (nameplate capacity, export capability, inverter type) to calculate net metering correctly. Business process: Mo

attributes.name: dr_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to demand.dr_event. Business justification: Billing determinants (peak demand, TOU consumption) may be affected by DR events that alter normal consumption patterns. Baseline calculations, billing validation, and dispute resolution require under

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.feeder. Business justification: Advanced metering analytics aggregate consumption by feeder for load forecasting, capacity planning, demand response program design, and feeder-level revenue analysis. Supports distribution planning a

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Billing determinants are consumed during invoice generation to calculate charges. This FK links determinants to the invoice they contributed to, enabling traceability from invoice back to source deter

attributes.name: lmp_price_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to trading.lmp_price. Business justification: Real-time pricing tariffs calculate interval-specific charges using LMP data matched to customer consumption intervals; critical for TOU programs, dynamic pricing pilots, and regulatory cost-of-servic

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the meter from which the interval data was sourced. Links to the physical or virtual meter device in the Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI).

attributes.name: meter_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter_point. Business justification: Billing determinants calculate usage for service points, incorporating network topology (feeder, transformer) and rate schedule context. Service point is the fundamental unit for TOU period assignment

attributes.name: rate_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.rate_schedule. Business justification: Billing determinants are calculated according to a specific rate schedule's rules and structure. Currently billing_determinant has rate_schedule_code (STRING) but no FK to the rate_schedule master ent

attributes.name: adjustment_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating why the billing determinants were manually adjusted after initial calculation. Used for audit trail and to track common data quality issues requiring manual intervention. Examples include meter malfunction, CT/PT ratio correction, or billing dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Codes

attributes.name: billing_cycle_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing cycle schedule to which this service agreement belongs. Used to group customers for batch billing processing and to coordinate meter reading, determinant calculation, and invoice generation schedules.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Billing Cycle; SAP IS-U Billing Schedule

attributes.name: billing_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days in the billing period. Used for pro-ration calculations, average daily usage metrics, and normalization of consumption data for year-over-year comparisons.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Billing Period; SAP IS-U Billing

attributes.name: billing_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to meter readings to account for Current Transformer (CT) and Potential Transformer (PT) ratios in high-voltage metering installations. Converts secondary meter readings to primary consumption values. Typically greater than 1 for commercial and industrial customers.

attributes.name: calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to derive the billing determinants from meter data. Indicates whether values were calculated from actual interval data, estimated due to missing data, or derived using special algorithms for net metering or demand windowing.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Billing

attributes.name: calculation_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the billing determinants were calculated from validated meter interval data. Represents the business event time when MDM output was transformed into billing inputs.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text field for billing analysts to document special circumstances, data quality issues, manual adjustments, or other notes relevant to this billing determinant record. Used for audit trail and knowledge transfer.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; SAP IS-U Billing

attributes.name: contract_demand_kw
attributes.description: The contracted maximum demand level agreed upon between the utility and customer. Used for rate schedules where customers commit to a minimum demand level in exchange for favorable pricing. Excess demand above this level may incur penalty charges.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Design; PUC Commercial Rate Schedules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing determinant record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; SAP IS-U Audit

attributes.name: critical_peak_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption during Critical Peak Pricing (CPP) event hours. Used for CPP rate schedules where utilities invoke premium pricing during grid stress events (typically 10-15 days per year).
attributes.references: FERC CPP Rate Design; PUC Demand Response Programs

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Composite score (0-100) representing the quality of the underlying meter interval data used to calculate these determinants. Considers factors such as percentage of actual vs estimated readings, validation rule pass rate, and data completeness. Used to flag determinants requiring manual review.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE; SAP IS-U Device Management

attributes.name: estimated_interval_count
attributes.description: Number of meter intervals that were estimated rather than actual readings. Used for data quality assessment and to flag billing determinants that may require review due to missing or invalid meter data.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE; ANSI C12.19

attributes.name: interval_count
attributes.description: Number of meter interval readings used to calculate these billing determinants. Typically 2,880 intervals for 15-minute data over a 30-day period, or 1,440 intervals for 30-minute data. Used for data quality validation.

attributes.name: is_final_determinant
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is the final, validated billing determinant record for the billing period (true) or a preliminary/estimated version (false). Used to prevent duplicate billing and ensure only validated determinants are passed to the billing engine.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Billing; SAP IS-U Billing

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing determinant record was last updated. Used for audit trail, change tracking, and identifying records that have been manually adjusted after initial calculation.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; SAP IS-U Audit

attributes.name: load_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of average load to peak load during the billing period, calculated as (total_kwh / (peak_demand_kw * billing_hours)). Indicates how efficiently the customer uses their peak capacity. Values range from 0 to 1, with higher values indicating more consistent usage patterns.

attributes.name: mid_peak_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption during mid-peak TOU periods (shoulder hours between on-peak and off-peak). Used for TOU rate schedules with three-tier time-based pricing.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this billing determinant record. Used for audit trail and accountability in SOX compliance reporting.

attributes.name: net_metering_export_kwh
attributes.description: Energy exported to the grid from customer-owned Distributed Energy Resources (DER) such as rooftop solar. Used for Net Energy Metering (NEM) rate schedules where exported energy is credited against consumption or compensated at a specified rate.
attributes.references: PURPA; State NEM Regulations; FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: net_metering_import_kwh
attributes.description: Energy imported from the grid by customers with Distributed Energy Resources (DER). Used for Net Energy Metering (NEM) rate schedules to calculate net consumption after accounting for on-site generation.
attributes.references: PURPA; State NEM Regulations; FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: off_peak_demand_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power demand during off-peak TOU periods. Used for rate schedules that apply separate demand charges for off-peak periods.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: off_peak_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption during off-peak TOU periods (typically nights and weekends when grid demand is lower). Used for TOU rate calculations with discounted pricing.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: on_peak_demand_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power demand during on-peak TOU periods. Used for rate schedules that apply separate demand charges for on-peak versus off-peak periods.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: on_peak_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption during on-peak TOU periods (typically weekday afternoons when grid demand is highest). Used for TOU and CPP rate calculations with premium pricing.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: peak_demand_kw
attributes.description: Maximum instantaneous power demand in kilowatts recorded during the billing period. Used for demand-based rate schedules common in commercial and industrial tariffs. Typically measured as the highest 15-minute or 30-minute interval average.

attributes.name: peak_demand_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the peak demand (kW) occurred during the billing period. Used for demand response analysis, load profiling, and customer engagement regarding demand management opportunities.

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of real power (kW) to apparent power (kVA) during the billing period, typically calculated at the time of peak demand. Used to assess power quality and apply power factor adjustment charges. Values range from 0 to 1, with 1.0 representing ideal unity power factor.

attributes.name: ratchet_demand_kw
attributes.description: Demand value used for ratchet clause billing, typically a percentage (e.g., 80%) of the highest demand recorded in the previous 11 months. Used in commercial and industrial rate schedules to ensure minimum demand charges even during low-usage months.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Design; PUC Commercial Rate Schedules

attributes.name: reactive_demand_kvar
attributes.description: Maximum reactive power demand in kilovolt-amperes reactive during the billing period. Used for power factor penalties or reactive power charges in industrial and large commercial rate schedules.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: System of record from which the meter interval data originated. Indicates whether data came from Meter Data Management (MDM), Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI), manual meter reading, estimation algorithms, or SCADA systems.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management

attributes.name: temperature_normalized_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption adjusted for weather variations using heating degree days (HDD) and cooling degree days (CDD). Used for load forecasting, energy efficiency program evaluation, and customer usage comparisons across different weather conditions.

attributes.name: total_kwh
attributes.description: Total energy consumption in kilowatt-hours for the billing period. Sum of all interval data across all Time-of-Use (TOU) periods. Primary determinant for energy charges.

attributes.name: tou_period_1_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption for TOU period 1 as defined in the rate schedule. Supports rate schedules with custom TOU period definitions beyond standard on-peak/off-peak/mid-peak classifications.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: tou_period_2_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption for TOU period 2 as defined in the rate schedule. Supports rate schedules with custom TOU period definitions beyond standard on-peak/off-peak/mid-peak classifications.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: tou_period_3_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption for TOU period 3 as defined in the rate schedule. Supports rate schedules with custom TOU period definitions beyond standard on-peak/off-peak/mid-peak classifications.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: tou_period_4_kwh
attributes.description: Energy consumption for TOU period 4 as defined in the rate schedule. Supports rate schedules with custom TOU period definitions beyond standard on-peak/off-peak/mid-peak classifications.
attributes.references: FERC TOU Rate Design; PUC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Current validation state of the billing determinants. Indicates whether the calculated values have passed automated validation rules, require manual review, or have been adjusted by billing analysts.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE; SAP IS-U Billing

products.name: adjustment
products.description: Transactional record of a financial adjustment applied to a customer account or invoice, including credits, debits, rebates, rate corrections, estimated-to-actual true-ups, regulatory surcharge adjustments, and NEM (Net Energy Metering) credits for behind-the-meter generation. Captures adjustment type, reason code, amount, affected billing period, approval status, authorizing user, and source invoice reference. For NEM credit adjustments: stores exported kWh, credit rate ($/kWh), credit amount, cumulative credit balance, credit expiration date, and applicable NEM tariff version. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA, Oracle CC&B adjustment processing, and NEM billing modules. SSOT for all financial adjustments including NEM credits. Supports SOX financial controls, revenue recognition, and state NEM/RPS regulatory compliance reporting.
products.reference: Billing Adjustment / Credit-Debit Memo

attributes.name: adjustment_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the person who approved the adjustment. Required for SOX audit trails and segregation of duties controls.

attributes.name: adjustment_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the source invoice affected by this adjustment. Nullable for account-level adjustments not tied to a specific invoice.

GL reconciliation, audit trails, and financial reporting require linking adjustments

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.application. Regulatory and audit requirements mandate traceability from customer billing adjustment to the causal

attributes.name: reversed_adjustment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original adjustment_id that this transaction reverses. Null if this is not a reversal. Used to maintain audit trail of adjustment corrections.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Reversal Document; Oracle CC&B Original Adjustment ID

attributes.name: to_invoice_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.invoice.invoice_id — Adjustments are frequently applied against a specific invoice (rate correction, estimated-to-actual true-up). This FK supports audit trail and SOX controls.

attributes.name: trade_id

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.work_order. Business justification: Billing adjustments frequently result from field work: meter test failures, equipment malfunctions, service quality issues. Customer service representatives and auditors require traceability from adju

attributes.name: adjustment_date
attributes.description: The business date when the adjustment transaction was created and recorded in the billing system. This is the principal business event timestamp for the adjustment.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Posting Date; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Date

attributes.name: adjustment_invoice
attributes.description: FK to billing.invoice.invoice_id — Adjustments are applied against specific invoices or billing periods. Critical for AR reconciliation and SOX controls.

attributes.name: adjustment_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the adjustment transaction, often displayed on customer correspondence and used for customer service reference.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Document Number; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Number

attributes.name: adjustment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the adjustment transaction indicating the nature of the financial change applied to the account or invoice. attributes.references: SAP IS-U Adjustment Type; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Type Code

attributes.name: affected_billing_period_end
attributes.description: End date of the billing period to which this adjustment applies. Used for period-specific rate corrections and estimated-to-actual true-ups.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Period; Oracle CC&B Service Period End

attributes.name: affected_billing_period_start
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period to which this adjustment applies. Used for period-specific rate corrections and estimated-to-actual true-ups.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Period; Oracle CC&B Service Period Start

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the adjustment. Positive values represent debits (charges to customer), negative values represent credits (refunds or reductions). Expressed in the account's billing currency.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Line Item Amount; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Amount

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the adjustment was approved by an authorized user or system process. Null if still pending approval.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Approval Date; Oracle CC&B Approval Timestamp; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the adjustment in the workflow. Supports SOX financial controls requiring segregation of duties for material adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Approval Workflow; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Status; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code indicating the currency in which the adjustment amount is denominated.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment is related to a customer dispute or complaint resolution. True if dispute-related, False otherwise.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Dispute Management; SAP IS-U Complaint Handling

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which the adjustment becomes effective for accounting and revenue recognition purposes. May differ from adjustment_date for backdated corrections.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Value Date; Oracle CC&B Effective Date; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: The date when this adjustment was posted to the general ledger. Null if not yet posted. Used for financial period reconciliation and revenue recognition.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Posting Date; Oracle ERP GL Date; ASC 606 Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: nem_credit_amount
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the total monetary credit amount calculated as nem_exported_kwh multiplied by nem_credit_rate. This amount is applied as a credit to the customer account. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Rules; Oracle CC&B NEM Module

attributes.name: nem_credit_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Credit Expiration Date
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the date when unused NEM credits expire per the applicable NEM tariff rules (typically 12 months from generation). Null for non-NEM adjustments or jurisdictions without credit expiration.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; Oracle CC&B NEM Module

attributes.name: nem_credit_rate
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the per-kWh credit rate applied to exported energy, expressed in currency per kWh. Rate is determined by the applicable NEM tariff and may vary by time-of-use period. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff; Oracle CC&B NEM Rate Schedule

attributes.name: nem_cumulative_credit_balance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Cumulative Credit Balance
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the cumulative balance of NEM credits on the customer account after this adjustment is applied. Used to track credit carryover across billing periods. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Rules; Oracle CC&B NEM Module

attributes.name: nem_exported_kwh
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the quantity of energy in kilowatt-hours exported by the customer's behind-the-meter generation system to the grid during the billing period. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Rules; Oracle CC&B NEM Module; PURPA Section 210

attributes.name: nem_tariff_version
attributes.description: For NEM credit adjustments: the version identifier of the NEM tariff applied to this adjustment (e.g., NEM 1.0, NEM 2.0, NEM 3.0). Different tariff versions have different credit calculation rules. Null for non-NEM adjustments.
attributes.references: State PUC NEM Tariff Schedule; Oracle CC&B NEM Configuration

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or context about the adjustment. Used by customer service representatives and billing analysts for documentation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Long Text; Oracle CC&B Comments

attributes.name: posted_to_gl_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment has been posted to the general ledger for financial reporting. True if posted, False if pending. Supports SOX financial controls and month-end close processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting; Oracle ERP GL Interface; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the business reason for the adjustment (e.g., meter read correction, customer complaint resolution, regulatory mandate, billing system error).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Reason Code; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Reason

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation providing additional context and details about why the adjustment was made, often used for audit trails and customer communication.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Adjustment Text; Oracle CC&B Adjustment Comments

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adjustment record was first created in the source system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Creation Timestamp; Oracle CC&B Created Date

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this adjustment record was last modified in the source system. Used for audit trails and change tracking.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Change Timestamp; Oracle CC&B Last Updated Date

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment must be included in regulatory compliance reporting to state PUC, FERC, or other governing bodies. True if reportable, False otherwise.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reports; NERC Compliance Reporting

attributes.name: revenue_class
attributes.description: Classification of the adjustment by revenue category for regulatory reporting and financial analysis. Aligns with FERC Uniform System of Accounts and state PUC reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: energy_sales|distribution_charges|transmission_charges|regulatory_surcharges|ancillary_services|nem_credits|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Revenue Classification

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment is a reversal of a previous adjustment transaction. True if this is a reversal, False otherwise.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Reversal Indicator; Oracle CC&B Reversal Flag

attributes.name: service_agreement
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Adjustments are posted to a service agreement. Required for account-level balance tracking.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the originating document or transaction in the source system (e.g., work order number, service request ID, regulatory filing reference). Used for audit trails and root cause analysis.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Document Number; Oracle CC&B Reference ID

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The operational system or process that originated this adjustment transaction. Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle CC&B; Oracle MDM

attributes.name: tariff_code
attributes.description: Rate schedule or tariff code applicable to this adjustment, particularly for rate corrections and regulatory surcharge adjustments. References the approved tariff on file with the regulatory authority.
attributes.references: State PUC Tariff Schedule; FERC Rate Schedule

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The tax component of the adjustment amount, if applicable. Null for non-taxable adjustments. Used for sales tax, utility tax, and other applicable taxes.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Tax Calculation; Oracle CC&B Tax Engine

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the tax jurisdiction applicable to this adjustment. Used for multi-jurisdictional tax compliance and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Tax Jurisdiction; Oracle CC&B Tax Authority Code

attributes.name: to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Adjustments are applied to a service agreement when not tied to a specific invoice (e.g., account-level credits, NEM credits).

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this adjustment represents a bad debt write-off. True if this is a write-off, False otherwise. Used for accounts receivable aging and collections reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Write-Off; Oracle CC&B Write-Off Processing; GAAP Bad Debt Accounting

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the reason for write-off (e.g., bankruptcy, uncollectible, deceased customer, small balance). Null for non-write-off adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Write-Off Reason; Oracle CC&B Write-Off Code

products.name: deposit
products.description: Master entity tracking customer security deposits held by the utility, including deposit amount, deposit type (cash, surety bond, letter of credit), collection date, interest accrual, refund eligibility date, refund status, and regulatory basis for deposit requirement. Managed within SAP IS-U FICA and Oracle CC&B deposit management. Supports PUC-mandated deposit rules and customer financial risk management.
products.reference: Customer Deposit / Security Deposit

attributes.name: deposit_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the customer security deposit record. Primary key.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which this deposit is held. Links to the customer billing account in CIS.

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: FK to billing.billing_service_agreement.billing_service_agreement_id — Security deposits are collected against a specific service agreement. This FK enables deposit tracking, refund eligibility, and regulatory compliance for deposit rules.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the system user or CSR who last modified the deposit record. Supports SOX audit requirements and internal control documentation for financial transactions.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Customer deposits held in specific liability GL accounts per regulatory requirements and GAAP. Link enables proper balance sheet classification, interest accrual tracking, and regulatory reporting of

attributes.name: accrued_interest_amount
attributes.description: Total interest earned on the deposit from collection date to current date, calculated per regulatory interest rate requirements. Many PUCs mandate interest payment on customer deposits held beyond specified periods.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Original principal amount of the deposit collected from or guaranteed by the customer, in the utility's functional currency. Does not include accrued interest.

attributes.name: collection_date
attributes.description: Date the deposit was collected from the customer or the guarantee instrument became effective. Serves as the start date for interest accrual and regulatory holding period calculations.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Deposit Posting Date

attributes.name: collection_method
attributes.description: Payment method or mechanism used to collect the cash deposit from the customer. Does not apply to surety bonds or letters of credit which are third-party guarantees.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the deposit record was first created in the CIS or FICA system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the deposit amount. Supports multi-currency operations for utilities operating across jurisdictions.

attributes.name: deposit_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the deposit, used in customer communications and financial reporting. Externally visible deposit reference number.

attributes.name: deposit_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the deposit. Active deposits are held and earning interest, refunded deposits have been returned to customer, forfeited deposits applied to outstanding balances, transferred deposits moved to new account, expired deposits past regulatory holding period, and pending refund deposits awaiting disbursement approval.

attributes.name: deposit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deposit instrument held by the utility. Cash deposits are held in utility accounts, surety bonds and letters of credit are third-party guarantees, bank guarantees are financial institution commitments, and escrow deposits are held by third-party trustees.

attributes.name: forfeiture_amount
attributes.description: Amount of deposit (including accrued interest) applied to customer account balance upon forfeiture. May be partial if deposit exceeds outstanding balance. Null for deposits not forfeited.

attributes.name: forfeiture_date
attributes.description: Date the deposit was forfeited and applied to outstanding customer account balance due to payment default, service disconnection, or final bill settlement. Null for deposits not forfeited.

attributes.name: forfeiture_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for forfeiting the deposit and applying it to customer account balance. Payment default and service disconnection are most common triggers per PUC tariff rules.

attributes.name: guarantee_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the surety bond, letter of credit, or bank guarantee. Utility must ensure renewal or replacement before expiration to maintain deposit coverage. Null for cash deposits and perpetual guarantees.

attributes.name: guarantee_instrument_number
attributes.description: Reference number or policy number of the surety bond, letter of credit, or bank guarantee instrument. Used for verification and claim processing. Null for cash deposits.

attributes.name: guarantee_provider_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution or surety company providing the letter of credit, surety bond, or bank guarantee. Applicable only for non-cash deposit types. Null for cash deposits.

attributes.name: interest_calculation_method
attributes.description: Method used to calculate interest accrual on the deposit. Simple interest calculates on principal only, compound methods add accrued interest to principal at specified intervals. Method is typically mandated by PUC tariff rules.

attributes.name: interest_rate_percent
attributes.description: Annual interest rate applied to the deposit balance, expressed as a percentage. Rate is typically set by state PUC regulations and may be tied to treasury rates or fixed by tariff.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the deposit record was last updated. Tracks changes to deposit status, interest accrual, or refund processing for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date the deposit record was last reviewed for refund eligibility, interest accrual accuracy, or regulatory compliance. Utilities typically perform periodic deposit reviews per PUC requirements.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next deposit review cycle. Used for workflow management and compliance tracking to ensure timely refund processing and interest payment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for recording special circumstances, customer disputes, regulatory exceptions, or other relevant information about the deposit. Used for audit trail and customer service reference.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Business reason for requiring or collecting the deposit. Regulatory requirements mandate deposits for certain customer risk profiles, payment defaults trigger deposit collection, and voluntary deposits may be offered for budget management.

attributes.name: refund_amount
attributes.description: Total amount refunded to customer, including original deposit principal plus accrued interest, minus any forfeitures or adjustments. Null for deposits not yet refunded.

attributes.name: refund_date
attributes.description: Actual date the deposit (plus accrued interest) was refunded to the customer or applied to their account balance. Null for deposits not yet refunded.

attributes.name: refund_eligibility_date
attributes.description: Date on which the deposit becomes eligible for refund to the customer, calculated based on PUC-mandated holding periods and customer payment history criteria. Typically 12-24 months of on-time payment history.

attributes.name: refund_method
attributes.description: Method used to return the deposit to the customer. Account credit applies deposit to outstanding balance, check and direct deposit return funds directly to customer, wire transfer used for large amounts.

attributes.name: regulatory_holding_period_months
attributes.description: Minimum number of months the utility must hold the deposit before refund eligibility, as mandated by state PUC regulations. Typically 12 or 24 months depending on jurisdiction and customer class.
attributes.references: State PUC Deposit Holding Period Rules

attributes.name: service_agreement
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Security deposits are held against a specific service agreement. Required for deposit refund eligibility tracking.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deposit record is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements. True for publicly traded utilities with material deposit balances requiring internal control documentation.

attributes.name: to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Security deposits are collected for a specific service agreement, often at service initiation or after credit events.

products.name: dunning_notice
products.description: Transactional record of a dunning or collections notice issued to a customer with a past-due balance. Captures dunning level (first notice, final notice, disconnect warning, disconnect order), issue date, past-due amount, response deadline, delivery channel (mail, email, SMS, door hanger), and resulting action taken. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA dunning program and Oracle CC&B collections workflow. Tracks the full collections escalation lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: customer_contact_name

attributes.name: delivery_channel

attributes.name: delivery_status

attributes.name: dunning_block_code

attributes.name: dunning_status

attributes.name: in_collections_case

products.name: collections
products.description: Master and transactional entity representing collections cases and their associated dunning notices for customer accounts with delinquent balances. At the case level: captures case open date, delinquent amount, collections stage, assigned collector, escalation history, disconnect status, reconnect conditions, write-off eligibility, and case resolution outcome. At the notice level: captures dunning level (first notice, final notice, disconnect warning, disconnect order), issue date, past-due amount, response deadline, delivery channel (mail, email, SMS, door hanger), and resulting action taken. Managed within SAP IS-U FICA dunning program and Oracle CC&B collections workflow. SSOT for all collections activity and dunning communications supporting SOX AR aging and bad debt controls.

attributes.description: Amount in USD of the most recent payment received against this collections case.

attributes.name: last_payment_date

attributes.name: legal_referral_date

attributes.name: legal_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this collections case has been referred to legal counsel or external collections agency.

attributes.name: next_action_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next collections action or follow-up activity.

attributes.name: next_action_type
attributes.description: Type of next scheduled collections action (e.g., send notice, phone call, disconnect order, legal referral).

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments from collectors documenting interactions, customer circumstances, and case-specific details.

attributes.name: original_delinquent_amount
attributes.description: Initial delinquent balance in USD at the time the collections case was opened, used for tracking payment progress.

attributes.name: past_due_days
attributes.description: Number of days the oldest invoice in the case has been past due, used for aging analysis and escalation triggers.

attributes.name: promise_kept_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer honored their promise to pay commitment.

attributes.name: promise_to_pay_amount
attributes.description: Amount in USD that the customer committed to pay by the promise to pay date.

attributes.name: promise_to_pay_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer committed to making payment on the delinquent balance.

attributes.name: reconnect_condition
attributes.description: Business conditions that must be met for service reconnection, such as payment in full, payment arrangement, or deposit.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management Reconnect Order

attributes.name: reconnect_date
attributes.description: Date when service was reconnected after disconnection.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management Reconnect Order

attributes.name: service_agreement
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Collections cases are opened against a delinquent service agreement/account. Critical for collections workflow and disconnect processing.

attributes.name: stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the collections escalation process indicating severity and next actions.

attributes.name: to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Collections cases are opened for a delinquent service agreement. This FK is essential for collections workflow and disconnect processing.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount in USD written off as bad debt for this collections case.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: Date when the delinquent balance was written off as uncollectible bad debt.

attributes.name: write_off_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this collections case meets business criteria for bad debt write-off consideration.

attributes.name: write_off_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the business reason for write-off (e.g., bankruptcy, deceased, uncollectible, small balance).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Write-Off Reason Codes

products.name: write_off
products.description: Transactional record of an accounts receivable write-off for an uncollectable customer balance. Captures write-off date, amount, reason (bankruptcy, skip, hardship, deceased), approval authority, associated collections case, bad debt GL account, and recovery tracking. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA and Oracle CC&B. Critical for SOX bad debt reserve management and PUC uncollectable expense reporting.
products.reference: AR Write-Off / Bad Debt Write-Off

attributes.name: write_off_id

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account for which the balance is being written off.

attributes.name: approved_by_employee_id
