attributes.name: collections_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collections case that led to this write-off decision, if applicable.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Write Off Cost Center Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Write-offs allocated to cost centers for performance tracking, collections effectiveness analysis, and regulatory cost recovery. Supports identification of high-risk customer segments and justificatio

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Write Off Gl Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Bad debt write-offs post to specific expense GL accounts for financial reporting and regulatory cost recovery. Link supports allowance for doubtful accounts reconciliation, FERC reporting, and rate ca

attributes.name: aging_bucket
attributes.description: The accounts receivable aging category at the time of write-off: 0-30 days, 31-60 days, 61-90 days, 91-120 days, 121-180 days, over_180 days.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of the accounts receivable balance being written off as uncollectable.

attributes.name: approval_authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the manager, director, or executive who authorized the write-off transaction per SOX approval hierarchy.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was formally approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approval_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical approval level required for this write-off based on dollar threshold: supervisor (under $500), manager ($500-$2,500), director ($2,500-$10,000), vp ($10,000-$50,000), cfo (over $50,000).

attributes.name: bankruptcy_case_number
attributes.description: The court-assigned bankruptcy case number if the write-off reason is bankruptcy, used for tracking potential distributions.

attributes.name: bankruptcy_chapter
attributes.description: The chapter of bankruptcy filed by the customer: chapter_7 (liquidation), chapter_11 (reorganization), chapter_13 (individual debt adjustment).

attributes.name: collection_agency_referral_date
attributes.description: The date on which the account was referred to an external collection agency for recovery efforts.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this write-off record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the write-off amount (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: days_past_due
attributes.description: The number of days the account balance was past due at the time of write-off, calculated from the original due date to the write-off date.

attributes.name: external_collection_agency
attributes.description: Name of the third-party collection agency to which the account was referred before write-off, if applicable.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal year and period (YYYY-MM format) in which the write-off was recognized for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: from_collections_case
attributes.description: FK to billing.collections_case.collections_case_id — Write-offs are the terminal outcome of a collections case. This FK is required for bad debt tracking, recovery management, and SOX AR aging controls.

attributes.name: interest_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the write-off amount representing accrued interest or late payment charges.

attributes.name: last_payment_amount
attributes.description: The dollar amount of the last payment received from the customer before the account was written off.

attributes.name: last_payment_date
attributes.description: The date of the last payment received from the customer before the account was written off.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the write-off record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this write-off record was last modified.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the write-off amount representing penalties, fees, or other charges assessed to the account.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off transaction was posted to the general ledger and accounts receivable subledger.

attributes.name: principal_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the write-off amount representing the original principal balance owed by the customer.

attributes.name: puc_reporting_category
attributes.description: The regulatory reporting category for this write-off as required by state Public Utility Commission uncollectable expense reporting.

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: The customer rate classification for the account at the time of write-off: residential, commercial, industrial, municipal, or agricultural.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: Categorical code indicating the primary reason for the write-off: bankruptcy (customer filed for bankruptcy protection), deceased (customer is deceased with no estate recovery), skip (customer location unknown), hardship (financial hardship waiver), uncollectable (exhausted collection efforts), fraud (fraudulent account).
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Write-Off Reason Codes

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative explanation of the circumstances leading to the write-off decision, including supporting documentation references.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: The cumulative dollar amount recovered from this write-off through subsequent collection efforts, bankruptcy distributions, or estate settlements.

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent recovery payment or distribution applied against this written-off balance.

attributes.name: recovery_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the written-off balance is eligible for future recovery efforts (true) or permanently closed (false).

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the write-off was reversed, if applicable (e.g., due to error correction or subsequent payment arrangement).

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation of why the write-off was reversed, including reference to correcting documentation or payment arrangement.

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: The geographic service territory or operating district in which the customer account was located.

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: The type of utility service for which the written-off balance was incurred: electric, gas, water, steam, or combined services.

attributes.name: tax_reporting_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the write-off is reported for income tax purposes (may differ from fiscal period for tax accounting).

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date on which the accounts receivable balance was officially written off. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction.

attributes.name: write_off_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the write-off transaction, used in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: write_off_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the write-off transaction: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet posted), posted (recorded to GL), reversed (write-off reversed), recovered (partial or full recovery after write-off).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created the write-off record.

products.name: budget_plan
products.description: Master entity representing a customer enrollment in a budget billing (levelized billing) program, where monthly charges are averaged over a 12-month period to smooth seasonal bill variability. Captures enrolled amount, plan start date, true-up month, cumulative actual vs. budget variance, annual true-up amount, and plan status. Managed within Oracle CC&B and SAP IS-U. Supports customer affordability programs and revenue smoothing.
products.reference: Budget Billing Plan / Levelized Billing

attributes.name: budget_plan_id
attributes.description: Primary key for budget_plan

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account enrolled in this budget billing plan.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Business Partner / Oracle CC&B Account

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_service_agreement. Business justification: Budget billing plans are configured at the service agreement level, not just the account level. A customer account may have multiple service agreements (e.g., residential and commercial), each with di

attributes.name: load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Budget billing plans calculate levelized monthly payments based on forecasted annual usage for each customer class. Customer service systems reference specific load forecasts (by rate class and season

attributes.name: payment_arrangement_id
attributes.description: Reference to an associated payment arrangement if the budget plan is part of a broader affordability or collections program.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Payment Arrangement / Oracle CC&B Payment Arrangement

attributes.name: affordability_program_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the customer affordability or assistance program under which this budget plan is offered (low-income, senior, medical baseline, etc.).

attributes.name: annual_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total estimated annual energy cost used as the basis for calculating monthly installments, typically based on historical usage and current rates.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the budget billing plan automatically renews at the end of the term or requires customer re-enrollment.

attributes.name: budget_plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget billing plan enrollment.

attributes.name: budget_to_sa
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Budget billing plans are enrolled for a specific service agreement to smooth seasonal bill variability.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget billing plan was cancelled by the customer or utility. Null if plan is active or completed normally.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for plan cancellation (customer request, payment default, account closure, service disconnection, etc.).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget billing plan record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_actual_amount
attributes.description: Total actual energy charges incurred by the customer since enrollment, based on actual consumption and applicable rates.

attributes.name: cumulative_billed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount billed to the customer under the budget plan since enrollment, representing the sum of all monthly installments charged.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget plan.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget billing plan ends or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended plans.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Budget Plan End Date

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the budget billing plan becomes effective and monthly installment billing begins.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Budget Plan Effective Date

attributes.name: eligibility_verified_date
attributes.description: Date when customer eligibility for the budget billing plan or associated affordability program was last verified.

attributes.name: enrollment_channel
attributes.description: Channel through which the customer enrolled in the budget billing plan.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer was enrolled into the budget billing plan.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Budget Plan Start Date

attributes.name: historical_usage_kwh
attributes.description: Total historical annual energy consumption in kilowatt-hours used as the basis for calculating the budget amount, typically from the prior 12-month period.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget billing plan record was last updated.

attributes.name: last_true_up_amount
attributes.description: Amount settled at the most recent true-up. Positive values represent credits issued to customer; negative values represent additional charges.

attributes.name: last_true_up_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent annual true-up reconciliation when variance was settled and plan was recalculated.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this budget billing plan record.

attributes.name: monthly_installment_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monthly payment amount charged to the customer under the budget billing plan, calculated to smooth seasonal bill variability.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next plan review or recalculation, typically mid-cycle or at true-up to adjust installments based on actual usage trends.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B Budget Plan Review Schedule

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the budget billing plan, including special arrangements, customer requests, or operational remarks.

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique identifier for the budget billing plan, used in customer communications and billing statements.

attributes.name: plan_term_months
attributes.description: Duration of the budget billing plan cycle in months, typically 12 months for annual levelized billing.

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget billing methodology used to calculate monthly installments (levelized over 12 months, rolling average, fixed amount, seasonal adjustment, or custom calculation).

attributes.name: rate_schedule_code
attributes.description: Tariff rate schedule code applied to calculate the budget amount and actual charges for this plan.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Rate Category / Oracle CC&B Rate Schedule

attributes.name: recalculation_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which the monthly installment amount is recalculated based on updated usage patterns and rate changes.

attributes.name: service_agreement
attributes.description: FK to billing.service_agreement.service_agreement_id — Budget billing plans are enrolled for a specific service agreement. Required for levelized billing calculation.

attributes.name: true_up_month
attributes.description: Month number (1-12) when the annual true-up reconciliation occurs, settling the variance between budget installments and actual charges.

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Current difference between cumulative billed amount and cumulative actual amount. Positive variance indicates customer has been overbilled (credit due at true-up); negative variance indicates underbilled (balance due at true-up).

products.name: cycle
products.description: Reference and operational entity defining billing cycle configurations and their execution history. At the cycle level: stores cycle code, read frequency (monthly, bi-monthly), scheduled read and bill generation dates, due date offset, and assigned account count. At the run level: captures batch billing run execution records including run date, billing cycle reference, accounts processed, invoices generated, total billed amount, run status (pending, in-progress, completed, error), exception count, and operator. Drives billing run scheduling, workload distribution, and revenue cycle timing. Sourced from SAP IS-U and Oracle CC&B billing engine. SSOT for billing cycle definitions and all batch billing run execution records.
products.reference: Billing Cycle / Read Cycle

attributes.name: cycle_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the billing cycle configuration and execution record. Primary key.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Engine, Oracle CC&B Billing Module

attributes.name: billing_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the specific batch billing run execution instance (e.g., BR2024011501). Generated when billing engine executes the cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Document Number, Oracle CC&B Batch Control ID

attributes.name: cycle_approved_by_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID of the supervisor who approved the billing run for invoice release. Null if approval not required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: cycle_employee_id
attributes.description: User ID or system account that initiated or executed the billing run. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, NERC CIP-007 User Authentication

attributes.name: accounts_processed_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer accounts successfully processed during this billing run execution.

attributes.name: approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this billing cycle run requires supervisory approval before invoice release (True) or can be automatically released (False). Typically True for high-value commercial/industrial cycles.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing run was approved for invoice release. Null if approval not required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: assigned_account_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer accounts assigned to this billing cycle for workload distribution and capacity planning.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Account Assignment, Oracle CC&B Cycle Assignment

attributes.name: bill_due_date_offset_days
attributes.business_glossary_term: Bill Due Date Offset in Days
attributes.description: Number of days after bill generation date to set the payment due date (e.g., 21 days for residential, 30 days for commercial).

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last date of the consumption period covered by this billing cycle run (inclusive).

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first date of the consumption period covered by this billing cycle run (inclusive).

attributes.name: billing_run_date
attributes.description: The actual date when the billing batch processing was executed for this cycle. May differ from scheduled date due to operational adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this billing cycle (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN).

attributes.name: cycle_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the billing cycle configuration (e.g., RES01, COM15, IND30). Used for scheduling and grouping accounts into billing batches.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Rate Category, Oracle CC&B Cycle Definition

attributes.name: cycle_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing the billing cycle (e.g., Residential Monthly Cycle 1, Commercial Bi-Monthly East).

attributes.name: cycle_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the billing cycle configuration. Active: in use for billing operations. Inactive: temporarily disabled. Suspended: on hold pending review. Archived: retired from active use.

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Classification of the billing cycle frequency and purpose. Monthly for standard monthly billing, bi-monthly for every-other-month, quarterly for seasonal, on-demand for ad-hoc billing, final for account closure billing.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date when this billing cycle configuration was retired or superseded. Null for currently active cycles.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this billing cycle configuration became active and available for use in billing operations.

attributes.name: exception_count
attributes.description: Number of accounts that encountered errors or exceptions during billing run processing (e.g., missing meter reads, rate errors, validation failures). Requires manual review.

attributes.name: exception_summary
attributes.description: Brief summary of the types of exceptions encountered during the billing run (e.g., 15 missing reads, 3 rate lookup failures, 2 validation errors).

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Primary method used to deliver invoices to customers in this billing cycle. Paper: postal mail. Email: electronic delivery. Portal: customer self-service. SMS: text message notification. Suppressed: no delivery (e.g., zero-balance accounts).

attributes.name: invoice_print_date
attributes.description: The date when physical invoices were printed or electronic bills were released to customers. May differ from billing run date due to approval workflows.

attributes.name: invoices_generated_count
attributes.description: Total number of invoices (bills) generated during this billing run execution. May differ from accounts processed if some accounts had zero consumption or credits.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this billing cycle record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or comments about this billing cycle or run (e.g., holiday adjustments, system issues, rate changes).

attributes.name: rate_class
attributes.description: Customer rate classification this billing cycle primarily serves. Determines applicable tariff schedules and rate structures.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Schedule Classification, State PUC Tariff Filings

attributes.name: read_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between scheduled meter reads for this billing cycle (e.g., 30 for monthly, 60 for bi-monthly).

attributes.name: run_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in minutes for the billing run execution. Used for capacity planning and performance optimization.

attributes.name: run_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing batch processing completed or terminated. Used for performance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: run_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the billing batch processing began execution. Used for performance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of the billing run. Pending: scheduled but not started. In-progress: actively processing. Completed: finished successfully. Completed-with-exceptions: finished but some accounts had errors. Error: run failed. Cancelled: run was aborted.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Run Status, Oracle CC&B Batch Status

attributes.name: scheduled_bill_generation_date
attributes.description: The date when invoice generation batch processing is scheduled to execute for this billing cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Billing Run Schedule, Oracle CC&B Bill Calculation

attributes.name: scheduled_read_end_date
attributes.description: The date by which all meter reading activities should be completed for this billing cycle period.

attributes.name: scheduled_read_start_date
attributes.description: The date when meter reading activities are scheduled to begin for this billing cycle period.

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Geographic service territory identifier this billing cycle serves (e.g., EAST, WEST, METRO1). Used for regional billing operations.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network Service Territory

attributes.name: total_billed_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all invoice amounts generated during this billing run execution, before payments and adjustments. Represents gross revenue for the cycle.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA Billing Document Total, SOX Revenue Recognition Controls

attributes.name: total_kwh_billed
attributes.description: Sum of all energy consumption in kilowatt-hours billed across all accounts in this billing run. Key operational metric for load forecasting and revenue analysis.

products.name: billing_run

attributes.name: employee_id

attributes.name: reversed_run_billing_run_id

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval state of the billing run results, indicating whether the run output has been reviewed and approved for invoice release and accounts receivable posting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the billing run was approved for invoice release, establishing the audit trail for revenue recognition timing.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User identifier of the supervisor or manager who approved the billing run results for release, supporting SOX segregation of duties requirements.

attributes.name: batch_job_reference
attributes.description: Technical identifier of the underlying batch job or process execution in the billing system, used for technical troubleshooting and system integration.

attributes.name: invoice_due_date

attributes.name: invoices_generated

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this billing run record was last updated, supporting change tracking and audit compliance for billing operations.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: print_batch_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the print or output batch associated with this billing run, linking invoices to physical or electronic delivery processes.

attributes.name: run_number

products.name: revenue_recognition
products.description: Transactional record capturing revenue recognition entries derived from billed and unbilled revenue for a service agreement and accounting period. Stores recognized revenue amount, deferred revenue amount, unbilled revenue accrual, revenue category (energy, demand, customer charge, rider), accounting period, GL account code, and recognition method. Supports SOX-compliant revenue recognition under ASC 606 and regulatory accounting requirements. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA and SAP S/4HANA FI integration.

attributes.name: adjustment_amount

attributes.name: revenue_class

attributes.name: revenue_invoice

attributes.name: reversal_flag

products.name: bill_dispute

Captures dispute open date, disputed invoice, disputed amount, dispute reason (estimated read, rate error, meter malfunction, unauthorized charge), investigation status, resolution type (credit issued, bill upheld, partial adjustment), resolution date, and regulatory escalation flag. Managed within Oracle CC&B and SAP IS-U. Supports PUC complaint tracking and customer service SLAs.

products.name: ar_ledger
products.description: Transactional entity representing the accounts receivable sub-ledger for customer billing activity, capturing all open item postings including invoiced amounts, payments applied, adjustments, write-offs, balance carry-forwards, and bad debt entries. Stores posting date, document type (invoice, payment, adjustment, write-off, refund), debit/credit indicator, amount, clearing status, clearing date, and GL account. For write-off postings: captures write-off date, write-off amount, reason (bankruptcy, skip, hardship, deceased), approval authority, bad debt GL account, recovery tracking status, and associated collections case reference. Sourced from SAP IS-U FICA open item management and SAP S/4HANA AR sub-ledger. SSOT for customer AR balance, write-off tracking, and bad debt management supporting SOX financial controls and PUC uncollectable expense reporting.

products.name: service_agreement_incentive_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a billing service agreement and a renewable incentive program. It captures the operational enrollment of a specific service agreement into a specific incentive program, tracking approval, payment, and compliance status. Each record links one billing service agreement to one incentive program with attributes that exist only in the context of this enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In energy utilities operations, a single billing service agreement can simultaneously participate in multiple renewable incentive programs (e.g., a residential solar customer enrolled in both a solar rebate program and a green tariff program and a low-income assistance program). Conversely, each incentive program serves many service agreements across the utility's customer base. The business actively manages these enrollments as operational entities, tracking approval amounts, payment schedules, compliance status, and payment history for each program-agreement combination.

products.name: ems_node
products.description: Master record for every electrical node (bus) modeled in the Energy Management System (EMS) state estimator and network topology processor. Captures node name, bus number, nominal voltage (kV), substation reference, voltage zone, island membership, base MVA, and EMS model version. PMU attributes include voltage/current phasor magnitude and angle, frequency (Hz), ROCOF (Hz/s), microsecond-precision timestamp, and PDC data quality flags. Measurement source type discriminator (SCADA/PMU) distinguishes data origin and grain. SSOT for all grid telemetry time-series data supporting post-event review, NERC TOP reliability analysis, NERC PRC-002 disturbance monitoring, wide-area situational awareness, oscillation detection, and operational analytics. Distinct from interval meter data (owned by metering domain).

attributes.name: reactive_power_mvar
attributes.description: The reactive power flow in megavolt-amperes reactive (MVAR) measured at this telemetry point. Critical for voltage control, VAR management, and power factor optimization. Monitored for NERC VAR-001 (Voltage and Reactive Control) compliance. Applicable to both SCADA and PMU measurements.

attributes.name: rocof_hz_per_second
attributes.description: The rate of change of frequency in Hertz per second, calculated from PMU synchrophasor data. A key indicator for detecting sudden generation loss, load rejection, or islanding events. High ROCOF values trigger under-frequency load shedding schemes and are monitored for NERC PRC-006 (Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding) compliance. Null for SCADA measurements that do not calculate ROCOF.

attributes.name: rtu_reference
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the Remote Terminal Unit that collected and transmitted this SCADA measurement. Identifies the source device in the field for SCADA telemetry. Null for PMU-sourced measurements.

attributes.name: scan_cycle_seconds
attributes.description: The scan cycle interval in seconds at which this SCADA point is polled by the RTU or SCADA master. Typical values range from 2 seconds (critical telemetry) to 60 seconds (slower-changing measurements). Null for PMU measurements which operate on continuous streaming at fixed reporting rates (e.g., 30 or 60 samples per second).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the source system that provided this measurement to the PI historian. Examples include EMS (Energy Management System), SCADA Master, PMU Network, ADMS (Advanced Distribution Management System). Used for data lineage and troubleshooting data quality issues by tracing back to the originating system.

attributes.name: state_estimator_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement is used as an input to the EMS (Energy Management System) state estimator application. True indicates the measurement is included in the state estimation model for real-time network analysis and contingency analysis. False indicates the measurement is for monitoring only. Critical for identifying the telemetry set used for NERC TOP reliability analysis.

attributes.name: switch_position
attributes.description: The position status of a disconnect switch or sectionalizing switch for digital SCADA measurements. Open indicates the switch is open. Closed indicates the switch is closed. Grounded indicates the switch is in a grounding position (for maintenance safety). Unknown indicates communication loss. Used for network topology modeling and switching order verification. Null for analog measurements.

attributes.name: voltage_angle_degrees
attributes.description: The phase angle of the voltage phasor in degrees relative to a common time reference (typically GPS-synchronized). Critical for wide-area situational awareness, angle difference monitoring across transmission corridors, and oscillation detection. Null for non-voltage SCADA measurements.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: The nominal voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the network element where this measurement was captured. Common values include 765, 500, 345, 230, 138, 115, 69, 34.5, 13.8, 4.16 kV. Used for segmenting telemetry by transmission vs. sub-transmission vs. distribution voltage classes and for voltage-specific analytics.

attributes.name: voltage_magnitude_kv
attributes.description: The magnitude of the voltage phasor in kilovolts (kV) for PMU measurements. Represents the RMS voltage at the measurement point. Used for wide-area voltage monitoring, oscillation detection, and voltage stability analysis. Null for non-voltage SCADA measurements.

products.name: state_estimation_run
products.description: Transactional record of each EMS state estimator execution cycle including topology connectivity state, per-node/per-branch electrical results, and network island configuration. Run-level attributes include timestamp, solution status (converged/diverged/flat-start), iterations, MW mismatch tolerance, bad-data detections, observable islands, operator overrides. Topology attributes include number of energized buses, open switching devices, topology change flag, and island membership. Result-level detail (grain: one row per node/branch per run) includes estimated voltage magnitude (kV), voltage angle (degrees), active power flow (MW), reactive power flow (MVAR), current (amps), and residual. SSOT for state estimation execution, topology snapshots, and electrical results — used for NERC TOP compliance evidence, post-event voltage profile and network reconstruction analysis, contingency pre-screening, NERC FAC-002 transfer capability studies, and EMS model validation.
products.reference: EMS State Estimator / NERC TOP-001

attributes.name: state_estimation_run_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each execution cycle of the Energy Management System (EMS) state estimator. Primary key for the state estimation run record.

attributes.name: balancing_authority_control_area_id
attributes.description: NERC-registered identifier of the Balancing Authority responsible for the control area where this state estimation run was executed. Used for inter-BA coordination and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: FK to grid.control_area.control_area_id — State estimation runs execute within the context of a specific control area's network model. This link is required for multi-area EMS configurations and for scoping SE results to the correct balancing

attributes.name: ems_node_id
attributes.description: FK to grid.ems_node.ems_node_id — State estimation results are per-node/per-branch. After merge of state_estimation_result into state_estimation_run, the result-level grain references ems_node. Required for post-event voltage analysis

attributes.name: state_ems_node_id
attributes.description: FK to grid.ems_node.ems_node_id — State estimation results (now merged into state_estimation_run) produce per-node voltage/angle estimates. The FK to ems_node is required to map results back to the network model for visualization and

attributes.name: bad_data_detection_count
attributes.description: Number of SCADA measurements flagged as bad data (outliers or erroneous readings) during the state estimation execution. High counts indicate telemetry quality issues requiring investigation.

attributes.name: closed_switching_device_count
attributes.description: Number of circuit breakers, disconnects, and other switching devices in the closed (conducting) position during this state estimation run. Defines network connectivity paths.

attributes.name: contingency_pre_screening_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) signaling whether this state estimation solution was used as the base case for contingency analysis pre-screening to identify critical N-1 and N-2 outage scenarios.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: control_center_reference
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical or logical control center facility where the EMS state estimator executed this run. Used for operational audit trail and disaster recovery tracking.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-002 Critical Cyber Asset Identification

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state estimation run record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: de_energized_bus_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical buses (nodes) in the network topology that are de-energized (out of service) and excluded from the state estimation solution for this execution cycle.

attributes.name: ems_model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the EMS network model (bus-branch topology, equipment parameters, ratings) used for this state estimation execution. Critical for model validation and change tracking.

attributes.name: energized_bus_count
attributes.description: Total number of electrical buses (nodes) in the network topology that are energized and included in the state estimation solution for this execution cycle.

attributes.name: execution_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total elapsed time in seconds from state estimation run initiation to solution completion or failure. Used for EMS performance monitoring and capacity planning.

attributes.name: iteration_count
attributes.description: Number of iterative solver cycles executed before the state estimator reached convergence or divergence. High iteration counts may indicate network stress or measurement quality issues.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this state estimation run record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: mvar_mismatch_tolerance
attributes.description: The maximum allowable reactive power mismatch threshold in megavars (MVAR) used as the convergence criterion for the state estimation solver. Critical for voltage stability assessment.
attributes.references: NERC VAR-001 Voltage and Reactive Control

attributes.name: mw_mismatch_tolerance
attributes.description: The maximum allowable active power mismatch threshold in megawatts (MW) used as the convergence criterion for the state estimation solver. Lower values indicate tighter solution accuracy requirements.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: observable_island_count
attributes.description: Number of electrically isolated network islands that have sufficient measurement coverage for state estimation. Each island requires independent solution processing.

attributes.name: open_switching_device_count
attributes.description: Number of circuit breakers, disconnects, and other switching devices in the open (non-conducting) position during this state estimation run. Defines network connectivity and island boundaries.

attributes.name: operator_override_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) signaling whether a system operator manually overrode state estimation inputs, outputs, or solver parameters during this execution cycle. Used for audit trail and compliance evidence.

attributes.name: operator_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the system operator documenting the business justification for any manual override applied during this state estimation run. Required for NERC compliance and post-event review.

attributes.name: pi_historian_tag_prefix
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI System tag prefix or namespace used to store time-series state estimation results (voltage, angle, flow) in the PI historian for operational analytics and post-event review.

attributes.name: pmu_measurement_count
attributes.description: Total number of synchrophasor measurements from Phasor Measurement Units (PMUs) available and processed as inputs to the state estimation algorithm. PMU data provides high-precision time-synchronized voltage and current phasors.

attributes.name: pseudo_measurement_count
attributes.description: Number of pseudo-measurements (synthetic measurements derived from historical load profiles, generation schedules, or forecasts) injected into the state estimation to improve observability in areas with sparse SCADA coverage.

attributes.name: run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the state estimation solution indicating whether the iterative solver successfully converged to a valid network state, diverged without solution, started from flat conditions, failed due to error, was aborted by operator, or produced partial results.

attributes.name: run_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the state estimation execution cycle was initiated by the EMS. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the network state was computed.

attributes.name: scada_measurement_count
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Measurement Count
attributes.description: Total number of SCADA telemetry measurements (voltage, current, MW, MVAR, breaker status) available and processed as inputs to the state estimation algorithm for this execution cycle.

attributes.name: solution_quality_indicator
attributes.description: Qualitative assessment of the state estimation solution quality based on residual magnitude, bad data detection count, and observability metrics. Used for operator confidence and post-event analysis.

attributes.name: system_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Measured or estimated electrical system frequency in Hertz (Hz) at the time of the state estimation run. Nominal frequency is 60 Hz in North America; deviations indicate generation-load imbalance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: thermal_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of transmission lines, transformers, or other network branches where the estimated current or power flow exceeds thermal rating limits. Indicates potential equipment overload requiring operator intervention.

attributes.name: topology_change_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) signaling whether the network topology connectivity state changed since the previous state estimation run due to switching operations, outages, or equipment status changes.

attributes.name: topology_snapshot_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier or hash representing the specific network topology configuration (bus connectivity, switching device states, equipment in-service status) captured at the time of this state estimation run. Used for topology reconstruction and post-event analysis.

attributes.name: total_generation_mw
attributes.description: Sum of active power generation in megawatts (MW) across all generating units included in the state estimation solution. Used for system-wide power balance verification and NERC BAL compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: total_interchange_mw
attributes.description: Net scheduled active power interchange in megawatts (MW) with neighboring balancing authorities or control areas. Positive values indicate net export; negative values indicate net import.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: total_load_mw
attributes.description: Sum of active power load in megawatts (MW) across all load buses included in the state estimation solution. Used for system-wide power balance verification and load forecasting validation.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: total_losses_mw
attributes.description: Calculated active power losses in megawatts (MW) across the transmission network (lines, transformers, reactors) derived from the state estimation solution. Used for loss allocation and energy accounting.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: unobservable_island_count
attributes.description: Number of electrically isolated network islands that lack sufficient SCADA measurement coverage for state estimation. These islands cannot be solved and require operator attention.

attributes.name: voltage_violation_count
attributes.description: Number of electrical buses where the estimated voltage magnitude falls outside acceptable operating limits (typically 0.95 to 1.05 per-unit). High counts indicate voltage stability concerns requiring corrective action.
attributes.references: NERC VAR-001 Voltage and Reactive Control

products.name: state_estimation_result
products.description: Per-node and per-branch output record from each EMS state estimator run. Captures the estimated voltage magnitude (kV), voltage angle (degrees), active power flow (MW), reactive power flow (MVAR), current (amps), and residual for each EMS node or branch in the solved network model. Linked to a parent state_estimation_run. Enables post-event voltage profile analysis, contingency pre-screening, and NERC FAC-002 transfer capability studies.
products.reference: IEC CIM EstimatedInjection / EMS SE Output

attributes.name: state_estimation_result_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each state estimation result record. Primary key for the state estimation result entity.

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.description: The SCADA telemetry point identifier that provided the measurement for this element. Links state estimation results to real-time data sources.

attributes.name: state_estimation_run_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent state estimation run that produced this result. Links this node or branch result to the specific EMS state estimator execution.

attributes.name: active_power_mw
attributes.description: The estimated active power flow through this branch or injected/consumed at this node in megawatts. Represents real power transfer in the network.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Standard

attributes.name: apparent_power_mva
attributes.description: The estimated apparent power (vector sum of active and reactive power) in megavolt-amperes. Used for equipment loading and thermal limit assessment.

attributes.name: balancing_authority
attributes.description: The balancing authority responsible for this network element. Identifies the control area for coordination and reliability compliance.

attributes.name: contingency_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this element would violate operating limits under contingency conditions. Used for pre-screening in contingency analysis.

attributes.name: control_area
attributes.description: The control area to which this network element belongs. Used for area interchange control and automatic generation control (AGC).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this state estimation result record was created in the system. Audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: current_amps
attributes.description: The estimated current flow through this branch or element in amperes. Critical for thermal limit monitoring and equipment protection.

attributes.name: current_magnitude_pu
attributes.description: The estimated current magnitude expressed in per-unit relative to the element rating. Normalized representation for loading assessment.

attributes.name: element_identifier
attributes.description: The unique identifier or name of the network element (node, branch, bus, line) in the EMS model. Corresponds to the SCADA point or network model object.

attributes.name: element_type
attributes.description: The type of network element this result represents. Distinguishes between nodes (buses), branches (lines, transformers), generators, and loads in the EMS network model. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: node|branch|bus|line|transformer|generator|load — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: estimation_confidence
attributes.description: A confidence score (0.0 to 1.0) indicating the reliability of the state estimation for this element based on measurement redundancy and quality.

attributes.name: from_bus_name
attributes.description: For branch elements, the name of the originating bus or node. Defines the topology of the power flow path.

attributes.name: loading_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the element's rated capacity being utilized based on the estimated power flow. Used for thermal limit and contingency analysis.

attributes.name: measurement_status
attributes.description: The quality status of the measurement used for this element in the state estimation. Indicates whether the measurement was accepted, flagged as suspect, or rejected.

attributes.name: normalized_residual
attributes.description: The residual normalized by the measurement standard deviation. Used for bad data detection and measurement validation in state estimation.

attributes.name: observability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this network element was observable in the state estimation (sufficient measurements available to estimate its state). True if observable, False if unobservable.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: The OSIsoft PI historian tag name for this measurement point. Enables integration with PI historian for operational analytics and post-event review.

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: The ratio of active power to apparent power at this element. Indicates the efficiency of power transfer and reactive power balance.

attributes.name: reactive_power_mvar
attributes.description: The estimated reactive power flow through this branch or injected/consumed at this node in megavolt-amperes reactive. Essential for voltage control and stability.
attributes.references: NERC VAR-001 Voltage and Reactive Control Standard

attributes.name: residual
attributes.description: The difference between the measured value and the estimated value for this element. Indicates measurement quality and potential bad data.

attributes.name: result_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this state estimation result was calculated by the EMS state estimator. Represents the real-world event time of the solved network state.

attributes.name: solution_convergence_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the state estimator solution converged for this element. False indicates numerical instability or insufficient measurements.

attributes.name: substation_name
attributes.description: The name of the substation where this network element is located. Provides geographic and operational context for the result.

attributes.name: thermal_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the estimated current or power flow exceeds the thermal rating of this element. Triggers congestion management actions.

attributes.name: to_bus_name
attributes.description: For branch elements, the name of the destination bus or node. Completes the topology definition of the power flow path.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this state estimation result record was last updated. Tracks modifications for audit and data quality purposes.

attributes.name: voltage_angle_degrees
attributes.description: The estimated voltage phase angle at this node in degrees. Critical for power flow analysis and system stability assessment.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: The nominal voltage level of the network element in kilovolts. Indicates whether this is transmission (e.g., 500kV, 345kV, 230kV) or sub-transmission (e.g., 138kV, 69kV).

attributes.name: voltage_magnitude_kv
attributes.description: The estimated voltage magnitude at this node or element in kilovolts. Core output of the state estimator representing the solved voltage level.

attributes.name: voltage_magnitude_pu
attributes.description: The estimated voltage magnitude expressed in per-unit (pu) relative to the nominal voltage level. Standard normalized representation for power system analysis.

attributes.name: voltage_violation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the estimated voltage at this element is outside acceptable operating limits. Triggers voltage control actions.
attributes.references: NERC VAR-001 Voltage and Reactive Control Standard

products.name: contingency
products.description: Master catalog of defined contingency cases (N-1 and N-2 scenarios) with their analysis execution records and violation results from the EMS contingency analysis (CA) function. Master attributes include contingency name, type (line outage, generator trip, transformer loss, bus fault), elements removed, NERC standard applicability (TPL-001 through TPL-004), and severity classification. Analysis run attributes (grain: one row per CA execution) include run timestamp, parent state estimation run reference, contingencies evaluated count, violations detected, worst-case contingency, solution method (full AC/linear DC), and operator acknowledgment. Violation detail attributes (grain: one row per violation per run) include violated element, violation type (thermal overload %, voltage exceedance kV), pre/post-contingency values, applicable rating, and corrective action status. SSOT for contingency definitions, security assessment execution, and N-1/N-2 violation records used in NERC TPL/TOP compliance evidence and real-time operator situational awareness.

attributes.name: contingency_type

attributes.name: corrective_action_description

attributes.name: corrective_action_scheme_enabled
