attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when the switching order execution began, recorded for compliance audit and performance analysis.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the switching order was cancelled or suspended, if applicable, used for operational review and lessons learned.

attributes.name: completed_step_count
attributes.description: Number of switching steps that have been successfully completed and verified.

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting any deviations, issues, or observations recorded during switching order execution, used for post-event review and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: contingency_analysis_performed
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a contingency analysis was performed to assess system reliability impacts before approving the switching order.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the switching order record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether customer notifications are required due to planned service interruption resulting from the switching operation.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system that originated this switching order record, typically the EMS, ADMS, or OMS platform.

attributes.name: ems_integration_enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the switching order is integrated with the Energy Management System for state estimation and contingency analysis updates.

attributes.name: estimated_customer_impact_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of customers who may experience service interruption as a result of the switching operation.

attributes.name: estimated_load_impact_mw
attributes.description: Estimated load in megawatts that will be interrupted or transferred during the switching operation, used for system balancing and contingency analysis.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the switching order record was most recently modified, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: nerc_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this switching order is subject to NERC TOP reliability standard compliance reporting and audit requirements.

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the switching order from initial draft through approval, execution, and completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|approved|issued|in_progress|completed|cancelled|suspended — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the switching order based on operational purpose: planned maintenance, emergency response, system restoration, equipment testing, or new asset commissioning.

attributes.name: outage_coordination_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this switching order requires coordination with neighboring utilities, Regional Transmission Organizations (RTO), or Independent System Operators (ISO).

attributes.name: pi_historian_tag_prefix
attributes.description: Tag prefix used in the OSIsoft PI historian system for archiving switching order execution data and equipment status changes.

attributes.name: post_switching_network_state
attributes.description: Description of the intended network topology and equipment status after the switching order is completed, used for verification and state estimation.

attributes.name: pre_switching_network_state
attributes.description: Description of the network topology and equipment status before the switching order is executed, used for state verification and rollback planning.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to the switching order based on system impact, safety considerations, and business urgency.

attributes.name: safety_clearance_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the associated safety clearance or work permit authorizing personnel to work on de-energized equipment.

attributes.name: scada_verification_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Verification Enabled
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether SCADA telemetry is used to verify equipment status changes during switching order execution.

attributes.name: scheduled_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the switching order execution is scheduled to be completed and equipment returned to normal service.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when the switching order execution is scheduled to begin.

attributes.name: switching_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the switching order, used by operators and field crews for reference and communication.

attributes.name: tagging_authority
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person or role authorized to place safety tags on equipment during the switching sequence.

attributes.name: target_equipment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the equipment being switched: circuit breaker, disconnect switch, transformer, or other grid device. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: circuit_breaker|disconnect_switch|load_break_switch|transformer|capacitor_bank|reactor|bus_tie|recloser — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: total_step_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual switching steps defined in this switching order sequence.

products.name: grid_switching_step
products.description: Individual step within a switching order, representing a single discrete switching action (open or close a specific breaker, disconnect switch, or recloser). Captures step sequence number, parent switching order reference, device identifier, action type (open/close/tag/verify), device pre-action status, device post-action status, executing crew member, execution timestamp, and step completion status. Enables granular audit trail of switching sequence execution for NERC TOP compliance and post-event review.
products.reference: NERC TOP-001 Switching Step

attributes.name: grid_switching_step_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the individual switching step within a switching order. Primary key for the grid switching step entity.

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation where the switching device is located. Enables geographic and operational context for crew dispatch and coordination.

attributes.name: grid_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent switching order that contains this step. Links the step to its parent switching sequence for operational coordination and audit trail.

attributes.name: primary_grid_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the crew member or operator who executed this switching step. Used for accountability, training assessment, and incident investigation.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation Transmission and Distribution

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Individual switching steps target specific assets (circuit breakers, disconnects, reclosers). Work management and safety systems require asset-level traceability to retrieve equipment specifications,

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Point Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Reference to the SCADA telemetry point that monitors the status of the switching device. Enables automated status verification and real-time operational visibility.

attributes.name: spare_parts_catalog_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.spare_parts_catalog. Business justification: Individual switching steps may require specific spare parts (fuses, bushings, control components) for contingency scenarios. Catalog link enables pre-positioning of critical spares at substation befor

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Type of switching action to be performed on the device. Defines the specific operation required for this step in the switching sequence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|close|tag|verify|ground|remove_ground|rack_in|rack_out — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: actual_device_status
attributes.description: Actual observed status of the device after the switching action was executed. Captured from SCADA telemetry or field crew verification for audit trail and discrepancy detection.

attributes.name: actual_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time when this switching step was executed. Captured from SCADA system or field crew reporting for precise audit trail and sequence timing analysis.

attributes.name: authorization_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this switching step was authorized for execution. Documents the authorization event for operational audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: clearance_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the safety clearance or work permit authorizing this switching step. Links to safety management system for compliance verification.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation Transmission and Distribution

attributes.name: contingency_step_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this step is a contingency or alternate step to be executed only if primary steps fail. True for contingency steps, false for primary sequence steps.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this switching step record was first created in the system. Establishes the audit trail origin for the step record.

attributes.name: critical_step_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this step is critical to grid reliability or safety. True for steps that require enhanced verification or cannot be skipped without significant operational impact.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated this switching step record. Typically the Outage Management System (OMS), Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS), or Energy Management System (EMS).

attributes.name: device_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the switching device for operator recognition and communication. Typically includes substation name and device position identifier.
attributes.references: IEEE C37.2 Electrical Power System Device Function Numbers

attributes.name: device_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the switching device (breaker, disconnect switch, recloser, or sectionalizing device) that is the target of this switching action. Links to asset registry or SCADA point configuration.
attributes.references: IEEE C37.2 Electrical Power System Device Function Numbers

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Classification of the switching device being operated. Determines operational procedures, safety protocols, and switching sequence constraints.
attributes.references: IEEE C37.2 Electrical Power System Device Function Numbers

attributes.name: ems_control_command_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Energy Management System (EMS) Control Command Identifier (ID)
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the EMS control command issued to execute this switching step remotely. Links to EMS audit logs for cyber security compliance and operational review.

attributes.name: executing_crew_member_name
attributes.description: Name of the crew member or operator who executed this switching step. Provides human-readable identification for operational logs and audit trails.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation Transmission and Distribution

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Description of the reason why the switching step failed or could not be completed as planned. Captured for root cause analysis and procedure improvement.

attributes.name: hold_tag_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether a physical hold tag was applied to the device as part of this switching step. Used for lockout/tagout compliance and worker safety.

attributes.name: hold_tag_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the physical hold tag applied to the device. Enables tracking of lockout/tagout devices for safety compliance and tag removal coordination.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this switching step record was last modified. Tracks the most recent change to the step record for audit trail and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional operational notes, observations, or special conditions related to this switching step. Captures context not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name for the switching device status point. Enables retrieval of historical device status data for post-event analysis and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: post_action_device_status
attributes.description: Expected status of the device after the switching action is completed. Used for verification that the switching action achieved the intended result.

attributes.name: pre_action_device_status
attributes.description: Expected status of the device before the switching action is executed. Used for verification and safety checks to ensure proper switching sequence execution.

attributes.name: remote_operation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching step was executed remotely via SCADA or Energy Management System (EMS) rather than by field crew. True for remote operations, false for manual field operations.

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of times this switching step was attempted before successful completion. Indicates operational challenges or equipment issues requiring investigation.

attributes.name: safety_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching step requires a safety clearance or work permit before execution. True for steps involving energized equipment or confined spaces.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation Transmission and Distribution

attributes.name: scada_status_confirmed
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Status Confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device status change was confirmed via SCADA telemetry. True if SCADA confirmation received, false if manual verification only or SCADA unavailable.

attributes.name: scheduled_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time for execution of this switching step. Used for crew scheduling, outage coordination, and operational planning.

attributes.name: step_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in minutes from step initiation to completion. Used for operational efficiency analysis, crew performance assessment, and future switching order planning.

attributes.name: step_sequence_number
attributes.description: Sequential order of this step within the parent switching order. Determines the execution order of switching actions to ensure safe and coordinated grid operations.

attributes.name: step_status
attributes.description: Current execution status of this switching step. Tracks the lifecycle state of the step from planning through completion for operational coordination and audit purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|in_progress|completed|verified|failed|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: switching_authority
attributes.description: Role or position of the person who authorized this switching step. Defines the level of operational authority required for the switching action.

attributes.name: verification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the switching step completion was verified. Documents the verification event for compliance with two-person verification protocols.

attributes.name: verifying_crew_member_name
attributes.description: Name of the crew member or operator who verified the completion of this switching step. Provides human-readable identification for verification audit trail.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation Transmission and Distribution

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts of the circuit or equipment being switched. Critical for safety protocols, crew qualifications, and switching procedure selection.
attributes.references: IEEE C37.2 Electrical Power System Device Function Numbers

products.name: voltage_control_action
products.description: Transactional record of voltage control actions taken by the EMS Volt-VAR optimization or operator to maintain voltage within acceptable limits. Captures action timestamp, control type (capacitor bank switching, reactor switching, transformer tap change, generator VAR dispatch), controlled device reference, pre-action voltage (kV), post-action voltage (kV), MVAR change, initiating cause (automatic/operator), and target bus. Supports NERC FAC-001 voltage profile compliance and reactive power management reporting.
products.reference: NERC FAC-001 / EMS Volt-VAR Control

attributes.name: voltage_control_action_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the voltage control action record.

attributes.name: contingency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contingency analysis scenario that recommended or triggered this control action. Null for non-contingency-driven actions.

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the control area where the voltage control action was executed.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system operator who initiated or approved the control action. Null for fully automatic actions. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder affected by the voltage control action. Applicable for distribution-level voltage control actions.

attributes.name: primary_ems_node_id
attributes.description: FK to grid.ems_node.ems_node_id — Voltage control actions target a specific EMS bus (node) to maintain voltage within limits. The FK to ems_node identifies the target bus for the action.

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Point ID
attributes.description: Reference to the SCADA telemetry point associated with the controlled device.

attributes.name: voltage_ems_node_id
attributes.description: Reference to the EMS node (bus) where the voltage control action was targeted.

attributes.name: action_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds from action initiation to completion or stabilization. Includes device response time and system settling time.

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the voltage control action. Successful indicates action completed and achieved desired voltage change, failed indicates action did not execute or had no effect, partial indicates action executed but did not fully achieve target, aborted indicates action was cancelled mid-execution, pending verification indicates action executed but effectiveness not yet confirmed.

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the voltage control action was executed in the field. This is the principal business event timestamp representing when the physical control action occurred.

attributes.name: alarm_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a voltage alarm was triggered that led to this control action. True if an alarm condition existed, False if action was preventive or scheduled.

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this voltage control action was taken to maintain compliance with NERC FAC-001 voltage profile requirements or other regulatory standards. True if compliance-driven, False otherwise.

attributes.name: control_action_type
attributes.description: Type of voltage control action executed. Capacitor bank switching adds reactive power, reactor switching removes reactive power, transformer tap change adjusts voltage ratio, generator VAR dispatch adjusts generator reactive output, static VAR compensator provides dynamic reactive support, synchronous condenser provides rotating reactive reserve.

attributes.name: control_mode
attributes.description: Operating mode under which the control action was executed. Automatic indicates system-initiated without operator intervention, manual indicates direct operator command, supervisory indicates operator-approved automatic action, emergency indicates action taken during system emergency, test indicates action performed during commissioning or testing.

attributes.name: controlled_device_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the physical device that was controlled (e.g., capacitor bank CB-123, transformer T-456, generator G-789).

attributes.name: controlled_device_type
attributes.description: Classification of the controlled device. Capacitor bank provides capacitive reactive power, shunt reactor provides inductive reactive power, load tap changer adjusts transformer voltage, generator provides dynamic VAR support, SVC and STATCOM provide fast dynamic reactive compensation, synchronous condenser provides rotating inertia and reactive support. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: capacitor_bank|shunt_reactor|load_tap_changer|generator|svc|statcom|synchronous_condenser — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this voltage control action record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that originated this voltage control action record (e.g., GE ADMS, OSIsoft PI, SCADA RTU).

attributes.name: ems_system_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the EMS system that executed or recorded the voltage control action (e.g., GE ADMS, ABB Symphony Plus, Siemens Spectrum).
attributes.references: IEC 61970 Energy Management System Application Program Interface

attributes.name: initiating_cause
attributes.description: Source or trigger that initiated the voltage control action. Automatic Volt-VAR optimization indicates EMS algorithm-driven action, automatic voltage regulator indicates local device control, operator manual indicates human-initiated action, state estimator recommendation indicates action based on network state analysis, contingency analysis recommendation indicates preventive action, scheduled maintenance indicates planned operational adjustment.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this voltage control action record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mvar_change
attributes.description: Change in reactive power in megavolt-amperes reactive resulting from the control action. Positive values indicate capacitive reactive power injection (voltage support), negative values indicate inductive reactive power absorption (voltage reduction).

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity jurisdiction where the voltage control action occurred. WECC=Western Electricity Coordinating Council, ERCOT=Electric Reliability Council of Texas, MRO=Midwest Reliability Organization, NPCC=Northeast Power Coordinating Council, RF=ReliabilityFirst, SERC=SERC Reliability Corporation, SPP=Southwest Power Pool, TRE=Texas Reliability Entity. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|ERCOT|MRO|NPCC|RF|SERC|SPP|TRE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator comments, special conditions, or additional context about the voltage control action.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name associated with this voltage control action for time-series data archival and retrieval.

attributes.name: post_action_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Measured voltage in kilovolts at the target bus after the control action was executed and the system stabilized. Used to assess the effectiveness of the control action.

attributes.name: power_factor_post_action
attributes.description: Power factor measured at the target bus after the control action and system stabilization. Used to assess improvement in reactive power balance.

attributes.name: power_factor_pre_action
attributes.description: Power factor measured at the target bus before the control action. Range -1.0 to 1.0, where values closer to 1.0 indicate better reactive power balance. Negative values indicate leading power factor (capacitive), positive values indicate lagging power factor (inductive).

attributes.name: pre_action_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Measured voltage in kilovolts at the target bus immediately before the control action was executed. Used to assess the voltage deviation that triggered the action.

attributes.name: rto_iso_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the RTO or ISO market operator responsible for the transmission system where the action occurred (e.g., CAISO, PJM, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP).

attributes.name: substation_name
attributes.description: Name of the substation where the controlled device is located.

attributes.name: tap_position_change
attributes.description: Number of tap positions changed for transformer tap control actions. Positive values indicate raise operations, negative values indicate lower operations. Null for non-tap control actions.

attributes.name: target_bus_name
attributes.description: Name of the electrical bus where voltage control was targeted. This is the point in the network where voltage was being regulated.

attributes.name: target_bus_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts of the target bus where control action was applied.

attributes.name: voltage_deviation_percent
attributes.description: Percentage deviation of pre-action voltage from the nominal voltage setpoint. Calculated as ((pre_action_voltage - nominal_voltage) / nominal_voltage) * 100. Positive values indicate overvoltage, negative values indicate undervoltage.

attributes.name: voltage_limit_high_kv
attributes.description: Upper voltage limit in kilovolts for the target bus as defined by operating procedures or NERC standards. Actions are triggered when voltage approaches or exceeds this limit.

attributes.name: voltage_limit_low_kv
attributes.description: Lower voltage limit in kilovolts for the target bus as defined by operating procedures or NERC standards. Actions are triggered when voltage approaches or falls below this limit.

attributes.name: voltage_setpoint_kv
attributes.description: Target voltage setpoint in kilovolts that the control action was attempting to achieve or maintain at the target bus.

products.name: frequency_event
products.description: Transactional record of a system frequency excursion event detected by the EMS. Captures event start timestamp, nadir frequency (Hz), recovery frequency (Hz), rate of change of frequency (ROCOF in Hz/s), duration (seconds), triggering cause (generation trip, load loss, islanding), under-frequency load shedding (UFLS) activation flag, MW of load shed, and restoration timestamp. SSOT for frequency disturbance events used in NERC BAL-003 frequency response obligation reporting and post-event analysis.
products.reference: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response / IEEE 1159

attributes.name: frequency_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the frequency excursion event. Primary key for the frequency event record.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corrective action plan developed in response to this frequency event to prevent recurrence or mitigate future impacts.

attributes.name: emergency_stock_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.emergency_stock_event. Business justification: Frequency excursion events causing generation/transmission equipment damage trigger emergency stock deployment for restoration. Essential for tracking material response to interconnection-wide disturb

attributes.name: ems_alarm_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the EMS alarm that was triggered when the frequency event was detected. Links the event to the real-time alarm sequence.
attributes.references: IEEE C37.1 SCADA and Automation Systems

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.outage_event. Business justification: Large outages trigger frequency events (generation/load imbalance). Linking enables analysis of frequency response, UFLS activation, and NERC BAL-003 compliance for disturbance control standard.

attributes.name: frequency_control_area_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the control area or balancing authority where the frequency event was detected.

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Point ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary SCADA measurement point used to detect and monitor the frequency event, typically a system frequency measurement point.
attributes.references: IEEE C37.1 SCADA and Automation Systems

attributes.name: to_control_area_id
attributes.description: FK to grid.control_area.control_area_id — Frequency events are detected within a specific control area's EMS. FK to control_area scopes the event for NERC BAL-003 frequency response obligation reporting.

attributes.name: agc_response_enabled_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Automatic Generation Control (AGC) Response Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Automatic Generation Control (AGC) was active and responding during the frequency event to provide corrective generation adjustments.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this frequency event record was first created in the data system.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that captured and recorded the frequency event data, typically the Energy Management System (EMS) or SCADA system.

attributes.name: disturbance_mw
attributes.description: Magnitude of the generation or load disturbance in Megawatts (MW) that caused the frequency event. Represents the MW imbalance introduced into the system.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: event_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the frequency excursion event measured in seconds, from initial detection to restoration or stabilization.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the frequency excursion event concluded and system frequency returned to acceptable operating range or stabilized.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: event_severity
attributes.description: Severity classification of the frequency event based on magnitude of frequency deviation, duration, and system impact. Used for prioritization and post-event analysis.

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the frequency excursion event was first detected by the Energy Management System (EMS). Represents the moment system frequency deviated beyond normal operating thresholds.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the frequency event based on the direction of frequency deviation: under-frequency (frequency drop), over-frequency (frequency rise), or frequency oscillation (sustained fluctuation).
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: frequency_deviation_hz
attributes.description: Maximum deviation of system frequency from nominal frequency (typically 60 Hz in North America or 50 Hz elsewhere) during the event, measured in Hertz.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: frequency_response_mw_per_hz
attributes.description: Measured frequency response of the balancing authority in Megawatts per Hertz (MW/Hz), calculated as the change in generation output divided by the change in frequency. Key metric for NERC BAL-003 compliance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: generation_response_mw
attributes.description: Total generation response in Megawatts (MW) provided by generating units through governor action, Automatic Generation Control (AGC), or manual dispatch to arrest frequency deviation.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: interconnection_name
attributes.description: Name of the North American interconnection where the frequency event occurred: Eastern Interconnection, Western Interconnection, Texas (ERCOT) Interconnection, or Quebec Interconnection.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this frequency event record was last modified or updated with additional information.

attributes.name: load_shed_mw
attributes.description: Total amount of load shed in Megawatts (MW) through UFLS or manual operator actions to restore frequency balance during the event.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

attributes.name: max_rocof_hz_per_second
attributes.business_glossary_term: Maximum Rate of Change of Frequency (ROCOF) (Hz/s)
attributes.description: Maximum rate of change of frequency observed during the event in Hertz per second (Hz/s). Peak ROCOF value used for worst-case analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources

attributes.name: nadir_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Lowest system frequency in Hertz (Hz) reached during the under-frequency event. Critical metric for assessing severity of frequency decline and system stability.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity with jurisdiction over the balancing authority where the event occurred (e.g., WECC, SERC, MRO, NPCC, RF, TRE).

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by system operators documenting observations, actions taken, and contextual information about the frequency event.

attributes.name: peak_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Highest system frequency in Hertz (Hz) reached during an over-frequency event. Used for over-frequency disturbance analysis.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name for the frequency measurement time series data associated with this event. Used for detailed post-event analysis and trending.

attributes.name: pre_event_frequency_hz
attributes.description: System frequency in Hertz (Hz) immediately before the disturbance event occurred, representing baseline operating frequency.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: recovery_frequency_hz
attributes.description: System frequency in Hertz (Hz) at the point of stabilization or restoration after the disturbance, indicating the settling point after corrective actions.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: reportable_event_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the frequency event meets NERC EOP-004 criteria for mandatory reporting to regulatory authorities and the Electricity Reliability Organization (ERO).

attributes.name: restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when system frequency was fully restored to normal operating range and all corrective actions were completed.

attributes.name: rocof_hz_per_second
attributes.description: Rate of Change of Frequency measured in Hertz per second (Hz/s). Indicates how rapidly system frequency is changing and is critical for assessing system inertia and disturbance severity.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnection and Interoperability of Distributed Energy Resources

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis_completed_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal root cause analysis has been completed for this frequency event.

attributes.name: triggering_cause
attributes.description: Root cause or initiating event that triggered the frequency excursion. Common causes include generation unit trip, sudden load loss, transmission fault, system islanding, or tie-line trip.

attributes.name: ufls_activated_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Under-Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS) schemes were activated during the event to arrest frequency decline and prevent system collapse.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

attributes.name: ufls_stage_activated
attributes.description: Identifier of the UFLS stage or stages that were activated during the event (e.g., Stage 1, Stage 2). Multiple stages may be activated in severe events.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

products.name: pmu_measurement
products.description: Time-series record of Phasor Measurement Unit (PMU) synchrophasor data ingested from the wide-area measurement system (WAMS) into the OSIsoft PI historian and Silver layer. Captures PMU device reference, UTC timestamp (microsecond precision), voltage phasor magnitude (kV) and angle (degrees), current phasor magnitude (amps) and angle, frequency (Hz), ROCOF (Hz/s), and PDC data quality flags. Supports wide-area situational awareness, oscillation detection, and NERC PRC-002 disturbance monitoring compliance.
products.reference: IEEE C37.118 Synchrophasor / NERC PRC-002

attributes.name: pmu_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the PMU synchrophasor measurement record. Primary key for the pmu_measurement product.

attributes.name: pmu_device_id
attributes.description: Reference to the PMU device that generated this measurement. Links to the physical PMU asset in the asset registry.

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Point ID
attributes.description: Reference to the SCADA point configuration associated with this PMU measurement stream. Links to the SCADA point registry for metadata and configuration.

attributes.name: wams_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to a WAMS disturbance or oscillation event that this measurement is associated with. Null for routine measurements outside of event windows.

attributes.name: active_power_mw
attributes.description: Real power flow in megawatts calculated from voltage and current phasors. Positive values indicate power flowing in the defined direction.

attributes.name: apparent_power_mva
attributes.description: Apparent power in megavolt-amperes, the vector sum of active and reactive power. Represents total power flow magnitude.

attributes.name: balancing_authority_code
attributes.description: NERC-registered balancing authority code for the control area where this PMU is located. Used for jurisdictional reporting and inter-BA coordination.

attributes.name: current_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Phase angle of the current phasor in degrees relative to the system reference. Used to calculate power flow and detect phase imbalances.

attributes.name: current_magnitude_amps
attributes.description: Magnitude of the current phasor measured in amperes. Represents the RMS current flowing through the monitored circuit element.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Quality indicator for the PMU measurement data. Good indicates valid GPS-synchronized data; questionable indicates potential issues; invalid indicates data should not be used for analysis.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system that provided this PMU measurement data. Typically the PDC system name or OSIsoft PI interface identifier.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of electrical equipment being monitored by this PMU measurement. Determines the interpretation and application of the phasor data.

attributes.name: frequency_hz
attributes.description: Measured system frequency in Hertz at the PMU location. Nominal frequency is 60 Hz in North America or 50 Hz in other regions. Frequency deviations indicate generation-load imbalances.

attributes.name: ingestion_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PMU measurement record was ingested into the Silver layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage and latency monitoring.

attributes.name: interconnection_name
attributes.description: North American interconnection where this PMU is located. The four major interconnections operate asynchronously from each other.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the PMU device location in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial visualization and propagation analysis.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the PMU device location in decimal degrees. Used for geospatial visualization and propagation analysis.

attributes.name: measurement_timestamp_utc
attributes.description: Precise UTC timestamp of the synchrophasor measurement with microsecond resolution. GPS-synchronized time reference for wide-area situational awareness and event correlation.

attributes.name: negative_sequence_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Negative sequence component of the three-phase voltage in kilovolts. Indicates voltage imbalance and potential phase faults.

attributes.name: nerc_prc_002_registered
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Protection and Control (PRC) 002 Registered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PMU measurement point is registered for NERC PRC-002 disturbance monitoring compliance. Registered points must retain data for reportable disturbances.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, data quality annotations, or event context related to this PMU measurement record.

attributes.name: oscillation_damping_ratio
attributes.description: Damping ratio of the detected oscillation mode. Values below 0.03 indicate poorly damped oscillations requiring operator attention. Null if no oscillation detected.

attributes.name: oscillation_detected_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an inter-area or local oscillation was detected in this measurement window by the WAMS analytics engine. Used for modal analysis and stability assessment.

attributes.name: oscillation_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Dominant oscillation frequency detected in Hertz. Typical inter-area oscillations range from 0.1 to 1.0 Hz. Null if no oscillation detected.

attributes.name: pdc_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the PDC that aggregated and forwarded this PMU measurement. PDCs collect synchrophasor data from multiple PMUs for wide-area monitoring.

attributes.name: pi_archive_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether this PMU measurement stream is actively archived in the OSIsoft PI historian for long-term storage and analysis.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name where this PMU measurement stream is archived. Enables correlation with other SCADA and operational data in the PI system.

attributes.name: pmu_configuration_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the PMU configuration frame active when this measurement was captured. Used to track configuration changes over time.

attributes.name: pmu_sync_status
attributes.description: Overall synchronization status of the PMU device. Synchronized indicates the PMU is GPS-locked and producing valid time-aligned measurements.

attributes.name: positive_sequence_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Positive sequence component of the three-phase voltage in kilovolts. Represents the balanced component of the voltage phasor.

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of active power to apparent power, ranging from -1.0 to 1.0. Indicates the efficiency of power transmission and the phase relationship between voltage and current.

attributes.name: reactive_power_mvar
attributes.description: Reactive power flow in megavolt-amperes reactive calculated from voltage and current phasors. Used for voltage control and power factor management.

attributes.name: record_version
attributes.description: Version number of this measurement record. Incremented if the record is corrected or reprocessed. Initial version is 1.

attributes.name: reporting_rate_fps
attributes.description: PMU reporting rate in frames per second. Common rates are 30, 60, or 120 FPS. Higher rates provide better temporal resolution for transient event analysis.

attributes.name: rocof_hz_per_second
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rate of Change of Frequency (ROCOF) Hertz per Second (Hz/s)
attributes.description: Rate of change of frequency measured in Hz per second. High ROCOF values indicate rapid frequency excursions and potential grid instability events requiring immediate response.

attributes.name: substation_name
attributes.description: Name of the substation where the PMU device is installed. Provides geographic and operational context for the measurement.

attributes.name: time_quality_flag
attributes.description: GPS time synchronization status. Locked indicates accurate GPS time; unlocked indicates loss of GPS signal; holdover indicates operating on internal clock.

attributes.name: total_harmonic_distortion_current_percent
attributes.description: Total harmonic distortion of the current waveform expressed as a percentage. Indicates non-linear load effects and power quality issues.

attributes.name: total_harmonic_distortion_voltage_percent
attributes.description: Total harmonic distortion of the voltage waveform expressed as a percentage. Measures power quality and the presence of harmonic frequencies.

attributes.name: voltage_angle_degrees
attributes.description: Phase angle of the voltage phasor in degrees relative to the system reference. Critical for detecting angular separation and stability issues across the wide-area grid.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level of the bus or circuit where the PMU is measuring. Common transmission levels include 115, 230, 345, 500, and 765 kV.

attributes.name: voltage_magnitude_kv
attributes.description: Magnitude of the voltage phasor measured in kilovolts. Represents the RMS voltage at the PMU measurement point.

attributes.name: zero_sequence_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Zero sequence component of the three-phase voltage in kilovolts. Indicates ground faults and neutral voltage displacement.

SSOT for PMU device inventory used in WAMS configuration and synchrophasor data quality management.

attributes.name: commissioning_date
attributes.description: Date when the PMU device was commissioned and began operational data reporting in the WAMS network.

attributes.name: communication_protocol

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_latency_ms

attributes.name: data_quality_threshold_pct

attributes.name: data_source_system

attributes.name: device_name

attributes.name: device_serial_number

attributes.name: device_type

attributes.name: firmware_version
attributes.description: Current firmware version installed on the PMU device, critical for compatibility and feature support in synchrophasor data collection.

attributes.name: gps_sync_source
attributes.description: Time synchronization method used by the PMU to achieve microsecond-level timestamp accuracy required for synchrophasor measurements (GPS antenna, IRIG-B, Precision Time Protocol, Network Time Protocol, or internal clock).

attributes.name: installation_date

attributes.name: interconnection_name

attributes.name: ip_address

attributes.name: last_calibration_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent calibration or accuracy verification test performed on the PMU device to ensure measurement quality.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PMU device record was most recently modified.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the PMU device installation location in decimal degrees.

attributes.name: longitude

attributes.name: maintenance_contract_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the maintenance service contract covering this PMU device.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the PMU device (e.g., SEL, GE, ABB, Schweitzer Engineering Laboratories).

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Manufacturer model number or designation for the PMU device, identifying the specific product line and capabilities.

attributes.name: monitored_bus_name
attributes.description: Name of the electrical bus or node that this PMU is monitoring for voltage phasor measurements.

attributes.name: monitored_line_name
attributes.description: Name of the transmission line or branch that this PMU is monitoring for current phasor and power flow measurements.

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.description: North American Electric Reliability Corporation regional entity jurisdiction where the PMU is located (WECC, ERCOT, MRO, NPCC, RF, SERC, SPP, TRE). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|ERCOT|MRO|NPCC|RF|SERC|SPP|TRE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: nerc_registration_code
attributes.description: NERC-assigned registration identifier for this PMU device when registered under PRC-002 disturbance monitoring requirements.

attributes.name: next_calibration_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required calibration or accuracy verification test of the PMU device.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional notes, comments, or special considerations related to the PMU device configuration or operation.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the PMU device in the WAMS network, indicating whether it is actively reporting synchrophasor data.

attributes.name: operator_organization
attributes.description: Name of the utility or organization responsible for operating and maintaining the PMU device, which may differ from the owner.

attributes.name: owner_organization

attributes.name: pdc_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the Phasor Data Concentrator that aggregates and time-aligns synchrophasor data from this PMU device.

attributes.name: pdc_stream_reference
attributes.description: Unique stream identifier or channel number assigned by the PDC for this PMU data feed.

attributes.name: pi_tag_prefix
attributes.description: Prefix used for all OSIsoft PI historian tags associated with this PMU device, enabling integration with PI for synchrophasor data archival and analytics.

attributes.name: reporting_rate_fps
attributes.description: Number of synchrophasor data frames transmitted per second by the PMU device, typically 30, 60, or 120 frames per second depending on application requirements.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when the PMU device was decommissioned and removed from operational service in the WAMS network.

attributes.name: total_error_vector_limit_pct
attributes.description: Maximum allowable Total Error Vector percentage for synchrophasor measurements, per IEEE C37.118 accuracy requirements.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts of the electrical equipment being monitored by the PMU device.

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date

products.name: operator_log
products.description: Chronological record of all system operator actions, EMS alarms, voltage control actions, and observations recorded during grid operations. Operator log attributes include entry timestamp, operator ID, shift reference, entry type (action taken, alarm, voltage control action, verbal communication, abnormal condition noted, switching order issued), free-text narrative, associated equipment or event reference, and priority level. Alarm attributes (entry_type=alarm) include alarm type (limit violation, equipment status change, communication failure, protection relay operation), alarm priority (critical/major/minor), associated SCADA point or EMS node, alarm message text, acknowledgment timestamp, and clearance timestamp. Voltage control attributes (entry_type=voltage_control) include control type (capacitor bank switching, reactor switching, transformer tap change, generator VAR dispatch), controlled device, pre/post-action voltage (kV), MVAR change, and initiating cause (automatic/operator). SSOT for the unified operational event log required by NERC TOP-001, NERC FAC-001 voltage profile compliance, alarm management performance tracking, post-event investigations, and regulatory audits.
products.reference: NERC TOP-001 Operator Log

attributes.name: audit_id

attributes.name: event_id

attributes.name: primary_operator_control_area_id
attributes.description: Reference to the control area or balancing authority area where the logged event occurred. Links the entry to the responsible operational jurisdiction.

attributes.name: registry_id

attributes.name: scada_point_id

attributes.name: shift_assignment_id

attributes.name: state_estimation_run_id

attributes.name: abnormal_condition_category

attributes.name: ace_mw

attributes.name: agc_mode_at_entry

attributes.description: Operating mode of the automatic generation control system at the time of the log entry. Documents the AGC state for operational context.

attributes.name: alarm_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alarm was acknowledged by the operator. Used for alarm response time analysis and operator performance metrics.

attributes.name: alarm_clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alarm condition was cleared or resolved. Marks the end of the alarm lifecycle for duration analysis.

attributes.name: alarm_message_text

attributes.name: alarm_priority

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: Classification of the alarm when entry_type is alarm. Categorizes the nature of the alarm condition for alarm management and performance tracking.

attributes.name: communication_method

attributes.name: communication_party

attributes.name: contingency_analysis_flag

attributes.name: control_initiating_cause
attributes.description: Classification of what triggered the voltage control action. Distinguishes between automatic system responses, manual operator interventions, scheduled actions, and emergency responses.

attributes.name: controlled_device
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the device that was controlled when entry_type is voltage_control_action. Specifies the equipment operated for voltage regulation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the operator log record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Audit field for data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: entry_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the operator action, observation, or event. Provides detailed context and operator commentary for post-event analysis and regulatory review.

attributes.name: entry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the operator log entry was recorded in the EMS system. This is the principal event timestamp for the log entry, critical for chronological reconstruction of grid operations and NERC TOP-001 compliance.

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the operator log entry type. Discriminates between operator actions, system alarms, voltage control activities, communications, abnormal conditions, and switching orders.

attributes.name: equipment_reference
attributes.description: Free-text reference to the equipment, device, or facility associated with the log entry. May include breaker names, transformer IDs, line designations, or substation names.

attributes.name: frequency_hz
attributes.description: System frequency in hertz at the time of the log entry. Critical measurement for frequency regulation and NERC BAL standard compliance.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the operator log record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Audit field for change tracking.

attributes.name: mvar_change
attributes.description: Change in reactive power in megavolt-amperes reactive resulting from the voltage control action. Quantifies the reactive power adjustment made.

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_event
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether the logged event meets NERC EOP-004 criteria for mandatory event reporting. Used for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: pi_tag_name

attributes.name: pre_action_voltage_kv

attributes.name: clearance_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the alarm condition was resolved and the alarm was cleared. Null if the alarm is still active. Used to calculate alarm duration and system performance metrics.

attributes.name: contingency_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alarm is related to a contingency analysis violation or post-contingency condition. True if the alarm resulted from contingency analysis.
attributes.references: NERC TPL-001 Transmission System Planning Performance Requirements

attributes.name: corrective_action
attributes.description: Description of the corrective action taken to resolve the alarm condition. Used for operational documentation and continuous improvement.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this alarm record was first inserted into the data system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system that provided this alarm record, such as the specific EMS vendor system or SCADA master. Supports multi-system data integration and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: disturbance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alarm is associated with a system disturbance event requiring NERC reporting. True if the alarm is part of a reportable disturbance.

attributes.name: ems_system_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the EMS system that generated the alarm. Supports multi-EMS environments and system-specific alarm analysis.

attributes.name: engineering_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the limit value and measured value, such as MW, MVAR, kV, Amps, Hz, or degrees. Essential for interpreting alarm magnitude.

attributes.name: equipment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or designation of the specific equipment associated with the alarm, as known to operators and maintenance personnel.

attributes.name: equipment_type
attributes.description: Type of equipment associated with the alarm condition, such as transformer, breaker, line, generator, capacitor bank, or relay. Supports equipment-specific alarm analysis.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this alarm record was last modified. Tracks changes to alarm state, acknowledgment, clearance, or operator notes.

attributes.name: limit_type
attributes.description: For limit violation alarms, specifies the type of limit that was exceeded: high, low, high-high (critical high), low-low (critical low), rate of change, or deadband violation.

attributes.name: limit_value
attributes.description: The threshold value that was exceeded to trigger the alarm. Provides context for the severity of the limit violation.

attributes.name: measured_value
attributes.description: The actual measured value at the time the alarm was triggered. Allows operators to assess the magnitude of the deviation from normal or limit conditions.

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity code (e.g., WECC, ERCOT, NPCC, SERC, MRO, RFC, SPP, TRE) for the geographic region where the alarm originated. Required for NERC compliance reporting.

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the alarm condition meets NERC criteria for mandatory event reporting under EOP-004 or other reliability standards. True if reportable to NERC.

attributes.name: operator_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by operators regarding the alarm, including actions taken, root cause observations, or coordination with other entities. Supports knowledge capture and post-event review.

attributes.name: pi_tag_name
attributes.description: OSIsoft PI historian tag name associated with the alarm, enabling integration with PI data for post-event analysis and trending.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Severity classification of the alarm indicating the urgency of operator response required. Critical alarms require immediate action, major alarms require prompt attention, minor alarms are monitored, and informational alarms are logged for awareness.

attributes.name: related_alarm_count
attributes.description: Number of related or cascading alarms that occurred within a defined time window of this alarm. Helps identify alarm floods and system-wide events.

attributes.name: response_time_seconds
attributes.description: Time in seconds from alarm generation to operator acknowledgment. Key performance indicator for alarm management and operator situational awareness.

attributes.name: root_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the alarm condition, assigned during post-event analysis. Supports trending and reliability improvement initiatives.
attributes.references: NERC GADS Generating Availability Data System

attributes.name: rtu_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the RTU that reported the alarm condition, if applicable. Links alarm to field communication infrastructure.

attributes.name: suppression_rule
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the alarm suppression rule applied to this alarm, if any. Supports intelligent alarm management and reduction of alarm floods.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts of the equipment or node associated with the alarm. Critical for prioritizing alarms based on system criticality.

products.name: grid_reliability_event
products.description: Transactional record of reportable reliability events as defined by NERC reliability standards (EOP, TOP, BAL), including frequency excursion events. General event attributes include event date/time, event type (disturbance, emergency, unusual occurrence, frequency excursion), NERC standard applicability, affected facilities, initiating cause, MW impact, duration, corrective actions taken, NERC OE-417 report reference, and regulatory submission status. Frequency excursion attributes (event_type=frequency_excursion) include nadir frequency (Hz), recovery frequency (Hz), ROCOF (Hz/s), excursion duration (seconds), triggering cause (generation trip, load loss, islanding), UFLS activation flag, MW of load shed, and restoration timestamp. SSOT for all NERC reliability event reporting including NERC BAL-003 frequency response obligation — distinct from outage records (owned by outage domain) which focus on customer impact.
products.reference: NERC EOP-004 / DOE OE-417 Disturbance Report

attributes.name: grid_reliability_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the grid reliability event record. Primary key for the grid reliability event entity.

attributes.name: audit_id

attributes.name: control_area_id

attributes.name: emergency_stock_event_id

attributes.name: operator_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: NERC reliability events (OE-417 reports) require documented operator accountability. 'operator_on_duty' text field should be FK to employee for regulatory audit trails and operator performance analysi

attributes.name: safety_incident_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.safety_incident. Business justification: NERC reliability events can involve personnel safety incidents. Linking enables correlation of NERC OE-417 reports with OSHA recordables for comprehensive event investigation and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: affected_facilities
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or free-text description of generation plants, substations, transmission lines, and other facilities impacted by the reliability event.

attributes.name: corrective_actions_taken
attributes.description: Detailed description of immediate corrective actions and operator interventions taken to mitigate and resolve the reliability event. Includes switching orders, generation redispatch, and emergency procedures.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability event record was first created in the system, in UTC. Audit field for data lineage and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of customer accounts impacted by the reliability event, if the event resulted in customer outages. Used for regulatory reporting and impact assessment.

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system or application that created or last updated this reliability event record. Used for data lineage and integration troubleshooting.

attributes.name: ems_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the EMS system that detected and recorded the reliability event. Used for data lineage and system integration.

attributes.name: event_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the reliability event from start to resolution, measured in minutes. Calculated from event start and end timestamps.

attributes.name: event_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reliability event was resolved or system returned to normal operating conditions, in UTC. Null if event is still ongoing.

attributes.name: event_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reliability event was first detected or initiated, in UTC. This is the principal business event timestamp for the reliability event.

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reliability event in the investigation and resolution workflow.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reliability event according to NERC reporting categories. Determines which NERC standards and reporting requirements apply. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: disturbance|emergency|unusual_occurrence|frequency_excursion|voltage_excursion|load_shed|generation_loss|transmission_loss|islanding — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: frequency_excursion_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the frequency excursion from initial deviation to recovery within acceptable limits, measured in seconds. Used for NERC BAL-003 compliance assessment.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: frequency_excursion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event involved a system frequency excursion outside normal operating limits. True if frequency deviated beyond acceptable thresholds per NERC BAL-003.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: frequency_excursion_trigger
attributes.description: Specific triggering cause of the frequency excursion event. Categorizes the type of disturbance that caused frequency deviation.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: initiating_cause
attributes.description: Root cause or triggering event that initiated the reliability event. Free-text description of the primary causal factor (e.g., generator trip, transmission line fault, equipment failure, weather event).

attributes.name: initiating_cause_category
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the root cause category for analytics and trend analysis. Aligns with NERC cause code taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|weather|human_error|cyber_security|physical_security|fuel_supply|load_forecast_error|unknown|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: interconnection_name
attributes.description: North American interconnection in which the reliability event occurred. Determines applicable reliability standards and coordination requirements.

attributes.name: investigation_complete_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the root cause investigation and analysis of the reliability event has been completed. True when final investigation report is approved.

attributes.name: investigation_report_url
attributes.description: URL or file path to the detailed investigation report document for this reliability event. Used for audit trail and knowledge repository access.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability event record was most recently modified, in UTC. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: lessons_learned
attributes.description: Summary of key lessons learned from the reliability event investigation. Used for knowledge management and continuous improvement of grid operations.

attributes.name: mw_impact
attributes.description: Total megawatt impact of the reliability event, representing generation loss, load shed, or transmission capacity reduction. Positive value indicates magnitude of impact.

attributes.name: nadir_frequency_hz
attributes.description: Lowest system frequency reached during a frequency excursion event, measured in Hertz. Applicable only when event_type is frequency_excursion. Critical metric for NERC BAL-003 frequency response obligation.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: nerc_oe417_report_number
attributes.description: Reference number for the DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report filed for this event, if applicable. Used to track regulatory submission.
attributes.references: DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity with jurisdiction over the control area where the event occurred. Determines regional compliance and reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|ERCOT|MRO|NPCC|RF|SERC|TRE|SPP — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this event meets NERC criteria for mandatory reporting to regulatory authorities. True if event must be reported per NERC EOP-004.

attributes.name: nerc_standard_applicability
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Standard Applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of applicable NERC reliability standards triggered by this event (e.g., EOP-004, BAL-003, TOP-001). Determines regulatory reporting obligations.

attributes.name: nerc_submission_status
attributes.description: Status of regulatory report submission to NERC and other governing bodies. Tracks compliance with mandatory reporting timelines.

attributes.name: nerc_submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the event report was submitted to NERC or other regulatory authorities, in UTC. Used to verify compliance with reporting deadlines.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-form notes and comments about the reliability event. Used for supplementary information not captured in structured fields.

attributes.name: pi_historian_tag_prefix
attributes.description: Tag prefix in the OSIsoft PI historian system for retrieving detailed telemetry data associated with this reliability event. Enables post-event analysis and forensics.

attributes.name: preventive_actions_recommended
attributes.description: Recommended preventive measures and long-term corrective actions to prevent recurrence of similar reliability events. Used for continuous improvement and reliability planning.

attributes.name: recovery_frequency_hz
attributes.description: System frequency after initial recovery and stabilization following a frequency excursion, measured in Hertz. Used to assess frequency response adequacy.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when all affected facilities and customer load were fully restored to normal service following the reliability event, in UTC.

attributes.name: rocof_hz_per_second
attributes.business_glossary_term: Rate of Change of Frequency (ROCOF) in Hertz per Second
attributes.description: Maximum rate of change of frequency during the excursion event, measured in Hertz per second. Critical parameter for assessing system inertia and frequency response performance.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-003 Frequency Response and Frequency Bias Setting

attributes.name: rto_iso_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) Name
attributes.description: Name of the RTO or ISO responsible for grid operations in the affected area, if applicable. Used for coordination and reporting.

attributes.name: scada_snapshot_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Snapshot Timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the SCADA system snapshot captured at the time of event detection, in UTC. Used to correlate event data with real-time telemetry.

attributes.name: severity_index
attributes.description: Calculated severity score for the reliability event based on MW impact, duration, frequency deviation, and customer impact. Used for prioritization and trend analysis.

attributes.name: ufls_activation_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Under Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS) Activation Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automatic under-frequency load shedding relays were activated during the event. True if UFLS protection operated to arrest frequency decline.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

attributes.name: ufls_load_shed_mw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Under Frequency Load Shedding (UFLS) Load Shed (Megawatts)
attributes.description: Total amount of load automatically shed by UFLS relays during the frequency excursion, measured in megawatts. Null if UFLS was not activated.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-006 Automatic Underfrequency Load Shedding

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions at the time of the reliability event, if weather was a contributing factor. Includes temperature, wind, precipitation, and severe weather events.

products.name: operating_limit
products.description: Master and transactional record defining all operating limits for transmission elements and interfaces — static seasonal ratings, ambient-adjusted ratings (AAR), and dynamic line ratings (DLR) — within the EMS network model. Static/seasonal attributes include element reference (line, transformer, interface), limit type (normal/emergency MVA, voltage upper/lower kV, stability MW), applicable season, ambient temperature condition, and NERC FAC-002 study reference. Dynamic real-time rating attributes (grain: one row per element per rating timestamp) include ambient-adjusted or dynamic normal and emergency MVA, ambient temperature (°F), wind speed (mph), solar irradiance (W/m²), conductor temperature (°C), rating method (static/ambient-adjusted/dynamic), and validity window. SSOT for all operating limits and real-time ratings used by EMS contingency analysis, operator displays, NERC FAC-001/FAC-008 compliance, and transmission capacity optimization.
products.reference: NERC FAC-001 / FAC-002 Operating Limit

attributes.name: conductor_temperature_c

attributes.references: IEEE 738 Standard for Calculating Current-Temperature Relationship of Bare Overhead Conductors

attributes.name: contingency_analysis_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this operating limit is monitored and enforced during EMS contingency analysis (N-1, N-2 studies). True means the limit is included in contingency screening and violation detection.
attributes.references: NERC TOP-002 Operations Planning, NERC FAC-011 System Operating Limits

attributes.name: created_timestamp
