attributes.description: Date when this REC expires and can no longer be used for compliance or sold. Based on registry rules and state-specific banking limitations.
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations, Registry Expiration Rules

attributes.name: generation_date
attributes.description: Date when the renewable energy generation occurred. Used for vintage year determination and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: green_e_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this REC meets Green-e certification standards for voluntary renewable energy programs. Green-e certification requires additional eligibility criteria beyond basic RPS compliance.
attributes.references: Green-e Certification Standards, Center for Resource Solutions

attributes.name: holding_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the REC holding. Indicates whether the REC is available for use, has been retired for compliance, sold to a counterparty, or is in a pending transaction state.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this REC holding record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to this REC holding. Used for documenting special circumstances, compliance decisions, or transaction details.

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Name of the trading portfolio or book to which this REC holding is assigned. Used for position aggregation and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: quantity_mwh
attributes.description: Quantity of renewable energy represented by this REC holding, measured in megawatt-hours. One REC typically represents one MWh of renewable generation.

attributes.name: registry_transaction_code
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the REC registry system for this transfer, retirement, or issuance. Provides audit trail linkage to the external registry.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date when this REC was retired in the registry system. Null if the REC has not been retired. Used for compliance period tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for retiring this REC. Provides audit trail for compliance filings and voluntary program tracking.

attributes.name: retirement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether and why this REC has been retired. Retired RECs cannot be sold or transferred and represent the final disposition of the environmental attribute.

attributes.name: rps_compliance_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) Compliance Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this REC is eligible for use in meeting state RPS compliance obligations. Eligibility is determined by fuel type, vintage, generation location, and state-specific rules.
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations, PUC Compliance Rules

attributes.name: rps_tier
attributes.description: RPS tier classification for this REC based on state-specific renewable energy portfolio standards. Different tiers have different compliance values and eligibility rules.
attributes.references: State RPS Regulations, PUC Compliance Rules

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when financial settlement for this REC transaction occurred. Used for cash flow tracking and accounts payable/receivable reconciliation.
attributes.references: OpenLink Endur Settlement, GAAP Cash Accounting

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Date when the REC transaction was executed. Represents the business event timestamp for inventory movement and financial settlement.
attributes.references: OpenLink Endur Deal Capture, NAESB WEQ-015

attributes.name: transaction_price_usd
attributes.description: Price per megawatt-hour for this REC transaction. Used for mark-to-market valuation, revenue recognition, and market price benchmarking.
attributes.references: OpenLink Endur Position Management, GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of transaction that created or modified this REC holding record. Tracks all movements in the REC inventory ledger. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: purchase|sale|retirement|transfer_in|transfer_out|import|export — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OpenLink Endur Transaction Types, NAESB WEQ-015

attributes.name: unit_cost_usd
attributes.description: Cost per megawatt-hour paid for this REC. Calculated as acquisition cost divided by quantity. Used for market pricing analysis and portfolio valuation.

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the renewable energy generation occurred that created this REC. Critical for RPS compliance eligibility and market valuation.

products.name: rec_transaction
products.description: REC transfer and retirement transaction record capturing the movement of RECs between registry accounts. Captures transaction type (purchase, sale, retirement, transfer), quantity (MWh), transaction price, counterparty, registry transaction ID, compliance program (RPS, voluntary), retirement reason, and transaction timestamp. Supports WREGIS/NEPOOL-GIS reporting and RPS compliance filings.
products.reference: REC Registry Transaction (WREGIS/NEPOOL-GIS)

attributes.name: rec_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the REC transaction record. Primary key for the rec_transaction product.
attributes.references: WREGIS Transaction Protocol, NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules

attributes.name: compliance_rec_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.rec_certificate. Business justification: REC transactions (purchases, sales, retirements) must reference specific compliance certificates being transferred. Essential audit trail from trading transaction to registry certificate retirement fo

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: REC transactions are allocated to cost centers for compliance cost tracking and RPS program accounting. Real business process: state RPS compliance reports require cost center-level REC transaction da

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.counterparty

attributes.name: der_interconnection_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.der_interconnection_point. Business justification: REC transactions must track generation source facility. DER interconnection points identify the physical generation asset, essential for REC registry compliance, renewable attribute verification, and

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: REC sale/purchase/retirement transactions require linking to originating DER facility for audit trail, eligibility verification, and compliance reporting. Enables tracking which interconnected systems

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: REC transactions must post to specific GL accounts for revenue recognition and inventory accounting. Real business process: monthly close requires REC sales/purchases to hit correct GL accounts for GA

attributes.name: primary_rec_counterparty_account_id
attributes.description: Registry account identifier for the counterparty organization. This is the account number in the REC registry system (WREGIS, NEPOOL-GIS, etc.) from which RECs are received or to which RECs are sent.
attributes.references: WREGIS Account Management Rules, NEPOOL-GIS Account Operating Procedures

attributes.name: rec_holding_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.rec_holding.rec_holding_id — REC transactions (purchase, sale, retirement) modify REC holdings. This FK is required for inventory reconciliation and RPS compliance tracking.

attributes.name: renewable_rec_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.renewable_rec_certificate. Business justification: Connects REC buy/sell transactions to underlying physical certificates for registry transfer validation, compliance tracking, and audit trails. Removes denormalized facility attributes now available t

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the broker or intermediary who facilitated the REC transaction, if applicable. Null for direct bilateral transactions or internal transfers.

attributes.name: compliance_program
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory compliance program or voluntary program for which these RECs are intended. Examples: California RPS, Oregon RPS, Washington RPS, voluntary green power program, corporate sustainability commitment. May be null for speculative trading positions.
attributes.references: State RPS Legislation, EPA Green Power Partnership, RE100 Corporate Renewable Energy Initiative

attributes.name: compliance_year
attributes.description: Calendar year for which these RECs will be applied toward compliance obligations or voluntary commitments. RECs are typically vintage-dated and must be used within specified timeframes per program rules.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules, WREGIS Vintage Requirements

attributes.name: contract_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the underlying contract or Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) associated with this REC transaction. Links the REC transaction to the commercial agreement. Null for spot market transactions.
attributes.references: FERC Market-Based Rate Tariff Requirements, NAESB WEQ Business Practice Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this REC transaction record was first created in the internal system. Audit trail field for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount. Typically USD for North American REC markets.

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the renewable energy and RECs were delivered. Bundled: RECs delivered with the physical electricity. Unbundled: RECs traded separately from electricity. Firmed and shaped: intermittent renewable energy firmed with conventional generation. Delivery method affects RPS compliance eligibility in many states.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules, WREGIS Delivery Method Classification

attributes.name: eligibility_flags
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of compliance program eligibility certifications for these RECs. Examples: CA_RPS_Tier1, OR_RPS_Bundled, WA_RPS_Eligible, Green-e_Certified. Programs have specific eligibility criteria based on fuel type, location, vintage, and delivery method.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules, Green-e Energy Certification Standards, WREGIS Eligibility Tracking

attributes.name: generation_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the generation period for the renewable energy represented by these RECs. Defines the vintage period along with generation_start_date.
attributes.references: WREGIS Certificate Issuance Rules, NEPOOL-GIS Generation Reporting

attributes.name: generation_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the generation period for the renewable energy represented by these RECs. RECs are typically issued for monthly or quarterly generation periods.
attributes.references: WREGIS Certificate Issuance Rules, NEPOOL-GIS Generation Reporting

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this REC transaction record was last modified in the internal system. Audit trail field for change tracking and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, FERC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the REC transaction. May include details about transaction purpose, special handling requirements, or reconciliation notes.

attributes.name: rec_quantity_mwh
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Quantity in Megawatt-Hours (MWh)
attributes.description: Quantity of RECs transferred in this transaction, measured in megawatt-hours (MWh). Each REC typically represents 1 MWh of renewable energy generation.
attributes.references: WREGIS Transaction Protocol, NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules, EPA Renewable Energy Tracking Systems

attributes.name: registry_transaction_code
attributes.description: External transaction identifier assigned by the REC registry system (WREGIS, NEPOOL-GIS, M-RETS, NAR, etc.). This is the authoritative reference number for the transaction in the external registry.
attributes.references: WREGIS Transaction Protocol, NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules, M-RETS Operating Procedures

attributes.name: retirement_beneficiary
attributes.description: Name of the organization or program on whose behalf the RECs are being retired. For compliance retirements, this is typically the utility itself. For voluntary programs, this may be a customer or corporate partner. Null for non-retirement transactions.
attributes.references: WREGIS Retirement Rules, NEPOOL-GIS Retirement Procedures, EPA Green Power Partnership

attributes.name: retirement_reason
attributes.description: Business reason for retiring the RECs, if transaction_type is retirement. Examples: RPS compliance obligation, voluntary green power program, corporate sustainability goal, customer green tariff fulfillment. Null for non-retirement transactions.
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules, EPA Green Power Partnership, WREGIS Retirement Rules

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the REC transaction was fully settled and ownership transfer was completed in the registry. May differ from transaction_timestamp for multi-day settlement cycles.
attributes.references: WREGIS Transaction Protocol, NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules

attributes.name: total_transaction_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the REC transaction, calculated as rec_quantity_mwh multiplied by transaction_price_per_rec. Denominated in USD. Zero for non-monetary transactions (transfers, retirements without purchase).
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Electric Plant Accounts, GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: trade_confirmation_number
attributes.description: Confirmation number from the Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) system (e.g., OpenLink Endur) that links this REC transaction to the trading deal. Used for reconciliation between registry transactions and trading positions.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ Business Practice Standards, OpenLink Endur Trade Capture

attributes.name: transaction_price_per_rec
attributes.business_glossary_term: Transaction Price Per Renewable Energy Certificate (REC)
attributes.description: Unit price paid or received per REC in this transaction, denominated in USD. For purchases this is the acquisition cost; for sales this is the revenue per REC. May be zero for internal transfers or retirements.
attributes.references: FERC Form 1 Electric Plant Accounts, GAAP Revenue Recognition ASC 606

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the REC transaction: pending (awaiting approval), approved (authorized but not yet settled), completed (fully executed and settled), rejected (denied by registry or counterparty), cancelled (withdrawn before completion), reversed (unwound after completion).
attributes.references: WREGIS Transaction Protocol, NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the REC transaction was executed or recorded in the registry system. This is the authoritative business event timestamp for the transaction.
attributes.references: WREGIS Transaction Protocol, NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of REC transaction: purchase (acquiring RECs from counterparty), sale (selling RECs to counterparty), transfer (internal account movement), retirement (permanent removal from circulation for compliance or voluntary use), import (receiving from another registry), export (sending to another registry).
attributes.references: WREGIS Transaction Protocol, NEPOOL-GIS Operating Rules

attributes.name: vintage_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the renewable energy was generated. RECs are vintage-dated and many compliance programs have vintage eligibility windows (e.g., current year plus 2 prior years).
attributes.references: State RPS Program Rules, WREGIS Vintage Requirements

products.name: ancillary_service_award
products.description: Ancillary service procurement record capturing the utility's acquisition of grid support services through ISO/RTO markets or bilateral contracts. Captures service type, resource ID, procured MW, procurement price ($/MW-hr), market interval, ISO award reference, and cost allocation to transmission or distribution tariff. Supports FERC ancillary service cost reporting.
products.reference: ISO Ancillary Service Procurement

attributes.name: ancillary_service_award_id
attributes.description: Primary key for ancillary_service_award

attributes.name: contract_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the bilateral contract or master agreement governing this ancillary service procurement. Null for ISO/RTO market procurements without underlying contracts.

attributes.name: counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the counterparty providing the ancillary service in bilateral contracts. Null for ISO/RTO market procurements or self-supply arrangements.

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the generation or demand response resource providing the ancillary service. May reference utility-owned assets or third-party resources registered with the ISO/RTO.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: Ancillary service procurement costs are reported in rate cases and cost recovery filings. Regulatory affairs justifies ancillary service costs in rate proceedings with specific procurement records, de

attributes.name: scheduling_coordinator_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the scheduling coordinator responsible for submitting bids and managing settlements for this ancillary service. Relevant in ISO/RTO markets with SC intermediaries.

attributes.name: settlement_statement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ISO/RTO settlement statement or invoice that includes this ancillary service charge. Used for financial reconciliation and dispute management.

attributes.name: actual_deployment_mw
attributes.description: Actual megawatts of ancillary service deployed or dispatched during the interval. May differ from procured capacity if the service was not called upon or only partially deployed.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Dispatch Instructions, NERC BAL Standards

attributes.name: award_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number assigned by the ISO/RTO or bilateral contract for this ancillary service award. Used for reconciliation with market settlement statements.

attributes.name: award_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the ancillary service award. Tracks progression from initial award through confirmation, settlement, and any dispute resolution.

attributes.name: cleared_price_per_mw
attributes.description: Market clearing price or contract price for the ancillary service, expressed in currency per megawatt per hour. Used to calculate total procurement cost.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Market Clearing Price Methodology, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: cost_allocation_category
attributes.description: Regulatory cost allocation category determining how the ancillary service cost is recovered through tariffs. Aligns with FERC and state PUC rate design principles.
attributes.references: FERC Order 888, State PUC Tariff Structures

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this ancillary service procurement record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Typically USD for North American utilities.

attributes.name: deployment_payment
attributes.description: Additional payment for actual deployment or dispatch of the ancillary service, separate from the capacity procurement cost. Applies when the ISO/RTO calls upon the resource to provide the service.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for booking the ancillary service cost. Typically accounts 447 (Sales for Resale) or 565 (Transmission of Electricity by Others).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: ferc_reporting_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERC (Federal Energy Regulatory Commission) Reporting Category
attributes.description: FERC reporting category for this ancillary service transaction as required by Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) filing. Classifies the transaction for regulatory transparency.
attributes.references: FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) Filing Requirements

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal operational notes, exceptions, or special circumstances related to this ancillary service procurement. Not shared externally.

attributes.name: iso_rto_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO/RTO (Independent System Operator/Regional Transmission Organization) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Independent System Operator or Regional Transmission Organization market where the ancillary service was procured. Null for bilateral contracts outside organized markets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|MISO|PJM|NYISO|ISO_NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this record was last updated. Tracks changes through the award lifecycle from initial award through settlement and any subsequent adjustments.

attributes.name: market_interval_end
attributes.description: End timestamp of the market interval or delivery period for which the ancillary service was procured. Defines the duration of service obligation.

attributes.name: market_interval_start
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the market interval or delivery period for which the ancillary service was procured. Typically aligned with ISO/RTO settlement intervals (5-minute, 15-minute, or hourly).

attributes.name: performance_obligation_met
attributes.description: Indicates whether the resource successfully met its performance obligation during the service interval. False may trigger penalties or non-performance charges.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Performance Incentive Mechanisms, NERC BAL Standards

attributes.name: pricing_node
attributes.description: Specific pricing node or location where the ancillary service was procured in nodal markets. Used for locational marginal pricing and congestion analysis.

attributes.name: procured_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Quantity of ancillary service capacity procured, measured in megawatts. Represents the resource capability committed to provide the service during the market interval.
attributes.references: NERC Glossary of Terms, ISO/RTO Tariff Definitions

attributes.name: procurement_method
attributes.description: Method by which the ancillary service was procured. Distinguishes between ISO/RTO market purchases, bilateral contracts with third parties, and self-supply from utility-owned resources.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ancillary service procurement must be included in regulatory reports to FERC, state PUCs, or other governing bodies. True for transactions meeting reporting thresholds.
attributes.references: FERC Electric Quarterly Report (EQR) Requirements, State PUC Reporting Rules

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of ancillary service procured to support grid reliability and stability. Includes regulation, reserves, and voltage support services as defined by NERC and ISO/RTO tariffs.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards BAL-001, FERC Order 888

attributes.name: total_procurement_cost
attributes.description: Total cost of the ancillary service procurement for the market interval, calculated as procured capacity multiplied by cleared price and interval duration. Expressed in the utility's reporting currency.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: transmission_zone
attributes.description: Transmission zone or load zone where the ancillary service was procured. Reflects geographic pricing and reliability requirements within the ISO/RTO footprint.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Zonal Market Design, NERC Regional Entities

products.name: book
products.description: Trading book master record defining the organizational unit within the ETRM system (OpenLink Endur) used to aggregate and manage related trades for P&L reporting, risk limits, and regulatory reporting. Captures book name, book type (physical, financial, hedging, proprietary), commodity, responsible trader/desk, risk limit (VaR), and FERC reporting category.
products.reference: OpenLink Endur Book

attributes.name: book_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the trading book within the Energy Trading and Risk Management (ETRM) system. Primary key.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the risk officer or executive who approved the establishment of this trading book and its risk limits.

attributes.name: book_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the trader or portfolio manager responsible for managing positions and P&L within this trading book.

attributes.name: book_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this trading book record. Supports audit trail and change management requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: Trading books are subject to SOX controls for valuation, position limits, and P&L reporting. SOX control testing validates trading book mark-to-market processes, segregation of duties, and limit monit

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Trading books are assigned to cost centers for overhead allocation and budget tracking. Real business process: annual budgeting allocates trading desk operating costs to responsible cost centers for c

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the legal entity under which trades in this book are executed. Critical for regulatory reporting, tax accounting, and counterparty credit agreements.

attributes.name: market_participant_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned by the ISO/RTO for this trading book's market participation. Used in day-ahead and real-time market bids, offers, and settlements.

attributes.name: trading_desk_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.trading_desk

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the risk committee or authorized governance body approved the creation and risk limits of this trading book.

attributes.name: book_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the trading book for operational reference and reporting. Used in trade capture, position reporting, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: book_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the trading book used for display and business communication. Examples: 'West Region Physical Power', 'Gas Hedging Portfolio', 'REC Trading Desk'.

attributes.name: book_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the trading book. Active books accept new trades; suspended books are temporarily inactive; closed books are archived; pending approval books await risk committee authorization.

attributes.name: book_type
attributes.description: Classification of the trading book by its primary business purpose. Physical books manage delivery obligations; financial books manage price risk; hedging books offset exposure; proprietary books capture speculative positions; structured books manage complex deals; ancillary services books manage grid support products.

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or division that owns this trading book. Used for segment reporting and management accounting.

attributes.name: collateral_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trading book requires active collateral management (margin calls, credit support annexes) for counterparty credit risk mitigation.

attributes.name: commodity
attributes.description: Primary commodity or product traded within this book. Determines applicable market rules, settlement conventions, and regulatory reporting requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: power|natural_gas|coal|renewable_energy_credits|emissions_allowances|capacity|ancillary_services|fuel_oil — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this trading book record was first created in the ETRM system. Used for audit trails and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate credit exposure allowed across all counterparties for trades booked to this trading book, expressed in USD. Used for pre-trade credit checks.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this trading book became active and eligible to accept trades. Used for historical analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: emissions_allowance_registry_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the emissions allowance registry account (e.g., EPA CATR, RGGI COATS) associated with this trading book. Required for books trading carbon or NOx allowances.
attributes.references: EPA Clean Air Markets Division Regulations

attributes.name: ferc_reporting_category
attributes.description: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission reporting category for this trading book. Determines which FERC forms and schedules apply (e.g., FERC Form 552 for wholesale power, FERC Form 2 for utilities).

attributes.name: hedge_accounting_designation
attributes.description: Accounting treatment designation under ASC 815 (Derivatives and Hedging). Determines whether mark-to-market gains/losses flow through earnings or other comprehensive income.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for internal operational notes, special instructions, or context about this trading book. Not visible to external parties or regulatory filings.

attributes.name: iso_rto_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) or Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Code
attributes.description: Primary ISO or RTO market in which this trading book operates. Determines market rules, settlement procedures, and scheduling protocols. Non-ISO indicates bilateral or over-the-counter trading. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|MISO|PJM|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP|non_iso — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this trading book record. Tracks changes to risk limits, status, or organizational assignments.

attributes.name: master_netting_agreement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether trades in this book are subject to master netting agreements (e.g., ISDA, EEI) that allow offsetting of exposures across multiple transactions with the same counterparty.
attributes.references: ISDA Master Agreement / EEI Master Power Purchase and Sale Agreement

attributes.name: position_limit_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum net position quantity (long or short) allowed in this book, expressed in the commodity's standard unit of measure (MWh for power, MMBtu for gas). Enforces concentration risk controls.

attributes.name: position_limit_uom
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the position limit quantity. Must align with the commodity type traded in this book.

attributes.name: rec_tracking_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Tracking System ID
attributes.description: Identifier for the REC tracking system registry account associated with this trading book (e.g., WREGIS, M-RETS, PJM-GATS). Required for books trading renewable energy certificates.

attributes.name: region_code
attributes.description: Code representing the primary geographic region or market area for this trading book (e.g., WEST, EAST, ERCOT, MISO). Used for regional P&L reporting and market analysis.

attributes.name: risk_limit_var
attributes.description: Maximum allowable Value at Risk for this trading book, expressed in USD. Represents the risk appetite approved by the risk committee. Breaches trigger escalation and position reduction requirements.

attributes.name: scheduling_coordinator_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this trading book acts as a Scheduling Coordinator (SC) responsible for submitting schedules and bids to the ISO/RTO on behalf of generation or load resources.

attributes.name: settlement_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial settlements of trades in this book. Typically USD for North American energy markets.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which this trading book was closed or deactivated. Null for active books. Used for historical reporting and compliance retention.

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used to value positions in this trading book for financial reporting. Mark-to-market uses observable market prices; mark-to-model uses pricing models for illiquid products; accrual recognizes value at settlement.

attributes.name: var_confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level used for VaR calculation, typically 95% or 99%. Defines the probability threshold for the risk limit.

attributes.name: var_time_horizon_days
attributes.description: Time horizon in days over which VaR is calculated, typically 1 day for daily risk monitoring or 10 days for regulatory capital calculations.

products.name: ferc_eqr_filing

Supports FERC Order 2001 compliance.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for the FERC EQR filing record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: counterparty_id

attributes.name: ferc_counterparty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the counterparty involved in the wholesale energy transactions reported in this EQR filing.

attributes.name: ferc_trade_id
attributes.description: FK to trading.trade.trade_id — FERC EQR filings report specific wholesale transactions. The filing must reference the underlying trades for audit trail and compliance verification.

attributes.name: gl_account_id

products.name: hedge_strategy
products.description: Hedge strategy master record defining the utility's board-approved hedging programs for managing commodity price risk, basis risk, volumetric risk, and credit risk in the wholesale energy portfolio. Captures strategy name, hedge type (fixed-price forward, basis swap, collar, option, heat rate, CRR/FTR), target commodity and delivery period, hedge ratio and target volume, hedge horizon, risk metric targets (VaR, CVaR, expected shortfall), authorized instruments, board approval date and reference, IRP alignment flag, and ASC 815 hedge designation (fair value, cash flow, net investment). Includes hedge effectiveness testing: prospective and retrospective test methods (dollar-offset, regression, critical terms match), effectiveness thresholds, test frequency, test results history, and de-designation triggers. Links to trading books that execute the strategy. Supports hedge accounting documentation, ASC 815/IFRS 9 compliance, effectiveness testing audit trail, and risk committee reporting.

products.name: hierarchy
products.description: Defines the parent-child structural hierarchy of utility assets, enabling roll-up from component level (e.g., circuit breaker trip coil) to equipment level (e.g., 132kV circuit breaker) to functional location (e.g., substation bay 3) to facility (e.g., Northside 132kV Substation) to network segment (e.g., Northern Transmission Zone). Each hierarchy record captures parent asset reference, child asset reference, hierarchy level, hierarchy type (functional location, linear asset, electrical connectivity), and effective date range. Supports CAPEX/OPEX cost roll-up, condition aggregation, RAB valuation at any hierarchy level, and regulatory reporting by network segment. Aligned with Ventyx Asset Suite functional location structure, SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance hierarchy, and IEC 61968 CIM asset model.
products.reference: Ventyx Asset Suite — Functional Location / SAP PM Functional Location

attributes.name: hierarchy_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent asset in the hierarchy structure. Links to the asset registry for the higher-level asset (e.g., substation, facility, network segment).

attributes.description: Percentage of OPEX and CAPEX costs allocated to this hierarchical relationship. Used when a child asset serves multiple parent facilities or network segments and costs must be apportioned. Value between 0.00 and 100.00. Supports regulatory cost allocation and rate case preparation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Cost Allocation Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage tracking, and regulatory compliance. Immutable after initial creation.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: criticality_inherited_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the child asset inherits the criticality classification from the parent asset in the hierarchy. True means child criticality is derived from parent (e.g., all equipment in a critical substation is critical). False means child has independent criticality assessment. Used for risk-based maintenance prioritization and outage impact analysis.
attributes.references: NERC Transmission Planning Standards; Asset Management Best Practices

attributes.name: depth
attributes.description: Total depth of the hierarchy tree from this relationship to the deepest leaf node. Used for hierarchy complexity analysis and query optimization. Updated when child relationships are added or removed.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchical relationship ended or was superseded. Null for currently active relationships. Supports historical hierarchy reconstruction for regulatory reporting, asset lifecycle analysis, and audit trails.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this hierarchical relationship became active. Supports temporal hierarchy tracking for asset relocations, network reconfigurations, and organizational restructuring. Used for point-in-time hierarchy queries and historical CAPEX/OPEX roll-up.

attributes.name: functional_location_code
attributes.description: Structured functional location identifier from the enterprise asset management system representing the hierarchical path (e.g., NORTH-SUB132-BAY03-CB01). Aligns with SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance functional location structure and Ventyx Asset Suite location hierarchy. Used for work order assignment, maintenance planning, and cost center allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance Functional Location; Ventyx Asset Suite Functional Location

attributes.name: geographic_zone_code
attributes.description: Geographic or service territory zone identifier for the hierarchical relationship. Used for regional reporting, storm response planning, mutual aid coordination, and geographic cost allocation. Aligns with GIS-based service territory boundaries.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; State PUC Service Territory Definitions

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the hierarchy tree structure where level 1 is the top-most parent (e.g., network segment, region) and higher numbers represent deeper nesting (e.g., level 5 might be a component within equipment within a bay within a substation within a zone). Supports depth-based queries and roll-up aggregations.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Functional Location Structure

attributes.name: hierarchy_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hierarchical relationship type. Functional location represents organizational structure (e.g., substation > bay > equipment). Electrical connectivity represents electrical network topology. Linear asset represents sequential physical assets (e.g., transmission line spans). Spatial containment represents physical location nesting. Logical grouping represents business-defined asset groups. System subsystem represents system decomposition.
attributes.references: IEC 61968 CIM Asset Model; Ventyx Asset Suite Functional Location Structure

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this hierarchy relationship record was last modified. Updated whenever any attribute changes. Used for audit trail, change detection, and incremental data processing.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: maintenance_responsibility_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the organizational unit or crew responsible for maintenance of assets in this hierarchical relationship. Used for work order routing, preventive maintenance scheduling, and O&M cost tracking. May differ from parent asset responsibility for shared or outsourced maintenance scenarios.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance

attributes.name: network_segment_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the top-level network segment or zone in the hierarchy (e.g., Northern Transmission Zone, Metro Distribution Area). Used for regulatory reporting by network segment, RAB valuation aggregation, and CAPEX/OPEX planning at the network level.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: outage_impact_propagation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage of the parent asset automatically impacts the child asset in this hierarchical relationship. attributes.description: Indicates whether this maintenance plan is legally or regulatorily mandated (True) or discretionary for asset optimization (False). Mandatory plans cannot be deferred without regulatory approval.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards, State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: condition_trigger_parameter
attributes.description: For condition-based maintenance plans, the specific asset health parameter or SCADA measurement that triggers maintenance (e.g., oil_dielectric_strength, vibration_amplitude, temperature_differential, partial_discharge_level). Empty for time-based plans.

attributes.name: condition_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value for the condition trigger parameter. When the monitored parameter exceeds (or falls below) this threshold, maintenance is triggered. Empty for time-based plans.

attributes.name: condition_trigger_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the condition trigger threshold (e.g., kV, ppm, mm/s, degrees_celsius, percent). Empty for time-based plans.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this maintenance plan record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: cycle_interval_unit
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the maintenance interval: calendar units (days, weeks, months, years), operational hours, operational cycles, or energy production (MWh for generation assets). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: days|weeks|months|years|hours|cycles|mwh — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: cycle_interval_value
attributes.description: Numeric value representing the maintenance interval (e.g., 12 for annual, 5 for five-year). Used in conjunction with cycle_interval_unit to calculate next due date.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: cycle_type
attributes.description: Frequency or trigger pattern for maintenance execution. Time-based cycles are calendar-driven; on-condition cycles are triggered by asset health thresholds; on-demand cycles are manually initiated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: daily|weekly|monthly|quarterly|semi_annual|annual|biennial|five_year|ten_year|on_condition|on_demand — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this maintenance plan is scheduled to expire or be retired. Nullable for ongoing plans. Used for asset decommissioning or maintenance strategy transitions.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this maintenance plan becomes active and begins generating work orders. Used for phased rollout of new maintenance strategies or asset commissioning.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: estimated_contractor_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated cost of external contractor services required for maintenance execution, expressed in US dollars. Used for OPEX budgeting and procurement planning.

attributes.name: estimated_labor_hours
attributes.description: Estimated total labor hours required to complete all tasks defined in the maintenance plan. Used for crew scheduling, OPEX forecasting, and resource capacity planning.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: estimated_material_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated total cost of spare parts, consumables, and materials required for maintenance execution, expressed in US dollars. Used for OPEX budgeting and inventory planning.

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: Hierarchical location identifier in the asset management system representing the physical or logical location of the asset (e.g., substation, plant, transmission line section). Used for geographic and organizational reporting.

attributes.name: last_execution_date
attributes.description: Date when maintenance activities under this plan were last completed. Used to calculate the next due date for time-based and usage-based maintenance cycles.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Work Order Completion

attributes.name: last_execution_work_order_number
attributes.description: Work order number of the most recent maintenance execution under this plan. Provides traceability to historical maintenance records and completion documentation.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Work Order Object

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this maintenance plan record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: lead_time_days
attributes.description: Number of days before the scheduled due date that the work order should be generated, allowing time for planning, material procurement, crew scheduling, and outage coordination.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: maintenance_strategy
attributes.description: High-level maintenance philosophy applied to the asset: preventive (scheduled), predictive (condition monitoring), reliability-centered (RCM analysis-driven), risk-based (prioritized by failure impact), or run-to-failure (no proactive maintenance).

attributes.name: next_due_date
attributes.description: Calculated date when the next maintenance execution is scheduled or required. System-calculated based on last execution date, cycle interval, and usage/condition triggers.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: next_scheduled_work_order_number
attributes.description: Work order number of the upcoming maintenance execution that has been generated but not yet completed. Empty if no future work order has been created.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Work Order Object

attributes.name: outage_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether execution of this maintenance plan requires taking the asset out of service (True) or can be performed while the asset is energized or in standby (False). Critical for outage coordination and reliability planning.

attributes.name: plan_asset_class
attributes.description: FK to asset.asset_class.asset_class_id — Maintenance plans are typically defined at the asset class level (all 132kV transformers get the same PM plan). This FK enables plan-to-class association.

attributes.name: plan_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the maintenance plan objectives, scope, and special instructions. Provides context for planners and technicians executing the work.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: plan_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the maintenance plan for human identification and reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: plan_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the maintenance plan, externally visible and used in work order generation and asset management reporting.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: plan_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the maintenance plan. Active plans generate work orders automatically; suspended plans are temporarily paused; inactive plans are disabled but retained for historical reference; retired plans are archived.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: plan_type
attributes.description: Classification of the maintenance strategy: time-based (calendar-driven), condition-based (triggered by asset condition thresholds), usage-based (driven by operational hours or cycles), predictive (AI/ML-driven forecasting), regulatory (compliance-mandated), or corrective (reactive repair).

attributes.name: planning_plant_code
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for maintenance planning and execution. Aligns with SAP PM planning plant structure for multi-site utility operations.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level for maintenance execution. Critical plans address safety or regulatory compliance; high priority plans prevent major outages; medium and low priority plans optimize asset performance and lifecycle cost.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: regulatory_driver
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard, code, or compliance requirement that mandates this maintenance plan (e.g., NERC FAC-003 Transmission Vegetation Management, NERC PRC-005 Protection System Maintenance, OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation). Empty if not compliance-driven.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards, OSHA Regulations, FERC Orders

attributes.name: safety_requirements
attributes.description: Specific safety protocols, personal protective equipment (PPE), lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, or clearance requirements mandated for maintenance execution under this plan. Ensures OSHA 1910.269 compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution

attributes.name: scheduling_window_days
attributes.description: Allowable time window (in days) after the due date within which maintenance can be performed without being considered overdue. Provides scheduling flexibility for resource optimization and outage coordination.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Maintenance Plan Object

attributes.name: task_list_reference
attributes.description: Reference code to the detailed task list or work instruction document that defines the specific maintenance activities, inspection points, and procedures to be executed under this plan.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Task List Object

attributes.name: to_asset
attributes.description: FK to asset.asset_registry.asset_registry_id — Maintenance plans are assigned to specific assets or asset classes. The FK to asset_registry enables plan-to-asset resolution for work order generation.

attributes.name: usage_trigger_parameter
attributes.description: For usage-based maintenance plans, the operational metric that triggers maintenance (e.g., operating hours for turbines, breaker operations for circuit breakers, MWh generated for generators). Empty for time-based and condition-based plans.

attributes.name: usage_trigger_threshold
attributes.description: Numeric threshold value for the usage trigger parameter. When cumulative usage since last maintenance reaches this threshold, maintenance is triggered. Empty for time-based and condition-based plans.

attributes.name: work_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of work orders automatically generated by this maintenance plan. Determines work order routing, approval workflows, and cost accounting treatment in Ventyx Asset Suite and SAP PM. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: preventive_maintenance|predictive_maintenance|inspection|calibration|testing|overhaul|refurbishment — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite - Work Order Object
