attributes.description: Summary of findings from the post-event review, including lessons learned and recommended process improvements.

attributes.name: rps_compliance_impact_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) Compliance Impact Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this curtailment event affects the utility's renewable portfolio standard compliance calculations or reporting obligations.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Description of the weather conditions at the time of curtailment (e.g., high wind, peak solar irradiance, low hydro flow) that influenced available capacity.

products.name: nem_account
products.description: Net Energy Metering (NEM) account master record and full credit transaction ledger for customers with Behind-the-Meter (BTM) generation. Captures customer account reference, interconnection application number, BTM system type (solar PV, battery+solar, wind), installed capacity (kW), NEM program type (NEM 1.0, NEM 2.0, NEM 3.0/NEM-A), enrollment date, export rate ($/kWh), annual true-up date, and program status. Includes all billing-period credit transactions: gross consumption/generation (kWh), net import/export (kWh), export credit value ($), cumulative credit balance ($), true-up adjustments, and credit expiry dates. SSOT for NEM program enrollment, credit ledger, and annual true-up processing — no separate credit transaction product exists. Credit summaries feed into the billing domain for invoice generation.
products.reference: State PUC NEM Tariff / CPUC NEM Program

attributes.name: nem_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NEM account record. Primary key for the NEM account entity.

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account enrolled in the NEM program. Links to the billing customer account master.

attributes.name: interconnection_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: NEM accounts reference utility-owned interconnection equipment (service transformers, meter sockets, service panel upgrades) capitalized by the utility. Links NEM program costs to rate base assets for

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) meter measuring bidirectional energy flow for the NEM account. Links to the meter registry for interval data and device metadata.

attributes.name: nem_der_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.der_registry. Business justification: Net Energy Metering (NEM) accounts are for behind-the-meter (BTM) DERs that must be registered in the DER registry. This FK links the NEM billing/credit account to the registered DER asset. Cardinalit

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical service location where the BTM generation system is installed. Links to the premise master for geographic and service point data.

attributes.name: primary_der_registry_id
attributes.description: FK to renewable.der_registry.der_registry_id — NEM accounts are tied to specific BTM DER installations. The NEM account must reference the DER registry entry for the BTM system generating the credits.

attributes.name: annual_true_up_date
attributes.description: Anniversary date when cumulative NEM credits are reconciled. Any remaining credit balance may be paid out, rolled over, or forfeited based on program rules.

attributes.name: battery_storage_capacity_kwh
attributes.description: Total energy storage capacity of paired battery system in kilowatt-hours. Null if no battery is installed. Used for SGIP (Self-Generation Incentive Program) eligibility and VPP dispatch.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the current NEM billing period. Marks the cutoff for credit calculation and ledger posting.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the current NEM billing period for which credit transactions are recorded. Aligns with the customer billing cycle.

attributes.name: btm_system_type
attributes.description: Type of distributed energy resource installed behind the customer meter. Identifies the generation technology for capacity planning and forecasting.
attributes.references: DERMS (Distributed Energy Resource Management System) Standard

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the NEM account record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: credit_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which unused NEM credits expire if not applied or paid out. Typically aligns with the annual true-up date for programs with credit expiration policies.

attributes.name: cumulative_credit_balance
attributes.description: Running total of NEM credits available to offset future charges. Accumulates across billing periods until the annual true-up date.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date the customer was officially enrolled in the NEM program and began receiving export credits. Marks the start of the NEM billing cycle.

attributes.name: export_credit_value
attributes.description: Dollar value of NEM credits earned during the billing period, calculated as net_export_kwh multiplied by export_rate_per_kwh. Posted to the cumulative credit balance.

attributes.name: export_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum instantaneous power export allowed to the grid in kilowatts. May be lower than installed capacity due to interconnection constraints or grid hosting capacity limits.

attributes.name: export_rate_per_kwh
attributes.description: Compensation rate in dollars per kWh for energy exported to the grid. Rate varies by NEM program type and may differ from retail rate. Used to calculate export credit value.

attributes.name: gross_consumption_kwh
attributes.description: Total energy consumed by the customer from the grid during the billing period, measured in kilowatt-hours. Does not net out BTM generation.

attributes.name: gross_generation_kwh
attributes.description: Total energy generated by the BTM system during the billing period, measured in kilowatt-hours. Includes both self-consumed and exported energy.

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the BTM generation system was physically installed and commissioned. Used for warranty tracking and depreciation calculations.

attributes.name: installed_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate capacity of the BTM generation system in kilowatts. Used for interconnection limits, export calculations, and grid impact analysis.
attributes.references: NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) Standard

attributes.name: installer_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the contractor or company that installed the BTM generation system. Used for quality assurance and warranty claims.

attributes.name: installer_license_number
attributes.description: State-issued contractor license number for the installer. Verifies that installation was performed by a certified professional.

attributes.name: interconnection_application_number
attributes.description: Unique application number assigned during the DER interconnection approval process. Tracks the regulatory approval for BTM generation interconnection to the utility grid.

attributes.name: inverter_manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the company that manufactured the inverter. Used for equipment certification verification and technical support.

attributes.name: inverter_model
attributes.description: Model number of the inverter installed. Used to verify compliance with interconnection standards and grid support functions.

attributes.name: inverter_serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number of the primary inverter converting DC generation to AC for grid export. Used for equipment tracking, warranty claims, and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: last_inspection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent utility or third-party inspection of the BTM system. Used to verify ongoing compliance with safety and interconnection standards.
attributes.references: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) Standard

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the NEM account record. Used for change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified the record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: nem_program_type
attributes.description: Specific NEM tariff program under which the customer is enrolled. Determines export credit rates, true-up rules, and credit expiration policies. NEM 1.0 offers full retail rate credits; NEM 2.0 includes non-bypassable charges; NEM 3.0/NEM-A uses export compensation rates below retail.

attributes.name: net_export_kwh
attributes.description: Net energy exported to the grid during the billing period after self-consumption. Positive value indicates surplus generation sent to the grid. Basis for export credit calculation.

attributes.name: net_import_kwh
attributes.description: Net energy imported from the grid during the billing period after accounting for BTM generation. Positive value indicates net consumption from the grid.

attributes.name: next_inspection_due_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next required inspection of the BTM system. Used for compliance tracking and maintenance planning.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special conditions, or exceptions related to the NEM account. Used by customer service and billing operations.

attributes.name: permission_to_operate_date
attributes.description: Date the utility granted permission for the BTM system to operate and export to the grid. Marks the official start of interconnection and may differ from enrollment date.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NEM account. Active accounts receive export credits; suspended accounts are temporarily paused; terminated accounts are closed.

attributes.name: rec_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generation from this NEM account is eligible for REC issuance. True if the system meets RPS (Renewable Portfolio Standard) eligibility criteria.

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the NEM account was closed or terminated. Null for active accounts. Marks the end of credit accrual and triggers final true-up processing.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for NEM account termination. Used for program analytics and customer retention analysis.

attributes.name: true_up_adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of credit adjustment applied during the annual true-up reconciliation. May represent payout, rollover, or forfeiture of remaining credits based on program rules.

attributes.name: vpp_participation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NEM account is enrolled in a VPP aggregation program for demand response or grid services. True if the customer has opted into VPP dispatch.
attributes.references: DERMS (Distributed Energy Resource Management System) Standard

products.name: interconnection_queue
products.description: Queue management record for utility-scale and large renewable generation/storage interconnection requests submitted to the utility or ISO/RTO under FERC OATT. Captures queue position, applicant, project type (solar, wind, storage, hybrid), requested capacity (MW), proposed POI substation, study phase (feasibility, system impact, facilities), study fees, milestone dates, cluster study group, FERC OATT compliance status, and queue withdrawal/approval status. SSOT boundary: scoped ONLY to bulk/wholesale renewable generation interconnection queue entries managed as part of the renewable procurement pipeline. Customer-level BTM interconnection applications (residential solar, EV chargers, small DER) are managed in the interconnection domain. Cross-domain SSOT adjudication pending with global architect.
products.reference: FERC Order 2023 / NERC FAC-002 / ISO/RTO Generator Interconnection Procedures

attributes.name: interconnection_queue_id
attributes.description: Primary key for interconnection_queue

attributes.name: applicant_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: Interconnection queue applications track applicant customer account for study deposits, cost allocation, communications, and eventual service agreement creation upon project completion. Essential for

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.capex_project. Business justification: Queue projects that proceed to construction become capex projects; link tracks progression from interconnection application to capital investment for IRP alignment, budget forecasting, and CPCN regula

attributes.name: cpcn_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.cpcn_application. Business justification: Large generation projects in interconnection queue typically require Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity. Links project development pipeline to regulatory approval process. Standard workfl

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to distribution.distribution_substation. Business justification: Interconnection queue entries specify point-of-interconnection substation for system impact studies, hosting capacity analysis, and queue management. Critical for FERC/state interconnection process co

attributes.name: irp_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.irp_scenario. Business justification: IRP scenarios model future capacity additions from the interconnection queue to assess resource adequacy, planning reserve margins, and renewable penetration pathways. Core IRP modeling input.

attributes.name: network_upgrade_asset_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Network Upgrade Asset Registry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Interconnection queue entries link to utility network upgrade assets (substation expansions, line upgrades, protection equipment) funded by generators for cost reconciliation and rate base inclusion.

attributes.name: network_upgrade_material_master_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Network Upgrade Material Master Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Interconnection projects require network upgrade materials (transformers, switchgear, cables, protection equipment) for cost estimation and procurement planning. Real business process: capital project

attributes.name: reviewing_engineer_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Interconnection applications require utility engineers to conduct feasibility studies, system impact studies, and facilities studies per FERC Order 2023. Tracks assigned engineer for workload manageme

attributes.name: transmission_service_request_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to transmission.transmission_service_request. Business justification: Large renewable projects requiring network upgrades or long-haul delivery often file transmission service requests under FERC OATT alongside interconnection applications. ISO/RTO interconnection proce

attributes.name: affected_systems_coordination_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interconnection requires coordination with adjacent transmission systems or neighboring utilities due to potential impacts on their facilities.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the applicant or project developer for interconnection study communications and milestone notifications.

attributes.name: applicant_contact_phone
attributes.description: Primary phone number for the applicant or project developer for interconnection coordination and study discussions.

attributes.name: applicant_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the entity or developer submitting the interconnection request for the renewable generation or storage project.

attributes.name: application_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the interconnection request assigned by the utility or ISO/RTO. Used in regulatory filings and customer communications.
attributes.references: FERC OATT - Open Access Transmission Tariff

attributes.name: application_received_date
attributes.description: Date the interconnection application was received and accepted by the utility or ISO/RTO, establishing the queue position and study timeline.

attributes.name: cluster_study_group
attributes.description: Identifier for the cluster study group if this application is being studied as part of a batch of interconnection requests in the same geographic area or queue window.

attributes.name: commercial_readiness_deposit_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has posted the commercial readiness deposit or financial security required under FERC Order 2023 to demonstrate project viability and reduce speculative queue entries.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code for the country where the proposed facility will be located. Primarily USA, CAN (Canada), or MEX (Mexico) for North American interconnection queues.

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County where the proposed renewable generation or storage facility will be located.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interconnection queue record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: environmental_permit_status
attributes.description: Status of environmental permitting for the renewable project, including federal and state environmental reviews, endangered species assessments, and wetlands permits.
attributes.references: NEPA - National Environmental Policy Act, EPA Regulations

attributes.name: expected_commercial_operation_date
attributes.description: Target date for the renewable facility to achieve commercial operation and begin energy delivery, as declared by the applicant.

attributes.name: facilities_study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the facilities study was completed and results delivered to the applicant. Null if study is in progress or not started.

attributes.name: facilities_study_start_date
attributes.description: Date the facilities study phase commenced. Null if study has not yet started.

attributes.name: feasibility_study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the feasibility study was completed and results delivered to the applicant. Null if study is in progress or not started.

attributes.name: feasibility_study_start_date
attributes.description: Date the feasibility study phase commenced. Null if study has not yet started.

attributes.name: ferc_oatt_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: FERC OATT (Open Access Transmission Tariff) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the interconnection request is being processed under FERC OATT pro forma procedures for wholesale generation interconnection. True for bulk/wholesale projects; False for retail/distribution interconnections.

attributes.name: generation_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Requested nameplate generation capacity of the renewable facility in megawatts. For hybrid projects, represents the generation component only.

attributes.name: interconnection_agreement_executed_date
attributes.description: Date the final interconnection agreement was executed between the applicant and the utility or ISO/RTO. Null if agreement not yet signed.

attributes.name: interconnection_facilities_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost in dollars for direct interconnection facilities such as gen-tie lines, transformers, and switchgear required to connect the facility to the POI.

attributes.name: interconnection_service_type
attributes.description: Type of interconnection service requested under FERC OATT. Energy Resource allows injection but no delivery guarantee; Network Resource includes firm transmission rights.

attributes.name: iso_rto_jurisdiction
attributes.business_glossary_term: ISO/RTO (Independent System Operator / Regional Transmission Organization) Jurisdiction
attributes.description: Name of the ISO or RTO managing the interconnection queue if the project is in an organized wholesale market region (e.g., CAISO, PJM, MISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP). Null for non-ISO utility territories.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this interconnection queue record was last updated, reflecting changes to study phase, status, or milestone dates.

attributes.name: network_upgrade_cost_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated cost in dollars for required transmission network upgrades to accommodate the interconnection, as determined by system impact and facilities studies.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, or coordination notes related to the interconnection request and study process.

attributes.name: poi_voltage_kv
attributes.description: Transmission or distribution voltage level in kilovolts at the proposed point of interconnection. Determines study complexity and upgrade requirements.

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation of the proposed renewable generation or storage facility as provided by the applicant.

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the renewable generation or storage technology proposed for interconnection. Hybrid projects combine generation and storage at the same POI. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: solar|wind|battery_storage|hybrid_solar_storage|hybrid_wind_storage|hydroelectric|other_renewable — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: queue_position
attributes.description: Sequential position in the interconnection queue determining study priority and processing order. Lower numbers indicate earlier queue entry and higher priority.

attributes.name: queue_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the interconnection queue entry. Active indicates ongoing study; Withdrawn indicates applicant termination; Approved indicates studies complete and agreement executed; In Service indicates facility is operational.

attributes.name: site_control_documentation_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has provided evidence of site control (land lease, purchase option, or ownership) as required for interconnection study progression under FERC Order 2023 reforms.

attributes.name: state
attributes.description: State or province where the proposed renewable generation or storage facility will be located.

attributes.name: storage_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Requested nameplate storage discharge capacity in megawatts for battery storage or hybrid projects. Null for generation-only projects.

attributes.name: storage_duration_hours
attributes.description: Energy storage duration in hours at rated discharge capacity. Represents the time the battery can discharge at full power. Null for generation-only projects.

attributes.name: study_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Total deposit amount paid by the applicant to fund interconnection studies. Typically covers feasibility, system impact, and facilities study costs.

attributes.name: study_phase
attributes.description: Current phase of the interconnection study process. Feasibility assesses viability, System Impact evaluates grid impacts, Facilities designs required upgrades.

attributes.name: system_impact_study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date the system impact study was completed and results delivered to the applicant. Null if study is in progress or not started.

attributes.name: system_impact_study_start_date
attributes.description: Date the system impact study phase commenced. Null if study has not yet started.

attributes.name: withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date the applicant withdrew the interconnection request from the queue. Null if application remains active or was approved.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Business reason provided by the applicant for withdrawing the interconnection request, such as project economics, permitting issues, or site constraints.

products.name: vpp_configuration
products.description: Virtual Power Plant (VPP) master record defining DER aggregation into a dispatchable virtual fleet, including complete dispatch event history. Captures VPP name, aggregation type (demand response, storage dispatch, solar curtailment), total aggregated capacity (MW), participating DER count, ISO/RTO registration status, DERMS program reference, dispatch protocol (automated/manual), communication latency requirements, and activation eligibility windows. Includes all dispatch event records: timestamp, dispatch trigger (ISO/RTO signal, operator command, automated rule), requested MW, actual MW response, response time, participating DER count, dispatch success rate, settlement-eligible energy (MWh), and performance score. SSOT for VPP portfolio management AND dispatch performance — no separate dispatch event product exists. Supports FERC Order 2222 market participation and settlement.
products.reference: FERC Order 2222 / DERMS VPP Aggregation

attributes.name: vpp_configuration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the Virtual Power Plant configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: aggregator_id
attributes.description: FK to demand.aggregator

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: VPPs participate in control area AGC, regulation reserves, and ancillary services markets. Control area operators dispatch VPPs for frequency regulation and must track aggregated capacity for reserve

attributes.name: der_registry_id
attributes.description: FK to renewable.der_registry.der_registry_id — VPP configurations aggregate multiple DERs. The VPP must reference participating DERs from the registry. This is a many-to-many relationship critical for VPP dispatch and settlement.

attributes.name: derms_program_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS) Program ID
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this VPP configuration to the controlling DERMS program or platform that orchestrates dispatch commands and monitors DER performance.

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary distribution substation or point of interconnection (POI) serving the majority of DERs in this VPP aggregation.

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary distribution feeder circuit serving the majority of DERs in this VPP aggregation. Used for distribution-level constraint management.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: VPP programs must comply with ISO/RTO market rules, FERC Orders 841/2222, state DER regulations. Tracks which compliance obligation governs each VPP configuration. Essential for market participation a

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: VPP programs operate as distinct business units with revenue (capacity payments, energy sales) and costs (incentives, operations); link enables P&L reporting by program for regulatory filings and mana

attributes.name: program_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Virtual power plant programs require designated program managers for aggregator coordination, ISO/RTO market registration, performance monitoring, and settlement reconciliation. Essential for operatio

attributes.name: settlement_meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the revenue-quality meter or virtual meter used for settlement and billing of VPP dispatch performance in ISO/RTO markets.

attributes.name: supporting_outage_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.outage_event. Business justification: VPPs are dispatched during outages for grid support (black start, islanding, load restoration). Outage management coordinates with DERMS to activate VPP resources during major events. Required for mut

attributes.name: activation_window_end_time
attributes.description: Daily time-of-day (HH:MM format) when the VPP is no longer eligible for dispatch. Supports time-of-use constraints and operational availability windows.

attributes.name: activation_window_start_time
attributes.description: Daily time-of-day (HH:MM format) when the VPP becomes eligible for dispatch. Supports time-of-use constraints and operational availability windows.

attributes.name: aggregation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the VPP aggregation strategy: demand response (load reduction), storage dispatch (battery discharge/charge), solar curtailment (PV output reduction), wind curtailment, load shifting, or mixed DER (combination of multiple resource types).

attributes.name: average_performance_score
attributes.description: Rolling average performance score (0-100 scale) across all dispatch events, calculated as the ratio of actual delivered capacity to requested capacity. Used for aggregator performance evaluation.

attributes.name: baseline_calculation_method
attributes.description: Methodology used to establish the counterfactual baseline for measuring VPP dispatch performance: customer baseline load (CBL), day-ahead forecast, historical average, or control group comparison.

attributes.name: capacity_payment_rate_per_mw_month
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capacity Payment Rate per Megawatt (MW) per Month
attributes.description: Monthly capacity payment rate in dollars per MW for maintaining the VPP in a dispatchable state, independent of actual dispatch events.

attributes.name: communication_latency_ms
attributes.description: Maximum acceptable communication latency in milliseconds between the DERMS platform and participating DER assets for dispatch signal transmission and acknowledgment. Critical for fast-response ancillary services.

attributes.name: compliance_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the VPP configuration received compliance certification from the applicable ISO/RTO or Public Utility Commission (PUC) for market participation.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Expiration or termination date of the VPP aggregation contract or program enrollment period. Null for open-ended contracts.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date of the VPP aggregation contract or program enrollment period.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VPP configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dispatch_protocol
attributes.description: Method by which dispatch commands are issued to the VPP: automated (DERMS-driven without human intervention), manual (operator-initiated), semi-automated (operator approval required), or api_driven (external system integration).

attributes.name: geographic_zone
attributes.description: ISO/RTO pricing zone, load zone, or distribution service territory in which the VPP operates. Used for locational marginal pricing (LMP) and congestion management.

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_mwh
attributes.description: Financial incentive rate in dollars per MWh paid to the VPP for successful dispatch performance and energy delivery.

attributes.name: iso_rto_market_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Market ID
attributes.description: Unique market participant identifier assigned by the ISO/RTO for this VPP in wholesale energy, capacity, or ancillary services markets.

attributes.name: iso_rto_registration_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Registration Status
attributes.description: Registration status of the VPP with the applicable ISO or RTO for wholesale market participation: registered (approved and active), pending (application submitted), not registered (no application), expired (registration lapsed), or rejected (application denied).

attributes.name: last_dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent dispatch event issued to this VPP. Used for operational monitoring and performance tracking.

attributes.name: maximum_dispatch_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Maximum duration in minutes that a single dispatch event can be sustained before requiring a rest period or recharge cycle (relevant for battery storage VPPs).

attributes.name: minimum_dispatch_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Minimum duration in minutes that a dispatch event must be sustained once activated. Ensures operational stability and prevents rapid cycling of DER assets.

attributes.name: minimum_performance_threshold_percent
attributes.description: Minimum percentage of requested dispatch capacity that must be delivered for the event to qualify for settlement payment. Typical values range from 70% to 90%.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this VPP configuration record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or configuration comments related to this VPP aggregation.

attributes.name: participating_der_count
attributes.description: Number of individual DER assets (solar arrays, battery storage units, demand response participants, etc.) currently enrolled and participating in this VPP aggregation.

attributes.name: penalty_rate_per_mwh
attributes.description: Financial penalty rate in dollars per MWh applied when the VPP fails to meet minimum performance thresholds during a dispatch event.

attributes.name: performance_measurement_interval_minutes
attributes.description: Time interval in minutes over which VPP dispatch performance is measured and aggregated for settlement purposes (e.g., 5-minute, 15-minute, or hourly intervals).

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_minute
attributes.description: Rate at which the VPP can increase or decrease its aggregated output in megawatts per minute. Critical for frequency regulation and ramping services.

attributes.name: regulatory_program_name
attributes.description: Name of the state or federal regulatory program under which the VPP operates (e.g., California DRAM, NYISO DER Participation Model, PJM DER Aggregation).

attributes.name: telemetry_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which telemetry data is transmitted from participating DERs to the DERMS platform during active dispatch events.

attributes.name: telemetry_reporting_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time telemetry data (voltage, frequency, power output) from participating DERs is transmitted to the ISO/RTO or utility control center during dispatch events.

attributes.name: total_aggregated_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total nameplate capacity in megawatts (MW) of all Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) aggregated within this VPP portfolio. Represents the maximum dispatchable capacity under ideal conditions.

attributes.name: total_dispatch_events_count
attributes.description: Cumulative count of all dispatch events issued to this VPP since configuration inception. Used for performance analytics and settlement auditing.

attributes.name: voltage_class_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage class in kilovolts (kV) of the distribution system at which the VPP DERs are interconnected (e.g., 12.47 kV, 34.5 kV).

attributes.name: vpp_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or registration code for the VPP used in ISO/RTO market systems and DERMS platforms.

attributes.name: vpp_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation of the Virtual Power Plant aggregation portfolio.

attributes.name: vpp_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the VPP configuration: active (operational and dispatchable), inactive (configured but not operational), suspended (temporarily disabled), pending approval (awaiting ISO/RTO or regulatory approval), decommissioned (retired), or testing (pilot phase).

products.name: battery_storage_asset
products.description: Master record for utility-scale and grid-connected battery energy storage systems (BESS), including day-ahead and real-time dispatch schedules. Captures storage technology type (lithium-ion, flow battery, compressed air), rated power (MW), rated energy capacity (MWh), SoC range limits, round-trip efficiency, cycle count, degradation rate, charge/discharge ramp rates, interconnection voltage level, co-location flag, and ISO/RTO storage registration status. Includes dispatch schedules: interval timestamps, scheduled charge/discharge MW, target SoC, market participation mode (energy arbitrage, frequency regulation, spinning reserve, capacity), ISO/RTO schedule submission reference, and revision history. SSOT for battery storage asset master data AND dispatch scheduling — no separate dispatch schedule product exists. Excludes generation-domain thermal storage or pumped hydro assets.
products.reference: IEC 62933 / FERC Order 841 Storage Registration

attributes.name: derms_integration_flag

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: max_soc_percent

attributes.name: min_soc_percent

attributes.name: operational_status

attributes.name: ownership_type

attributes.name: poi_substation_name

attributes.name: primary_use_case

attributes.name: rated_energy_capacity_mwh

attributes.name: rated_power_mw
attributes.description: Maximum continuous power output or input capacity of the battery storage system measured in megawatts (MW). Represents the instantaneous charge or discharge rate.

attributes.name: round_trip_efficiency_percent
attributes.description: Round-trip energy efficiency of the battery storage system expressed as a percentage. Represents the ratio of energy discharged to energy charged, accounting for conversion and storage losses.

attributes.name: scada_integration_flag

attributes.name: site_address

attributes.name: site_city

attributes.name: site_postal_code

attributes.name: site_state

attributes.name: storage_technology_type

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date

products.name: generation_meter_read
products.description: Interval meter read records specific to renewable generation facilities and BTM generation assets within the renewable domain. Captures meter serial number, facility or DER reference, read timestamp, interval duration (15-min, hourly), gross generation (kWh), net generation after auxiliary load (kWh), reactive power (kVAR), power factor, meter read source (AMI, SCADA, manual), VEE status, and data quality flag. SSOT boundary: scoped ONLY to generation-side reads used for REC issuance calculations, PPA settlement verification, and NEM credit determination. Customer consumption meter reads, AMI infrastructure, and meter asset management are managed in the metering domain. Cross-domain SSOT adjudication pending with global architect.

attributes.name: ambient_temperature_c
attributes.description: Ambient temperature at the generation site during the interval. Used for performance analysis and generation forecasting model validation.

attributes.name: availability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the generation asset was available for operation during the interval. False during planned or forced outages.

attributes.name: capacity_factor_percent
attributes.description: Ratio of actual generation to maximum possible generation during the interval, expressed as percentage. Key performance indicator for renewable assets.

attributes.name: capacity_mw
attributes.description: Nameplate capacity of the generation facility or DER asset in megawatts. Used for capacity factor and performance ratio calculations.

attributes.name: charge_discharge_mode
attributes.description: Operating mode of battery storage system during the interval. Applicable to battery storage assets for dispatch verification.

attributes.name: curtailed_energy_kwh
attributes.description: Amount of potential generation curtailed during the interval in kilowatt-hours. Used for curtailment compensation calculations and renewable integration analysis.

attributes.name: curtailment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether generation was curtailed during this interval due to grid constraints, negative pricing, or dispatch instructions from ISO/RTO.

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Overall data quality indicator for the meter read. Used to filter reads for financial settlement and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: data_source_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the read was captured by the source system (AMI, SCADA, MDM). May differ from read_timestamp due to communication latency.

attributes.name: daylight_saving_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the read timestamp falls within daylight saving time. Used for interval alignment during DST transitions.

attributes.name: frequency_hz
attributes.description: Average grid frequency during the interval in hertz. Must remain within NERC reliability standards (59.95-60.05 Hz for North America).

attributes.name: gross_generation_kwh
attributes.description: Total energy generated during the interval in kilowatt-hours before auxiliary load deduction. Used for REC issuance calculations and renewable portfolio standard compliance reporting.

attributes.name: interconnection_queue_number
attributes.description: ISO/RTO or utility interconnection queue identifier for the generation facility. Links meter reads to interconnection agreements.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the meter read interval in minutes. Typically 15 or 60 minutes for generation metering per FERC Order 2222 and state RPS requirements.

attributes.name: irradiance_w_per_m2
attributes.description: Solar irradiance measured at the site in watts per square meter. Applicable to solar generation facilities for performance ratio calculations.

attributes.name: lmp_energy_price
attributes.description: Energy component of the locational marginal price at the settlement point during the interval in dollars per MWh. Used for revenue calculation.

attributes.name: market_settlement_point
attributes.description: ISO/RTO pricing node or settlement point identifier where generation is financially settled. Used for locational marginal price (LMP) matching.

attributes.name: meter_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to raw meter register values to calculate actual generation. Accounts for current transformer and potential transformer ratios.

attributes.name: meter_read_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the meter read record indicating whether it is preliminary, final, or has been revised. Critical for settlement finalization.

attributes.name: nem_credit_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this BTM generation read qualifies for NEM bill credit under state net metering programs. Applicable only to DER assets.

attributes.name: net_generation_kwh
attributes.description: Net energy delivered to the grid after deducting auxiliary load and station service consumption. Used for PPA settlement verification and NEM credit determination.

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Type of outage or unavailability during the interval if availability_flag is false. Used for reliability reporting and PPA force majeure claims.

attributes.name: power_factor
attributes.description: Ratio of real power to apparent power during the interval. Must meet interconnection agreement requirements typically between 0.95 leading and 0.95 lagging.

attributes.name: ppa_settlement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this read is included in PPA settlement calculations. False for reads with poor data quality or outside contract delivery periods.

attributes.name: reactive_power_kvar
attributes.description: Reactive power measured during the interval in kilovolt-amperes reactive. Required for power factor compliance and grid stability analysis.

attributes.name: read_method
attributes.description: Method by which the meter read was obtained. Distinguishes between automated AMI reads, manual field reads, and estimated values.

attributes.name: read_source
attributes.description: Source system that captured or provided the meter read data. Indicates data provenance for audit and quality validation.

attributes.name: read_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the meter read interval was captured. Represents the end of the interval period. Critical for REC issuance and PPA settlement calculations.

attributes.name: rec_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this generation interval qualifies for REC issuance based on facility certification, data quality, and state RPS program rules.

attributes.name: rec_serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number of the REC certificate issued for this generation interval. Assigned by REC tracking system (e.g., WREGIS, M-RETS, PJM-GATS).

attributes.name: rec_vintage_year
attributes.description: Calendar year assigned to RECs issued from this generation interval. Determines eligibility for state RPS compliance periods.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this meter read record was first inserted into the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trails.

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: ISO/RTO settlement period identifier (e.g., YYYYMM or trading day) to which this read is assigned for financial settlement.

attributes.name: state_of_charge_percent
attributes.description: Battery energy storage system state of charge at interval end as percentage of total capacity. Applicable to battery storage assets.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: Time zone of the meter read timestamp. Critical for accurate interval alignment across facilities in different time zones.

attributes.name: validation_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the VEE validation process was completed for this read. Used for data quality audit trails.

attributes.name: vee_status
attributes.description: Data quality status from the VEE process indicating whether the read is actual, estimated, or edited. Critical for REC issuance eligibility and settlement accuracy.

attributes.name: voltage_kv
attributes.description: Average voltage at the point of interconnection during the interval in kilovolts. Used for power quality monitoring and interconnection compliance.

attributes.name: wind_speed_mps
attributes.description: Average wind speed at hub height during the interval. Applicable to wind generation facilities for capacity factor analysis.

products.name: der_enrollment
products.description: Enrollment record linking a specific DER to a utility program, VPP, demand response event, or DERMS-managed portfolio. Captures enrollment date, DER reference, program type (NEM, VPP, DR, RPS, storage incentive), program term, enrolled capacity (kW), communication protocol (IEEE 2030.5, OpenADR, DNP3), telemetry endpoint, enrollment status, and opt-out history. SSOT for DER program participation lifecycle within the renewable domain. Manages the many-to-many relationship between DERs and utility programs.
products.reference: DERMS Program Enrollment / IEEE 2030.5 / OpenADR 2.0

attributes.description: Primary key for der_enrollment

attributes.name: dr_program_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility program, VPP, demand response initiative, or DERMS portfolio that the DER is enrolled in. Links to program master data containing terms, incentives, and operational parameters.

attributes.name: incentive_program_id
attributes.description: FK to renewable.incentive_program.incentive_program_id — DER enrollments in incentive programs need to reference the specific incentive_program. Supports tracking which DERs are enrolled in which incentive programs.

attributes.name: meter_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to metering.meter_point. Business justification: DER program enrollments are tied to specific service points for VPP dispatch and settlement. VPP dispatch requires enrollment linked to service point for location-based control, feeder-level aggregati

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: DER program enrollments must comply with tariff requirements, interconnection standards, ISO/RTO market rules. Links enrollment to governing compliance obligation. Essential for program eligibility ve

attributes.name: primary_der_registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific DER asset being enrolled. Links to the DER registry containing technical specifications, interconnection details, and asset metadata.

attributes.name: settlement_meter_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the revenue-grade meter used for program settlement calculations, incentive payments, and NEM credit determination. Links to MDM system for interval data retrieval.
attributes.references: ANSI C12.1, State Net Metering Rules

attributes.name: vpp_configuration_id
attributes.description: FK to renewable.vpp_configuration.vpp_configuration_id — DER enrollments into VPP programs must reference the specific VPP configuration. Critical for dispatch eligibility and aggregation.

attributes.name: auto_renew_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the enrollment automatically renews at the end of the term. True for evergreen enrollments, false for fixed-term enrollments requiring explicit renewal.

attributes.name: baseline_methodology
attributes.description: Method used to calculate the customer baseline load (CBL) for demand response performance measurement. Customer baseline load uses historical consumption patterns, meter-before-meter-after compares pre/post installation, control group uses similar non-participating customers, day-matching uses same-day-type averages, regression uses statistical modeling.

attributes.name: communication_protocol
attributes.description: Communication protocol used for telemetry, dispatch commands, and control signals between the DER and DERMS or VPP platform. IEEE 2030.5 (Smart Energy Profile 2.0) for residential, OpenADR 2.0b for commercial DR, DNP3 for utility-scale SCADA integration.

attributes.name: control_endpoint_url
attributes.description: Network endpoint URL for sending dispatch commands, curtailment signals, and control instructions to the DER. Separate from telemetry for security and operational isolation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this enrollment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for dispatch order within the VPP or DERMS portfolio. Lower numbers indicate higher priority. Used for economic dispatch optimization and curtailment sequencing.

attributes.name: enrolled_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Nameplate capacity in kilowatts (kW) enrolled in the program. May be less than the DER's total capacity if partial enrollment is allowed. Used for dispatch calculations, incentive payments, and portfolio aggregation.

attributes.name: enrolled_energy_capacity_kwh
attributes.description: Energy storage capacity in kilowatt-hours (kWh) enrolled for battery storage systems. Represents the usable energy that can be dispatched or charged under program control. Null for non-storage DERs.

attributes.name: enrollment_application_date
attributes.description: Date when the customer submitted the enrollment application. Used for tracking application processing time and program participation trends.

attributes.name: enrollment_approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the utility approved the enrollment application and authorized program participation. Used for compliance reporting and customer communications.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: Date when the DER was officially enrolled in the program and participation became effective. Used for program term calculations, incentive eligibility, and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: enrollment_effective_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when enrollment became active and the DER began participating in program dispatch, telemetry, or credit calculations. Critical for real-time market operations and settlement.

attributes.name: enrollment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional enrollment details, special conditions, customer preferences, or operational notes not covered by structured fields.

attributes.name: enrollment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the enrollment record. Human-readable unique number used in customer communications, program reporting, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: enrollment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the enrollment. Pending indicates application submitted but not yet approved, active indicates full participation, suspended indicates temporary hold, terminated indicates program exit, opted_out indicates customer-initiated withdrawal, expired indicates term completion.

attributes.name: enrollment_term_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the contractual enrollment term. Null for open-ended enrollments. Used to trigger renewal processes and calculate program participation duration.

attributes.name: enrollment_term_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the contractual enrollment term. May differ from enrollment_date if there is a delay between enrollment and term commencement.

attributes.name: export_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power in kilowatts (kW) that the DER is permitted to export to the grid under the interconnection agreement. Used to enforce dispatch constraints and prevent grid violations.

attributes.name: import_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum power in kilowatts (kW) that the DER is permitted to import from the grid for charging (applicable to battery storage systems). Null for generation-only DERs.

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_kw
attributes.description: Capacity incentive payment rate in dollars per kilowatt of enrolled capacity. Used for calculating monthly or annual capacity payments to program participants.
attributes.references: Program Tariff, State PUC Approved Rates

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_kwh
attributes.description: Energy incentive payment rate in dollars per kilowatt-hour of dispatched or curtailed energy. Used for calculating performance-based incentive payments.
attributes.references: Program Tariff, State PUC Approved Rates

attributes.name: interconnection_agreement_number
attributes.description: Reference to the interconnection agreement governing the DER's connection to the distribution grid. Links enrollment to technical interconnection requirements and export limits.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547, FERC SGIP, State Interconnection Standards

attributes.name: last_dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent dispatch event or control signal sent to this enrolled DER. Used for monitoring program activity and asset utilization.

attributes.name: last_opt_out_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent opt-out event. Used for tracking opt-out patterns and customer engagement analysis.

attributes.name: opt_out_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is permitted to opt out of individual dispatch events or curtailment requests. True for voluntary DR programs, false for firm capacity commitments.
attributes.references: Program Terms and Conditions, FERC Order 2222

attributes.name: opt_out_count
attributes.description: Number of times the customer has opted out of dispatch events during the current enrollment term. Used to enforce opt-out limits and assess program reliability.

attributes.name: opt_out_limit
attributes.description: Maximum number of opt-outs allowed per enrollment term. Null if unlimited opt-outs are permitted. Exceeding this limit may result in enrollment suspension or termination.

attributes.name: program_type
attributes.description: Classification of the program type. Net Energy Metering (NEM) for BTM generation credits, Virtual Power Plant (VPP) for aggregated dispatch, Demand Response (DR) for load curtailment, Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) for compliance tracking, storage incentive for battery programs, or feed-in tariff for fixed-rate purchase agreements.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222, State RPS Statutes, PURPA

attributes.name: rec_issuance_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Renewable Energy Certificate (REC) Issuance Eligible Flag

products.name: der_program_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment contract between a distributed energy resource and a demand response program. It captures the business relationship where a single DER asset participates in multiple DR programs simultaneously (e.g., ISO capacity market, utility peak-time rebate, emergency DR, VPP aggregation), each with distinct contract terms, capacity commitments, settlement rules, and performance history. Each record links one DER to one DR program with enrollment-specific attributes including dates, capacity commitments, participation rates, incentive payments, and opt-out history that exist only in the context of this specific enrollment relationship.. Existence Justification: In energy utilities operations, a single DER asset (e.g., solar+storage system) routinely enrolls in multiple demand response programs simultaneously to optimize revenue and meet grid service obligations. For example, a battery storage system may be enrolled in an ISO capacity market program, a utility peak-time rebate program, an emergency DR program, and a VPP aggregation program at the same time. Each enrollment is a distinct business contract with its own capacity commitment, settlement rules, term dates, performance tracking, and incentive payments. The business actively manages this portfolio of enrollments per asset, tracking enrollment status, participation rates, opt-out history, and cumulative payments for each DER-program combination.

products.name: battery_vendor_service_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the service contract relationship between battery storage assets and their vendors. Each battery storage system requires multiple vendors for different service types (battery OEM, inverter supplier, BMS provider, O&M contractor), and each vendor provides services to multiple battery assets. Each record captures vendor-specific contract terms, warranty coverage, and SLA commitments that exist only in the context of this specific asset-vendor relationship.. Existence Justification: In energy utilities operations, battery storage assets require multiple specialized vendors simultaneously: the battery cell OEM provides capacity warranty, the inverter supplier maintains power conversion equipment, the BMS provider supports control systems, and O&M contractors handle daily operations. Each vendor relationship has distinct contract terms, SLA commitments, warranty coverage types, and performance metrics. This is an operational M:N relationship that asset managers actively maintain, not an analytical correlation.

products.name: der_service_assignment
products.description: This association product represents the service assignment relationship between distributed energy resources and field crews. It captures the operational assignment of crews to DER sites for maintenance, inspection, emergency repair, and storm restoration activities. Each record links one DER installation to one crew service event with attributes that track service history, crew specialization matching, and maintenance schedule optimization. SSOT for DER field service history and crew utilization tracking.. Existence Justification: In utility DER operations, field crews are assigned to service portfolios of distributed generation sites on rotating schedules driven by maintenance type, technology specialization, and geographic proximity. A single DER installation receives service from multiple crews over its lifecycle (preventive maintenance crews, emergency repair crews, storm restoration crews, commissioning support crews). Each crew services many DER sites across their service territory. The business actively manages these service assignments with work orders, tracks service history per DER asset for compliance, and optimizes crew-to-DER matching based on technology specialization (solar vs storage vs wind).

products.name: ppa_vendor_participation
products.description: This association product represents the contractual participation of vendors in renewable energy Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) contracts. Each record links one PPA contract to one vendor with a specific role (counterparty/IPP, scheduling coordinator, transmission provider, REC administrator, credit support provider). Captures vendor-specific contract terms including payment terms, settlement frequency, credit support obligations, and performance guarantees that vary by vendor role within the same PPA. Supports multi-party PPA administration, vendor role management, and contract-specific commercial terms tracking.. Existence Justification: In renewable energy PPA operations, a single PPA contract involves multiple vendors in distinct roles: the counterparty/IPP who generates the energy, scheduling coordinators who manage ISO/RTO schedules, transmission providers who deliver the power, REC administrators who track renewable attributes, and credit support providers. Conversely, a single vendor (especially large IPPs or specialized service providers) participates in multiple PPA contracts across different projects. The utility actively manages these multi-party relationships with contract-role-specific terms, payment schedules, and performance obligations.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: notification_preference

attributes.name: opt_out_count

attributes.name: participation_rate_percent

attributes.name: puc_reporting_flag

attributes.name: telemetry_enabled_flag

attributes.name: termination_date

attributes.name: vpp_enrollment_flag

Core operational record for DR event lifecycle management and OMS/ADMS integration.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special circumstances, or additional context about the DR event execution and outcomes.

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when participants were notified of the upcoming DR event, used to calculate notification lead time compliance.

attributes.name: opted_out_count

attributes.name: participant_count
attributes.description: The total number of customers or premises that participated in this DR event, used for program performance reporting.

attributes.name: performance_ratio
attributes.description: The ratio of actual curtailment to target curtailment expressed as a percentage (0-100), used to measure event effectiveness and participant compliance.

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time when load curtailment is scheduled to end for this DR event.

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time when load curtailment is scheduled to begin for this DR event.

attributes.name: settlement_price
attributes.description: The final price in dollars per MWh used for customer incentive payment settlement for this DR event, may differ from LMP based on program rules.

attributes.name: target_curtailment_mw
attributes.description: The target load reduction in megawatts (MW) requested for this DR event across all participating customers and assets.

attributes.name: temperature_fahrenheit

attributes.name: total_incentive_payment
attributes.description: The total incentive payment amount in dollars paid to all participants for this DR event, calculated based on actual curtailment and settlement price.

attributes.name: triggering_entity

attributes.name: vpp_dispatch_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether this DR event was dispatched as part of a virtual power plant (VPP) aggregation strategy.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Description of the prevailing weather conditions during the DR event (e.g., extreme heat, cold snap, normal), used for baseline adjustment and event analysis.

products.name: dr_event_participant
products.description: Transactional record linking an enrolled customer, aggregated resource, or DLC device to a specific DR event, serving as the single authoritative response record across ALL DR program types. For direct load control: captures device commands (shed/restore/cycle with target setpoints), acknowledgment status, actual device response, load shed achieved, dispatch duration, and failure reasons. For behavioral DR: captures notification delivery confirmation, peer comparison data, engagement scoring, pre-event baseline consumption, actual consumption during event window, calculated reduction, and response classification. For interruptible tariff, VPP, and wholesale market dispatch: captures committed curtailment (kW), actual measured curtailment (kW), performance ratio, incentive payment eligibility, non-performance penalty flag, and M&V method applied. SSOT for per-resource event performance tracking across all DR program types including DLC device-level response and behavioral DR customer engagement.

attributes.name: notification_delivery_status

SSOT for M&V baseline data required by ISO/RTO settlement and PUC program reporting.

attributes.name: load_baseline_id

attributes.name: dr_program_id

attributes.name: profile_id

attributes.name: superseded_by_baseline_load_baseline_id
attributes.description: Reference to the baseline record that supersedes this one. Null if this is the current active baseline. Used to maintain baseline version history.

attributes.name: adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative adjustment factor applied to the baseline to account for day-of conditions (e.g., weather, operational changes). Typically ranges from 0.8 to 1.2. A value of 1.0 indicates no adjustment.

attributes.name: adjustment_method
attributes.description: The method used to adjust the baseline for day-of conditions. Options include none (no adjustment), additive (add/subtract a fixed amount), multiplicative (apply a scaling factor), weather-normalized (adjust based on weather data), or pre-event-hours (adjust based on load in hours immediately before the event).

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline was approved for use. Required for regulatory audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the person who approved this baseline for use in M&V calculations. Required for regulatory audit trail.

attributes.name: baseline_calculation_date

attributes.name: baseline_effective_date

attributes.name: baseline_expiration_date

attributes.name: baseline_methodology
attributes.description: The methodology used to calculate the customer baseline load. Common methods include 10-of-10 (average of 10 most recent similar days), high-10-of-10 (highest 10 days), mid-8-of-10 (middle 8 of 10), regression-based, weather-adjusted, or customer-specific algorithms approved by the ISO/RTO or PUC.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-012 Demand Response Baseline Standards

attributes.name: baseline_source_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) used as source data for calculating this baseline. Provides traceability to the historical load data used in the calculation.

attributes.name: baseline_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the baseline record. Indicates whether the baseline is in draft, pending approval, approved for use, actively in use, superseded by a newer version, or rejected.

attributes.name: baseline_to_enrollment
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_enrollment.dr_enrollment_id — Baselines are calculated per enrolled resource. Required for M&V — you cannot measure curtailment without linking baseline to the enrolled customer/resource.

attributes.name: baseline_version

attributes.name: calculation_engine

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: data_quality_score

attributes.name: estimation_method

attributes.name: event_window_end_timestamp

attributes.name: event_window_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The start timestamp of the DR event window for which this baseline applies. Defines the beginning of the curtailment measurement period.

attributes.name: exclusion_days
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of dates (YYYY-MM-DD) that were excluded from the baseline calculation due to holidays, prior DR events, or anomalous load conditions.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes

attributes.name: iso_rto_submission_timestamp

attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline was submitted to the ISO/RTO for settlement. Null if not yet submitted.

attributes.name: iso_rto_submitted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Submitted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this baseline has been submitted to the ISO/RTO for settlement purposes. True if submitted, False otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that last modified this baseline record. Required for audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this baseline record was last modified. Updated whenever any field in the record changes.

attributes.name: missing_interval_count
attributes.description: Number of intervals with missing or invalid meter data that were estimated or excluded from the baseline calculation. Used to assess baseline reliability.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting special circumstances, manual adjustments, or exceptions applied during baseline calculation. Used for audit trail and operational transparency.

attributes.name: peak_baseline_demand_kw
attributes.description: The maximum demand (kW) observed in the baseline load profile during the event window. Used for capacity-based DR program settlement.

attributes.name: puc_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this baseline is included in PUC program performance reporting. True if included, False otherwise.

attributes.name: temperature_sensitivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer's load is temperature-sensitive and requires weather-adjusted baseline methodology. True if temperature-sensitive, False otherwise.

attributes.name: to_dr_enrollment
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_enrollment.dr_enrollment_id — Baselines are calculated per enrolled resource. Without this FK, you cannot match baselines to the correct customer enrollment for M&V calculations.

attributes.name: total_baseline_energy_kwh
attributes.description: The sum of all interval baseline load values across the entire event window, expressed in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Used for aggregate curtailment measurement.

attributes.name: weather_station_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the weather station used for weather-adjusted baseline calculations. Links to external weather data sources (e.g., NOAA, local meteorological services).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user or system process that created this baseline record. Required for audit trail.

products.name: curtailment_measurement
products.description: Post-event measurement record capturing actual load curtailment achieved by an enrolled resource during a DR event interval. Stores interval-level metered load (kWh/kW), baseline load, calculated curtailment (kW), data source (AMI, SCADA, estimated), validation status, VEE flags, and M&V method applied. Feeds DR settlement, incentive payment calculation, and ISO/RTO performance reporting.
products.reference: Oracle MDM Interval Data; FERC Order 745 Measurement and Verification

attributes.name: curtailment_measurement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the curtailment measurement record. Primary key for post-event measurement records capturing actual load reduction achieved during a Demand Response (DR) event interval.

attributes.name: audit_id

attributes.name: curtailment_dr_event_participant_id
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_event_participant.dr_event_participant_id — Curtailment measurements are interval-level detail records for a participant's event performance. Required for M&V settlement calculations.

attributes.name: curtailment_load_baseline_id
attributes.description: FK to demand.load_baseline.load_baseline_id — Each curtailment measurement references the baseline used for comparison. Required for auditable M&V calculations.

attributes.name: demand_dr_enrollment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the enrolled DR resource (customer premise, aggregated load zone, or DER asset) that participated in the curtailment event.
