attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the meter or metering point from which interval data was sourced for this measurement. May be an AMI meter, SCADA point, or aggregated virtual meter.

attributes.name: to_dr_event_participant_id
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_event_participant.dr_event_participant_id — Curtailment measurements are taken per participant per event. This FK links measured load reduction to the specific participant response record.

attributes.name: to_load_baseline_id
attributes.description: FK to demand.load_baseline.load_baseline_id — Each curtailment measurement references the baseline used to calculate the reduction. Required for M&V audit trail.

attributes.name: baseline_adjustment_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative adjustment factor applied to the baseline to account for day-of conditions (weather, operational changes). Typically ranges from 0.8 to 1.2. A value of 1.0 indicates no adjustment.

attributes.name: baseline_demand_kw
attributes.description: Calculated baseline power demand in kilowatts (kW) representing what the resource would have demanded absent the DR event. Used as the reference for curtailment calculation.

attributes.name: baseline_load_kwh
attributes.description: Calculated baseline energy consumption in kilowatt-hours (kWh) representing what the resource would have consumed absent the DR event. Calculated using the baseline methodology specified in the DR program rules.

attributes.name: baseline_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the baseline calculation methodology applied for this measurement. Common methods include High X of Y (e.g., average of highest 3 of last 10 similar days), Mid X of Y, regression-based, control group, meter-before, or customer-provided baseline.

attributes.name: bid_quantity_kw
attributes.description: The bid quantity in kilowatts (kW) submitted by the resource or aggregator for this DR event interval. May differ from enrolled_capacity_kw if the resource bid a different amount for this specific event.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this curtailment measurement record was first created in the system. Represents the initial calculation or data ingestion time.

attributes.name: curtailment_kw
attributes.description: Calculated load curtailment achieved during the interval in kilowatts (kW). Computed as baseline_demand_kw minus metered_demand_kw. Positive values indicate successful load reduction; negative values indicate load increase.

attributes.name: curtailment_kwh
attributes.description: Calculated energy curtailment achieved during the interval in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Computed as baseline_load_kwh minus metered_load_kwh. Used for settlement and incentive payment calculation.

attributes.name: data_quality_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the quality status of the metered data. ACTUAL indicates raw meter data; ESTIMATED indicates VEE-filled gaps; VALIDATED indicates passed quality checks; SUSPECT indicates potential data issues; MISSING indicates no data received; REJECTED indicates failed validation.

attributes.name: data_source_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source of the metered load data. Values include AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure), SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition), MANUAL (manual meter read), ESTIMATED (VEE-estimated), AGGREGATED (sum of multiple meters), or TELEMETRY (real-time sensor data).

attributes.name: enrolled_capacity_kw
attributes.description: The enrolled or nominated load reduction capacity in kilowatts (kW) for this resource during the DR event. Represents the committed curtailment target used for performance evaluation and settlement.

attributes.name: incentive_amount
attributes.description: Calculated incentive payment amount in currency for this measurement interval. Computed as settlement_quantity_kw multiplied by incentive_rate_per_kwh and interval duration. Subject to program caps and adjustments.

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_kwh
attributes.description: The incentive payment rate in currency per kilowatt-hour ($/kWh) applicable to this measurement interval. Rate may vary by time-of-use period, event type, or performance tier.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the measurement interval in minutes. Common values are 5, 15, or 60 minutes depending on ISO/RTO market settlement rules and meter data granularity.

attributes.name: interval_end_timestamp
attributes.description: End timestamp of the measurement interval during the DR event. Defines the boundary of the measurement period for load curtailment calculation.

attributes.name: interval_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Start timestamp of the measurement interval during the DR event. Typically aligned to 5-minute, 15-minute, or hourly intervals per ISO/RTO settlement rules.

attributes.name: iso_rto_market_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Market Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ISO/RTO wholesale market to which this curtailment measurement is reported for settlement. Values include CAISO, ERCOT, ISONE, MISO, NYISO, PJM, SPP, or NONE for retail-only programs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|ISONE|MISO|NYISO|PJM|SPP|NONE — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lmp_price_per_mwh
attributes.description: The Locational Marginal Price in currency per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) at the resource location during this interval. Used to value the curtailment for wholesale market settlement or avoided cost calculation.

attributes.name: measurement_status_code
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the curtailment measurement record. PRELIMINARY indicates initial calculation; VALIDATED indicates passed M&V review; SETTLED indicates used for payment calculation; DISPUTED indicates under review; ADJUSTED indicates corrected after dispute; FINAL indicates locked for regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: metered_demand_kw
attributes.description: Actual power demand measured during the interval in kilowatts (kW). Represents the average or peak demand during the measurement period depending on metering configuration.

attributes.name: metered_load_kwh
attributes.description: Actual energy consumption measured during the interval in kilowatt-hours (kWh). Sourced from AMI meter data, SCADA telemetry, or estimated via Validation Estimation and Editing (VEE) process.

attributes.name: mv_method_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Measurement and Verification (M&V) protocol applied to validate the curtailment calculation. Common protocols include IPMVP Options A-D (International Performance Measurement and Verification Protocol) or utility-specific custom methods.

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: Penalty amount in currency assessed for under-performance or non-compliance during this interval. Applied when actual curtailment falls below minimum performance thresholds defined in the DR program agreement.

attributes.name: performance_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of actual curtailment achieved to the enrolled capacity or bid quantity for this resource during the interval. Calculated as curtailment_kw divided by enrolled_capacity_kw. Values above 1.0 indicate over-performance; below 1.0 indicate under-performance.

attributes.name: reported_to_iso_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement has been reported to the ISO/RTO for wholesale market settlement. True indicates the record was included in the ISO/RTO performance report; False indicates retail-only or not yet reported.

attributes.name: reported_to_iso_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement was submitted to the ISO/RTO for wholesale market settlement. Used for tracking reporting deadlines and settlement cycles.

attributes.name: reported_to_puc_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reported to Public Utility Commission (PUC) Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this measurement has been included in regulatory reporting to the state Public Utility Commission (PUC). True indicates the record was included in DR program performance reports; False indicates not yet reported.

attributes.name: settlement_quantity_kw
attributes.description: The final settled curtailment quantity in kilowatts (kW) used for incentive payment calculation. May differ from curtailment_kw after applying performance thresholds, caps, or adjustments per program rules.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this curtailment measurement record was last modified. Tracks revisions due to data corrections, dispute resolution, or re-calculation with updated baseline methods.

attributes.name: validated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this measurement record was validated and approved for settlement. Marks the transition from preliminary to validated status in the measurement lifecycle.

attributes.name: validation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting validation findings, data quality issues, adjustments applied, or dispute resolution details for this measurement record. Used for audit trail and M&V documentation.

attributes.name: vee_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the metered data was processed through Validation Estimation and Editing (VEE) logic. True indicates VEE was applied to fill gaps or correct suspect data; False indicates raw meter data was used.

attributes.name: vee_method_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Validation Estimation and Editing (VEE) Method Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the VEE estimation method applied when metered data was missing or suspect. Common methods include linear interpolation, historical average, similar day substitution, regression-based estimation, or NONE if no VEE was applied.

attributes.name: weather_humidity_percent
attributes.description: Relative humidity percentage at the resource location during the measurement interval. Used for baseline adjustment in weather-sensitive load profiles.

attributes.name: weather_temperature_f
attributes.description: Ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit at the resource location during the measurement interval. Used for baseline adjustment and performance analysis. May be sourced from weather station data or utility weather service.

products.name: dr_incentive_payment
products.description: Transactional record of all DR financial settlements and incentive payments, serving as the single authoritative financial record for the demand domain. Covers wholesale market settlement (ISO/RTO capacity and energy payments, LMP-based calculations, performance adjustments, settlement statement references, settlement period reconciliation) and retail-level incentive disbursements (capacity payments, energy payments, performance bonuses, penalty deductions). Captures settlement period, calculation basis, enrolled capacity, measured curtailment, gross and net amounts, aggregator share, utility net cost, payment approval status, disbursement reference, reconciliation status, and ISO/RTO settlement statement cross-reference. SSOT for ALL DR financial obligations — wholesale settlement, retail incentives, aggregator payments, customer disbursements, and settlement reconciliation with wholesale markets.

attributes.name: actual_load_kw
attributes.description: The measured actual load in kilowatts during the demand response event. Used to calculate curtailment performance.

attributes.name: aggregator_share_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the payment allocated to the aggregator based on the aggregator share percentage.

attributes.name: aggregator_share_percentage

attributes.name: approval_timestamp

attributes.description: The calculated baseline load in kilowatts representing the customers expected consumption without demand response curtailment. Used for measurement and verification (M&V) calculations.

attributes.name: capacity_payment_amount

attributes.name: currency_code

attributes.name: curtailment_duration_minutes

attributes.name: customer_net_payment_amount

attributes.name: disbursement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the incentive payment was disbursed to the customer or aggregator.

attributes.name: disbursement_reference
attributes.description: Reference number for the payment disbursement transaction (e.g., check number, wire confirmation, EFT trace number) for reconciliation with financial systems.

attributes.name: energy_payment_amount

attributes.name: gross_payment_amount

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_method

attributes.name: payment_reference_number

attributes.name: vpp_configuration_id
attributes.description: Reference to the aggregated portfolio of Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) that received this dispatch instruction.

attributes.name: vpp_dr_event_id
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_event.dr_event_id — VPP dispatches occur in the context of DR events or market signals. Required to correlate VPP actions with overall DR event management.

attributes.name: acknowledgement_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the aggregator or DERMS platform acknowledged receipt of the VPP dispatch instruction. Used to track communication latency and dispatch readiness.

attributes.name: actual_mw
attributes.description: Actual measured power response in megawatts (MW) delivered by the VPP portfolio during the dispatch period. Used for measurement and verification (M&V) and settlement calculations.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-032 - Data for Power System Modeling

attributes.name: baseline_mw
attributes.description: Calculated baseline power level in megawatts (MW) representing what the VPP portfolio would have consumed or generated without the dispatch instruction. Used for measurement and verification (M&V) to calculate actual response.
attributes.references: NAESB REQ-021 - Demand Response Measurement and Verification

attributes.name: bidirectional_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VPP dispatch instruction utilized bidirectional DER capabilities (both charging and discharging). True for dispatches involving energy storage or vehicle-to-grid (V2G) resources; false for unidirectional load curtailment.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the VPP dispatch instruction was cancelled. Examples include grid condition change, market price change, or operational constraint. Null if the dispatch was not cancelled.

attributes.name: cancellation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction was cancelled before completion. Null if the dispatch was not cancelled.

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction was completed and DER resources returned to normal operation. Marks the end of the dispatch lifecycle.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the VPP dispatch met the minimum performance requirements for the contracted service type. True if performance ratio exceeded the compliance threshold; false otherwise. Used for capacity accreditation and penalty assessment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this VPP dispatch record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: der_count
attributes.description: Number of individual DER assets (batteries, electric vehicles, smart inverters, controllable loads) that participated in this VPP dispatch instruction.

attributes.name: der_response_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of DER assets in the VPP portfolio that successfully responded to the dispatch instruction, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.92 for 92% response rate). Used to assess portfolio reliability.

attributes.name: derms_integration_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS) Integration Reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier linking this VPP dispatch to the corresponding instruction or transaction in the Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS). Enables traceability between utility dispatch systems and DER control platforms.

attributes.name: dispatch_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the VPP dispatch instruction in minutes. Calculated as the difference between dispatch end time and dispatch start time.

attributes.name: dispatch_end_time
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction expires and DER resources should return to normal operation.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the VPP dispatch instruction, formatted as VPP- followed by 10 digits. Used for external communication with ISO/RTO and aggregators.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Priority level of the VPP dispatch instruction. Emergency dispatches override normal operations; high priority dispatches support critical grid conditions; normal and low priority dispatches support economic optimization.

attributes.name: dispatch_reason
attributes.description: Business justification or operational reason for issuing the VPP dispatch instruction. Examples include peak demand management, renewable integration, frequency response, voltage support, or market arbitrage.

attributes.name: dispatch_source
attributes.description: Originating system or entity that initiated the VPP dispatch instruction. Distinguishes between utility Energy Management System (EMS), ISO/RTO market dispatch, aggregator platform, Distributed Energy Resource Management System (DERMS), or manual operator dispatch.

attributes.name: dispatch_start_time
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction becomes effective and DER resources should begin responding.
attributes.references: NAESB WEQ-015 - Wholesale Electric Quadrant Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the VPP dispatch instruction. Tracks progression from issuance through execution to completion or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|issued|acknowledged|active|completed|cancelled|failed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: dispatch_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the VPP dispatch instruction was issued to the aggregated DER portfolio. Represents the principal business event time for this transaction.

attributes.name: iso_rto_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Code
attributes.description: Code identifying the ISO or RTO market region where the VPP dispatch is being executed. Examples include CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, PJM, NYISO, ISO-NE, and SPP. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|MISO|PJM|NYISO|ISO-NE|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: lmp_energy_price
attributes.description: Locational Marginal Price for energy at the pricing node during the dispatch interval, expressed in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh). Used for settlement and revenue calculation.

attributes.name: market_product
attributes.description: Specific wholesale market product or ancillary service that the VPP dispatch is fulfilling. Examples include Day-Ahead Market (DAM) energy, Real-Time Market (RTM) energy, regulation up/down, or operating reserves. Maps to ISO/RTO product definitions.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operational notes, special instructions, or contextual information about the VPP dispatch. Used to capture non-standard conditions or operator observations.

attributes.name: performance_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of actual MW response to target MW dispatch, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.95 for 95% performance). Used to assess VPP portfolio compliance and reliability for capacity accreditation.

attributes.name: pricing_node
attributes.description: Locational Marginal Price (LMP) node or pricing point where the VPP portfolio is registered and settled in the wholesale market. Used for financial settlement and locational value calculation.

attributes.name: ramp_rate_mw_per_min
attributes.description: Required rate of change in power output in megawatts per minute (MW/min). Specifies how quickly the VPP portfolio must transition from current state to target dispatch level.
attributes.references: NERC BAL-001 - Real Power Balancing Control Performance

attributes.name: service_type
attributes.description: Type of grid service requested from the VPP portfolio. Includes energy arbitrage, capacity provision, frequency regulation, spinning reserve, non-spinning reserve, and voltage support. Determines the operational mode and response requirements for the DER fleet.

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Total financial settlement amount in dollars for the VPP dispatch performance. Calculated based on actual MW response, LMP energy price, and applicable market product rates. Used for aggregator and customer incentive payments.

attributes.name: settlement_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the settlement amount. Typically USD for North American energy markets.

attributes.name: settlement_interval
attributes.description: Time granularity for measuring and settling the VPP dispatch performance. Aligns with ISO/RTO market settlement intervals (typically 5-minute, 15-minute, or hourly).

attributes.name: target_mw
attributes.description: Target power output or curtailment in megawatts (MW) requested from the VPP portfolio. Positive values indicate generation or discharge; negative values indicate load reduction or charging.
attributes.references: NERC MOD-032 - Data for Power System Modeling

attributes.name: telemetry_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Frequency in seconds at which real-time telemetry data was collected from the VPP portfolio during the dispatch. Typical values range from 1 to 60 seconds depending on service type and ISO/RTO requirements.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this VPP dispatch record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

products.name: dr_capacity_registration
products.description: Master record of DR capacity registered with an ISO/RTO or utility capacity market, representing individual customer resources, aggregator portfolios, and VPP resource pools. Captures registration ID, ISO/RTO market, portfolio name, resource type mix (load curtailment, DER, battery, EV), capacity season, registered MW, geographic zone, performance tier and obligation, capacity payment rate ($/MW-day), compliance test results, certification status, registration effective date, portfolio composition details, and aggregator portfolio metadata (ISO/RTO registration ID, resource type mix, total registered capacity). SSOT for wholesale DR capacity positions, aggregator portfolio registrations, VPP resource pools, and ISO/RTO capacity reporting obligations.
products.reference: ISO/RTO DR Capacity Resource Registration; FERC Order 745 Capacity Enrollment

attributes.name: primary_dr_program_id

attributes.name: to_aggregator_id

attributes.name: to_dr_program_id
attributes.description: FK to demand.dr_program.dr_program_id — Capacity registrations are made under specific DR programs for ISO/RTO market participation. Required for capacity reporting.

attributes.name: annual_capacity_payment_usd
attributes.business_glossary_term: Annual Capacity Payment United States Dollars (USD)
attributes.description: Total annual capacity payment in USD for this registration, calculated as registered_capacity_mw × capacity_payment_rate_per_mw_day × days_in_season. Used for revenue forecasting and financial reporting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration was approved by the ISO/RTO or utility. Marks the transition to certified status.

attributes.name: baseline_methodology
attributes.description: The ISO/RTO-approved baseline methodology used for measuring demand reduction performance (e.g., High 5 of 10, Mid 8 of 10, Regression-based). Determines how capacity performance is calculated during events.

attributes.name: capacity_obligation_mw
attributes.description: The firm capacity obligation in megawatts (MW) that must be delivered during performance assessment hours. May differ from registered capacity due to derating factors or performance adjustments.

attributes.name: capacity_payment_rate_per_mw_day
attributes.description: The capacity payment rate in dollars per megawatt per day ($/MW-day) for this registration, as determined by the ISO/RTO capacity auction clearing price for the zone and season.
attributes.references: FERC Order 719, ISO/RTO Capacity Auction Results

attributes.name: capacity_season
attributes.description: The capacity delivery year or season for which this registration is effective (e.g., 2024/2025, Summer 2024). Aligns with ISO/RTO capacity auction and delivery periods.

attributes.name: certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the DR capacity registration was certified by the ISO/RTO as meeting all technical, metering, and performance requirements.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current certification status of the DR capacity registration with the ISO/RTO. Certified status is required for capacity payments and market participation.

attributes.name: compliance_test_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent ISO/RTO compliance test or capacity performance verification test for this registration.

attributes.name: compliance_test_result_mw
attributes.description: Measured demand reduction in megawatts (MW) achieved during the most recent compliance test. Used to validate registered capacity and adjust capacity credits.

attributes.name: compliance_test_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the most recent compliance test. Failed tests may result in capacity derating or registration suspension.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: iso_rto_market
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Market
attributes.description: The ISO/RTO market in which this DR capacity is registered. Determines market rules, capacity auction structure, and performance obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: PJM|NYISO|ISO-NE|CAISO|MISO|SPP|ERCOT — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: iso_rto_registration_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Registration Identifier
attributes.description: External registration identifier assigned by the ISO/RTO capacity market for this DR resource or portfolio. This is the business identifier used in wholesale market communications and settlements.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this registration record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing special conditions, exceptions, or operational details related to this DR capacity registration. Used for operational coordination and issue tracking.

attributes.name: performance_penalty_rate_per_mwh
attributes.description: Penalty rate in dollars per megawatt-hour ($/MWh) applied for non-performance during ISO/RTO performance assessment hours. Varies by market and performance tier.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Performance classification tier assigned by the ISO/RTO based on historical performance, resource type, and telemetry capabilities (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2, Emergency-Only). Affects capacity credit and payment rates.

attributes.name: portfolio_composition_json
attributes.description: JSON structure containing detailed composition of the DR portfolio, including individual customer IDs, premise IDs, meter IDs, resource types, and individual capacity contributions. Used for portfolio management and settlement allocation.

attributes.name: portfolio_name
attributes.description: Business name or designation for the DR capacity portfolio. May represent an aggregator portfolio, utility program portfolio, or Virtual Power Plant (VPP) resource pool.

attributes.name: puc_reporting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this registration must be included in state Public Utility Commission (PUC) demand response program reporting and Renewable Portfolio Standard (RPS) compliance filings.

attributes.name: registered_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total registered demand response capacity in megawatts (MW) committed to the ISO/RTO capacity market. This is the capacity obligation that must be available during performance periods.

attributes.name: registration_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this DR capacity registration becomes effective and capacity obligations begin. Typically aligns with the start of the capacity delivery season.

attributes.name: registration_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this DR capacity registration expires and capacity obligations end. Typically aligns with the end of the capacity delivery season.

attributes.name: registration_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DR capacity registration. Active status is required for capacity payments and dispatch eligibility.

attributes.name: registration_type
attributes.description: Classification of the DR capacity registration structure. Determines reporting obligations, settlement processes, and performance measurement methodologies.

attributes.name: resource_type_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or JSON structure describing the mix of resource types in this registration (e.g., load_curtailment, battery_storage, solar_der, ev_charging, chp). Captures the composition of the portfolio for capacity credit calculations.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this registration was submitted to the ISO/RTO capacity market. Used for tracking registration timelines and auction participation.

attributes.name: submitted_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who submitted this registration to the ISO/RTO. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: telemetry_interval_seconds
attributes.description: Required telemetry reporting interval in seconds (e.g., 4, 10, 60) for real-time performance monitoring. Null if telemetry is not required.

attributes.name: telemetry_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether real-time telemetry data submission to the ISO/RTO is required for this registration. Typically required for Tier 1 performance resources and VPP registrations.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Telemetry Requirements, NERC CIP Standards

products.name: dr_compliance_report

SSOT for DR regulatory reporting obligations and program performance period tracking.

attributes.name: acceptance_timestamp

attributes.name: actual_events_called

attributes.references: ISO/RTO Market Operations, DR Program Rules

attributes.name: audit_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the compliance report was audited and validated for accuracy and completeness.

attributes.name: auditor_name

attributes.name: baseline_methodology
attributes.description: The baseline calculation methodology used for measurement and verification (M&V) in this compliance report (e.g., 'High 5 of 10', 'High 4 of 5', 'Meter Before/Meter After', 'Regression-based').

attributes.name: compliance_status
attributes.description: Overall compliance determination for the reporting period. compliant = met all performance and reporting requirements; non_compliant = failed to meet minimum thresholds; conditional_compliance = compliant with conditions or waivers; under_investigation = compliance determination pending; penalty_assessed = non-compliance with financial penalties imposed.

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility representative or program manager responsible for this compliance report and available for regulatory inquiries.
attributes.references: PUC Filing Requirements, ISO/RTO Contact Protocols

attributes.name: contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the utility representative responsible for this compliance report.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this compliance report record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: ISO/RTO Data Retention Standards, SOX Requirements

attributes.name: data_quality_score
attributes.description: Composite data quality score (0.0000 to 1.0000) reflecting completeness, accuracy, and timeliness of the underlying meter data and baseline calculations used in this compliance report.

attributes.name: enrolled_capacity_mw
attributes.description: Total enrolled demand response capacity in megawatts (MW) committed for the reporting period, representing the baseline program commitment.

attributes.name: iso_rto_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Name
attributes.description: Name of the ISO or RTO market operator receiving this report (e.g., PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, NYISO, ISO-NE, MISO, SPP).

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this compliance report record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: measurement_verification_method

attributes.name: methodology_attestation_flag

attributes.name: minimum_performance_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum required performance ratio (e.g., 0.7500 for 75%) that the program must achieve to remain compliant and avoid penalties.

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: penalty_amount_usd

attributes.name: penalty_reason

attributes.name: performance_period_type

attributes.name: performance_ratio

products.name: aggregation
products.description: This association product represents the contractual relationship between a demand response aggregator and a specific distributed energy resource (DER) system. It captures the commercial and operational terms under which an aggregator includes a DER system in its portfolio for participation in ISO/RTO wholesale markets or utility demand response programs. Each record links one aggregator to one DER system with attributes that exist only in the context of this aggregation contract, including capacity allocation, revenue sharing, performance obligations, and telemetry requirements.. Existence Justification: In energy utilities demand response operations, a single DER system can be contracted by multiple aggregators simultaneously to participate in different markets or programs (e.g., one aggregator for ISO/RTO wholesale capacity markets, another for utility-managed demand response programs). Each aggregator manages a portfolio of many DER systems. The aggregation relationship is an active contractual arrangement with specific commercial terms (capacity allocation, revenue sharing, performance tiers) and operational requirements (telemetry intervals, dispatch priority, baseline methodology) that vary by aggregator-system combination.

products.name: demand_enrollment
products.description: This association product represents the enrollment relationship between a demand response program and a distributed energy resource system. It captures the operational configuration and performance tracking for each DER system's participation in each DR program. Each record links one DR program to one DER system with program-specific capacity allocation, baseline methodology, telemetry configuration, and enrollment lifecycle attributes that exist only in the context of this participation relationship.. Existence Justification: In energy utilities operations, a single DER system (solar+battery, EV charger, etc.) can simultaneously participate in multiple demand response programs - for example, enrolling in both an emergency load reduction program and an economic dispatch program and a capacity market program. Conversely, each DR program enrolls many DER systems across its service territory to aggregate sufficient capacity. The enrollment relationship is an operational business entity that DR program managers actively create, configure, monitor, and terminate.

products.name: storm_aggregator_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the emergency demand response deployment between aggregator and storm_event. It captures the operational activation of demand response aggregators during declared storm events for emergency load relief and mutual aid coordination. Each record links one aggregator to one storm_event with deployment-specific capacity, performance metrics, and settlement data that exist only in the context of this emergency response relationship.. Existence Justification: In energy utility emergency operations, demand response aggregators are activated during major storm events to provide emergency load relief and support mutual aid coordination. A single aggregator participates in multiple storm events over time (Hurricane Ida, Winter Storm Uri, etc.), and each major storm event involves activating multiple aggregators simultaneously to achieve required load reduction targets. The utility actively manages these deployments as operational records with specific capacity commitments, performance tracking, and financial settlements for each aggregator-storm combination.

products.name: irp_dr_program_assumption
products.description: This association product represents the scenario-specific modeling assumptions for a demand response program within an Integrated Resource Plan scenario. Each IRP scenario models the same DR program portfolio with different participation rates, capacity credits, costs, and deployment timing to evaluate resource adequacy under various planning assumptions. Each record links one DR program to one IRP scenario with the scenario-specific assumptions used in capacity expansion modeling and regulatory filings.. Existence Justification: In IRP planning, utilities model the same portfolio of DR programs across multiple scenarios (base case, high DR penetration, low carbon, accelerated retirement) with different participation rates, capacity credits, costs, and deployment timing for each scenario. Each DR program appears in multiple IRP scenarios with scenario-specific assumptions, and each IRP scenario models multiple DR programs. IRP analysts actively create and manage these scenario-specific DR program assumptions as part of regulatory filing preparation and resource adequacy sensitivity analysis.

domains.name: outage

Distinct from grid domain (real-time control) — focuses on event lifecycle and restoration coordination.

Includes cause classification, outage type (sustained, momentary, planned, major event per IEEE 1366), affected circuit/feeder, estimated vs. actual restoration time (ETR/ATR), initial prediction metadata (source, confidence, predicted scope, predicted cause, predicted affected segments), source call/report metadata (call receipt timestamp, source type, reported symptom, call disposition, duplicate flag, call clustering results), lifecycle status transitions with full audit trail (status code, transition timestamp, triggering actor, status notes), affected network segment detail (segment identifier, type, de-energization timestamps, isolation method, customer count, restoration sequence priority), SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI contribution, storm flag, Major Event Day declaration status, and OMS event identifier. attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage event per IEEE 1366 definitions: sustained (interruption > 5 minutes), momentary (≤ 5 minutes), planned (scheduled maintenance), major_event_day (MED per IEEE 1366 beta method), or partial (affecting a subset of customers on a circuit). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sustained|momentary|planned|major_event_day|partial|rolling — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 Standard for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: fault_location
attributes.description: Descriptive location of the fault or interruption point on the network (e.g., pole number, span identifier, address nearest to fault). Captured from field crew report or automated fault location indicator (FLI) in the ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: initial_call_receipt_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first customer call or report associated with this outage event was received by the Customer Information System (CIS) or IVR. Used for call clustering analysis and detection latency measurement.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle CC&B; State PUC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: is_major_event_day
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event occurred on a day declared as a Major Event Day (MED) per the IEEE 1366 beta method. MED events are excluded from standard SAIDI/SAIFI calculations and reported separately to PUC. True = MED event; False = normal event.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 Section 4.2 Major Event Day; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: is_storm_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event was caused by or associated with a declared storm or severe weather event. Storm-flagged events may be subject to separate regulatory reporting thresholds and mutual aid activation criteria.
attributes.references: State PUC Storm Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: isolation_method
attributes.description: Method by which the fault was isolated from the network: automatic (protective device operated automatically), manual (field crew operated device manually), remote (SCADA/ADMS remote switching), or flisr_automated (ADMS FLISR automation executed switching sequence).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; IEEE C37; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event meets NERC reporting thresholds (e.g., EOP-004 disturbance reporting criteria based on MW loss, customer count, or duration). True = event must be reported to NERC/DOE via OE-417 or equivalent.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004 Disturbance Reporting; DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident Reporting

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether automated customer outage notifications (IVR, SMS, email, or app push) have been sent for this outage event. True = at least one notification batch dispatched. Used for regulatory compliance tracking of customer communication requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; Oracle CC&B Notification Module

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the first customer outage notification was dispatched for this event. Used to measure notification latency from detection and to demonstrate compliance with PUC customer communication time requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; Oracle CC&B

attributes.name: oms_event_code
attributes.description: The externally-known event identifier assigned by the Outage Management System (GE PowerOn ADMS). This is the operational business identifier used by field crews, dispatchers, and customer service representatives to reference the outage event across systems.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Event; NAESB Business Practice Standards

attributes.name: predicted_cause_code
attributes.description: The cause code predicted by the OMS predictive model or ADMS fault analysis engine at the time of initial detection, before field crew investigation. Compared against final cause_code for model accuracy tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather|equipment_failure|animal_contact|vegetation|human_error|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Predictive Analytics; IEEE 1366-2012

attributes.name: predicted_customers_affected
attributes.description: The number of customers predicted to be affected by the outage at the time of initial detection, as estimated by the OMS/ADMS predictive model. Compared against actual customers_affected_count for model accuracy and ETR calibration.

attributes.name: prediction_confidence_score
attributes.description: Confidence score (0.00–100.00) assigned by the predictive model or ADMS fault analysis engine to the initial outage prediction, including predicted cause and affected scope. Used to assess model reliability and calibrate automated dispatch thresholds.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Predictive Analytics Module

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Restoration priority classification assigned to the outage event, used to sequence crew dispatch and switching operations. Critical: hospitals, emergency services, critical infrastructure; High: large commercial/industrial, high customer count; Medium: standard residential; Low: single-customer or non-critical.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Restoration Prioritization; State PUC Critical Facility Requirements; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: puc_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reportable Event Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event meets the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) threshold for mandatory individual event reporting (e.g., exceeds customer count or duration thresholds defined in the utility's tariff or service quality rules).
attributes.references: State PUC Service Quality and Reliability Rules; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: reported_symptom
attributes.description: The primary symptom reported by the first customer caller or detected by the AMI/SCADA system at the time of initial report. Used for triage, cause hypothesis, and crew dispatch guidance.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Oracle CC&B Trouble Call Management

attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution in Minutes
attributes.description: This event's contribution to the System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI), expressed in customer-minutes per total customers served. Calculated as customer_minutes_interrupted divided by total customers served in the reporting period. Stored at event level for regulatory period aggregation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 SAIDI Definition; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: saifi_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Contribution
attributes.description: This event's contribution to the System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI), expressed as customer interruptions per total customers served. Calculated as customers_affected_count divided by total customers served. Stored at event level for regulatory period aggregation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012 SAIFI Definition; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the outage event record. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.

products.name: interruption
products.description: Granular record of a single customer or premise-level service interruption linked to a parent outage event or planned maintenance window. Tracks the specific service point, customer account reference, interruption start and end timestamps, duration in minutes, cause code, restoration method (switching, repair, bypass), planned/unplanned flag, notification sent flag, notification channel, critical care designation (medical baseline, life support), restoration confirmation, and association to planned maintenance windows. Also serves as the customer-outage association record capturing per-customer impact including notification delivery status and opt-out preferences. This is the single SSOT for ALL customer-level outage impact — feeds SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI reliability index calculations, supports customer-facing outage communication, drives regulatory customer impact reporting, and provides the definitive record of which customers were affected by each event.
products.reference: Customer Interruption Record (IEEE 1366)

attributes.name: interruption_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a single customer or premise-level service interruption record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 - Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account associated with the interrupted service point at the time of the interruption. Supports customer-facing outage communication and regulatory customer impact reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U FICA; Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Account

attributes.name: ami_meter_id
attributes.description: The AMI meter identifier associated with the service point at the time of the interruption. Used to correlate last-gasp and first-breath AMI signals from the MDM system for automated interruption detection and restoration confirmation.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; AMI/Advanced Metering Infrastructure Standards; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_service_agreement. Business justification: Individual customer interruptions require service agreement context to apply correct credit calculation rules based on rate schedule, service class, and contractual SLA terms. Enables automated credit

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation serving the affected service point at the time of the interruption. Supports substation-level reliability performance reporting and outage root cause analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event that caused this customer-level interruption. Links the granular interruption record to the broader outage event for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI roll-up calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Event Record

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution feeder circuit that serves the affected service point. Supports feeder-level reliability analysis, SAIDI/SAIFI benchmarking by circuit, and GIS-based outage mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: interruption_planned_outage_window_id
attributes.description: Reference to the planned maintenance window associated with this interruption, when applicable. Null for unplanned outages. Links to the planned outage schedule for customer notification and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: outage_crew_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field crew dispatch record associated with the restoration of this interruption. Links to workforce management for crew response time analysis and restoration efficiency reporting.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the switching order executed to isolate or restore the affected circuit segment. Links the customer-level interruption to the operational switching workflow in the ADMS/OMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service delivery point (meter point or premise connection) that experienced the interruption. The fundamental unit of interruption tracking per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle CC&B Service Point

attributes.name: to_planned_outage_window_id
attributes.description: FK to outage.planned_outage_window.planned_outage_window_id — Customer interruptions from planned maintenance link to the planned outage window. Required for distinguishing planned vs unplanned interruptions in reliability reporting.

attributes.name: cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the primary cause of the service interruption (e.g., weather, equipment failure, animal contact, vegetation, scheduled maintenance, third-party damage). Aligned with IEEE 1366 cause categories and OMS cause code taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: weather|equipment_failure|animal_contact|vegetation|scheduled_maintenance|third_party_damage|unknown|human_error|overload|lightning — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Annex A; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Cause Codes; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the specific cause of the interruption, supplementing the standardized cause_code with field crew observations, dispatcher notes, or automated OMS event descriptions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this interruption record was first created in the system, either by automated OMS event processing or manual dispatcher entry. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: critical_care_type
attributes.description: Specific category of critical care designation for the affected customer. Used to prioritize restoration sequencing and determine notification requirements. Only populated when is_critical_care is true.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; CPUC Rule 14; HIPAA (for health-related designations)

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Classification of the affected customer by service class at the time of the interruption. Used for segmented SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting by customer class as required by state PUC reliability standards and NERC reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of customers affected by the parent outage event at the time this interruption record was created. Denormalized from the outage event for regulatory reporting convenience. Used in SAIFI numerator calculations and NERC/PUC customer impact reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC EOP-004; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the data quality status of this interruption record as assessed during Silver layer validation. 'validated' indicates all timestamps and durations are confirmed; 'estimated' indicates one or more fields are estimated; 'suspect' indicates anomalies detected; 'corrected' indicates the record has been manually revised post-initial capture.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM VEE (Validation, Estimation, and Editing); Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Quality Rules

attributes.name: duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the service interruption in whole minutes, calculated as the difference between interruption_end_timestamp and interruption_start_timestamp. Stored as a business field to support SAIDI and CAIDI reliability index calculations without requiring real-time computation. Null if interruption is still active.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC Reliability Reporting; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer's service was restored, recorded to millisecond precision. Null if the interruption is still active. Used as the end point for duration calculations and CAIDI index computation per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time of service restoration communicated to the customer and used for crew scheduling. Distinct from interruption_end_timestamp (actual restoration). Supports customer communication accuracy tracking and ETR (Estimated Time to Restore) performance measurement.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS ETR; State PUC Customer Notification Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: interruption_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the interruption record. 'active' indicates the customer is currently without power; 'restored' indicates service has been re-energized; 'cancelled' indicates the interruption was logged in error; 'pending_confirmation' indicates restoration has been initiated but field confirmation is outstanding.

attributes.name: interruption_type
attributes.description: Classification of the interruption as planned (scheduled maintenance), unplanned (forced outage), or momentary (duration less than 5 minutes per IEEE 1366 definition). Drives separate SAIDI/SAIFI/MAIFI index tracking and regulatory reporting segmentation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Section 3; NERC Reliability Reporting; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: is_critical_care
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected customer or premise is designated as a critical care account (medical baseline, life support equipment, or other medically vulnerable designation). Critical care customers receive priority restoration and mandatory advance notification under state PUC rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; CPUC Rule 14; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this interruption record was most recently modified, including status updates, restoration confirmation, or cause code revisions. Supports change tracking and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Change Data Capture

attributes.name: major_event_day_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption has been formally excluded from the standard SAIDI/SAIFI reliability index calculations under the IEEE 1366 Major Event Day beta method. Distinct from storm_event_flag — this is the formal regulatory exclusion determination.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Section 4.2 Major Event Day Beta Method; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: momentary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption qualifies as a momentary interruption (duration less than 5 minutes per IEEE 1366 definition). Momentary interruptions are tracked separately for MAIFI (Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index) calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Section 3 Momentary Interruption Definition; State PUC MAIFI Reporting

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel used to deliver the outage notification to the affected customer. Supports multi-channel notification analytics and customer preference compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: notification_opt_out
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer has opted out of outage notifications for this service point. When true, notification_sent will be false by design. Supports customer preference management and regulatory opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication Rules; TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act)

attributes.name: notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage notification has been sent to the affected customer for this interruption. Supports regulatory compliance tracking for customer notification requirements mandated by state PUCs.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B Notification

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the outage notification was dispatched to the customer. Used to measure notification lead time relative to interruption start and to demonstrate regulatory compliance with advance notice requirements for planned outages.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Rules; NAESB Business Practices

attributes.name: oms_event_number
attributes.description: The externally-known event number assigned by the Outage Management System (GE PowerOn ADMS) to the parent outage event. Serves as the cross-system integration key for reconciliation between OMS, CIS, and MDM systems.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; SAP IS-U; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: protective_device_operation
attributes.description: Type of protective device that operated to isolate the fault causing this interruption. Supports equipment performance analysis, recloser operation tracking, and fuse-saving vs. trip-and-reclose strategy evaluation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC PRC Standards

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this interruption record, used in customer communications, regulatory filings, and OMS integration. Format: INT-YYYY-NNNNNNNN.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B; NERC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption must be included in regulatory reliability reports submitted to NERC, FERC, or state PUCs. Interruptions below minimum duration thresholds or excluded under MED rules may be flagged as non-reportable.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reliability Reports; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: restoration_confirmation_method
attributes.description: Method by which service restoration was confirmed. AMI ping uses Advanced Metering Infrastructure last-gasp/first-breath signals; field_crew indicates on-site verification; customer_callback indicates customer-reported restoration; scada indicates SCADA system re-energization signal; estimated indicates restoration assumed based on switching operations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; Oracle Utilities MDM; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: restoration_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether service restoration has been confirmed for this interruption, either through AMI meter ping, field crew confirmation, or customer callback. Distinguishes between estimated restoration and verified restoration for CAIDI accuracy.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities MDM AMI

attributes.name: restoration_method
attributes.description: Method used to restore service to the affected customer or premise. Supports operational analysis of restoration efficiency and crew dispatch effectiveness. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: switching|repair|bypass|auto_reclosure|manual_transfer|temporary_generation — promote to reference product if additional values are needed]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR; IEEE 1366; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution (Minutes)
attributes.description: This interruption's individual contribution to the SAIDI reliability index, expressed in customer-minutes divided by total customers served. Stored as a pre-computed business field to support regulatory reporting aggregation without requiring full recalculation. Null if interruption is active or excluded from SAIDI.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 SAIDI Definition; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulated service territory within which the interrupted service point is located. Used for jurisdictional segmentation of reliability reporting across multiple state PUC regulatory boundaries.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Definitions; FERC OATT; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this interruption record originated. Supports data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver layer provenance tracking across OMS, CIS, and MDM source systems.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage; GE PowerOn ADMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the customer's service interruption began, recorded to millisecond precision. This is the principal business event timestamp used as the start point for duration calculations and SAIDI/SAIFI index computation per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC EOP-004; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption occurred during a declared major event or storm. When true, the interruption may be excluded from IEEE 1366 Major Event Day (MED) calculations per the beta method, affecting SAIDI/SAIFI index reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Major Event Day (MED) Beta Method; State PUC Storm Reporting Rules

attributes.name: to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — Every customer-level interruption must link to its parent outage event. This is the foundational relationship for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculation — without it, reliability indices cannot be computed. Da

attributes.name: voltage_level
attributes.description: Voltage classification of the circuit segment at which the interruption originated. Used to segment reliability reporting by voltage class and to identify transmission vs. distribution-level outage impacts for FERC and state PUC reporting.
attributes.references: NERC Reliability Standards; FERC Form 1; IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the time and location of the interruption. Used for weather-normalized reliability analysis, storm response performance reporting, and climate resilience planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|wind|ice|snow|lightning|flood|extreme_heat|none — promote to reference product if additional values needed]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Storm Reporting; NERC EOP-004

products.name: outage_switching_order
products.description: Formal switching order issued during outage restoration or planned maintenance to reconfigure the distribution network. Captures the complete switching sequence including individual step detail (step sequence number, device identifier, device type, action type — open/close/tag/verify, required safety state, completion status, actual execution timestamp, executing crew member). Also records issuing dispatcher, executing crew, affected switching devices (sectionalizers, reclosers, breakers), safety clearance references, energization/de-energization timestamps, and approval chain. Supports granular audit trail of switching sequences for NERC compliance and post-event analysis. Integrates with GE PowerOn ADMS switching management module.
products.reference: Switching Order (GE PowerOn ADMS / NERC FAC-001)

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the switching order record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module

attributes.name: affected_feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary distribution feeder circuit affected by this switching order. Used for network topology analysis, outage impact assessment, and GIS integration with Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor or operations manager who approved this switching order prior to execution. Supports the approval chain audit trail.

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Switching orders affect control area operations (state estimation, interchange schedules, AGC). EMS operators coordinate switching with field crews to maintain system reliability and balancing authori

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field crew assigned to execute this switching order. Used for crew dispatch tracking and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Crew Management; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: Switching orders require DER isolation verification before energization per IEEE 1547 and utility operating procedures. Operators must confirm DER status (online/offline/isolated) before executing swi

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation from which the affected feeder originates or where the primary switching devices are located. Used for geographic scoping and asset management integration.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event that triggered this switching order. Links the switching sequence to the originating interruption or planned maintenance event in the Outage Management System (OMS).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Module; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: grid_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.grid_switching_order. Business justification: Outage switching orders may reference or be coordinated with grid switching orders for transmission-connected substations. Linking enables cross-system switching coordination and safety compliance.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Switching orders on critical infrastructure require compliance documentation under NERC CIP or operational reliability standards. Operations must document adherence to switching protocols mandated by

attributes.name: primary_outage_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the control room dispatcher who issued and authorized this switching order. Required for NERC compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; NERC CIP-006; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: actual_customers_affected
attributes.description: The confirmed number of customer service points that were interrupted as a result of this switching order, validated post-restoration. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation and regulatory reporting to State PUCs.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the final switching step was completed and the switching order was closed. Used for outage duration calculation and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability performance reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the field crew began executing the first step of the switching sequence. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: adms_switching_order_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) Switching Order Reference
attributes.description: The native switching order identifier assigned by the GE PowerOn Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS). Used for cross-system reconciliation between the Silver Layer lakehouse and the operational ADMS source system.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module

attributes.name: approval_chain_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the approval chain for this switching order, including any conditional approvals, escalations, or deviations from standard authorization procedures. Supports NERC compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the switching order received final authorization from the approving supervisor or operations manager. Part of the approval chain audit trail required for NERC compliance.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this switching order was cancelled, if applicable. Populated only when order_status is 'cancelled'. Supports post-event analysis and process improvement.

attributes.name: completed_steps_count
attributes.description: The number of individual switching steps that have been successfully executed and confirmed as of the last update. Enables real-time progress monitoring during active switching operations.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this switching order record was first created in the system, which may precede the issued timestamp if the order was drafted in advance. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether advance customer notification was sent for this switching order (applicable to planned outages). Supports compliance tracking against State PUC advance notification requirements, typically 48-72 hours prior to planned interruption.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Management

attributes.name: de_energization_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the affected network segment was de-energized (taken out of service) as part of this switching order. Critical for outage duration measurement and SAIDI calculation start point.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: energization_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the affected network segment was re-energized (returned to service) following completion of the switching sequence. Marks the end of the customer interruption for SAIDI/CAIDI calculation.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: estimated_customers_affected
attributes.description: The estimated number of customer service points that will be or are interrupted as a result of this switching order. Used for customer notification prioritization, regulatory reporting, and SAIFI calculation inputs.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: hazard_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing known hazards, special safety precautions, or environmental conditions relevant to executing this switching order. Examples include downed conductors, flooded equipment, or proximity to energized lines. Mandatory review by crew before execution.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; IEEE Std C2 (NESC); NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the dispatcher formally issued this switching order to the field crew. This is the principal business event timestamp marking the start of the switching order lifecycle. Recorded in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this switching order record was most recently modified. Tracks any changes to the order after initial creation, supporting audit trail requirements.

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order is associated with an event that meets NERC reportability thresholds (e.g., EOP-004 disturbance reporting). When True, the event must be included in mandatory NERC regulatory submissions.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-001; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: network_segment_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the distribution or transmission network segment affected by this switching order, including feeder name, circuit section, and geographic reference. Supports field crew orientation and post-event reporting.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: oms_incident_number
attributes.description: The incident or trouble call number from the Outage Management System (OMS) associated with this switching order. Enables traceability from the switching sequence back to the originating customer-reported outage or system-detected fault.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Module; State PUC Outage Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the switching order. Tracks progression from initial drafting through dispatcher issuance, field execution, and final completion or cancellation. Drives workflow routing in GE PowerOn ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the switching order by operational purpose. Distinguishes planned maintenance windows from emergency outage restoration, storm response, load transfer operations, and asset commissioning/decommissioning activities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned_maintenance|emergency_restoration|storm_response|load_transfer|commissioning|decommissioning — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: planned_outage_flag
