attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order is associated with a planned (scheduled) outage as opposed to an unplanned (forced) interruption. Planned outages are tracked separately for SAIDI/SAIFI reporting and customer advance notification compliance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: post_event_review_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order has been flagged for mandatory post-event review, typically triggered by NERC reportable events, major storm response, or switching errors. Drives the post-event analysis workflow.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-001; State PUC Post-Event Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: post_event_review_notes
attributes.description: Free-text findings and corrective actions documented during the post-event review of this switching order. Populated after review completion when post_event_review_flag is True. Supports continuous improvement and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-001; State PUC Post-Event Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to this switching order, used for restoration prioritization and crew dispatch sequencing. Critical priority is reserved for transmission-level or large-scale customer impact events.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC TPL-001; State PUC Service Reliability Standards

attributes.name: restoration_method
attributes.description: The method used to restore service as part of this switching order. Distinguishes manual field crew switching from automated ADMS-driven Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration (FLISR), remote switching via SCADA, sectionalizing, or load transfer to alternate feeders.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: safety_clearance_number
attributes.description: The reference number of the safety clearance (hold tag or clearance order) associated with this switching order. Ensures that de-energized equipment is properly tagged and locked out before crew work begins. Mandatory for OSHA lockout/tagout compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std C2 (NESC)

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time by which the switching sequence is expected to be completed and the network restored to target configuration. Used for outage duration estimation and customer notification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Customer Notification Requirements

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The planned date and time for field crew to begin executing the switching sequence. Used for planned maintenance scheduling and crew coordination. May differ from actual execution start time.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching order was issued in response to a major storm or declared emergency event. When True, the associated outage duration may be excluded from IEEE Std 1366 SAIDI/SAIFI calculations per major event day (MED) criteria.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Major Event Day Exclusion Policy; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: suspension_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this switching order was suspended mid-execution, if applicable. Populated only when order_status is 'suspended'. Common reasons include unexpected hazards, equipment failure, or crew safety concerns.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: switching_order_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the switching order, used by dispatchers, field crews, and control room operators. Format: SO-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}. This is the business-facing reference number used in OMS and ADMS systems.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: switching_purpose_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the operational reason for issuing this switching order, including the specific fault, maintenance activity, or load transfer objective. Provides context beyond the structured order_type classification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: switching_zone
attributes.description: The operational control zone or dispatch territory within which this switching order is executed. Aligns with the utility's geographic service territory divisions used for crew dispatch and reliability performance reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; State PUC Service Territory Definitions

attributes.name: total_steps_count
attributes.description: The total number of individual switching steps defined in this switching order sequence. Used for progress tracking and completeness validation during execution.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Management Module; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of this switching order, incremented each time the order is revised after initial issuance. Supports audit trail requirements and ensures field crews are executing the most current approved version of the switching sequence.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: The nominal operating voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the network segment affected by this switching order. Determines applicable safety procedures, crew qualifications, and regulatory requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; IEEE Std C2 (NESC); IEC 60038

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the associated maintenance or repair work order in the asset management system (Ventyx Asset Suite or SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance). Links the switching order to the underlying maintenance activity that necessitated the switching sequence.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP S/4HANA PM Module; NERC FAC-002

products.name: outage_switching_step
products.description: Individual step within a switching order defining a discrete device operation (open, close, tag, verify). Tracks step sequence number, device identifier, action type, required safety state, completion status, actual execution timestamp, and executing crew member. Enables granular audit trail of switching sequences for NERC compliance and post-event analysis.
products.reference: Switching Step (GE PowerOn ADMS)

attributes.name: outage_switching_step_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individual step within a switching order. Primary key for the outage_switching_step entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field crew unit dispatched to execute this switching step. A crew may execute multiple steps across one or more switching orders. Used for crew workload tracking and dispatch optimization.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance

attributes.name: device_asset_registry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: Switching steps operate on physical distribution assets (circuit breakers, reclosers, sectionalizers, switches). Linking to asset_registry enables maintenance history correlation, asset condition trac

attributes.name: device_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific switchable grid device (breaker, recloser, disconnect switch, sectionalizer, fuse, capacitor bank, or regulator) targeted by this switching step. Sourced from the GIS network model.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEC CIM (Common Information Model) IEC 61968/61970

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation associated with the target device. Supports substation-level switching activity reporting, transformer loading analysis, and geographic outage impact assessment.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEC CIM IEC 61968/61970

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage event (planned or unplanned) that this switching step is associated with. Links the granular switching activity to the broader outage lifecycle for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting and OMS event correlation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; IEEE Std 1366; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution feeder circuit on which the target device resides. Enables feeder-level aggregation of switching activity for reliability performance reporting and load management analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS ADMS; IEC CIM IEC 61968

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent switching order that contains this step. Establishes the header-to-line relationship between the switching order and its individual device operation steps.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: primary_outage_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the qualified crew member who physically performed this switching step. Required for NERC compliance audit trail and post-event accountability. Must be a certified switching operator per utility qualification standards.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; GE PowerOn ADMS; SAP S/4HANA HR/HCM

attributes.name: protection_device_id
attributes.description: Reference to the protective relay associated with the target device for this switching step. Relevant for steps involving circuit breakers where relay coordination must be verified before switching. Supports protection coordination analysis.
attributes.references: NERC PRC-001; IEC 60255; GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.scada_point. Business justification: Switching steps operate devices monitored by SCADA points. Linking enables remote verification of device status, automated switching validation, and ADMS/OMS integration for coordinated switching.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance or construction work order in the asset management system that necessitated this switching step. Links switching activity to planned maintenance work for O&M cost tracking and asset lifecycle management.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: The discrete device operation to be performed in this switching step. 'Open' de-energizes a circuit segment; 'Close' re-energizes; 'Tag' applies a hold tag for safety isolation; 'Verify' confirms device state without operating it; 'Ground' applies protective grounding; 'De-energize'/'Energize' for non-switching state changes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|close|tag|verify|ground|de-energize|energize — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; IEEE C37.100; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual time in minutes taken to execute this switching step, calculated from actual_execution_timestamp to completion_timestamp. Used for switching performance benchmarking, crew efficiency analysis, and future switching order planning.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; IEEE Std 1366; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: actual_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which this switching step was physically executed in the field, expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Critical for NERC compliance audit trails, SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculation, and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1366 (SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI); GE PowerOn ADMS; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this switching step received formal authorization from the control room operator or switching supervisor. Distinct from created_timestamp (authoring) and actual_execution_timestamp (field execution). Required for NERC compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; NERC FAC-002; GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: clearance_number
attributes.description: Safety clearance authorization number issued by the control room for this switching step. Required for high-voltage operations and provides the formal authorization reference linking the field operation to the control room approval record.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; GE PowerOn ADMS EMS/OMS

attributes.name: completion_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for the executing crew member to record observations, anomalies, or deviations encountered during step execution. Captured at time of completion and preserved for post-event analysis and NERC compliance documentation.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the step was confirmed complete and the result was recorded in the OMS. May differ from actual_execution_timestamp if there is a delay between physical execution and system confirmation (e.g., radio communication lag or SCADA confirmation delay).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this switching step record was first created in the OMS/ADMS system. Establishes the audit trail start point for the step lifecycle. Expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; SOX Section 404; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of end-use customers whose service is interrupted or restored as a direct result of this switching step. Used in real-time SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculation and customer notification prioritization. Derived from the network topology model at time of execution.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366 (SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI); GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; State PUC Reliability Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: device_state_after
attributes.description: Confirmed state of the target device immediately after this switching step was executed. Verified by the executing crew member and/or SCADA telemetry. Used to confirm successful execution and update the real-time network model.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS SCADA; IEC CIM IEC 61970; OSIsoft PI

attributes.name: device_state_before
attributes.description: Confirmed state of the target device immediately before this switching step was executed (e.g., 'open', 'closed', 'tagged'). Verified by the executing crew member and recorded for audit trail integrity and post-event sequence reconstruction.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS SCADA; IEC CIM IEC 61970

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Classification of the switchable device targeted by this step. Determines applicable safety procedures, required PPE, and permissible action types. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: circuit_breaker|disconnect_switch|recloser|sectionalizer|fuse|capacitor_bank|voltage_regulator — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEC CIM IEC 61968/61970; IEEE C37.100; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: estimated_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration in minutes for executing this switching step, as estimated during switching order planning. Used for outage window scheduling, crew time allocation, and customer notification of expected restoration times.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management; IEEE Std 1366; State PUC Customer Notification Requirements

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason why this switching step failed to execute successfully. Populated only when step_status is 'failed'. Used for root cause analysis, equipment reliability tracking, and corrective action planning.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Ventyx Asset Suite Condition Monitoring; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: hazard_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the specific hazard condition identified at the device location. Populated only when hazard_flag is True. Provides field crew with critical safety information before approaching the device.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: hazard_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a known hazard condition (e.g., downed conductor, flooded equipment, damaged structure) has been identified at the device location for this step. When True, additional safety precautions and supervisor approval are required before execution.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: hold_tag_number
attributes.description: Physical hold tag or clearance tag number applied to the device as part of a lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedure for this switching step. Required for 'tag' action types. Provides traceability between the physical safety tag and the digital switching record.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 (LOTO); NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this switching step record was most recently modified. Tracks the latest change to step details, status, or execution data. Used for data lineage, change detection in ETL pipelines, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; SOX Section 404; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: load_transferred_mw
attributes.description: Estimated or measured electrical load in megawatts (MW) transferred as a result of this switching step. Relevant for load transfer switching operations during outage restoration. Used for grid loading analysis and post-event load flow validation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; OSIsoft PI; NERC TPL-001; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: nerc_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) Reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching step is part of a switching sequence that must be reported to NERC under applicable reliability standards (e.g., FAC-001, FAC-002, or CIP standards). Drives automated regulatory reporting workflows.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; NERC FAC-002; FERC Order 693; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: oms_step_reference
attributes.description: Native step identifier from the source Outage Management System (GE PowerOn ADMS) for this switching step record. Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver Layer data product and the operational OMS for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: planned_execution_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time at which this switching step is planned to be executed, expressed in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Used for crew scheduling, outage window coordination, and customer notification timing.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001; ISO 8601

attributes.name: remote_operated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this switching step was executed remotely via SCADA/ADMS control (True) or required physical field crew intervention (False). Supports FLISR (Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration) automation performance tracking and remote switching capability analytics.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR; NERC FAC-001; OSIsoft PI; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: required_safety_state
attributes.description: Mandatory pre-condition safety state that the device or circuit segment must be in before this step can be executed. Enforces OSHA lockout/tagout (LOTO) and NERC safety rule compliance. Field crew must verify this state before proceeding.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 (LOTO); NERC FAC-001; IEEE C37.100; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: scada_confirmation_timestamp
attributes.business_glossary_term: SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) Confirmation Timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which SCADA telemetry confirmed the device state change for this switching step. Populated only when scada_confirmed is True. Used to measure SCADA response latency and validate field execution timing.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI SCADA Integration; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: scada_confirmed
attributes.business_glossary_term: SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) Confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the device state change for this step was confirmed via SCADA telemetry in addition to field crew verbal confirmation. True when SCADA telemetry corroborates the reported device state; False when confirmation is based solely on field crew report (e.g., non-telemetered device).
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSIsoft PI SCADA Integration; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: skip_reason
attributes.description: Documented justification for skipping this switching step, populated only when step_status is 'skipped'. Must be authorized by the control room operator and recorded for NERC compliance audit trail.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: step_instruction
attributes.description: Detailed written instruction describing exactly how this switching step is to be performed, including specific device location, approach direction, required tools, and safety precautions. Authored by the switching order planner and reviewed by the authorizing operator.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management

attributes.name: step_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal position of this step within the parent switching order. Defines the mandatory execution order of device operations to ensure safe and correct switching sequences. Steps must be executed in ascending sequence order unless the switching order explicitly permits parallel execution.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management; NERC FAC-001; IEEE C37.100

attributes.name: step_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this switching step. 'Pending' indicates awaiting execution; 'In Progress' indicates crew is actively performing the operation; 'Completed' indicates successfully executed; 'Skipped' indicates bypassed per approved deviation; 'Failed' indicates execution attempted but unsuccessful; 'Cancelled' indicates step voided prior to execution.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management; NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1366

attributes.name: switching_order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the parent switching order that contextualizes this step. Determines applicable approval workflows, safety requirements, and reporting categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned_maintenance|emergency_restoration|load_transfer|commissioning|decommissioning|storm_response — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Management; NERC FAC-001; State PUC Storm Response Requirements

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the circuit or bus associated with the target device. Determines applicable safety clearance distances, PPE requirements, and qualified worker certifications required for this step.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; IEC 60038; IEEE C37.100

products.name: outage_crew_dispatch
products.description: Record of a field crew assignment dispatched to an outage location for investigation, repair, or restoration. Captures dispatched crew identifier, dispatch timestamp, estimated travel time, on-site arrival time, work start and completion times, crew type (line crew, troubleshooter, contractor), vehicle assignment, dispatch priority tier, and dispatch status lifecycle. Links to outage events and restoration actions without duplicating workforce master data owned by the workforce domain.
products.reference: Crew Dispatch (GE PowerOn ADMS / Ventyx Asset Suite)

attributes.name: outage_crew_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each crew dispatch record within the outage management system. Primary key for the crew_dispatch data product.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Management Module

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Crew dispatches to transmission-connected substations affect control area operations. Coordination between field crews and control center operators is essential for safe switching and maintaining syst

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Crew labor, vehicle, and equipment costs are allocated to cost centers for O&M expense tracking, budget variance analysis, and FERC account classification. Required for labor cost accounting and regul

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field crew assigned to this dispatch. Links to the workforce domain crew master record without duplicating workforce data. Crew composition and qualifications are owned by the workforce domain.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management; SAP S/4HANA HCM

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage event that triggered this crew dispatch. Links the dispatch record to the parent outage lifecycle managed in the Outage Management System (OMS).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management System (OMS)

attributes.name: forecast_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Crew dispatches are assigned to forecast zones for resource tracking, mutual aid coordination, and operational planning. Utilities use zone-level crew deployment data for storm response planning, reso

attributes.name: grid_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.grid_switching_order. Business justification: Crew dispatches execute grid switching orders. Linking enables tracking of switching order execution status, crew assignment, and field crew coordination with control center operators.

attributes.name: restoration_action_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific restoration action or switching order this dispatch is fulfilling. Enables traceability from dispatch to restoration workflow step.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Switching Order Management

attributes.name: training_record_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.training_record. Business justification: Crew dispatches to critical infrastructure or NERC CIP assets require verification that crew members have completed required compliance training (NERC CIP personnel risk assessments, safety certificat

attributes.name: actual_arrival_at
attributes.description: Actual timestamp when the crew arrived at the outage location and confirmed on-site presence. Captured via mobile device check-in or OMS field update. Used to measure travel time actuals vs. estimates.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Field Crew Mobile; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: actual_restoration_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when power was actually restored to affected customers following crew repair work. Used as the definitive restoration time for SAIDI (System Average Interruption Duration Index) and CAIDI (Customer Average Interruption Duration Index) calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — SAIDI/CAIDI Calculation; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for dispatch cancellation when dispatch_status is 'cancelled'. Captures why the crew was stood down before completing the assignment (e.g., outage restored via FLISR/remote switching, duplicate dispatch, crew reassigned to higher priority). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: duplicate_dispatch|outage_restored_remotely|crew_reassigned|weather_stand_down|customer_cancelled|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Lifecycle; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized cause code assigned by the crew upon arrival or completion, classifying the root cause of the outage (e.g., equipment failure, tree contact, animal contact, weather, vehicle accident). Aligns with IEEE 1366 cause code taxonomy for reliability reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Cause Code Classification; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: cleared_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the crew was formally released from the outage site and cleared for reassignment. May differ from work_completed_at if post-work safety checks, documentation, or switching order closeout is required.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Lifecycle; OSHA 1910.269

attributes.name: contractor_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the external contractor company providing the crew, when crew_type is 'contractor' or mutual_aid_flag is true. Used for contractor performance tracking, invoice reconciliation, and mutual aid cost recovery.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Vendor Management; Ventyx Asset Suite — Contractor Management

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the crew dispatch record was first created in the Outage Management System (OMS). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GE PowerOn ADMS — Audit Trail

attributes.name: crew_identifier
attributes.description: Human-readable operational identifier for the dispatched crew (e.g., crew badge number, radio call sign, or crew unit code) as used by dispatchers and field supervisors in OMS communications.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Management; NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: crew_size
attributes.description: Number of personnel included in the dispatched crew. Used for resource planning, storm response staffing analytics, and mutual aid tracking.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: crew_type
attributes.description: Classification of the dispatched crew by functional role and capability. Determines the type of work the crew is qualified to perform at the outage site. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: line_crew|troubleshooter|contractor|tree_crew|substation_crew|damage_assessment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Resource Classification; OSHA 1910.269

attributes.name: critical_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage site or affected area includes a critical facility (e.g., hospital, emergency services, water treatment plant, military installation). Drives elevated dispatch priority and regulatory notification requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Critical Customer Regulations; NERC CIP-014; DHS Critical Infrastructure Protection

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of customer service points affected by the outage event at the time of dispatch. Used for prioritization, regulatory reporting, and SAIFI (System Average Interruption Frequency Index) calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — SAIFI/SAIDI Calculation; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: damage_assessment_code
attributes.description: Field crew assessment of infrastructure damage severity at the outage site. Used for storm response resource planning, mutual aid requests, and post-event damage reporting to regulators.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-011 — Emergency Operations; State PUC Storm Reporting; FEMA Damage Assessment

attributes.name: dispatch_location_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the outage site location provided to the crew at dispatch time, including landmarks, access instructions, or hazard notes. Supplements GIS coordinates for field navigation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Management; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: dispatch_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the dispatch record, used by field crews, dispatchers, and OMS operators for cross-system reference and communication. Format: DSP-YYYY-NNNNNN.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Management Module; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: dispatch_priority
attributes.description: Priority tier assigned to this dispatch, reflecting urgency based on outage impact (e.g., critical infrastructure, hospital, large customer count). Drives restoration sequencing and resource allocation decisions.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Restoration Prioritization; NERC EOP-011; State PUC Service Reliability Standards

attributes.name: dispatch_source
attributes.description: Originating channel or system through which the dispatch was initiated. Distinguishes automated OMS-driven dispatches from manual dispatcher assignments, storm center activations, or mutual aid requests.

attributes.name: dispatch_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the crew dispatch record, tracking progression from initial assignment through field completion. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pending|dispatched|en_route|on_site|work_in_progress|completed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Lifecycle; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: dispatched_at
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp when the crew was formally dispatched from the operations center to the outage location. Used as the primary business event time for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: dispatcher_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the dispatcher at the time of crew assignment, including special instructions, hazard warnings, customer contact information, or access restrictions for the outage site.

attributes.name: estimated_arrival_at
attributes.description: Calculated timestamp for when the crew is expected to arrive on-site at the outage location. Derived at dispatch time from dispatched_at plus estimated_travel_time_min. Used for customer ETR (Estimated Time to Restore) communications.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Customer Notification; State PUC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_at
attributes.description: Estimated Time to Restore (ETR) as assessed by the crew or dispatcher after on-site evaluation. Used for customer notification updates and regulatory ETR reporting requirements. Distinct from estimated_arrival_at.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Standards; GE PowerOn ADMS — ETR Management; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: estimated_travel_time_min
attributes.description: Estimated travel time in minutes from the crew's current location or staging area to the outage site at the time of dispatch. Used for restoration time estimation and customer notification ETAs.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Dispatch Management; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: field_crew_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the field crew upon arrival or completion, documenting observed conditions, equipment findings, repair actions taken, or follow-up work required. Captured via mobile OMS interface.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Field Crew Mobile; Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management

attributes.name: follow_up_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the crew identified additional work required beyond the initial restoration scope (e.g., permanent repair after temporary restoration, equipment replacement, vegetation management). Triggers follow-up work order creation.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management; GE PowerOn ADMS — Restoration Lifecycle

attributes.name: mutual_aid_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the dispatched crew is a mutual aid crew provided by another utility or contractor under a mutual assistance agreement. Used for storm cost tracking, mutual aid settlement, and NERC EOP-011 compliance reporting.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-011 — Mutual Assistance; Edison Electric Institute (EEI) Mutual Aid Guidelines

attributes.name: oms_incident_number
attributes.description: The incident or trouble call number assigned by the Outage Management System (OMS) that initiated this dispatch. Provides cross-system traceability between the OMS incident record and the dispatch record.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Incident Management

attributes.name: operating_district_code
attributes.description: Internal operating district or division code for the area where the outage occurred. Used for crew assignment routing, regional performance reporting, and SAIDI/SAIFI district-level aggregation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Distribution Operations; State PUC Reporting

attributes.name: safety_clearance_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety clearance or hold tag issued to the crew before commencing energized work. Required for OSHA lockout/tagout compliance and NERC CIP physical security documentation.
attributes.references: OSHA 1910.269 — Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution; NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the utility service territory or operating district in which the outage site is located. Used for regulatory reporting to State Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) and for regional resource allocation.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Regulations; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: site_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the outage site to which the crew is dispatched. Sourced from GIS or OMS outage location data for field navigation and spatial analytics.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Geospatial; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: site_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate (decimal degrees, WGS84) of the outage site to which the crew is dispatched. Sourced from GIS or OMS outage location data for field navigation and spatial analytics.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Geospatial; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dispatch is associated with a declared storm or major event. When true, the dispatch may be excluded from standard SAIDI/SAIFI calculations per IEEE 1366 major event day (MED) exclusion criteria.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED) Exclusion; State PUC Storm Reporting; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: switching_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the switching order issued to the crew for safe isolation and restoration of the affected circuit segment. Links to the switching order management workflow in the ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Switching Order Management; NERC FAC-002; OSHA 1910.269 Lockout/Tagout

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the crew dispatch record. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GE PowerOn ADMS — Audit Trail

attributes.name: vehicle_identifier
attributes.description: Operational identifier for the assigned vehicle (e.g., fleet unit number, license plate, or radio unit ID) as used by dispatchers for field tracking and resource management.

attributes.name: vehicle_number
attributes.description: Reference to the vehicle assigned to this dispatch from the fleet management system. Links to the asset management domain vehicle master record.

attributes.name: work_completed_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the crew completed all assigned repair or restoration work at the outage site and confirmed task closure in the OMS. Used for SAIDI/CAIDI calculation and restoration performance reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Restoration Lifecycle; IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the associated work order in the asset management or ERP system (Ventyx Asset Suite or SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance) that governs the repair or restoration task assigned to this crew.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance

attributes.name: work_start_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the crew began active repair or restoration work at the outage site. Distinct from arrival time — accounts for safety setup, hazard assessment, and switching order receipt before work commences.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Work Lifecycle; OSHA 1910.269; NERC FAC-002

products.name: restoration_action
products.description: Discrete restoration action taken during an outage event to restore power to a portion of affected customers, covering both manual and automated (FLISR) restoration. Records action type (isolation, sectionalizing, temporary bypass, permanent repair, load transfer, automated FLISR), execution mode (manual crew action vs automated grid self-healing), affected segment, customers restored by this action, action timestamp, crew performing the action (if manual), partial vs. full restoration flag, FLISR-specific attributes (fault detection timestamp, faulted segment, isolation actions taken automatically, load transfer actions, FLISR algorithm version, success/failure outcome, customers restored automatically vs requiring manual intervention). Enables step-by-step restoration tracking, ETR refinement, and FLISR performance analytics.
products.reference: Restoration Action (GE PowerOn ADMS OMS)

attributes.name: restoration_action_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each discrete restoration action record within the outage management system. Primary key for the restoration_action data product.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management System (OMS) Action Record

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Restoration actions change load/generation balance within control areas, requiring AGC adjustments and interchange schedule updates. Essential for coordinating distribution restoration with transmissi

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Restoration work costs (switching operations, load transfers, FLISR actions) are charged to cost centers for O&M expense allocation and variance analysis against distribution operations budgets. Stand

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field crew assigned to execute this restoration action. Populated only for manual crew-dispatched actions; null for fully automated FLISR actions.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Crew Dispatch; Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: FLISR and manual restoration sequences must account for DER presence on segments (anti-islanding protection, voltage regulation impact, fault current contribution). Restoration logic checks DER status

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the substation serving the network segment affected by this restoration action. Used for substation-level outage aggregation and reliability reporting.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event that this restoration action is associated with. Links the discrete action to the broader outage lifecycle managed in the OMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management System (OMS)

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder circuit on which this restoration action was performed, as defined in the GIS and ADMS network model. Used for feeder-level reliability performance tracking.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the switching order that authorized or directed this restoration action, if applicable. Switching orders govern the sequence of switching operations for safe restoration.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Switching Order Management

attributes.name: primary_restoration_network_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution network segment (feeder section, lateral, or zone) affected by this restoration action. Identifies the portion of the grid being isolated, sectionalized, or re-energized.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS — Distribution Management System (DMS)

attributes.name: scada_point_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.scada_point. Business justification: Restoration actions involve SCADA-monitored devices (reclosers, switches). Linking enables real-time status verification, FLISR automation, and coordinated distribution automation with EMS operations.

attributes.name: sectionalizing_device_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the switching device (recloser, sectionalizer, circuit breaker, or fuse) operated to isolate the faulted segment during this action. References the device asset in the GIS or ADMS network model.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Asset Location; GE PowerOn ADMS — ADMS Network Model

attributes.name: action_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the restoration action was confirmed complete and verified by the crew or automated system. Used to calculate action duration and assess restoration efficiency.

attributes.name: action_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed time in minutes from action initiation (action_timestamp) to action completion (action_completed_timestamp). Used in CAIDI calculations and crew performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — CAIDI; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: action_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for operator or crew notes describing the specific conditions, complications, or observations encountered during this restoration action. Supports post-event analysis and lessons-learned documentation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; NERC FAC-002 Post-Event Analysis

attributes.name: action_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable identifier for this restoration action as recorded in the OMS or switching order log (e.g., RA-2024-00451). Used by field crews, control room operators, and regulators to reference specific actions.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Action Reference; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: action_sequence
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this action within the parent outage event's restoration workflow. Enables step-by-step reconstruction of the restoration sequence for post-event analysis and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Power Distribution Reliability Indices; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS

attributes.name: action_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the restoration action. Pending: scheduled but not yet started. In_progress: crew or automation is actively executing. Completed: action successfully finished. Failed: action attempted but unsuccessful. Cancelled: action voided before execution.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Workflow; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: action_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world timestamp when this restoration action was executed or initiated in the field or by the automated system. Used as the primary event time for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculations and restoration timeline analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Power Distribution Reliability Indices; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: action_type
attributes.description: Classification of the type of restoration action performed. Isolation: de-energizes a faulted segment. Sectionalizing: divides a feeder to limit the outage zone. Load transfer: moves load to an alternate feeder. Temporary bypass: restores power via a temporary path. Permanent repair: physical repair restoring normal configuration. FLISR automated: Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) algorithm-driven action.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR; IEEE 1366 — Power Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this restoration action record was first created in the OMS or data platform. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: crew_arrival_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the field crew arrived on-site to begin executing this manual restoration action. Used to calculate crew travel time and on-site restoration duration for workforce performance analytics.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Crew Dispatch; Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management

attributes.name: crew_dispatched_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the field crew was dispatched from the control room or dispatch center to execute this restoration action. Used to measure dispatch-to-arrival interval and overall crew response time.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Crew Dispatch; Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer notification (outage alert, ETR update, or restoration confirmation) was sent to affected customers as a result of this restoration action. Supports compliance with state PUC customer communication requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Customer Management

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer service points that were de-energized or affected by the segment targeted by this action at the time of action execution. Provides context for partial vs. full restoration assessment.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Power Distribution Reliability Indices; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: customers_requiring_manual
attributes.description: Number of customers within the affected segment that could not be restored by FLISR automation and required manual crew dispatch for restoration. Highlights FLISR coverage gaps.

attributes.name: customers_restored_automatically
attributes.description: Number of customers restored through fully automated Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) self-healing actions without manual crew intervention. Key metric for FLISR performance analytics.

attributes.name: customers_restored_count
attributes.description: Number of customer service points restored to power as a direct result of this specific restoration action. Used in SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI index calculations and regulatory reliability reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Power Distribution Reliability Indices; State PUC Reliability Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_time
attributes.description: Estimated Time to Restore (ETR) for the remaining affected customers at the time this action was recorded. Updated as each restoration action is completed to refine the ETR communicated to customers and regulators.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS ETR; State PUC Customer Notification Requirements

attributes.name: execution_mode
attributes.description: Indicates whether the restoration action was executed manually by a field crew or control room operator, fully automated by the FLISR algorithm, or semi-automated (system-initiated but operator-confirmed).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS); IEEE 1366

attributes.name: fault_detected_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the fault triggering this restoration action was first detected by SCADA, FLISR, or field crew. Distinct from action_timestamp; used to calculate fault-to-isolation and fault-to-restoration intervals.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR; OSIsoft PI — SCADA Integration; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: flisr_algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) algorithm that executed this automated restoration action. Enables performance benchmarking across algorithm versions and supports software change management.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: flisr_isolation_actions_taken
attributes.description: Number of automated switching operations performed by the FLISR algorithm to isolate the faulted segment during this restoration action. Supports FLISR performance analytics and switching operation audits.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: flisr_load_transfer_actions_taken
attributes.business_glossary_term: FLISR Load Transfer Actions Taken Count
attributes.description: Number of automated load transfer switching operations performed by the FLISR algorithm to restore power to non-faulted segments during this action. Key metric for FLISR self-healing effectiveness.

attributes.name: flisr_outcome
attributes.description: Outcome of the FLISR automated restoration attempt for this action. Success: FLISR fully restored the affected segment. Partial_success: FLISR restored a portion; manual intervention required for remainder. Failure: FLISR could not restore; full manual restoration required. Not_applicable: action was manual, not FLISR-driven.

attributes.name: is_major_event_day
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restoration action occurred during a Major Event Day (MED) as defined by IEEE 1366 beta method. MED events are typically excluded from standard SAIDI/SAIFI calculations and reported separately to regulators.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED) Beta Method; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: is_partial_restoration
attributes.description: Indicates whether this action resulted in a partial restoration (True) — restoring power to a subset of affected customers — or a full restoration of the affected segment (False). Drives ETR refinement and customer notification logic.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Power Distribution Reliability Indices; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS

attributes.name: is_planned_outage
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restoration action is associated with a planned maintenance outage (True) or an unplanned/forced outage (False). Planned outages are tracked separately for SAIDI/SAIFI reporting and customer notification compliance.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Planned Outage Notification Requirements

attributes.name: load_transfer_source_feeder
attributes.description: Identifier of the source feeder or substation bus from which load is transferred during a load transfer restoration action. Populated when action_type is load_transfer or flisr_automated.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — ADMS Load Transfer; IEEE C37.100

attributes.name: load_transfer_target_feeder
attributes.description: Identifier of the target feeder or substation bus receiving the transferred load during a load transfer restoration action. Used to assess feeder loading and capacity constraints post-transfer.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — ADMS Load Transfer; IEEE C37.100

attributes.name: oms_action_reference
attributes.description: Source system reference key for this restoration action as recorded in the GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management System (OMS). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational OMS.

attributes.name: outage_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized cause code for the fault or outage condition that necessitated this restoration action (e.g., equipment failure, tree contact, animal contact, storm, vehicle accident, planned maintenance). Aligns with IEEE 1366 cause code taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|tree_contact|animal_contact|storm|vehicle_accident|planned_maintenance|unknown|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Power Distribution Reliability Indices; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this restoration action is associated with an outage event that must be reported to a regulatory body (NERC, FERC, State PUC, or DOE). Drives inclusion in regulatory reliability reports and OE-417 emergency incident filings.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004 — Event Reporting; DOE OE-417 Emergency Incident Reporting; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: scada_event_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this restoration action to the corresponding SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) event or alarm in OSIsoft PI historian. Enables correlation between OMS restoration records and real-time grid telemetry.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI — SCADA Integration; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: to_crew
attributes.description: FK to outage.crew_dispatch.crew_dispatch_id — Each restoration action is performed by a dispatched crew. Links action to the crew that executed it for accountability and performance tracking.

attributes.name: to_crew_dispatch
attributes.description: FK to outage.crew_dispatch.crew_dispatch_id — Restoration actions are performed by dispatched crews. This FK links the action to the crew that executed it, enabling crew performance tracking and accountability.

attributes.name: to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — Every restoration action is performed within the context of an outage event. Required for step-by-step restoration tracking and ETR refinement.

attributes.name: transferred_load_mw
attributes.description: Magnitude of electrical load in Megawatts (MW) transferred from the faulted segment to an alternate feeder during a load transfer action. Used for grid capacity analysis and post-event load flow validation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — ADMS; IEEE C37.100; NERC TPL standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this restoration action record was last modified. Tracks updates to status, customer counts, or FLISR outcome fields throughout the restoration lifecycle.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the network segment on which this restoration action was performed (e.g., 4.16, 12.47, 34.5, 69, 115 kV). Used to classify the action within transmission vs. distribution tiers.

attributes.name: weather_condition_code
attributes.description: Weather condition code at the time of the outage event and restoration action. Used for storm-related reliability analysis, SAIDI/SAIFI major event day (MED) exclusion calculations, and regulatory storm reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: normal|wind|ice|lightning|flood|extreme_heat|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED) Exclusion; State PUC Storm Reporting

products.name: cause
products.description: Reference classification of outage cause codes used to categorize the root cause of interruption events. Includes cause category (equipment failure, weather, vegetation, animal contact, human error, third-party damage, unknown), sub-cause code, NERC cause code mapping, PUC reportable flag, and whether the cause qualifies as a Major Event Day (MED) exclusion under IEEE 1366. Drives regulatory reporting and reliability analytics.
products.reference: Outage Cause Code (IEEE 1366 / NERC EOP)

attributes.name: cause_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each outage cause code record in the reference classification table. Primary key. [REFERENCE_LOOKUP role — canonical_skip_reason: This entity is a reference/lookup table of cause codes; per-role minimum categories do not apply.]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Specific outage cause codes trigger different regulatory reporting obligations (e.g., vegetation management failures vs. equipment failures have different NERC reporting rules). Compliance teams map c

attributes.name: asset_class_applicability
attributes.description: Identifies the class(es) of utility assets to which this cause code applies (e.g., 'Overhead Distribution', 'Underground Transmission', 'Substation Equipment', 'Generation Unit'). Supports asset-cause correlation in reliability and asset management analytics.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: cause_category
attributes.description: High-level grouping of the outage cause into standard industry categories. Drives SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI segmentation in reliability analytics and PUC regulatory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|weather|vegetation|animal_contact|human_error|third_party_damage|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: cause_code
attributes.description: Alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the outage cause within the classification system. Used as the business-facing key in OMS, regulatory filings, and reliability reports. Sourced from GE PowerOn ADMS cause code configuration.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the outage cause, including typical failure modes, contributing conditions, and examples. Used for training, documentation, and regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: cause_group
attributes.description: Operational grouping of cause codes for internal reporting and benchmarking purposes (e.g., 'Overhead T&D', 'Underground T&D', 'Substation', 'Generation', 'External'). Supports drill-down analysis in reliability dashboards.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Internal Reliability Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cause_name
attributes.description: Human-readable short name for the outage cause (e.g., 'Tree Contact', 'Equipment Failure - Transformer', 'Animal Contact'). Displayed in OMS dashboards and regulatory reports.

attributes.name: cause_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cause code record. Active codes are available for OMS event classification; deprecated codes are retained for historical reporting only; pending_review codes are under regulatory or operational review.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this cause code record was first created in the data platform. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and change management for the reference classification table.

attributes.name: crew_type_required
attributes.description: Identifies the type of field crew typically required to restore outages of this cause (e.g., 'Line Crew', 'Cable Crew', 'Substation Technician', 'Tree Crew', 'Damage Assessment'). Supports automated crew dispatch recommendations in OMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether outages with this cause trigger mandatory proactive customer notification obligations (e.g., via IVR, SMS, or email). Supports compliance with PUC customer communication requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this cause code is valid and available for use in outage event classification. Supports temporal versioning of the cause code reference table for historical reporting accuracy.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: epa_cause_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage cause has environmental reporting implications under EPA regulations (e.g., spill events, emissions exceedances triggered by unplanned generation outages). Used for environmental compliance tracking.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which this cause code is no longer valid for new outage event classification. Null indicates the code is currently active with no planned expiry. Supports cause code lifecycle management and historical data integrity.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: ieee_1366_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE) 1366 Interruption Category
attributes.description: Classification of the outage cause under IEEE Standard 1366 for electric power distribution reliability indices. Determines how interruptions associated with this cause are counted in SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI calculations.

attributes.name: insurance_claimable
attributes.description: Indicates whether outage events attributed to this cause are eligible for insurance claim submission (e.g., storm damage, third-party damage). Supports financial recovery tracking and CAPEX/OPEX classification.

attributes.name: is_controllable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage cause is considered controllable by the utility (i.e., preventable through operational or maintenance actions). Used in reliability improvement program targeting and PUC performance benchmarking.

attributes.name: is_doe_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether outage events with this cause require submission to the U.S. Department of Energy via the OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report. True = DOE OE-417 filing required.

attributes.name: is_med_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether outage events attributed to this cause qualify for exclusion from SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI baseline calculations as a Major Event Day (MED) under IEEE 1366. True = MED-eligible exclusion; False = included in standard reliability indices.

attributes.name: is_momentary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cause code is associated with momentary interruptions (duration less than 5 minutes per IEEE 1366). Momentary events are tracked separately in MAIFI (Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index) calculations.

attributes.name: is_nerc_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether outage events attributed to this cause trigger mandatory NERC event reporting obligations (e.g., EOP-004 threshold events). True = NERC reporting required; False = not required.

attributes.name: is_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cause code applies to planned (scheduled) outages rather than unplanned interruptions. Planned outages are excluded from SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculations per IEEE 1366. True = planned; False = unplanned.

attributes.name: is_puc_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether outage events with this cause must be reported to the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) under applicable regulatory reporting requirements. True = mandatory PUC notification required; False = not required.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: is_weather_related
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage cause is classified as weather-related. Drives storm response analytics, MED determination, and insurance/force-majeure reporting. Distinct from the cause_category field as some sub-causes may be weather-adjacent.

attributes.name: nerc_cause_category
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Cause Category
attributes.description: NERC-defined top-level cause category label corresponding to the nerc_cause_code. Supports direct mapping to NERC event reporting taxonomy without requiring a separate lookup. Examples: 'Electrical', 'Environmental', 'Human Error', 'Other'.

attributes.name: nerc_cause_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Cause Code
attributes.description: Standardized cause code as defined by NERC for transmission and bulk electric system outage reporting. Required for NERC event reporting (EOP-004) and DOE OE-417 submissions. Maps the internal cause code to the NERC taxonomy.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC Reliability Standards; DOE OE-417

attributes.name: oms_cause_code
attributes.description: The native cause code identifier as configured in the GE PowerOn ADMS/OMS system. Used for direct system integration, data lineage tracing, and reconciliation between the silver layer and the source OMS.

attributes.name: puc_cause_code
attributes.description: The cause code as defined in the applicable state Public Utility Commission (PUC) reporting taxonomy. Required for annual reliability reports and service quality filings. May differ from internal cause_code.

attributes.name: regulatory_reporting_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing specific regulatory reporting instructions, exceptions, or conditions associated with this cause code. Used by compliance teams to document PUC, NERC, or DOE reporting nuances for this cause.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; State PUC Reporting Requirements; DOE OE-417

attributes.name: reliability_index_impact
attributes.description: Identifies which reliability performance indices (SAIDI, SAIFI, CAIDI, MAIFI) are impacted by outage events attributed to this cause. Drives automated index calculation logic in the reliability analytics platform.

attributes.name: saidi_weight_factor
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Weight Factor
attributes.description: Numeric weighting factor applied to SAIDI calculations for outages of this cause type. Allows regulatory-mandated cause-specific weighting adjustments in reliability index computations. Default is 1.0 (no adjustment).

attributes.name: sort_order
attributes.description: Numeric value controlling the display sequence of cause codes in OMS dropdown lists, regulatory report templates, and analytics dashboards. Lower values appear first.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Internal UX Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this cause code was sourced or synchronized (e.g., GE PowerOn ADMS, SAP IS-U). Supports data lineage and reconciliation in the Databricks silver layer.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; SAP IS-U; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: sub_cause_code
attributes.description: Secondary classification code providing finer granularity within a cause category (e.g., within 'equipment_failure': transformer, cable, switch, fuse). Enables detailed root-cause analysis and asset failure trending.

attributes.name: sub_cause_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for the sub-cause code (e.g., 'Overhead Conductor', 'Underground Cable Fault', 'Fuse Operation'). Used in OMS event classification and crew dispatch workflows.

attributes.name: switching_order_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether outages attributed to this cause typically require a formal switching order to be issued before restoration work can begin. Drives workflow automation in OMS switching order management.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC Standards; Internal Safety Procedures

attributes.name: third_party_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether outages attributed to this cause may involve third-party liability (e.g., contractor damage, vehicle contact, excavation damage). Triggers claims management and legal notification workflows.
attributes.references: Internal Claims Management Policy; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: typical_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Historical average or benchmark restoration duration in minutes for outages attributed to this cause. Used for crew dispatch planning, customer estimated restoration time (ERT) communications, and CAIDI benchmarking.

attributes.name: typical_restoration_priority
attributes.description: Default restoration priority level associated with outages of this cause type. Used to pre-populate restoration prioritization workflows in OMS and crew dispatch systems. Overridable at the individual outage event level.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Internal Restoration Prioritization Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this cause code record. Used for incremental data pipeline processing, change detection, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version number tracking revisions to the cause code definition, category mapping, or regulatory alignment. Supports audit trail and change management for the reference classification table.

attributes.name: voltage_level_applicability
attributes.description: Indicates the voltage level(s) at which this cause code is applicable: transmission (>= 115 kV), sub-transmission, distribution (< 35 kV), or all levels. Ensures correct cause code assignment during OMS event classification.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC Reliability Standards; IEEE 1366

products.name: planned_outage_window
products.description: Scheduled planned outage window for maintenance, construction, or upgrade activities requiring deliberate de-energization of network segments. Captures planned start and end times, affected feeder/circuit, work order reference, customer notification requirement, advance notice period, regulatory filing requirement, and actual vs. planned duration variance. Distinct from unplanned outage events — has its own approval and notification workflow.
products.reference: Planned Outage (GE PowerOn ADMS / Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management)

attributes.name: planned_outage_window_id
attributes.description: Primary key for planned_outage_window

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the substation from which the affected feeder or circuit originates. Used for switching coordination, crew dispatch, and geographic impact analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary distribution feeder or circuit segment to be de-energized during the planned outage window. Sourced from the GIS network model (Esri ArcGIS Utility Network) and used for switching order generation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE C37

attributes.name: interconnection_application_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.application. Business justification: Tariff rules require notifying customers with pending interconnection applications of planned outages affecting their POI. Coordination prevents construction conflicts and ensures applicants can sched

attributes.name: oms_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the corresponding event record in the Outage Management System (OMS), such as GE PowerOn ADMS. Provides traceability between the planned outage window record and the operational OMS event for reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.premise. Business justification: Planned maintenance windows often target specific premises for equipment upgrades, service line work, or meter replacements. Utilities must track affected premises for advance customer notification (r

attributes.name: actual_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Actual duration of the de-energization in minutes, recorded upon restoration. Used to compute duration variance against planned_duration_minutes and to feed SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability indices.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: actual_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which the network segment was re-energized and service restored. Used to compute actual outage duration and variance against planned duration for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI performance reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: actual_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Actual date and time at which the network segment was de-energized. Compared against planned_start_timestamp to compute schedule variance for reliability reporting and SAIDI/SAIFI tracking.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: advance_notice_period_hours
attributes.description: Minimum advance notice period in hours required before the planned outage commences, as mandated by state PUC tariff rules or internal SLA policy. Drives the customer notification scheduling workflow.
attributes.references: State PUC tariff rules; NAESB business practices; SAP IS-U notification management

attributes.name: affected_customer_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of customer service points (meters) that will experience interruption during the planned outage window. Used for customer notification prioritization, regulatory reporting, and SAIFI impact assessment.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC reporting requirements; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: alternate_feed_available
attributes.description: Indicates whether an alternate supply path exists to maintain service to some or all affected customers during the planned outage window. Informs restoration strategy and customer notification messaging.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; IEEE C37

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Approval workflow status for the planned outage window, tracking whether the request has been reviewed and authorized by the appropriate operations or grid control authority before execution.
