attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-002; internal outage coordination procedures

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the operations supervisor, grid control authority, or system operator who authorized the planned outage window. Required for audit trail and NERC compliance documentation.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; NERC CIP-010; internal authorization policy

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the planned outage window received formal authorization from the approving authority. Part of the approval audit trail required for NERC and PUC compliance.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; State PUC; internal authorization policy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the planned outage window record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, workflow SLA tracking, and advance notice compliance verification.
attributes.references: SOX internal controls; NERC CIP-010; internal data governance policy

attributes.name: critical_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of critical or life-support customers (medical baseline, hospitals, emergency services) within the affected area. Drives mandatory advance notification requirements and restoration prioritization per PUC rules.
attributes.references: State PUC critical customer rules; NERC CIP-014; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: customer_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether customer advance notification is required for this planned outage window based on PUC tariff rules, affected customer count thresholds, or presence of critical customers.
attributes.references: State PUC tariff rules; NAESB; Oracle CC&B notification management

attributes.name: customer_notification_sent
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required customer advance notification has been dispatched for this planned outage window. Used for compliance tracking and audit trail against PUC notification obligations.
attributes.references: State PUC tariff rules; Oracle CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: duration_variance_minutes
attributes.description: Difference between actual and planned outage duration in minutes (actual_duration_minutes minus planned_duration_minutes). Positive values indicate overrun; negative values indicate early restoration. Key metric for reliability performance reporting.

attributes.name: estimated_load_mw
attributes.description: Estimated peak load in megawatts (MW) that will be interrupted during the planned outage window. Used for grid stability assessment, load transfer planning, and RTO/ISO notification thresholds.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; OSIsoft PI

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or district within the service territory where the planned outage is located (e.g., North District, Urban Core, Rural East). Used for crew dispatch routing and regional reliability reporting.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; internal geographic taxonomy

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the planned outage window record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: SOX internal controls; internal data governance policy; Databricks Delta Lake

attributes.name: load_transfer_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether load transfer switching is required to maintain service to customers via alternate feed paths during the planned outage window. Triggers switching order generation and crew coordination.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR; IEEE C37.96; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel used to deliver the planned outage advance notification to affected customers (e.g., IVR automated call, SMS, email, postal mail, online portal, or field visit for critical customers).
attributes.references: State PUC tariff rules; Oracle CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the customer advance notification was dispatched. Used to verify compliance with the required advance_notice_period_hours and to support PUC audit inquiries.
attributes.references: State PUC tariff rules; Oracle CC&B; SAP IS-U

attributes.name: outage_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized cause code classifying the reason for the planned de-energization (e.g., scheduled maintenance, capital project, vegetation management, equipment replacement). Aligns with IEEE 1366 cause code taxonomy for reliability reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled_maintenance|capital_project|vegetation_management|equipment_replacement|inspection|testing|new_connection — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: outage_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the planned outage window, used in customer notifications, regulatory filings, and OMS records. Format: POW-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: outage_window_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the planned outage window through its approval and execution workflow. Tracks progression from initial draft through approval, active execution, and final completion or cancellation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: outage_window_type
attributes.description: Classification of the planned outage window by the nature of the work activity requiring de-energization. Drives notification requirements, crew dispatch, and regulatory filing obligations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: maintenance|construction|upgrade|inspection|testing|emergency_planned|commissioning|decommissioning — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-002; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: planned_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Planned duration of the de-energization window in minutes, derived from planned start and end timestamps at scheduling time. Stored explicitly for scheduling, crew planning, and customer notification purposes.

attributes.name: planned_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time at which the network segment is planned to be re-energized and service restored. Used to calculate planned outage duration and customer notification windows.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; State PUC notification rules

attributes.name: planned_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Scheduled date and time at which the network segment is planned to be de-energized to begin the maintenance or construction activity. Used for customer advance notification and crew scheduling.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; State PUC notification rules

attributes.name: planned_window_to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — When a planned outage window is executed, it creates an outage event. Links planned scheduling to actual execution for variance tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or docket number of the regulatory filing submitted to the PUC, NERC, or FERC for this planned outage. Populated only when regulatory_filing_required is true.

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this planned outage window requires a formal regulatory filing with the state PUC, NERC, or FERC prior to execution (e.g., for high-voltage transmission outages or outages affecting critical infrastructure).
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; FERC Order 693; State PUC filing requirements

attributes.name: requested_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the employee, crew supervisor, or project manager who submitted the planned outage window request. Used for accountability tracking and workflow routing.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; SAP S/4HANA PM; internal outage coordination procedures

attributes.name: requesting_department
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit or department (e.g., T&D Engineering, Asset Management, Construction) that initiated the planned outage window request. Used for resource allocation and OPEX/CAPEX tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA; Ventyx Asset Suite; internal organizational taxonomy

attributes.name: rto_iso_notification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the planned outage must be reported to the Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) or Independent System Operator (ISO) due to transmission-level impact or market implications under NERC/FERC requirements.

attributes.name: rto_iso_outage_code
attributes.description: Outage coordination identifier assigned by the RTO or ISO (e.g., MISO, PJM, CAISO) when the planned outage is registered in the transmission outage coordination system. Populated only when rto_iso_notification_required is true.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-002; FERC; RTO/ISO outage coordination procedures

attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution (Minutes)
attributes.description: Contribution of this planned outage window to the annual System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) in customer-minutes per customer served. Calculated as (actual_duration_minutes × affected_customer_count) / total_customers_served. Used for IEEE 1366 reliability reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC reliability reporting; NERC

attributes.name: saifi_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Contribution
attributes.description: Contribution of this planned outage window to the annual System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI), calculated as affected_customer_count / total_customers_served. Used for IEEE 1366 reliability performance reporting to PUC.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC reliability reporting; NERC

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulated service territory within which the planned outage window occurs. Used for PUC jurisdictional reporting, rate case filings, and geographic performance analysis.
attributes.references: State PUC CPCN; FERC; internal service territory taxonomy

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this planned outage window is associated with a declared storm or major event, which may qualify for IEEE 1366 major event day (MED) exclusion from SAIDI/SAIFI reliability index calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Major Event Day criteria; State PUC reliability rules

attributes.name: switching_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the switching order issued in the ADMS or OMS to execute the de-energization and re-energization sequence for this planned outage window. Links to the operational switching workflow.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE C37.96; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — Planned maintenance windows result in planned outage events. This FK links the scheduling/approval workflow to the actual outage event record.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the network segment being de-energized. Determines safety protocols, crew qualifications, and regulatory notification thresholds.
attributes.references: IEC 60038; IEEE C57; NERC FAC-002; OSHA 1910.269

attributes.name: work_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the maintenance, construction, or upgrade activity to be performed during the planned outage window. Provides context for crew briefings, customer communications, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; SAP S/4HANA PM; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the associated work order in the asset management or ERP system (e.g., SAP S/4HANA PM or Ventyx Asset Suite) that drives the maintenance, construction, or upgrade activity requiring de-energization.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

products.name: affected_customer
products.description: Association record linking a specific customer service point to an outage event or planned maintenance window, capturing the customer-level impact. Records customer account reference, service point identifier, interruption start and end times, duration, notification sent flag, notification channel, critical care flag (medical baseline, life support), and restoration confirmation. Enables customer-facing outage communication and regulatory customer impact reporting.
products.reference: Outage Customer Impact (Oracle CC&B / SAP IS-U OMS Integration)

attributes.name: affected_customer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the affected customer association record linking a customer service point to an outage or planned maintenance event.

attributes.name: billing_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.billing_service_agreement. Business justification: Affected customer records need service agreement link to determine applicable credit/adjustment rules, verify eligibility for outage compensation programs, and ensure credits are posted to correct bil

attributes.name: compliance_exception_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.exception. Business justification: Critical care customers experiencing outages may trigger compliance exceptions if notification protocols weren't followed per regulatory requirements. Compliance monitors critical customer outages for

attributes.name: customer_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account record in the Customer Information System (CIS). Sourced from SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B customer account master.

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: Tracks DER-owning customers experiencing outages for NEM credit adjustments (energy not exported during outage), performance guarantee calculations, and regulatory reporting (CPUC Rule 21 requires tra

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the substation serving this customer service point at the time of the outage. Used for substation-level reliability performance reporting and asset management correlation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage or planned maintenance event that caused this customer interruption. Links to the outage event record in the Outage Management System (OMS).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; NERC TADS

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder circuit serving this customer service point at the time of the outage. Used for feeder-level reliability analysis and SAIDI/SAIFI segmentation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: When customers are affected by outages, credits are applied to specific invoices; direct link streamlines adjustment posting, enables invoice-level outage credit tracking for regulatory reporting, and

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the meter installed at the affected service point. Used to correlate outage impact with Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) last-gasp signals and meter data.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management

attributes.name: outage_crew_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew dispatch or work order assigned to restore power at this customer service point. Links to the field crew assignment in the OMS or Work Management System.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the switching order or planned maintenance work order that caused this customer interruption. Populated for planned outages; null for unplanned events.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service point (premise delivery point) associated with this customer interruption. Corresponds to the service point or premise identifier in the CIS and GIS.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: trouble_call_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier for the customer trouble call or service request that reported this outage, as recorded in the Customer Information System (CIS) or CRM. Populated when customer_reported_flag is True.
attributes.references: Oracle CC&B; SAP IS-U CIS; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known customer account number as assigned by the Customer Information System (CIS). Used for customer-facing communications and regulatory impact reporting.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle CC&B; PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: advance_notice_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours of advance notice provided to this customer prior to a planned interruption. Used to verify compliance with PUC minimum advance notification requirements for planned outages (typically 48–72 hours).
attributes.references: PUC Planned Outage Notification Rules; State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized cause code classifying the root cause of the outage affecting this customer (e.g., equipment failure, tree contact, animal contact, weather, vehicle accident). Sourced from OMS cause code taxonomy aligned with EEI/NERC reporting categories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|tree_contact|animal_contact|weather|vehicle_accident|scheduled_maintenance|unknown|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC TADS Cause Codes; EEI Reliability Reporting; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this affected customer association record was first created in the system, typically when the outage event was declared and customer impact was identified by the OMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: critical_care_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer at this service point is registered as a critical care or life support customer (e.g., medical baseline, home oxygen, dialysis). Critical care customers receive priority restoration and mandatory advance notification per PUC regulations.
attributes.references: PUC Medical Baseline Rules; CPUC Rule 14; State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: critical_care_type
attributes.description: Specific type of critical care or life support designation for the affected customer. Populated only when critical_care_flag is True. Classified as restricted health information per HIPAA and state PUC medical baseline program rules.
attributes.references: HIPAA; PUC Medical Baseline Program; State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Regulatory and rate classification of the customer affected by the outage. Used for segmented reliability reporting and prioritization of restoration efforts per PUC requirements.
attributes.references: PUC Rate Classification; SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle CC&B

attributes.name: customer_reported_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage was identified through a customer trouble call or self-reported via web/app, as opposed to being detected automatically via AMI last-gasp, SCADA, or OMS prediction. Used for outage detection source analysis.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle CC&B CRM

attributes.name: data_source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational source system from which this affected customer record was ingested into the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and audit purposes.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Architecture

attributes.name: der_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected customer has a registered Distributed Energy Resource (DER) such as rooftop solar, battery storage, or a Net Energy Metering (NEM) arrangement. Relevant for assessing behind-the-meter (BTM) resilience and grid impact during outages.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2222; DERMS Integration; NEM Program Rules

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: The estimated date and time of power restoration communicated to this customer. Corresponds to the Estimated Restoration Time (ERT) published in customer-facing outage communications and OMS crew dispatch workflows.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; PUC Customer Communication Standards

attributes.name: interruption_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the power interruption at this customer service point in minutes, calculated from interruption start to end timestamp. Used directly in SAIDI (System Average Interruption Duration Index) and CAIDI (Customer Average Interruption Duration Index) regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: interruption_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when power supply was restored at this customer service point. Null if restoration has not yet occurred. Used in SAIDI/CAIDI duration calculations.

attributes.name: interruption_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when power supply was interrupted at this customer service point. Used as the principal business event timestamp for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 (Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices); NERC TADS; PUC Reporting

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this affected customer association record was most recently modified, such as when restoration status was updated, notification was sent, or duration was recalculated.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Internal Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: major_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer interruption is associated with a declared Major Event Day (MED) per IEEE 1366 criteria. Major event interruptions are excluded from standard SAIDI/SAIFI calculations and reported separately to regulators.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; PUC Major Event Reporting; NERC TADS

attributes.name: momentary_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this interruption is classified as a momentary interruption (duration under 5 minutes per IEEE 1366 definition). Momentary interruptions are counted in MAIFI (Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index) rather than SAIDI/SAIFI.

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The communication channel used to deliver the outage notification to this customer (e.g., SMS text, email, Interactive Voice Response (IVR) call, mobile app push notification). Supports multi-channel outage communication tracking.
attributes.references: PUC Customer Notification Rules; CRM Communication Standards

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage notification has been sent to this customer for the associated outage event. Used to track compliance with PUC customer notification requirements.
attributes.references: PUC Customer Notification Rules; State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the outage notification was sent to this customer. Used for regulatory compliance reporting on customer notification timeliness.
attributes.references: PUC Customer Notification Rules; State PUC Regulations

attributes.name: oms_customer_ref
attributes.description: External customer reference identifier as recorded in the Outage Management System (OMS), used for cross-system reconciliation between OMS and CIS records.

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage event type affecting this customer. 'unplanned' = unexpected fault-driven interruption, 'planned' = scheduled maintenance window, 'momentary' = interruption under 5 minutes per IEEE 1366, 'major_event' = declared major event excluded from standard reliability indices.

attributes.name: planned_interruption_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The originally scheduled end time of the planned maintenance interruption for this customer service point. Populated only for planned outages. Compared against actual interruption_end_timestamp for schedule adherence reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Ventyx Asset Suite; PUC Planned Outage Notification Rules

attributes.name: planned_interruption_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The originally scheduled start time of the planned maintenance interruption for this customer service point. Populated only for planned outages. Compared against actual interruption_start_timestamp for schedule adherence reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Ventyx Asset Suite; PUC Planned Outage Notification Rules

attributes.name: regulatory_exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Reason code indicating why this customer interruption is excluded from standard IEEE 1366 reliability index calculations. 'major_event' = IEEE 1366 MED exclusion, 'planned' = scheduled maintenance exclusion, 'momentary' = under 5-minute threshold, 'none' = included in standard indices.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC TADS

attributes.name: restoration_confirmation_method
attributes.description: The method by which power restoration was confirmed at this customer service point. 'ami_signal' = AMI meter power-on event, 'crew_verification' = field crew confirmation, 'customer_callback' = customer reported power restored, 'scada' = SCADA system indication.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities MDM; SCADA Integration Standards

attributes.name: restoration_confirmed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether power restoration at this customer service point has been confirmed, either via AMI last-gasp/power-on signal, crew field verification, or customer callback. Distinguishes crew-reported restoration from confirmed restoration.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities MDM AMI Integration; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: restoration_status
attributes.description: Current restoration lifecycle status for this customer service point. 'interrupted' = power out, 'restored' = power confirmed back, 'partial' = partial restoration, 'pending_confirmation' = crew reports restored but not yet confirmed, 'excluded' = excluded from reliability indices per IEEE 1366 major event criteria.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; PUC Reporting

attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution (Minutes)
attributes.description: This customer's individual contribution to the SAIDI reliability index in customer-minutes. Equals the interruption duration in minutes for this customer record. Aggregated across all affected customers to compute system-level SAIDI per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC TADS; PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: saifi_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Contribution
attributes.description: This customer's individual contribution to the SAIFI reliability index (value of 1 per sustained interruption, 0 for momentary). Aggregated across all affected customers to compute system-level SAIFI per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC TADS; PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: service_point_number
attributes.description: The externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the customer service point (premise delivery point) where the interruption occurred. Used in field crew dispatch and restoration confirmation.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulated service territory in which this customer service point is located. Used for jurisdictional reliability reporting to the applicable State Public Utility Commission (PUC).
attributes.references: PUC Service Territory Definitions; SAP IS-U CIS

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this customer interruption occurred during a declared storm or major weather event. Used for storm response performance reporting and potential major event day exclusion analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; PUC Storm Reporting; NERC TADS

products.name: customer_notification
products.description: Record of outage-related notifications sent to customers via IVR, SMS, email, or mobile app. Captures notification type (outage alert, ETR update, restoration confirmation, planned outage advance notice), channel, delivery timestamp, delivery status, customer preference reference, and opt-out flag. Supports regulatory requirements for advance notice of planned outages and tracks communication SLA compliance.
products.reference: Customer Outage Notification (Oracle CC&B / CIS Integration)

attributes.name: customer_notification_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each customer notification record in the outage management system. Primary key for the customer_notification data product.

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer account receiving this notification. Sourced from the Customer Information System (CIS) in SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: customer_preference_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer's communication preference profile that governed channel selection and opt-in/opt-out status at the time this notification was generated. Enables preference-driven communication auditing.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication Standards; TCPA Compliance

attributes.name: etr_revision_id
attributes.description: FK to outage.etr_revision.etr_revision_id — ETR update notifications are triggered by ETR revisions. This FK enables audit trail from revision to customer communication.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage event that triggered this notification. Links the notification to the specific unplanned interruption or planned maintenance window in the Outage Management System (OMS).

attributes.name: message_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the approved message template used to compose this notification. Templates are pre-approved for regulatory compliance and brand consistency. Enables template performance analytics and A/B testing of communication effectiveness.

attributes.name: service_point_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific service delivery point (premise) affected by the outage for which this notification was issued. Enables geographic and network-level analysis of notification coverage.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U Device Management; Oracle CC&B Service Point

attributes.name: acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the customer acknowledged receipt of this notification. Null if no acknowledgment was received. Used for life-support welfare check compliance and two-way communication analytics.
attributes.references: State PUC Life Support Customer Communication Rules

attributes.name: advance_notice_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours of advance notice provided to the customer prior to a planned outage, calculated as the difference between notification sent timestamp and planned outage start timestamp. Used to verify compliance with state PUC minimum advance notice requirements (typically 48–72 hours).
attributes.references: State PUC Planned Outage Advance Notice Requirements

attributes.name: cause_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the outage cause as communicated to the customer in this notification (e.g., 'equipment failure on Main St. feeder', 'storm damage to transmission line'). Supports customer transparency and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication Standards; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: cis_account_number
attributes.description: The customer account number as recorded in the Customer Information System (CIS) — SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B — at the time of notification. Provides a direct cross-reference to the billing and service account for regulatory audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: contact_address
attributes.description: The specific contact address (email address, phone number, or device token) used for this notification delivery attempt, as resolved from the customer's preference profile. Stored for audit and delivery confirmation purposes. Classified as restricted PII.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; TCPA; State PUC Customer Data Privacy Rules

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp when this notification record was first created in the outage management system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory record-keeping requirements.

attributes.name: customer_acknowledgment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer explicitly acknowledged receipt of this notification (e.g., via IVR keypress, SMS reply, or mobile app confirmation). True = acknowledged. Supports two-way communication tracking and life-support customer welfare checks.
attributes.references: State PUC Life Support Customer Communication Rules

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Total number of customers affected by the associated outage event at the time this notification was generated. Included in the notification for context and used in SAIFI (System Average Interruption Frequency Index) reporting.

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when delivery confirmation was received from the channel provider, confirming the notification reached the customer's device, inbox, or IVR endpoint. Null if delivery has not been confirmed or failed.

attributes.name: delivery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the notification delivery attempt. pending: queued for dispatch; sent: transmitted to channel provider; delivered: confirmed receipt by customer device or inbox; failed: delivery attempt unsuccessful; bounced: message returned undeliverable; opted_out: customer has opted out of this channel.
attributes.references: State PUC SLA Compliance Reporting; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: etr_timestamp
attributes.description: The Estimated Time to Restore (ETR) communicated to the customer in this notification. Represents the utility's best estimate of when power will be restored to the affected service point. Critical for customer satisfaction and regulatory ETR accuracy reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC ETR Reporting Requirements; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for notification delivery failure when delivery_status is 'failed' or 'bounced'. Supports channel quality monitoring, contact data hygiene initiatives, and SLA root cause analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: invalid_contact|channel_unavailable|provider_error|customer_opted_out|number_disconnected|mailbox_full|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State PUC SLA Compliance Reporting; NAESB Retail Business Practices

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) of the language in which the notification was composed and delivered. Supports multilingual customer communication compliance requirements mandated by state PUCs in diverse service territories.
attributes.references: State PUC Language Access Requirements; ISO 639-1

attributes.name: last_retry_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent delivery retry attempt for this notification. Null if no retries have been attempted. Used in conjunction with retry_count to assess delivery persistence and channel failure patterns.

attributes.name: life_support_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer is registered as a life support or medical baseline customer at the time of this notification. True = life support customer. Triggers priority notification handling and regulatory reporting obligations under state PUC medical baseline rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline and Life Support Customer Rules; CPUC Rule 14

attributes.name: message_body
attributes.description: Full text content of the notification message as delivered to the customer, including outage details, Estimated Time to Restore (ETR), and restoration instructions. Stored for regulatory audit and dispute resolution.
attributes.references: State PUC Advance Notice Requirements; NAESB Retail Business Practices

attributes.name: message_subject
attributes.description: Subject line or headline of the notification as delivered to the customer. Applicable primarily to email and mobile app push notifications. Stored for audit, regulatory review, and communication effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication Standards; CAN-SPAM Act

attributes.name: notification_batch_number
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch or campaign in which this notification was grouped and dispatched. Multiple customer notifications for the same outage event are typically dispatched in batches. Supports batch-level delivery performance analysis and storm response coordination.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Integration; State PUC Storm Response Reporting

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Communication channel through which the notification was dispatched to the customer. IVR: Interactive Voice Response automated call; SMS: text message; email: electronic mail; mobile_app: push notification via utility mobile application; web_portal: in-portal alert; postal_mail: physical letter for regulatory advance notice.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication Standards; NAESB Retail Business Practices

attributes.name: notification_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable business identifier for this notification record. Used in customer correspondence, regulatory audit trails, and SLA compliance tracking. Format: NTF- followed by 10-digit sequence.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-014; State PUC Advance Notice Requirements

attributes.name: notification_priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this notification, governing dispatch queue order and retry escalation logic. Critical priority is used for life-support customers and medical baseline accounts. Supports regulatory requirements for prioritized restoration communication.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline and Life Support Customer Rules

attributes.name: notification_to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — Customer notifications are triggered by outage events (alerts, ETR updates, restoration confirmations). Must link to the event for communication audit trail.

attributes.name: notification_type
attributes.description: Classification of the notification purpose. outage_alert: initial unplanned outage alert; etr_update: Estimated Time to Restore (ETR) revision; restoration_confirmation: power restored confirmation; planned_outage_notice: advance notice of scheduled maintenance; safety_alert: safety-related communication; demand_response_event: Demand Response (DR) program event notice.
attributes.references: State PUC Advance Notice Requirements; NAESB Business Practices

attributes.name: oms_notification_ref
attributes.description: External reference identifier assigned by the Outage Management System (OMS), specifically GE PowerOn ADMS, to this notification record. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational OMS source system.

attributes.name: opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer had opted out of this notification channel or notification type at the time of dispatch. True = customer opted out; notification may have been suppressed or sent via alternate channel per preference rules. Critical for TCPA and state PUC opt-out compliance.
attributes.references: TCPA (Telephone Consumer Protection Act); State PUC Opt-Out Rules; GDPR Article 21

attributes.name: outage_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the outage event start as communicated to the customer in this notification. Provides the customer with context on when the interruption began. Used in SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations.

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage event type associated with this notification. Distinguishes between unplanned interruptions, scheduled maintenance windows, storm-related events, equipment failures, and transmission faults. Supports SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric segmentation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Reliability Indices; NERC TPL Standards

attributes.name: planned_outage_end_timestamp
attributes.description: For planned maintenance outage notifications, the scheduled end time of the planned interruption communicated to the customer. Null for unplanned outage notifications. Supports advance notice compliance and customer impact duration communication.
attributes.references: State PUC Planned Outage Advance Notice Requirements

attributes.name: planned_outage_start_timestamp
attributes.description: For planned maintenance outage notifications, the scheduled start time of the planned interruption communicated to the customer. Null for unplanned outage notifications. Supports advance notice compliance tracking required by state PUCs.
attributes.references: State PUC Planned Outage Advance Notice Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_notice_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this notification fulfills a specific regulatory advance notice obligation (e.g., state PUC-mandated 48-hour advance notice for planned outages). True = this notification is a regulatory compliance notice. Supports regulatory reporting and audit evidence.
attributes.references: State PUC Planned Outage Advance Notice Requirements; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: retry_count
attributes.description: Number of delivery retry attempts made for this notification after an initial failure. Used to track delivery persistence, diagnose channel reliability issues, and support SLA compliance reporting.

attributes.name: sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The principal real-world event timestamp when the notification was dispatched from the utility's outage communication platform to the delivery channel provider. Used as the primary business event time for SLA measurement and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Advance Notice Requirements; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: sla_met_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this notification was dispatched within the required Service Level Agreement (SLA) target time. True = SLA met; False = SLA breached. Supports regulatory SLA compliance reporting to state PUCs and internal performance dashboards.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication SLA Requirements

attributes.name: sla_target_minutes
attributes.description: The Service Level Agreement (SLA) target time in minutes within which this notification type must be dispatched following the triggering outage event. Defined by state PUC regulations and internal communication standards. Used as the benchmark for SLA compliance measurement.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Communication SLA Requirements

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this notification record. Primarily GE PowerOn ADMS for OMS-driven notifications, but may include SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B for billing-related outage notices, or manual OMS entries during storm response.
attributes.references: Enterprise Data Lineage Standards; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the utility's service territory or operating division within which the affected customer and service point are located. Supports territory-level SLA compliance reporting to individual state PUCs and regional storm response performance analysis.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Definitions; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — Notifications are sent in the context of an outage event or planned outage. Required for communication SLA compliance tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp of the most recent modification to this notification record, such as a delivery status update or retry attempt. Supports change tracking and SLA audit.

products.name: event_status_history
products.description: Lifecycle status history of an outage event, capturing each state transition from initial report through investigation, crew dispatch, partial restoration, and full restoration. Records status code, transition timestamp, triggering actor (dispatcher, system, crew), and status notes. Enables full audit trail of outage event progression and supports OMS workflow state machine.
products.reference: OMS Event Status History (GE PowerOn ADMS)

attributes.name: event_status_history_id
attributes.description: Primary key for event_status_history

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the field crew associated with this status transition, particularly relevant for CREW_DISPATCHED and PARTIAL_RESTORE transitions. Links to the crew or work order management record in Ventyx Asset Suite or SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; SAP S/4HANA PM

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: System identifier of the specific dispatcher, crew member, or automated system process that triggered this status transition. References the workforce or system actor record. Used for accountability auditing and OMS workflow traceability.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; NERC CIP-007; SAP S/4HANA HR/HCM

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event whose lifecycle this status record belongs to. Links each status transition to the originating outage event in the OMS. Serves as the EVENT_SOURCE_REFERENCE for this event log entity.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; IEEE 1366 Outage Event Tracking

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the switching order executed as part of this status transition, applicable when the OMS issues switching instructions to isolate faults or restore service segments. Links to the switching order record in GE PowerOn ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Switching Management; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work order created or updated in conjunction with this status transition. Links the outage event status history to the maintenance and restoration work order in Ventyx Asset Suite or SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance for integrated O&M tracking.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP S/4HANA PM; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: actual_restoration_time
attributes.description: The actual date and time at which service was fully restored, populated only when status_code transitions to RESTORED. Used as the definitive restoration timestamp for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculations and regulatory outage duration reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Power Systems Reliability; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Outage Reporting

attributes.name: affected_customer_count
attributes.description: Number of customers without power at the time of this status transition. Updated at each transition to reflect partial restorations. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculations, customer notification prioritization, and regulatory outage reporting to State PUCs and NERC.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Power Systems Reliability; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Outage Reporting

attributes.name: cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized cause classification code assigned or updated at this status transition point, following IEEE 1366 or utility-specific cause code taxonomy. May be refined as investigation progresses (e.g., initially UNKNOWN, later updated to EQUIPMENT_FAILURE or TREE_CONTACT). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: UNKNOWN|EQUIPMENT_FAILURE|TREE_CONTACT|ANIMAL_CONTACT|WEATHER|VEHICLE_ACCIDENT|SCHEDULED_MAINTENANCE|OVERLOAD|THIRD_PARTY — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Power Systems Reliability; State PUC Outage Reporting; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this status history record was first created in the Silver layer data product. Distinct from transition_timestamp (the business event time). Used for data lineage, audit trail, and Silver layer ingestion monitoring. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer; SOX Internal Controls; NERC CIP-007 Audit Logging

attributes.name: critical_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether one or more critical facilities (hospitals, emergency services, water treatment plants, NERC CIP-designated assets) are among the affected customers at this status transition. Triggers escalation protocols and mandatory regulatory notification timelines.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-014; State PUC Critical Facility Standards; FERC Order 754

attributes.name: ert_confidence_level
attributes.description: Dispatcher or system assessment of the confidence level in the estimated_restoration_time at this transition. Supports customer communication tiering (e.g., only publish ERT to customers when confidence is HIGH or MEDIUM) and ERT accuracy analytics.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Notification; State PUC Service Standards

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_time
attributes.description: The estimated date and time by which full service restoration is expected, as assessed at the time of this status transition. ERT may be revised at each transition as field conditions evolve. Used for customer notifications, dispatcher planning, and regulatory ERT accuracy reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Notification; State PUC Service Standards

attributes.name: flisr_activated_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) Activated Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the GE PowerOn ADMS Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration (FLISR) automation was activated during this status transition. FLISR activations represent automated restoration actions and are tracked separately for reliability performance and automation benefit reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR; IEEE 1366; State PUC Automation Reporting

attributes.name: major_event_day_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition occurred during a declared IEEE 1366 Major Event Day (MED), where system-wide outage levels exceed the 2.5 beta threshold. MED-flagged records are excluded from normalized SAIDI/SAIFI regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Power Systems Reliability; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: The primary communication channel used to notify affected customers of this status transition. Populated when notification_sent_flag is True. Supports multi-channel notification analytics and State PUC communication compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Notification; State PUC Customer Communication Standards

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a customer notification (SMS, IVR, email, or app push) was dispatched to affected customers as a result of this status transition. Supports notification compliance tracking and customer communication audit trails per State PUC notification requirements.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Notification; State PUC Customer Communication Standards

attributes.name: oms_event_number
attributes.description: The externally-known OMS event reference number assigned by GE PowerOn ADMS at the time of outage event creation. Carried on each status history record to enable direct cross-reference with OMS reports, dispatcher logs, and regulatory filings without requiring a join to the parent event table.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; NERC CIP-014; State PUC Outage Reporting

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Elapsed duration in minutes from the initial outage report timestamp to this status transition timestamp. Provides a running duration metric at each lifecycle stage without requiring a join to the parent event. Used for real-time SAIDI contribution monitoring and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Power Systems Reliability; State PUC Outage Reporting; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage event type at the time of this status record. Distinguishes unplanned interruptions (equipment failure, fault), planned maintenance windows, storm-related events, and emergency outages. Denormalized from the parent event for efficient status history reporting and SAIDI/SAIFI segmentation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Power Systems Reliability; State PUC Reporting; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: previous_status_code
attributes.description: The OMS workflow state code that was active immediately before this transition occurred. Enables reconstruction of the full state machine path and supports regression analysis of outage event progressions. Null for the initial status record. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: same set as status_code — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Workflow; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Restoration priority classification assigned at this status transition, reflecting the urgency of restoration based on affected customer types (e.g., hospitals, critical infrastructure), customer count, and storm response protocols. Drives crew dispatch sequencing and resource allocation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; State PUC Critical Facility Standards; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this status transition triggers a mandatory regulatory notification obligation to NERC, FERC, State PUC, or other governing bodies based on outage severity thresholds (e.g., NERC EOP-004 event reporting, State PUC major outage notification). Drives compliance workflow automation.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004 Event Reporting; FERC Order 754; State PUC Outage Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the required regulatory notification has been submitted to the applicable governing body (NERC, FERC, State PUC) as of this status transition. Supports compliance audit trails and ensures no mandatory notifications are missed.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; FERC Order 754; State PUC Outage Reporting; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: restored_customer_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of customers whose service has been restored as of this status transition. Enables tracking of partial restoration progress and supports incremental SAIDI/SAIFI credit calculations. Particularly relevant for PARTIAL_RESTORE status transitions.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Power Systems Reliability; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Outage Reporting

attributes.name: scada_alarm_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Alarm Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier of the SCADA alarm or event in OSIsoft PI or GE PowerOn ADMS that triggered or is associated with this status transition. Enables cross-system traceability between the OMS event lifecycle and real-time SCADA/EMS alarm data.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI SCADA Integration; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record that originated this status transition record. Primarily GE PowerOn ADMS for automated OMS transitions, but may include SAP IS-U, Oracle CC&B, or MANUAL for dispatcher-entered records. Supports data lineage and Silver layer reconciliation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; SAP IS-U; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: source_system_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier assigned by the source system (e.g., GE PowerOn ADMS internal status log ID) for this status transition. Enables bidirectional traceability between the Silver layer and the operational system of record for reconciliation and audit purposes.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Lineage

attributes.name: status_code
attributes.description: Standardized OMS workflow state code representing the current lifecycle stage of the outage event at the time of this transition. Drives the OMS state machine and is used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI milestone tracking. Serves as the EVENT_TYPE_OR_CHANNEL discriminator for this event log. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: REPORTED|INVESTIGATING|CREW_DISPATCHED|PARTIAL_RESTORE|RESTORED|CANCELLED|ON_HOLD|ESCALATED|PENDING_VERIFICATION — promote to reference product if additional states are required]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Workflow; IEEE 1366; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: status_description
attributes.description: Human-readable label or narrative description corresponding to the status_code at the time of this transition. Provides dispatcher-facing context for the OMS workflow state and supports customer notification messaging. Serves as the EVENT_PAYLOAD_OR_VALUE for this event log.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Oracle Utilities CC&B Customer Notification

attributes.name: status_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the dispatcher, crew, or system at the time of this status transition. Captures contextual information such as field conditions, equipment findings, partial restoration scope, or escalation reasons. Supports OMS audit trail and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: storm_event_flag

attributes.name: customer_notification_issued

attributes.name: declared_end_time

attributes.name: eoc_activation_time

attributes.name: external_crews_deployed

attributes.name: fema_disaster_declaration_number

attributes.name: is_mutual_aid_requested

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: med_threshold_saidi

attributes.name: meteorological_start_time

attributes.name: mutual_aid_coordinator

attributes.name: responding_utility_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the utility that is committing resources in response to the mutual aid request. Identifies the aid-providing party.

attributes.name: responding_utility_nerc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Responding Utility NERC (North American Electric Reliability Corporation) ID
attributes.description: NERC-assigned registered entity identifier for the responding (aid-providing) utility, used for regulatory reporting and inter-utility coordination.

attributes.name: service_territory_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code for the primary service territory where restoration work will be performed. Used for jurisdictional compliance, state PUC reporting, and logistics planning.
attributes.references: State PUC regulatory reporting; NERC EOP-005-3

attributes.name: staging_location
attributes.description: Name or address of the staging area designated for incoming mutual aid crews within the requesting utility's service territory. Used for logistics coordination and crew check-in management.
attributes.references: ESOP staging and logistics procedures; EEI Mutual Assistance Program

products.name: reliability_index_period
products.description: Periodic reliability performance record capturing computed SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI index values for a defined reporting period (monthly, quarterly, annual) at a given reporting level (system, circuit, substation, PUC territory). Stores total customer minutes interrupted, total interruptions, customers served, MED-excluded values, and IEEE 1366 normalized values. This is the authoritative operational record — NOT an analytics aggregate — used for PUC regulatory filings and NERC reliability reporting.
products.reference: SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI Reporting (IEEE 1366 / PUC Annual Reliability Report)

attributes.name: reliability_index_period_id
attributes.description: Primary key for reliability_index_period

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting is mandated by specific PUC obligations with defined performance thresholds and filing deadlines. Regulatory affairs maps each reporting period to the governing obligation

attributes.name: amendment_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason for amending or recomputing this reliability index period record (e.g., data correction from OMS, reclassification of MED events, customer count correction). Required for version_number greater than 1. Supports regulatory audit trail and PUC amendment filing documentation.
attributes.references: State PUC Amendment Reporting Requirements; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Identifier or name of the authorized utility employee (typically a Reliability Engineer or Director of Grid Operations) who approved this reliability index period record for regulatory filing. Supports SOX internal control documentation and regulatory audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302 and 906 (Management Certification); State PUC Audit Requirements; NERC Compliance

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability index period record was formally approved for regulatory filing. Supports SOX internal control audit trails and regulatory submission documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; State PUC Audit Requirements; NERC Compliance Documentation

attributes.name: caidi_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Average Interruption Duration Index (CAIDI) in Minutes
attributes.description: Customer Average Interruption Duration Index expressed in minutes per interruption. Computed as total_customer_minutes_interrupted divided by total_customer_interruptions (equivalently, SAIDI divided by SAIFI). Represents the average duration of each interruption experienced by affected customers. Used to assess restoration performance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.3; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: caidi_normalized_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: IEEE 1366 Normalized CAIDI (Excluding Major Event Days) in Minutes
attributes.description: CAIDI value computed after excluding Major Event Day (MED) interruptions per IEEE 1366 normalization methodology. Derived from normalized SAIDI and SAIFI values. Used for PUC performance standard compliance and restoration performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Performance Standards

attributes.name: computation_method
attributes.description: Identifies the specific computational methodology applied to derive the reliability indices in this record. IEEE_1366_STANDARD applies the full IEEE 1366 methodology including MEDs; IEEE_1366_MED_EXCLUDED applies the normalized MED-excluded methodology; PUC_CUSTOM applies a state-specific PUC-mandated variation; NERC_BENCHMARK applies NERC benchmarking methodology.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability index period record was first created in the system. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and SOX internal control requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: customers_served
attributes.description: Total number of customers served within the reporting entity boundary during the reporting period. This is the denominator used in SAIDI and SAIFI index calculations per IEEE 1366. Typically represents the average or end-of-period customer count as defined by the applicable PUC methodology.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.1; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: equipment_failure_outage_events
attributes.description: Number of outage events during the reporting period caused by equipment failure (excluding storm and third-party causes). Supports asset reliability analysis, maintenance planning, and capital investment justification for aging infrastructure programs.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: filed_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which this reliability index period record was submitted to the applicable regulatory authority. Null if not yet filed. Used to verify on-time filing compliance and support regulatory audit trails.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards EOP-004; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: filing_due_date
attributes.description: Deadline date by which this reliability index period record must be submitted to the applicable regulatory authority (PUC or NERC). Used to track filing compliance and trigger workflow notifications. Determined by PUC tariff or NERC standard reporting schedule.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards EOP-004; FERC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reliability index period record in the regulatory submission workflow. DRAFT indicates preliminary computation; UNDER_REVIEW indicates internal QA; APPROVED indicates sign-off for submission; FILED indicates submission to PUC or NERC; AMENDED indicates a corrected re-submission; SUPERSEDED indicates replaced by a newer version.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards EOP-004; SOX Internal Controls

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reliability index period record was most recently modified. Tracks amendments, recomputations, and corrections to the reliability indices. Supports audit trail and regulatory amendment documentation.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; State PUC Amendment Reporting Requirements; IEEE Std 1366-2012

attributes.name: maifi_index
attributes.description: Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index computed as total momentary customer interruptions divided by customers served. Measures the frequency of brief power interruptions (five minutes or less) per customer. Increasingly required by PUCs as a power quality metric alongside SAIDI and SAIFI.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.5; State PUC Power Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: med_event_count
attributes.description: Number of calendar days during the reporting period that qualified as Major Event Days (MEDs) per the IEEE 1366 beta + 2.5 sigma threshold methodology. Used to assess storm and extreme weather impact on reliability performance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: med_excluded_customer_interruptions
attributes.business_glossary_term: Major Event Day (MED) Excluded Customer Interruptions
attributes.description: Total customer interruptions attributable to Major Event Days (MEDs) that are excluded from the normalized IEEE 1366 index calculations. MEDs are days where the daily SAIDI exceeds a statistically derived threshold (beta + 2.5 sigma). Tracking this separately enables both total and MED-excluded reporting as required by most PUCs.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4 (Major Event Day definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: med_excluded_customer_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Major Event Day (MED) Excluded Customer Minutes Interrupted
attributes.description: Total customer minutes interrupted attributable to Major Event Days (MEDs) that are excluded from the normalized IEEE 1366 index calculations. Used to compute MED-normalized SAIDI and SAIFI values required for PUC regulatory filings and NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: med_threshold_saidi_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: Major Event Day (MED) SAIDI Threshold in Minutes
attributes.description: The computed daily SAIDI threshold (beta + 2.5 sigma) used to classify a calendar day as a Major Event Day for this reporting period. Derived from the five-year historical daily SAIDI distribution per IEEE 1366 methodology. Documents the MED classification boundary applied to this period.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: momentary_interruption_count
attributes.description: Total number of momentary interruptions (duration five minutes or less per IEEE 1366 definition) experienced by customers during the reporting period. Used to compute MAIFI (Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index) and assess power quality performance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.5 (MAIFI definition); State PUC Power Quality Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: nerc_registered_entity_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Registered Entity ID
attributes.description: NERC Compliance Registry identifier for the utility entity responsible for this reliability report. Required for NERC reliability standard compliance submissions and benchmarking participation. Aligns with the NERC Transmission Planner, Distribution Provider, or Load-Serving Entity registration.
attributes.references: NERC Compliance Registry; NERC Reliability Standards EOP-004; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: oms_source_system_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outage Management System (OMS) Source System Code
attributes.description: Identifier of the Outage Management System (OMS) instance from which the underlying outage event data was sourced for this reliability index computation. Supports data lineage tracing back to GE PowerOn ADMS or equivalent OMS. Critical for audit and regulatory filing validation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Integration; SOX Data Lineage Requirements; State PUC Audit Requirements

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: Calendar date marking the inclusive end of the reliability reporting period. Combined with period_start_date to define the exact window over which SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI indices are computed.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Calendar date marking the inclusive start of the reliability reporting period. Combined with period_end_date to define the exact window over which SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI indices are computed.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; FERC Form 1; State PUC Annual Reliability Report

attributes.name: period_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reporting period granularity. Determines the aggregation window for SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI index calculations. MONTHLY is used for operational monitoring; QUARTERLY and ANNUAL are used for PUC regulatory filings; ROLLING_12_MONTH is used for NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4; NERC Reliability Standards EOP-004; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: planned_interruption_customer_minutes
attributes.description: Customer minutes interrupted attributable to planned (scheduled maintenance) outage events during the reporting period. Some PUC jurisdictions require separate reporting of planned vs. unplanned interruptions. Enables decomposition of total CMI into planned and unplanned components.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 3.2 (planned interruption definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: prior_period_saidi_minutes
attributes.description: SAIDI value from the immediately preceding equivalent reporting period (e.g., prior month, prior quarter, prior year) for the same reporting entity. Stored on the record to support period-over-period variance analysis in regulatory filings without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Annual Reliability Report; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: prior_period_saifi_index
attributes.description: SAIFI value from the immediately preceding equivalent reporting period for the same reporting entity. Stored on the record to support period-over-period variance analysis in regulatory filings without requiring a self-join.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Annual Reliability Report; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: puc_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: Two-letter state code plus PUC suffix identifying the state Public Utility Commission jurisdiction under which this reliability index period record is filed (e.g., CA-PUC, NY-PUC, TX-PUC). Determines applicable performance standards, reporting formats, and filing deadlines.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission Regulations; NERC Compliance Registry; FERC Jurisdictional Boundaries

attributes.name: puc_saidi_performance_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) SAIDI Performance Target in Minutes
attributes.description: Regulatory SAIDI performance target (in minutes) established by the applicable state PUC for the reporting period and reporting entity. Used to assess compliance with performance-based rate mechanisms and potential penalty or incentive triggers. Null if no PUC target applies to this reporting level.
attributes.references: State PUC Performance-Based Ratemaking Orders; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: puc_saifi_performance_target
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) SAIFI Performance Target
attributes.description: Regulatory SAIFI performance target established by the applicable state PUC for the reporting period and reporting entity. Used to assess compliance with performance-based rate mechanisms and potential penalty or incentive triggers. Null if no PUC target applies to this reporting level.
attributes.references: State PUC Performance-Based Ratemaking Orders; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: puc_target_met
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) Performance Target Met Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the utility met all applicable PUC reliability performance targets (SAIDI and SAIFI) for this reporting period and reporting entity. True if all applicable targets were met; False if one or more targets were missed. Null if no PUC targets apply. Drives performance-based rate adjustment calculations.
attributes.references: State PUC Performance-Based Ratemaking Orders; State PUC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: reporting_entity_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the specific entity (circuit ID, substation code, PUC territory code, operating area code, or system-level identifier) at which the reliability indices are reported. Corresponds to the reporting_level classification. For SYSTEM level, this is the utility NERC registered entity identifier.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; NERC Compliance Registry; State PUC Service Territory Definitions

attributes.name: reporting_entity_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the reporting entity (e.g., circuit name, substation name, PUC territory name, operating area name). Used for display in regulatory filings and reliability performance dashboards.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: reporting_level
attributes.description: Organizational or geographic granularity at which the reliability indices are computed and reported. SYSTEM represents the full utility service territory; CIRCUIT and SUBSTATION represent distribution-level granularity; PUC_TERRITORY aligns with regulatory jurisdiction boundaries; OPERATING_AREA represents internal operational divisions.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 5; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: reporting_period_code
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the reporting period, encoding the period type and calendar reference (e.g., MONTHLY-2024-03, QUARTERLY-2024-Q1, ANNUAL-2024). Used as the primary business key for regulatory filings and cross-system reconciliation.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: saidi_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) in Minutes
attributes.description: System Average Interruption Duration Index expressed in minutes per customer. Computed as total_customer_minutes_interrupted divided by customers_served. Represents the average total duration of interruptions experienced per customer during the reporting period. Primary reliability metric for PUC regulatory filings and NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.1; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements
