attributes.name: saidi_normalized_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: IEEE 1366 Normalized SAIDI (Excluding Major Event Days) in Minutes
attributes.description: SAIDI value computed after excluding Major Event Day (MED) interruptions per IEEE 1366 normalization methodology. Computed as (total_customer_minutes_interrupted minus med_excluded_customer_minutes) divided by customers_served. This is the primary metric used for year-over-year performance benchmarking and PUC performance standard compliance.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Performance Standards; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: saifi_index
attributes.description: System Average Interruption Frequency Index expressed as interruptions per customer. Computed as total_customer_interruptions divided by customers_served. Represents the average number of interruptions experienced per customer during the reporting period. Key reliability metric for PUC regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.2; NERC Reliability Standards; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: saifi_normalized_index
attributes.business_glossary_term: IEEE 1366 Normalized SAIFI (Excluding Major Event Days)
attributes.description: SAIFI value computed after excluding Major Event Day (MED) interruptions per IEEE 1366 normalization methodology. Computed as (total_customer_interruptions minus med_excluded_customer_interruptions) divided by customers_served. Used for PUC performance standard compliance and NERC benchmarking.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Performance Standards; NERC Reliability Benchmarking

attributes.name: storm_related_outage_events
attributes.description: Number of outage events during the reporting period that were classified as storm-related (weather-caused). Supports storm impact analysis, MED classification validation, and regulatory storm reporting requirements. Sourced from OMS event cause codes.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.4; State PUC Storm Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: third_party_outage_events
attributes.description: Number of outage events during the reporting period caused by third parties (e.g., vehicle accidents, dig-ins, animal contacts, vegetation encroachment by non-utility parties). Some PUC jurisdictions allow exclusion of third-party caused outages from performance standard calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: total_customer_interruptions
attributes.description: Total number of customer interruptions (sum of customers affected across all outage events) during the reporting period. This is the numerator for SAIFI calculation. Each customer affected by each distinct outage event counts as one interruption.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.2 (SAIFI definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: total_customer_minutes_interrupted
attributes.description: Sum of the product of customers affected multiplied by outage duration in minutes across all outage events in the reporting period. This is the numerator for SAIDI calculation, expressed in customer-minutes. Also referred to as Customer Minutes of Interruption (CMI) in regulatory filings.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 4.1 (SAIDI definition); State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: total_outage_events
attributes.description: Total number of distinct outage events (interruption incidents) that occurred within the reporting entity boundary during the reporting period. Provides context for interpreting SAIDI and SAIFI values and supports frequency-based reliability analysis.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Event Records; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: unplanned_interruption_customer_minutes
attributes.description: Customer minutes interrupted attributable to unplanned (forced/fault) outage events during the reporting period. Unplanned interruptions are the primary driver of reliability index degradation and are the focus of most PUC performance standards.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366-2012 Section 3.2; State PUC Performance Standards; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number incremented each time this reliability index period record is amended or recomputed. Version 1 represents the initial filing; subsequent versions represent amendments. Supports regulatory amendment tracking and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Amendment Reporting Requirements; SOX Internal Controls; IEEE Std 1366-2012

products.name: prediction
products.description: Operational record of a system-generated or dispatcher-created predicted outage scope at the time of initial event creation, capturing estimated number of affected customers, predicted cause, predicted affected circuit segments, confidence level, and prediction source (AMI ping, SCADA alarm, customer call clustering, predictive model). Distinct from the actual outage event — represents the initial assessment used for crew pre-positioning and ETR communication before field confirmation.
products.reference: Predicted Outage (GE PowerOn ADMS Predictive Outage)

attributes.name: prediction_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the outage prediction record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module

attributes.name: circuit_feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary distribution circuit predicted to be affected by the outage. Sourced from the GIS network model and used for crew routing and switching order preparation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the substation associated with the predicted outage scope. Used for crew dispatch routing and switching order coordination.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system operator or dispatcher who created or last modified this prediction record when prediction_source is 'dispatcher_manual'. Provides accountability and audit trail for manually-entered predictions.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 — Personnel and Training; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder predicted to be affected. A feeder is a primary distribution line segment fed from a substation bus. Used for network topology analysis and switching order preparation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Predictive outage management systems integrate load forecasts to estimate customer impact (count, MW interrupted) and prioritize response. Advanced OMS platforms reference specific load forecast runs

attributes.name: oms_event_id
attributes.description: Externally-known identifier assigned by the Outage Management System (OMS) to the predicted outage event. Used to correlate this prediction record with the OMS event lifecycle and downstream actual outage records.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: predictive_model_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the predictive analytics model version that generated this prediction, when prediction_source is 'predictive_model'. Enables model performance tracking, auditability, and retraining feedback loops.
attributes.references: DOE Grid Modernization Initiative; GE PowerOn ADMS — Predictive Analytics

attributes.name: scada_alarm_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the SCADA (Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition) alarm that triggered or corroborated this outage prediction. Provides traceability back to the real-time operational data historian (OSIsoft PI) or ADMS alarm log.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI — SCADA Integration; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: service_territory_id
attributes.description: Reference to the regulated service territory within which the predicted outage falls. Used for regulatory reporting to State Public Utility Commissions (PUCs) and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI performance tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Regulations; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storm or major weather event record associated with this prediction, if applicable. Links the prediction to the storm response management workflow for resource mobilization and regulatory major event day (MED) classification.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED) Classification; State PUC Storm Reporting

attributes.name: weather_input_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.weather_input. Business justification: Outage prediction models consume weather forecast inputs (wind speed, precipitation, temperature) to predict storm-related outage likelihood and severity. Utilities use this linkage for storm prepared

attributes.name: ami_meter_count
attributes.description: Number of Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) smart meters within the predicted outage scope that contributed last-gasp or ping-failure signals to the prediction. Indicates the AMI signal density supporting the prediction confidence.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — Meter Reading; AMI/MDM Integration

attributes.name: confidence_level_pct
attributes.description: Numeric confidence score (0.00–100.00) representing the model's or system's certainty in the predicted outage scope, cause, and affected area. Higher values indicate greater confidence. Used to prioritize crew dispatch and ETR communication decisions.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Predictive Analytics; DOE Grid Modernization Initiative

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this outage prediction record was first persisted in the data platform. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: crew_preplacement_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether field crews have been pre-positioned based on this outage prediction prior to field confirmation of the actual outage. When True, crew dispatch records are linked to this prediction in the workforce management system.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management; Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management

attributes.name: critical_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope includes one or more critical customers (e.g., hospitals, emergency services, life-support customers, large industrial accounts with SLA obligations). When True, triggers priority restoration protocols and mandatory customer notification.
attributes.references: State PUC Critical Customer Regulations; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: customer_call_count
attributes.description: Number of inbound customer outage calls received and clustered to generate or corroborate this prediction. Used to assess the customer-reported signal strength and prioritize crew dispatch.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U — CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Customer Management

attributes.name: der_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope includes Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) such as rooftop solar, battery storage, or microgrids that may be islanded or require isolation procedures. When True, DERMS coordination is required.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 — DER Interconnection; FERC Order 2222; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: expiry_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time after which this prediction is considered stale and should no longer be used for crew dispatch or ETR communication without refresh. Typically set to a configurable window (e.g., 2 hours) after prediction_timestamp. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module

attributes.name: flisr_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope is within a network segment eligible for automated Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration (FLISR) execution via the ADMS. When True, automated switching sequences may be initiated without manual dispatcher intervention.

attributes.name: major_event_day_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this prediction is associated with a Major Event Day (MED) as defined by IEEE 1366. MED events are excluded from standard SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI calculations and reported separately to state PUCs and NERC.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day Classification; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC

attributes.name: medical_baseline_customer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the predicted outage scope includes customers enrolled in a medical baseline or life-support program. When True, triggers mandatory proactive notification and priority restoration per state PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline / Life Support Customer Regulations

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage notification has been sent to affected customers based on this prediction. When True, the notification timestamp and channel are tracked in the customer notification log. Supports state PUC notification compliance reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; NAESB Business Practices

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the first customer notification was dispatched based on this outage prediction. Used for state PUC compliance reporting on notification timeliness. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the predicted outage by its nature. 'unplanned' = unexpected equipment or system failure; 'planned' = scheduled maintenance window; 'storm' = weather-driven event; 'momentary' = predicted to be a brief interruption (< 5 minutes per IEEE 1366); 'sustained' = predicted to exceed the momentary threshold.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices

attributes.name: predicted_affected_segments
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of distribution circuit segment identifiers predicted to be de-energized. Sourced from the GIS network model topology analysis. Used for switching order preparation and crew routing.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predicted_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized cause code representing the predicted root cause of the outage at time of initial assessment (e.g., equipment failure, tree contact, animal contact, weather, vehicle accident, unknown). Aligned with IEEE 1366 cause code taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: equipment_failure|tree_contact|animal_contact|weather|vehicle_accident|planned_maintenance|unknown|overload|lightning|ice_loading — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predicted_cause_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the predicted cause of the outage as assessed at the time of prediction creation. Supplements the structured cause code with dispatcher or model-generated context.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module

attributes.name: predicted_customer_count
attributes.description: Estimated number of customers predicted to be without power based on the initial assessment. Used for crew pre-positioning, ETR communication, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI impact estimation. Distinct from the confirmed customer count on the actual outage event record.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: predicted_etr
attributes.description: Initial estimated date and time by which power is predicted to be restored to affected customers. Communicated to customers and field crews at the time of prediction creation. Distinct from the revised ETR updated during active restoration. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predicted_fault_latitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal latitude coordinate of the predicted fault location. Used for GIS-based crew dispatch and outage mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS-84 Coordinate Reference System

attributes.name: predicted_fault_location
attributes.description: Predicted geographic or network location of the fault, expressed as a GIS asset identifier, address, or coordinate reference. Used to direct first-responder crews to the most probable fault point before field confirmation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Outage Analysis; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: predicted_fault_longitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal longitude coordinate of the predicted fault location. Used for GIS-based crew dispatch and outage mapping.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; WGS-84 Coordinate Reference System

attributes.name: predicted_load_mw
attributes.description: Estimated megawatts (MW) of load predicted to be interrupted based on the affected circuit segments and customer mix. Used for grid operations impact assessment and load restoration prioritization.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management; NERC TPL Standards

attributes.name: predicted_outage_duration_min
attributes.description: Estimated duration of the outage in minutes as assessed at the time of prediction creation. Derived from historical restoration times for similar cause codes and circuit configurations. Used for CAIDI estimation and crew resource planning.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — CAIDI; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: prediction_source
attributes.description: The originating signal or mechanism that triggered the outage prediction. 'ami_ping' = Advanced Metering Infrastructure (AMI) last-gasp or ping failure; 'scada_alarm' = SCADA system alarm from field device; 'customer_call_cluster' = clustering of inbound customer outage calls; 'predictive_model' = ML/analytics model output; 'dispatcher_manual' = manually entered by a system operator or dispatcher; 'smart_meter_outage_notification' = direct outage notification from smart meter.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — Meter Reading; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC CIP-014

attributes.name: prediction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the outage prediction record. 'pending' = generated but not yet dispatched; 'active' = in use for crew pre-positioning and ETR communication; 'confirmed' = field crew has validated the predicted scope; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer prediction; 'cancelled' = prediction voided before confirmation; 'expired' = prediction window elapsed without field confirmation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module

attributes.name: prediction_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the outage prediction was system-generated or dispatcher-created. Represents the principal real-world event time for this prediction record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management Module; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: predictive_model_version
attributes.description: Version string of the predictive analytics model that generated this prediction. Used alongside predictive_model_id for model governance, auditability, and performance benchmarking.
attributes.references: DOE Grid Modernization Initiative; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: protection_zone
attributes.description: The protection zone or relay zone within which the predicted fault is located. Used by switching order coordinators to identify the correct protective device (recloser, fuse, breaker) to operate for isolation and restoration.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR; IEEE C37 — Protective Relaying

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this outage prediction record. Used for data lineage, reconciliation, and Silver Layer provenance tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; GE PowerOn ADMS; OSIsoft PI; Oracle Utilities MDM

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Audit timestamp recording when this outage prediction record was last modified in the data platform. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: voltage_level
attributes.description: Voltage classification of the network segment predicted to be affected. Determines the severity tier, crew qualification requirements, and regulatory reporting category.
attributes.references: IEC 60038 — Standard Voltages; IEEE C57; NERC FAC Standards

attributes.name: weather_condition_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the weather conditions at the time of prediction creation (e.g., clear, wind, ice, lightning, flood). Used for cause analysis, storm classification, and reliability reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|wind|ice|lightning|flood|snow|extreme_heat|fog|tornado|hurricane — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day Classification; NOAA Weather Classification

attributes.name: wind_speed_mph
attributes.description: Recorded or forecast wind speed in miles per hour at the predicted fault location at the time of prediction creation. Used for storm severity assessment and major event day (MED) classification.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day Classification; NOAA

products.name: etr_revision
products.description: Record of each revision to the Estimated Time of Restoration (ETR) for an outage event. Captures revision sequence number, previous ETR, revised ETR, revision timestamp, revision reason code, issuing dispatcher, and whether customer notifications were triggered by the revision. Enables ETR accuracy tracking, customer communication audit trail, and dispatcher performance review.
products.reference: ETR Management (GE PowerOn ADMS OMS)

attributes.name: etr_revision_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Estimated Time of Restoration (ETR) Revision ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each ETR revision record within the outage management system. Primary key for the etr_revision data product.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management System (OMS) ETR Revision Entity

attributes.name: affected_feeder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary distribution feeder affected by the outage event at the time of this ETR revision. Supports feeder-level reliability analysis and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Distribution Management System (DMS); Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispatcher or control room operator who issued this ETR revision. Supports dispatcher performance review and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Dispatcher Role; NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event for which this ETR revision was issued. Links the revision to its originating outage lifecycle record in the OMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — Outage Management System (OMS); NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: outage_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the switching order associated with the restoration effort at the time of this ETR revision. Links the ETR revision to the specific switching sequence being executed. Null if no switching order was active.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Switching Order Management; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: regulatory_correspondence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_correspondence. Business justification: ETR revisions for major outages may require regulatory notifications or explanations to PUC regarding restoration delays. Customer service and regulatory affairs teams document regulatory communicatio

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the field work order created for the restoration effort associated with this ETR revision. Links to the asset management and workforce management system for crew and material tracking.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite — Work Management; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: auto_generated
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ETR revision was automatically generated by the OMS/ADMS system (e.g., via predictive restoration algorithms or rule-based triggers) rather than manually entered by a dispatcher. True if system-generated; False if manually entered.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Automated ETR Engine; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Dispatcher or system-assigned confidence level for the revised ETR at the time of issuance. Reflects the degree of certainty based on available information (crew on-site, damage assessment status, resource availability). Used in ETR accuracy analytics.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS ETR Confidence Scoring; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this ETR revision record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit trail creation timestamp for the Silver layer record. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; NERC CIP-007; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: crew_dispatched
attributes.description: Indicates whether a field crew had been dispatched to the outage location at the time this ETR revision was issued. True if crew dispatch had occurred; False if crew was not yet dispatched. Supports correlation between crew availability and ETR accuracy.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Crew Dispatch Module; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: crew_on_site
attributes.description: Indicates whether a field crew had arrived on-site at the outage location at the time this ETR revision was issued. True if crew was confirmed on-site; False otherwise. Supports analysis of ETR accuracy improvement after crew arrival.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Crew Status; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: customer_notification_triggered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ETR revision triggered an outbound customer notification (SMS, IVR, email, or web portal update). True if notifications were dispatched; False if the revision was internal only. Supports customer communication audit trail.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Customer Notification Module; State PUC Customer Notification Rules; NAESB Business Practices

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of customer service points affected by the outage event at the time this ETR revision was issued. May change between revisions as the outage scope is refined. Used for prioritization and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability metric calculations.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; IEEE 1366 SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: customers_restored_count
attributes.description: Cumulative number of customer service points that had been restored at the time this ETR revision was issued. Enables tracking of restoration progress across the outage lifecycle and supports CAIDI calculation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Restoration Tracking; IEEE 1366 CAIDI; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: damage_assessment_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal damage assessment had been completed prior to this ETR revision. True if damage assessment was finalized; False if the revision was issued before full assessment. ETR revisions post-assessment are typically more accurate.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Damage Assessment Workflow; NERC EOP-005

attributes.name: dispatcher_notes
attributes.description: Free-text operational notes entered by the dispatcher at the time of this ETR revision. May include field crew communications, equipment status updates, or coordination details not captured in structured fields. Supports dispatcher performance review and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Dispatcher Console; NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: estimated_mw_interrupted
attributes.description: Estimated load in megawatts (MW) interrupted by the outage event at the time of this ETR revision. Used for NERC EOP-004 regulatory reporting thresholds and for grid impact assessment.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; FERC Form 1; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Load Estimation

attributes.name: etr_shift_minutes
attributes.description: Signed integer representing the change in estimated restoration time in minutes between the previous ETR and the revised ETR. Positive values indicate a later restoration estimate; negative values indicate an earlier estimate. Derived at ingestion for analytical convenience — not a KPI aggregate.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; IEEE 1366 ETR Accuracy Metrics

attributes.name: mutual_aid_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether mutual aid from neighboring utilities or contractors had been requested for this outage event at the time of this ETR revision. True if mutual aid was requested; False otherwise. Mutual aid requests often correlate with extended ETR windows.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; NERC EOP-005 Mutual Assistance; Edison Electric Institute (EEI) Mutual Aid Guidelines

attributes.name: nerc_event_type
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Event Type
attributes.description: NERC EOP-004 event type classification applicable to the outage at the time of this ETR revision. Populated only when regulatory_reportable is True. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LOSS_OF_LOAD|TRANSMISSION_LOSS|GENERATION_LOSS|VOLTAGE_DEVIATION|FREQUENCY_DEVIATION|CYBER_SECURITY|PHYSICAL_SECURITY|NATURAL_DISASTER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004 Event Reporting Standard; FERC Order 809

attributes.name: notification_channel
attributes.description: Primary channel through which customer notifications were dispatched for this ETR revision. Null or NONE if customer_notification_triggered is False. Supports multi-channel communication audit and regulatory compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; SAP IS-U Customer Notification; State PUC Customer Communication Rules

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which customer notifications were dispatched following this ETR revision. Null if no notification was triggered. Enables measurement of lag between ETR revision and customer communication. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; State PUC Customer Notification Rules

attributes.name: oms_incident_number
attributes.description: External incident number assigned by the GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management System to the parent outage event. Serves as the cross-system business identifier for traceability between the OMS and downstream reporting systems.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Incident Management; State PUC Outage Reporting

attributes.name: outage_cause_code
attributes.description: Standardized cause code for the outage event as known at the time of this ETR revision. May be updated across revisions as field crews refine the root cause. Aligns with IEEE 1366 cause code taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WEATHER|EQUIPMENT_FAILURE|TREE_CONTACT|ANIMAL_CONTACT|VEHICLE_ACCIDENT|PLANNED_MAINTENANCE|UNKNOWN|THIRD_PARTY|OVERLOAD|LIGHTNING — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; IEEE 1366 Outage Cause Codes; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage event type at the time of this ETR revision. UNPLANNED covers unexpected equipment failures; PLANNED covers scheduled maintenance windows; STORM covers major weather events; EMERGENCY covers safety-driven de-energizations.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; IEEE 1366; State PUC Outage Reporting

attributes.name: partial_restoration_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a partial restoration of service had been achieved for a subset of affected customers prior to this ETR revision being issued. True if partial restoration was in effect; False if no customers had been restored yet.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Restoration Tracking; IEEE 1366 Partial Restoration

attributes.name: previous_etr
attributes.description: The ETR value that was in effect immediately before this revision was applied. Null for the initial ETR issuance (revision_sequence_number = 1). Enables before/after comparison for ETR accuracy analysis. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS ETR History; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Restoration priority assigned to the outage event at the time of this ETR revision. CRITICAL typically covers medical baseline customers, hospitals, or critical infrastructure; HIGH covers large commercial/industrial customers; MEDIUM and LOW cover standard residential and commercial segments.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Restoration Prioritization; State PUC Critical Customer Rules; NERC EOP-005

attributes.name: regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the parent outage event meets the threshold for mandatory regulatory reporting to NERC, FERC, or State PUC at the time of this ETR revision. True if reportable thresholds (e.g., customer count, duration, MW lost) are met; False otherwise.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004 Event Reporting; FERC Form 1; State PUC Outage Reporting Rules

attributes.name: revised_etr
attributes.description: The new ETR value established by this revision. Represents the dispatcher's best estimate of when service will be restored to affected customers at the time of revision. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS ETR; IEEE 1366; State PUC Customer Notification Rules

attributes.name: revision_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for this ETR revision. Used for root-cause analysis of ETR accuracy and dispatcher performance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: INITIAL_ESTIMATE|CREW_ASSESSMENT|SCOPE_CHANGE|RESOURCE_DELAY|WEATHER_UPDATE|RESTORATION_PARTIAL|EQUIPMENT_COMPLEXITY|SAFETY_HOLD|MUTUAL_AID_DELAY|DAMAGE_REASSESSMENT — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Revision Reason Codes; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: revision_reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative provided by the dispatcher explaining the specific circumstances that necessitated this ETR revision. Supplements the structured reason code with operational context.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; State PUC Outage Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: revision_sequence_number
attributes.description: Ordinal sequence number of this revision within the outage event, starting at 1 for the initial ETR issuance. Enables chronological ordering of all ETR revisions for a given outage and supports ETR accuracy trend analysis.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS ETR Revision Sequence; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: revision_source
attributes.description: Indicates the originating source of this ETR revision — whether it was manually entered by a dispatcher, automatically generated by the OMS/ADMS system, submitted by a field crew, escalated by a supervisor, or issued from a storm operations center.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; NERC EOP-005

attributes.name: revision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this ETR revision record. ACTIVE indicates the revision is the current operative ETR; SUPERSEDED indicates it has been replaced by a later revision; CANCELLED indicates the revision was voided; FINAL indicates the outage has been restored and this was the last ETR.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS ETR Lifecycle; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: revision_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time (with timezone offset) at which this ETR revision was recorded in the OMS. Serves as the principal business event timestamp for the revision lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS; IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution (Minutes)
attributes.description: Incremental SAIDI contribution in customer-minutes attributable to this outage event as projected at the time of this ETR revision, calculated as (customers_affected_count × projected_duration_minutes) / total_customers_served. Supports real-time reliability index tracking.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 SAIDI Definition; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the regulated service territory within which the outage event occurred. Used for jurisdictional regulatory reporting to State PUCs and for territory-level reliability benchmarking.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Definitions; NERC FAC-002; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this ETR revision record was sourced. Supports data lineage tracking and Silver layer provenance in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance — Data Lineage Policy; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Standards

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this ETR revision was issued during an active declared storm event or major weather emergency. True if a storm event declaration was active; False for normal operations. Supports storm vs. non-storm ETR accuracy benchmarking.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Storm Operations; NERC EOP-005; State PUC Storm Reporting

attributes.name: to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — Every ETR revision is for a specific outage event. Required for ETR accuracy tracking and customer communication audit.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this ETR revision record was last modified in the data platform. Supports audit trail and change tracking for the Silver layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Audit Trail; NERC CIP-007; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the affected circuit or equipment at the time of this ETR revision. Distinguishes transmission-level (>69 kV) from distribution-level (<69 kV) outages for regulatory classification and restoration complexity assessment.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — DMS; IEEE C37; NERC TPL; IEC 60038

attributes.name: weather_condition_code
attributes.description: Standardized weather condition code recorded at the time of this ETR revision. Used to correlate ETR accuracy and outage duration with prevailing weather conditions for storm hardening and reliability planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CLEAR|WIND|RAIN|ICE|SNOW|LIGHTNING|EXTREME_HEAT|FLOOD — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Storm Operations; NOAA Weather Classification; State PUC Storm Reporting

products.name: call
products.description: Record of an inbound customer trouble call or AMI-generated outage report received by the utility, used to initiate or corroborate an outage event. Captures call receipt timestamp, source type (IVR, agent, AMI ping, mobile app, web portal), reported symptom, caller account reference, associated outage event (once matched), call disposition, and whether the call was a duplicate of an existing event. Feeds OMS call clustering and outage prediction logic.
products.reference: Trouble Call (GE PowerOn ADMS / Oracle CC&B CIS)

attributes.name: call_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each inbound customer trouble call or AMI-generated outage report record in the Outage Management System (OMS). Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Management

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility customer account associated with the caller or AMI device that originated this outage report. Links to the Customer Information System (CIS) account record.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Account Management

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution substation serving the reported outage location, resolved from the GIS network model. Used for geographic grouping of calls, outage event scoping, and storm response coordination.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Substation Asset Model; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: duplicate_of_call_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original (first-received) outage call record of which this call is a duplicate. Populated only when is_duplicate = True. Enables deduplication lineage tracing in OMS call clustering.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Clustering

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the call center agent who received and logged this trouble call. Populated only when call_source_type = AGENT. Used for quality assurance, workforce management, and call handling performance reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B — Agent Management; SAP S/4HANA HCM

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event record once this call has been matched or clustered to a confirmed outage event in the OMS. Null until the call is correlated to an event.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Event Management

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution circuit (feeder) serving the reported outage location, resolved from the GIS network model based on the service address or premise. Used for OMS call clustering by circuit and outage event correlation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Distribution Network Model; GE PowerOn ADMS — ADMS (Advanced Distribution Management System) Circuit Management

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the smart meter or AMI endpoint that generated an automated outage ping or last-gasp signal, if the call source is AMI-initiated rather than a human caller.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — Meter Data Management; AMI Infrastructure

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility service premise (physical delivery point) associated with the reported outage location. Links to the GIS/network model for spatial outage clustering and distribution circuit identification.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U — Device Management; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the declared storm or major weather event record associated with this outage call, when weather_event_flag = True. Links to the storm event management entity for storm response coordination and MED exclusion processing.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED); GE PowerOn ADMS — Storm Management; State PUC Storm Reporting

attributes.name: affected_customers_reported
attributes.description: Number of customers the caller reports as being affected by the outage (e.g., 'my whole street is out'). This is a caller-provided estimate, not a system-confirmed count. Used as an early indicator for outage scope assessment and crew dispatch prioritization.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Outage Scope Assessment; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: ami_device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the AMI endpoint (smart meter) that generated an automated last-gasp outage notification or power-off ping. Populated only when call_source_type = AMI_PING. Used to correlate AMI-detected outages with customer account and network topology.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) Device Management; ANSI C12.19

attributes.name: ami_signal_type
attributes.description: Type of automated signal received from the AMI endpoint that triggered this outage report. LAST_GASP = meter-detected power loss notification; POWER_RESTORE = meter-detected power restoration; TAMPER = tamper event; BLINK = momentary interruption blink count; POWER_QUALITY = voltage sag/swell event. Populated only when call_source_type = AMI_PING.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities MDM — AMI Signal Processing; IEEE 1159 Power Quality

attributes.name: call_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the outage call record within the OMS workflow. RECEIVED = call logged, not yet processed; PENDING_MATCH = awaiting correlation to an outage event; MATCHED = successfully linked to an outage event; DUPLICATE = identified as a duplicate of an existing call or event; CLOSED = call resolved and closed; CANCELLED = call withdrawn or invalid.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Management Workflow

attributes.name: caller_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who placed the trouble call, as provided at time of call. May differ from the account holder name if a third party is reporting on behalf of the customer. Classified as confidential PII per GDPR/CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Management

attributes.name: caller_phone_number
attributes.description: Phone number provided by or captured from the caller at time of call receipt. Used for call-back confirmation and customer notification of restoration. Classified as restricted PII per GDPR/CCPA.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Management

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this outage call record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer ingestion timestamp). Serves as the audit creation timestamp for data lineage and regulatory record-keeping. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NERC Reliability Reporting Audit Trail; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: customer_class
attributes.description: Classification of the customer associated with this outage call by service type. Used for restoration prioritization, regulatory reporting, and SAIDI/SAIFI index segmentation per IEEE 1366 and PUC requirements.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Tariff Classification; SAP IS-U — Customer Classification

attributes.name: data_quality_flag
attributes.description: Indicates the data quality status of this outage call record as assessed during Silver Layer ingestion and validation. VALID = passed all validation rules; SUSPECT = passed ingestion but has anomalies requiring review; INVALID = failed critical validation; PENDING_REVIEW = awaiting manual data quality review.
attributes.references: Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer Data Quality Standards; Oracle Utilities MDM — VEE (Validation, Estimation, and Editing)

attributes.name: disposition_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the final outcome or resolution action taken on this call (e.g., EVENT_CREATED, ADDED_TO_EVENT, DUPLICATE_CLOSED, NO_OUTAGE_FOUND, REFERRED_TO_CREW, CUSTOMER_CALLBACK_SCHEDULED). Sourced from OMS disposition reference table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EVENT_CREATED|ADDED_TO_EVENT|DUPLICATE_CLOSED|NO_OUTAGE_FOUND|REFERRED_TO_CREW|CUSTOMER_CALLBACK_SCHEDULED|INVALID — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Disposition; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: duration_seconds
attributes.description: Duration of the customer call in seconds from answer to disconnect, for calls received via IVR or live agent channels. Used for call center operational reporting, SLA (Service Level Agreement) compliance, and customer experience analytics.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Center Operations; State PUC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time of power restoration communicated to the customer at the time of call handling or subsequent notification. Sourced from OMS restoration forecasting. Used for customer expectation management and SLA (Service Level Agreement) tracking. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Restoration Forecasting; State PUC Customer Service Standards

attributes.name: hazard_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the caller reported a safety hazard associated with the outage (e.g., downed power line, sparking equipment, fire, flooding near electrical equipment). True = hazard reported; False = no hazard reported. Triggers priority escalation in OMS crew dispatch and public safety notification workflows.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 — Electric Power Generation, Transmission, and Distribution; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Priority Escalation

attributes.name: hazard_type
attributes.description: Specific type of safety hazard reported by the caller when hazard_indicator = True. Used to determine emergency response protocol, crew safety briefing requirements, and coordination with emergency services (fire, police). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DOWNED_LINE|SPARKING|FIRE|FLOODING|EQUIPMENT_DAMAGE|TREE_ON_LINE|VEHICLE_ACCIDENT|OTHER — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC CIP; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Hazard Management

attributes.name: is_duplicate
attributes.description: Indicates whether this call has been identified as a duplicate report of an outage already captured by a prior call or AMI notification for the same event and location. True = duplicate; False = unique first report. Used by OMS call clustering logic to avoid double-counting in reliability metrics.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Clustering; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: ivr_session_code
attributes.description: Unique session identifier assigned by the Interactive Voice Response (IVR) system for calls received through the automated phone channel. Used for call traceability, IVR system reconciliation, and customer experience analytics. Populated only when call_source_type = IVR.
attributes.references: Oracle Utilities CC&B — IVR (Interactive Voice Response) Integration; SAP IS-U CIS

attributes.name: matched_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this call was successfully matched or correlated to a confirmed outage event in the OMS. Populated when call_status transitions to MATCHED. Used for OMS processing latency analysis and reliability reporting timelines. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Event Correlation

attributes.name: medical_baseline_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the affected customer account is registered on the utility's medical baseline or life-support program, requiring priority restoration and proactive notification per PUC regulations. True = medical baseline customer; False = standard customer. Classified as confidential due to sensitivity of health-related program enrollment.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Program Rules; NERC EOP Standards; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Customer Program Management

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an outage acknowledgement or estimated restoration time (ERT) notification has been sent to the customer associated with this call. True = notification sent; False = not yet sent. Supports PUC customer notification compliance tracking.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Customer Notification

attributes.name: notification_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the outage acknowledgement or estimated restoration time (ERT) notification was dispatched to the customer. Populated when notification_sent_flag = True. Used for PUC notification compliance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: State PUC Customer Notification Requirements; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Notification Management

attributes.name: oms_call_cluster_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Outage Management System (OMS) Call Cluster ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the OMS call cluster to which this call has been assigned during the outage prediction and event correlation process. Multiple calls from the same geographic area or circuit are grouped into a cluster to predict the probable outage location and initiate crew dispatch before a formal event is confirmed.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS (Outage Management System) Call Clustering and Outage Prediction

attributes.name: outage_start_reported_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the caller reports the outage began, as stated by the customer or detected by the AMI device. May differ from the OMS-confirmed outage start time. Used as an input to outage event timeline reconstruction and SAIDI/CAIDI calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Reliability Indices; GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Event Timeline

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Restoration priority level assigned to this outage call based on hazard indicators, medical baseline status, customer class, and outage scope. CRITICAL = life-safety or critical infrastructure; HIGH = medical baseline or large commercial/industrial; MEDIUM = standard residential or small commercial; LOW = non-urgent or duplicate. Drives OMS crew dispatch sequencing.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Restoration Prioritization; State PUC Service Reliability Rules

attributes.name: received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which the outage call or AMI-generated outage report was received by the utility system. This is the principal business event timestamp used for OMS call clustering, outage prediction, and SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Guide for Electric Power Distribution Reliability Indices; NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this trouble call at receipt, used for customer-facing acknowledgement (e.g., IVR confirmation code, agent ticket number, web portal confirmation). Sourced from the CIS or OMS call intake module.
attributes.references: SAP IS-U; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Management

attributes.name: reported_symptom_code
attributes.description: Standardized code representing the symptom or problem reported by the caller or detected by the AMI system (e.g., FULL_OUTAGE, PARTIAL_OUTAGE, FLICKERING, LOW_VOLTAGE, DOWNED_LINE, BURNING_SMELL). Sourced from the OMS symptom code reference table. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FULL_OUTAGE|PARTIAL_OUTAGE|FLICKERING|LOW_VOLTAGE|DOWNED_LINE|BURNING_SMELL|SPARKING|BUZZING — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Symptom Codes; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: reported_symptom_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the outage symptom or problem as reported by the caller or transcribed by the call center agent. Supplements the structured symptom code with verbatim customer language for OMS analysis and crew dispatch context.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Notes; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Call Management

attributes.name: service_address
attributes.description: Street address of the service location reported as experiencing the outage, as provided by the caller or resolved from the account record. Used for geographic clustering in the OMS and crew dispatch routing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Geospatial Asset Location; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: service_territory_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the utility's regulated service territory or operating division in which the reported outage is located. Used for regulatory reporting segmentation to State PUCs and NERC reliability reporting.
attributes.references: State PUC Service Territory Definitions; NERC Reliability Reporting; SAP IS-U — Service Territory

attributes.name: source_system_call_code
attributes.description: Original call or ticket identifier assigned by the source operational system (e.g., OMS call number from GE PowerOn ADMS, CIS interaction ID from SAP IS-U or Oracle CC&B). Enables traceability and reconciliation between the Silver Layer data product and the system of record.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Management; SAP IS-U; Oracle Utilities CC&B

attributes.name: source_type
attributes.description: Channel or mechanism through which the outage report was received. IVR = Interactive Voice Response automated phone system; AGENT = live call center agent; AMI_PING = Advanced Metering Infrastructure last-gasp or outage notification; MOBILE_APP = utility mobile application; WEB_PORTAL = online self-service portal; FIELD_CREW = field crew-initiated report.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Call Intake; AMI (Advanced Metering Infrastructure) Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time at which this outage call record was last modified in the data platform, reflecting any status updates, event matching, or data corrections applied during the call lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; NERC Reliability Reporting Audit Trail; Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer

attributes.name: weather_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the outage reported in this call is associated with a declared weather event (storm, hurricane, ice storm, heat wave, etc.). True = weather-related; False = non-weather. Relevant for IEEE 1366 Major Event Day (MED) exclusion determination and storm response activation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 — Major Event Day (MED) Exclusion; State PUC Storm Reporting Requirements

products.name: segment_impact
products.description: Record of a specific distribution network segment (feeder section, lateral, transformer zone) impacted by an outage event. Captures segment identifier, segment type, de-energization start and end timestamps, isolation method, number of customers on segment, and restoration sequence priority. Enables network topology-based outage analysis and supports FLISR (Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration) workflow tracking.
products.reference: Network Segment Outage (GE PowerOn ADMS / Esri ArcGIS Utility Network)

attributes.name: segment_impact_id
attributes.description: Primary key for segment_impact

attributes.name: cause_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage cause classification record describing the root cause of the de-energization event for this segment.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC Reliability Standards; outage.outage_cause reference product

attributes.name: der_system_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to interconnection.der_system. Business justification: Network segment analysis must identify DER on affected segments for hosting capacity recalculation, protection coordination verification, and restoration priority determination. Engineering studies po

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution substation that supplies this network segment. Used for substation-level outage impact aggregation and transmission-distribution boundary analysis.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEC 61968 CIM

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event that caused this segment to be de-energized. Links the segment impact to the originating outage lifecycle record.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management Module

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the distribution feeder circuit that this segment belongs to. Used for feeder-level outage aggregation, reliability reporting, and ADMS topology navigation. Sourced from Esri ArcGIS Utility Network feeder model.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEC 61968 CIM

attributes.name: nerc_cip_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.nerc_cip_asset. Business justification: Network segment impacts may affect NERC CIP-designated BES Cyber Systems, triggering CIP incident reporting obligations. Cybersecurity teams assess whether outages impacted CIP assets to determine CIP

attributes.name: network_segment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution network segment (feeder section, lateral, transformer zone) affected by the outage. Sourced from the GIS network model in Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; IEC 61968 Common Information Model (CIM)

attributes.name: outage_crew_dispatch_id
attributes.description: Reference to the crew dispatch assignment record for field crews assigned to restore this segment. Links to workforce and work order management in Ventyx Asset Suite.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; GE PowerOn ADMS OMS

attributes.name: sectionalizing_device_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the switching device (recloser, sectionalizer, fuse, breaker) that performed the isolation of this segment. Sourced from the GIS network model and ADMS device registry. Used for asset performance tracking in Ventyx Asset Suite.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEC 61968 CIM

attributes.name: storm_event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the storm or major weather event record associated with this segment impact. Null for non-storm outages. Used for storm response coordination, MED exclusion processing, and FEMA/state emergency reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 MED; NERC EOP-004; State PUC Storm Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment impact record was first created in the OMS or lakehouse system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and record provenance tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: critical_infrastructure_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment serves critical infrastructure facilities (hospitals, emergency services, water treatment, telecommunications). When true, triggers elevated restoration priority and mandatory regulatory notification.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-014; DHS Critical Infrastructure Protection; State PUC Standards

attributes.name: customers_on_segment
attributes.description: Total number of customer service points (meters) located on this network segment at the time of the outage event. Used as the customer count denominator for SAIDI, SAIFI, and CAIDI reliability index calculations per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002; Oracle Utilities MDM; SAP IS-U Device Management

attributes.name: customers_partially_restored
attributes.description: Number of customers on this segment restored during partial restoration switching operations prior to full segment restoration. Used to accurately credit partial restoration in SAIDI/CAIDI calculations per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: customers_restored
attributes.description: Number of customer service points on this segment that have been restored to service. Incremented as partial restoration switching operations are completed. Enables real-time tracking of restoration progress.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS; State PUC Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: de_energization_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the network segment was fully restored to energized state. Null if the segment has not yet been restored. Used with de_energization_start_timestamp to compute segment outage duration for SAIDI/CAIDI calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: de_energization_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the network segment was de-energized (lost power) as recorded by the OMS or SCADA system. This is the principal business event timestamp used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002; GE PowerOn ADMS; OSIsoft PI Historian

attributes.name: doe_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment impact is part of an event requiring reporting to the U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) via Form OE-417 (Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report).
attributes.references: DOE Form OE-417; DOE Energy Emergency Guidelines

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time when the segment is expected to be restored to service. Published to customer notification systems and field crews. Updated dynamically as restoration progresses. Supports ETR (Estimated Time to Restore) commitments to regulators and customers.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; State PUC Service Restoration Standards; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: fault_location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the fault or damage location on this segment as identified by field crews or FLISR analysis (e.g., 'Pole 47 on Oak Street', 'Underground cable section between manholes MH-12 and MH-14'). Supports crew navigation and post-event analysis.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: flisr_action_type
attributes.description: Type of Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration (FLISR) automated action applied to this segment. Indicates whether the segment was handled by automatic FLISR logic or required manual crew intervention.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; IEEE 1366; IEC 61968 CIM

attributes.name: flisr_automated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the FLISR (Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration) action for this segment was executed automatically by the ADMS system (true) or required manual crew switching (false). Used to measure ADMS automation effectiveness.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: gis_segment_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier for this network segment in the Esri ArcGIS Utility Network geospatial model. Enables spatial analysis, outage mapping, and topology-based impact assessment.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; IEC 61968 CIM

attributes.name: impact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the segment impact record. Tracks the progression from initial de-energization through isolation, partial restoration, and full restoration. Drives OMS workflow state transitions in GE PowerOn ADMS.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management; IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: is_med_exclusion
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment impact qualifies for Major Event Day (MED) exclusion from SAIDI/SAIFI reliability index calculations per IEEE 1366-2012 beta method. MED exclusions apply during catastrophic storm or disaster events.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366-2012; State PUC MED Exclusion Rules; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: is_momentary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment impact qualifies as a momentary interruption (typically less than 5 minutes per IEEE 1366 definition). Momentary interruptions are counted in MAIFI (Momentary Average Interruption Frequency Index) rather than SAIDI/SAIFI.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting Standards

attributes.name: is_planned
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment de-energization was a planned maintenance outage (true) or an unplanned/forced interruption (false). Planned outages are typically excluded from SAIDI/SAIFI calculations per IEEE 1366 and state PUC rules.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: isolation_method
attributes.description: The switching or protective device operation method used to isolate this segment from the energized network. Critical for FLISR (Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration) workflow analysis and switching order documentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: automatic_switch|manual_switch|fuse_operation|recloser|sectionalizer|breaker_trip — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module; IEEE C37.112; IEC 61968 CIM

attributes.name: life_support_customers
attributes.description: Number of customers on this segment registered as life-support or medical baseline customers. Elevates restoration priority and triggers mandatory notification protocols per state PUC regulations.
attributes.references: State PUC Life Support Customer Regulations; SAP IS-U CIS; Oracle CC&B

attributes.name: load_mw_at_outage
attributes.description: Estimated electrical load in megawatts (MW) on this segment at the time of de-energization. Sourced from SCADA/OSIsoft PI historian data. Used for load loss reporting, demand response impact assessment, and grid restoration planning.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI Historian; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC EOP-005

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment impact contributes to a reportable event under NERC reliability standards (e.g., EOP-004 disturbance reporting thresholds). Drives mandatory NERC event reporting workflows.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-002; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: oms_segment_ref
attributes.description: Source system reference identifier for this segment impact record as assigned by the GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management System. Used for cross-system reconciliation and data lineage tracing between the OMS and the lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS; Data Lineage Standards

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the de-energization event for this segment in minutes, calculated from de_energization_start_timestamp to de_energization_end_timestamp. Null if segment is not yet restored. Used directly in SAIDI and CAIDI reliability index calculations per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: partial_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when partial restoration of this segment was achieved (i.e., a subset of customers on the segment were restored via switching operations before full restoration). Null if no partial restoration occurred.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; State PUC Restoration Reporting

attributes.name: puc_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment impact must be included in mandatory reliability reporting submissions to the state Public Utility Commission (PUC). Determined by customer count thresholds, duration thresholds, and critical infrastructure involvement.
attributes.references: State PUC Reliability Reporting Rules; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: restoration_method
attributes.description: Method used to restore this segment to service. Distinguishes between switching-based restoration (no repair needed), physical repair of damaged equipment, temporary bypass, or load transfer to alternate feeder.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: restoration_sequence_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority rank assigned to this segment for restoration sequencing within the outage event. Lower values indicate higher priority. Drives crew dispatch order and switching plan execution. Considers life-support customers, critical infrastructure, and load size.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; State PUC Critical Load Standards; NERC EOP-005

attributes.name: segment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for the distribution network segment as maintained in the GIS and ADMS systems (e.g., feeder section code, lateral identifier). Used for cross-system reconciliation with GE PowerOn ADMS and Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEC 61968 CIM

attributes.name: segment_name
attributes.description: Human-readable descriptive name of the impacted distribution network segment (e.g., 'Oak Street Lateral 3', 'Feeder 12A Section 4'). Used in operational dashboards and crew dispatch communications.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the distribution network segment topology type. Determines the scope of impact and applicable FLISR (Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration) switching logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: feeder_section|lateral|transformer_zone|substation_bus|service_point_group|tie_line — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEC 61968 CIM; GE PowerOn ADMS; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: switching_order_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the switching order issued to field crews for isolating or restoring this segment. Links to the switching order management workflow in GE PowerOn ADMS. Required for audit trail of all switching operations.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Switching Order Module; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Operating Procedures

attributes.name: to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — Network segment impacts are recorded per outage event. Required for topology-based outage analysis and FLISR workflow tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this segment impact record was last modified. Tracks updates to restoration status, customer counts, ETR, and other operational fields throughout the outage lifecycle.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage of the impacted network segment in kilovolts (kV). Used to classify the segment within the distribution voltage hierarchy (e.g., 4kV, 12kV, 25kV, 34.5kV) and determine applicable switching procedures.
attributes.references: IEC 60038 Standard Voltages; IEEE C57; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition at the time of the segment de-energization. Used for storm-related outage analysis, MED exclusion determination, and regulatory storm reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: normal|wind|ice|lightning|flood|heat|snow|hurricane|tornado — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Storm Reporting; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: Work order number from the asset management system (Ventyx Asset Suite or SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance) associated with the restoration or repair activity for this segment impact.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance; NERC FAC-002

products.name: outage_flisr_event
products.description: Record of an automated FLISR (Fault Location, Isolation, and Service Restoration) execution triggered by a fault on the distribution network. Captures fault detection timestamp, faulted segment, isolation actions taken automatically, load transfer actions, customers restored automatically vs. requiring manual intervention, FLISR algorithm version, and success/failure outcome. Distinct from manual switching orders — represents automated grid self-healing actions.
products.reference: FLISR Automation (GE PowerOn ADMS FLISR Module)

attributes.name: outage_flisr_event_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) Event ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each automated FLISR execution event record in the distribution network self-healing system.

attributes.name: audit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit. Business justification: Automated FLISR operations on critical infrastructure are audited for compliance with operational reliability standards. Compliance audits review FLISR algorithm performance, operator override decisio

attributes.name: cause_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage cause classification record that categorizes the root cause of the fault triggering this FLISR event (e.g., equipment failure, tree contact, animal contact, lightning). Links to the outage_cause reference product for NERC/PUC cause code reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC EOP-004; State PUC Outage Cause Reporting; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation from which the faulted feeder originates. Used for geographic and operational scoping of the FLISR event.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent outage event that triggered this FLISR execution. Links the automated self-healing action to the broader outage lifecycle record in the Outage Management System (OMS).
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Integration; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: network_segment_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific distribution network segment (line section, cable section, or switch zone) determined by the FLISR algorithm to contain the fault. Sourced from the GIS/Utility Network model.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Fault Location

attributes.name: primary_outage_feeder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution feeder on which the fault was detected and FLISR was triggered. Identifies the primary circuit affected by the fault event.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network — Network Modeling; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: sectionalizing_device_id
