attributes.description: Identifier of the normally-open tie switch operated by the FLISR algorithm to transfer load to the alternate feeder during restoration. Sourced from the GIS/Utility Network model. Critical for post-event switching order reconciliation.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module

attributes.name: tie_switch_asset_registry_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Tie Switch Asset Registry Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_registry. Business justification: FLISR (Fault Location, Isolation, Service Restoration) events use tie switches to transfer load between feeders. Linking to asset_registry enables tracking tie switch operation counts, maintenance nee

attributes.name: adms_event_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) Event Reference
attributes.description: Native event reference identifier assigned by the GE PowerOn ADMS system for this FLISR execution. Enables cross-system traceability between the data lakehouse record and the operational ADMS source system.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; NERC CIP-007

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this FLISR event record was first created in the data platform. Serves as the audit trail creation marker for data lineage and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: customers_affected_total
attributes.description: Total number of customer service points de-energized as a result of the fault event prior to any FLISR restoration actions. Used as the baseline for SAIFI and SAIDI reliability index calculations per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: customers_requiring_manual
attributes.description: Number of customer service points within the faulted segment that could not be restored automatically by FLISR and require manual crew dispatch and switching operations for restoration. Drives crew dispatch prioritization.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: customers_restored_auto
attributes.description: Number of customer service points successfully restored to service by the FLISR automated switching and load transfer actions, without requiring manual crew intervention. Key metric for measuring FLISR effectiveness and SAIDI/CAIDI improvement.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: doe_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FLISR event is associated with an outage that meets DOE OE-417 reporting thresholds (e.g., affecting 50,000+ customers or critical infrastructure). Triggers mandatory federal emergency reporting.
attributes.references: DOE OE-417 Electric Emergency Incident and Disturbance Report; DOE Energy Policy Act

attributes.name: event_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the FLISR execution event. 'initiated' = algorithm triggered; 'in_progress' = isolation/restoration actions underway; 'completed' = full automated restoration achieved; 'failed' = algorithm could not restore; 'partial' = some customers restored automatically, remainder require manual intervention; 'cancelled' = FLISR aborted before completion.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: failure_reason
attributes.description: Descriptive reason code or message explaining why the FLISR execution failed or was aborted. Populated only when outcome is 'failure' or 'aborted'. Examples: capacity constraint on alternate feeder, communication failure to remote switch, operator override, protection relay lockout.

attributes.name: fault_detected_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the fault on the distribution network was first detected by the ADMS/FLISR system, triggering the automated response sequence. This is the principal business event timestamp for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculations per IEEE 1366.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: fault_distance_m
attributes.description: Estimated distance in meters from the substation or reference point to the calculated fault location on the feeder, as determined by the FLISR impedance-based fault location algorithm. Used for crew dispatch and asset inspection prioritization.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Fault Location; IEEE C37.113

attributes.name: fault_location_confidence
attributes.description: Confidence level assigned by the FLISR algorithm to its fault location determination. Influences whether automated restoration proceeds or is held pending manual verification. High confidence enables full automation; low confidence may trigger manual review.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Fault Location Algorithm

attributes.name: fault_type
attributes.description: Electrical classification of the fault detected on the distribution network. Determines the FLISR algorithm's isolation and restoration strategy. Phase-to-ground is the most common distribution fault type.
attributes.references: IEEE C37.113; IEC 60909; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: flisr_algorithm_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the FLISR algorithm deployed in the ADMS at the time of this event execution. Critical for reproducibility analysis, algorithm performance benchmarking, and post-event audit of automated decision logic.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; NERC CIP-007; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: flisr_event_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Fault Location Isolation and Service Restoration (FLISR) Event Number
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally referenceable identifier for this FLISR execution event, as assigned by the Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS). Used in operational reports, regulatory filings, and cross-system correlation.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; NERC CIP; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: is_momentary
attributes.description: Indicates whether the fault event was classified as a momentary interruption (duration ≤ 5 minutes per IEEE 1366) rather than a sustained outage. Momentary events are tracked under MAIFI rather than SAIFI/SAIDI for reliability reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: isolation_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the FLISR algorithm completed all automated isolation switching actions to contain the faulted segment. Marks the end of the isolation phase and the start of the restoration phase.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: isolation_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Elapsed time in seconds from fault detection to completion of all automated isolation switching actions. Key performance indicator for FLISR speed and ADMS response time benchmarking.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366; State PUC Performance Standards

attributes.name: isolation_switch_count
attributes.description: Total number of automated switching operations executed by the FLISR algorithm during the isolation phase to contain the faulted segment. Used for asset wear tracking and switching order audit.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; Ventyx Asset Suite — Condition Monitoring

attributes.name: life_support_customers_affected
attributes.description: Number of registered life support or medical baseline customers within the affected area of this FLISR event. Used to prioritize restoration sequencing and trigger mandatory customer notification per state PUC medical baseline rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Medical Baseline Rules; Oracle Utilities CC&B — Life Support Registry; NERC EOP-011

attributes.name: load_transferred_mw
attributes.description: Total electrical load in megawatts (MW) transferred to alternate feeders or tie switches by the FLISR algorithm during the restoration phase. Used to assess grid capacity utilization and validate load transfer feasibility.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Load Transfer; NERC TPL-001; IEC 60364

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FLISR event is associated with an outage that meets NERC reporting thresholds and must be reported to NERC under applicable reliability standards (e.g., EOP-004). Drives regulatory reporting workflow.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; NERC FAC-002; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: oms_incident_number
attributes.description: Incident number assigned by the Outage Management System (OMS) to the outage event associated with this FLISR execution. Enables correlation between automated FLISR actions and the broader outage incident record for regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — OMS Integration; State PUC Outage Reporting

attributes.name: operator_override_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a dispatcher or system operator manually intervened to override, modify, or abort the FLISR automated execution sequence. True = operator intervention occurred; False = fully automated execution without human intervention.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; NERC CIP-005; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: operator_override_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason a dispatcher or operator overrode the FLISR automated execution. Populated only when operator_override_flag is True. Used for post-event analysis and FLISR algorithm improvement.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; NERC CIP-005

attributes.name: outcome
attributes.description: Overall outcome of the FLISR execution event. 'success' = all restorable customers restored automatically; 'partial_success' = some customers restored, remainder require manual intervention; 'failure' = FLISR could not execute any restoration; 'aborted' = execution halted due to constraint violation or operator override.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366; State PUC Reliability Reporting

attributes.name: pre_fault_load_mw
attributes.description: Total electrical load in megawatts (MW) on the affected feeder immediately prior to the fault event, as recorded by the ADMS/SCADA historian. Used to assess load transfer feasibility and post-restoration capacity margin.
attributes.references: OSIsoft PI — Real-Time Data Historian; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC TPL-001

attributes.name: protection_relay_operated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a protection relay (recloser, sectionalizer, or breaker) operated to initiate the fault isolation sequence that triggered FLISR. True = relay operation confirmed; False = FLISR triggered by other detection method (e.g., SCADA alarm, voltage sag detection).
attributes.references: IEEE C37.113; IEC 60255; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: recloser_operations_count
attributes.description: Number of automatic recloser operations that occurred on the faulted circuit prior to FLISR lockout and isolation. Used to distinguish momentary interruptions from sustained outages for IEEE 1366 MAIFI vs SAIFI classification.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; IEC 60255; GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module

attributes.name: restoration_completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the FLISR algorithm completed all automated load transfer and service restoration actions. Customers restored after this timestamp required manual crew intervention.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: restoration_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Elapsed time in seconds from completion of fault isolation to completion of all automated load transfer and service restoration actions. Used to measure FLISR restoration speed and its contribution to CAIDI reduction.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; IEEE 1366; State PUC Performance Standards

attributes.name: restoration_switch_count
attributes.description: Total number of automated switching operations executed by the FLISR algorithm during the load transfer and service restoration phase. Distinct from isolation switch count — represents the re-energization actions.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — FLISR Module; Ventyx Asset Suite — Condition Monitoring

attributes.name: scada_communication_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) Communication Status
attributes.description: Status of SCADA communication to the affected field devices (switches, reclosers, sensors) at the time of FLISR execution. 'degraded' or 'failed' communication may limit FLISR automation capability and is a key factor in partial or failed outcomes.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS — SCADA Integration; NERC CIP-005; OSIsoft PI

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this FLISR event occurred during a declared major event or storm. Major event exclusions per IEEE 1366 may apply to SAIDI/SAIFI calculations when this flag is True.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Major Event Day (MED) Criteria; State PUC Storm Reporting; NERC FAC-002

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this FLISR event record was most recently modified in the data platform. Supports audit trail and incremental data pipeline processing.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage in kilovolts (kV) of the distribution circuit on which the FLISR event occurred. Determines applicable switching procedures, safety clearances, and regulatory reporting thresholds.

attributes.name: weather_condition
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weather Condition at Time of Event
attributes.description: Prevailing weather condition recorded at the time of the fault event (e.g., clear, wind, lightning, ice, flooding). Used for outage cause analysis, storm event classification, and reliability reporting under IEEE 1366 Major Event Day criteria. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: clear|wind|lightning|ice|flooding|snow|fog|extreme_heat|unknown — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1366 Major Event Day Criteria; State PUC Storm Reporting; NERC EOP-004

products.name: safety_clearance
products.description: Formal safety clearance (hold tag, clearance tag, or ground placement) issued to protect field crews working on de-energized equipment during outage restoration or planned maintenance. Captures clearance type, issuing authority, equipment covered, clearance issue and release timestamps, crew member holding the clearance, and safety state verification. Required for OSHA and NERC FAC compliance during switching and restoration operations.
products.reference: Safety Clearance / Hold Tag (OSHA 1910.269 / NERC FAC)

attributes.name: safety_clearance_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the safety clearance record in the lakehouse. Primary key for the safety_clearance data product. Entity role: TRANSACTION_HEADER — a discrete, lifecycle-managed safety authorization event issued to protect field crews working on de-energized equipment.

attributes.name: approver_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the supervisor, lead dispatcher, or safety officer who approved the issuance of this safety clearance, where a dual-authorization workflow is required. May be the same as the issuing dispatcher in single-authority configurations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: compliance_sox_control_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.sox_control. Business justification: Safety clearance processes for critical infrastructure work may be subject to SOX internal controls over operational safety and asset protection. Internal audit tests safety clearance controls as part

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation where the de-energized equipment covered by this clearance is located. Used for geographic scoping of the clearance and for SAIDI/SAIFI reliability reporting.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the outage event during which this safety clearance was issued. Links the clearance to the associated unplanned interruption or planned maintenance outage driving the switching and restoration work.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS OMS Incident; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: feeder_id
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution feeder or circuit segment on which the safety clearance applies. Enables feeder-level aggregation of active clearances for dispatcher situational awareness and restoration sequencing.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: grid_switching_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.grid_switching_order. Business justification: Safety clearances are issued for grid switching orders to protect field crews. Linking enables safety compliance tracking, OSHA documentation, and lockout/tagout procedure enforcement.

attributes.name: primary_safety_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the control room dispatcher or system operator who formally issued this safety clearance. The issuing authority is accountable for verifying equipment de-energization and isolation before granting clearance. Satisfies PARTY_REFERENCE category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(d); NERC FAC-001; NERC CIP-006

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary electrical equipment asset (transformer, circuit breaker, switch, line segment, cable, bus section) covered by this safety clearance. Sourced from the asset registry in Ventyx Asset Suite or Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: tertiary_safety_release_authorized_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the dispatcher or supervisor who authorized the release of this safety clearance after confirming all crew members are clear of the work zone and equipment is ready for re-energization. May differ from the original issuing dispatcher.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(d); NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the maintenance or restoration work order in the asset management system (Ventyx Asset Suite / SAP S/4HANA PM) that this safety clearance supports. Enables traceability between safety clearances and planned work activities.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management; SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: adms_switching_ref
attributes.business_glossary_term: Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) Switching Reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier from the GE PowerOn Advanced Distribution Management System (ADMS) linking this safety clearance to the associated switching sequence or network model state. Enables traceability to the ADMS network topology at the time of clearance issuance.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason this safety clearance was cancelled before use or suspended mid-work. Populated only when clearance_status is 'cancelled' or 'suspended'. Required for safety audit trail and incident investigation.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: clearance_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable alphanumeric identifier for the safety clearance, as assigned by the OMS or switching management system (e.g., GE PowerOn ADMS). Used by dispatchers, field crews, and control room operators to reference the clearance in verbal and written communications. Satisfies BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: clearance_purpose
attributes.description: Business purpose for which the safety clearance was issued. Outage Restoration: unplanned outage repair. Planned Maintenance: scheduled preventive or corrective maintenance. Emergency Repair: urgent unplanned repair outside normal outage workflow. Inspection: equipment inspection requiring de-energization. Construction: new construction or capital project work. Storm Response: clearance issued during declared storm event.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; Ventyx Asset Suite

attributes.name: clearance_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the safety clearance. Requested: clearance has been requested but not yet issued. Issued: clearance has been formally issued to the holding crew member. Active: crew is actively working under the clearance. Suspended: clearance temporarily suspended (e.g., weather hold). Released: clearance has been formally released and equipment may be re-energized. Cancelled: clearance voided before use. Expired: clearance lapsed without formal release. Satisfies LIFECYCLE_STATUS category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|issued|active|suspended|released|cancelled|expired — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: clearance_to_switching_order
attributes.description: FK to outage.switching_order.switching_order_id — Safety clearances are issued in context of switching orders to protect crews. Must link for safety compliance and clearance release workflow.

attributes.name: clearance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the safety clearance instrument issued to protect field crew. Hold Tag: prevents re-energization while crew is on equipment. Clearance Tag: formal authorization to work on de-energized equipment. Ground Placement: physical grounding of conductors for crew protection. Danger Tag: prohibits operation of tagged device. Caution Tag: advisory restriction. Equipment Tag: equipment-specific isolation marker. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hold_tag|clearance_tag|ground_placement|danger_tag|caution_tag|equipment_tag — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(d); IEEE Std 1584; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this safety clearance record was first created in the OMS or switching management system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: crew_count
attributes.description: Number of field crew members working under this safety clearance. Used for crew accountability tracking and to ensure all crew members are clear of the work zone before the clearance is released and equipment is re-energized.

attributes.name: crew_type
attributes.description: Classification of the field crew holding this safety clearance. Line Crew: distribution line workers. Substation Crew: substation maintenance technicians. Transmission Crew: high-voltage transmission workers. Contractor Crew: third-party contracted crew. Mutual Aid Crew: crew deployed under a mutual aid agreement from another utility.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; NERC MOU mutual aid

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Number of customers de-energized as a result of the switching and isolation actions associated with this safety clearance. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI reliability index calculation and customer notification prioritization.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; PUC Reliability Reporting; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: equipment_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the electrical equipment covered by this safety clearance, including equipment name, type, and location identifier as recorded in the OMS or GIS. Supplements the equipment_id for dispatcher and crew reference.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: grounds_applied
attributes.description: Indicates whether physical protective grounds have been applied to the de-energized conductors or equipment covered by this clearance. True = grounds applied; False = no grounds applied. Grounding is mandatory for certain voltage levels and work types per OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(n); IEEE Std 1584; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: grounds_location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the specific locations where protective grounds have been applied (e.g., 'North side of pole 47A, phase A-B-C'). Required when grounds_applied is True. Used for crew safety verification and clearance release sequencing.

attributes.name: hazard_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing specific hazard conditions, safety warnings, or special precautions associated with this clearance (e.g., proximity to energized conductors, confined space entry, asbestos presence, wildlife hazards). Communicated to field crew at time of clearance issuance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.146 (Confined Space); NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: isolation_point_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the electrical isolation boundary for this safety clearance, identifying all open points, switches, and disconnects that define the de-energized zone. Critical for crew safety verification and dispatcher situational awareness.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(d); NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1584

attributes.name: issued_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the safety clearance was formally issued to the holding crew member by the issuing dispatcher. This is the principal real-world business event time for the clearance lifecycle. Satisfies BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: life_support_customers_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any customers dependent on life support equipment (medical baseline, life support registry) are within the de-energized zone covered by this safety clearance. True = life support customers affected. Triggers priority restoration and mandatory customer notification per PUC rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Life Support Rules; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; Oracle CC&B CIS

attributes.name: lockout_tagout_ref
attributes.description: Reference number for the associated Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedure document or energy control program record, as required by OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147 for control of hazardous energy. Links the safety clearance to the formal LOTO documentation package.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: nerc_reportable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the switching and clearance activity associated with this safety clearance is subject to NERC reliability standard reporting requirements (e.g., FAC-001, FAC-002, or CIP-related switching). True = NERC reportable.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; NERC FAC-002; NERC CIP-006; FERC Order 693

attributes.name: network_segment_description
attributes.description: Description of the electrical network segment (feeder section, bus section, transmission line segment) covered by this safety clearance, including circuit identifiers and geographic boundaries. Used for dispatcher situational awareness and restoration sequencing.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: oms_clearance_ref
attributes.description: Native clearance or safety tag identifier as recorded in the source Outage Management System (GE PowerOn ADMS). Used for cross-system traceability between the lakehouse silver layer record and the operational OMS source record.

attributes.name: osha_compliance_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether all applicable OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 electrical safety requirements have been verified and documented prior to issuing this clearance, including minimum approach distances, PPE requirements, and lockout/tagout procedures. True = OSHA compliance verified.

attributes.name: planned_outage_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety clearance was issued in support of a planned (scheduled) outage rather than an unplanned interruption. True = planned outage; False = unplanned/emergency outage. Used for SAIDI/SAIFI planned vs. unplanned reliability index segregation.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; PUC Reliability Reporting; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Priority classification for this safety clearance, reflecting the urgency of the associated restoration or maintenance work. Critical: life safety or critical infrastructure. High: large customer impact or time-sensitive restoration. Normal: standard planned or unplanned work. Low: minor maintenance with minimal customer impact.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; NERC FAC-001; PUC Service Reliability Standards

attributes.name: regulatory_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for regulatory compliance notes associated with this safety clearance, including NERC FAC, OSHA, or PUC-specific documentation requirements, special reporting obligations, or compliance exceptions noted at time of issuance.
attributes.references: NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; State PUC Reporting Requirements; FERC

attributes.name: released_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the safety clearance was formally released by the holding crew member and acknowledged by the issuing dispatcher, signaling that the equipment may be re-energized. Null if the clearance has not yet been released. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269; NERC FAC-001; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: requested_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the field crew or work planner submitted the request for this safety clearance to the control room. Used to measure dispatcher response time and clearance issuance latency for safety performance reporting. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.

attributes.name: safety_state_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issuing dispatcher has formally verified that the equipment is in a safe de-energized state (confirmed open isolation points, absence of voltage, and grounding where required) prior to issuing the clearance. True = verified; False = not yet verified. Required for OSHA and NERC FAC compliance.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269(d); NERC FAC-001; IEEE Std 1584

attributes.name: scheduled_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when field work under this safety clearance is expected to be completed and the clearance released. Used for outage duration estimation and customer notification ETR (Estimated Time of Restoration). Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; SAP S/4HANA PM; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: scheduled_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Planned date and time when field work under this safety clearance is scheduled to begin. Used for planned maintenance windows and pre-scheduled outage coordination. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite; SAP S/4HANA PM; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: storm_event_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this safety clearance was issued during a declared major event or storm restoration. True = storm event clearance. Used to segregate storm-related clearances for major event day (MED) exclusion in IEEE 1366 reliability reporting.
attributes.references: IEEE Std 1366; PUC Major Event Day Reporting; NERC FAC-001

attributes.name: to_switching_order
attributes.description: FK to outage.switching_order.switching_order_id — Safety clearances are issued in conjunction with switching orders. Required for OSHA/NERC FAC compliance — every clearance must trace to the switching activity it protects.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this safety clearance record was last modified in the source system. Satisfies RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED category for TRANSACTION_HEADER role. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC CIP-007; GE PowerOn ADMS

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Incremental version counter for this safety clearance record, tracking revisions such as scope extensions, crew changes, or re-issuance after suspension. Supports audit trail requirements and change history for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NERC FAC-001; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal operating voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the equipment covered by this safety clearance. Determines the applicable OSHA electrical safety standards, required personal protective equipment (PPE), and minimum approach distances for field crew.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 Table R-6; IEEE Std 516; NERC FAC-001

products.name: puc_outage_report
products.description: Formal regulatory outage report filed with the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) for qualifying outage events meeting reportable thresholds (e.g., >50,000 customers, >8 hours, transmission-level events). Captures report type (initial, update, final), filing deadline, actual filing timestamp, reporting utility, affected customer count, outage duration, cause narrative, corrective action plan, and PUC acknowledgment status. Supports NERC EOP-004 and state PUC reporting obligations.
products.reference: PUC Outage Report (NERC EOP-004 / State PUC Rules)

attributes.name: puc_outage_report_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Public Utility Commission (PUC) Outage Report ID
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each PUC outage report record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying outage event that triggered this PUC regulatory report. Links the formal filing to the operational outage record in the Outage Management System (OMS).

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.regulatory_filing. Business justification: PUC outage reports are a specific type of regulatory filing with docket numbers, submission tracking, and approval workflows. Compliance teams manage outage reports within the broader regulatory filin

attributes.name: superseded_by_report_puc_outage_report_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Superseded By PUC Outage Report ID
attributes.description: Reference to the newer puc_outage_report_id that supersedes this record when a corrected or amended report has been filed. Null if this is the current active version. Enables version chain traversal for audit purposes.

attributes.name: actual_filing_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this report was actually submitted to the state PUC. Compared against filing_deadline_timestamp to determine on-time compliance. This is the principal business event timestamp for the report transaction.

attributes.name: affected_counties
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of county names within the utility service territory that experienced customer interruptions during this outage event. Required by many state PUCs for geographic impact assessment and emergency management coordination.

attributes.name: affected_service_territory
attributes.description: Description of the geographic service territory area impacted by the outage, such as county names, city names, or distribution circuit identifiers. Used in PUC reports to communicate the geographic scope of the event to regulators.

attributes.name: cause_narrative
attributes.description: Free-text narrative description of the root cause of the outage event as submitted in the PUC report. Provides detailed explanation beyond the cause category code, including contributing factors, sequence of events, and any relevant environmental or equipment conditions.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: Target completion date for the corrective action plan committed to in the final PUC report. Used for regulatory follow-up tracking and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: corrective_action_plan
attributes.description: Free-text description of the corrective actions taken or planned to prevent recurrence of the outage event. Required in final PUC reports. Includes infrastructure improvements, maintenance program changes, vegetation management, and operational procedure updates.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this PUC outage report record was first created in the lakehouse silver layer. Represents the audit trail creation timestamp for data governance and lineage tracking.

attributes.name: customers_affected_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer accounts that experienced an interruption during this outage event. Used to determine whether the event meets PUC reportable customer threshold (e.g., >50,000 customers) and for System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: customers_restored_count
attributes.description: Number of customer accounts that have been restored to service as of the time this report was filed. For final reports, this should equal customers_affected_count. For initial and update reports, tracks restoration progress.

attributes.name: estimated_restoration_timestamp
attributes.description: Estimated date and time by which all affected customers are expected to be restored, as reported in initial and update PUC filings. The Estimated Time of Restoration (ETR) is a key metric for customer communication and regulatory scrutiny during major events.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; OMS Best Practices

attributes.name: filing_deadline_timestamp
attributes.description: Regulatory deadline by which this report type (initial, update, or final) must be submitted to the state PUC. Calculated based on outage_start_timestamp and the applicable PUC reporting rules for the jurisdiction. Used for compliance monitoring and SLA tracking.

attributes.name: is_filed_on_time
attributes.description: Indicates whether the report was submitted to the PUC at or before the filing_deadline_timestamp. Used for regulatory compliance tracking, internal audit, and PUC performance reporting.

attributes.name: is_major_event_day
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage occurred on a day classified as a Major Event Day (MED) per IEEE 1366 beta method. MED events are typically excluded from SAIDI/SAIFI baseline calculations but must still be reported to the PUC separately.

attributes.name: is_nerc_reportable
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage event also meets NERC EOP-004 reporting thresholds and has been or must be filed with NERC in addition to the state PUC. Enables cross-regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: is_storm_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether this outage was caused by or associated with a declared storm event. Storm-related outages may have different PUC reporting requirements, extended restoration time allowances, and separate cost recovery treatment.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: life_support_customers_affected
attributes.description: Number of customers registered on the utility's life support or medical baseline program who were affected by this outage. PUC regulations typically require special notification and prioritized restoration for life support customers, and this count is a required field in many state PUC outage reports.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; PUC Life Support Rules

attributes.name: mutual_aid_activated
attributes.description: Indicates whether mutual aid assistance from other utilities was requested and activated in response to this outage event. Mutual aid activation is a reportable fact in many state PUC major event reports and NERC EOP-004 filings.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004; ESOP

attributes.name: nerc_event_report_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Event Report Number
attributes.description: NERC-assigned event report number for the corresponding NERC EOP-004 filing, when applicable. Enables cross-referencing between the state PUC report and the federal NERC submission for the same outage event.

attributes.name: oms_incident_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the corresponding incident record in the Outage Management System (OMS), specifically GE PowerOn ADMS. Enables traceability between the regulatory PUC report and the operational OMS incident record.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS; OMS Integration Standards

attributes.name: outage_cause_category
attributes.description: High-level cause category for the outage event as reported to the PUC. Derived from the OMS outage cause classification and mapped to PUC-required cause taxonomy. Distinct from the detailed cause code in the outage_cause reference product.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; IEEE 1366; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: outage_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of the outage event in minutes, measured from outage_start_timestamp to outage_end_timestamp. Used to assess whether the event meets PUC reportable duration thresholds (e.g., >8 hours) and for SAIDI/CAIDI reliability index calculations.
attributes.references: IEEE 1366; State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: outage_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the last affected customer was restored and the outage event was officially closed. Used to calculate total outage duration for SAIDI/CAIDI reporting and to confirm restoration completion.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; State PUC Reporting Requirements; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: outage_start_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reportable outage event began, as recorded in the Outage Management System (OMS). This is the principal real-world event time used to calculate outage duration and filing deadline compliance.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; State PUC Reporting Requirements; IEEE 1366

attributes.name: outage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the outage by the level of the electric grid affected. Transmission-level events typically have lower PUC reporting thresholds than distribution events. Used to route reports to the appropriate regulatory body and apply correct reporting rules.
attributes.references: State PUC Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004; FERC

attributes.name: prepared_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the utility employee responsible for preparing and submitting this PUC outage report. Required for regulatory accountability and as the point of contact for PUC inquiries about the filing.

attributes.name: prepared_by_phone
attributes.description: Direct phone number of the utility employee who prepared this PUC outage report. Provided to the PUC as the contact number for follow-up questions regarding the filing.

attributes.name: prepared_by_title
attributes.description: Job title of the utility employee who prepared this PUC outage report (e.g., 'Manager, Regulatory Affairs', 'Director, Grid Operations'). Required by some PUCs to confirm appropriate organizational authority for the filing.

attributes.name: puc_acknowledgment_status
attributes.description: Status of the PUC's formal acknowledgment or acceptance of this report filing. 'pending' indicates awaiting PUC response; 'acknowledged' indicates receipt confirmed; 'accepted' indicates formally accepted without deficiency; 'rejected' indicates returned with deficiency notice requiring resubmission.

attributes.name: puc_acknowledgment_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the state PUC formally acknowledged or responded to this report filing. Null if acknowledgment has not yet been received.

attributes.name: puc_docket_number
attributes.description: Official docket or case number assigned by the state PUC upon receipt of the outage report. Used for tracking the regulatory proceeding and all subsequent correspondence with the commission.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: puc_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code identifying the state Public Utility Commission (PUC) to which this report is filed. Determines applicable reporting thresholds, deadlines, and format requirements.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: puc_rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text description of the reason provided by the PUC for rejecting or returning this report filing. Populated only when puc_acknowledgment_status is 'rejected'. Used to guide corrective resubmission.

attributes.name: puc_report_to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — PUC reports are filed for specific qualifying outage events. Must link to the event(s) being reported for regulatory traceability.

attributes.name: report_number
attributes.description: Externally-known, human-readable report identifier assigned by the reporting utility and submitted to the state PUC. Used as the official reference number in all regulatory correspondence and acknowledgment tracking (e.g., PUC-2024-OUT-00123).
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: report_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this regulatory report filing. 'draft' indicates preparation in progress; 'submitted' indicates filed with PUC; 'acknowledged' indicates PUC receipt confirmed; 'accepted' indicates PUC formally accepted; 'rejected' indicates PUC returned for correction; 'superseded' indicates replaced by a subsequent filing.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: report_type
attributes.description: Indicates the filing stage of this report submission: 'initial' (first notification within required timeframe), 'update' (interim progress report), or 'final' (complete post-restoration report with root cause and corrective actions). Multiple report types may exist per outage event.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reporting Requirements; NERC EOP-004

attributes.name: report_version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this report record, incremented each time the report is revised and resubmitted to the PUC. Version 1 represents the original submission; subsequent versions represent amendments or corrections.

attributes.name: reporting_utility_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the electric utility entity filing this PUC outage report. Required on all regulatory submissions to identify the responsible regulated entity.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Reporting Requirements; FERC

attributes.name: reporting_utility_nerc_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Reporting Utility North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) ID
attributes.description: NERC-assigned registered entity identifier for the reporting utility. Used to cross-reference NERC EOP-004 filings and to uniquely identify the utility across multi-state regulatory submissions.

attributes.name: saidi_contribution_minutes
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI) Contribution (Minutes)
attributes.description: This outage event's contribution to the utility's System Average Interruption Duration Index (SAIDI), calculated as (customer_interruption_minutes / total_customers_served). Reported to the PUC as part of annual reliability performance metrics.

attributes.name: saifi_contribution
attributes.business_glossary_term: System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI) Contribution
attributes.description: This outage event's contribution to the utility's System Average Interruption Frequency Index (SAIFI), calculated as (customers_affected / total_customers_served). Reported to the PUC as part of annual reliability performance metrics.

attributes.name: to_outage_event
attributes.description: FK to outage.outage_event.outage_event_id — PUC reports are filed for specific qualifying outage events. Required for regulatory compliance tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this PUC outage report record was last modified in the lakehouse silver layer. Used for incremental data processing, change detection, and audit trail maintenance.

attributes.name: voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage level in kilovolts (kV) of the highest-voltage facility involved in the outage event. Used to classify the outage as transmission-level (typically ≥69 kV) or distribution-level, which determines applicable PUC and NERC reporting thresholds.
attributes.references: NERC EOP-004; State PUC Reporting Requirements; IEEE

products.name: storm_der_impact
products.description: This association product represents the operational impact assessment between a storm event and a distributed energy resource system. It captures DER performance, availability, and grid interaction behavior during major weather events for regulatory reporting, after-action analysis, and DER program evaluation. Each record links one storm event to one DER system with metrics that exist only in the context of that specific storm's impact on that specific DER asset.. Existence Justification: In energy utility operations, storm events impact multiple DER systems across the affected service territory (one storm affects hundreds or thousands of DER installations), and each DER system experiences multiple storm events over its operational lifetime (10-25 years). Utilities actively manage and track DER performance during Major Event Days for regulatory compliance (DOE OE-417 filings, IEEE 1366 MED reporting), after-action analysis, mutual aid coordination, and DER program evaluation. This is an operational assessment process, not an analytical correlation.

domains.name: supply
domains.description: Utility supply chain including materials management, procurement of transformers, conductors, meters, poles, generation spare parts, fuel supply contracts (gas, coal, uranium), vendor management, inventory warehouses, and logistics. Manages purchase orders, supplier contracts, spare parts catalog, warehouse stock levels, and emergency restoration supply chain within SAP S/4HANA MM. Supports T&D construction material sourcing and supply chain resilience.

products.name: material_master
products.description: Master record for all physical materials managed in the utility supply chain — transformers, conductors, meters, poles, insulators, generation spare parts, and fuel commodities. Captures material identification (number, description, type, group), physical attributes (base unit of measure, weight, dimensions), storage and handling requirements (hazardous classification, storage conditions), procurement parameters (procurement type, vendor-specific pricing via info records with net price, price unit, validity period), and financial valuation (valuation class, standard price, moving average price, price control indicator). SSOT for all utility material definitions and their valuation across the enterprise.
products.reference: SAP MM Material Master (MM01/MM60)

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure

attributes.name: gross_weight

attributes.name: hazard_class

attributes.name: industry_sector

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Master LAEDA

attributes.name: manufacturer_name
attributes.description: Name of the original equipment manufacturer or producer of the material. Used for quality tracking, warranty management, and approved vendor lists.

attributes.name: material_group
