attributes.description: Financial accounting entity representing the legal company or subsidiary for which this purchase order is issued. Standard 4-character code in SAP.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Reference to a master contract, framework agreement, or Power Purchase Agreement (PPA) under which this purchase order is issued. Used for fuel supply contracts, long-term service agreements, and renewable energy PPAs.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Organizational cost center to which the purchase order costs will be charged. Used for internal cost allocation and departmental budgeting. Standard 10-character code in SAP.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this purchase order (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Requested or committed date by which the vendor must deliver the goods or complete the services. Used for logistics planning and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: emergency_order_flag
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this is an emergency procurement order for outage restoration, critical equipment failure, or storm response. Emergency orders may bypass standard approval workflows and expedite delivery.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether goods receipt posting is required for this purchase order. True for material purchases requiring physical receipt confirmation; false for services or direct invoicing scenarios.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities, costs, and risks between buyer and seller for delivery of goods. Standard ICC Incoterms 2020 codes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EXW|FCA|CPT|CIP|DAP|DPU|DDP|FAS|FOB|CFR|CIF — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Specific location or point referenced in the Incoterms clause (e.g., port name, warehouse address, delivery point).

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether invoice verification is required for this purchase order. Controls whether the PO flows through the invoice verification process.

attributes.name: material_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the materials or services being procured (e.g., T&D Construction Materials, Generation Spare Parts, Fuel Supply, Professional Services, Emergency Restoration Materials). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: td_construction|generation_spares|fuel_supply|meters_ami|transformers|conductors|poles_structures|professional_services|it_equipment|vehicles_fleet|safety_equipment|office_supplies|emergency_restoration — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the purchase order record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the purchase order record was last modified. Audit trail for record updates.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special terms, or internal notes related to the purchase order. May include vendor communication history, special handling requirements, or procurement justification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Text

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount conditions for invoice payment. Standard 4-character code in SAP (e.g., Z001 for Net 30 days, Z002 for 2/10 Net 30).

attributes.name: plant
attributes.description: Physical location or facility where the procured materials or services will be delivered and consumed. May represent generation plants, substations, warehouses, or service centers. Standard 4-character code in SAP.

attributes.name: po_date
attributes.description: Date when the purchase order was created and issued to the vendor. Represents the principal business event timestamp for the procurement transaction.

attributes.name: po_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique purchase order document number assigned by the procurement system. Standard 10-digit format in SAP S/4HANA MM.

attributes.name: po_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order in the procure-to-pay workflow. Tracks progression from creation through goods receipt and invoice verification to closure. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|in_process|partially_received|fully_received|closed|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Lifecycle

attributes.name: po_type
attributes.description: Classification of the purchase order based on procurement scenario: standard (one-time material purchase), framework (blanket agreement), subcontracting (external processing), consignment (vendor-owned inventory), service (non-material procurement), stock_transport (inter-plant transfer).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Types

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project, construction project, or work breakdown structure (WBS) element to which this purchase order is assigned. Used for project cost tracking and CAPEX management.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for managing this purchase order. Represents the functional group handling vendor relationships and negotiations. Standard 3-character code in SAP.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for procurement activities. Represents the legal entity or business unit negotiating terms with vendors. Standard 4-character code in SAP.

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Reference to the source purchase requisition document that initiated this purchase order. Links PO to the original material or service request.

attributes.name: shipping_instructions
attributes.description: Special instructions for the vendor regarding packaging, shipping method, delivery hours, site access requirements, or handling of hazardous materials. Critical for large equipment deliveries to generation plants or substations.
attributes.references: Utility Logistics and Site Access Procedures

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Specific warehouse or storage area within the plant where materials will be received and stored. Standard 4-character code in SAP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: total_gross_value
attributes.description: Total gross monetary value of the purchase order including taxes and all additional charges. Represents the final amount payable to the vendor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Pricing

attributes.name: total_net_value
attributes.description: Total net monetary value of the purchase order before taxes and additional charges. Sum of all line item net values. Expressed in the currency specified by currency_code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Purchase Order Pricing

attributes.name: total_tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount applicable to the purchase order. Includes sales tax, VAT, GST, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: vendor_quote_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the vendor quotation or bid that was accepted and converted into this purchase order. Links PO to the source quotation for audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Request for Quotation

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the procurement specialist or system user who created the purchase order record.

products.name: po_line_item
products.description: Individual line item within a purchase order capturing material-level procurement detail. Captures line identification (PO line number), material specification (material number, short text, quantity ordered, unit of measure), pricing (net price, price unit), delivery requirements (delivery date, plant, storage location), account assignment (category, cost center or WBS element), receipt controls (goods receipt indicator, invoice receipt indicator), and line item status. Supports granular tracking of multi-material procurement events for T&D construction, generation maintenance, and fuel supply.
products.reference: SAP MM PO Item (EKPO)

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the purchase order line item. Primary key for the po_line_item product.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.material_master.material_master_id — Each PO line item references a material being procured. This FK enables material-level procurement analysis and inventory planning.

attributes.name: po_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record. Identifies the specific material, equipment, or spare part being procured (e.g., transformer, conductor, meter, pole, generation spare part).

attributes.name: po_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent purchase order header. Links this line item to its containing purchase order document.

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.purchase_order.purchase_order_id — Header-to-line relationship. Every PO line item belongs to exactly one PO header. Without this FK the line items are orphaned and unusable.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_requisition. Business justification: PO line items are created from purchase requisitions. N:1 relationship - one PO line item typically fulfills one requisition line (though consolidation is possible). Adding purchase_requisition_id FK

attributes.name: to_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.material_master.material_master_id — Every PO line item procures a specific material. This FK is required for inventory tracking, spend analysis, and three-way matching.

attributes.name: to_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.purchase_order.purchase_order_id — Header-to-line relationship is the most fundamental FK in procurement. Every PO line item MUST reference its parent PO header. Without this, the PO structure is broken and unusable.

attributes.name: account_assignment_category
attributes.description: Account assignment category code defining how costs are allocated. Values: K=Cost Center, A=Asset, P=Project/WBS Element, F=Order, N=Network, U=Unknown. Determines financial posting logic.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Fixed asset number when account_assignment_category is A. Links procurement to specific capital assets such as transformers, turbines, or transmission lines.

attributes.name: confirmation_control_key
attributes.description: Confirmation control key defining whether and how vendor confirmations are expected for this line item. Manages order acknowledgment and delivery confirmation workflows.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code for account assignment when account_assignment_category is K. Used for O&M expense allocation to organizational units.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order line item record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record origination.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the line item pricing (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD). Defines the monetary unit for all financial values on this line.

attributes.name: deletion_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line item is marked for deletion. True if the line has been logically deleted but retained for audit purposes; False if active.

attributes.name: delivery_date
attributes.description: Requested or scheduled delivery date for the material or service. Critical for T&D construction project planning, generation maintenance scheduling, and fuel supply coordination.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: General ledger account number for financial posting. Defines the expense or asset account to which this procurement cost is charged.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_based_invoice_verification
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoice verification is based on goods receipt. True if invoices can only be posted after goods receipt; False if invoice can precede receipt.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether goods receipt is required for this line item. True if physical receipt must be posted; False for services or non-stock items.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: Incoterms code defining delivery terms and transfer of risk (e.g., FOB, CIF, DDP). Specifies responsibilities for shipping, insurance, and customs.

attributes.name: incoterms_location
attributes.description: Named location associated with the Incoterms (e.g., port of shipment, destination facility). Provides geographic context for delivery terms.

attributes.name: invoice_receipt_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether invoice receipt is expected for this line item. True if vendor invoice verification is required; False if invoice is not applicable.

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: Item category code defining the type of procurement item (e.g., standard, consignment, subcontracting, service, text). Controls procurement processing logic.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this purchase order line item record was last updated. Audit trail for record change tracking.

attributes.name: line_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the purchase order line item. Tracks progression from open order through receipt to closure.

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line item number within the purchase order. Determines the ordering and position of this line item in the PO document.

attributes.name: manufacturer_part_number
attributes.description: Original equipment manufacturer (OEM) part number for the material. Critical for spare parts procurement and equipment maintenance.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Material group classification code for procurement categorization. Groups similar materials for reporting and analysis (e.g., transformers, conductors, meters, fuel).

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the material being procured. Human-readable material code used in procurement operations and inventory management.

attributes.name: net_order_value
attributes.description: Total net value of the line item calculated as quantity_ordered multiplied by net_price adjusted for price_unit. Represents the total procurement cost for this line before taxes.

attributes.name: net_price
attributes.description: Net price per unit of measure for the material or service. Base price before taxes, discounts, or surcharges.

attributes.name: over_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage over-delivery tolerance allowed for this line item. Defines acceptable variance above ordered quantity before triggering exception handling.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Plant or facility code where the material will be delivered. Identifies the receiving location such as generation plant, warehouse, or service center.

attributes.name: price_unit
attributes.description: Price unit quantity that the net price relates to. For example, if price_unit is 100 and net_price is 50, the price is 50 per 100 units.

attributes.name: purchase_requisition_line_number
attributes.description: Line item number within the source purchase requisition. Provides granular traceability from PO line to originating requisition line.

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Purchasing group code responsible for this line item. Identifies the procurement team or buyer managing this purchase.

attributes.name: quantity_invoiced
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity invoiced by the vendor against this line item to date. Supports three-way match reconciliation between PO, goods receipt, and invoice.

attributes.name: quantity_ordered
attributes.description: Quantity of material or service ordered on this line item. Represents the procurement volume for this specific material.

attributes.name: quantity_received
attributes.description: Cumulative quantity of material received against this line item to date. Tracks fulfillment progress and outstanding delivery balance.

attributes.name: requisitioner_name
attributes.description: Name of the person or department that requested this material or service. Identifies the internal business stakeholder driving the procurement need.

attributes.name: short_text
attributes.description: Brief description of the material or service being procured on this line item. Provides human-readable context for the line item content.

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Storage location code within the plant where the material will be stored upon receipt. Defines the specific warehouse or inventory location.

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code determining applicable sales tax, VAT, or other tax treatment for this line item. Drives tax calculation in invoice verification.

attributes.name: under_delivery_tolerance_percent
attributes.description: Percentage under-delivery tolerance allowed for this line item. Defines acceptable variance below ordered quantity before requiring follow-up action.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the ordered quantity (e.g., EA for each, MT for metric ton, M for meter, KG for kilogram). Defines the measurement unit for procurement quantities.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: Vendor's own material number or part number for the procured item. Facilitates cross-reference between utility and supplier catalogs.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: WBS element code for project-based account assignment when account_assignment_category is P. Links procurement to capital projects such as T&D construction or generation upgrades.

products.name: goods_receipt
products.description: Unified inventory movement document recording all material movements across the utility supply chain. Covers inbound receipts (purchase order deliveries, production receipts, field returns), outbound issues (cost center consumption, project issues, work order withdrawals, field crew material picks), and inter-location transfers (warehouse-to-warehouse, plant-to-plant, emergency rebalancing, mutual aid movements). Captures document identification (material document number, posting date), movement classification (movement type, direction), material and quantity details, location context (sending/receiving plant and storage location), cost allocation (cost center, WBS element, work order), transfer logistics (reason, transport mode, transit dates), batch tracking, and quality inspection status. Triggers real-time inventory updates and supports three-way match for invoice verification. Critical for T&D construction material tracking, generation maintenance consumption, fuel delivery confirmation, and emergency restoration logistics.
products.reference: SAP MM Goods Receipt (MIGO/MSEG)

attributes.name: goods_receipt_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the goods receipt transaction. Primary key for the goods receipt record.

attributes.name: goods_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the material master record. Identifies the specific material (transformer, conductor, meter, pole, spare part, fuel) involved in this goods movement.

attributes.name: goods_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.purchase_order. Business justification: Goods receipts are recorded against purchase orders. N:1 relationship - many goods receipts for one PO (partial deliveries, multiple shipments). Adding purchase_order_id FK enables JOIN to retrieve PO

attributes.name: goods_warehouse_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.warehouse.warehouse_id — Goods movements occur at specific warehouse/storage locations. Required for inventory location tracking.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.material_master.material_master_id — Every inventory movement references a material. Required for inventory position calculation and material consumption tracking.

attributes.name: po_line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.po_line_item. Business justification: Goods receipts are recorded at the PO line item level. N:1 relationship - many goods receipts for one PO line item (partial deliveries). Adding po_line_item_id FK enables JOIN to retrieve line-level d

attributes.name: purchase_order_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.purchase_order.purchase_order_id — Goods receipts for POs reference the originating purchase order. Critical for three-way match (PO→GR→IV) and procurement lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: receiving_warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse. Business justification: Goods are received into specific warehouses. N:1 relationship - many receipts into one warehouse. Adding receiving_warehouse_id FK enables JOIN to retrieve warehouse master data. Not removing receivin

attributes.name: to_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.material_master.material_master_id — Every goods movement involves a specific material. Required for inventory posting and material document integrity.

attributes.name: to_purchase_order_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.purchase_order.purchase_order_id — GR for PO (movement type 101) must reference the PO for three-way matching. This is the core link enabling invoice verification.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the vendor (supplier) master record. Identifies the supplier for inbound receipts from external sources.

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.warehouse.warehouse_id — Inventory movements occur at a specific warehouse/storage location. Required for warehouse-level inventory accuracy and movement history.

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: The batch or lot number for batch-managed materials. Enables traceability for quality control, warranty tracking, and recall management. Critical for fuel deliveries and critical spare parts.

attributes.name: bill_of_lading
attributes.description: The bill of lading number for shipments. Legal document issued by the carrier acknowledging receipt of cargo for shipment.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: The cost center to which material consumption is charged for outbound issues. Used for internal cost allocation and departmental expense tracking.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who created the goods receipt record in the system. Audit field for accountability and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the valuation amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: delivery_note_number
attributes.description: The external delivery note or packing slip number provided by the vendor. Used for matching physical deliveries to system records.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the external source document (e.g., delivery note date, packing slip date). May differ from posting date when documents are processed with a delay.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The date when the goods receipt record was created in the system by the user. Audit timestamp for data entry.

attributes.name: gl_account
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which the inventory value change is posted. Determines the financial accounting treatment of the goods movement.

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text notes or comments entered at the document header level. Used for special instructions, explanations, or contextual information about the goods movement.

attributes.name: inspection_lot_number
attributes.description: The quality inspection lot number created for this goods receipt. Links the material movement to quality inspection results and certificates.

attributes.name: item_text
attributes.description: Free-form text notes or comments specific to this line item. Used for material-specific details, condition notes, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: material_description
attributes.description: Short text description of the material for display and reporting purposes. Denormalized from material master for query performance.

attributes.name: material_document_item
attributes.description: Line item number within the material document. Allows multiple material movements to be grouped under a single document header.

attributes.name: material_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known SAP material document number that uniquely identifies this goods movement transaction in the ERP system. Used for traceability and audit purposes.

attributes.name: material_document_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the material document was posted. Part of the compound business key with material document number.

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: The business material number (SKU) from the material master. Human-readable identifier for the material being received or issued.

attributes.name: movement_direction
attributes.description: High-level classification of the inventory movement direction: inbound (receipts into inventory), outbound (issues from inventory), or transfer (location-to-location movements).

attributes.name: movement_type
attributes.description: Three-digit SAP movement type code that classifies the nature of the inventory transaction (e.g., 101=GR from PO, 201=GR to cost center, 311=transfer posting, 551=scrapping). Determines accounting treatment and inventory impact.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the plant (generation station, service center, warehouse, or operational facility) where the goods movement occurred.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the goods movement was posted to inventory and financial accounting. This is the principal business event timestamp for the transaction and determines the fiscal period for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: purchase_order_item
attributes.description: The line item number on the purchase order. Null for non-PO movements.

attributes.name: quality_inspection_status
attributes.description: The quality inspection status for the received material. Determines whether the material is available for unrestricted use or must remain in quality hold until inspection is complete.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: The quantity of material moved in this transaction, expressed in the base unit of measure. Positive for receipts, negative for issues in some movement types.

attributes.name: reason_code
attributes.description: The reason code explaining the purpose or cause of the goods movement (e.g., emergency restoration, planned maintenance, field return, obsolescence, damage). Used for root cause analysis and supply chain optimization.

attributes.name: receiving_plant_code
attributes.description: For transfer movements, the plant code of the destination location. Null for non-transfer movements.

attributes.name: receiving_storage_location
attributes.description: For transfer movements, the storage location code of the destination. Null for non-transfer movements.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this goods receipt is a reversal (cancellation) of a previous goods movement. True if this is a reversal transaction.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The material document number of the original transaction that this reversal cancels. Null for non-reversal transactions.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: The unique serial number for serialized materials (e.g., meters, transformers, high-value equipment). Enables individual asset tracking and lifecycle management.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating special stock categories (e.g., project stock, sales order stock, consignment stock). Determines special handling and valuation rules.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: The inventory stock type classification: unrestricted (available for use), quality inspection (pending QC), blocked (unusable), restricted (limited use), or consignment (vendor-owned).

attributes.name: storage_location
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the specific storage location (warehouse, yard, bin, or storeroom) within the plant where the material is stored.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: The unit in which the quantity is expressed (e.g., EA=each, FT=feet, LB=pounds, GAL=gallons, TON=tons). ISO unit code.

attributes.name: unloading_point
attributes.description: The specific physical location or dock where the material was unloaded. Used for warehouse logistics and receiving dock management.

attributes.name: valuation_amount
attributes.description: The total monetary value of the goods movement in the company currency. Calculated as quantity multiplied by the material valuation price at the time of posting.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The WBS element (project phase or task) to which material is charged for capital projects. Used for tracking T&D construction material costs and CAPEX allocation.

attributes.name: work_order_number
attributes.description: The maintenance or service work order number for material withdrawals supporting field maintenance activities. Links material consumption to asset maintenance events.

products.name: warehouse_stock
products.description: Current and period-end inventory stock levels for utility materials across all warehouse locations, substations, and field storerooms. Captures stock position per material and location: plant, storage location, stock type (unrestricted, quality inspection, blocked, in-transit, consignment), quantity on hand, unit of measure, stock value, and last movement date. Includes replenishment parameters: reorder point, safety stock level, maximum stock level, and slow-moving indicator. Supports emergency restoration supply chain readiness assessment, T&D construction material availability planning, and generation spare parts stocking optimization.
products.reference: SAP MM Stock Overview (MMBE/MARD)

attributes.name: warehouse_stock_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse stock record. Primary key for the warehouse stock entity.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.material_master.material_master_id — Stock levels are tracked per material. This FK enables material-level inventory queries and reorder point monitoring.

attributes.name: primary_warehouse_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.warehouse. Business justification: Stock is physically stored in a warehouse/storage location. N:1 relationship - many stock records for one warehouse. Adding warehouse_id FK enables JOIN to retrieve warehouse master data (name, addres

attributes.name: to_material_master_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.material_master.material_master_id — Stock levels are per-material. This FK is essential for inventory queries, reorder point checks, and MRP.

attributes.name: to_warehouse_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.warehouse.warehouse_id — Stock levels are per-warehouse/storage-location. Required for location-specific inventory management.

attributes.name: warehouse_material_master_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to supply.material_master. Business justification: Warehouse stock records track inventory levels for specific materials. N:1 relationship - many stock records (across locations, time periods, stock types) reference one material master. Adding materia

attributes.name: abc_indicator
attributes.description: ABC analysis classification for inventory management priority. A=High-value/critical items requiring tight control, B=Moderate-value items, C=Low-value items with relaxed control, X=Unclassified.

attributes.name: available_quantity
attributes.description: Net available quantity for new consumption, calculated as unrestricted quantity on hand minus reserved quantity. Represents true available-to-promise inventory.

attributes.name: base_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for the material quantity. EA=Each, FT=Feet, M=Meters, KG=Kilograms, LB=Pounds, GAL=Gallons, L=Liters, TON=Tons, MT=Metric Tons, ROLL=Roll, SPOOL=Spool, SET=Set, KIT=Kit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: EA|FT|M|KG|LB|GAL|L|TON|MT|ROLL|SPOOL|SET|KIT — 13 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: batch_number
attributes.description: Batch or lot number for materials managed with batch-level traceability (e.g., chemicals, fuels, certain spare parts). Enables quality tracking and recall management.

attributes.name: blocked_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity that has been blocked from use due to quality issues, damage, or other restrictions. Cannot be issued until block is removed.

attributes.name: consignment_vendor_code
attributes.description: Vendor identifier for consignment stock arrangements where the vendor owns inventory stored at utility locations until consumption. Populated only for consignment stock type.

attributes.name: critical_spare_part_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this material is classified as a critical spare part for generation or T&D assets. True if stockout would cause significant operational impact or extended outage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the stock value amount.

attributes.name: emergency_restoration_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this material is designated for emergency storm restoration and outage response. True if material is pre-positioned for rapid deployment during major events.

attributes.name: fiscal_year_period
attributes.description: Fiscal year and period for which this stock position is reported, in format YYYYPPP (e.g., 2024001 for period 001 of fiscal year 2024). Enables period-end inventory reporting.

attributes.name: in_quality_inspection_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity currently in quality inspection status awaiting QA approval before release to unrestricted stock. Typically applies to newly received materials.

attributes.name: in_transit_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity currently in transit between storage locations or plants via stock transfer orders. Not yet available at destination location.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Transport Order

attributes.name: last_goods_issue_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods issue transaction that decreased stock at this location. Indicates last consumption or withdrawal activity.

attributes.name: last_goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent goods receipt transaction that increased stock at this location. Indicates last replenishment activity.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent physical inventory count or cycle count performed for this material at this location. Used for inventory accuracy tracking.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: Hierarchical classification code grouping similar materials for procurement and inventory planning. Examples: transformers, conductors, meters, poles, generation parts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Group Master

attributes.name: material_number
attributes.description: Unique material identifier from the materials master catalog. Identifies the specific utility material (transformer, conductor, meter, pole, generation spare part, etc.) being stocked.

attributes.name: material_type
attributes.description: Classification of material category. ROH=Raw Material, HALB=Semi-Finished, FERT=Finished Product, HAWA=Trading Goods, ERSA=Spare Parts, UNBW=Non-Valuated Material, NLAG=Non-Stock Material, DIEN=Services, VERP=Packaging, HIBE=Operating Supplies, IBAU=Maintenance Assembly. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: ROH|HALB|FERT|HAWA|ERSA|UNBW|NLAG|DIEN|VERP|HIBE|IBAU — 11 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Material Type Configuration

attributes.name: maximum_stock_level
attributes.description: Upper limit for inventory quantity to prevent overstocking and excess capital tied up in inventory. Used in reorder quantity calculations.

attributes.name: mrp_type
attributes.description: Code defining the MRP procedure for this material. PD=MRP, VB=Manual Reorder Point, VM=Automatic Reorder Point, VV=Forecast-Based Planning, ND=No Planning, X0=No MRP.

attributes.name: obsolete_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this material has been marked as obsolete and should be phased out of inventory. True if material is no longer procured or used.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the plant or facility where the material is stocked. Represents the organizational unit responsible for inventory management.

attributes.name: procurement_type
attributes.description: Defines how the material is procured. F=External Procurement (purchased), E=In-House Production (manufactured), X=Both.

attributes.name: quantity_on_hand
attributes.description: Current physical inventory quantity available at this plant and storage location for this material and stock type. Represents the actual count of units in stock.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse stock record was first created in the source system.

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse stock record was last updated in the source system. Tracks data freshness and change activity.

attributes.name: reorder_point_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum stock level that triggers automatic replenishment. When quantity on hand falls below this threshold, a purchase requisition or order is generated.

attributes.name: reserved_quantity
attributes.description: Quantity of unrestricted stock that has been reserved for specific work orders, projects, or planned consumption but not yet issued. Reduces available-to-promise quantity.

attributes.name: safety_stock_quantity
attributes.description: Buffer stock quantity maintained to protect against demand variability and supply chain disruptions. Critical for emergency restoration supply chain readiness.

attributes.name: serial_number_profile
attributes.description: Code indicating the serial number management profile for serialized materials (e.g., meters, transformers, high-value equipment). Defines serialization requirements and tracking rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Serial Number Management

attributes.name: slow_moving_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this material is classified as slow-moving based on consumption velocity analysis. True if no movement in defined period (e.g., 12 months).

attributes.name: snapshot_date
attributes.description: Date for which this stock position snapshot was captured. Supports historical inventory analysis and period-end reporting.

attributes.name: special_stock_indicator
attributes.description: Code for special stock categories. E=Sales Order Stock, K=Consignment at Customer, O=Project Stock, Q=Quality Inspection, V=Vendor Consignment, W=Consignment at Vendor, M=Pipeline/In-Transit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: E|K|O|Q|V|W|M — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Special Stock Configuration

attributes.name: stock_coverage_days
attributes.description: Calculated number of days the current stock quantity will last based on average daily consumption rate. Key metric for supply chain resilience assessment.

attributes.name: stock_type
attributes.description: Classification of stock availability status. Unrestricted stock is available for use; quality inspection stock is pending QA approval; blocked stock is restricted from use; in-transit stock is moving between locations; consignment stock is vendor-owned; project stock is allocated to specific capital projects; subcontracting stock is at vendor location. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: unrestricted|quality_inspection|blocked|in_transit|consignment|project_stock|subcontracting — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Stock Type Configuration

attributes.name: stock_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value of the stock on hand at this location, calculated using the material valuation price multiplied by quantity. Represents the financial investment in inventory.

attributes.name: storage_location_code
attributes.description: Four-character code identifying the specific storage location within the plant (warehouse, substation storeroom, field depot, central warehouse, etc.).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Storage Location Master

attributes.name: valuation_class
attributes.description: Four-digit code that groups materials for accounting and financial reporting purposes. Links inventory to General Ledger (GL) accounts.

products.name: warehouse
products.description: Master record for all utility warehouse facilities, field storerooms, and staging areas used to store T&D construction materials, generation spare parts, meters, and emergency restoration stock. Captures facility identification (warehouse number, name, type: central, regional, field storeroom, mobile), organizational assignment (plant), physical attributes (address, GPS coordinates, storage capacity), capability flags (climate control, hazmat storage certification), and responsible warehouse manager. Supports warehouse network planning and emergency restoration staging logistics.
products.reference: SAP WM Warehouse Number (LG01)

attributes.name: warehouse_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the warehouse facility. Primary key for the warehouse master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Materials Management (MM) - Storage Location Master

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Warehouses operate as cost centers for overhead allocation - facility rent, utilities, labor costs tracked. Essential for inventory carrying cost calculation and rate base allocation in regulated util

attributes.name: manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the warehouse manager. Links to the HR system for contact information and organizational hierarchy.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.nerc_cip_asset. Business justification: Warehouses storing CIP-critical equipment are physical security perimeters (CIP-006). Real business process: CIP physical security compliance, access control, and critical infrastructure protection fo

attributes.name: address_line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the warehouse facility including street number and name. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: address_line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address information such as building number, suite, or unit. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality where the warehouse facility is located. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: climate_controlled_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility has climate control systems (HVAC) to maintain temperature and humidity within specified ranges. Critical for storing sensitive materials such as electronic meters, batteries, and certain generation spare parts.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that owns or operates this warehouse facility. Used for financial accounting and asset ownership tracking.

attributes.name: construction_year
attributes.description: Year in which the warehouse facility was originally constructed. Used for asset age analysis, depreciation calculations, and facility modernization planning.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code where the warehouse facility is located (e.g., 'USA', 'CAN', 'MEX').

attributes.name: crane_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility has overhead crane or gantry crane equipment for handling heavy or oversized materials such as large transformers, turbine components, or pole sections.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse master record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: cycle_count_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which physical inventory cycle counts are performed at this warehouse facility to verify inventory accuracy and reconcile discrepancies with the SAP MM system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Physical Inventory Procedures

attributes.name: decommission_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse facility was permanently closed and removed from active service. Null for active facilities. Used for asset retirement accounting and historical analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location Valid To

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the warehouse facility became operational and available for inventory storage. Marks the beginning of the facility's active lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location Valid From

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the warehouse facility for business correspondence and logistics coordination. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: emergency_restoration_designated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility is designated as an emergency restoration staging area for storm response and outage restoration operations. These facilities maintain critical spare parts inventory (poles, transformers, conductors) and are staffed 24/7 during major events.

attributes.name: fax_number
attributes.description: Fax number for the warehouse facility, if applicable. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: fire_suppression_system_type
attributes.description: Type of fire suppression system installed at the warehouse facility. Sprinkler systems are standard for most facilities, foam systems are used for flammable liquid storage, gas systems (e.g., FM-200) are used for electronics storage, and some field storerooms may have no automated system.
attributes.references: NFPA 13 - Sprinkler System Installation; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.159

attributes.name: forklift_capacity_tons
attributes.description: Maximum lifting capacity of the largest forklift or material handling equipment available at the warehouse facility, measured in tons. Determines the maximum weight of individual items that can be handled (e.g., transformers, cable reels).

attributes.name: hazmat_certified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility is certified to store hazardous materials such as transformer oil, PCB-containing equipment, batteries, fuel, and chemical supplies. Certification requires compliance with EPA and OSHA regulations.
attributes.references: EPA RCRA - Hazardous Waste Storage Requirements; OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120

attributes.name: insurance_policy_number
attributes.description: Insurance policy number covering the warehouse facility and its contents. Used for risk management and claims processing in the event of damage or loss.

attributes.name: inventory_valuation_method
attributes.description: Accounting method used to value inventory stored at this warehouse facility. FIFO (First In First Out), LIFO (Last In First Out), weighted average, or standard cost methods are used for financial reporting and CAPEX/OPEX allocation.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 330 - Inventory; SAP S/4HANA MM - Valuation Configuration

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this warehouse master record was last updated in the system. Used for data lineage and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: last_physical_inventory_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent complete physical inventory count performed at this warehouse facility. Used to track compliance with inventory audit requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Physical Inventory Document

attributes.name: last_renovation_year
attributes.description: Year of the most recent major renovation or expansion of the warehouse facility. Used to track facility condition and plan future capital investments.

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the warehouse facility in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, emergency restoration logistics planning, and proximity analysis.

attributes.name: lease_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the lease agreement for leased warehouse facilities. Null for owned facilities. Used for lease renewal planning and OPEX forecasting.

attributes.name: loading_dock_count
attributes.description: Number of loading docks available at the warehouse facility for receiving and shipping materials. Impacts throughput capacity and logistics scheduling.
attributes.references: Warehouse Design Standards - Loading Dock Specifications

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the warehouse facility in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, emergency restoration logistics planning, and proximity analysis.

attributes.name: operating_hours
attributes.description: Standard operating hours for the warehouse facility (e.g., '7:00 AM - 5:00 PM Monday-Friday', '24/7', 'On-Call'). Defines when the facility is staffed and available for receiving and issuing materials.

attributes.name: operational_status
attributes.description: Current operational state of the warehouse facility. Active warehouses are fully operational, inactive warehouses are not currently in use, temporarily closed warehouses are undergoing maintenance or renovation, decommissioned warehouses are permanently closed, under construction warehouses are being built or expanded, and seasonal warehouses operate only during specific periods.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location Status

attributes.name: ownership_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility is owned by the utility, leased from a third party, operated by a third-party logistics (3PL) provider, or managed by a vendor under a consignment or vendor-managed inventory (VMI) arrangement.
attributes.references: Supply Chain Management Best Practices - Warehouse Network Strategy

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the warehouse facility. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: plant_code
attributes.description: SAP plant code representing the organizational unit to which this warehouse is assigned. Links the warehouse to a specific generation facility, service center, or operational division within the utility's organizational structure.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code for the warehouse facility address. Organizational contact data classified as confidential business information.

attributes.name: rail_access_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the warehouse facility has direct rail siding access for receiving large shipments of bulk materials such as coal, transformers, or cable reels via rail freight.

attributes.name: security_level
attributes.description: Classification of physical security measures implemented at the warehouse facility. Basic security includes perimeter fencing and locks, standard security adds alarm systems and access control, high security includes 24/7 monitoring and guards, and critical infrastructure security meets NERC CIP requirements for facilities storing grid-critical spare parts.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-006 - Physical Security of BES Cyber Systems

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: Two-letter state or province code where the warehouse facility is located (e.g., 'CA', 'TX', 'ON').

attributes.name: storage_capacity_cubic_ft
attributes.description: Total volumetric storage capacity of the warehouse facility measured in cubic feet. Accounts for vertical storage capability including racking and shelving systems.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management Best Practices - Capacity Planning

attributes.name: storage_capacity_sqft
attributes.description: Total storage capacity of the warehouse facility measured in square feet. Represents the usable floor space available for inventory storage, excluding office areas and loading docks.
attributes.references: Warehouse Management Best Practices - Capacity Planning

attributes.name: warehouse_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the warehouse facility (e.g., 'Central Distribution Center', 'North Regional Storeroom', 'Mobile Emergency Restoration Unit 3').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location Description

attributes.name: warehouse_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the warehouse facility. Externally-known code used in procurement, inventory, and logistics operations. Corresponds to SAP storage location or plant code.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM - Storage Location Code

attributes.name: warehouse_type
attributes.description: Classification of the warehouse facility based on its role in the supply chain network. Central warehouses serve as primary distribution hubs, regional warehouses support geographic territories, field storerooms are located at operational sites, mobile units support emergency restoration, staging areas are temporary holding locations, and vendor-managed facilities are owned by suppliers.
attributes.references: Utility Supply Chain Best Practices - Warehouse Network Design

products.name: supplier_contract
products.description: Long-term supply agreements and framework contracts with utility vendors covering all contract types: quantity contracts, value contracts, scheduling agreements, master service agreements, and fuel supply contracts. Captures contract identification (number, type), parties and scope (vendor, material or service scope), term and value (start/end dates, total value, minimum order quantity), commercial terms (pricing conditions, escalation clauses, force majeure, delivery schedule lines), and compliance requirements (NERC CIP). For fuel supply contracts: fuel type (natural gas, coal, uranium), commodity specifications (BTU content, sulfur/ash content), delivery logistics (delivery point, pipeline/rail transport mode), financial terms (take-or-pay obligations, quantity in MMBtu or short tons, pricing index such as Henry Hub/API2/spot, price adjustment formula), and environmental compliance requirements. Supports transformer supply agreements, conductor blanket orders, emergency restoration MSAs, and generation fuel procurement.
products.reference: SAP MM Outline Agreement (ME31K/EKKO)

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supplier contract record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Contracts assign to responsible cost centers for budget ownership and commitment tracking. Contract spend rolls up to cost center actuals for variance analysis and budget forecasting.

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: Long-term fuel/service contracts embed regulatory compliance requirements (environmental permits, NERC standards, RPS eligibility). Contract approval workflow validates obligation coverage. Real busin

attributes.name: supplier_vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supplier or vendor party to this contract. Links to the vendor master record in the procurement system.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: FK to supply.vendor.vendor_id — Every supply contract is with a specific vendor. Required for contract management and vendor relationship tracking.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the contract was formally approved by authorized signatories and became legally binding.

attributes.name: contract_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the contract scope, materials or services covered, and key business terms. For fuel supply contracts, includes fuel type and commodity specifications.

attributes.name: contract_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled expiration date of the contract. Nullable for open-ended or evergreen contracts with no fixed termination date.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique business identifier for the supplier contract. Used in procurement documents, purchase orders, and vendor communications.

attributes.name: contract_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual or role responsible for managing this contract, including renewals, amendments, and vendor relationship management.

attributes.name: contract_start_date
attributes.description: Effective start date when the contract terms become binding and procurement activities can commence.

attributes.name: contract_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the supplier contract. Draft contracts are being negotiated, pending approval awaiting authorization, active contracts are in force, suspended contracts are temporarily halted, expired contracts have passed their end date, terminated contracts were ended early, and closed contracts are completed and archived. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|active|suspended|expired|terminated|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: contract_type
attributes.description: Classification of the supplier contract based on procurement structure and commitment model. Quantity contracts specify fixed quantities, value contracts specify total spend limits, scheduling agreements define delivery schedules, MSAs cover ongoing services, fuel supply contracts govern commodity procurement, and framework agreements establish terms for multiple call-offs.

attributes.name: contract_value_amount
attributes.description: Total monetary value or spending limit of the contract over its full term. For value contracts, this is the maximum spend; for quantity contracts, this is the estimated total value based on unit prices and quantities.

attributes.name: contract_value_currency
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the contract value amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: delivery_location
attributes.description: Primary delivery destination or point of receipt for materials or services under this contract. May reference a warehouse, plant, substation, or generation facility.

attributes.name: delivery_mode
attributes.description: Transportation method for fuel or material delivery. For fuel supply contracts, includes pipeline (natural gas), rail (coal, uranium), truck, barge, or ship. For equipment contracts, includes truck, rail, or specialized transport.

attributes.name: delivery_point
attributes.description: Specific physical location or interconnection point where fuel or materials are delivered. For natural gas, this may be a pipeline interconnect or city gate; for coal, a rail siding or stockpile area; for equipment, a warehouse or construction site.

attributes.name: emergency_restoration_contract
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a master service agreement or framework contract specifically for emergency storm restoration, outage response, or disaster recovery services. True for contracts with mutual assistance provisions or emergency response crews.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_requirements
attributes.description: Environmental regulations and standards that the supplier must meet, including EPA emissions standards, fuel quality requirements, hazardous material handling, and waste disposal protocols. Critical for fuel supply and generation equipment contracts.

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause
attributes.description: Contractual provision defining events beyond the control of either party (natural disasters, war, pandemics, regulatory changes) that excuse performance obligations without penalty.

attributes.name: fuel_specification
attributes.description: Technical specifications for fuel quality, including BTU content, sulfur content, ash content, moisture level, and other commodity-specific parameters. Critical for generation fuel procurement to ensure equipment compatibility and environmental compliance.

attributes.name: fuel_type
attributes.description: Type of fuel commodity covered by this contract. Applicable to fuel supply contracts for generation facilities. Includes natural gas, coal, uranium, diesel, biomass, and other fuel sources.

attributes.name: incoterms
attributes.description: International Commercial Terms defining the responsibilities of buyer and seller for delivery, insurance, and risk transfer. Examples: FOB (Free on Board), CIF (Cost Insurance Freight), DDP (Delivered Duty Paid).

attributes.name: last_amendment_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent contract amendment or modification. Null if no amendments have been made since original execution.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this contract record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: material_group
attributes.description: High-level categorization of materials or services covered by this contract. Examples include transformers, conductors, meters, poles, generation spare parts, or fuel commodities.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered under this contract. Used to enforce contract limits and prevent over-commitment.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered per release or over the contract term, as stipulated in the contract terms. Applicable to quantity contracts and scheduling agreements.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_compliance_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) Compliance Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contract involves materials, services, or access to systems that fall under NERC CIP cybersecurity and physical security standards. True for contracts involving SCADA systems, control centers, generation facilities, or critical cyber assets.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Agreed payment terms and conditions, including net payment period, early payment discounts, and payment milestones. Examples: Net 30, 2/10 Net 30, or milestone-based payment schedules.

attributes.name: price_escalation_clause
attributes.description: Description of the price adjustment mechanism tied to inflation indices, commodity price indices, or other economic factors. Common for multi-year contracts to account for cost changes over time.

attributes.name: pricing_index
attributes.description: Reference index used for price adjustments in fuel supply contracts or commodity contracts. Examples: Henry Hub (natural gas), API2 (coal), spot uranium prices, or CPI (Consumer Price Index).

attributes.name: purchasing_group
attributes.description: Buyer or procurement team responsible for day-to-day contract administration and purchase order release.

attributes.name: purchasing_organization
attributes.description: Organizational unit responsible for negotiating and managing this contract. Typically aligned with business divisions such as Transmission and Distribution (T&D), Generation, or Corporate Procurement.

attributes.name: renewal_notice_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days prior to contract expiration that either party must provide notice of intent to renew or terminate. Null if no renewal option exists.

attributes.name: renewal_option
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes an option for automatic or negotiated renewal upon expiration. True if renewal provisions exist, false otherwise.

attributes.name: service_level_agreement
attributes.description: Performance commitments and service standards defined in the contract, including response times, uptime guarantees, delivery lead times, and quality metrics. Common in master service agreements and emergency restoration contracts.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Identifier of the operational system of record from which this contract data originated. Typically SAP S/4HANA MM for utility supply chain contracts.

attributes.name: supplier_contract_vendor
attributes.description: FK to supply.vendor.vendor_id — Every supply contract is with a specific vendor. Fundamental FK for contract management and vendor relationship tracking.

attributes.name: take_or_pay_obligation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes a take-or-pay provision requiring the buyer to pay for a minimum quantity regardless of actual consumption. Common in fuel supply contracts for natural gas, coal, and uranium.

attributes.name: take_or_pay_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity the buyer is obligated to purchase or pay for under a take-or-pay provision. Expressed in the contract unit of measure (e.g., MMBtu, short tons).

attributes.name: termination_clause
attributes.description: Conditions and procedures under which either party may terminate the contract early, including notice periods, termination fees, and grounds for termination (breach, convenience, insolvency).

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Standard unit of measure for quantities specified in this contract. Examples include EA (each) for transformers, FT (feet) for conductors, MMBTU (million British thermal units) for natural gas, or TON (short tons) for coal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA MM Unit of Measure

attributes.name: warranty_terms
attributes.description: Warranty coverage provided by the supplier, including warranty period, covered defects, repair or replacement obligations, and exclusions. Particularly important for transformers, generation equipment, and other capital assets.

products.name: fuel_supply_contract

Distinct from general supplier contracts due to commodity-specific regulatory and operational attributes.

attributes.description: Identifier of the fuel supplier or vendor party to this contract.

attributes.name: btu_content_specification

attributes.name: contract_manager_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility employee or role responsible for managing and administering this fuel supply contract.

attributes.name: contract_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the fuel supply contract, used in procurement documents and supplier communications.

attributes.name: contract_status

attributes.name: contract_type

attributes.name: delivery_schedule

attributes.name: effective_end_date

attributes.name: effective_start_date

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_notes

attributes.name: force_majeure_clause

attributes.name: last_modified_by

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this fuel supply contract record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: minimum_take_quantity

attributes.name: moisture_content_max_pct

attributes.name: payment_terms

products.name: supply_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the Supply Agreement between vendor and material_master. It captures the commercial and operational terms under which a specific vendor supplies a specific material to the utility. Each record links one vendor to one material_master with pricing, lead time, quality ratings, and procurement terms that exist only in the context of this vendor-material relationship. This is the operational SSOT for approved vendor lists (AVL), competitive sourcing decisions, and procurement execution.. Existence Justification: In utility supply chain operations, vendors supply multiple materials (transformers, conductors, meters, poles, fuel) and each material can be sourced from multiple approved vendors at different prices, lead times, and quality levels. Procurement teams actively manage vendor-material relationships through approved vendor lists (AVL), competitive bidding (RFQ), and sourcing strategies. This is a core operational M:N relationship central to supply chain management and emergency restoration planning.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.description: Negotiated price per base unit of measure for this vendor-material combination. This price is specific to the vendor-material relationship and varies by vendor for the same material.

attributes.name: vendor_material_number
attributes.description: The vendors own part number or catalog number for this material. Used for cross-referencing in purchase orders and vendor communications. Specific to each vendor-material pair.

products.name: contract_line_item
products.description: This association product represents the contractual agreement between a specific material and a supplier contract. It captures the commercial terms, pricing, quantities, and delivery conditions that apply to the procurement of a specific material under a framework contract. Each record links one material to one supplier contract with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific material-contract relationship. Contract line items are referenced on purchase orders and used for price validation during invoice verification.. Existence Justification: In utility procurement operations, supplier contracts are framework agreements that cover multiple materials, and each material can be sourced from multiple suppliers under different contracts. Contract line items are actively managed operational entities that procurement teams create, update, and reference on purchase orders. Each line item captures material-specific commercial terms (price, quantities, lead times, delivery conditions) that exist only in the context of a specific material-contract pairing.
products.reference: Internal - M:N Association

attributes.name: contract_line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this contract line item record. Primary key.

attributes.name: material_master_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Line Item - Material Master Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the material master record covered by this contract line item

attributes.name: supplier_contract_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contract Line Item - Supplier Contract Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier contract under which this material is procured

attributes.name: contracted_quantity
attributes.description: Total quantity of this material committed under this contract. For quantity contracts, this is the total quantity to be delivered over the contract term.

attributes.name: contracted_unit_price
attributes.description: Negotiated price per unit of measure for this material under this contract. Used for purchase order price validation and invoice verification.

attributes.name: delivery_lead_time_days
attributes.description: Expected number of calendar days from purchase order release to goods receipt for this material under this contract. May differ from the material master planned delivery time based on supplier-specific logistics.

attributes.name: delivery_terms
attributes.description: Specific delivery conditions and requirements for this material under this contract, including delivery location, packaging requirements, and delivery schedule constraints.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this contract line item expires and can no longer be used for procurement. May differ from the overall contract end date if materials are phased out or have different validity periods.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this contract line item becomes effective and can be used for procurement. May differ from the overall contract start date if materials are phased in.

attributes.name: line_item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this contract line item. ACTIVE items can be used for procurement, INACTIVE items are temporarily disabled, SUSPENDED items are on hold pending resolution, EXPIRED items have passed their end date, CANCELLED items have been terminated early.

attributes.name: maximum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Maximum quantity that can be ordered per release or over the contract term for this material. Used to enforce contract quantity limits.

attributes.name: minimum_order_quantity
attributes.description: Minimum quantity that must be ordered per release for this material under this contract. Enforces supplier minimum order requirements.

attributes.name: price_escalation_percentage
attributes.description: Annual or periodic price increase percentage applied to this material under this contract. Used to calculate adjusted prices over the contract term based on escalation clauses.
