domains.name: workforce
domains.description: Utility workforce management including field crews, linemen, plant operators, engineers, dispatchers, meter readers, and administrative staff. Manages employee records, certifications (NERC CIP personnel risk assessments), OSHA safety compliance, union agreements, crew scheduling, time and attendance, contractor workforce, and labor cost allocations to work orders. Serves as SSOT for personnel identity referenced by asset maintenance, grid operations, and compliance domains.

products.name: employee
products.description: SSOT master record for all utility personnel including field crews (linemen, cable splicers), plant operators, engineers, dispatchers, meter readers, and administrative staff. Captures employee identity, employment status, job classification, union affiliation, cost center, hire/termination dates, and NERC CIP personnel risk assessment status. Referenced by asset maintenance, grid operations, outage, and compliance domains as the authoritative personnel identity source.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HCM Employee Master

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the utility employee. Primary key for the employee master record. Serves as the authoritative personnel identity reference across asset maintenance, grid operations, outage management, and compliance domains.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Personnel Number Standard

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee identifier of the direct supervisor or manager. Establishes reporting hierarchy for organizational structure, approval workflows, and performance management. References another employee record in the employee master.

attributes.name: workforce_position_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.workforce_position.workforce_position_id — Every employee fills an authorized position. This is the fundamental structural relationship in workforce management — it drives pay grade, job classification, required certifications, and union statu

attributes.name: active_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee record is currently active in the system. True for active employees available for work assignments, False for inactive or terminated employees. Used for filtering active workforce in crew scheduling and reporting.

attributes.name: annual_salary
attributes.description: Annual base salary for salaried employees in USD. Null for hourly employees. Used for budgeting, labor cost allocation, and compensation planning. Business-confidential data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Payroll, FLSA Fair Labor Standards Act

attributes.name: badge_number
attributes.description: Physical security badge or access card number assigned to the employee. Used for facility access control, time and attendance tracking, and physical security audit trails. Personally identifiable credential.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-006 Physical Security, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: cdl_class
attributes.description: Class of Commercial Driver License held by the employee. Class A for combination vehicles, Class B for heavy straight vehicles, Class C for smaller vehicles with hazmat or passenger endorsements. None if no CDL. Determines vehicle assignment eligibility.
attributes.references: FMCSA Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration CDL Standards

attributes.name: cdl_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the employee's Commercial Driver License. Null if no CDL. Used to track license renewal requirements and ensure compliance with FMCSA regulations for utility fleet operations.
attributes.references: FMCSA Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration CDL Standards

attributes.name: cdl_license_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a valid Commercial Driver License. True if CDL-certified, False otherwise. Required for employees operating utility trucks, bucket trucks, and heavy equipment. Used for crew assignment and fleet management.
attributes.references: FMCSA Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration CDL Standards

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center to which the employee's labor costs are allocated. Links employee time and expenses to organizational units such as generation, transmission, distribution, or administrative departments. Used for labor cost tracking and work order costing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the employee record was first created in the system. Used for data lineage, audit trails, and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: crew_assignment
attributes.description: Identifier of the field crew or work team to which the employee is assigned. Examples include Line Crew 1, Substation Crew A, Meter Reading Team 3. Used for crew scheduling, work order dispatch, and team-based performance tracking.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management, GE PowerOn ADMS Crew Management

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Organizational department or division to which the employee is assigned. Examples include Transmission Operations, Distribution Maintenance, Generation Plant, Customer Service, Engineering, or IT. Used for organizational hierarchy reporting and workforce planning.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary corporate email address for the employee. Used for business communication, system access notifications, and work order assignments.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the employee's designated emergency contact person. Used for notification in case of workplace accidents, injuries, or critical incidents during field operations.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the employee's designated emergency contact person. Used for immediate notification in case of workplace accidents, injuries, or critical incidents.

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact person to the employee. Used to understand the nature of the emergency contact relationship for notification protocols.

attributes.name: employee_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the employee. Externally-known employee number used in payroll, timekeeping, and work order systems. May follow utility-specific numbering conventions.

attributes.name: employee_type
attributes.description: Classification of employment relationship. Distinguishes between full-time utility employees, part-time staff, external contractors, temporary workers, seasonal crews, and interns. Impacts benefits eligibility, labor cost allocation, and union coverage.

attributes.name: employment_status
attributes.description: Current employment lifecycle status of the employee. Determines eligibility for work assignments, system access, and payroll processing. Active employees are available for crew scheduling and work order assignments.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Legal first name of the employee as recorded in HR systems. Used for personnel identification, payroll processing, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: hire_date
attributes.description: Date the employee was hired or began employment with the utility. Used for seniority calculations, benefits eligibility, service anniversary tracking, and union seniority rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Hire Date, FLSA Fair Labor Standards Act

attributes.name: hourly_rate
attributes.description: Standard hourly pay rate for the employee in USD. Null for salaried employees. Used for time and attendance processing, work order labor costing, and payroll calculation. Business-confidential data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Payroll, FLSA Fair Labor Standards Act

attributes.name: job_classification
attributes.description: Standardized job classification code defining the employee's role, skill level, and pay grade. Examples include lineman, cable splicer, plant operator, engineer, dispatcher, meter reader. Used for crew scheduling, labor cost allocation, and union agreement compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Job Classification, OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Job Categories

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Descriptive job title for the employee. Human-readable position name such as Senior Lineman, Distribution Engineer, SCADA Operator, Meter Technician. Used for organizational reporting and personnel directories.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Legal last name (surname) of the employee as recorded in HR systems. Used for personnel identification, payroll processing, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the employee. Optional field used for complete legal name identification.

attributes.name: mobile_number
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the employee. Critical for field crew dispatch, outage response coordination, and emergency communications.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_pra_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP Personnel Risk Assessment (PRA) Date
attributes.description: Date the most recent NERC CIP Personnel Risk Assessment was completed or approved. Used to track compliance with NERC CIP-004 requirements for periodic background checks and security clearances.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 Personnel and Training Standard

attributes.name: nerc_cip_pra_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP Personnel Risk Assessment (PRA) Status
attributes.description: Status of NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) Personnel Risk Assessment for employees with access to critical cyber assets or bulk electric system facilities. Required for compliance with NERC CIP-004 personnel security standards. Approved status is mandatory for access to protected systems.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 Personnel and Training Standard

attributes.name: nerc_cip_training_status
attributes.description: Status of NERC CIP cyber security training for employees with access to critical infrastructure. Current status indicates compliance with NERC CIP-004 training requirements. Expired status triggers retraining requirements.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 Personnel and Training Standard

attributes.name: on_call_status
attributes.description: Current on-call availability status for emergency response and outage restoration. Available for normal work, On-call for emergency dispatch, Unavailable due to leave or other assignment, Deployed to active incident. Used for storm response and outage management crew dispatch.
attributes.references: GE PowerOn ADMS Outage Management System, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: osha_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) safety certifications and training. Current status indicates compliance with OSHA safety training requirements for utility field work, confined space entry, electrical safety, and hazardous materials handling.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910 General Industry Standards, OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Construction Standards

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for overtime pay under FLSA regulations. True for non-exempt employees, False for exempt employees. Used for time and attendance processing and labor cost calculation.
attributes.references: FLSA Fair Labor Standards Act 29 USC 207

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation pay grade or salary band assigned to the employee. Determines base pay range, overtime eligibility, and benefits tier. Used for payroll processing and labor cost forecasting. Business-confidential data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Pay Scale, FLSA Fair Labor Standards Act

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the employee. Used for crew dispatch, emergency contact, and field operations coordination.

attributes.name: security_clearance_level
attributes.description: Physical and cyber security clearance level granted to the employee. Determines access to critical infrastructure facilities, control centers, substations, and cyber assets. Aligned with NERC CIP access control requirements.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-006 Physical Security, NERC CIP-005 Electronic Security Perimeter

attributes.name: shift_assignment
attributes.description: Primary work shift assignment for the employee. Day shift (typically 7am-3pm), Evening shift (3pm-11pm), Night shift (11pm-7am), Rotating shifts, or On-call status. Used for crew scheduling, shift differential pay, and 24/7 operations coverage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Work Schedule, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: skill_level
attributes.description: Proficiency level or skill grade of the employee within their job classification. Apprentice for trainees, Journeyman for certified skilled workers, Master for advanced practitioners. Used for crew composition, work assignment complexity, and pay grade determination.
attributes.references: IBEW Apprenticeship Standards, SAP S/4HANA HCM Qualification

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Date the employee's employment ended. Null for active employees. Populated upon resignation, retirement, or termination. Used for workforce turnover analysis, benefits termination, and system access revocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Termination Date, COBRA Consolidated Omnibus Budget Reconciliation Act

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for employment termination. Null for active employees. Used for turnover analysis, unemployment claims, and HR compliance reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: resignation|retirement|layoff|termination_for_cause|end_of_contract|disability|death — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Termination Reason, WARN Worker Adjustment and Retraining Notification Act

attributes.name: union_affiliation
attributes.description: Union or labor organization to which the employee belongs. Examples include IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers), USW (United Steelworkers), or non-union designation. Determines applicable collective bargaining agreement, work rules, and grievance procedures.
attributes.references: NLRA National Labor Relations Act, Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: union_member_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is a member of a labor union. True if union member, False if non-union. Used for labor relations reporting and contract compliance.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the employee record was last modified. Used for change tracking, data synchronization, and audit compliance.

attributes.name: work_location
attributes.description: Primary work location or facility where the employee is based. Examples include power plant name, service center, district office, or headquarters building. Used for crew dispatch, asset assignment, and geographic workforce analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Work Location, OSHA 29 CFR 1904 Establishment

products.name: workforce_position
products.description: Authorized organizational positions within the utility workforce structure and their hiring requisition lifecycle. Defines job titles, job families, pay grades, required certifications, union classification, FLSA status, and whether the role requires NERC CIP access authorization. Positions are the structural slots that employees fill; they exist independently of incumbents and drive headcount planning and budgeting. Hiring requisition records capture requisition number, hiring manager, org unit, justification (backfill, new headcount, seasonal), required certifications, target hire date, approved headcount budget, recruitment status, and sourcing channel. SSOT for organizational structure, position management, and talent acquisition workflow.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HCM Organizational Management

attributes.name: workforce_position_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the authorized organizational position within the utility workforce structure. Primary key.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.org_unit.org_unit_id — Positions are authorized within specific org units. This drives headcount planning, budgeting, and organizational structure. Without this link, you cannot aggregate authorized vs filled positions by d

attributes.name: workforce_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit (department, division, or cost center) to which this position is assigned for reporting and budget allocation purposes.

attributes.name: approved_headcount_budget
attributes.description: Annual budgeted compensation amount approved for this position, including base salary, benefits, and overhead. Used for financial planning and cost allocation.

attributes.name: background_check_level
attributes.description: Depth of pre-employment background screening required. NERC CIP level includes seven-year criminal history and identity verification for positions with BES Cyber System access.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which labor costs for this position are allocated. Used for departmental budgeting and financial reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the position record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: drug_testing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires pre-employment and random drug testing. Typically required for safety-sensitive positions (field crews, plant operators, drivers).

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was created or became active in the organizational structure. Used for historical workforce analysis and headcount tracking.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee responsible for the hiring decision and onboarding for this position. Typically the direct supervisor or department head.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: Date when the position was eliminated or frozen. Null for active positions. Used for organizational restructuring tracking and historical analysis.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act determining overtime eligibility. Exempt positions are salaried and not eligible for overtime; non-exempt positions are hourly and eligible for overtime pay.

attributes.name: full_time_equivalent
attributes.description: The FTE allocation for the position, representing the proportion of a full-time workload. 1.00 = full-time, 0.50 = half-time. Used for headcount budgeting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the position responsibilities, duties, and expectations. Used for job postings, performance management, and role clarity.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping similar roles for workforce planning and career pathing (e.g., field operations includes linemen and meter readers; plant operations includes turbine operators and control room staff). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: field_operations|plant_operations|engineering|grid_operations|customer_service|administrative|management|technical_support|safety_compliance|regulatory_affairs — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title for the position as it appears in organizational charts and job postings (e.g., Senior Lineman, Distribution Engineer, SCADA Operator).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the position record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: minimum_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational attainment required for the position. Trade certification applies to skilled trades (linemen, electricians); bachelor or higher typically required for engineering positions.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for the position. Used for candidate screening and qualification assessment.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the position record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_access_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Access Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires access to Bulk Electric System (BES) Cyber Systems or physical access to critical cyber assets, triggering NERC CIP personnel risk assessment requirements.

attributes.name: osha_safety_sensitive
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Safety Sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is classified as safety-sensitive under OSHA regulations, requiring enhanced safety training, drug testing, and incident reporting.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation band or salary grade assigned to the position, determining the salary range and benefits eligibility.

attributes.name: physical_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical demands and working conditions for the position (e.g., ability to climb utility poles, work at heights, lift 50 lbs, work outdoors in extreme weather). Required for OSHA compliance and ADA accommodation assessment.

attributes.name: position_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the position, used in organizational planning and budgeting. Externally visible position code.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the position. Active positions are filled or available for hiring; frozen positions are temporarily suspended from hiring; eliminated positions are being phased out.

attributes.name: position_type
attributes.description: Classification of the position based on employment duration and nature. Regular positions are permanent; seasonal positions are recurring but time-limited (e.g., summer peak demand crews).

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory professional certifications, licenses, or credentials required for the position (e.g., Journeyman Lineman License, Professional Engineer PE, NERC System Operator Certification, CDL Class A, OSHA 30-Hour).
attributes.references: State Licensing Boards and Professional Certification Bodies

attributes.name: requisition_justification
attributes.description: Business reason for opening the hiring requisition. Backfill replaces a departed employee; new headcount expands the workforce; regulatory requirement addresses compliance mandates (e.g., NERC CIP staffing).

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hiring requisition associated with this position, if currently open for recruitment. Null if position is filled or not actively recruiting.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current state of the hiring requisition workflow. Open requisitions are approved and actively recruiting; in-progress requisitions have active candidates; filled requisitions have accepted offers. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_open|open|in_progress|offer_extended|filled|cancelled|on_hold — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Level of security clearance required for the position, if any. Positions with access to critical infrastructure or sensitive grid operations data may require government security clearances.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard work shift schedule for the position. Rotating shifts are common for plant operators and grid dispatchers; on-call applies to emergency response crews.

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: Primary recruitment channel for filling this position. Internal sourcing promotes existing employees; apprenticeship programs develop skilled trades (linemen, electricians). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal|external|referral|agency|campus|veteran|apprenticeship — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_hire_date
attributes.description: Planned start date for the new hire to fill this position. Used for workforce planning and onboarding preparation.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_pct
attributes.description: Expected percentage of work time requiring travel away from the primary work location. Field positions may have 50-80% travel; office positions typically 0-10%.

attributes.name: union_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Union positions are subject to negotiated labor contracts; management positions are excluded from union representation.

attributes.name: union_local
attributes.description: Specific union local chapter representing this position, if applicable (e.g., IBEW Local 1245, UWUA Local 246). Null for non-union positions.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Reference to the primary physical work location for the position (e.g., power plant, service center, district office, field territory).

products.name: org_unit

attributes.name: company_code

attributes.name: contact_email

attributes.name: contact_phone

attributes.name: contractor_workforce_flag

attributes.name: cost_center_code

products.name: certification
products.description: Master catalog of all required certifications, licenses, qualifications, and training programs applicable to utility workforce roles, including safety training curricula and session delivery records. Covers externally-issued certifications (NERC CIP PRA clearance, OSHA 10/30, CDL, state electrical contractor license, first aid/CPR), internally-assessed qualifications (journeyman lineman, substation operator, generation unit operator, SCADA operator authorization), and mandatory safety and compliance training programs (lockout/tagout, confined space entry, arc flash safety, fall protection, hazmat, NERC CIP security awareness). Defines credential name, credential category (certification, qualification, training), issuing body or internal program owner, validity period, renewal cycle, delivery method options (classroom, online, field), pass/fail criteria, instructor requirements, and whether it is mandatory for specific job classifications or NERC CIP access roles. Training session delivery records capture session date, instructor, delivery method, attendees, completion status, and next required date. SSOT for all credential definitions and training program delivery in the utility workforce.
