products.name: employee_certification
products.description: SSOT for all individual employee and contractor credential records — covering externally-issued certifications (NERC CIP PRA clearance, OSHA 10/30, CDL, state electrical contractor license, first aid/CPR), internally-assessed qualifications (journeyman lineman, substation operator, generation unit operator, SCADA operator authorization, apprenticeship completions), and training completion records. Captures credential source type (external_certification, internal_qualification, training_completion), issue date, expiration date, issuing authority or internal assessor, certificate number, competency level achieved, assessment date, renewal status, and compliance flag. Drives compliance alerts for expiring credentials, NERC CIP-004 audit evidence, OSHA training compliance, DOT certification tracking, and qualification-based crew dispatch eligibility.
products.reference: NERC CIP-004 R3 Personnel Risk Assessment Records

attributes.name: employee_certification_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee certification record. Primary key for the employee certification entity.

attributes.name: certification_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.certification. Business justification: employee_certification should reference the master certification catalog to normalize certification details. Currently stores certification_name, certification_type, certification_category, issuing_au

attributes.name: primary_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee or contractor who holds this certification or qualification. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: tertiary_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — employee_certification is a transactional child of employee. FK required for credential expiration alerts, NERC CIP-004 audit evidence, and qualification-based crew dispatch.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the employee was assessed or tested for the qualification or competency. Applicable primarily to internal qualifications and skills assessments.
attributes.references: Internal Training and Competency Assessment Programs

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: The numerical score or percentage achieved by the employee on the certification exam or competency assessment. Null if no scored assessment was required.

attributes.name: attachment_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or file path to the scanned certificate, training completion document, or other supporting documentation stored in the document management system.

attributes.name: certification_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the certification: active (valid and current), expired (past expiration date), suspended (temporarily invalid), revoked (permanently invalid), pending_renewal (renewal in process), in_progress (training/assessment underway).

attributes.name: competency_level
attributes.description: The level of competency or proficiency achieved by the employee for this certification or qualification (e.g., apprentice, journeyman, master for trades; operator levels for plant/SCADA operators). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: apprentice|journeyman|master|operator_level_1|operator_level_2|operator_level_3|certified|qualified — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Internal Competency Frameworks, Trade Union Agreements

attributes.name: compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification is currently in compliance with regulatory or internal requirements. True if active and not expired; False if expired, suspended, or revoked.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The total cost incurred by the utility to obtain or renew this certification for the employee, including training fees, exam fees, travel, and materials. Used for workforce development cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Finance, Internal Training Budget

attributes.name: cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the certification cost amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: crew_dispatch_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification qualifies the employee for field crew dispatch assignments. True if the certification enables dispatch eligibility (e.g., journeyman lineman, CDL, OSHA training current).
attributes.references: Internal Crew Scheduling and Dispatch Systems

attributes.name: dot_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification is required for DOT compliance (e.g., Commercial Drivers License CDL, DOT medical certification, hazardous materials endorsement). True if DOT-mandated.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration

attributes.name: employee_certification_instance_of_catalog
attributes.description: FK to workforce.certification.certification_id — employee_certification references the certification catalog to identify which credential was earned. Required for renewal cycle management and compliance reporting by credential type.

attributes.name: employee_certification_instance_of_type
attributes.description: FK to workforce.certification.certification_id — Each employee certification instance references a certification type from the catalog. This drives renewal requirements, validity periods, and mandatory-for-job-classification rules.

attributes.name: equipment_authorization
attributes.description: Specific equipment, tools, or systems the employee is authorized to operate or maintain based on this certification (e.g., bucket truck, aerial lift, high-voltage switchgear, DMS/SCADA console).
attributes.references: OSHA Equipment Operation Requirements, Internal Safety Programs

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification or qualification expires and requires renewal. Null for certifications with no expiration (e.g., some apprenticeship completions).

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: The name of the instructor or assessor who conducted the training or competency assessment. Used for internal quality assurance and audit trails.

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification, qualification, or training completion was officially issued or awarded to the employee.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this certification record was last updated in the system. Used for audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls, Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: last_verification_date
attributes.description: The date on which the certification was last verified with the issuing authority or through internal audit. Used for NERC CIP audit evidence and compliance validation.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification is required for NERC CIP compliance, specifically for personnel with access to critical cyber assets or bulk electric system facilities. True if NERC CIP-004 Personnel Risk Assessment or related training.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional comments, special conditions, restrictions, or context related to the certification (e.g., conditional approval, specific limitations, renewal in progress details).

attributes.name: osha_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification is required for OSHA safety compliance (e.g., OSHA 10/30-hour training, confined space, lockout/tagout, fall protection). True if OSHA-mandated.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum score or percentage required to pass the certification exam or competency assessment. Used to determine qualification status.

attributes.name: qualification_area
attributes.description: The specific technical or operational area for which the employee is qualified (e.g., transmission line work, substation maintenance, generation unit operation, SCADA system operation, meter installation).
attributes.references: Internal Competency Frameworks, Trade Union Agreements

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification is mandated by external regulatory bodies (NERC, OSHA, DOT, EPA, state licensing boards). True if regulatory-required; False if internal or voluntary.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004, OSHA, DOT FMCSA, EPA

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_days
attributes.description: Number of days before expiration that renewal reminder notifications should be triggered. Used by compliance alert systems to notify employees and managers of upcoming expirations.

attributes.name: renewal_status
attributes.description: Status of the certification renewal process: not_required (no expiration), upcoming (renewal due soon), overdue (past expiration), in_progress (renewal underway), completed (renewal finished).

attributes.name: training_hours
attributes.description: Total number of training hours completed to achieve this certification or qualification. Used for OSHA compliance reporting and internal training tracking.
attributes.references: OSHA Training Requirements, Internal Training Programs

attributes.name: training_provider
attributes.description: The name of the organization or vendor that delivered the training program (e.g., internal training department, external training vendor, community college, trade association).

attributes.name: union_requirement_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this certification is required by collective bargaining agreements or union contracts. True if union-mandated.

attributes.name: verification_method
attributes.description: The method used to verify the authenticity and validity of the certification: issuer_database (checked with issuing authority), physical_certificate (physical document reviewed), employee_attestation (employee self-certification), manager_verification (manager confirmed), third_party_audit (external auditor verified).

products.name: safety_incident
products.description: OSHA-recordable and non-recordable safety events, compliance incidents, and DOT/utility-mandated drug and alcohol test results for utility workforce. Captures event category (injury, near_miss, vehicle_accident, hazmat_exposure, drug_alcohol_test, fitness_for_duty), event date/time, location, employee(s) involved, severity classification, OSHA recordability flag, days away/restricted/transferred, root cause analysis, corrective actions, OSHA 300 log reference, and follow-up actions. For drug/alcohol test events: captures DOT 49 CFR Part 40 test type (pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, return-to-duty), testing provider, result (negative/positive/refused), MRO review status, SAP referral, and chain-of-custody documentation. SSOT for all safety events and DOT compliance testing. Supports OSHA 300/300A annual reporting, TRIR/DART rate calculation, DOT 49 CFR Part 40 compliance, and safety performance trending.
products.reference: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 Recordkeeping; OSHA 300 Log

attributes.name: safety_incident_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety incident record. Primary key for the safety incident entity.

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the utility facility where the incident occurred (generation plant, substation, service center, warehouse). Links to asset facility master data.

attributes.name: primary_safety_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary employee involved in the safety incident. Links to workforce employee master data.

attributes.name: quaternary_safety_modified_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who last modified the safety incident record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: safety_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — Safety incidents involve specific employees. OSHA 300 log reporting requires employee identification. Note: may need a junction for multi-employee incidents, but the primary FK is essential.

attributes.name: tertiary_safety_reported_by_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who reported the incident. May differ from the injured employee in cases of witness reporting or near-miss observations.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order being executed when the incident occurred. Links incident to maintenance or construction activity for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: body_part_affected
attributes.description: Body part(s) injured in the incident (e.g., hand, back, eyes, head, multiple). Used for injury trend analysis and PPE effectiveness evaluation.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the drug/alcohol test specimen chain-of-custody documentation. Links to laboratory records and ensures specimen integrity per DOT requirements.

attributes.name: corrective_actions
attributes.description: Documented corrective and preventive actions taken or planned to prevent recurrence of similar incidents (e.g., procedure revision, additional training, equipment modification, PPE upgrade).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the safety incident record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: days_away_from_work
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the employee was unable to work as a result of the incident. Used to calculate DART (Days Away, Restricted, or Transferred) rate.

attributes.name: days_on_restricted_duty
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the employee was on restricted work activity or job transfer due to the incident. Used to calculate DART rate.

attributes.name: dot_test_type
attributes.description: For drug/alcohol test incidents: type of DOT-mandated test per 49 CFR Part 40. Pre-employment (before hire), random (unannounced selection), post-accident (after qualifying incident), reasonable suspicion (supervisor-initiated), return-to-duty (after violation), follow-up (ongoing monitoring).

attributes.name: environmental_conditions
attributes.description: Description of environmental factors at the time of the incident (e.g., weather, lighting, temperature, noise level, confined space). Used for root cause analysis.

attributes.name: equipment_involved
attributes.description: Description or identifier of equipment, tools, or vehicles involved in the incident. Used to identify equipment-related hazards and maintenance needs.

attributes.name: incident_category
attributes.description: Classification of the safety event type: injury (physical harm), near_miss (potential incident avoided), vehicle_accident (fleet collision), hazmat_exposure (hazardous material contact), drug_alcohol_test (DOT compliance testing), fitness_for_duty (medical clearance event).

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Calendar date when the safety incident occurred. Critical for OSHA 300 log chronological recording and regulatory reporting timelines.

attributes.name: incident_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of how the incident occurred, what the employee was doing, and the sequence of events leading to the incident.

attributes.name: incident_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the safety incident, typically formatted as SI-YYYYMMDD-sequence for external reference and reporting.

attributes.name: incident_time
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the safety incident occurred, including time zone. Used for shift analysis, response time calculation, and detailed incident reconstruction.

attributes.name: injury_type
attributes.description: Nature of the injury sustained (e.g., laceration, fracture, burn, electric shock, strain, contusion, amputation, respiratory condition). Free text or standardized code.

attributes.name: investigation_completed_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident investigation was completed and findings were documented. Used to track investigation cycle time and regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: investigation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the incident investigation workflow: not_started (incident logged, investigation pending), in_progress (active investigation), completed (findings documented), closed (corrective actions implemented and verified).

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of where the incident occurred (e.g., substation yard, transmission line mile marker, generation plant turbine hall, customer premise, public road).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the safety incident record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: mro_name
attributes.description: Name of the Medical Review Officer who reviewed and verified the drug test result. Required for DOT compliance documentation.

attributes.name: mro_review_status
attributes.description: Status of Medical Review Officer review for drug test results. MRO verifies positive results and evaluates legitimate medical explanations per DOT 49 CFR Part 40.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_reportable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP (North American Electric Reliability Corporation Critical Infrastructure Protection) Reportable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident involves personnel with NERC CIP-designated access and requires reporting under CIP-004 personnel risk assessment standards.

attributes.name: osha_300_log_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) 300 Log Reference
attributes.description: Reference number or case number assigned to this incident on the OSHA 300 log for the establishment and calendar year.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) Recordable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident meets OSHA criteria for recordability on the OSHA 300 log. True if recordable per 29 CFR 1904.4-1904.7.

attributes.name: ppe_in_use
attributes.description: Description of personal protective equipment the employee was wearing at the time of the incident (e.g., hard hat, safety glasses, gloves, arc flash suit, fall protection). Used to assess PPE effectiveness.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when regulatory notification was made to OSHA or other agencies. Used to verify compliance with notification deadlines.

attributes.name: regulatory_notification_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the incident severity requires notification to OSHA, state agencies, or other regulatory bodies within mandated timeframes (e.g., fatality within 8 hours, hospitalization within 24 hours).

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date when the incident was formally reported to management or safety department. Used to track reporting timeliness and compliance with notification requirements.

attributes.name: root_cause_analysis
attributes.description: Findings from the root cause investigation identifying underlying factors that contributed to the incident (e.g., inadequate training, equipment failure, procedural gap, environmental hazard).

attributes.name: sap_name
attributes.description: Name of the Substance Abuse Professional assigned to the employee for evaluation and treatment. Confidential per DOT privacy requirements.

attributes.name: sap_referral_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee was referred to a Substance Abuse Professional for evaluation and treatment following a positive test or refusal. Required per DOT 49 CFR Part 40.287.

attributes.name: severity_classification
attributes.description: Severity level of the incident: fatality (death), lost_time (days away from work), restricted_duty (job transfer or restriction), medical_treatment (beyond first aid), first_aid (minor treatment), near_miss (no injury).

attributes.name: test_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the drug or alcohol test: negative (no substances detected), positive (prohibited substance detected), refused (employee declined test), invalid (specimen issue), cancelled (procedural error). Confidential per DOT regulations.

attributes.name: testing_provider
attributes.description: Name of the DOT-certified laboratory or collection site that performed the drug/alcohol test. Required for chain-of-custody documentation.

attributes.name: witness_count
attributes.description: Number of witnesses to the incident. Used to assess investigation completeness and corroboration of incident details.

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: Workers compensation insurance claim number associated with the incident. Links safety incident to financial and medical case management systems.

products.name: safety_training
products.description: Records of safety training sessions delivered to utility workforce personnel, including OSHA-mandated training (lockout/tagout, confined space entry, arc flash, fall protection, hazmat), NERC CIP security awareness training, and utility-specific operational safety programs. Captures training program name, delivery date, instructor, delivery method (classroom, online, field), employees trained, pass/fail status, and next required date. Supports OSHA compliance and NERC CIP-004 security awareness evidence.
products.reference: OSHA 1910.132; NERC CIP-004 R2 Security Awareness

attributes.name: safety_training_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the safety training session record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_safety_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the utility workforce employee who attended the training session. Links to workforce employee master data.

attributes.name: training_program_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the safety training program or course catalog entry. Links to training program master data.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order to which training labor costs are allocated, if applicable. Links to asset management work order data.

attributes.name: assessment_required_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the training program requires a formal assessment or examination for completion.

attributes.name: assessment_score
attributes.description: Numerical score achieved by the employee on the training assessment or examination, if applicable. Typically expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: attendance_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the employee attended the full training session, was absent, attended partially, or was excused.

attributes.name: certification_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification or credential expires and requires renewal or recertification.

attributes.name: certification_issue_date
attributes.description: Date on which the certification or credential was issued to the employee.

attributes.name: certification_issued_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether a formal certification or credential was issued to the employee upon successful completion of the training.

attributes.name: certification_number
attributes.description: Unique certification or credential number issued to the employee upon successful completion of the training, if applicable.

attributes.name: completion_status
attributes.description: Status indicating whether the employee successfully completed the training requirements.

attributes.name: compliance_evidence_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this training record serves as formal compliance evidence for regulatory audits (OSHA, NERC CIP, state PUC).

attributes.name: delivery_method
attributes.description: Method by which the training was delivered to the employee (classroom instruction, online e-learning, field demonstration, simulator-based, hybrid, or on-the-job training).

attributes.name: instructor_name
attributes.description: Name of the instructor or trainer who delivered the safety training session.

attributes.name: mandatory_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this training is mandatory for the employee based on their role, job function, or regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: next_required_training_date
attributes.description: Date by which the employee must complete the next required training session or recertification to maintain compliance.

attributes.name: pass_fail_status
attributes.description: Outcome of the training assessment indicating whether the employee passed, failed, was not assessed, or has a pending result.

attributes.name: passing_score_threshold
attributes.description: Minimum score required to pass the training assessment and achieve certification, expressed as a percentage.

attributes.name: recertification_interval_months
attributes.description: Number of months between required recertification or refresher training sessions for this safety program.

attributes.name: record_active_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this training record is currently active and valid, or has been superseded or voided.

attributes.name: record_created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety training record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: record_source_system
attributes.description: Name of the source system from which this safety training record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA HCM, Learning Management System, Contractor Management System).

attributes.name: record_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this safety training record was last updated or modified in the system.

attributes.name: regulatory_requirement
attributes.description: Specific regulatory standard or requirement that mandates this training (e.g., OSHA 1910.147 Lockout/Tagout, NERC CIP-004-6 Personnel Risk Assessment, OSHA 1910.269 Electric Power Generation).

attributes.name: training_category
attributes.description: High-level category of the safety training program for classification and reporting purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: OSHA Compliance|NERC CIP Security|Operational Safety|Environmental Safety|Emergency Response|Equipment Operation|Regulatory Compliance — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: training_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost incurred for delivering this training session, including instructor fees, materials, facility rental, and employee time. Used for labor cost allocation to work orders and capital projects.

attributes.name: training_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the training cost amount. Typically USD for US-based energy utilities.

attributes.name: training_date
attributes.description: Date on which the safety training session was delivered to the employee.

attributes.name: training_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total duration of the training session in hours, used for compliance reporting and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: training_end_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the training session ended, used for attendance tracking and duration calculation.

attributes.name: training_facility_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the facility or site where the training was conducted, if applicable. Links to facility master data.

attributes.name: training_location
attributes.description: Physical or virtual location where the training was conducted (e.g., training center name, plant site, online platform).

attributes.name: training_materials_provided
attributes.description: Description or list of training materials provided to the employee (e.g., manuals, handouts, online resources, safety equipment).

attributes.name: training_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about the training session, including special circumstances, accommodations, or observations by the instructor.

attributes.name: training_start_time
attributes.description: Timestamp when the training session started, used for attendance tracking and duration calculation.

attributes.name: training_type
attributes.description: Type of training session indicating whether it is initial certification, recertification, refresher, or remedial training.

attributes.name: training_vendor_name
attributes.description: Name of the external training vendor or provider, if the training was delivered by a third-party organization rather than internal staff.

products.name: union_agreement
products.description: Master records of collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) between the utility and labor unions (IBEW, UWUA, and others) covering field crews, plant operators, and other bargaining unit employees, plus the full grievance lifecycle under each CBA. CBA records capture union name, local number, agreement effective/expiration dates, covered job classifications, wage scales, overtime rules, call-out provisions, storm duty obligations, grievance procedure definitions, and arbitration terms. Grievance records capture grievance number, filing date, grievant employee, union local, alleged CBA violation, grievance step (Step 1 through arbitration), management response, resolution outcome, settlement terms, and arbitration award details. SSOT for all CBA terms and grievance lifecycle tracking. Drives payroll rules, scheduling constraints, labor cost modeling, and labor relations compliance.
products.reference: IBEW/UWUA Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement record. Primary key.

attributes.name: primary_successor_agreement_union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the collective bargaining agreement that supersedes this agreement upon expiration.

attributes.name: agreement_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the collective bargaining agreement, typically including union name and bargaining unit.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique identifier for the collective bargaining agreement, typically formatted as CBA-XXXXXX.

attributes.name: agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the collective bargaining agreement. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|negotiation|ratified|active|expired|terminated|superseded — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: agreement_type
attributes.description: Classification of the collective bargaining agreement document type.

attributes.name: arbitration_cost_sharing
attributes.description: Method for allocating arbitration costs between the utility and union.

attributes.name: arbitration_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes binding arbitration as the final step in the grievance procedure.

attributes.name: arbitrator_selection_method
attributes.description: Process defined in the agreement for selecting a neutral arbitrator (e.g., FMCS panel, AAA list, permanent umpire).

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the scope and composition of the bargaining unit, including covered job classifications and exclusions.

attributes.name: bargaining_unit_name
attributes.description: Name of the employee group covered by this agreement (e.g., Field Operations Unit, Generation Plant Operators Unit).

attributes.name: base_wage_increase_percent
attributes.description: Negotiated percentage increase in base wages effective under this agreement term.

attributes.name: call_out_minimum_hours
attributes.description: Minimum number of hours guaranteed for pay when an employee is called out for emergency or unscheduled work.

attributes.name: call_out_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Premium pay multiplier applied to call-out hours (e.g., 2.0 for double-time call-out pay).

attributes.name: cola_formula
attributes.description: Mathematical formula or methodology for calculating cost of living adjustments, including index references (e.g., CPI-U).

attributes.name: cola_provision_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) Provision Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes a cost of living adjustment provision tied to inflation indices.

attributes.name: covered_employee_count
attributes.description: Total number of employees covered under this collective bargaining agreement at the time of execution.

attributes.name: covered_job_classifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or detailed description of all job classifications and titles covered by this agreement (e.g., Lineman, Substation Electrician, Meter Reader, Plant Operator).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this collective bargaining agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: document_storage_location
attributes.description: File path, URL, or document management system reference to the full executed agreement document.

attributes.name: dues_checkoff_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employer is authorized to deduct union dues from employee paychecks and remit to the union.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the collective bargaining agreement becomes binding and enforceable.

attributes.name: excluded_job_classifications
attributes.description: Job classifications explicitly excluded from coverage under this agreement (e.g., supervisory, managerial, confidential positions).

attributes.name: execution_date
attributes.description: Date when authorized representatives of both the utility and union signed the agreement.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the collective bargaining agreement term ends. Nullable for evergreen agreements.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Geographic coverage area of the agreement (e.g., service territory, state, region, facility locations).

attributes.name: grievance_filing_deadline_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days from the alleged violation within which a grievance must be filed to be considered timely.

attributes.name: grievance_procedure_steps
attributes.description: Detailed description of the multi-step grievance resolution process defined in the agreement (e.g., Step 1: Supervisor, Step 2: Department Manager, Step 3: HR Director, Step 4: Arbitration).

attributes.name: health_insurance_contribution_percent
attributes.description: Percentage of health insurance premium costs paid by the employer under this agreement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this collective bargaining agreement record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: management_rights_clause
attributes.description: Text of the management rights provision reserving certain operational decisions to the employer.

attributes.name: no_strike_clause_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes a no-strike/no-lockout provision during the contract term.

attributes.name: overtime_rate_multiplier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to base wage for overtime hours (e.g., 1.5 for time-and-a-half, 2.0 for double-time).

attributes.name: overtime_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a period (daily or weekly) after which overtime rates apply.

attributes.name: pension_plan_reference
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the pension or retirement plan covering employees under this agreement.

attributes.name: probationary_period_days
attributes.description: Number of calendar days a new employee must work before gaining full bargaining unit rights and protections.

attributes.name: ratification_date
attributes.description: Date when the union membership voted to approve and ratify the collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: safety_committee_provision_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement establishes a joint labor-management safety committee.

attributes.name: seniority_system_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of how seniority is calculated, applied, and used for bidding, layoffs, recalls, and other employment decisions.

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate
attributes.description: Additional hourly pay rate or percentage premium for non-standard shifts (evening, night, weekend).

attributes.name: storm_duty_obligation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agreement includes mandatory storm duty and emergency response obligations for covered employees.

attributes.name: storm_duty_provisions
attributes.description: Detailed description of storm duty requirements, including response time, duration, compensation, and meal/lodging provisions.

attributes.name: union_international_affiliation
attributes.description: International or national parent organization of the union (e.g., AFL-CIO, Change to Win Federation).

attributes.name: union_local_number
attributes.description: Local chapter or lodge number of the union (e.g., IBEW Local 1245, UWUA Local 246).

attributes.name: union_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the labor union or labor organization party to this agreement (e.g., International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers, Utility Workers Union of America).

attributes.name: union_security_clause
attributes.description: Type of union security arrangement defined in the agreement governing union membership and dues requirements.

attributes.name: vacation_accrual_formula
attributes.description: Formula or schedule defining how vacation time accrues based on years of service.

attributes.name: wage_scale_structure
attributes.description: Description of the wage scale framework defined in the agreement, including pay grades, steps, and progression rules.

products.name: work_schedule
products.description: Master schedule templates defining shift patterns for utility workforce roles — including rotating 12-hour shifts for generation plant operators, 8-hour day/evening/night shifts for distribution control room dispatchers, on-call rotation schedules for emergency response crews, and standard M-F schedules for administrative staff. Captures schedule name, shift type, hours per shift, rotation cycle, applicable union agreement, and overtime eligibility rules.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HCM Work Schedule Rules

attributes.name: work_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the work schedule template. Primary key.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.union_agreement.union_agreement_id — Work schedules for bargaining unit employees must comply with CBA shift provisions, overtime rules, and call-out requirements. This link enables schedule validation against union agreement terms.

attributes.name: applicable_departments
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of departments or business units that use this schedule (e.g., 'Generation Operations, Transmission Control', 'Distribution Field Services', 'Customer Service'). Used for organizational reporting.

attributes.name: applicable_job_roles
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of job roles or classifications that typically use this schedule (e.g., 'Generation Plant Operator, Control Room Operator', 'Lineman, Field Technician', 'Administrative Staff'). Used for workforce planning.

attributes.name: applicable_union_agreement
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the collective bargaining agreement (CBA) or union contract that governs this schedule (e.g., 'IBEW Local 1245 CBA 2023', 'Non-Union'). Null if not union-covered.
attributes.references: Labor Relations and Union Agreement Standards

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Total duration of paid and unpaid breaks during the shift in minutes (e.g., 30 for lunch, 60 for lunch plus rest breaks). Used for net work hour calculations.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Safety Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this work schedule template record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: crew_size_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum number of employees required per shift under this schedule to maintain safe operations and regulatory compliance (e.g., 2 for line crew, 1 for control room operator). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: crew_size_optimal
attributes.description: Optimal number of employees per shift under this schedule for efficient operations and workload distribution. Used for workforce planning and scheduling optimization.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this work schedule template ceased or will cease to be effective. Null for currently active schedules with no planned end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this work schedule template became or will become effective for workforce assignments. Used for schedule versioning and historical tracking.

attributes.name: fatigue_risk_level
attributes.description: Assessment of fatigue risk associated with this schedule pattern: low (standard day shifts), moderate (rotating or extended shifts), high (frequent night shifts or compressed schedules). Used for safety and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Safety Standards

attributes.name: holiday_work_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees on this schedule are expected to work on company-recognized holidays (True) or have holidays off (False). Affects holiday premium pay.

attributes.name: hours_per_shift
attributes.description: Standard number of hours in a single shift under this schedule (e.g., 8.00, 10.00, 12.00). Used for time tracking and labor cost allocation.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Safety Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the workforce administrator who last modified this schedule template. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this work schedule template record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_personnel_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) Personnel Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees on this schedule are subject to NERC CIP personnel risk assessment and training requirements (True) due to access to critical cyber assets, or not subject (False).
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 Personnel and Training Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional information about the schedule template, including special instructions, exceptions, or historical context. Used for operational guidance and documentation.

attributes.name: off_days_per_cycle
attributes.description: Number of scheduled off days within one complete rotation cycle. Used for work-life balance analysis and crew availability planning.

attributes.name: on_call_duration_hours
attributes.description: Duration of each on-call period in hours (e.g., 24.00 for 24-hour on-call, 168.00 for week-long on-call). Null if on-call rotation is not applicable.

attributes.name: on_call_frequency_days
attributes.description: Number of days between on-call assignments in the rotation (e.g., 7 for weekly on-call, 14 for bi-weekly). Null if on-call rotation is not applicable.

attributes.name: on_call_rotation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule includes on-call rotation periods (True) for emergency response, or does not include on-call duty (False).

attributes.name: overtime_calculation_basis
attributes.description: Time period over which overtime hours are calculated: daily (hours beyond threshold per day), weekly (hours beyond threshold per week), biweekly, or pay_period.

attributes.name: overtime_eligibility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees on this schedule are eligible for overtime pay under FLSA and union agreements (True) or are exempt (False).

attributes.name: overtime_threshold_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked in a period (daily or weekly) after which overtime rates apply (e.g., 8.00 for daily OT, 40.00 for weekly OT). Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: paid_break_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of paid breaks during the shift in minutes. Subset of total break duration. Used for payroll and labor cost calculations.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Safety Standards

attributes.name: rotation_cycle_days
attributes.description: Number of days in the complete rotation cycle before the pattern repeats (e.g., 28 for a 4-week rotation, 7 for weekly rotation). Null for fixed schedules.

attributes.name: safety_sensitive_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule is designated for safety-sensitive positions (True) requiring enhanced OSHA compliance, fatigue management, and drug/alcohol testing, or not safety-sensitive (False).

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Short alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the schedule template in workforce systems (e.g., 'GEN-12HR-ROT', 'ADMIN-STD', 'EMERG-OC').
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HR/HCM Work Schedule Configuration

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Business name of the work schedule template (e.g., '12-Hour Rotating Shift - Generation', 'Standard M-F Admin', 'On-Call Emergency Response').

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classification of the schedule pattern: fixed (same shift daily), rotating (shifts change on cycle), on_call (standby/emergency), flexible (variable hours), or compressed (longer shifts, fewer days).

attributes.name: shift_differential_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether employees on this schedule are eligible for shift differential pay (True) for evening, night, or weekend shifts, or not eligible (False).
attributes.references: Labor Relations and Union Agreement Standards

attributes.name: shift_differential_rate_pct
attributes.description: Percentage premium applied to base pay for shift differential (e.g., 10.00 for 10% night shift premium, 15.00 for 15% weekend premium). Null if not applicable.
attributes.references: Labor Relations and Union Agreement Standards

attributes.name: shift_end_time
attributes.description: Standard end time for the shift in HH:mm format (24-hour clock, e.g., '15:00', '23:00', '07:00'). Represents the conclusion of the work period.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard shift pattern designation: day (morning/daytime), evening (afternoon/evening), night (overnight), swing (alternating day/night), split (two separate periods), continental (rotating 12-hour), dupont (4-crew rotation), panama (2-2-3 pattern). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: day|evening|night|swing|split|continental|dupont|panama — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: shift_start_time
attributes.description: Standard start time for the shift in HH:mm format (24-hour clock, e.g., '07:00', '15:00', '23:00'). Represents the beginning of the work period.

attributes.name: shifts_per_day
attributes.description: Number of distinct shifts in a 24-hour period under this schedule (e.g., 1 for standard day shift, 3 for 8-hour rotating coverage, 2 for 12-hour rotating).

attributes.name: unpaid_break_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of unpaid breaks (typically meal periods) during the shift in minutes. Subset of total break duration. Deducted from compensable hours.
attributes.references: OSHA Work Hours and Safety Standards

attributes.name: weekend_work_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this schedule includes regular weekend work (True) or is Monday-Friday only (False). Used for shift differential and premium pay calculations.

attributes.name: work_days_per_cycle
attributes.description: Number of actual work days within one complete rotation cycle. Used to calculate average work hours and staffing levels.

attributes.name: work_location_type
attributes.description: Primary work location type for employees on this schedule: field (outdoor utility infrastructure), plant (generation facility), control_room (SCADA/EMS/DMS operations center), office (administrative), remote (home-based), hybrid (combination).

attributes.name: work_schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the work schedule template: active (in use), inactive (temporarily suspended), draft (under development), deprecated (phased out but retained for historical reference).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the workforce administrator who created this schedule template. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: shift_assignment
products.description: Transactional records of individual employee shift assignments against work schedule templates, capturing assigned shift date, shift start/end times, assigned location (plant, substation, service center, control room), shift role, and any schedule deviations (swap, coverage, emergency callout). Supports daily crew scheduling, control room staffing compliance, and generation plant minimum staffing requirements.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HCM Time Management

attributes.name: shift_assignment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the shift assignment record. Primary key for the shift assignment entity.

attributes.name: alt5_shift_last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who last modified this shift assignment record. Audit field for accountability and change tracking.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: The cost center to which labor costs for this shift assignment are allocated. Used for financial reporting and departmental budgeting.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the crew or team to which the employee is assigned for this shift. Used for coordinated field work, outage response, and maintenance activities. Nullable for individual assignments.
attributes.references: Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management Crew

attributes.name: primary_shift_swap_original_employee_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Original Employee Identifier (ID) for Shift Swap
attributes.description: Identifier of the original employee who was initially scheduled for this shift before a swap occurred. Nullable if no swap. Used for shift trade tracking and union compliance.

attributes.name: primary_work_schedule_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.work_schedule.work_schedule_id — Shift assignments are instances of work schedule templates. This link enables schedule adherence tracking and overtime calculation based on the applicable schedule pattern.

attributes.name: quaternary_shift_scheduled_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or scheduler who created this shift assignment. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: quinary_shift_cancelled_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user who cancelled this shift assignment. Nullable for non-cancelled assignments. Used for audit trail.

attributes.name: shift_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — Each shift assignment is for a specific employee. Without this FK, daily staffing rosters cannot be generated and control room minimum staffing compliance cannot be verified.

attributes.name: shift_template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work schedule template that defines the standard shift pattern (e.g., 8-hour day shift, 12-hour night shift, rotating shift). References the shift template master.

attributes.name: shift_work_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.work_schedule. Business justification: shift_assignment currently has shift_template_id (BIGINT) which should reference work_schedule (the master schedule template table). The work_schedule table defines shift patterns, rotation cycles, ho

attributes.name: tertiary_shift_supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the supervisor or shift lead responsible for overseeing this employee during the assigned shift. References the employee master record.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order or maintenance task that this shift assignment supports. Nullable for general operational shifts. Enables labor cost allocation to specific asset maintenance activities.

attributes.name: actual_clock_in_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the employee clocked in or reported for duty at the start of the shift. Used for time and attendance tracking and variance analysis against scheduled start time.

attributes.name: actual_clock_out_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the employee clocked out or completed duty at the end of the shift. Used for time and attendance tracking and variance analysis against scheduled end time.

attributes.name: actual_hours_worked
attributes.description: The actual number of hours the employee worked during this shift, calculated from clock-in and clock-out timestamps. Used for payroll processing and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: assignment_date
attributes.description: The calendar date for which this shift assignment is scheduled. Represents the business day of the shift, not necessarily the clock start time (night shifts may start on prior calendar day).

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the shift assignment. Tracks progression from initial scheduling through completion or cancellation.

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the shift assignment indicating whether it is a regular scheduled shift, overtime, emergency callout, standby duty, or a shift swap/coverage arrangement. Critical for labor cost allocation and union agreement compliance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: regular|overtime|emergency_callout|standby|on_call|shift_swap|coverage — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: break_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration of unpaid break time during the shift, in minutes. Used to calculate net working hours and ensure compliance with labor regulations.

attributes.name: callout_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the employee was called out for emergency duty. Nullable for non-emergency assignments. Used to calculate response time and premium pay eligibility.

attributes.name: cancellation_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why the shift assignment was cancelled, if applicable. Nullable for non-cancelled assignments. Used for workforce planning analysis.

attributes.name: cancelled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this shift assignment was cancelled. Nullable for non-cancelled assignments. Used for audit trail and schedule change tracking.

attributes.name: confirmed_by_employee_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the employee acknowledged and confirmed acceptance of this shift assignment. Nullable if confirmation is not required or not yet received.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this shift assignment record was first created in the system. Audit field for data lineage and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: is_emergency_callout
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift assignment was triggered by an emergency callout (e.g., storm response, unplanned outage, critical equipment failure). Emergency callouts typically carry premium pay rates.

attributes.name: is_overtime_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift assignment qualifies for overtime compensation based on hours worked, employee classification, and union agreement rules.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: The total labor cost for this shift assignment, including base pay, overtime premium, and any shift differentials. Used for work order costing and financial analysis.

attributes.name: labor_cost_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the labor cost amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this shift assignment record was last updated. Audit field for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) Required Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this shift assignment requires NERC CIP personnel risk assessment and background check compliance due to access to critical cyber assets or bulk electric system facilities.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this shift assignment, such as special instructions, equipment requirements, or schedule deviations. Used for operational communication.

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the employee responded to the emergency callout and reported for duty. Used to measure callout response time compliance.

attributes.name: safety_certification_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee's required safety certifications (e.g., OSHA training, arc flash, confined space, high voltage) have been verified as current and valid for this shift assignment.

attributes.name: scheduled_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this shift assignment was created in the scheduling system. Audit field for tracking when the assignment was made.

attributes.name: shift_duration_hours
attributes.description: The total scheduled duration of the shift in hours, including any built-in break periods. Supports labor cost allocation and OSHA compliance for maximum shift length.

attributes.name: shift_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the employee's shift is scheduled to end, including time zone. Used to calculate shift duration and ensure minimum staffing coverage.

attributes.name: shift_role_code
attributes.description: Code representing the functional role the employee performs during this shift (e.g., LINEMAN, OPERATOR, DISPATCHER, ENGINEER, METER_READER, SUPERVISOR). Used for skill-based scheduling and NERC CIP personnel risk assessment compliance.

attributes.name: shift_role_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the shift role, providing context for the functional responsibilities during this assignment.

attributes.name: shift_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The actual date and time when the employee's shift is scheduled to begin, including time zone. Used for precise crew scheduling and control room staffing compliance.

attributes.name: shift_swap_approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the shift swap was approved by the supervisor or scheduling system. Nullable if no swap occurred.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code representing the labor union to which the employee belongs, if applicable. Used to ensure shift assignment complies with union collective bargaining agreement rules (e.g., seniority, overtime rotation, shift bidding).

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the physical work location where the employee is assigned for this shift (e.g., power plant, substation, service center, control room, field territory). References the location master.

products.name: time_entry
products.description: SSOT for employee and contractor time, attendance, and labor cost allocation records. Captures actual hours worked per day including regular, overtime, double-time, on-call, storm duty, leave, and travel time. Records work date, employee or contractor worker, cost object (work order, cost center, project, WBS element), activity type, pay type, labor rate, total cost, capitalization vs O&M expense classification, approval status, and payroll period. Supports labor cost allocation to asset maintenance work orders, capital construction projects, outage restoration events, demand response program delivery, and overhead cost centers. Feeds SAP S/4HANA plant maintenance and project accounting for CAPEX/OPEX reporting. Also supports FMLA leave tracking, leave balance management, DOT hours-of-service compliance for CDL positions, and union overtime compliance verification.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HCM CATS (Cross-Application Time Sheet)

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the time entry record. Primary key for the time entry data product.

attributes.name: contractor_worker_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.contractor_worker.contractor_worker_id — Time entries also capture contractor hours. Required for contractor labor cost allocation and invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: The organizational cost center to which this labor time is charged. Used for overhead and indirect labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the field crew or work team to which the employee was assigned during this time entry. Used for crew-based scheduling and dispatch.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — Time entries must reference the employee who worked the hours. Core FK for payroll, labor cost allocation, and overtime compliance.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the grid outage or storm restoration event to which this labor time is allocated. Used for outage cost tracking and SAIDI/SAIFI reporting.

attributes.name: payroll_period_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the payroll period to which this time entry belongs. Links to payroll processing cycle.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific payroll run that processed this time entry. Used for payroll reconciliation and audit.

attributes.name: primary_time_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee or contractor worker who recorded this time entry. Links to workforce employee registry.

attributes.name: project_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the capital construction project or program to which this labor time is allocated. Used for capital project cost tracking.

attributes.name: tertiary_time_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the person who last modified this time entry record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: time_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — Every time entry belongs to an employee. This is the fundamental payroll and cost allocation relationship. Without it, labor costs cannot be allocated and paychecks cannot be generated.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the asset maintenance or construction work order to which this labor time is allocated. Used for CAPEX/OPEX cost allocation.

attributes.name: activity_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the work activity performed during this time entry. Provides context for labor allocation.

attributes.name: activity_type_code
attributes.description: Classification code for the type of work activity performed (e.g., installation, repair, inspection, patrol, engineering, administrative).

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval workflow status of the time entry. Tracks progression from draft through supervisor approval to payroll posting.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the time entry was approved by the supervisor. Used for audit trail and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: capitalization_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this labor cost is capitalized (CAPEX) or expensed (OPEX). True for capital projects, false for O&M work.

attributes.name: comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes entered by the employee or supervisor regarding this time entry. Provides additional context for time allocation.

attributes.name: contractor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is for a contractor worker rather than a direct employee. Used for contractor labor cost tracking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for labor cost amount (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: dot_regulated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is subject to DOT hours-of-service regulations for commercial driver license (CDL) positions. Used for compliance tracking.
attributes.references: DOT FMCSA Hours of Service Regulations

attributes.name: expense_type
attributes.description: Classification of the expense type for financial reporting. Distinguishes between capital expenditure, operational expenditure, overhead, and indirect costs.

attributes.name: fmla_qualifying_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) Qualifying Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave time entry qualifies under FMLA regulations. Used for FMLA leave tracking and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FMLA Family and Medical Leave Act

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked or leave hours taken for this time entry. Supports fractional hours (e.g., 7.5 hours).

attributes.name: job_classification_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the job classification or craft for this time entry (e.g., lineman, electrician, engineer, dispatcher). Used for labor rate determination.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost for this time entry, calculated as hours worked multiplied by labor rate. Includes burden and overhead allocation.

attributes.name: labor_rate
attributes.description: The hourly labor rate applied to this time entry, including any overtime or premium multipliers. Used for labor cost calculation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this time entry record was last updated. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: leave_balance_impact
attributes.description: The number of leave hours deducted from or accrued to the employee's leave balance as a result of this time entry. Negative for leave taken, positive for accrual.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Time Management Leave Accounting

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the work location or facility where the work was performed. Used for geographic labor cost analysis.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_work_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Work Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry involves work on NERC CIP-designated critical cyber assets or bulk electric system facilities. Used for personnel risk assessment compliance.

attributes.name: osha_recordable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Recordable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is associated with an OSHA recordable injury or illness event. Used for safety compliance reporting.

attributes.name: overtime_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee is eligible for overtime pay under FLSA or union contract rules. True for non-exempt employees, false for exempt.

attributes.name: pay_type_code
attributes.description: Classification of the pay type for this time entry. Determines wage rate multiplier and leave balance impact. Supports union overtime compliance and DOT hours-of-service tracking.
