attributes.name: shift_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the work shift during which this time was worked (e.g., day shift, night shift, rotating shift). Used for shift differential pay calculation.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the source system from which this time entry was captured (e.g., SAP Time Management, mobile time entry app, badge reader).

attributes.name: time_entry_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the time entry record, typically generated by the time and attendance system.

attributes.name: time_for_employee
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — Time entries record hours worked by an employee. This FK is essential for payroll processing, labor cost allocation, and overtime compliance verification.

attributes.name: travel_time_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry represents travel time rather than direct work time. Used for travel time pay policy compliance.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union to which the employee belongs. Used for union contract compliance and overtime rule enforcement.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The specific WBS element within a project hierarchy to which this labor time is allocated. Enables detailed project cost tracking.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work was performed. Principal business event timestamp for labor time tracking.

products.name: leave_request
products.description: Employee leave requests and approved absences including vacation, sick leave, FMLA, military leave, bereavement, and union-negotiated personal days. Captures leave type, requested start/end dates, approved dates, approving supervisor, leave balance consumed, FMLA eligibility flag, and impact on minimum staffing levels. Integrates with shift scheduling to flag coverage gaps for critical operational roles (control room operators, plant operators).
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HCM Absence Management; FMLA 29 CFR Part 825

attributes.name: leave_request_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the leave request record. Primary key.

attributes.name: leave_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — Leave requests are per-employee. FK required for leave balance management, FMLA tracking, and staffing gap analysis.

attributes.name: primary_leave_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee submitting the leave request. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: tertiary_leave_coverage_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee assigned to cover the absent employee duties during the leave period. Links to employee master record.

attributes.name: work_schedule_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the shift schedule affected by this leave request. Used to flag coverage gaps for shift-based operational roles.

attributes.name: approval_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments entered by the approving supervisor explaining the approval decision, conditions, or denial reason.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request was approved or denied by the supervisor.

attributes.name: approved_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of work hours approved for absence, calculated from approved start and end dates. Used to decrement leave balance.

attributes.name: approved_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of absence as approved by the supervisor. May differ from requested end date if partial approval granted.

attributes.name: approved_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of absence as approved by the supervisor. May differ from requested start date if partial approval granted.

attributes.name: coverage_plan_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether a formal coverage plan must be documented before this leave can be approved, typically for critical roles or extended absences.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request record was first created in the system, typically when the employee began drafting the request.

attributes.name: critical_role_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee requesting leave holds a critical operational role (control room operator, plant operator, dispatcher, NERC CIP personnel) requiring special staffing considerations and coverage planning.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 Personnel and Training; Internal Staffing Policy

attributes.name: denial_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why the leave request was denied: insufficient_staffing (minimum crew requirements not met), insufficient_balance (employee lacks accrued leave), business_need (critical operational period), policy_violation (does not meet policy requirements), documentation_missing (required medical certification not provided), other (see comments).

attributes.name: fmla_case_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Case Number
attributes.description: Unique case identifier assigned to track FMLA-protected leave for compliance reporting. Populated only when is_fmla_eligible is true.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; DOL Reporting Requirements

attributes.name: impacts_minimum_staffing
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether approving this leave would cause staffing levels to fall below the minimum required for safe operations in critical roles such as control room operators, plant operators, or NERC CIP-designated positions.
attributes.references: NERC CIP Personnel Risk Assessment; Internal Staffing Policy

attributes.name: intermittent_leave_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is intermittent leave (true) taken in separate blocks of time rather than one continuous period (false). Common for FMLA medical treatment schedules.

attributes.name: is_fmla_eligible
attributes.business_glossary_term: FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act) Eligible Indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this leave qualifies for FMLA protection (true) or not (false). FMLA provides job-protected unpaid leave for qualifying medical and family reasons.

attributes.name: is_paid_leave
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this leave is paid (true) or unpaid (false). Determines payroll processing and leave balance consumption.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the leave request record was last updated, capturing any changes to dates, status, or approval information.

attributes.name: leave_balance_consumed_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours deducted from the employee leave balance accrual for this approved absence. May differ from approved duration if unpaid leave or partial pay applies.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA HCM Time Management Quota

attributes.name: leave_subtype
attributes.description: Detailed classification within the leave type, such as FMLA continuous vs intermittent, sick personal vs sick family care, or military active duty vs reserve training.

attributes.name: leave_type
attributes.description: Category of leave being requested: vacation (paid time off), sick (illness or medical appointments), FMLA (Family and Medical Leave Act protected leave), military (active duty or reserve training), bereavement (death of family member), personal (union-negotiated personal days).
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825; Union Collective Bargaining Agreement

attributes.name: medical_certification_received_date
attributes.description: Date when required medical certification documentation was received by HR, if applicable.

attributes.name: medical_certification_required
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether medical certification documentation is required to support this leave request, typically for FMLA or extended sick leave.
attributes.references: FMLA 29 CFR Part 825.305; Internal HR Policy

attributes.name: osha_recordable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: OSHA (Occupational Safety and Health Administration) Recordable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave is related to an OSHA recordable workplace injury or illness requiring compliance reporting.

attributes.name: payroll_integration_status
attributes.description: Status of integration with payroll system to process leave pay or unpaid time: pending (awaiting transmission), sent (transmitted to payroll), confirmed (acknowledged by payroll), error (integration failure requiring manual intervention).

attributes.name: reason_description
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the employee describing the reason for the leave request. May contain sensitive medical or personal information.

attributes.name: request_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for the leave request, typically system-generated in format LR-YYYYNNNN.

attributes.name: request_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the leave request: draft (employee is composing), submitted (sent to supervisor), pending_approval (awaiting manager decision), approved (authorized for absence), denied (rejected by supervisor), cancelled (system-cancelled due to business rule), withdrawn (employee retracted before approval). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|pending_approval|approved|denied|cancelled|withdrawn — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requested_duration_hours
attributes.description: Total number of work hours the employee is requesting to be absent, calculated from requested start and end dates based on employee work schedule.

attributes.name: requested_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date the employee intends to be absent, as originally requested. Inclusive end date.

attributes.name: requested_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date the employee intends to be absent, as originally requested.

attributes.name: return_to_work_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a return-to-work medical clearance is required before the employee can resume duties, typically for extended medical leave or OSHA recordable injuries.

attributes.name: return_to_work_date
attributes.description: Actual date the employee returned to work following the leave period. Used for attendance tracking and leave reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this leave request record originated, typically SAP S/4HANA HCM or a self-service portal.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this leave request in the source operational system, used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the employee submitted the leave request for supervisor approval.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union to which the employee belongs, if applicable. Union membership may affect leave entitlements, approval rules, and personal day allocations per collective bargaining agreement.
attributes.references: Union Collective Bargaining Agreement; SAP S/4HANA HCM Organizational Management

attributes.name: work_order_impact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this leave affects scheduled work orders or maintenance activities assigned to the employee, requiring crew reassignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Plant Maintenance; Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management

attributes.name: workers_comp_claim_number
attributes.description: Workers compensation insurance claim number if this leave is related to a workplace injury or occupational illness.

products.name: contractor_worker
products.description: Master records for contractor and contingent workforce personnel engaged by the utility for capital construction projects, storm restoration mutual aid, specialized maintenance (e.g., turbine overhauls, relay testing), and supplemental operations staffing. Captures contractor company name, worker identity, trade classification, contract reference, daily rate or hourly rate, site access authorization status, NERC CIP PRA status for CIP-applicable contractors, background check completion, safety orientation date, required PPE certifications, and active engagement period. Distinct from employees — contractor workers are not on utility payroll but are subject to the same safety, access, and certification requirements on utility property.
products.reference: NERC CIP-004 R3 Contractor Personnel Risk Assessment; Ventyx Asset Suite Contractor Management

attributes.name: contractor_worker_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the contractor worker record. Primary key for the contractor_worker product.

attributes.name: contractor_company_id
attributes.description: Reference to the contractor company that employs or dispatches this worker. Links to the contractor company master record.

attributes.name: contractor_crew_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.crew. Business justification: Contractor workers assigned to utility crews for storm response and mutual aid. Linking enables mixed crew composition tracking, labor cost allocation, and contractor safety oversight.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Contractor labor costs must be allocated to cost centers for financial tracking, budget management, and rate case support. New FK needed as no existing cost_center reference exists.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_access_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.nerc_cip_access.nerc_cip_access_id — Contractors working at CIP facilities require NERC CIP access authorization. FK needed for CIP-004 compliance — contractors are subject to same PRA and access control requirements.

attributes.name: primary_crew_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.crew.crew_id — Contractor workers are often assigned to crews for storm restoration and capital construction. This link enables mixed crew composition tracking (utility employees + contractors) which is critical for

attributes.name: supervisor_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the utility employee who supervises or coordinates the work of this contractor worker. Links to the employee master record.
attributes.references: Internal Workforce Management Standard; SAP S/4HANA HCM

attributes.name: arc_flash_training_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor worker completed arc flash hazard awareness and PPE training required for work on energized electrical equipment.
attributes.references: NFPA 70E (electrical safety in the workplace); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269

attributes.name: background_check_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the background check was completed for this contractor worker. Null if not required or not yet completed.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 (personnel risk assessment); Internal Security Policy

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of criminal and employment background check for the contractor worker (cleared, pending, failed, not_required, expired).
attributes.references: NERC CIP-004 (personnel risk assessment); Internal Security Policy

attributes.name: cdl_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the contractor worker's Commercial Driver License. Null if CDL not held.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 383 (commercial driver license standards)

attributes.name: cdl_license_number
attributes.description: Commercial Driver License number for contractor workers authorized to operate utility vehicles and heavy equipment. Null if CDL not required for role.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 383 (commercial driver license standards)

attributes.name: confined_space_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor worker completed confined space entry training and certification required for work in vaults, manholes, and other permit-required confined spaces.

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the master service agreement or purchase order under which this contractor worker is engaged by the utility.
attributes.references: Internal Procurement Standard; SAP S/4HANA Materials Management

attributes.name: cpr_first_aid_certification_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: CPR and First Aid Certification Date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor worker completed CPR and first aid certification. Required for field crew members working in remote locations.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.151 (medical services and first aid)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contractor worker record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: daily_rate_usd
attributes.description: Daily billing rate in US Dollars for the contractor worker if compensated on a per-diem basis. Null if hourly rate applies.
attributes.references: Internal Procurement Standard; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: drug_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent drug and alcohol test was administered to the contractor worker.
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 40 (drug and alcohol testing); Internal Drug-Free Workplace Policy

attributes.name: drug_test_status
attributes.description: Status of pre-employment or random drug and alcohol screening for the contractor worker (passed, failed, pending, not_required, expired).
attributes.references: DOT 49 CFR Part 40 (drug and alcohol testing); Internal Drug-Free Workplace Policy

attributes.name: emergency_contact_name
attributes.description: Full name of the emergency contact person for the contractor worker in case of workplace injury or incident.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 (recording and reporting occupational injuries and illnesses)

attributes.name: emergency_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the emergency contact person for the contractor worker.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 (recording and reporting occupational injuries and illnesses)

attributes.name: emergency_contact_relationship
attributes.description: Relationship of the emergency contact person to the contractor worker (e.g., spouse, parent, sibling, friend).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 (recording and reporting occupational injuries and illnesses)

attributes.name: engagement_end_date
attributes.description: Planned or actual date on which the contractor worker engagement with the utility ends or ended. Null for open-ended engagements.

attributes.name: engagement_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor worker began active engagement with the utility under the current contract.

attributes.name: hourly_rate_usd
attributes.description: Hourly billing rate in US Dollars for the contractor worker if compensated on an hourly basis. Null if daily rate applies.
attributes.references: Internal Procurement Standard; SAP S/4HANA Finance

attributes.name: national_id_number
attributes.description: Government-issued national identification number (e.g., Social Security Number in USA) used for background check and tax reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15 (employer tax guide); NERC CIP-004 (personnel risk assessment)

attributes.name: nerc_cip_pra_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP Personnel Risk Assessment (PRA) Completion Date
attributes.description: Date on which the NERC CIP Personnel Risk Assessment was completed for this contractor worker. Null if not required or not yet completed.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_pra_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: NERC CIP Personnel Risk Assessment (PRA) Status
attributes.description: Status of NERC CIP-004 Personnel Risk Assessment for contractor workers requiring unescorted physical or electronic access to BES Cyber Systems or Physical Security Perimeters (completed, pending, not_required, expired, failed).

attributes.name: ppe_certification_status
attributes.description: Status of required Personal Protective Equipment certification for the contractor worker, including arc flash PPE, fall protection, and respiratory protection (current, expired, pending, not_required).
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.132 (general PPE requirements); OSHA 29 CFR 1910.269 (electric power generation, transmission, and distribution)

attributes.name: safety_orientation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contractor worker completed mandatory utility safety orientation training covering site-specific hazards, emergency procedures, and OSHA compliance requirements.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.120 (hazardous waste operations); OSHA 29 CFR 1926 Subpart C (general safety and health provisions)

attributes.name: site_access_status
attributes.description: Current authorization status for the contractor worker to access utility facilities and work sites (authorized, pending, suspended, revoked, expired).

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this contractor worker record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA HCM, Ventyx Asset Suite Work Management, contractor management portal).

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Reason for termination or suspension of the contractor worker engagement (e.g., contract completion, safety violation, performance issue, voluntary departure). Null if status is active.

attributes.name: trade_classification
attributes.description: Primary skilled trade or craft classification of the contractor worker (e.g., lineman, electrician, welder, heavy equipment operator, relay technician, turbine technician, instrumentation technician). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: lineman|electrician|welder|heavy_equipment_operator|relay_technician|turbine_technician|instrumentation_technician|substation_technician|meter_technician|civil_engineer|structural_engineer|environmental_specialist|safety_coordinator — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IBEW (International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers) trade classifications; OSHA 29 CFR 1910 Subpart S (electrical work practices)

attributes.name: union_affiliation
attributes.description: Labor union or trade association to which the contractor worker belongs (e.g., IBEW Local 1245, Operating Engineers Local 3). Null if non-union.
attributes.references: NLRA (National Labor Relations Act); Internal Labor Relations Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this contractor worker record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Primary utility facility or service territory code where the contractor worker is assigned (e.g., generating station, substation, district office, or regional operations center).
attributes.references: Internal Asset Management Standard; Esri ArcGIS Utility Network

attributes.name: worker_badge_number
attributes.description: Utility-issued badge or access card number assigned to the contractor worker for physical and logical access control to utility facilities and systems.
attributes.references: NERC CIP-006 (physical security); NERC CIP-005 (electronic security perimeter)

attributes.name: worker_email
attributes.description: Primary email address for the contractor worker used for safety notifications, training assignments, and site access communications.

attributes.name: worker_first_name
attributes.description: First (given) name of the contractor worker as recorded in identity verification documents.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 (recordkeeping); NERC CIP-004 (personnel risk assessment)

attributes.name: worker_last_name
attributes.description: Last (family) name of the contractor worker as recorded in identity verification documents.
attributes.references: OSHA 29 CFR 1904 (recordkeeping); NERC CIP-004 (personnel risk assessment)

attributes.name: worker_middle_name
attributes.description: Middle name or initial of the contractor worker, if provided.

attributes.name: worker_phone
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the contractor worker for emergency contact and crew dispatch coordination.

attributes.name: worker_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contractor worker engagement with the utility (active, inactive, suspended, terminated).

products.name: labor_cost_allocation
products.description: Transactional records allocating employee and contractor labor costs to specific cost objects — work orders (asset maintenance, capital construction), outage restoration events, demand response program delivery, and overhead cost centers. Captures employee/contractor, hours, labor rate, total cost, cost object type, cost object reference, allocation date, and capitalization vs. O&M expense classification. Feeds SAP S/4HANA plant maintenance and project accounting for CAPEX/OPEX reporting.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Cost Object Controlling; FERC USOA Labor Accounts

attributes.name: labor_cost_allocation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the labor cost allocation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the capital construction project to which labor cost is allocated. Null if allocated to a different cost object type.

attributes.name: contractor_worker_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the contractor whose labor cost is being allocated. Null if the allocation is for an employee. References the contractor master.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Code of the overhead cost center to which labor cost is allocated. Null if allocated to a specific work order, project, or event.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the field crew or work team to which the employee or contractor was assigned during this allocation period.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee whose labor cost is being allocated. References the workforce employee master.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the outage restoration event to which labor cost is allocated. Null if allocated to a different cost object type.

attributes.name: work_order_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the work order to which labor cost is allocated. Null if allocated to a different cost object type.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Type of work activity performed during the allocated labor hours. Used for labor productivity analysis and cost benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: maintenance|construction|inspection|emergency_restoration|meter_reading|vegetation_management|engineering|administrative|training|safety_compliance — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: allocation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the labor cost allocation is recorded. Represents the business event date for the allocation.

attributes.name: allocation_status
attributes.description: Current status of the labor cost allocation record in the workflow. Approved allocations are posted to SAP S/4HANA financial accounting.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the labor cost allocation was approved by the supervisor or project manager. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the supervisor or manager who approved this labor cost allocation. Null if not yet approved.

attributes.name: base_wage_rate
attributes.description: The base hourly wage rate for the employee or contractor, excluding benefits and burden. Expressed in USD per hour.

attributes.name: burden_rate
attributes.description: The hourly burden rate applied to this allocation, covering benefits, payroll taxes, insurance, and overhead. Expressed in USD per hour.

attributes.name: business_unit
attributes.description: Business unit or operating division responsible for this labor cost allocation (e.g., Transmission, Distribution, Generation).

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: SAP Controlling cost element code representing the type of labor cost (e.g., direct labor, indirect labor, contractor labor).

attributes.name: cost_object_type
attributes.description: Type of cost object to which labor is allocated. Determines which cost object reference field is populated.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor cost allocation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the labor cost. Typically USD for US-based utilities.

attributes.name: double_time_hours
attributes.description: Number of double-time hours worked for this allocation, typically at 2x regular rate per union agreements or emergency restoration work.

attributes.name: expense_classification
attributes.description: Classification of the labor cost as Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operational Expenditure (OPEX) for financial reporting and regulatory accounting.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code to which this labor cost is posted for regulatory financial reporting.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code in SAP S/4HANA to which this labor cost is posted.

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total number of hours worked by the employee or contractor for this allocation. Includes regular, overtime, and double-time hours.

attributes.name: job_classification
attributes.description: Job classification or title of the employee or contractor performing the work (e.g., Journeyman Lineman, Substation Technician, Plant Operator, Engineer).

attributes.name: labor_rate
attributes.description: The blended hourly labor rate applied to this allocation, including base wage, benefits, and burden. Expressed in USD per hour.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this labor cost allocation record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this labor cost allocation record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this labor cost allocation, including special circumstances, exceptions, or clarifications.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of overtime hours worked for this allocation, typically at 1.5x regular rate per union agreements or labor law.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the labor cost allocation was posted to SAP S/4HANA general ledger. Null if not yet posted.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Number of regular hours worked (non-overtime) for this allocation.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date on which this labor cost allocation was reversed. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this labor cost allocation has been reversed due to error correction or reallocation. True if reversed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation of why this labor cost allocation was reversed. Null if not reversed.

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA financial document number generated when this labor cost allocation was posted to the general ledger. Null if not yet posted.

attributes.name: shift_type
attributes.description: Type of work shift during which the labor was performed. Affects labor rate multipliers and union agreement compliance.

attributes.name: time_entry_source
attributes.description: Source system or method by which the labor hours were originally captured (e.g., mobile field app, web timesheet, biometric time clock).

attributes.name: total_labor_cost
attributes.description: Total labor cost for this allocation, calculated as hours_worked multiplied by labor_rate. Expressed in USD.

attributes.name: union_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the labor union to which the employee belongs. Null for non-union employees and contractors. Used for union agreement compliance and labor cost reporting.

attributes.name: work_date
attributes.description: The date on which the labor was actually performed. May differ from allocation_date if allocation is recorded retrospectively.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the geographic location or facility where the work was performed. Used for regional cost analysis and labor mobility tracking.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this labor cost allocation record.

products.name: nerc_cip_access
products.description: NERC CIP-004 and CIP-006 access authorization records for employees and contractors with logical or physical access to Critical Cyber Assets (CCAs) and Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) facilities including control rooms, generation plants, and transmission substations. Captures access type (physical/logical), CIP facility or system, authorization date, revocation date, PRA completion reference, and seven-year retention flag. Mandatory evidence for NERC CIP compliance audits.
products.reference: NERC CIP-004 R4 Access Management; NERC CIP-006 Physical Security

attributes.name: nerc_cip_access_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Access ID
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the NERC CIP access authorization record. Primary key for the access authorization entity.

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: NERC CIP access authorizations are control-area-specific (CCA boundaries). Linking enables CIP-002 BES Cyber System access audits and personnel risk assessments by operational jurisdiction.

attributes.name: logical_access_account_id
attributes.description: User account identifier or login credential for logical access to Critical Cyber Assets. Applicable for logical access authorizations.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the CIP-designated facility to which access is granted, such as control centers, generation plants, or transmission substations.

attributes.name: nerc_employee_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.employee.employee_id — NERC CIP access records must link to the specific employee or contractor granted access. This is mandatory audit evidence for NERC CIP-004 and CIP-006 compliance. Without this FK, access authorization

attributes.name: primary_nerc_employee_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the employee or contractor being granted access. Links to the workforce employee master record.

attributes.name: tertiary_nerc_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who last modified this access authorization record, required for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: access_authorization_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the access authorization record, typically used in audit documentation and compliance reporting.

attributes.name: access_badge_number
attributes.description: Physical access badge or credential number issued for entry to CIP facilities. Applicable for physical access authorizations.

attributes.name: access_level
attributes.description: Level or privilege tier of access granted within the CIP facility or system, defining the scope of permitted actions.

attributes.name: access_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the periodic access review process. Current indicates review is up to date; overdue indicates review deadline has passed; scheduled indicates review is planned; in_progress indicates review is underway.

attributes.name: access_type
attributes.description: Type of access granted: physical access to CIP facilities, logical access to Critical Cyber Assets (CCAs), or both.

attributes.name: audit_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional audit-relevant information, exceptions, special conditions, or compliance notes related to this access authorization.

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the access authorization was granted and became effective.

attributes.name: authorization_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the access authorization expires and must be renewed or revoked. Nullable for indefinite authorizations subject to periodic review.

attributes.name: authorization_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the access authorization. Active indicates valid access; revoked indicates access has been terminated; suspended indicates temporary hold; expired indicates authorization period has ended; pending indicates awaiting approval.

attributes.name: authorized_by_name
attributes.description: Full name of the manager or security officer who approved the access authorization, captured for audit documentation.

attributes.name: background_check_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the background check or identity verification was completed as part of the Personnel Risk Assessment process.

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the background check or identity verification process. Cleared indicates successful completion; pending indicates in progress; failed indicates disqualifying findings; waived indicates exemption granted.

attributes.name: business_justification
attributes.description: Business reason and justification for granting CIP access, documenting the operational need and role requirements.

attributes.name: cca_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the Critical Cyber Asset system or application to which logical access is granted, such as SCADA, EMS, or DMS systems.

attributes.name: contractor_agreement_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the master service agreement or contract under which the contractor is engaged. Applicable for contractor access authorizations.

attributes.name: contractor_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the contracting company if the individual is a contractor rather than a direct employee. Nullable for direct employees.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this access authorization record was first created in the system, used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: escort_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the individual requires an escort when accessing CIP facilities. True if escort is required; false if unescorted access is permitted.

attributes.name: last_access_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic review of this access authorization, required at least annually per NERC CIP-004-6 R4.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this access authorization record was last updated, used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Version
attributes.description: Version of the NERC CIP standards under which this access authorization was granted, important for tracking compliance requirements across standard revisions.

attributes.name: next_access_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of this access authorization to verify continued business need and appropriateness.

attributes.name: pra_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the Personnel Risk Assessment was completed for this individual, a prerequisite for CIP access authorization.

attributes.name: pra_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the Personnel Risk Assessment record, used for audit verification and compliance tracking.

attributes.name: revocation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the access authorization was revoked, typically upon termination, transfer, or no longer requiring access. Nullable if authorization has not been revoked.

attributes.name: revocation_reason
attributes.description: Reason for revoking the access authorization, required for audit trail and compliance documentation.

attributes.name: seven_year_retention_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this access authorization record must be retained for seven years per NERC CIP compliance requirements. True for records requiring extended retention; false otherwise.

attributes.name: training_completion_date
attributes.description: Date on which the individual completed required NERC CIP security awareness and role-based training, a prerequisite for access authorization.

attributes.name: training_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking to the CIP training completion record for audit verification.

products.name: grievance
products.description: Union grievance records filed by bargaining unit employees or union representatives alleging violations of the collective bargaining agreement. Captures grievance number, filing date, grievant employee, union local, alleged CBA violation, step in grievance procedure (Step 1 through arbitration), management response, resolution outcome, and settlement terms. Supports labor relations management and CBA compliance tracking.
products.reference: IBEW/UWUA CBA Grievance Procedure

attributes.name: grievance_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the union grievance record. Primary key.

attributes.name: grievance_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the union steward or business agent representing the grievant in the grievance procedure.

attributes.name: grievance_grievant_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the bargaining unit employee who filed the grievance or on whose behalf the grievance was filed.

attributes.name: grievance_labor_relations_specialist_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the company labor relations specialist or human resources representative managing the grievance on behalf of management.

attributes.name: grievance_management_respondent_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the management representative or supervisor whose action or decision is being grieved.

attributes.name: union_agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.union_agreement. Business justification: Grievances allege violations of collective bargaining agreements (CBAs). Adding union_agreement_id FK links each grievance to the specific CBA being contested. Currently stores alleged_cba_violation a

attributes.name: arbitration_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of arbitration including arbitrator fees, hearing room rental, and administrative expenses, in USD.

attributes.name: arbitration_decision_date
attributes.description: Date the arbitrator issued the binding arbitration award or decision.

attributes.name: arbitration_filed_date
attributes.description: Date the union filed for binding arbitration after exhausting internal grievance procedure steps.

attributes.name: arbitration_hearing_date
attributes.description: Date of the formal arbitration hearing where both parties present evidence and arguments.

attributes.name: arbitration_outcome
attributes.description: Final outcome of the arbitration: sustained (grievance upheld), denied (management decision upheld), or partially sustained (split decision).

attributes.name: arbitrator_name
attributes.description: Name of the neutral arbitrator selected to hear and decide the grievance if it proceeds to arbitration.

attributes.name: back_pay_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of back pay awarded to the grievant as part of the grievance resolution or arbitration award, in USD.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center to which any financial settlement, back pay, or arbitration costs are allocated for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grievance record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date the grievance was formally filed with management, triggering the grievance procedure timeline per the collective bargaining agreement.

attributes.name: grievance_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the grievance, typically formatted as GRV-YYYY-NNNNN for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: grievance_status
attributes.description: Current status of the grievance in the resolution lifecycle, tracking progression through the grievance procedure steps defined in the CBA. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: filed|step_1_pending|step_2_pending|step_3_pending|arbitration_pending|resolved|withdrawn|denied — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: grievance_type
attributes.description: Classification of the grievance: individual (single employee), group (multiple employees), policy (interpretation of CBA language), or continuing (ongoing violation).

attributes.name: incident_date
attributes.description: Date the alleged CBA violation or incident that gave rise to the grievance occurred.

attributes.name: incident_location
attributes.description: Work location, facility, or service center where the alleged violation occurred.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this grievance record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: management_response
attributes.description: Written response from management to the grievance, including rationale for the decision and interpretation of CBA provisions.

attributes.name: management_response_date
attributes.description: Date management provided its written response to the grievance at the current step.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or system account that last modified this grievance record, for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding the grievance, its handling, or resolution.

attributes.name: precedent_setting_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this grievance or arbitration decision establishes a precedent for future CBA interpretation (True/False).

attributes.name: remedy_requested
attributes.description: Specific remedy or relief requested by the grievant or union (e.g., reinstatement, back pay, removal of discipline from record).

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date the grievance was formally resolved, closed, or withdrawn.

attributes.name: resolution_outcome
attributes.description: Final resolution outcome of the grievance: granted (remedy provided), denied (grievance rejected), settled (mutual agreement), or withdrawn (grievant withdrew).

attributes.name: settlement_terms
attributes.description: Detailed terms of the settlement agreement if the grievance was resolved through mutual agreement between the parties.

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Current step in the multi-step grievance procedure as defined in the collective bargaining agreement (typically Step 1 through arbitration).

attributes.name: step_1_hearing_date
attributes.description: Date of the Step 1 grievance hearing between the grievant, union representative, and first-level management.

attributes.name: step_2_hearing_date
attributes.description: Date of the Step 2 grievance hearing with higher-level management if Step 1 did not resolve the grievance.

attributes.name: step_3_hearing_date
attributes.description: Date of the Step 3 grievance hearing with senior management or labor relations department if Step 2 did not resolve the grievance.

attributes.name: subject
attributes.description: Primary subject matter category of the grievance for classification and trend analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: discipline|discharge|work_assignment|overtime|seniority|safety|wages|benefits|working_conditions|other — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: time_limit_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the grievance was filed and processed within the time limits specified in the CBA (True/False). Non-compliance may render grievance invalid.

attributes.name: union_local
attributes.description: Union local chapter or bargaining unit that represents the grievant (e.g., IBEW Local 1245, UWUA Local 223).

products.name: job_requisition
products.description: Workforce hiring requisitions initiated by utility managers to fill open positions — covering both permanent hires and temporary/seasonal staffing needs. Captures requisition number, position, org unit, hiring manager, justification (backfill, new headcount, seasonal), required certifications, target hire date, approved headcount budget, recruitment status, and sourcing channel. Drives talent acquisition workflow and headcount tracking against authorized positions.
products.reference: SAP S/4HANA HCM Recruitment

attributes.name: job_requisition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the job requisition record. Primary key for the job requisition entity.

attributes.name: job_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational unit (department, division, service center) where the position will be located. Links to organizational hierarchy for reporting and budget allocation.

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.org_unit.org_unit_id — Requisitions are raised within specific org units. This drives departmental hiring budget tracking and approval workflows.

attributes.name: primary_job_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee who initiated the requisition and will manage the new hire. Responsible for interview participation and final selection decision.

attributes.name: workforce_position_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.workforce_position.workforce_position_id — Job requisitions are opened to fill specific authorized positions. This link enables headcount tracking (authorized vs filled vs in-recruitment) and ensures requisitions align with approved position s

attributes.name: approved_headcount_budget
attributes.description: Total annual budget allocated for this position including salary, benefits, and overhead. Used for financial planning and budget variance tracking.

attributes.name: background_check_level
attributes.description: Depth of pre-employment background screening required. NERC CIP PRA is most comprehensive, including criminal history, employment verification, and credit check for positions with CIP access.

attributes.name: cdl_class
attributes.description: Required CDL class if CDL is mandatory. Class A for heavy combination vehicles, Class B for heavy straight vehicles, Class C for vehicles carrying hazardous materials or 16+ passengers.

attributes.name: cdl_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a valid Commercial Driver License is required for the position. Common for field crew, meter reader, and equipment operator roles.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Financial cost center code to which the position salary and benefits will be charged. Used for budget tracking and labor cost allocation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the requisition record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and process analytics.

attributes.name: drug_testing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether pre-employment and ongoing drug testing is required. Mandatory for safety-sensitive positions and CDL holders under DOT regulations.

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the employment relationship. Determines benefits eligibility, labor agreements, and workforce reporting categories.

attributes.name: flsa_status
attributes.description: Classification under the Fair Labor Standards Act determining overtime eligibility. Non-exempt employees are entitled to overtime pay; exempt employees are not.

attributes.name: full_time_equivalent
attributes.description: Numeric representation of the position workload as a fraction of full-time hours. 1.0 for full-time, 0.5 for half-time. Used for headcount budgeting and capacity planning.

attributes.name: job_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the position responsibilities, duties, and expectations. Used for job postings and candidate communication.

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad occupational category grouping similar roles. Used for workforce planning, compensation benchmarking, and career pathing. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: operations|engineering|technical|administrative|management|field_services|customer_service|finance|it|safety — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the requisition record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: minimum_education_level
attributes.description: Minimum educational qualification required for the position. Used for candidate screening and compliance with professional licensing requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_experience_years
attributes.description: Minimum number of years of relevant work experience required for the position. Used for candidate screening and compensation determination.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the requisition record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_access_required
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Access Required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires access to NERC CIP-designated critical cyber assets or physical security perimeters. Triggers Personnel Risk Assessment (PRA) and background check requirements.

attributes.name: number_of_openings
attributes.description: Count of positions to be filled under this requisition. Typically 1 for individual hires, may be higher for seasonal or crew hiring campaigns.

attributes.name: osha_safety_sensitive
attributes.business_glossary_term: Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) Safety Sensitive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is classified as safety-sensitive under OSHA regulations, requiring enhanced safety training, drug testing, and incident reporting.

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation level assigned to the position within the utility pay structure. Determines salary range and progression path. Often tied to union agreements.

attributes.name: physical_requirements
attributes.description: Description of physical demands of the position (e.g., ability to lift 50 lbs, climb poles, work at heights, operate in confined spaces). Required for ADA compliance and safety planning.

attributes.name: position_title
attributes.description: Job title for the open position being recruited. Examples include Lineman, Substation Operator, Meter Reader, Distribution Engineer, SCADA Technician.

attributes.name: required_certifications
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of mandatory certifications for the position (e.g., CDL Class A, NERC CIP training, OSHA 10-hour, First Aid/CPR, Journeyman Lineman). Used for candidate screening.

attributes.name: requisition_approved_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition received final approval and was authorized to proceed with recruitment. Null if still pending or rejected.

attributes.name: requisition_closed_date
attributes.description: Date when the requisition was closed (filled, cancelled, or withdrawn). Used to calculate time-to-fill metrics.

attributes.name: requisition_justification
attributes.description: Business reason for the hiring request. Supports headcount planning and budget approval processes. Distinguishes between replacement hires and net new positions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: backfill_retirement|backfill_resignation|backfill_termination|new_headcount_growth|new_headcount_project|seasonal_demand|regulatory_requirement|workload_increase — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the job requisition, typically formatted as REQ-NNNNNN. Used for external communication and tracking in recruitment systems.

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job requisition in the hiring workflow. Tracks progression from draft through approval to fulfillment or cancellation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|submitted|approved|rejected|open|in_progress|filled|cancelled|on_hold — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: requisition_submitted_date
attributes.description: Date when the hiring manager submitted the requisition for approval. Marks the start of the approval workflow.

attributes.name: requisition_type
attributes.description: Classification of the hiring need. Distinguishes between new headcount, backfill for departed employee, seasonal staffing, temporary assignments, and contractor positions. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_position|backfill|replacement|seasonal|temporary|contractor|intern — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: salary_range_maximum
attributes.description: Maximum annual salary for the position in USD. Defines the upper bound of the compensation band for the pay grade.

attributes.name: salary_range_minimum
attributes.description: Minimum annual salary for the position in USD. Defines the lower bound of the compensation band for the pay grade.

attributes.name: security_clearance_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position requires government or utility security clearance. Common for positions with access to critical infrastructure or sensitive operational data.

attributes.name: shift_pattern
attributes.description: Standard work schedule pattern for the position. Critical for operations and field services roles requiring 24/7 coverage.

attributes.name: sourcing_channel
attributes.description: Primary recruitment channel for candidate sourcing. Used to track recruitment effectiveness and cost-per-hire by channel. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: internal_posting|external_posting|employee_referral|recruitment_agency|campus_recruiting|job_board|social_media|direct_sourcing — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: target_hire_date
attributes.description: Desired start date for the new hire. Used for recruitment timeline planning and workforce capacity forecasting.

attributes.name: travel_requirement_pct
attributes.description: Expected percentage of work time requiring travel away from primary work location. Ranges from 0 (no travel) to 100 (constant travel). Important for field engineering and mutual aid roles.

attributes.name: union_classification
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is covered by a collective bargaining agreement. Critical for labor relations, scheduling rules, and compensation administration.

attributes.name: union_local
attributes.description: Specific union local chapter governing the position (e.g., IBEW Local 1245, UWUA Local 246). Null for non-union positions. Determines applicable labor agreement terms.

attributes.name: work_location_code
attributes.description: Reference to the primary work location (service center, plant, substation, office) where the employee will be based. Critical for field crew and operations roles.

products.name: mutual_aid_deployment
products.description: Records of utility workforce and contractor crews deployed under mutual aid agreements during major storm events, natural disasters, or grid emergencies. Captures requesting utility, providing utility or contractor, crew type, number of personnel, deployment start/end dates, work location, restoration tasks performed, and reimbursable cost. Supports EATON/EEI mutual aid cost recovery, FEMA reimbursement documentation, and post-storm after-action reporting.
products.reference: EEI Mutual Assistance Agreement; FEMA PA Program

attributes.name: mutual_aid_deployment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the mutual aid deployment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Mutual aid deployments track cost centers for reimbursement tracking, cost recovery, and financial reporting. Replacing denormalized cost_allocation_code with proper FK to cost_center.

attributes.name: crew_id
attributes.description: FK to workforce.crew.crew_id — Mutual aid deployments send specific crews to requesting utilities. This link enables tracking which crews are deployed, their availability status, and restoration cost allocation.

attributes.name: deployment_coordinator_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee coordinating the mutual aid deployment from the providing utility.

attributes.name: event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to outage.outage_event. Business justification: Mutual aid deployments are triggered by specific major outage events (storms, disasters). Utilities track which outage event necessitated external crew deployment for cost recovery, NERC/FEMA reportin

attributes.name: mutual_aid_agreement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the mutual aid agreement or compact under which the deployment was authorized (e.g., EEI Mutual Assistance Agreement, regional compact).

attributes.name: receiving_control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Mutual aid deployments to receiving utility's control area. Linking enables load restoration coordination, ACE impact analysis, and reimbursement cost allocation by operational jurisdiction.

attributes.name: requesting_utility_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the utility company requesting mutual aid assistance during the emergency event.

attributes.name: contractor_company_name
attributes.description: Name of the contractor company if the providing entity is a contractor.

attributes.name: contractor_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the providing entity is a contractor (True) or another utility (False).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mutual aid deployment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customers_restored_count
attributes.description: Total number of customer accounts restored to service by the deployed crew.

attributes.name: deployment_county
attributes.description: County or region where the mutual aid deployment occurred.

attributes.name: deployment_duration_days
attributes.description: Total number of days the crew was deployed under mutual aid.

attributes.name: deployment_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the mutual aid deployment ended and crews were released to return home.

attributes.name: deployment_notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or special instructions related to the mutual aid deployment.

attributes.name: deployment_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the mutual aid deployment, used for external tracking and reference in mutual aid coordination systems.

attributes.name: deployment_personnel_count
attributes.description: Total number of personnel deployed under this mutual aid agreement.

attributes.name: deployment_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the mutual aid deployment began and crews arrived at the requesting utility's service territory.

attributes.name: deployment_state
attributes.description: State or province where the mutual aid deployment occurred.

attributes.name: deployment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the mutual aid deployment (requested, approved, mobilizing, deployed, demobilizing, completed, cancelled). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: requested|approved|mobilizing|deployed|demobilizing|completed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deployment_vehicle_count
attributes.description: Total number of vehicles and equipment units deployed with the crew.

attributes.name: deployment_work_location
attributes.description: Geographic location or service territory where the deployed crew performed restoration work.

attributes.name: equipment_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total equipment and vehicle cost for the deployment, including rental, fuel, and maintenance.

attributes.name: event_type
attributes.description: Type of emergency event that triggered the mutual aid request (hurricane, tornado, ice storm, wildfire, flood, earthquake, grid emergency, other). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hurricane|tornado|ice_storm|wildfire|flood|earthquake|grid_emergency|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: fema_disaster_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Disaster Number
attributes.description: FEMA disaster declaration number associated with the event, used for federal reimbursement tracking.

attributes.name: labor_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total labor cost for deployed personnel, including wages, benefits, and overtime.

attributes.name: labor_hours_total
attributes.description: Total labor hours worked by all deployed personnel during the mutual aid deployment.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the mutual aid deployment record was last updated.

attributes.name: lodging_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total lodging and accommodation cost for deployed personnel.

attributes.name: material_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total material and supply cost used during the deployment.

attributes.name: meal_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total meal and per diem cost for deployed personnel.

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime labor hours worked during the deployment.

attributes.name: providing_utility_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the utility company or contractor providing mutual aid resources and personnel.

attributes.name: providing_utility_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility company or contractor providing mutual aid resources.

attributes.name: regular_hours
attributes.description: Total regular labor hours worked during the deployment.

attributes.name: reimbursable_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total reimbursable cost amount for the mutual aid deployment, including labor, equipment, materials, and expenses.

attributes.name: reimbursement_date
attributes.description: Date when the mutual aid reimbursement payment was received.

attributes.name: reimbursement_invoice_number
attributes.description: Invoice number submitted to the requesting utility for mutual aid cost reimbursement.

attributes.name: reimbursement_status
attributes.description: Status of the reimbursement claim for mutual aid costs (pending, submitted, approved, paid, disputed).

attributes.name: requesting_utility_contact_name
attributes.description: Name of the primary contact person at the requesting utility for this deployment.

attributes.name: requesting_utility_contact_phone
attributes.description: Phone number of the primary contact person at the requesting utility.

attributes.name: requesting_utility_name
attributes.description: Name of the utility company requesting mutual aid assistance.

attributes.name: restoration_tasks_performed
attributes.description: Description of the restoration tasks and work activities performed by the deployed crew during the mutual aid deployment.

attributes.name: travel_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total travel cost including mobilization and demobilization expenses.

attributes.name: work_order_count
attributes.description: Total number of work orders completed by the deployed crew during the mutual aid deployment.

products.name: drug_alcohol_test
products.description: DOT and utility-mandated drug and alcohol testing records for safety-sensitive utility positions including CDL drivers, generation plant operators, and transmission/distribution field crews. Captures test type (pre-employment, random, post-accident, reasonable suspicion, return-to-duty), test date, employee, testing provider, result (negative/positive/refused), and follow-up action required. Supports DOT 49 CFR Part 40 compliance and OSHA post-accident investigation requirements.
products.reference: DOT 49 CFR Part 40; OSHA 1910.120

attributes.name: drug_alcohol_test_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the drug and alcohol test record. Primary key for the drug_alcohol_test product.

attributes.name: primary_drug_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee who underwent the drug and alcohol test. Links to the employee master record in the workforce domain.

attributes.name: safety_incident_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the workplace accident or incident that triggered a post-accident drug and alcohol test. Links to incident or safety event records for OSHA investigation requirements.

attributes.name: alcohol_concentration
attributes.description: Measured blood alcohol concentration (BAC) level from breath or blood test, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.040 for 0.04%). DOT prohibits safety-sensitive work at 0.04% or higher.

attributes.name: alcohol_test_result
attributes.description: Specific result of the alcohol screening component. Separate from drug result when both are tested.

attributes.name: cdl_driver_test
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test was administered to an employee holding a Commercial Driver License under FMCSA regulations.

attributes.name: chain_of_custody_maintained
attributes.description: Indicates whether proper chain of custody procedures were followed from specimen collection through laboratory analysis. Required for test validity and legal defensibility.

attributes.name: collection_site_address
attributes.description: Physical address of the collection site where the test specimen was obtained. Organizational contact data classified as confidential.

attributes.name: collection_site_name
attributes.description: Name of the facility or location where the specimen was collected (e.g., clinic name, mobile collection unit, on-site medical facility).

attributes.name: collector_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified specimen collector who performed the collection. Required for chain of custody documentation.

attributes.name: confirmation_test_date
attributes.description: Date the confirmation test was performed following an initial positive screening result.

attributes.name: confirmation_test_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether a confirmation test is required following an initial positive screening result. DOT requires confirmation testing using gas chromatography/mass spectrometry (GC/MS) or equivalent.

attributes.name: confirmation_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the confirmation test. Confirmed positive verifies the initial positive screening; negative overturns the initial positive; cancelled indicates the confirmation test could not be completed.

attributes.name: cost_center
attributes.description: Cost center code to which the drug and alcohol testing costs are allocated. Used for financial tracking and departmental budgeting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this drug and alcohol test record was first created in the system. Audit trail for record creation.

attributes.name: disciplinary_action_taken
attributes.description: Description of disciplinary action taken as a result of the test (e.g., suspension, termination, written warning, mandatory treatment). May reference collective bargaining agreement provisions.

attributes.name: dot_regulated_test
attributes.description: Indicates whether this test is subject to DOT 49 CFR Part 40 regulations. True for safety-sensitive positions including CDL drivers, pipeline operators, and certain generation plant operators.

attributes.name: drug_test_result
attributes.description: Specific result of the drug screening component. Separate from alcohol result when both are tested. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: negative|positive|refused|adulterated|substituted|invalid|cancelled|not tested — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: employee_notification_date
attributes.description: Date the employee was notified of the test result. Required for due process and to initiate any appeal or follow-up action timelines.

attributes.name: follow_up_action_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether follow-up action is required based on the test result. True for positive results requiring substance abuse professional evaluation, return-to-duty testing, or disciplinary action.

attributes.name: follow_up_action_type
attributes.description: Type of follow-up action required. May include referral to substance abuse professional (SAP), return-to-duty testing, follow-up testing plan, disciplinary action, or termination. Comma-separated list if multiple actions apply.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this drug and alcohol test record was last updated. Audit trail for record changes.

attributes.name: legitimate_medical_explanation
attributes.description: Indicates whether the MRO determined there was a legitimate medical explanation for a positive test result (e.g., valid prescription for detected substance). If true, the MRO may verify the result as negative.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this drug and alcohol test record. Audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: mro_name
attributes.description: Name of the licensed physician serving as Medical Review Officer who reviewed and verified the test result. Required for DOT-mandated testing.

attributes.name: mro_review_date
attributes.description: Date the Medical Review Officer completed review and verification of the test result.

attributes.name: mro_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether Medical Review Officer review is required. DOT requires MRO review of all positive, adulterated, substituted, and invalid drug test results.

attributes.name: mro_verified_result
attributes.description: Final result verified by the Medical Review Officer after reviewing laboratory results and interviewing the employee. This is the official reportable result.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes or comments regarding the drug and alcohol test, including special circumstances, procedural issues, or follow-up actions. Free-text field for case documentation.

attributes.name: post_accident_incident_date
attributes.description: Date of the workplace accident or incident that triggered the post-accident test. DOT requires testing within specified timeframes after qualifying accidents.

attributes.name: reasonable_suspicion_basis
attributes.description: Description of the observed behavior or circumstances that provided reasonable suspicion for ordering a drug or alcohol test. Must be documented by a trained supervisor.

attributes.name: refusal_reason
attributes.description: Reason for test refusal if result is 'refused'. May include failure to appear, failure to provide adequate specimen, adulterating or substituting specimen, failure to cooperate with collection process, or leaving collection site before process is complete.

attributes.name: result_reported_to_employer_date
attributes.description: Date the verified test result was officially reported to the employer by the MRO or testing provider. DOT requires timely reporting of verified results.

attributes.name: return_to_duty_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date the employee received clearance to return to safety-sensitive duties following completion of SAP-recommended treatment and passing a return-to-duty test.

attributes.name: safety_sensitive_position
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee holds a safety-sensitive position requiring drug and alcohol testing under DOT or utility company policy. Includes transmission/distribution field crews, generation plant operators, and CDL drivers.

attributes.name: sap_name
attributes.description: Name of the Substance Abuse Professional (licensed physician, social worker, psychologist, or certified counselor) who evaluated the employee and recommended treatment.

attributes.name: sap_referral_date
attributes.description: Date the employee was referred to a Substance Abuse Professional following a positive test result. DOT requires SAP evaluation before return-to-duty.

attributes.name: specimen_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier assigned to the specimen for chain of custody tracking. Typically a barcode or serial number on the collection container.

attributes.name: specimen_type
attributes.description: Type of biological specimen collected for testing. Urine is standard for drug tests; breath is standard for alcohol tests; blood, saliva, and hair may be used in specific circumstances.

attributes.name: split_specimen_requested
attributes.description: Indicates whether the employee requested analysis of the split specimen following a positive result. DOT requires split specimen testing option for all positive drug tests.

attributes.name: split_specimen_result
attributes.description: Result of the split specimen analysis if requested by the employee. Used to verify or refute the original positive result.

attributes.name: substances_detected
attributes.description: List of specific controlled substances or drug metabolites detected in a positive drug test (e.g., marijuana metabolites, cocaine metabolites, opiates, amphetamines, PCP). Comma-separated list.

attributes.name: test_category
attributes.description: Category of substance tested: drug only, alcohol only, or combined drug and alcohol test.

attributes.name: test_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total cost of the drug and alcohol test including collection, laboratory analysis, MRO review, and administrative fees. Used for cost tracking and vendor invoice reconciliation.

attributes.name: test_date
attributes.description: Date the drug and alcohol test was administered. Principal business event date for the test record.

attributes.name: test_number
