domains.name: finance
domains.description: Corporate financial management including general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, capital budgeting, CAPEX and OPEX tracking, regulatory asset base (RAB) valuations, WACC calculations, EBITDA reporting, rate case financial models, ROE filings, depreciation, FERC account codes, cost allocation, and SOX-compliant financial controls within SAP S/4HANA FI/CO. Distinct from billing (customer revenue) — owns enterprise-level financial consolidation and treasury.
domains.references: FERC USoA, GAAP, IFRS, SOX, SAP S/4HANA Finance

products.name: cost_center
products.description: SAP S/4HANA CO master data entity representing organizational units to which costs are assigned for internal management reporting. Captures cost center ID, name, hierarchy node, responsible manager, controlling area, profit center assignment, currency, validity period, and activity type. SSOT for OPEX cost collection, overhead allocation, and FERC cost-of-service study segmentation across generation, transmission, distribution, and corporate functions.
products.reference: SAP CO Cost Center (KS01)

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the cost center. Primary key for the cost center master data entity in SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) module.

attributes.name: primary_cost_employee_id
attributes.description: Employee ID of the manager or supervisor responsible for this cost center. Accountable for budget management and cost control.

attributes.name: activity_type_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether activity types can be posted to this cost center. Relevant for cost centers that provide internal services (e.g., maintenance hours, engineering hours).

attributes.name: budget_profile_code
attributes.description: Budget profile defining budget control and availability checking rules for this cost center. Controls whether budget overruns are allowed and how budget warnings are triggered.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area for segment reporting. Enables cross-company code financial analysis by business line (e.g., Generation, Transmission, Distribution).

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs posted to this cost center are primarily capital expenditures, operational expenditures, or a mix. Used for financial planning and regulatory asset base (RAB) calculations.

attributes.name: commitment_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether commitment management (purchase requisitions and purchase orders) is active for this cost center. Used for budget control and funds management.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Company code representing the legal entity to which this cost center is assigned. Used for external financial reporting and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: controlling_area_code
attributes.description: Controlling area to which this cost center belongs. Represents the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal management reporting in SAP CO.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate costs from this cost center to other cost objects. Direct allocation assigns costs directly; assessment and distribution use allocation bases; activity-based uses activity drivers.

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: High-level classification of the cost center by business function. Used for cost allocation and regulatory reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: production|transmission|distribution|customer_service|administrative|sales|research|maintenance|corporate — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier for the cost center. Alphanumeric code used in financial reporting and cost allocation. Typically follows organizational coding standards (e.g., GEN-001 for Generation, TRN-002 for Transmission).

attributes.name: cost_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the cost center's purpose, scope, and responsibilities. Provides context for cost allocation and management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_name
attributes.description: Full descriptive name of the cost center. Human-readable label used in financial reports and management dashboards.

attributes.name: cost_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the cost center. Active cost centers accept postings; inactive and blocked cost centers do not.

attributes.name: cost_center_type
attributes.description: Type of cost center indicating its role in cost allocation. Standard cost centers collect direct costs; auxiliary and overhead centers allocate costs to other cost centers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created the cost center master record in the system.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cost center master record was created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for cost center transactions. Typically USD for US-based utilities.

attributes.name: department_code
attributes.description: Department or organizational unit code to which this cost center belongs. Used for organizational reporting and workforce management.

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center incurs costs related to environmental compliance (EPA emissions standards, renewable portfolio standards, environmental remediation). Used for regulatory reporting and cost recovery.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for regulatory reporting. Maps cost center expenses to standardized FERC account classifications for rate case filings and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric Utilities

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cost-of-service studies and regulatory reporting. Aligns with FERC functional classifications (Production, Transmission, Distribution, Customer Service, Administrative & General).

attributes.name: hierarchy_area_code
attributes.description: Standard hierarchy area for organizational reporting. Defines the cost center hierarchy structure for management reporting and cost rollups.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the cost center master record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the cost center master record was last modified.

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Physical location or plant where the cost center operates. Used for geographic cost analysis and facility-level reporting.

attributes.name: lock_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether the cost center is locked for actual postings. Used during period-end close and budget planning cycles.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_relevant_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Relevant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center supports NERC CIP-designated critical cyber assets or bulk electric system facilities. Used for compliance tracking and cost allocation for cybersecurity investments.

attributes.name: overhead_allocation_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center participates in overhead allocation cycles. Overhead cost centers distribute their costs to production and service cost centers.

attributes.name: parent_cost_center_code
attributes.description: Parent cost center in the organizational hierarchy. Enables hierarchical cost rollup and management reporting at multiple organizational levels.

attributes.name: rab_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs from this cost center are eligible for inclusion in the regulatory asset base for rate recovery. Critical for rate case preparation and return on equity (ROE) calculations.

attributes.name: sox_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this cost center is subject to SOX internal controls and audit requirements. Typically true for cost centers involved in financial reporting and material account balances.

attributes.name: statistical_cost_center_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a statistical cost center used for informational purposes only, without actual cost postings.

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Start date of the cost center's validity period. Cost center becomes active for postings from this date.

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: End date of the cost center's validity period. Cost center is no longer active for postings after this date. Null indicates open-ended validity.

products.name: profit_center
products.description: SAP S/4HANA CO organizational master representing the full internal management reporting hierarchy — both cost collection units (cost centers) and autonomous business segments (profit centers). Captures organizational unit ID, name, hierarchy node and level, controlling area, responsible manager, parent unit, unit type (cost center or profit center), currency, validity period, activity type, segment classification, and FERC functional classification (generation, transmission, distribution, corporate). Cost center attributes include overhead allocation basis, activity type, and cost element group. Profit center attributes include segment P&L responsibility and business unit classification. SSOT for OPEX cost collection, overhead allocation, segment P&L reporting, and FERC cost-of-service study segmentation. Replaces separate cost_center and profit_center entities to reflect the unified organizational hierarchy used in utility finance operations.
products.reference: SAP CO-PCA Profit Center

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the profit center or cost center organizational unit within SAP S/4HANA Controlling (CO) module. Primary key for internal management reporting hierarchy.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the employee who is accountable for the financial performance and operational results of this organizational unit. Used for management accountability reporting.

attributes.name: parent_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent organizational unit in the management reporting hierarchy. Null for top-level units. Enables roll-up reporting and hierarchical cost allocation.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: Primary activity type for cost center activity-based costing. Represents the unit of work output (e.g., labor hours, machine hours, MWh generated) used for internal cost allocation and overhead distribution.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Approved annual budget amount for this organizational unit in the units currency. Used for variance analysis, budget vs. actual reporting, and financial performance management.

attributes.name: budget_fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year for which the budget amount is applicable. Supports multi-year budget tracking and historical budget analysis.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area classification for cross-company code segment reporting. Used for consolidated financial statements across multiple legal entities.

attributes.name: business_unit_classification
attributes.description: Strategic business unit classification for profit centers. Regulated units operate under PUC rate regulation; unregulated units operate in competitive markets; merchant units trade energy; renewable units manage clean energy assets; wholesale units serve bulk power markets; retail units serve end customers.

attributes.name: capex_opex_classification
attributes.description: Primary expenditure classification for this organizational unit. CAPEX units manage capital projects and asset investments; OPEX units manage operating costs and maintenance; mixed units handle both capital and operating activities.
attributes.references: Utility Financial Planning Standards; FERC Account Classification

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity to which this organizational unit is assigned for external financial reporting and statutory compliance.

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP Controlling Area code to which this organizational unit belongs. Represents the highest level of cost accounting and internal management reporting.

attributes.name: cost_center_category
attributes.description: Classification of cost center type for cost allocation methodology. Production centers directly support generation/transmission/distribution; service centers provide internal services; administrative centers are corporate overhead; overhead centers are indirect costs; project centers track capital initiatives.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: cost_element_group
attributes.description: Primary cost element group classification for this organizational unit. Groups related cost types (labor, materials, services, depreciation) for financial analysis and variance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for financial transactions and reporting in this organizational unit. Typically USD for US utilities.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation methodology applied to assets assigned to this organizational unit. Straight-line is standard for utility rate-making; declining balance for tax purposes; units of production for generation assets; group composite for T&D infrastructure.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: ferc_functional_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Functional Classification
attributes.description: FERC functional classification for cost-of-service studies and rate case filings. Maps organizational unit to generation, transmission, distribution, or corporate support functions per FERC Uniform System of Accounts.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or service territory associated with this organizational unit. Used for regional performance analysis, regulatory jurisdiction mapping, and geographic cost allocation.

attributes.name: hierarchy_level
attributes.description: Numeric level in the organizational hierarchy tree. Level 1 represents top-level units, with increasing numbers for deeper nesting. Used for hierarchical aggregation and drill-down reporting.

attributes.name: hierarchy_node_path
attributes.description: Full path from root to this node in the organizational hierarchy, represented as a delimited string of profit center codes. Enables efficient ancestor and descendant queries.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this organizational unit record. Supports SOX compliance and audit requirements.
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this organizational unit record was last updated. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: nerc_region
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Region
attributes.description: NERC regional entity jurisdiction for reliability compliance. Used for CIP (Critical Infrastructure Protection) compliance tracking and reliability reporting segmentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: WECC|TRE|SERC|RFC|MRO|NPCC|SPP|FRCC — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: overhead_allocation_basis
attributes.description: Allocation basis used to distribute overhead costs from this cost center to other organizational units or products. Critical for FERC cost-of-service studies and rate case preparation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; SAP S/4HANA CO Overhead Allocation

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Business identifier code for the organizational unit as defined in SAP Controlling Area. Used in financial reporting, cost allocation, and FERC account mapping.

attributes.name: profit_center_description
attributes.description: Detailed business description of the organizational units purpose, scope, and responsibilities. Provides context for financial analysis and management reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_name
attributes.description: Full business name of the profit center or cost center organizational unit. Human-readable label for management reporting and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: profit_center_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the organizational unit. Active units accept cost postings; inactive units are retained for historical reporting; planned units are future organizational changes; closed units are archived.

attributes.name: rab_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether costs from this organizational unit are included in the Regulatory Asset Base for rate-making purposes. True for regulated utility operations; false for unregulated competitive businesses.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate-Making Regulations; FERC Rate Base Methodology

attributes.name: responsibility
attributes.business_glossary_term: Profit Center Profit and Loss (P&L) Responsibility
attributes.description: Level of P&L accountability for profit centers. Full P&L includes both revenue and cost responsibility; revenue-only tracks top-line performance; cost-only tracks expense management; none indicates cost center classification.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: roe_target
attributes.description: Target return on equity rate for this profit center as authorized by regulatory commission or established by corporate finance policy. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0950 for 9.50%). Critical for rate case filings and performance evaluation.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Orders; FERC ROE Methodology

attributes.name: rto_iso_affiliation
attributes.business_glossary_term: Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) / Independent System Operator (ISO) Affiliation
attributes.description: RTO or ISO market affiliation for this organizational unit (e.g., PJM, CAISO, ERCOT, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP). Relevant for generation and transmission units participating in wholesale energy markets.

attributes.name: segment
attributes.description: Segment classification for IFRS and US GAAP segment reporting requirements. Represents reportable business segments for external financial disclosure.
attributes.references: IFRS 8 Operating Segments; US GAAP ASC 280

attributes.name: short_name
attributes.description: Abbreviated name for the organizational unit used in reports and dashboards where space is constrained.

attributes.name: sox_control_scope_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this organizational unit is within the scope of SOX financial controls and audit requirements. True for units with material financial impact; false for immaterial or non-financial units.

attributes.name: unit_type
attributes.description: Classification of the organizational unit as either a cost center (cost collection only) or profit center (autonomous business segment with P&L responsibility).

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Effective start date for this organizational unit configuration. Supports time-dependent organizational structures and historical reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Time-Dependent Master Data

attributes.name: valid_to_date
attributes.description: Effective end date for this organizational unit configuration. Null for currently active configurations. Supports organizational restructuring and historical analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Time-Dependent Master Data

attributes.name: wacc_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) Rate
attributes.description: Weighted average cost of capital rate applied to this organizational unit for capital budgeting and investment analysis. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0725 for 7.25%). Used in NPV calculations and rate case ROE filings.
attributes.references: Utility Financial Planning Standards; State PUC Rate Case Methodology

products.name: gl_account
products.description: General ledger chart of accounts master aligned to FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) and SAP S/4HANA FI-GL. Captures FERC account code, account type (asset, liability, equity, revenue, expense), balance sheet vs. P&L indicator, tax category, reconciliation account flag, and controlling relevance. SSOT for all financial account classifications.
products.reference: FERC Uniform System of Accounts / SAP FI-GL Account Master

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the general ledger account. Primary key for the GL account master data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: account_group
attributes.description: SAP account group that controls field status, number range, and screen layout for the account. Examples: ASSETS, LIABILITIES, REVENUE, EXPENSE.

attributes.name: account_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name of the GL account. Human-readable label used in financial statements and reports.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: account_number
attributes.description: The externally-known GL account number used in SAP S/4HANA chart of accounts. This is the business identifier displayed on financial reports, journal entries, and trial balances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: account_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the GL account. Active accounts accept postings; inactive accounts are temporarily disabled; blocked accounts prevent all activity; retired accounts are permanently closed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: account_type
attributes.description: High-level classification of the account into one of the five fundamental accounting categories: asset, liability, equity, revenue, or expense. Determines financial statement placement and normal balance (debit or credit).
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - Financial Statement Classification

attributes.name: alternative_account_number
attributes.description: Alternative or legacy account number used for cross-reference purposes during system migrations or consolidations. Maintains traceability to prior chart of accounts structures.

attributes.name: balance_sheet_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account appears on the balance sheet (true) or profit and loss statement (false). Balance sheet accounts carry balances forward; P&L accounts reset annually.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - Financial Statement Structure

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) or Operational Expenditure (OPEX) Indicator
attributes.description: Classifies the account as capital expenditure (CAPEX - capitalized and depreciated), operational expenditure (OPEX - expensed immediately), or not applicable. Critical for regulatory reporting and financial planning.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - Capitalization Policy

attributes.name: chart_of_accounts
attributes.description: Identifier of the chart of accounts to which this GL account belongs. Utilities typically maintain a FERC-aligned chart of accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Chart of Accounts Configuration

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code to which this GL account belongs. Company code represents a legal entity for financial reporting and consolidation purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Organizational Structure - Company Code

attributes.name: controlling_relevance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether postings to this account are relevant for Controlling (CO) module and should flow to cost centers, internal orders, or profitability segments.

attributes.name: cost_element
attributes.description: Cost element code used in SAP Controlling (CO) module for cost center accounting, internal orders, and profitability analysis. Links financial accounting to management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Configuration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this GL account master record was first created in the system. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the account. Most utility accounts use USD, but multi-national utilities may have accounts in other currencies.

attributes.name: depreciation_relevant_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to depreciation calculations. Typically true for fixed asset accounts and false for expense or liability accounts.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date after which this GL account is no longer active for new postings. Null for currently active accounts. Used for account retirement and chart of accounts cleanup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this GL account becomes active and available for posting. Used for phased chart of accounts implementations and regulatory changes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (USoA) account code. Mandatory for regulated utilities to classify assets, liabilities, revenues, and expenses according to federal regulatory standards. Examples: 101 (Electric Plant in Service), 254 (Accounts Payable), 400 (Operation Expense), 440 (Rent Expense).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric Utilities (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: field_status_group
attributes.description: SAP field status group that controls which fields are required, optional, or hidden when posting to this account. Enforces data entry rules and compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Field Status Configuration

attributes.name: financial_statement_item
attributes.description: Code that maps the GL account to a specific line item on the balance sheet or profit and loss statement. Used for financial statement generation and consolidation reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Financial Statement Version Configuration

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Functional area classification for segment reporting and management accounting. Examples: generation, transmission, distribution, customer service, administration. Used for FERC functional cost allocation.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Functional Classification

attributes.name: line_item_display_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether individual line items can be displayed for this account. Required for detailed transaction analysis and audit trails.

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Extended description providing detailed explanation of the account purpose, usage guidelines, and posting rules. Used for training and audit documentation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this GL account master record. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this GL account master record was last modified. Part of the audit trail for SOX compliance and change management.

attributes.name: open_item_management_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account uses open item management, where individual line items remain open until explicitly cleared. Typically used for accounts receivable, accounts payable, and clearing accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Open Item Management

attributes.name: planning_blocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is blocked for planning and budgeting activities. Used to exclude certain accounts from budget allocation processes.

attributes.name: posting_blocked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether direct postings to this account are blocked. Used to prevent accidental postings to control accounts or retired accounts.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Master Data Standard

attributes.name: profit_loss_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this account appears on the profit and loss statement (income statement). P&L accounts measure periodic performance and are closed to retained earnings at year-end.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP) - Financial Statement Structure

attributes.name: rab_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs posted to this account are eligible for inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-making purposes. RAB-eligible assets earn a regulated return on equity (ROE).
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) Rate-Making Standards

attributes.name: reconciliation_account_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a reconciliation account (subledger control account) that summarizes detailed transactions from subsidiary ledgers such as accounts receivable, accounts payable, or asset accounting. Reconciliation accounts cannot be posted to directly.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Reconciliation Account Configuration

attributes.name: sort_key
attributes.description: Sorting rule that determines how line items are sorted within the account (e.g., by posting date, document number, or amount). Used for account display and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this account is subject to SOX internal control requirements and enhanced audit scrutiny. Typically true for material accounts affecting financial statement accuracy.

attributes.name: tax_category
attributes.description: Tax classification code that determines how transactions posted to this account are treated for tax reporting purposes. Examples: taxable income, non-taxable expense, capital expenditure.
attributes.references: Internal Revenue Service (IRS) Tax Code and SAP Tax Configuration

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created this GL account master record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL journal entry header capturing all financial postings including manual entries, accruals, reversals, recurring entries, intercompany eliminations, and regulatory adjustments. Records document number, document type, posting date, fiscal year/period, company code, ledger group (leading/non-leading/extension), reference document, posting user, approval workflow status, and SOX control evidence reference. Core transactional record for the general ledger — every financial event in the utility ultimately creates or references a journal entry.
products.reference: SAP FI-GL Journal Entry (FB50/BKPF)

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.

attributes.name: approver_user_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the individual who approved this journal entry for posting. Populated only when approval_status is approved or posted. Required for SOX compliance and segregation of duties evidence.

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the capital project or work order associated with this journal entry. Links financial postings to specific infrastructure projects, generation plant construction, grid modernization initiatives, or renewable energy integration projects.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries can have default cost center assignments at the header level (in addition to line-level assignments). The cost_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.generating_unit. Business justification: Manual journal entries adjust unit-level costs (accruals, reclassifications). Essential for period-end close, audit trail, and regulatory accounting adjustments.

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: Plant-level journal entries for cost allocations and corrections. Required for regulatory accounting adjustments and FERC compliance.

attributes.name: primary_journal_employee_id
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the individual who created and posted this journal entry. Used for audit trail, SOX compliance, segregation of duties monitoring, and user activity analysis.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entries can have default profit center assignments at the header level (in addition to line-level assignments). The profit_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to profit_center.profit_ce

attributes.name: recurring_entry_template_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the recurring entry template that generated this journal entry. Populated only when recurring_entry_indicator is true. Links the posted entry back to its master template for audit and maintenance purposes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Recurring Entry Configuration

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current state of the journal entry in the approval workflow. Draft = entry created but not submitted; Pending Approval = submitted for review; Approved = authorized for posting; Rejected = denied by approver; Posted = successfully posted to GL. Supports SOX-compliant maker-checker controls.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the journal entry was approved by the authorized approver. Populated only when approval_status is approved or posted. Part of the SOX control evidence and audit trail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Workflow Audit Trail

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: Classification of the fixed asset associated with this journal entry (e.g., Generation Plant, Transmission Lines, Distribution Equipment, Substation Assets, Metering Infrastructure). Used for depreciation calculation, asset lifecycle management, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: High-level business segment code for external financial statement reporting. Represents major lines of business (e.g., Electric Utility Operations, Gas Distribution, Renewable Energy Services) for segment disclosure under GAAP/IFRS.

attributes.name: capital_vs_expense_indicator
attributes.business_glossary_term: Capital Expenditure (CAPEX) vs Operational Expenditure (OPEX) Indicator
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry as either CAPEX (capital expenditure - capitalized to balance sheet) or OPEX (operational expenditure - expensed to income statement). Critical for regulatory asset base (RAB) calculations, rate case filings, and EBITDA reporting.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character alphanumeric code identifying the legal entity or operating company within the utility enterprise. Represents the organizational unit for which a complete self-contained set of accounts can be drawn up for purposes of external reporting.

attributes.name: cost_allocation_method
attributes.description: Method used to allocate costs across company codes, business units, or regulatory jurisdictions. Direct = costs directly assigned to a single entity; Allocated = costs distributed using allocation keys (e.g., headcount, revenue); Apportioned = costs split based on regulatory formulas; Shared Services = costs from centralized service centers. Critical for rate case cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction currency of this journal entry (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, CAD). All monetary amounts in the journal entry lines are denominated in this currency.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation calculation method applied for this journal entry. Straight Line = equal annual depreciation; Declining Balance = accelerated depreciation; Units of Production = usage-based depreciation; Regulatory Prescribed = depreciation rates mandated by FERC or state PUC. Populated for depreciation-related journal entries.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Depreciation

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the source document or invoice that originated this journal entry. Used for document aging, payment terms calculation, and audit trail reconciliation. May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: Ten-digit unique accounting document number assigned by SAP FI-GL upon posting. Serves as the externally-known business identifier for this journal entry across all financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character code classifying the nature and origin of the journal entry. Examples: SA (G/L account document), AB (Accounting document), AF (Depreciation posting), DR (Customer invoice), KR (Vendor invoice), RE (Invoice receipt), RV (Billing document), WA (Goods issue), WE (Goods receipt), ZP (Payment document). Controls number ranges, account types allowed, and posting rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: SA|AB|AF|DR|DZ|KA|KG|KN|KR|RE|RV|WA|WE|ZP — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the journal entry was physically entered into the SAP system by the user. Used for audit trail, user activity tracking, and SOX compliance evidence.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied to convert foreign currency amounts to the company code's local currency. Populated for journal entries involving foreign currency transactions. Expressed as local currency per one unit of foreign currency.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: Three-digit FERC Uniform System of Accounts code classifying the journal entry for regulatory reporting. Examples: 101 (Electric Plant in Service), 108 (Accumulated Depreciation), 400 (Operation Expense), 500 (Maintenance Expense). Required for FERC Form 1 and state PUC filings.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric Utilities

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Four-digit fiscal year in which the journal entry is posted. Aligns with the utility's fiscal calendar and determines the accounting period structure for regulatory and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry by business function (e.g., Power Generation, Grid Operations, Customer Service, Regulatory Affairs, Corporate Administration). Used for functional cost analysis and segment reporting.

attributes.name: header_text
attributes.description: Free-form text field providing a descriptive explanation or memo for the entire journal entry. Typically includes the business reason for the posting, project references, or special instructions for auditors and reviewers.

attributes.name: intercompany_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry involves intercompany transactions between multiple company codes within the utility enterprise. True for entries requiring intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the journal entry record was last updated in the system. Captures any changes to header fields, approval status, or document attributes after initial creation. Part of the audit trail for change tracking.

attributes.name: ledger_group
attributes.description: Two-character code identifying the ledger in which this entry is recorded. 0L = Leading Ledger (statutory GAAP reporting), 2L = Non-Leading Ledger (IFRS or management reporting), 3L = Extension Ledger (regulatory adjustments for FERC/PUC), 9L = Tax Ledger. Supports parallel accounting for multiple reporting frameworks.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA New GL Ledger Architecture

attributes.name: parked_document_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is parked (saved but not yet posted to the general ledger). True for entries awaiting additional information, approval, or final review before posting. Parked documents do not update account balances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Parked Document Functionality

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period assignment and is the primary date for financial statement reporting and regulatory compliance. Distinct from document date and entry date.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: Numeric posting period (1-16) within the fiscal year. Periods 1-12 represent standard monthly periods; periods 13-16 are special periods for year-end adjustments, accruals, and closing entries required for regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period Configuration

attributes.name: posting_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the journal entry was successfully posted to the general ledger. Represents the exact moment the entry became part of the official books of record. Used for audit trail and transaction sequencing.

attributes.name: rab_eligible_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the costs in this journal entry are eligible for inclusion in the utility's regulatory asset base (RAB) for rate-making purposes. True for prudent capital investments approved by the PUC for cost recovery through customer rates.

attributes.name: rate_case_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this journal entry to a specific rate case filing or regulatory proceeding. Used to track costs and investments that are subject to regulatory review and rate recovery approval.

attributes.name: recurring_entry_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry was generated from a recurring entry template. True for automated postings such as monthly depreciation, lease payments, insurance premiums, and other predictable periodic entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Recurring Entry Program

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing the external reference number from the source document (e.g., vendor invoice number, purchase order number, contract reference, regulatory filing reference). Used for cross-referencing and audit trail documentation.

attributes.name: regulatory_adjustment_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry represents a regulatory accounting adjustment required by FERC, state PUC, or other utility regulatory bodies. True for entries that adjust GAAP results to regulatory accounting principles for rate case filings and regulatory asset base (RAB) calculations.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this journal entry is a reversal of a prior entry. True if this document reverses a previous posting (e.g., accrual reversal, error correction). Used to identify offsetting entries in audit and reconciliation processes.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the original journal entry that this entry reverses. Populated only when reversal_indicator is true. Establishes the audit trail linkage between the original posting and its reversal.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-GL Reversal Document Reference

attributes.name: sox_control_reference
attributes.description: Reference code linking this journal entry to the specific SOX internal control that governs its creation, approval, and posting. Examples include control IDs for manual journal entry reviews, segregation of duties, and management review controls. Required for SOX 404 compliance documentation.

attributes.name: trading_partner_company_code
attributes.description: The company code of the intercompany trading partner for this journal entry. Populated only when intercompany_indicator is true. Used for intercompany reconciliation and elimination entries in consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure element code identifying the specific phase or component of a capital project to which this journal entry is assigned. Enables detailed project cost tracking and earned value management.

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Line-item detail of SAP S/4HANA FI-GL journal entries. Each line captures GL account, cost center, profit center, WBS element, functional area, debit/credit indicator, amount in transaction and local currency, tax code, and FERC account code. Enables granular cost allocation and regulatory account-level reporting.
products.reference: SAP FI-GL Line Item (BSEG)

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for granular financial transaction detail.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.fixed_asset. Business justification: Journal entry lines can post to fixed assets for capitalization, depreciation, and asset-related adjustments. The asset_number (STRING) should be replaced with FK to fixed_asset.fixed_asset_id, enabli

attributes.name: journal_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines are assigned to cost centers for cost allocation and management reporting. The cost_center_code (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id, enabling JOIN to

attributes.name: journal_gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entry lines post to GL accounts. This is a core financial posting relationship. The gl_account_code (STRING) should be replaced with a proper FK to gl_account.gl_account_id, allowing JOIN to r

attributes.name: journal_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines are assigned to profit centers for internal management reporting and segment analysis. The profit_center_code (STRING) should be replaced with FK to profit_center.profit_center_id,

attributes.name: primary_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent journal entry header document. Links line-item detail to the overall posting document.

attributes.name: to_cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center.cost_center_id — Journal entry lines for expense postings must reference a cost center for cost allocation and OPEX tracking. Critical for management reporting and FERC cost-of-service studies.

attributes.name: to_gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account.gl_account_id — Every journal entry line posts to a GL account. This is the core debit/credit posting relationship. Without this FK, you cannot produce a trial balance or any financial statement.

attributes.name: to_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Fundamental header-to-line relationship. Every journal entry line must reference its parent journal entry header. This is the most critical FK in the GL — without it, line items are orphaned and the l

attributes.name: to_profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center.profit_center_id — Journal entry lines reference profit centers for segment reporting. Required for internal P&L by business segment (generation, T&D, retail).

attributes.name: asset_subnumber
attributes.description: Sub-asset identifier for component-level tracking within a main asset. Supports detailed depreciation and retirement accounting.

attributes.name: assignment_reference
attributes.description: Free-text assignment field for additional line item context. Often contains invoice numbers, purchase order references, or payment identifiers.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation. Determines due date for accounts payable and receivable line items.

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area for segment reporting and divisional financial statements. Supports multi-segment utility operations (generation, transmission, distribution).
attributes.references: SAP FI Business Area Accounting; FASB ASC 280 Segment Reporting

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this line item was cleared (paid or offset). Null for open items.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing entry that settled this open item. Null for uncleared items; populated when payment or offset is posted.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system account that created this journal entry line. Supports SOX compliance and audit requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; SAP User Audit Trail

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when this journal entry line record was first created in the source system. Audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: debit_credit_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this line is a debit (D) or credit (C) posting. Fundamental double-entry bookkeeping classification.
attributes.references: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (GAAP); Double-Entry Bookkeeping

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Foreign exchange rate applied to convert transaction amount to local amount. Null if transaction and local currencies are identical.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for regulatory reporting. Mandatory for rate case filings and regulatory asset base (RAB) valuations.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: functional_area_code
attributes.description: Functional area classification for cross-organizational cost allocation. Supports activity-based costing and functional expense reporting.

attributes.name: line_item_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry document. Determines the ordering and position of this line in the posting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Document Line Item Numbering

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text explaining the business purpose or nature of this journal entry line. Provides audit trail and user context.

attributes.name: local_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount converted to the company code local currency. Used for consolidated financial reporting and statutory books.
attributes.references: SAP FI Currency Translation; GAAP Foreign Currency Translation

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the local amount. Typically USD for US-based utilities.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person or system account that last modified this journal entry line. Supports SOX compliance and change tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404 Internal Controls; SAP User Audit Trail

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp of the most recent modification to this journal entry line record. Tracks change history for audit and compliance.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: Payment terms key defining discount periods and due dates. Applicable to AP and AR line items.
attributes.references: SAP FI Payment Terms Master Data

attributes.name: posting_key
attributes.description: SAP posting key determining account type (GL, customer, vendor, asset) and debit/credit direction. Controls document entry behavior.

attributes.name: quantity
attributes.description: Physical quantity associated with this line item (e.g., MWh for energy purchases, units for materials). Supports quantity-based cost allocation.

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference document number (e.g., vendor invoice number, customer bill number). Links financial posting to source operational document.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item is a reversal of a prior posting. True if this is a correcting or reversing entry.

attributes.name: reversed_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the original entry being reversed by this line item. Null if this is not a reversal.

attributes.name: special_gl_indicator
attributes.description: Special GL transaction type code (e.g., down payment, bill of exchange, guarantee). Enables specialized accounting treatment.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Calculated tax amount for this line item in local currency. Supports tax reconciliation and regulatory tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP FI Tax Calculation; IRS Tax Reporting

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax jurisdiction and rate code applied to this line item. Determines sales tax, use tax, or VAT calculation for the transaction.
attributes.references: SAP FI-CA Tax Processing; State and Local Tax Codes

attributes.name: to_journal_entry
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Every journal entry line belongs to exactly one journal entry header. This is the most fundamental header→line relationship in the GL. Without this FK, you cannot reconstruct a balanced journal entry

attributes.name: to_org_unit
attributes.description: FK to finance.organizational_unit.organizational_unit_id — Journal entry lines reference cost centers and profit centers (merged into organizational_unit) for cost allocation and segment reporting. Required for management reporting and FERC cost-of-service st

attributes.name: to_organizational_unit
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center.profit_center_id — Journal entry lines reference cost centers and profit centers (merged into organizational_unit) for internal management reporting, FERC cost-of-service segmentation, and segment P&L. Critical for cost

attributes.name: trading_partner_code
attributes.description: Intercompany trading partner identifier for elimination entries. Supports consolidated financial statements and intercompany reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP FI Intercompany Accounting; GAAP Consolidation Standards

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount of the line item in the original transaction currency. Unsigned value; sign is determined by debit_credit_indicator.

attributes.name: transaction_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the transaction amount. Supports multi-currency operations and foreign exchange tracking.

attributes.name: unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the quantity field. Common values: MWH (megawatt-hour), KWH (kilowatt-hour), EA (each), TON (ton).
attributes.references: ISO 80000 Quantities and Units; SAP UOM Master Data

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: Value date for cash management and interest calculation. Represents the effective date for financial impact, distinct from posting date.
attributes.references: SAP FI Cash Management; Banking Value Date Standards

attributes.name: wbs_element_code
attributes.description: WBS element for capital project tracking. Links line items to specific capital expenditure (CAPEX) projects for asset capitalization and depreciation.
attributes.references: SAP PS Project System; PMI Work Breakdown Structure Standard

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Calculated withholding tax amount in local currency. Deducted from vendor payment and remitted to tax authority.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_code
attributes.description: Withholding tax type and rate code for vendor payments. Supports IRS 1099 reporting and international withholding compliance.
attributes.references: IRS Withholding Tax Regulations; SAP FI Withholding Tax

products.name: ap_invoice
products.description: Accounts payable lifecycle record in SAP S/4HANA FI-AP covering the full payable lifecycle from invoice receipt through payment execution. Invoice attributes: vendor invoice number, invoice date, posting date, payment terms, gross amount, tax amount, withholding tax, payment block status, three-way match status (PO/GR/IR), and due date. Payment attributes: payment run date, payment method (ACH, wire, check), bank account, clearing document, payment amount, discount taken, vendor bank details, and payment status. Supports OPEX and CAPEX payable tracking for utility procurement including fuel, materials, EPC contractors, and equipment vendors. Tracks the complete procure-to-pay financial lifecycle from obligation recognition through cash disbursement.
products.reference: SAP FI-AP Vendor Invoice (MIRO/FB60)

attributes.name: ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Unique system identifier for the accounts payable invoice record. Primary key for the AP invoice entity.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the company bank account from which payment was disbursed. Used for cash management and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: AP invoices are assigned to cost centers for cost allocation and budget tracking. The cost_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id, enabling JOIN to retrieve cost_cent

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: AP invoices post to GL accounts for expense or asset classification. The gl_account_code (STRING) should be replaced with FK to gl_account.gl_account_id, enabling JOIN to retrieve account_name, accoun

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.internal_order. Business justification: AP invoices can be charged to internal orders for project or activity-specific cost tracking. The internal_order_number (STRING) should be replaced with FK to internal_order.internal_order_id, enablin

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Every AP invoice/payment posting creates a journal entry in the GL. This FK enables AP subledger to GL reconciliation — a core SOX control and month-end close requirement.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor (supplier) from whom goods or services were procured. Links to the vendor master data.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The reference date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date depending on payment term configuration.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Payment Terms Baseline Date

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was cleared (paid) in the accounts payable ledger. Marks the completion of the payable lifecycle.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: Four-character organizational unit representing the legal entity for which the invoice is posted. Used for financial consolidation and reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the invoice is denominated (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: Cash discount amount available if payment is made within the discount period as defined in payment terms. Incentivizes early payment.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice document was created or entered into the system. Used for document control and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is due to the vendor according to the agreed payment terms. Used for cash flow planning and payment scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Due Date Calculation

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: Exchange rate applied for foreign currency invoices to convert to local company currency. Used for multi-currency accounting.

attributes.name: expenditure_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice as operational expenditure (OPEX) or capital expenditure (CAPEX). Critical for financial reporting and regulatory asset base (RAB) calculations.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: Three-digit FERC account code for regulatory reporting compliance. Required for utilities subject to FERC jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the invoice is posted, used for period-based financial reporting and year-end closing processes.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_number
attributes.description: Reference to the goods receipt document confirming physical receipt of materials or services. Part of three-way match process.

attributes.name: gross_invoice_amount
attributes.description: Total invoice amount before any deductions, including line item charges, freight, and taxes. Represents the vendor's billed amount.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor issued the invoice. This is the business event date used for aging analysis and payment term calculations.

attributes.name: invoice_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the goods or services covered by the invoice. Provides business context for the transaction.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Invoice Header Text

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice in the procure-to-pay workflow. Tracks progression from receipt through payment execution. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|posted|parked|blocked|approved|paid|cancelled|reversed — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified the invoice record. Supports change tracking and SOX compliance audit requirements.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: System timestamp when the invoice record was last modified. Critical for change audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: net_payable_amount
attributes.description: Net amount payable to the vendor after deducting withholding tax and applying any discounts. This is the actual cash disbursement amount.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating if the invoice is blocked for payment. Blank if not blocked. Common values include A (blocked for payment), R (blocked for review).

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation for why the invoice is blocked for payment, such as pricing discrepancy, quantity variance, or pending approval.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP document number of the payment document that cleared this invoice. Used to trace payment execution and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to disburse funds to the vendor, such as ACH, wire transfer, check, or electronic payment.

attributes.name: payment_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the automatic payment program was executed to generate payment for this invoice. Null if not yet paid.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Four-character code defining the payment terms agreed with the vendor, including net due days, discount periods, and discount percentages.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice was posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period and fiscal year assignment.

attributes.name: posting_period
attributes.description: The accounting period (typically 1-12 for monthly periods) in which the invoice was posted. Used for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: Reference to the purchase order against which this invoice is matched. Used for three-way match validation (PO/GR/IR).

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: The internal SAP accounting document number generated upon invoice posting. Ten-digit numeric identifier used for financial document traceability.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total tax amount charged on the invoice, including sales tax, use tax, VAT, or other applicable taxes based on jurisdiction.

attributes.name: three_way_match_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way match validation comparing purchase order, goods receipt, and invoice receipt. Identifies discrepancies requiring resolution.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account_number
attributes.description: The vendor's bank account number to which payment was sent. Confidential financial information used for electronic payment processing.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing number for the vendor's bank. Used for ACH and wire transfer payment processing in the United States.

attributes.name: vendor_invoice_number
attributes.description: The invoice number assigned by the vendor. This is the externally-known identifier used for vendor reconciliation and three-way matching.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: WBS element for capital project cost tracking. Links invoice to specific phases of capital construction or infrastructure projects.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: Amount of tax withheld at source as required by tax regulations. Reduces the net payment to the vendor.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created or entered the invoice record into the system. Used for audit trail and accountability.

Tracks outgoing cash flows for vendor obligations including fuel suppliers, EPC contractors, and equipment vendors.

attributes.name: payment_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the automated payment run batch that generated this payment. Used for grouping payments processed together.

attributes.name: primary_ap_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.ap_invoice. Business justification: AP payments clear AP invoices. This is a core accounts payable relationship linking payment transactions to the invoices they settle. The invoice_reference_number (STRING) should be replaced with FK t

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: AP payments can be assigned to profit centers for internal management reporting. The profit_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to profit_center.profit_center_id, enabling JOIN to retrieve prof

attributes.name: vendor_bank_account_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor bank account receiving the payment. May be IBAN for SEPA payments or domestic account number.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the vendor receiving payment. Links to vendor master data for fuel suppliers, EPC contractors, equipment vendors, and service providers.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The baseline date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the invoice date or goods receipt date.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The SAP clearing document number that links the payment to the original invoice(s) being settled. Used for accounts payable reconciliation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The SAP company code representing the legal entity making the payment. Used for financial consolidation and SOX-compliant segregation of duties.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The SAP user ID who created or initiated the payment transaction. Used for SOX audit trails and segregation of duties compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and record lifecycle tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the payment transaction (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The cash discount amount taken during payment processing for early payment terms (e.g., 2/10 net 30). Reduces the net payment amount.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The external document date of the payment. May differ from posting date for backdated or forward-dated transactions.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The calculated due date for the payment based on baseline date and payment terms. Used for cash flow forecasting and working capital management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Due Date Calculation

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the payment was posted. Used for monthly financial close and reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which the payment was posted. Used for financial reporting and year-end closing.

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The SAP user ID who last modified the payment transaction. Used for change tracking and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the payment record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: The final net amount disbursed to the vendor after applying discounts and withholding taxes. Equals payment_amount minus discount_amount minus withholding_tax_amount.

attributes.name: payment_advice_number
attributes.description: The remittance advice document number sent to the vendor. Used for vendor reconciliation and inquiry resolution.

attributes.name: payment_amount
attributes.description: The gross payment amount disbursed to the vendor before any adjustments. Represents the total outgoing cash flow.

attributes.name: payment_block_indicator
attributes.description: Single-character code indicating if payment is blocked for manual review. Common values: A (blocked for payment), B (blocked for approval), blank (not blocked).

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: The system or interface through which the payment was initiated. Distinct from payment method - represents the operational channel.

attributes.name: payment_document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique payment document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI-AP during the payment run. Used for audit trails and reconciliation.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The payment instrument used to disburse funds. ACH (Automated Clearing House) for domestic electronic transfers, wire for urgent or international transfers, check for physical payments, EFT (Electronic Funds Transfer), RTGS (Real-Time Gross Settlement), SEPA (Single Euro Payments Area).

attributes.name: payment_reference_text
attributes.description: Free-form reference text included with the payment for vendor reconciliation. May contain invoice numbers, contract references, or remittance advice.

attributes.name: payment_run_date
attributes.description: The date when the payment run was executed in SAP S/4HANA FI-AP. Represents the principal business event timestamp for this transaction.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction. Tracks progression from draft through clearing or reversal.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The payment terms code defining the due date calculation and cash discount conditions (e.g., 0001 for net 30 days, Z001 for 2/10 net 30).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting posting date when the payment transaction was recorded in the general ledger. Used for financial period assignment.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number associated with the payment. Links payment to procurement transaction for three-way match validation.

attributes.name: reversal_document_number
attributes.description: The document number of the reversal transaction if this payment was reversed. Null if payment has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment has been reversed. True if payment was voided or reversed due to error or stop payment.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Two-character code indicating the reason for payment reversal (e.g., 01 for error, 02 for stop payment, 03 for duplicate).

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The value date when funds are actually debited from the company bank account. Used for cash position management and bank reconciliation.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_name
attributes.description: The name of the financial institution holding the vendor bank account.

attributes.name: vendor_bank_routing_number
attributes.description: The bank routing number (ABA for US, SWIFT/BIC for international) for the vendor bank account. Used for electronic payment routing.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The WBS element for capital project tracking. Used when payment is for CAPEX items such as generation plant construction or transmission line upgrades.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The withholding tax amount deducted from the payment per regulatory requirements. Remitted separately to tax authorities.

products.name: receivable
products.description: Accounts receivable open item in SAP S/4HANA FI-AR representing non-customer-billing receivables such as wholesale energy sales, renewable energy certificate (REC) sales, transmission access charges (OATT), capacity market settlements, and intercompany receivables. Captures document number, posting date, due date, amount, GL account, business partner, payment terms, dunning level, clearing status, and collection activity. Distinct from billing domain customer invoices — this entity covers enterprise-level AR outside the CIS/billing system including FERC-jurisdictional wholesale receivables, ISO/RTO settlement receivables, and inter-affiliate charges.
products.reference: SAP FI-AR Open Item (FBL5N)

attributes.name: receivable_id
attributes.description: Primary key for receivable

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the business partner (debtor) who owes this receivable. May reference wholesale counterparties, ISO/RTO entities, renewable energy certificate buyers, transmission customers, or inter-affiliate entities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Master Data

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Receivables can be assigned to cost centers for tracking revenue or receivable-related costs by organizational unit. The cost_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to billing.invoice. Business justification: Accounts receivable entries in finance originate from customer invoices in billing. The finance.receivable table currently has account_id linking to customer but lacks the direct link to the source in

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Every AR posting creates a journal entry in the GL. This FK enables AR subledger to GL reconciliation for wholesale energy sales, REC sales, OATT charges, and intercompany receivables.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Receivables can be assigned to profit centers for internal management reporting and segment analysis. The profit_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to profit_center.profit_center_id.

attributes.name: receivable_gl_account_id
