attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Receivables post to GL accounts for accounts receivable classification. The gl_account_code (STRING) should be replaced with FK to gl_account.gl_account_id, enabling JOIN to retrieve account details a

attributes.name: to_gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account.gl_account_id — AR items post to reconciliation GL accounts. Required for AR subledger-to-GL reconciliation and FERC revenue account reporting.

attributes.name: amount_document_currency
attributes.description: The gross receivable amount in the original transaction currency (document currency). Represents the total amount due before any payments or adjustments.

attributes.name: amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The receivable amount converted to the company code local currency (typically USD for US utilities). Used for consolidated financial reporting and general ledger posting.

attributes.name: assignment_field
attributes.description: SAP assignment field used for payment matching and reconciliation. Often contains purchase order number, contract number, or settlement period identifier.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: The reference date from which payment terms are calculated. Typically the document date or posting date depending on configuration.

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: SAP business area code for segment reporting (e.g., generation, transmission, distribution, trading). Enables profitability analysis by line of business.

attributes.name: business_partner_name
attributes.description: The legal name of the business partner debtor. Denormalized for reporting convenience.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Master Data

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: The date when the receivable was cleared (fully paid or offset). Null for open items. Used to calculate days sales outstanding (DSO).

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The accounting document number that cleared this receivable (payment document, credit memo, offset). Null for open items.

attributes.name: clearing_status
attributes.description: Current clearing status of the receivable item. Open indicates unpaid, partially_cleared indicates partial payment received, fully_cleared indicates payment complete, written_off indicates bad debt write-off, disputed indicates customer dispute in progress.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity that owns this receivable. Used for multi-entity consolidation and inter-company reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this receivable record was first created in the SAP S/4HANA FI-AR system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls for Financial Systems

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the receivable is currently under dispute (true = disputed, false = not disputed). Disputed items are typically excluded from aging analysis and may have dunning blocked.

attributes.name: dispute_reason_code
attributes.description: Code indicating the reason for dispute if dispute_flag is true (e.g., pricing error, quantity discrepancy, contract interpretation, metering issue). Null if no dispute.

attributes.name: document_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the original transaction (e.g., USD, CAD, MXN). Determines the currency in which the receivable was invoiced.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date printed on the source document (invoice, settlement statement, billing document). May differ from posting date due to processing delays.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The externally-known unique accounting document number assigned by SAP S/4HANA FI-AR for this receivable item. Used for reconciliation and audit trails.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: SAP document type code classifying the receivable: DR (Customer Invoice), DZ (Customer Payment), RV (Billing Document), AB (Accounting Document), KR (Vendor Credit Memo), KG (Vendor Invoice). Determines posting rules and workflow.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: The date by which payment is contractually due. Used for aging analysis, dunning, and collections prioritization.
attributes.references: Payment Terms and Credit Management Standards

attributes.name: dunning_block_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether dunning is blocked for this receivable (true = blocked, false = eligible for dunning). Set when disputes are under review or payment arrangements are in place.

attributes.name: dunning_level
attributes.description: The current dunning level (0 = no dunning, 1 = first reminder, 2 = second reminder, 3+ = escalated collections). Increments with each dunning run for overdue items.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert document currency to local currency at posting time. Stored for audit and revaluation purposes.

attributes.name: ferc_jurisdictional_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Jurisdictional Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this receivable falls under FERC jurisdiction (true = FERC-jurisdictional wholesale transaction, false = non-jurisdictional or state-regulated). Determines regulatory reporting requirements.

attributes.name: iso_rto_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Independent System Operator (ISO) / Regional Transmission Organization (RTO) Code
attributes.description: The ISO or RTO market code if this receivable originates from wholesale market settlements. CAISO = California ISO, ERCOT = Electric Reliability Council of Texas, ISONE = ISO New England, MISO = Midcontinent ISO, NYISO = New York ISO, PJM = PJM Interconnection, SPP = Southwest Power Pool. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CAISO|ERCOT|ISONE|MISO|NYISO|PJM|SPP — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: last_dunning_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent dunning notice sent for this receivable. Used to schedule next dunning action.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this receivable record was last updated. Tracks changes to clearing status, amounts, or other attributes.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls for Financial Systems

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company code local currency. Typically USD for US-based utilities.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount_document_currency
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance in document currency after partial payments or credits. Equals amount_document_currency for open items, zero for fully cleared items.

attributes.name: outstanding_amount_local_currency
attributes.description: The remaining unpaid balance in local currency. Used for cash flow forecasting and working capital management.

attributes.name: payment_block_code
attributes.description: SAP payment block code if payment processing is temporarily blocked (e.g., pending approval, dispute resolution, credit hold). Null if no block is active.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The expected or actual payment method for this receivable. Wire transfer and ACH are common for wholesale energy settlements, check for smaller counterparties, offset for inter-affiliate netting.

attributes.name: payment_terms_code
attributes.description: SAP payment terms code defining the due date calculation and discount terms (e.g., Z001 for Net 30, Z002 for 2/10 Net 30). Determines dunning and collections strategy.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date when the receivable was posted to the general ledger. Represents the accounting period assignment and is the principal business event timestamp for financial reporting.

attributes.name: receivable_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the receivable type. Wholesale_energy covers ISO/RTO energy market settlements, rec_sales covers renewable energy certificate transactions, transmission_access covers OATT charges, capacity_market covers capacity auction settlements, ancillary_services covers frequency regulation and reserves, intercompany covers inter-affiliate charges. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: wholesale_energy|rec_sales|transmission_access|capacity_market|ancillary_services|intercompany|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the source system (e.g., ISO/RTO settlement statement number, REC transaction ID, OATT invoice number, inter-affiliate billing reference). Enables traceability to originating transaction.

attributes.name: settlement_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the settlement period for wholesale energy or capacity market receivables. Defines the revenue recognition period.

attributes.name: settlement_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the settlement period for wholesale energy or capacity market receivables. Used for period-based revenue recognition and reconciliation.

attributes.name: text_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the receivable item. May include details such as 'Wholesale energy sales - January 2024', 'REC sales - Q1 2024', 'Transmission access charges - OATT Schedule 1', or 'Inter-affiliate services - shared services allocation'.

attributes.name: write_off_date
attributes.description: The date when the receivable was written off. Null if not written off. Used for bad debt reporting and recovery tracking.

attributes.name: write_off_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this receivable has been written off as uncollectible bad debt (true = written off, false = active). Write-offs are posted to bad debt expense accounts.

products.name: fixed_asset
products.description: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA fixed asset master and depreciation record representing capitalized utility infrastructure and its periodic depreciation lifecycle. Asset master attributes: asset class, FERC plant account (e.g., Account 101-106), capitalization date, useful life, depreciation method, RAB inclusion flag, accumulated depreciation, net book value, and location/functional assignment. Depreciation attributes: depreciation run date, fiscal period, depreciation area (book, tax, regulatory), depreciation amount, accumulated depreciation balance, and remaining useful life. SSOT for CAPEX tracking, RAB valuation inputs, FERC depreciation studies, rate case filings, and regulatory plant account reporting submitted to PUCs and FERC.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Asset Master (AS01) / FERC Plant Accounts 101-106

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the fixed asset record. Primary key for the fixed asset master data in SAP S/4HANA FI-AA. This is the system-generated asset number that uniquely identifies each capitalized utility infrastructure asset throughout its lifecycle from acquisition through retirement.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project (CAPEX project) under which this asset was acquired or constructed. Links the asset to project budgets, work breakdown structures, and capital expenditure tracking.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Fixed assets require asset class reference for depreciation method, useful life parameters, FERC account alignment, and regulatory reporting consistency. New FK needed; removes denormalized asset_clas

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Fixed assets (transmission lines, substations, generation units) are physically located within control areas. Essential for asset register by jurisdiction, depreciation allocation, rate base calculati

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Fixed assets are assigned to cost centers for depreciation expense allocation and cost tracking. The cost_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id, enabling JOIN to ret

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.gl_account.gl_account_id — Fixed assets post to FERC plant accounts (GL accounts 101-106). This FK enables asset-to-GL reconciliation, RAB valuation, and FERC Form 1 plant schedule reporting.

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: Plant-level fixed assets (buildings, land, common equipment) are assigned to plants for asset registry reconciliation, insurance valuation, and FERC reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.regulatory_asset.regulatory_asset_id — Fixed assets with RAB inclusion flag contribute to the regulatory asset base. This FK enables RAB roll-forward calculations by linking individual assets to their RAB valuation treatment.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: Total depreciation expense recognized to date since the asset was placed in service. Represents the cumulative reduction in asset value due to wear, obsolescence, and passage of time. Used to calculate net book value.

attributes.name: acquisition_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was acquired or purchased by the utility. May differ from capitalization date for assets that require installation or commissioning before being placed in service.

attributes.name: acquisition_value
attributes.description: Original acquisition cost or capitalized value of the asset including purchase price, installation costs, freight, and other costs necessary to bring the asset to its intended use. This is the gross book value before accumulated depreciation.

attributes.name: annual_depreciation_amount
attributes.description: Calculated annual depreciation expense for the current fiscal year. For straight-line depreciation, this is acquisition value divided by useful life. Posted monthly or quarterly to the general ledger as depreciation expense.

attributes.name: asset_condition_rating
attributes.description: Current physical condition assessment of the asset based on inspections, maintenance history, and performance monitoring. Used for asset health indexing, replacement prioritization, and risk assessment.

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the fixed asset including make, model, specifications, capacity, and distinguishing characteristics. Used for asset identification, inventory management, and regulatory documentation.

attributes.name: asset_location_latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, spatial analysis, outage correlation, and field service routing. Integrates with Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.

attributes.name: asset_location_longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the asset location in decimal degrees. Used for GIS mapping, spatial analysis, outage correlation, and field service routing. Integrates with Esri ArcGIS Utility Network.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: Business-facing asset number or tag used for external identification and physical labeling. This is the human-readable identifier displayed on asset tags, used in field operations, and referenced in maintenance work orders and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the fixed asset. In-service assets are operational and depreciating; under-construction assets are CWIP (Construction Work in Progress) not yet placed in service; retired assets are no longer operational; disposed assets have been sold or scrapped; transferred assets have moved between cost centers or legal entities.

attributes.name: capacity_rating
attributes.description: Nameplate capacity or rated output of the asset in appropriate units (MW for generation, MVA for transformers, kV for transmission lines, etc.). Used for load planning, capacity analysis, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: capacity_unit_of_measure
attributes.description: Unit of measure for the capacity rating field. Common units include MW (megawatts) for generation, MVA (megavolt-amperes) for transformers, kV (kilovolts) for voltage, and circuit miles for transmission lines. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: MW|MVA|kV|kVA|MWh|GWh|miles|circuit_miles|units — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was placed in service and capitalized on the balance sheet. This is the date depreciation begins and marks the transition from CWIP to depreciable plant. Critical for depreciation calculations, RAB valuations, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this asset master record was first created in the system. Used for audit trails and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: criticality_classification
attributes.description: Business criticality rating indicating the impact of asset failure on operations, customer service, safety, and regulatory compliance. Used for maintenance prioritization and risk-based asset management.

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: Valuation perspective for depreciation calculation. Book depreciation for financial statements, tax depreciation for IRS filings, regulatory depreciation for rate case and PUC reporting. SAP supports parallel depreciation areas for the same asset.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Area Configuration

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: Depreciation calculation method applied to the asset. Straight-line is most common for utility plant. Regulatory method follows PUC-approved depreciation rates. Method determines how acquisition value is allocated over useful life.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Key Configuration

attributes.name: disposal_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was physically disposed of through sale, scrap, or transfer. May occur after retirement date. Used for gain/loss on disposal calculations and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: disposal_proceeds
attributes.description: Cash or fair market value received from disposal of the asset through sale or salvage. Used to calculate gain or loss on disposal (proceeds minus net book value at disposal).

attributes.name: environmental_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset is subject to environmental regulations such as EPA emissions standards, hazardous materials handling, or environmental permitting. Used for compliance tracking and environmental reporting.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts plant account code (e.g., 101-399 for electric plant accounts). Critical for regulatory reporting, rate case filings, and depreciation studies. Examples: Account 310 (Transmission Plant), Account 360 (Distribution Plant), Account 340 (Generation Plant).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric Utilities

attributes.name: functional_location
attributes.description: SAP Plant Maintenance (PM) functional location representing the physical or logical location of the asset within the utility infrastructure hierarchy. Used for maintenance planning, work order assignment, and asset tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PM Functional Location Master

attributes.name: geographic_location
attributes.description: Physical location or address of the asset including site name, substation, service territory, or facility. Used for GIS integration, outage management, field service dispatch, and regulatory reporting by jurisdiction.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network and SAP Asset Master

attributes.name: installation_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was physically installed or constructed at its current location. May differ from capitalization date if commissioning or testing was required before the asset was placed in service.

attributes.name: last_depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent depreciation calculation and posting run. Depreciation is typically calculated monthly or quarterly. This date tracks when accumulated depreciation was last updated.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AA Depreciation Run Log

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this asset master record. Used for audit trails, change management, and SOX compliance documentation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time this asset master record was last updated. Used for change tracking, audit trails, and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: manufacturer
attributes.description: Name of the equipment manufacturer or vendor. Used for warranty tracking, spare parts sourcing, maintenance planning, and vendor performance analysis.

attributes.name: model_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer model or part number for the asset. Used for technical specifications lookup, spare parts identification, and standardization analysis.

attributes.name: nerc_cip_classification
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) Classification
attributes.description: NERC CIP cyber security classification level for assets that are part of the Bulk Electric System. High and medium impact assets require enhanced physical and cyber security controls per NERC CIP standards.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: Current carrying value of the asset calculated as acquisition value minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the remaining capitalized value on the balance sheet. Critical for RAB calculations and financial reporting.

attributes.name: rab_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is included in the Regulatory Asset Base for rate-making purposes. RAB assets are used to calculate allowed return on equity (ROE) and revenue requirements in rate cases filed with PUCs.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: Remaining depreciable life of the asset in years calculated as useful life minus elapsed time since capitalization. Used for depreciation forecasting, asset replacement planning, and rate case projections.

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: Date the asset was retired from service and removed from the active plant inventory. Depreciation ceases on this date. Used for asset lifecycle analysis and regulatory plant retirement reporting.

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Unique serial number assigned by the manufacturer. Used for warranty claims, recall tracking, and individual asset identification in the field.

attributes.name: sox_material_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the asset value is material for SOX financial reporting and internal controls testing. Material assets require enhanced documentation, approval workflows, and audit trails.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: Expected useful life of the asset in years as determined by depreciation studies and regulatory guidance. Used to calculate annual depreciation expense. Varies by asset class (e.g., 30-50 years for transmission lines, 10-15 years for vehicles).
attributes.references: FERC Depreciation Studies and SAP Asset Class Configuration

attributes.name: warranty_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date the manufacturer warranty expires. Used for maintenance planning decisions (repair vs. replace) and warranty claim tracking.

products.name: asset_depreciation
products.description: Periodic depreciation posting records for fixed assets in SAP FI-AA. Captures depreciation run date, fiscal period, depreciation area (book, tax, regulatory), depreciation amount, accumulated depreciation balance, and remaining useful life. Supports FERC depreciation studies, rate case filings, and RAB calculations submitted to PUCs.
products.reference: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Run (AFAB)

attributes.name: asset_depreciation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the asset depreciation posting record. Primary key for the asset_depreciation product.

attributes.name: class_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to asset.asset_class. Business justification: Depreciation runs require asset class for rate tables, useful life parameters, depreciation method selection, and FERC regulatory reporting. New FK needed; removes denormalized asset_class_code.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Depreciation postings are assigned to cost centers for expense allocation. The cost_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id, enabling JOIN to retrieve cost center mast

attributes.name: depreciation_expense_gl_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Depreciation Expense Gl Account Id (Foreign Key)
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Depreciation postings hit GL accounts for depreciation expense. The gl_account_depreciation_expense (STRING) should be replaced with FK to gl_account.gl_account_id, enabling JOIN to retrieve account d

attributes.name: depreciation_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the batch depreciation calculation run that generated this posting. Used to group all depreciation postings from a single execution.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.fixed_asset.fixed_asset_id — Every depreciation posting must reference the fixed asset being depreciated. Without this FK, depreciation records are meaningless and RAB calculations cannot be performed.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.generating_unit. Business justification: Depreciation expense is tracked at the unit level for rate base calculations, FERC depreciation studies, and rate case testimony. Critical for regulatory accounting.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original asset_depreciation_id that this record reverses, if this is a reversal posting. Null for original postings.

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: Plant-level depreciation for aggregated asset classes. Required for monthly depreciation runs, RAB valuation, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Depreciation postings are assigned to profit centers for internal management reporting and segment analysis. The profit_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to profit_center.profit_center_id, en

attributes.name: registry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the fixed asset for which depreciation is being posted. Links to the asset registry master data.

attributes.name: accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The cumulative total depreciation posted for this asset from acquisition date through the current period. Represents the total reduction in asset value to date.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Accumulated Depreciation; FERC Account 108 Accumulated Depreciation

attributes.name: acquisition_value
attributes.description: The original acquisition or capitalized cost of the asset. Used as the basis for depreciation calculations and remains constant unless revaluation occurs.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Acquisition and Production Costs; FERC Account 101

attributes.name: asset_location
attributes.description: The physical location or plant where the asset is installed. Used for geographic cost allocation and service territory reporting to state PUCs.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Asset Location; GIS Asset Location

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: The business area or segment (e.g., generation, transmission, distribution, retail) to which this depreciation expense is assigned. Used for segment reporting and regulatory cost allocation.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code for which this depreciation posting is recorded. Supports multi-entity consolidation and separate regulatory reporting by operating company.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that created this depreciation posting record. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation posting record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record. Typically USD for US utilities.

attributes.name: depreciation_amount
attributes.description: The periodic depreciation expense amount posted for this asset in this period. Represents the reduction in asset value for the reporting period.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Posting; FERC Account 403 Depreciation Expense

attributes.name: depreciation_area
attributes.description: The depreciation area or valuation view for which this posting applies. Supports parallel depreciation calculations for book accounting, tax reporting, regulatory filings (FERC), and international standards (IFRS/GAAP).
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Area; FERC Uniform System of Accounts

attributes.name: depreciation_key
attributes.description: The depreciation method key that defines the calculation rules applied (e.g., straight-line, declining balance, units of production). Controls how depreciation is computed for this asset.

attributes.name: depreciation_method
attributes.description: The depreciation calculation method applied for this posting. Straight-line is most common for utility assets; composite and group methods are used for transmission and distribution assets per FERC guidelines.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; IRS Publication 946

attributes.name: depreciation_rate_percent
attributes.description: The annual depreciation rate applied as a percentage of acquisition value. For straight-line depreciation, calculated as 100 divided by useful life years.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Depreciation Rate; FERC Depreciation Rate Studies

attributes.name: depreciation_run_date
attributes.description: The date on which the depreciation calculation batch was executed. Represents the business event timestamp for this depreciation posting.

attributes.name: document_number
attributes.description: The financial document number assigned to this depreciation posting in the general ledger. Used for audit trail and reconciliation with FI-GL.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for this asset. Required for regulatory reporting to FERC and state Public Utility Commissions (PUCs). Examples: 311 (Structures), 353 (Station Equipment), 364 (Poles and Fixtures).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric Utilities (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for which this depreciation posting applies. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this depreciation posting applies. Used for financial period reporting and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: gl_account_accumulated_depreciation
attributes.description: The general ledger account number to which accumulated depreciation is posted as a contra-asset. Typically maps to FERC Account 108 (Accumulated Depreciation) for utility assets.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA GL Account Assignment; FERC Account 108

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or system account that last modified this depreciation posting record. Used for audit trail and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this depreciation posting record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: net_book_value
attributes.description: The net book value of the asset after this depreciation posting, calculated as acquisition value minus accumulated depreciation. Represents the current carrying value of the asset.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Net Book Value; Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) Calculation

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments related to this depreciation posting. Used to document adjustments, corrections, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the depreciation transaction was posted to the general ledger. May differ from the depreciation run date due to period-end processing.

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: The current status of this depreciation posting. Indicates whether the posting has been successfully recorded to the general ledger, reversed due to error, or is pending approval.

attributes.name: rab_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is eligible for inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-making purposes. True if the asset is used and useful in providing regulated utility service.
attributes.references: PUC Rate Case Guidelines; RAB Calculation Methodology

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction (state PUC or FERC) under which this asset and its depreciation are reported. Critical for rate case filings and cost recovery.

attributes.name: remaining_useful_life_years
attributes.description: The remaining useful life of the asset in years after this depreciation posting. Calculated as original useful life minus elapsed life. Critical for rate case filings and asset replacement planning.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Remaining Life; PUC Rate Case Filings

attributes.name: retirement_date
attributes.description: The date on which the asset was retired or disposed of, if applicable. Null for active assets. Used to stop depreciation calculations and trigger retirement accounting.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this depreciation posting is a reversal of a previous posting. True if this record reverses a prior depreciation entry due to correction or adjustment.

attributes.name: salvage_value
attributes.description: The estimated residual value of the asset at the end of its useful life. Used in depreciation calculations and retirement accounting. May be negative for assets with removal costs.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Salvage Value; FERC Depreciation Studies

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this depreciation posting is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements. True for publicly traded utilities with material asset values.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The total estimated useful life of the asset in years as defined at acquisition. Used to calculate straight-line depreciation rates and supports FERC depreciation study requirements.
attributes.references: SAP FI-AA Useful Life; FERC Depreciation Studies

products.name: capex_project
products.description: Capital expenditure project master and expenditure detail in SAP S/4HANA PS/IM covering the full CAPEX lifecycle from approval through capitalization. Project master attributes: WBS structure, approved CAPEX budget, actual spend to date, forecast at completion, project phase (planning, execution, in-service), responsible business unit, IRP alignment, CPCN reference, and capitalization status. Expenditure detail attributes: purchase order reference, goods receipt date, invoice amount, asset under construction (AuC) account, settlement rule, capitalization event, and FERC account code. Supports capital budget governance, project cost tracking by WBS element, rate case CAPEX justification, and regulatory reporting of capital additions to the rate base.
products.reference: SAP PS WBS Element / SAP IM Investment Program

attributes.name: capex_project_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital expenditure project. Primary key.

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Capital projects are planned and executed within specific control areas for asset location tracking, regulatory jurisdiction assignment, and rate base allocation by service territory. Essential for ge

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center.profit_center_id — CAPEX projects are assigned to organizational units (business units) for budget governance and segment reporting. Critical for CAPEX variance analysis by business segment.

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: Actual date when the project was completed and the asset placed in service. Null if project is still in progress.

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative actual expenditure to date for this project, in USD. Sum of all posted costs including purchase orders, goods receipts, invoices, and internal labor.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when project work commenced. May differ from planned start date due to delays or early starts.

attributes.name: approved_budget_amount
attributes.description: Total capital budget approved by the board or executive management for this project, in USD. Represents the authorized spending limit.

attributes.name: auc_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code used to accumulate project costs before capitalization. Typically a balance sheet account in the 100-series per FERC Uniform System of Accounts.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Part 101

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: Date when the asset under construction (AuC) was settled to the fixed asset register and depreciation commenced. Marks the transition from CAPEX project to operational asset.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Asset Capitalization

attributes.name: capitalization_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the project costs have been transferred from asset under construction (AuC) to the fixed asset register: not capitalized (still in AuC), partially capitalized (some WBS elements settled), or fully capitalized (all costs settled and project closed).

attributes.name: committed_amount
attributes.description: Total committed funds for this project, in USD. Includes purchase orders issued but not yet invoiced. Used for budget availability checks.

attributes.name: cpcn_approval_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) Approval Date
attributes.description: Date when the Public Utility Commission (PUC) granted the CPCN for this project. Null if CPCN is not required or not yet approved.

attributes.name: cpcn_reference_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) Reference Number
attributes.description: Regulatory approval reference number for the Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity (CPCN) issued by the Public Utility Commission (PUC) authorizing this capital project. Required for major transmission and generation projects.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital project record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this project (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: environmental_permit_number
attributes.description: Reference number for environmental permits required for this project (e.g., EPA air quality permit, wetlands permit, NEPA clearance). Multiple permits may be concatenated or stored in related tables.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code to which the capitalized asset will be assigned (e.g., 350 for transmission lines, 360 for distribution lines, 310 for generation plant). Used for regulatory rate base reporting.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts - Part 101

attributes.name: forecast_at_completion_amount
attributes.description: Projected total cost at project completion, in USD. Updated periodically by project managers based on actual spend, commitments, and remaining work estimates.

attributes.name: irp_alignment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project is included in the utility's approved Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) filed with the Public Utility Commission (PUC). True if aligned; false otherwise.

attributes.name: irp_reference_number
attributes.description: Reference identifier linking this project to the specific IRP filing or docket number with the Public Utility Commission (PUC).

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this capital project record.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capital project record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: nerc_compliance_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Electric Reliability Corporation (NERC) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this project involves assets subject to NERC Critical Infrastructure Protection (CIP) standards or other NERC reliability requirements. True if subject to NERC compliance; false otherwise.

attributes.name: planned_completion_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for project completion and asset in-service, as defined in the project plan.

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for project initiation and commencement of work, as defined in the project plan.

attributes.name: priority_rank
attributes.description: Relative priority ranking of this project within the capital portfolio, used for resource allocation and budget decisions. Lower numbers indicate higher priority.

attributes.name: project_category
attributes.description: Nature of the capital investment: new construction (greenfield), replacement (asset retirement and new installation), expansion (capacity increase), upgrade (technology improvement), maintenance (major overhaul capitalized per FERC), compliance (mandated by regulation), or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: new_construction|replacement|expansion|upgrade|maintenance|compliance|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: project_description
attributes.description: Detailed business justification and scope description of the capital project, including technical specifications and strategic rationale.

attributes.name: project_manager_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned as project manager, accountable for delivery, budget, and schedule.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Project Manager Assignment

attributes.name: project_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the capital project (e.g., 'Substation XYZ Transformer Replacement', 'Solar Farm Phase 2 Expansion').

attributes.name: project_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique project identifier used in SAP S/4HANA PS and external communications. Corresponds to SAP Project Definition number.

attributes.name: project_phase
attributes.description: Current lifecycle phase of the capital project: planning (feasibility and design), engineering (detailed design and permitting), procurement (vendor selection and contracting), construction (physical build), commissioning (testing and startup), in-service (asset capitalized and operational), or closed (project administratively complete). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planning|engineering|procurement|construction|commissioning|in_service|closed — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: project_sponsor_name
attributes.description: Full name of the executive sponsor who approved the project and provides strategic oversight.

attributes.name: project_status
attributes.description: Administrative status of the project: approved (budget authorized), active (work in progress), on hold (temporarily suspended), cancelled (terminated before completion), or completed (all work finished and capitalized).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Project System Status

attributes.name: project_type
attributes.description: Classification of the capital project by asset category: generation (power plant construction/upgrade), transmission (high-voltage lines and towers), distribution (local grid infrastructure), substation (transformer and switching equipment), renewable integration (solar/wind/storage), grid modernization (AMI, ADMS, smart grid), customer systems (CIS, billing, MDM), regulatory compliance (environmental, safety, NERC CIP), or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution|substation|renewable_integration|grid_modernization|customer_systems|regulatory_compliance|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: rab_inclusion_date
attributes.description: Date when the capitalized asset was added to the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-making purposes, allowing cost recovery through customer rates.

attributes.name: rate_case_docket_number
attributes.description: Public Utility Commission (PUC) docket number for the rate case in which this capital project was included for cost recovery.

attributes.name: rate_case_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project has been included in a rate case filing for cost recovery through the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB). True if included; false otherwise.

attributes.name: responsible_business_unit
attributes.description: Name or code of the business unit or division responsible for executing this capital project (e.g., Transmission Operations, Distribution Engineering, Generation Services).

attributes.name: risk_rating
attributes.description: Overall risk assessment for the capital project based on technical complexity, regulatory uncertainty, budget size, and schedule constraints: low (routine project), medium (moderate complexity), high (significant challenges), or critical (major strategic initiative with high uncertainty).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this capital project is subject to SOX internal controls for financial reporting due to materiality thresholds. True if SOX controls apply; false otherwise.

attributes.name: strategic_initiative_alignment
attributes.description: Name or code of the corporate strategic initiative or program to which this project is aligned (e.g., Grid Modernization 2025, Renewable Integration Program, Customer Experience Transformation).

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between approved budget and forecast at completion, in USD. Positive indicates under budget; negative indicates over budget.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: Top-level WBS element code representing the project hierarchy in SAP PS. Used for cost collection and budget control.

products.name: capex_expenditure
products.description: Individual capital expenditure transaction posted against a CAPEX project WBS element. Records purchase order reference, goods receipt date, invoice amount, asset under construction (AuC) account, settlement rule, and capitalization event. Enables granular CAPEX tracking by project, asset class, and FERC account for regulatory reporting.
products.reference: SAP PS Actual Cost / AuC Settlement (AIAB)

attributes.name: capex_expenditure_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the capital expenditure transaction record. Primary key for the CAPEX expenditure entity.

attributes.name: capital_project_id
attributes.description: Reference to the capital project under which this expenditure is incurred. Links to the capital project master record.

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Individual capital expenditures must be assigned to control areas for geographic cost tracking, regulatory reporting by jurisdiction, and rate case support documentation. Enables rate base calculation

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: CAPEX expenditures are assigned to cost centers for tracking capital spending by organizational unit. The cost_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id, enabling JOIN t

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved this capital expenditure. Links to the workforce or employee master record for audit trail.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.generating_unit. Business justification: Capex expenditures capitalize to specific generating units (new equipment, upgrades). Essential for asset capitalization, depreciation start, and unit-level rate base tracking.

attributes.name: irp_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.irp_scenario. Business justification: Capital expenditures must be tracked against approved IRP scenario forecasts for variance analysis and regulatory compliance. Utilities demonstrate actual spending aligns with IRP plans during prudenc

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: Plant-level capex (substation upgrades, common facilities) capitalizes to the plant. Required for FERC plant-in-service accounting and rate base calculations.

attributes.name: vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or supplier from whom goods or services were procured for this capital expenditure. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this capital expenditure was approved by the authorized approver. Required for SOX compliance and audit trail.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: The approval workflow status of this capital expenditure transaction. Indicates whether the expenditure has been authorized per internal controls and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: asset_class
attributes.description: The classification of the asset being constructed or acquired (e.g., Generation Equipment, Transmission Lines, Distribution Infrastructure, IT Systems). Used for depreciation and asset management.

attributes.name: asset_number
attributes.description: The fixed asset number to which this expenditure was settled upon capitalization. Links the expenditure to the final asset record in the asset register.

attributes.name: auc_account_code
attributes.description: The general ledger account code for the Asset Under Construction (AuC) to which this expenditure is posted. Represents the interim capitalization account before final asset settlement.

attributes.name: budget_line_item
attributes.description: The budget line item or budget category against which this capital expenditure is tracked. Used for budget vs. actual variance reporting.

attributes.name: capex_expenditure_description
attributes.description: A detailed textual description of the capital expenditure transaction, including the nature of goods or services procured and any relevant context.

attributes.name: capitalization_date
attributes.description: The date on which this expenditure was capitalized and transferred from the AuC account to a fixed asset. Marks the start of depreciation.

attributes.name: capitalization_status
attributes.description: The current capitalization lifecycle status of this expenditure. Indicates whether the expenditure has been capitalized to an asset or is still in the AuC account.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capital expenditure record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which this expenditure was transacted (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: depreciation_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which depreciation begins for the asset created from this capital expenditure. Typically aligns with the capitalization date or asset in-service date.

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the source document (e.g., invoice, receipt) that originated this expenditure transaction. May differ from posting date.

attributes.name: expenditure_amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of this capital expenditure transaction before any adjustments or allocations. Represents the invoice or payment amount.

attributes.name: expenditure_type
attributes.description: The category of capital expenditure (e.g., materials, labor, contractor services, engineering). Used for cost breakdown analysis and project management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: material|labor|equipment|contractor_services|engineering|permits|land_acquisition|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts code that classifies this capital expenditure for regulatory reporting. Required for rate case filings and regulatory asset base (RAB) calculations.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year in which this capital expenditure was posted. Enables monthly CAPEX tracking and variance analysis.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this capital expenditure was posted. Used for annual CAPEX budgeting, tracking, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: goods_receipt_date
attributes.description: The date on which goods or services were received and confirmed in the system. Triggers the capitalization eligibility for the expenditure.

attributes.name: invoice_date
attributes.description: The date on which the vendor invoice was issued. Used for payment terms calculation and aging analysis.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: The vendor invoice number corresponding to this CAPEX expenditure. Used for accounts payable reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this capital expenditure record was last updated or modified. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net monetary value of this capital expenditure after deducting taxes and other adjustments. Represents the capitalizable base amount.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was made to the vendor for this capital expenditure. Null if payment is still pending.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: The current payment status of this capital expenditure invoice. Indicates whether the vendor has been paid and tracks accounts payable aging.

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The accounting date on which this CAPEX expenditure transaction was posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period for financial reporting.

attributes.name: purchase_order_number
attributes.description: The purchase order number associated with this capital expenditure transaction. Links the expenditure to the procurement document.

attributes.name: rab_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this capital expenditure is eligible for inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-making purposes. True if eligible, False otherwise.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: rab_inclusion_date
attributes.description: The date on which this capital expenditure was included in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate recovery. Used for Return on Equity (ROE) and Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) calculations.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this capital expenditure transaction was reversed or cancelled. Null if the transaction has not been reversed.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this capital expenditure transaction has been reversed or cancelled. True if reversed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: A textual explanation of why this capital expenditure transaction was reversed or cancelled. Used for audit trail and root cause analysis.

attributes.name: settlement_rule
attributes.description: The settlement rule code that defines how this CAPEX expenditure is allocated or settled to one or more fixed assets. May specify percentage splits or allocation keys.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: The unique document identifier in the source system (e.g., SAP document number) that originated this capital expenditure transaction. Used for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or code of the source operational system from which this capital expenditure record was extracted (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount (sales tax, VAT, GST) included in this CAPEX expenditure. Used for tax reporting and recovery calculations.

attributes.name: useful_life_years
attributes.description: The estimated useful life of the asset in years, used for calculating depreciation expense. Determined by asset class and regulatory guidelines.

attributes.name: wbs_element
attributes.description: The WBS element code against which this CAPEX expenditure is posted. Represents a specific phase or component of the capital project for granular cost tracking.

products.name: opex_budget
products.description: Operational expenditure budget plan in SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA capturing approved O&M spending targets by cost center and cost element group. Records budget version (original, revised, forecast), fiscal year, planned OPEX amount, approved amount, actual spend to date, variance amount and percentage, and regulatory OPEX allowance reference. Supports O&M cost planning against PUC-approved levels, EBITDA forecasting by business unit, and management variance reporting for generation fuel, T&D maintenance, and corporate overhead.
products.reference: SAP CO-CCA Cost Center Planning (KP06)

attributes.name: opex_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the operational expenditure budget record. Primary key for the OPEX budget entity.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost center responsible for this OPEX budget allocation. Links to organizational cost center hierarchy in SAP CO-CCA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-CCA Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: cost_element_group_id
attributes.description: Reference to the cost element group categorizing the type of operational expenditure (e.g., fuel costs, maintenance labor, administrative overhead).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Element Accounting

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: The user ID or employee identifier of the person who last modified this budget record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

attributes.name: generating_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.generating_unit. Business justification: O&M budgets are set at the unit level for cost control, budget preparation, and monthly variance reporting. Standard in utility operations.

attributes.name: load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Operating expense budgets are developed using load forecasts as primary drivers. O&M costs scale with forecasted energy delivery and peak demand. Critical for annual budgeting cycle and operational pl

attributes.name: owner_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who owns and is accountable for managing this budget line. Links to the workforce or employee master data.

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: Plant-level O&M budgets for aggregated operations. Required for annual budget cycle, regulatory filings, and executive reporting.

attributes.name: primary_opex_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or manager who approved this budget version. Links to the workforce or employee master data for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center.profit_center_id — OPEX budgets are set by cost center (merged into organizational_unit). This FK enables budget vs. actual variance reporting by organizational unit — a core management reporting requirement.

attributes.name: actual_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual operational expenditure incurred to date for this budget line, sourced from posted cost transactions in SAP FI/CO. Used for variance analysis against planned and approved amounts.

attributes.name: approved_opex_amount
attributes.description: The approved operational expenditure amount after management and regulatory review. This is the authorized spending limit for the period.

attributes.name: available_budget_amount
attributes.description: The remaining budget available for new commitments or expenditures, calculated as approved_opex_amount minus (actual_spend_amount plus commitment_amount).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Availability Control

attributes.name: budget_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget version was formally approved by management or the board, transitioning from draft or submitted status to approved status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Approval Workflow

attributes.name: budget_category
attributes.description: High-level categorization of the OPEX budget line by expenditure type, enabling roll-up reporting and analysis by major cost driver (e.g., fuel costs for generation, maintenance for T&D assets). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fuel|labor|maintenance|materials|contracted_services|administrative|regulatory|environmental|technology — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: budget_effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this budget version becomes effective and active for spending authorization and control.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Validity Period

attributes.name: budget_expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this budget version expires and is no longer valid for new commitments or expenditures. Typically the end of the fiscal period or year.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Validity Period

attributes.name: budget_lock_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether this budget line is open for changes (unlocked), locked to prevent further modifications, or frozen for regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: budget_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing additional context, assumptions, or justifications related to this budget line. Used for documenting budget planning rationale and variance explanations.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget record indicating its approval and activation state within the budget planning and execution workflow.

attributes.name: budget_version
attributes.description: The version of the budget record indicating whether this is the original approved budget, a revised budget after adjustments, a forecast update, or a supplemental allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Version Management

attributes.name: business_unit_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the business unit or division (e.g., Generation, Transmission and Distribution, Corporate) responsible for this OPEX budget line.

attributes.name: commitment_amount
attributes.description: The total amount of purchase orders, contracts, or other financial commitments issued against this budget line but not yet posted as actual expenditure. Used for funds availability checking.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OPEX budget record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget record (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: The FERC Uniform System of Accounts code that classifies this OPEX expenditure for regulatory reporting purposes. Ensures compliance with FERC financial reporting requirements.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (18 CFR Part 101)

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for which this budget line applies. Typically 1-12 for monthly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which this OPEX budget is planned and tracked. Typically a four-digit year (e.g., 2024).

attributes.name: forecast_amount
attributes.description: The forecasted or projected OPEX expenditure for this budget line based on current run-rate and known future commitments. Used for EBITDA forecasting and financial planning.

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: The functional area of utility operations to which this OPEX budget applies, enabling segmentation by core business process (e.g., power generation, T&D operations, customer service). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: generation|transmission|distribution|customer_service|corporate|regulatory|trading|renewable_energy — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: is_capital_conversion_candidate
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this OPEX expenditure may be eligible for capitalization or conversion to CAPEX under regulatory accounting rules. Used for financial planning and rate base optimization.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts Capitalization Rules

attributes.name: is_regulatory_reportable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this OPEX budget line must be included in regulatory financial reports submitted to PUC or FERC. True if reportable; false otherwise.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this OPEX budget record was last updated or modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: planned_opex_amount
attributes.description: The planned operational expenditure amount for this cost center and cost element group for the specified fiscal period. Represents the initial budget target before approvals or adjustments.

attributes.name: prior_year_actual_amount
attributes.description: The actual OPEX expenditure for the same cost center and cost element group in the prior fiscal year. Used for year-over-year trend analysis and budget benchmarking.

attributes.name: regulatory_allowance_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or docket number for the regulatory filing or rate case order that established the regulatory OPEX allowance for this budget line.
attributes.references: PUC Docket Management and FERC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: regulatory_opex_allowance
attributes.description: The OPEX spending level approved by the Public Utility Commission (PUC) or regulatory authority for this cost category and period. Used to ensure spending aligns with rate case approvals and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: PUC Rate Case Order and FERC Account Codes

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary variance between approved OPEX budget and actual spend (approved_opex_amount minus actual_spend_amount). Positive values indicate under-spend; negative values indicate over-spend.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage variance between approved OPEX budget and actual spend, calculated as (variance_amount / approved_opex_amount) * 100. Used for management reporting and exception flagging.

products.name: internal_order
products.description: SAP CO internal order used to collect and monitor costs for specific short-term activities such as planned outage repairs, storm restoration events, vegetation management campaigns, or overhead projects not warranting a full WBS structure. Captures order type (overhead, investment, accrual), responsible cost center, settlement rule, budget, actual costs, commitment values, and lifecycle status (created, released, technically complete, closed). Used for O&M job costing, regulatory cost segregation, and FERC account-level cost tracking.
products.reference: SAP CO Internal Order (KO01)

attributes.name: internal_order_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SAP CO internal order. Primary key for cost collection and monitoring of short-term activities.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Master Data

attributes.name: internal_cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center.cost_center_id — Internal orders settle to cost centers. The responsible cost center is a required organizational assignment for every internal order in SAP CO.

attributes.name: internal_profit_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the profit center to which internal order costs are allocated for segment profitability analysis and management reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO-PA Profit Center Master Data

attributes.name: internal_responsible_cost_center_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the cost center accountable for planning, executing, and settling the internal order costs. Links to the organizational unit managing the activity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Master Data

attributes.name: primary_settlement_gl_account_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Primary Settlement General Ledger (GL) Account ID
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary GL account to which internal order costs are settled, typically a FERC account code for regulatory cost tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI General Ledger Master Data

attributes.name: to_profit_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.profit_center.profit_center_id — Internal orders are assigned to responsible cost centers (merged into organizational_unit) for cost collection and settlement. Critical for storm cost tracking and regulatory cost segregation.

attributes.name: wbs_element_id
attributes.description: Optional reference to a WBS element if this internal order is part of a larger capital project structure, enabling hierarchical cost rollup.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS Work Breakdown Structure

attributes.name: actual_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total actual costs posted to the internal order to date, including labor, materials, services, and overhead allocations, in the company currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Actual Costs

attributes.name: actual_end_date
attributes.description: Actual date when work on the internal order activity was completed, triggering technical completion status and final settlement processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Dates

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date when work on the internal order activity commenced, captured from work order confirmations or time entry records.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Dates

attributes.name: audit_trail_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether detailed change history and approval documentation must be retained for this internal order to support regulatory audits or rate case proceedings.

attributes.name: budget_amount
attributes.description: Approved budget allocation for the internal order in the company currency, representing the planned cost ceiling for the activity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Budget Management

attributes.name: business_area
attributes.description: Cross-company code segment for internal financial reporting, often aligned with business divisions such as Generation, Transmission, Distribution, or Retail.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Configuration

attributes.name: capex_opex_indicator
attributes.description: Classification of internal order costs as capital expenditure (CAPEX) for asset capitalization and depreciation, or operational expenditure (OPEX) for immediate expense recognition.
attributes.references: Energy Utilities Capital vs Operating Expense Policy

attributes.name: closure_date
attributes.description: Date when the internal order was closed and archived, indicating all costs have been settled and the order is no longer active for any postings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Status Management

attributes.name: commitment_amount
attributes.description: Total committed costs (purchase requisitions and purchase orders) assigned to the internal order but not yet invoiced, used for funds availability checking and budget monitoring.

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: SAP company code representing the legal entity to which this internal order belongs, used for financial consolidation and regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: controlling_area
attributes.description: SAP Controlling (CO) area code representing the organizational unit for cost accounting and internal reporting, may span multiple company codes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Controlling Area Configuration

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the internal order master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this internal order (e.g., USD, CAD, EUR).

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code to which internal order costs are ultimately allocated for regulatory financial reporting and rate case filings.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts for Electric Utilities

attributes.name: functional_area
attributes.description: Classification of the internal order by business function for cost-of-sales accounting and segment reporting (e.g., Operations, Maintenance, Administration, Sales).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Functional Area Configuration

attributes.name: long_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative describing the scope, purpose, and business justification for the internal order, including work location, asset references, and regulatory drivers.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Master Data

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who last modified the internal order master record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the internal order master record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format with timezone.

attributes.name: order_category
attributes.description: Business classification of the activity being tracked: planned outage repairs, storm restoration events, vegetation management campaigns, regulatory compliance initiatives, customer-funded projects, asset replacement programs, grid modernization efforts, or other activities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: planned_outage|storm_restoration|vegetation_management|regulatory_compliance|customer_project|asset_replacement|grid_modernization|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Energy Utilities Internal Order Classification Standard

attributes.name: order_number
attributes.description: Business-facing alphanumeric identifier for the internal order, used in work requests, cost reports, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Master Data

attributes.name: order_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the internal order: created (initial setup), released (active for posting), technically complete (work finished, final costs pending), closed (settled and archived), or locked (posting blocked for corrections).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Status Management

attributes.name: order_type
attributes.description: Classification of the internal order by accounting treatment: overhead (O&M expense), investment (CAPEX capitalization), accrual (period-end allocation), statistical (non-financial tracking), or settlement (cost redistribution).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Order Type Configuration

attributes.name: planned_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when work on the internal order activity is planned to be completed, used for milestone tracking and settlement scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Dates

attributes.name: planned_start_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date when work on the internal order activity is planned to begin, used for resource planning and project scheduling.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Dates

attributes.name: rab_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether costs accumulated on this internal order are eligible for inclusion in the Regulatory Asset Base (RAB) for rate-of-return calculations and rate case filings.
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: requesting_department
