attributes.description: Name or code of the business department that initiated the internal order request (e.g., Transmission Operations, Distribution Maintenance, Regulatory Affairs).

attributes.name: settled_cost_amount
attributes.description: Total costs that have been settled (distributed) from this internal order to receiving cost objects, used to track settlement completeness and reconcile order balances.

attributes.name: settlement_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (YYYY-MM format) in which internal order costs are settled to receiving cost objects, used for period-end closing and financial reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Period Configuration

attributes.name: settlement_receiver_type
attributes.description: Type of cost object that receives settled costs from this internal order: GL account (direct expense posting), cost center (overhead allocation), asset (capitalization), WBS element (project assignment), or profitability segment (CO-PA).

attributes.name: settlement_rule_profile
attributes.description: Configuration key defining how costs accumulated on this internal order are settled (distributed) to receiving cost objects such as GL accounts, cost centers, assets, or WBS elements at period-end.

attributes.name: short_description
attributes.description: Brief title or summary of the internal order activity, typically 40-60 characters, used in reports and work order references.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Master Data

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this internal order is subject to SOX financial controls and audit requirements, triggering additional approval workflows and documentation retention.

attributes.name: system_status
attributes.description: SAP system-controlled status codes concatenated as a string (e.g., CRTD REL SETC TECO CLSD), reflecting automated status transitions based on business transactions.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO System Status Configuration

attributes.name: technical_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the internal order was set to technically complete status, preventing further primary cost postings while allowing settlement and final adjustments.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Internal Order Status Management

attributes.name: user_status
attributes.description: User-defined status value from a configured status profile, enabling business-specific workflow states such as Approved, In Progress, Pending Review, or Rejected.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO User Status Profile Configuration

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Difference between actual costs and budget amount (actual minus budget), used for cost control reporting and management variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget vs Actual Reporting

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: SAP user ID of the person who created the internal order master record in the system.

products.name: regulatory_asset
products.description: Regulatory asset base (RAB) master representing both individual regulatory assets/liabilities and the periodic RAB valuation roll-forward. Individual asset attributes: regulatory asset type (storm costs, pension, environmental remediation, deferred fuel, CWIP), authorization order reference, amortization period, carrying amount, and rate recovery status. RAB valuation attributes: valuation date, opening RAB, CAPEX additions, depreciation charge, disposals, inflation indexation, closing RAB, regulatory jurisdiction, and allowed return amount. Core to rate case financial models, revenue requirement calculations, and PUC/FERC rate proceedings. SSOT for all regulatory assets, deferred cost recovery items, and the net asset base on which the utility earns its regulated return.
products.reference: FERC Account 182 / ASC 980 Regulatory Assets

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory asset or liability record. Primary key for the regulatory asset base (RAB) master.

attributes.name: control_area_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.control_area. Business justification: Regulatory assets (deferred storm costs, stranded costs) are often jurisdiction-specific and must be tracked by control area for rate recovery, FERC reporting, state PUC filings, and amortization allo

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the cost center responsible for the originating costs or credits that created this regulatory asset or liability.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the general ledger account in SAP S/4HANA FI where this regulatory asset or liability is recorded.

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: Plant-level regulatory assets (deferred major maintenance, storm costs). Required for FERC account 182.3 tracking and rate recovery.

attributes.name: accrued_carrying_cost
attributes.description: Cumulative carrying costs (interest or return) accrued on the regulatory asset balance, calculated using the authorized rate of return or weighted average cost of capital (WACC).
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Orders, FERC Orders

attributes.name: allowed_return_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of return on equity (ROE) and debt return that the utility is allowed to earn on this regulatory asset base component during the period, calculated as RAB × WACC.

attributes.name: amortization_end_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date on which the regulatory asset or liability will be fully amortized and recovered, based on the authorized amortization period.

attributes.name: amortization_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months over which the regulatory asset or liability is authorized to be amortized and recovered through customer rates.

attributes.name: amortization_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which amortization and rate recovery of the regulatory asset or liability began.

attributes.name: asset_liability_indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether this record represents a regulatory asset (deferred cost recoverable from customers) or a regulatory liability (deferred credit owed to customers).

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory asset or liability. Storm costs, pension obligations, environmental remediation, deferred fuel costs, construction work in progress (CWIP), deferred tax, regulatory liability, or other. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: storm_costs|pension_obligation|environmental_remediation|deferred_fuel|cwip|deferred_tax|regulatory_liability|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory authority issued the order authorizing this regulatory asset or liability treatment.

attributes.name: authorization_order_number
attributes.description: Public Utility Commission (PUC) or FERC order number authorizing the deferral and recovery of this regulatory asset, or the refund mechanism for this regulatory liability.

attributes.name: authorized_return_rate
attributes.description: Annual rate of return authorized by the regulatory body for calculating carrying costs on the regulatory asset balance. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0725 for 7.25%).
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Orders, FERC Orders

attributes.name: capex_additions
attributes.description: Capital expenditure additions to the regulatory asset base during the valuation period, representing new plant and equipment placed in service.

attributes.name: carrying_amount
attributes.description: Current net book value of the regulatory asset or liability after amortization, adjustments, and accrued carrying costs. This is the balance sheet amount.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts, GAAP ASC 980

attributes.name: closing_rab_amount
attributes.description: Closing balance of the regulatory asset base at the end of the valuation period, after all additions, depreciation, disposals, and indexation adjustments.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory asset record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_amortization
attributes.description: Total amount of the regulatory asset or liability that has been amortized and recovered through customer rates to date.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this record (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: depreciation_charge
attributes.description: Depreciation expense charged against the regulatory asset base during the valuation period, reducing the net book value of rate base assets.

attributes.name: disallowed_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the regulatory asset that was disallowed by the regulator during prudence review and cannot be recovered from customers.

attributes.name: disposals_retirements
attributes.description: Net book value of assets retired or disposed from the regulatory asset base during the valuation period.

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory asset or liability record ceased to be effective. Null for currently active records.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which this regulatory asset or liability record became effective and active in the system.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for the regulatory asset or liability (e.g., 182.3 for Other Regulatory Assets, 254 for Other Regulatory Liabilities).

attributes.name: inflation_indexation
attributes.description: Inflation adjustment applied to the regulatory asset base in jurisdictions that use indexed RAB methodologies (e.g., RPI or CPI indexation). Zero in non-indexed jurisdictions.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this regulatory asset record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this regulatory asset record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: monthly_amortization_amount
attributes.description: Fixed monthly amortization amount recovered through customer rates, calculated as the original amount divided by the amortization period.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes providing additional context, regulatory guidance, or special conditions related to this regulatory asset or liability.

attributes.name: opening_rab_amount
attributes.description: Opening balance of the regulatory asset base at the beginning of the valuation period, before CAPEX additions, depreciation, and disposals.

attributes.name: original_amount
attributes.description: Original principal amount of the regulatory asset or liability at the time of initial recognition, in the reporting currency.

attributes.name: prudence_review_status
attributes.description: Status of the regulatory prudence review for this asset: pending review, approved for full recovery, partially approved (some costs disallowed), or disallowed.

attributes.name: rab_inclusion_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset is included in the regulatory asset base (RAB) for calculating the allowed return on equity (ROE) and revenue requirement.

attributes.name: rab_valuation_date
attributes.description: As-of date for the RAB valuation roll-forward calculation. Typically the end of a reporting period (month-end, quarter-end, or year-end).

attributes.name: rate_recovery_status
attributes.description: Current status of rate recovery for this regulatory asset or liability: not started, in progress (actively being recovered), completed (fully recovered), suspended, or denied by regulator.

attributes.name: rate_schedule_reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific rate schedule or tariff rider through which this regulatory asset or liability is being recovered from or refunded to customers.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the regulatory asset or liability (e.g., Storm Cost Recovery 2023, Deferred Fuel Costs Q4 2024, Environmental Remediation Reserve).

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the regulatory asset or liability, used in rate case filings and regulatory correspondence. Format: RA-NNNNNNNN.

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the regulatory asset: pending regulatory approval, approved for recovery, actively being recovered through rates, fully amortized, written off, or suspended.

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction
attributes.description: Regulatory body with jurisdiction over this asset or liability (e.g., California PUC, FERC, Texas PUC, New York PSC). Determines applicable accounting and rate recovery rules.

attributes.name: roe_rate
attributes.description: Authorized return on equity rate used in the revenue requirement calculation for this regulatory asset. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0950 for 9.50%).
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Orders, FERC Orders

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this regulatory asset is subject to Sarbanes-Oxley Act internal control requirements due to materiality or financial statement impact.

attributes.name: unamortized_balance
attributes.description: Remaining principal balance of the regulatory asset or liability that has not yet been amortized or recovered through customer rates.

attributes.name: wacc_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) Rate
attributes.description: Weighted average cost of capital authorized by the regulator for calculating the allowed return on this regulatory asset. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0675 for 6.75%).

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this regulatory asset record in the system.

products.name: rate_case_filing
products.description: Rate case financial model and filing record submitted to PUC or FERC. Captures filing date, docket number, test year, requested revenue requirement, allowed ROE, WACC, rate base (RAB), proposed rate schedules, intervenor positions, settlement terms, and final order outcome. SSOT for regulatory financial proceedings and revenue requirement determinations.
products.reference: PUC/FERC Rate Case Docket

attributes.name: rate_case_filing_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the rate case filing record. Primary key for the rate case filing entity.

attributes.name: irp_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.irp_scenario. Business justification: Rate cases reference specific IRP scenarios to justify revenue requirements and capital investments. Test year assumptions must align with filed IRP forecasts. Essential for regulatory rate case prepa

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: Rate cases reference specific plants for cost-of-service calculations, test year data compilation, and rate base valuation. Essential for regulatory proceedings.

attributes.name: primary_regulatory_asset_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.regulatory_asset.regulatory_asset_id — Rate case filings reference the RAB valuation as a core input to revenue requirement calculations. This FK links the regulatory proceeding to the asset base on which return is earned.

attributes.name: rate_regulatory_asset_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.regulatory_asset.regulatory_asset_id — Rate case filings include regulatory assets (deferred costs) in the revenue requirement. The filing must reference which regulatory assets are being recovered.

attributes.name: annual_revenue_impact
attributes.description: Estimated annual revenue impact to the utility resulting from the approved rate changes, calculated as the difference between approved and current revenue levels.
attributes.references: State PUC Final Order; FERC Final Order

attributes.name: approved_rate_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Rate Base (Regulatory Asset Base - RAB)
attributes.description: Total value of utility plant and other assets approved by the regulatory commission for earning a return, which may differ from the requested rate base due to disallowances or adjustments.
attributes.references: FERC Final Order; State PUC Final Order

attributes.name: approved_revenue_requirement
attributes.description: Total annual revenue requirement approved by the regulatory commission in the final order, which may differ from the requested amount due to adjustments and disallowances.
attributes.references: FERC Final Order; State PUC Final Order

attributes.name: approved_roe
attributes.description: Return on equity percentage approved by the regulatory commission in the final order. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0950 for 9.50%).

attributes.name: approved_wacc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Approved Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)
attributes.description: Weighted average cost of capital approved by the regulatory commission in the final order. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0675 for 6.75%).
attributes.references: FERC Final Order; State PUC Final Order

attributes.name: capital_structure_debt_ratio
attributes.description: Proportion of debt in the approved capital structure used for rate-making purposes. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.4800 for 48%).

attributes.name: capital_structure_equity_ratio
attributes.description: Proportion of equity in the approved capital structure used for rate-making purposes. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5200 for 52%).

attributes.name: cost_of_debt

attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: customer_class_coverage
attributes.description: Customer classes affected by this rate case filing (e.g., residential, commercial, industrial, or all classes). Pipe-separated list if multiple classes.

attributes.name: depreciation_expense

attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Depreciation Guidelines

attributes.name: docket_number

attributes.references: FERC Filing Requirements; State PUC Procedural Rules

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the approved rates become effective and are implemented for customer billing.
attributes.references: FERC Final Order; State PUC Final Order

attributes.name: filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the rate case application was officially filed with the regulatory commission.
attributes.references: FERC Filing Requirements; State PUC Procedural Rules

attributes.name: filing_document_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL to the official rate case filing documents, testimony, exhibits, and supporting materials submitted to the regulatory commission.
attributes.references: FERC eFiling System; State PUC Document Management System

attributes.name: filing_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the rate case filing within the regulatory review process. attributes.name: filing_type

attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: final_order_date
attributes.description: Date on which the regulatory commission issued its final order or decision on the rate case.
attributes.references: FERC Final Order; State PUC Final Order

attributes.name: final_order_outcome

attributes.references: FERC Final Order; State PUC Final Order

attributes.name: hearing_scheduled_date

attributes.references: State PUC Procedural Rules; FERC Administrative Procedures

attributes.name: intervenor_count
attributes.description: Number of intervenor parties formally participating in the rate case proceeding (e.g., consumer advocates, industrial customer groups, environmental organizations).
attributes.references: State PUC Procedural Rules; FERC Administrative Procedures

attributes.name: intervenor_positions_summary

attributes.references: State PUC Procedural Rules; FERC Administrative Procedures

attributes.name: jurisdiction

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this rate case filing record was last modified or updated in the system.

attributes.name: operating_expenses
attributes.description: Total annual operating expenses included in the revenue requirement calculation, covering operations and maintenance costs, administrative expenses, and customer service costs.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: rate_design_methodology
attributes.description: Description of the rate design methodology proposed or approved in the rate case (e.g., cost-of-service, performance-based ratemaking, decoupling mechanism, time-of-use rates).
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Design Guidelines; FERC Rate Design Policy

attributes.name: rate_increase_percentage
attributes.description: Overall percentage increase in customer rates resulting from the approved revenue requirement. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0350 for 3.50% increase). Negative values indicate rate decreases.
attributes.references: State PUC Final Order; FERC Final Order

attributes.name: regulatory_commission
attributes.description: Name of the regulatory body with jurisdiction over this rate case (e.g., Federal Energy Regulatory Commission, California Public Utilities Commission, New York Public Service Commission).

attributes.name: requested_rate_base
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requested Rate Base (Regulatory Asset Base - RAB)
attributes.description: Total value of utility plant and other assets on which the utility requests to earn a return, also known as Regulatory Asset Base (RAB). Includes net plant in service, working capital, and other rate base components.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: requested_revenue_requirement
attributes.description: Total annual revenue requirement requested by the utility in the rate case filing, representing the sum of operating expenses, depreciation, taxes, and return on rate base.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: requested_roe
attributes.description: Return on equity percentage requested by the utility, representing the rate of return on shareholder equity investment. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1050 for 10.50%).
attributes.references: FERC Policy Statement on ROE; State PUC ROE Determination Guidelines

attributes.name: requested_wacc
attributes.business_glossary_term: Requested Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC)
attributes.description: Weighted average cost of capital requested by the utility, representing the blended cost of debt and equity financing. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0725 for 7.25%).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: service_territory
attributes.description: Geographic service territory or region covered by this rate case filing (e.g., state name, county list, or service area designation).

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the settlement agreement was executed by the parties, if applicable.
attributes.references: State PUC Procedural Rules; FERC Settlement Guidelines

attributes.name: settlement_reached_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a settlement agreement was reached among parties prior to final commission decision (True if settlement reached, False otherwise).
attributes.references: State PUC Procedural Rules; FERC Settlement Guidelines

attributes.name: settlement_terms_summary
attributes.description: High-level summary of key settlement terms and conditions agreed upon by the parties, including revenue requirement, ROE, rate base adjustments, and other material provisions.
attributes.references: State PUC Settlement Agreement; FERC Settlement Agreement

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this rate case filing is subject to SOX financial reporting controls and audit requirements (True for publicly-traded utilities, False otherwise).

attributes.name: tax_expense
attributes.description: Total tax expense included in the revenue requirement, including federal and state income taxes, property taxes, and other applicable taxes.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; IRS Tax Code; State Tax Regulations

attributes.name: test_year_end_date
attributes.description: Ending date of the test year period used as the basis for revenue requirement calculations and rate design in the filing.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: test_year_start_date
attributes.description: Beginning date of the test year period used as the basis for revenue requirement calculations and rate design in the filing.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Case Guidelines

attributes.name: test_year_type
attributes.description: Classification of the test year methodology used in the rate case (historical actual data, future projected data, or hybrid approach combining historical with known adjustments).

products.name: rab_valuation
products.description: Regulatory Asset Base valuation record representing the net value of utility assets on which a regulated return is earned. Captures valuation date, opening RAB, CAPEX additions, depreciation charge, disposals, inflation indexation, closing RAB, regulatory jurisdiction, and allowed return amount. Core input to revenue requirement calculations in PUC and FERC rate proceedings.
products.reference: PUC/FERC Rate Base (RAB) Calculation

attributes.name: rab_valuation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the regulatory asset base valuation record.

attributes.name: fixed_asset_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.fixed_asset.fixed_asset_id — RAB valuations are computed from the net book value of regulated fixed assets. The RAB must reference the underlying asset base to support rate case filings and PUC audits.

attributes.name: irp_scenario_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.irp_scenario. Business justification: RAB valuations are calculated within IRP scenario contexts for different planning futures. Regulatory asset base projections depend on scenario-specific capex and depreciation assumptions for long-ter

attributes.name: power_plant_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to generation.power_plant. Business justification: RAB valuations are performed at the plant level for regulatory returns, annual RAB roll-forward, and allowed return calculations. Critical for UK/international regulatory models.

attributes.name: rate_case_filing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.rate_case_filing. Business justification: RAB valuations are prepared for and submitted as part of rate case filings to regulatory commissions. The rate_case_docket_number (STRING) should be replaced with FK to rate_case_filing.rate_case_fili

attributes.name: accumulated_deferred_income_tax_amount
attributes.description: The accumulated deferred income tax liability that is deducted from the RAB, representing the tax benefit of accelerated depreciation and other timing differences between book and tax accounting.
attributes.references: FERC Account 282 (Accumulated Deferred Income Taxes); IRS Tax Code; State PUC Tax Normalization

attributes.name: allowed_return_amount
attributes.description: The total dollar amount of return the utility is permitted to earn on the closing RAB, calculated as closing RAB multiplied by the allowed WACC or ROE. This is a key component of the revenue requirement.
attributes.references: FERC Revenue Requirement Calculations; State PUC Rate Case Orders

attributes.name: allowed_roe_percentage
attributes.description: The regulatory-approved return on equity percentage that the utility is permitted to earn on the equity portion of its RAB, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0950 for 9.50%).
attributes.references: FERC ROE Policy Statements; State PUC Rate Orders

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the regulatory commission formally approved this RAB valuation and associated revenue requirement.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Orders; State PUC Commission Orders

attributes.name: asset_category_code
attributes.description: The functional classification of assets included in this RAB valuation (generation, transmission, distribution, general plant, intangible assets, or common/shared assets).
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts (Plant Accounts 300-399); State PUC Asset Classification

attributes.name: asset_disposal_amount
attributes.description: The net book value of assets retired, sold, or otherwise removed from the rate base during the valuation period, including plant retirements and decommissioning.
attributes.references: FERC Account 108 (Accumulated Depreciation); State PUC Asset Retirement Guidelines

attributes.name: audit_trail_reference
attributes.description: A reference identifier linking this RAB valuation to supporting audit documentation, workpapers, and regulatory filings for compliance and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls; FERC Audit Requirements; State PUC Audit Standards

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: The business segment or division code (e.g., electric, gas, water) to which this RAB valuation is allocated, used for segment reporting and cost allocation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Business Area Structure; FERC Segment Reporting

attributes.name: capex_additions_amount
attributes.description: The total value of capital investments added to the rate base during the valuation period, including new generation, transmission, distribution assets, and major upgrades placed into service.
attributes.references: FERC Account 101 (Electric Plant in Service); State PUC CAPEX Guidelines

attributes.name: closing_rab_amount
attributes.description: The net book value of rate base assets at the end of the valuation period, calculated as opening RAB plus CAPEX additions minus depreciation minus disposals plus inflation adjustments. This is the base on which the allowed return is calculated.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Base Methodologies

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The internal company or legal entity code for the utility operating company to which this RAB valuation applies, used for multi-entity consolidation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Company Code Structure; Internal Corporate Governance

attributes.name: construction_work_in_progress_amount
attributes.description: The value of capital projects under construction that are included in the RAB before they are placed into service, subject to regulatory approval for CWIP-in-rate-base treatment.
attributes.references: FERC Account 107 (Construction Work in Progress); State PUC CWIP Policies

attributes.name: cost_of_debt_percentage
attributes.description: The weighted average interest rate on the utility's debt obligations, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0450 for 4.50%). Used to calculate the debt component of WACC.
attributes.references: FERC Cost of Capital Methodologies; State PUC Debt Cost Determinations

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who created this RAB valuation record in the financial system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this RAB valuation record was first created in the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this RAB valuation record (typically USD for US utilities).

attributes.name: customer_advances_amount
attributes.description: The amount of customer contributions and advances for construction that are deducted from the RAB, representing funds provided by customers for line extensions and service installations.
attributes.references: FERC Account 252 (Customer Advances for Construction); State PUC Customer Contribution Policies

attributes.name: debt_ratio_percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of the RAB financed by debt capital, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 for 50%). Used in conjunction with equity ratio to calculate WACC.
attributes.references: FERC Capital Structure Guidelines; State PUC Capital Structure Determinations

attributes.name: depreciation_charge_amount
attributes.description: The total depreciation expense recognized during the valuation period, reducing the RAB in accordance with approved depreciation rates and asset useful lives.
attributes.references: FERC Account 403 (Depreciation Expense); State PUC Depreciation Studies

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this RAB valuation ceases to be effective for rate-making purposes, typically the end of a rate period or the start of a new rate case.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Schedules; State PUC Rate Effective Dates

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this RAB valuation becomes effective for rate-making purposes, typically the start of a new rate period.
attributes.references: FERC Rate Schedules; State PUC Rate Effective Dates

attributes.name: equity_ratio_percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of the RAB financed by equity capital, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.5000 for 50%). Used in conjunction with debt ratio to calculate WACC.
attributes.references: FERC Capital Structure Guidelines; State PUC Capital Structure Determinations

attributes.name: inflation_indexation_amount
attributes.description: The adjustment to RAB for inflation indexation where applicable, used in jurisdictions that apply real-terms or indexed RAB methodologies (common in UK-style regulatory frameworks, less common in US FERC jurisdictions).

attributes.name: jurisdiction_name
attributes.description: The full name of the regulatory jurisdiction or commission (e.g., 'California Public Utilities Commission', 'Federal Energy Regulatory Commission').

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user
attributes.description: The user ID or name of the person who last modified this RAB valuation record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this RAB valuation record was last modified in the system.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Audit Trail; Internal Data Governance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text field for additional comments, explanations, or context regarding this RAB valuation, including regulatory adjustments, special circumstances, or variance explanations.

attributes.name: opening_rab_amount
attributes.description: The net book value of rate base assets at the beginning of the valuation period, representing the starting point for RAB roll-forward calculations.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts; State PUC Rate Base Methodologies

attributes.name: regulatory_asset_amount
attributes.description: The value of regulatory assets (deferred costs approved for future recovery) included in the RAB, such as deferred storm costs, pension obligations, or environmental remediation expenses.
attributes.references: FERC Account 182.3 (Other Regulatory Assets); State PUC Regulatory Asset Treatment

attributes.name: regulatory_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The regulatory authority governing this RAB valuation (FERC for interstate transmission, State PUC for retail distribution, ISO/RTO for market operations, or multi-jurisdictional for utilities operating across multiple territories).
attributes.references: FERC; State Public Utility Commissions; NERC

attributes.name: regulatory_liability_amount
attributes.description: The value of regulatory liabilities (deferred credits to be returned to customers) that reduce the RAB, such as excess deferred taxes or over-collected revenues.
attributes.references: FERC Account 254 (Other Regulatory Liabilities); State PUC Regulatory Liability Treatment

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this RAB valuation record is subject to SOX internal controls and audit requirements (True for publicly traded utilities, False otherwise).
attributes.references: Sarbanes-Oxley Act Section 404; PCAOB Auditing Standards

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The date on which this RAB valuation is calculated and recorded, typically aligned with regulatory reporting periods (annual or rate case filing dates).
attributes.references: FERC Form 1; State PUC Rate Case Filing Requirements

attributes.name: valuation_method_code
attributes.description: The methodology used to value the RAB (historical cost, fair value, replacement cost, inflation-indexed, or hybrid approach), as prescribed by the regulatory jurisdiction.
attributes.references: FERC Valuation Methodologies; State PUC Rate Base Valuation Standards

attributes.name: valuation_status
attributes.description: The current status of this RAB valuation in the regulatory review and approval process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: DRAFT|SUBMITTED|UNDER_REVIEW|APPROVED|REJECTED|AMENDED|FINAL — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: State PUC Rate Case Procedures; FERC Filing Requirements

attributes.name: wacc_percentage
attributes.business_glossary_term: Weighted Average Cost of Capital (WACC) Percentage
attributes.description: The blended cost of capital (debt and equity) approved by the regulator for calculating the allowed return on the RAB, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0725 for 7.25%).
attributes.references: FERC Cost of Capital Methodologies; State PUC WACC Determinations

attributes.name: working_capital_allowance_amount
attributes.description: The amount of working capital included in the RAB to cover the utility's operational cash flow needs, typically calculated as a percentage of operating expenses or using a lead-lag study.
attributes.references: FERC Working Capital Methodologies; State PUC Working Capital Allowances

products.name: intercompany_transaction
products.description: Intercompany financial transaction record between legal entities within the utility holding company group (e.g., regulated T&D utility, unregulated generation subsidiary, shared services company, fuel procurement entity). Captures sending and receiving company codes, transaction type (management fee, shared service allocation, intercompany loan, dividend, cost recharge, power purchase), amount, transfer pricing method, netting status, elimination flag for consolidation, and SOX/FERC affiliate transaction compliance reference. Supports consolidated financial reporting, FERC affiliate transaction disclosure (18 CFR 35.39), and cross-subsidy prevention controls.
products.reference: SAP FI Intercompany Posting / FERC Affiliate Transaction Rules

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the intercompany transaction record. Primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Posting Standard

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions can be assigned to cost centers for tracking intercompany charges by organizational unit. The cost_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to cost_center.cost_center_id.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the person or role who approved the intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Intercompany transactions post to GL accounts for intercompany receivables, payables, and revenue/expense. The gl_account_code (STRING) should be replaced with FK to gl_account.gl_account_id.

attributes.name: intercompany_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Intercompany transactions generate journal entries in both sending and receiving company codes. The link to the GL posting is required for elimination processing and consolidated reporting.

attributes.name: primary_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Intercompany transactions generate journal entries for both sending and receiving entities. Required for consolidated financial reporting and elimination entries.

attributes.name: profit_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.profit_center. Business justification: Intercompany transactions can be assigned to profit centers for internal management reporting and segment analysis. The profit_center (STRING) should be replaced with FK to profit_center.profit_center

attributes.name: reversed_transaction_intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original intercompany transaction ID that this transaction reverses, if applicable.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany transaction was approved by the designated authority.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the intercompany transaction in the workflow.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cross_subsidy_prevention_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) marking transactions that require special scrutiny to ensure regulated utility customers do not subsidize unregulated business activities.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amount (e.g., USD, EUR, CAD).

attributes.name: elimination_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) specifying whether this transaction should be eliminated during consolidated financial reporting to prevent double-counting.

attributes.name: ferc_account_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Account Code
attributes.description: FERC Uniform System of Accounts code for regulatory financial reporting and compliance.
attributes.references: FERC Uniform System of Accounts 18 CFR Part 101

attributes.name: ferc_affiliate_transaction_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Affiliate Transaction Flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) identifying whether this transaction must be disclosed under FERC affiliate transaction rules to prevent cross-subsidization.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year when the transaction is recorded.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which the intercompany transaction is recorded for financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_description
attributes.description: Detailed textual description of the intercompany transaction, including business purpose and context.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified the intercompany transaction record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the intercompany transaction record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: Net monetary value of the intercompany transaction after taxes and adjustments.

attributes.name: netting_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the intercompany transaction has been netted with offsetting transactions for settlement efficiency.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms agreed upon for the intercompany transaction (e.g., Net 30, Due on Receipt, Quarterly).

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany transaction was posted to the general ledger in the financial system.

attributes.name: receiving_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the legal entity receiving the intercompany transaction within the utility holding company group.

attributes.name: receiving_company_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the receiving company entity (e.g., shared services company, fuel procurement entity).

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: Reference to the originating document, invoice, or agreement that supports this intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) marking whether this transaction is a reversal or correction of a previous intercompany transaction.

attributes.name: sending_company_code
attributes.description: Company code of the legal entity originating or sending the intercompany transaction within the utility holding company group.

attributes.name: sending_company_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the sending company entity (e.g., regulated T&D utility, unregulated generation subsidiary).

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date when the intercompany transaction was settled or cash was transferred between entities.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the transaction in the source system for traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the source system from which the intercompany transaction originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP).

attributes.name: sox_control_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) marking whether this transaction is subject to SOX internal control requirements and audit trails.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount associated with the intercompany transaction, if applicable.

attributes.name: transaction_amount
attributes.description: Gross monetary value of the intercompany transaction before any adjustments or taxes.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Business date when the intercompany transaction occurred or was executed.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique transaction number or document number assigned to this intercompany transaction for tracking and reference purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the intercompany transaction in the financial workflow. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|posted|settled|reversed|cancelled — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intercompany transaction indicating the nature of the financial exchange between legal entities. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: management_fee|shared_service_allocation|intercompany_loan|dividend|cost_recharge|power_purchase|asset_transfer|royalty|interest_payment|capital_contribution — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: transfer_pricing_method
attributes.description: Method used to determine the pricing of the intercompany transaction to ensure arms-length compliance and regulatory adherence.
attributes.references: IRS Transfer Pricing Guidelines IRC Section 482

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created the intercompany transaction record in the system.

products.name: tax_provision
products.description: Corporate income tax provision record capturing current and deferred tax components per legal entity and fiscal period. Records pre-tax income, statutory tax rate, effective tax rate, current tax expense, deferred tax asset and liability movements (ADIT), uncertain tax positions (FIN 48), and regulatory flow-through vs. normalized accounting treatment per FERC/PUC requirements. Includes excess deferred income tax (EDIT) tracking per Tax Cuts and Jobs Act provisions. Supports SOX tax controls, FERC Form 1 tax schedules, and rate case tax normalization filings.
products.reference: ASC 740 Income Tax Provision / FERC Tax Normalization

attributes.name: tax_provision_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the corporate income tax provision record. Primary key for the tax provision entity.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user who last modified this tax provision record.

attributes.name: legal_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the legal entity for which this tax provision is recorded. Supports multi-entity consolidated financial reporting.

attributes.name: primary_tax_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or employee who prepared this tax provision record.

attributes.name: reviewer_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the user or employee who reviewed and approved this tax provision record.

attributes.name: sox_control_id
attributes.description: The SOX control identifier associated with this tax provision record for internal control testing and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: tax_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Tax provisions generate journal entries for current and deferred tax expense postings. Required for tax close process and FERC Form 1 tax schedules.

attributes.name: to_journal_entry_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.journal_entry.journal_entry_id — Tax provisions are posted as journal entries for current tax expense, deferred tax movements, and ADIT adjustments. This FK enables tax-to-GL reconciliation and FERC Form 1 tax schedule preparation.

attributes.name: adit_balance
attributes.description: The net accumulated deferred income tax balance (DTL minus DTA) used in regulatory rate base calculations per FERC requirements.

attributes.name: adit_movement
attributes.description: The change in ADIT balance during the fiscal period, critical for regulatory asset base (RAB) adjustments and rate case filings.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this tax provision record was formally approved by the reviewer.

attributes.name: audit_status
attributes.description: The current status of external audit review for this tax provision record.

attributes.name: auditor_notes
attributes.description: Notes or comments from external auditors regarding this tax provision record, including any adjustments or findings.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax provision record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: The three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which all monetary amounts in this tax provision record are denominated (e.g., USD).

attributes.name: current_tax_expense
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense that is currently payable to tax authorities for the fiscal period.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_asset
attributes.description: The cumulative balance of deferred tax assets arising from temporary differences, net operating losses, and tax credits that will reduce future tax payments.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_expense
attributes.description: The portion of total income tax expense attributable to changes in deferred tax assets and liabilities for the fiscal period.

attributes.name: deferred_tax_liability
attributes.description: The cumulative balance of deferred tax liabilities arising from temporary differences that will result in future tax payments.

attributes.name: effective_tax_rate
attributes.description: The actual tax rate after adjustments for permanent differences, credits, and other items, expressed as a decimal. Key metric for FERC Form 1 and rate case filings.

attributes.name: excess_adit_amortization
attributes.business_glossary_term: Excess Accumulated Deferred Income Tax (ADIT) Amortization
attributes.description: The amount of excess ADIT amortized during the fiscal period per average rate assumption method (ARAM) or other IRS-approved method.

attributes.name: excess_adit_balance
attributes.business_glossary_term: Excess Accumulated Deferred Income Tax (ADIT) Balance
attributes.description: The excess deferred income tax balance arising from the Tax Cuts and Jobs Act rate reduction, requiring amortization per IRS normalization rules.

attributes.name: ferc_form1_schedule_reference
attributes.business_glossary_term: Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) Form 1 Schedule Reference
attributes.description: The FERC Form 1 schedule number(s) to which this tax provision record maps for regulatory reporting purposes (e.g., Schedule 261, 262, 263).

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year for which the tax provision applies.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year for which the tax provision is calculated and recorded.

attributes.name: flow_through_treatment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax provision uses flow-through accounting treatment (True) or normalized accounting treatment (False) per regulatory requirements.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this tax provision record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: normalized_treatment_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the tax provision uses normalized accounting treatment (True) where tax benefits are deferred and amortized over the life of the related asset.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form notes or comments regarding this tax provision record, including explanations of significant adjustments or unusual items.

attributes.name: permanent_difference_adjustment
attributes.description: The net adjustment to tax expense for permanent book-tax differences that do not reverse over time (e.g., non-deductible expenses, tax-exempt income).

attributes.name: pre_tax_income
attributes.description: Income before income taxes for the legal entity and fiscal period, serving as the base for tax provision calculation.

attributes.name: provision_date
attributes.description: The date on which the tax provision was calculated and recorded in the financial system.

attributes.name: provision_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the tax provision record indicating its stage in the financial close and reporting process.

attributes.name: puc_filing_reference
attributes.description: The state PUC filing or docket number associated with this tax provision for rate case or regulatory reporting purposes.

attributes.name: rab_impact_amount
attributes.description: The impact of this tax provision on the regulatory asset base calculation, primarily driven by ADIT adjustments that reduce rate base.

attributes.name: rate_case_year
attributes.description: The year of the rate case filing for which this tax provision data is used in revenue requirement calculations and ROE filings.

attributes.name: source_document_reference
attributes.description: The unique document identifier in the source system that generated this tax provision record for audit trail and reconciliation purposes.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name of the source system from which this tax provision record originated (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Oracle ERP).

attributes.name: sox_certification_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this tax provision record has been reviewed and certified under SOX internal control procedures (True) or not (False).

attributes.name: statutory_tax_rate
attributes.description: The statutory federal and state combined income tax rate applicable to the legal entity for the fiscal period, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2100 for 21%).

attributes.name: tax_credit_amount
attributes.description: The total tax credits claimed during the fiscal period, including renewable energy credits, research credits, and other federal and state credits.

attributes.name: temporary_difference_adjustment
attributes.description: The net adjustment to deferred tax expense for temporary book-tax differences that will reverse in future periods (e.g., depreciation timing differences).

attributes.name: total_tax_expense
attributes.description: The sum of current and deferred tax expense for the fiscal period, representing the total income tax provision recorded in the financial statements.

attributes.name: uncertain_tax_position_reserve
attributes.description: The reserve for uncertain tax positions per FIN 48 (ASC 740-10) representing tax benefits that may not be sustained upon examination by tax authorities.

attributes.name: utp_movement

products.name: regulatory_asset_rate_case_inclusion
products.description: This association product represents the inclusion and presentation of regulatory assets and liabilities in rate case filings submitted to regulatory commissions (PUC or FERC). Each record captures the requested and approved recovery amounts, amortization periods, carrying cost rates, and regulatory outcomes for a specific regulatory asset within a specific rate case proceeding. This is a core business entity in utility regulatory accounting, actively managed by rate case analysts and regulatory accountants throughout the rate case lifecycle from filing preparation through commission approval and implementation.. Existence Justification: In utility regulatory accounting, a single regulatory asset can be presented in multiple rate case filings over time (initial authorization, subsequent rate cases for continued recovery, or re-authorization after regulatory changes), and each rate case filing includes multiple regulatory assets in its revenue requirement calculation. Rate case analysts actively manage the inclusion of each asset in each filing, tracking requested vs. approved amounts, amortization periods, carrying cost rates, and commission rulings. This is a core operational business process with its own lifecycle (preparation, filing, testimony, commission review, approval/disallowance, implementation) that is tracked in regulatory accounting systems.

products.name: project_cost_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the cost allocation agreement between capital projects and cost centers in SAP S/4HANA PS/CO integration. It captures the negotiated budget allocations, actual cost tracking, and variance analysis for cross-organizational capital project funding. Each record links one CAPEX project to one cost center with allocation percentages, budget amounts, and actual spend that exist only in the context of this funding relationship. This is a core operational entity in utility capital project management where projects are funded by multiple organizational units and cost centers contribute to multiple capital initiatives.. Existence Justification: In utility capital project management, projects are routinely funded by multiple cost centers (e.g., a substation upgrade funded by transmission operations, engineering services, and corporate IT), and cost centers contribute to multiple capital projects simultaneously. Project managers and cost center managers negotiate and actively manage these allocation agreements with specific budget amounts, approval workflows, and variance tracking. This is a core operational process in SAP PS/CO integration where the allocation itself is a managed business entity with its own lifecycle.

domains.name: interconnection
domains.description: Customer and third-party interconnection requests for distributed generation, solar installations, battery storage, EV chargers, and other BTM resources. Manages interconnection applications, technical reviews, impact studies, POI specifications, NEM agreements, queue management, and SGIP compliance for DER integration. Distinct from renewable (resource management) — focuses on the application and approval process for grid connection.

products.name: application
products.description: Master record for a customer or third-party application to interconnect a distributed energy resource (DER) — solar PV, battery storage, EV charger, CHP, wind, or other BTM resource — to the utility distribution grid. Captures applicant identity, DER technology type, proposed capacity (kW/kVA), point of interconnection (POI), service address, application tier (Level 1/2/3 or Fast Track per applicable interconnection rules), applicable regulatory framework (CPUC Rule 21, FERC Order 2023, state-specific), application date, current queue position, assigned review engineer, and overall application lifecycle status. Also manages the complete application document package — including document type (single-line diagram, site plan, equipment specification sheet, inverter datasheet, UL 1741 certification, load calculation, executed agreement, insurance certificate, permit, as-built drawing), document name, file reference, submission date, submitted by (applicant or utility), document status (received, under review, accepted, rejected, superseded), rejection reason, required resubmission deadline, and completeness determination outcome. This is the SSOT for all interconnection requests and the anchor entity for the entire interconnection domain, including full document lifecycle management for application completeness determination.

products.name: der_system
products.description: Master record for a specific distributed energy resource (DER) system proposed or approved for grid interconnection. Captures DER technology type and classification (solar PV, BESS, EV charger, CHP, fuel cell, wind, micro-hydro, diesel — replacing the former der_technology_type reference table), nameplate capacity (kW AC/DC), inverter type and certification (UL 1741 / UL 1741 SA / IEEE 1547-2018), battery storage capacity (kWh), export capability flag, generation vs. storage classification, inverter-based resource flag, behind-the-meter (BTM) flag, NEM eligibility, SGIP eligibility, equipment manufacturer and model, protective relay and protection system requirements (IEEE 1547 mandatory functions, utility-required additional protection, relay model, settings ranges, compliance verification status), installer reference, installation address, and commissioning date. Distinct from the renewable domain's resource management — this entity tracks the physical DER asset and its technical protection requirements as part of the interconnection approval process.
products.reference: IEEE 1547 DER System / SGIP DER Registration

attributes.name: resource_classification

attributes.name: sgip_eligible_flag

attributes.name: system_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DER system in the interconnection and operational process.

products.name: poi_specification
products.description: Technical specification record defining the Point of Interconnection (POI) on the utility distribution network where a DER system will connect. Captures POI location (GIS coordinates, feeder ID, transformer ID, circuit segment), voltage level (120V/240V/480V/12kV), phase configuration (single-phase/three-phase), available hosting capacity (kW) at the POI at time of application, maximum export limit (kW), anti-islanding protection requirements, interconnection equipment requirements (disconnect switch, meter socket, protective relay), and utility-assigned POI identifier. Links to the distribution network topology managed in the distribution domain.
products.reference: POI (Point of Interconnection) Technical Specification

attributes.name: primary_poi_employee_id
attributes.description: User identifier of the utility engineer who created the POI specification.

attributes.name: transformer_id

attributes.name: anti_islanding_protection_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether anti-islanding protection is required at this POI to prevent the DER from energizing a de-energized portion of the utility grid.

attributes.name: approved_date

attributes.name: circuit_segment_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific circuit segment or span where the POI is located on the distribution network.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnecting Distributed Resources with Electric Power Systems

attributes.name: communication_protocol

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: distribution_upgrades_required

attributes.name: interconnection_study_required

attributes.references: FERC Order 2006 - Standardizing Generator Interconnection Agreements and Procedures

attributes.name: maximum_export_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum allowable export power in kilowatts from the DER system to the utility grid at this POI. May be less than the DER nameplate capacity.

attributes.name: maximum_import_limit_kw
attributes.description: Maximum allowable import power in kilowatts from the utility grid to the customer premises at this POI. Relevant for battery storage and EV charging applications.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnecting Distributed Resources with Electric Power Systems

attributes.name: meter_socket_type

attributes.name: phase_configuration

attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnecting Distributed Resources with Electric Power Systems

attributes.name: poi_identifier
attributes.description: Utility-assigned unique identifier for the POI location on the distribution network. This is the externally-known business identifier used in engineering documents and interconnection agreements.

attributes.name: power_quality_monitoring_required

attributes.name: protective_relay_required

attributes.name: telemetry_required

attributes.name: voltage_regulation_capability_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DER inverter must provide voltage regulation capability (volt-VAR or volt-watt control) at the POI.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Standard for Interconnecting Distributed Resources with Electric Power Systems

products.name: technical_review
products.description: Record of the utility engineering technical review conducted for an interconnection application. Captures review type (initial completeness check, supplemental review, independent study), assigned engineer, review start and completion dates, screening criteria applied (15% rule, 100% rule, Fast Track screens per FERC Order 2023), screening pass/fail result, identified technical issues (voltage violations, thermal overloads, protection coordination conflicts, power quality concerns), required mitigation measures, and review disposition (approved, conditionally approved, requires impact study). One application may have multiple sequential technical reviews.
products.reference: IEEE 1547 / FERC Order 2023 Technical Screening

attributes.description: FK to interconnection.application.application_id — Technical reviews are performed FOR a specific interconnection application. One application may have multiple sequential reviews. This is the core workflow link.

products.name: impact_study
products.description: Record of a formal grid impact study ordered for an interconnection application that fails Fast Track or simplified review screens. Captures study type (Feasibility Study, System Impact Study, Facilities Study per FERC Order 2023 or state PUC rules), study scope (affected network segments, contingency scenarios), study contractor (utility internal or third-party), study initiation and completion dates, study cost estimate, cost responsibility allocation reference, identified network upgrades required, upgrade cost estimate, and study findings summary. Also manages cluster/group study cohorts formed under FERC Order 2023 — including cluster study group identifier, geographic study area (feeder, substation zone, planning area), study group formation date, number of applications in group, group study cost allocation methodology, study type classification (cluster feasibility, cluster system impact, cluster facilities), and group study contractor assignment. Supports both individual application studies and FERC Order 2023 cluster study processing for efficient handling of high-volume DER interconnection queues. Drives the determination of required network upgrades and cost allocation across grouped applications.
products.reference: FERC Order 2023 Feasibility / System Impact / Facilities Study

products.name: network_upgrade

Tracks the physical grid improvements needed to enable safe DER integration and drives capital project initiation in the asset domain.
