attributes.description: Indicates whether the interconnection agreement includes enrollment in a Net Energy Metering program, allowing the customer to receive bill credits for excess generation exported to the grid.

attributes.name: nem_program_version
attributes.description: Specific version or tariff schedule of the NEM program under which the customer is enrolled (e.g., NEM 2.0, NEM 3.0, grandfathered NEM 1.0). Different versions have different compensation rates and rules.
attributes.references: State Public Utility Commission (PUC) NEM Tariffs

attributes.name: network_upgrade_cost_usd
attributes.description: Estimated or actual cost in US dollars of utility system upgrades required for this interconnection. Cost allocation (customer-funded vs. utility-funded) depends on regulatory framework and agreement type.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2003, State PUC Cost Allocation Rules

attributes.name: network_upgrade_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether utility distribution or transmission system upgrades are required to accommodate the interconnection of this DER. Upgrades may include transformer replacements, line reconductoring, or protection system enhancements.

attributes.name: parallel_operation_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DER is authorized to operate in parallel with the utility grid (exporting power) or is restricted to islanded/backup operation only. Most modern interconnection agreements allow parallel operation.

attributes.name: poi_location_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the physical location where the DER interconnects to the utility distribution or transmission system. Includes substation name, feeder ID, transformer location, or other technical reference points.

attributes.name: poi_voltage_level_kv
attributes.description: Nominal voltage in kilovolts at the point where the DER interconnects to the utility system. Common values include 0.12, 0.24, 0.48, 4.16, 12.47, 13.8, 34.5, 69, 115, 138, 230, 345, 500 kV.

attributes.name: sgip_application_number
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the SGIP or other incentive program application associated with this interconnection agreement. Null if no incentive application exists.

attributes.name: sgip_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DER project is eligible for California Self-Generation Incentive Program rebates or other state/federal incentive programs. Used for customer incentive tracking and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: California SGIP Guidelines, State Energy Incentive Programs

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the interconnection agreement was terminated prior to its natural expiration, due to breach, mutual consent, or other contractual provisions. Null if agreement has not been terminated.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: Business reason or contractual clause under which the interconnection agreement was terminated. Examples include breach of terms, failure to maintain insurance, decommissioning of DER, customer request, or utility system changes.

attributes.name: witness_test_date
attributes.description: Date on which the utility conducted a witness test or commissioning inspection to verify that the DER installation meets all technical and safety requirements specified in the interconnection agreement.

attributes.name: witness_test_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the utility witness test or commissioning inspection. Passed = DER meets all requirements, Failed = deficiencies identified, Conditional Pass = minor issues to be resolved, Not Required = test waived for low-impact projects, Pending = test scheduled but not yet completed.

products.name: nem_agreement
products.description: Net Energy Metering (NEM) program enrollment agreement for a customer with an approved DER interconnection. Captures NEM program type (NEM 1.0, NEM 2.0, NEM 3.0 / NEM-ST, VNEM for virtual NEM, NEMA for NEM aggregation), enrollment date, true-up period (monthly, annual), export compensation rate (retail rate, avoided cost, NEM tariff rate), banking credits policy, maximum system size eligibility, applicable PUC tariff schedule, and program expiration date. Distinct from the interconnection agreement (technical/legal) — the NEM agreement governs the billing and compensation mechanism for exported energy.
products.reference: NEM (Net Energy Metering) Enrollment Agreement — PUC Tariff

attributes.name: nem_agreement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for nem_agreement

attributes.name: account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.account. Business justification: NEM billing credits, export compensation, and annual true-up calculations are account-level financial transactions requiring direct account linkage for billing system integration and credit reconcilia

attributes.name: customer_service_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing service agreement under which NEM credits and charges are applied.

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility employee or system user who approved the NEM agreement.

attributes.name: interconnection_agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the technical interconnection agreement that governs the physical connection of the DER to the utility grid. The NEM agreement governs billing and compensation; the interconnection agreement governs technical and safety requirements.

attributes.name: interconnection_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent interconnection application that this NEM agreement is associated with.

attributes.name: meter_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bi-directional meter installed at the customer premises to measure both energy consumption and generation for NEM billing purposes.

attributes.name: nem_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to renewable.nem_account. Business justification: Billing and settlement systems must link the formal NEM interconnection agreement to the operational NEM account for export credit calculations, banking policy application, and annual true-up reconcil

attributes.name: obligation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.obligation. Business justification: NEM agreements implement specific regulatory obligations from state NEM programs (tariff compliance, metering requirements, reporting rules, RPS credit eligibility). Essential for tracking program com

attributes.name: profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the customer who owns the Distributed Energy Resource (DER) and is enrolled in the NEM program.

attributes.name: sgip_application_id
attributes.description: The SGIP application identifier if the customer has applied for or received SGIP incentives for the DER system. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: agreement_number
attributes.description: Externally visible unique identifier for the NEM agreement, used in customer communications and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: annual_true_up_month
attributes.description: The calendar month (1-12) in which the annual NEM true-up reconciliation occurs for customers on annual true-up billing. Null for monthly true-up customers.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the utility approved the customer's NEM agreement application.

attributes.name: banking_credits_policy
attributes.description: The policy governing how excess NEM credits are carried forward. Indefinite (credits roll over indefinitely until used), Annual Expiration (credits expire at annual true-up), Monthly Expiration (credits expire at end of each billing cycle), No Banking (no credit carryover, excess generation compensated at lower rate).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NEM agreement record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: cumulative_credit_balance_kwh
attributes.description: The current cumulative balance of NEM energy credits in kilowatt-hours (kWh) that the customer has banked and not yet consumed. Updated after each billing cycle.

attributes.name: cumulative_credit_balance_usd
attributes.description: The current cumulative monetary value in US dollars of NEM credits that the customer has banked and not yet applied to billing charges. Updated after each billing cycle.

attributes.name: der_technology_type
attributes.description: The primary technology type of the DER system covered by this NEM agreement. Solar PV (photovoltaic solar panels), Wind (small wind turbine), Battery Storage (standalone or paired with generation), Fuel Cell (hydrogen or natural gas fuel cell), Combined Heat and Power (CHP cogeneration), Micro Hydro (small-scale hydroelectric).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Effective End Date
attributes.description: The date on which the NEM agreement expires or is terminated. Null for open-ended agreements or active agreements without a defined end date.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Effective Start Date
attributes.description: The date from which NEM billing and credit calculations begin. May differ from enrollment date if retroactive application is approved.

attributes.name: enrollment_date
attributes.description: The date the customer was officially enrolled in the NEM program and the agreement became effective.

attributes.name: export_compensation_rate
attributes.description: The per-kilowatt-hour (kWh) rate at which the customer is compensated for energy exported to the grid, expressed in dollars per kWh.

attributes.name: export_compensation_rate_type
attributes.description: The methodology used to compensate the customer for energy exported to the grid. Retail Rate (full retail electricity rate, typical for NEM 1.0), Avoided Cost (utility's avoided cost of generation, typical for NEM 3.0), NEM Tariff Rate (specific tariff rate defined by PUC for NEM program), Wholesale Rate (market-based wholesale energy price).

attributes.name: grandfathered_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NEM agreement is grandfathered under a previous program version's terms and conditions, protecting the customer from changes in subsequent tariff revisions. True if grandfathered, False otherwise.

attributes.name: grandfathered_until_date
attributes.description: The date until which the grandfathered status is valid. After this date, the customer may be transitioned to the current NEM program terms. Null if not grandfathered or if grandfathering is indefinite.

attributes.name: installed_system_size_kw
attributes.description: The actual nameplate capacity in kilowatts (kW) of the customer's installed DER system as verified during interconnection inspection.

attributes.name: interconnection_agreement
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.agreement.agreement_id — NEM enrollment requires an executed interconnection agreement. The NEM agreement references the underlying interconnection agreement for the same DER system.

attributes.name: last_true_up_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent NEM true-up reconciliation for this agreement.

attributes.name: maximum_system_size_kw
attributes.description: The maximum nameplate capacity in kilowatts (kW) of the customer's Distributed Energy Resource (DER) system that is eligible for NEM under this agreement. Typically based on customer's historical peak demand or regulatory cap.

attributes.name: nem_program_type
attributes.description: The specific NEM program version under which the customer is enrolled. NEM 1.0 (legacy retail rate compensation), NEM 2.0 (retail rate minus non-bypassable charges), NEM 3.0 / NEM-ST (successor tariff with export compensation based on avoided cost), VNEM (Virtual Net Energy Metering for multi-tenant or community solar), NEMA (NEM Aggregation for multiple meters under single customer).
attributes.references: CPUC Decision 14-03-041, CPUC Decision 16-01-044, CPUC Decision 21-12-006

attributes.name: nema_aggregation_type
attributes.description: For NEM Aggregation (NEMA) agreements, the type of meter aggregation allowed. On Site (multiple meters on same parcel), Adjacent Parcels (meters on contiguous parcels owned by same customer), Same Customer (meters under same customer account within service territory). Null for non-NEMA agreements.

attributes.name: next_true_up_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date of the next NEM true-up reconciliation for this agreement.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, comments, or special conditions related to the NEM agreement.

attributes.name: poi_location
attributes.description: The physical location description of the Point of Interconnection where the customer's DER system connects to the utility distribution grid.

attributes.name: program_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the NEM agreement. Pending (application submitted, awaiting approval), Active (agreement in force, customer receiving NEM credits), Suspended (temporarily inactive due to non-compliance or system outage), Terminated (customer or utility ended agreement), Expired (agreement reached end of term).

attributes.name: sgip_incentive_eligible_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Self-Generation Incentive Program (SGIP) Incentive Eligible Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DER system under this NEM agreement is eligible for Self-Generation Incentive Program (SGIP) incentives. True if eligible, False otherwise.

attributes.name: tariff_schedule_code
attributes.description: The Public Utility Commission (PUC) approved tariff schedule code that governs the rates, terms, and conditions of this NEM agreement.

attributes.name: tariff_schedule_name
attributes.description: The human-readable name of the tariff schedule applicable to this NEM agreement (e.g., 'Residential NEM 2.0', 'Commercial NEM-ST').

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date on which the NEM agreement was terminated by the customer or utility. Null if agreement is still active.

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The reason for termination of the NEM agreement (e.g., customer request, system decommissioned, non-compliance, property sale). Null if agreement is still active.

attributes.name: to_agreement
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.agreement.agreement_id — NEM enrollment is contingent on having an executed interconnection agreement. The NEM agreement governs billing/compensation while the interconnection agreement governs technical/legal terms. They are

attributes.name: true_up_period
attributes.description: The billing cycle frequency at which net energy consumption and generation are reconciled and excess credits are settled. Monthly (credits reconciled each billing cycle), Annual (credits accumulated over 12 months and reconciled at year-end).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this NEM agreement record was last modified in the system.

attributes.name: vnem_allocation_method
attributes.business_glossary_term: Virtual Net Energy Metering (VNEM) Allocation Method
attributes.description: For Virtual NEM (VNEM) agreements, the method by which generation credits are allocated among multiple beneficiary accounts. Proportional (based on each account's usage), Fixed Percentage (predefined allocation percentages), Custom (customer-defined allocation rules). Null for non-VNEM agreements.

products.name: application_status_history
products.description: Audit trail record capturing each lifecycle state transition and formal regulatory communication for an interconnection application from submission through final disposition. Captures prior status, new status, transition timestamp, triggering event (applicant action, utility action, regulatory deadline, formal communication sent/received), responsible party, communication type (deficiency notice, completeness determination, study offer letter, cost estimate letter, agreement offer, PTO notification, withdrawal notice), communication channel, response deadline, response received flag, comments, and days elapsed in each status. Enables queue management SLA tracking, FERC Order 2023 milestone compliance reporting (completeness determination within 10 business days, study offer within 30 days, etc.), regulatory communication audit trail, and identification of bottlenecks in the interconnection review process.
products.reference: Interconnection Queue Status Tracking

attributes.name: application_status_history_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for each status transition record in the interconnection application lifecycle audit trail.

attributes.name: primary_application_employee_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the system user or automated process that created this status transition record, supporting audit trail and accountability requirements.

attributes.name: primary_interconnection_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent interconnection application for which this status transition occurred.

attributes.name: tertiary_application_id
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.application.application_id — Status history records are audit trail entries FOR a specific application. This is the most obvious parent-child FK in the domain.

attributes.name: business_days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: Number of business days (excluding weekends and holidays) the application remained in the prior status, used for regulatory compliance milestone tracking per FERC Order 2023.

attributes.name: communication_channel
attributes.description: The medium or channel through which the formal communication was sent or received during this status transition.

attributes.name: communication_received_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when a response or acknowledgment communication was received from the applicant or other party, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: communication_reference_number
attributes.description: Unique tracking number or identifier assigned to the formal communication document associated with this status transition, enabling audit trail linkage.

attributes.name: communication_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the formal communication was sent to the applicant or other party, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: communication_type
attributes.description: Type of formal regulatory or business communication associated with this status transition. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: deficiency_notice|completeness_determination|study_offer_letter|cost_estimate_letter|agreement_offer|pto_notification|withdrawal_notice|information_request|technical_review_report|impact_study_report|feasibility_study_report|system_impact_study|facilities_study — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this status transition record was first created in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: days_in_prior_status
attributes.description: Number of calendar days the application remained in the prior status before this transition occurred, used for SLA tracking and bottleneck analysis.

attributes.name: internal_notes
attributes.description: Confidential internal notes recorded by utility staff regarding this status transition, not shared with the applicant, used for internal coordination and decision documentation.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this status transition record was last modified in the system, recorded in ISO 8601 format for audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: new_status
attributes.description: The status of the interconnection application after this transition, representing the current state following the triggering event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_review|incomplete|study_in_progress|study_complete|agreement_pending|approved — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: notification_sent_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether an automated notification was sent to the applicant or other stakeholders regarding this status transition.

attributes.name: notification_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the automated notification was sent to stakeholders regarding this status transition, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: prior_status
attributes.description: The status of the interconnection application immediately before this transition occurred. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: submitted|under_review|incomplete|study_in_progress|study_complete|agreement_pending|approved — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: queue_position
attributes.description: The position of the interconnection application in the utility interconnection queue at the time of this status transition, used for queue management and priority tracking.

attributes.name: regulatory_milestone_met_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether the regulatory milestone timing requirement was met for this status transition, supporting FERC Order 2023 compliance reporting.

attributes.name: regulatory_milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the regulatory milestone associated with this status transition, aligned with FERC Order 2023 interconnection process requirements.

attributes.name: response_deadline_date
attributes.description: The date by which the applicant or responsible party must respond to the communication or complete required actions to maintain application progress.

attributes.name: response_received_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the required response was received from the applicant or responsible party.

attributes.name: response_received_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether a required response was received from the applicant or responsible party by the deadline date.

attributes.name: responsible_party_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual, organization, or system entity that initiated or was responsible for this status transition.

attributes.name: responsible_party_type
attributes.description: Classification of the party responsible for initiating or causing this status transition.

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this status transition occurred within the defined SLA timeframe for the prior status, supporting queue management and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: sla_target_days
attributes.description: The target number of business days defined in the SLA for completing the prior status phase, used as the benchmark for compliance measurement.

attributes.name: sla_variance_days
attributes.description: The difference between actual business days in prior status and the SLA target days, with positive values indicating delays and negative values indicating early completion.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the operational system that originated this status transition record, supporting data lineage and integration tracking.

attributes.name: source_system_record_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this status transition record in the source operational system, enabling traceability and reconciliation across systems.

attributes.name: system_generated_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this status transition record was automatically generated by the system based on business rules or manually created by a user.

attributes.name: transition_comments
attributes.description: Free-text comments or notes recorded by utility staff or system administrators regarding this status transition, providing additional context for audit and operational review.

attributes.name: transition_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the application status changed from the prior status to the new status, recorded in ISO 8601 format.

attributes.name: triggering_event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the specific event or action that triggered this status transition, providing context for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: triggering_event_type
attributes.description: Classification of the event that caused this status transition, such as applicant submission, utility review completion, regulatory deadline expiration, or formal communication exchange.

products.name: queue_position
products.description: Queue management record tracking the position and priority of pending interconnection applications in the utility's interconnection queue. Captures queue number (utility-assigned sequential identifier), queue entry date, queue position, study group assignment (for cluster/group study processes), queue withdrawal date (if applicable), withdrawal reason, queue hold status, and estimated study completion date. Manages the orderly processing of DER interconnection requests per FERC Order 2023 cluster study rules and state PUC interconnection procedures. One queue record per application.
products.reference: FERC Order 2023 Interconnection Queue / Cluster Study Group

attributes.name: queue_position_id
attributes.description: Primary key for queue_position

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.application.application_id — Queue position tracks where a specific application sits in the interconnection queue. One queue record per application as stated in the description.

attributes.name: cluster_study_group_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the cluster or group study cohort to which this application has been assigned. Used for FERC Order 2023 cluster study processes where multiple applications are studied together.

attributes.name: queue_application_id
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.application.application_id — Each queue position record tracks exactly one application's position in the interconnection queue. One-to-one relationship — the queue record is the application's place in line.

attributes.name: queue_interconnection_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the interconnection application that this queue position represents. Links to the parent application record.

attributes.name: queue_manager_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Interconnection queue management requires dedicated utility staff for application processing, milestone tracking, study coordination, and regulatory compliance. FK enables workload balancing, performa

attributes.name: affected_system_operator
attributes.description: Name of any neighboring transmission or distribution system operator whose system may be impacted by this interconnection. Null if no affected systems identified.

attributes.name: affected_system_study_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether an affected system study is required due to potential impacts on neighboring utility systems.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2023 - Affected System Study Process

attributes.name: commercial_readiness_deposit_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the commercial readiness deposit paid by the applicant. Typically calculated as dollars per kilowatt of proposed capacity.

attributes.name: commercial_readiness_deposit_date
attributes.description: Date when the commercial readiness deposit was received by the utility.

attributes.name: commercial_readiness_deposit_paid
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has paid the required commercial readiness deposit to maintain queue position. Required under FERC Order 2023 financial security provisions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this queue position record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: estimated_study_completion_date
attributes.description: Projected date for completion of all required interconnection studies (feasibility, system impact, facilities study). Updated as studies progress.

attributes.name: facilities_study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the facilities study was completed. Null if study is not yet complete.

attributes.name: facilities_study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the facilities study phase began for this queue position.

attributes.name: feasibility_study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the feasibility study was completed. Null if study is not yet complete.

attributes.name: feasibility_study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the feasibility study phase began for this queue position.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this queue position record was last updated. Tracks the most recent change to any field in the record.

attributes.name: next_milestone_description
attributes.description: Description of the next required milestone action for this queue position.

attributes.name: next_milestone_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the next required milestone (payment, study agreement execution, information submission) must be completed to maintain queue position.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, special circumstances, or coordination requirements for this queue position.

attributes.name: queue_entry_date
attributes.description: Date when the interconnection application was formally entered into the utility interconnection queue. Establishes priority for processing.

attributes.name: queue_hold_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why the queue position was placed on hold. May include pending information, payment issues, or technical review requirements.

attributes.name: queue_hold_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the queue position was placed on hold. Null if never placed on hold or currently active.

attributes.name: queue_hold_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the queue position is currently on hold. True if processing is temporarily suspended pending resolution of issues or additional information.

attributes.name: queue_manager_assigned
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the utility staff member assigned to manage this queue position and coordinate study activities.

attributes.name: queue_number
attributes.description: Utility-assigned sequential identifier for the position in the interconnection queue. Typically formatted as year-sequence (e.g., 2024-001).

attributes.name: queue_position
attributes.description: Numeric position of this application in the interconnection queue. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for study and processing.

attributes.name: queue_priority_points
attributes.description: Numeric score used to determine queue priority under FERC Order 2023 scoring criteria. Higher scores may receive priority processing.

attributes.name: queue_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the queue position. Indicates whether the application is actively progressing, on hold, withdrawn, or completed through the interconnection process.

attributes.name: queue_transition_cycle
attributes.description: Identifier for the transition cycle or window during which this application entered the queue. Used for FERC Order 2023 transition from serial to cluster study processes.

attributes.name: queue_withdrawal_date
attributes.description: Date when the application was withdrawn from the interconnection queue. Null if the application remains active.

attributes.name: site_control_demonstrated
attributes.description: Indicates whether the applicant has demonstrated site control (ownership, lease, or option) for the proposed interconnection location. Required milestone under FERC Order 2023.

attributes.name: site_control_demonstration_date
attributes.description: Date when site control documentation was submitted and verified by the utility.

attributes.name: study_group_assignment_date
attributes.description: Date when the application was assigned to a specific cluster or group study cohort.

attributes.name: system_impact_study_completion_date
attributes.description: Date when the system impact study was completed. Null if study is not yet complete.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2023 - System Impact Study Process

attributes.name: system_impact_study_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the system impact study phase began for this queue position.
attributes.references: FERC Order 2023 - System Impact Study Process

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason
attributes.description: Categorized reason for withdrawal from the interconnection queue. Captures whether withdrawal was due to applicant request, non-payment of fees, failure to meet milestones, or other factors.

attributes.name: withdrawal_reason_notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text details explaining the circumstances of the queue withdrawal.

products.name: hosting_capacity
products.description: Hosting capacity assessment record for a distribution circuit, feeder segment, or substation load area, capturing the maximum additional DER capacity (kW) that can be interconnected at that location without triggering network upgrades. Captures feeder/circuit identifier, node or segment location, assessment date, thermal hosting capacity (kW), voltage hosting capacity (kW), protection hosting capacity (kW), binding constraint type (thermal, voltage, protection coordination, power quality), assessment methodology (deterministic, stochastic, time-series), daytime minimum load assumption, confidence level, data vintage, next scheduled reassessment date, and publication status for public hosting capacity maps per CPUC Rule 21 / ICA or equivalent state requirements. Updated after major network reconfigurations, DER additions, or load changes. Enables applicant self-screening and utility pre-screening of POI feasibility before formal application submission.
products.reference: Distribution Hosting Capacity Analysis (CPUC Rule 21 / IEEE 1547)

attributes.name: hosting_capacity_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the hosting capacity assessment record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: assessment_analyst_employee_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to workforce.employee. Business justification: Hosting capacity assessments are performed by utility distribution engineers. FK enables technical accountability, quality assurance, workload tracking, and regulatory reporting for ICA compliance. Re

attributes.name: distribution_substation_id
attributes.description: Reference to the substation load area associated with this hosting capacity assessment.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network - Asset Location

attributes.name: ems_node_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to grid.ems_node. Business justification: Hosting capacity assessments calculate available DER capacity at specific EMS node locations before thermal, voltage, or protection violations occur. Required for Integration Capacity Analysis (ICA) m

attributes.name: forecast_zone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.zone. Business justification: Hosting capacity assessments are published and tracked by forecast zone for transparency, customer planning, and regulatory compliance. California Rule 21 and similar regulations require zone-level ho

attributes.name: load_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to forecast.load. Business justification: Hosting capacity calculations use load forecasts (specifically daytime_minimum_load_kw) as primary input for thermal and voltage constraint analysis. Direct operational dependency - hosting capacity c

attributes.name: poi_specification_id
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.poi_specification.poi_specification_id — Hosting capacity assessments are for specific distribution circuit locations that correspond to potential POIs. This FK enables applicants and reviewers to cross-reference hosting capacity at a propos

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the hosting capacity assessment was performed or published.

attributes.name: assessment_methodology
attributes.description: The analytical methodology used to calculate hosting capacity: deterministic (worst-case snapshot), stochastic (probabilistic scenarios), time-series (chronological simulation), or hybrid approach.

attributes.name: assessment_software_tool
attributes.description: Name and version of the software tool or platform used to perform the hosting capacity analysis (e.g., EPRI DRIVE, OpenDSS, CYME, Synergi Electric).

attributes.name: available_hosting_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Net available hosting capacity in kilowatts (kW) after accounting for existing and queued DER capacity. This is the capacity available for new interconnection applications without triggering network upgrades.

attributes.name: binding_constraint_type
attributes.description: The type of network constraint that limits the hosting capacity at this location. Identifies which technical factor (thermal, voltage, protection coordination, power quality, stability) is the bottleneck.

attributes.name: circuit_code
attributes.description: Reference to the distribution circuit or feeder for which this hosting capacity assessment was performed.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network - Network Modeling

attributes.name: confidence_level_percent
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level (as a percentage) associated with the hosting capacity estimate, particularly relevant for stochastic or probabilistic assessments. For example, 95% confidence means the capacity is available 95% of the time under modeled conditions.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hosting capacity assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_vintage_date
attributes.description: Date of the network model, load data, and DER penetration data used as inputs to the hosting capacity assessment. Indicates the currency of the underlying data.

attributes.name: daytime_minimum_load_kw
attributes.description: The assumed daytime minimum load in kilowatts (kW) used in the hosting capacity calculation. Critical for assessing reverse power flow and overvoltage risk from solar generation during low-load periods.

attributes.name: der_type_scope
attributes.description: The type(s) of Distributed Energy Resource (DER) for which this hosting capacity assessment applies. May be specific to solar PV, battery storage, EV chargers, or applicable to all DER types.

attributes.name: existing_der_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Total existing DER capacity in kilowatts (kW) already interconnected at this location or on this circuit segment at the time of assessment. Used to calculate remaining available capacity.

attributes.name: feeder_segment_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the specific feeder segment or node location where the hosting capacity was assessed. May reference a GIS node, pole, or transformer location.
attributes.references: Esri ArcGIS Utility Network - Network Modeling

attributes.name: ica_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this hosting capacity assessment complies with CPUC Integration Capacity Analysis (ICA) requirements or equivalent state-level interconnection transparency mandates.

attributes.name: interconnection_voltage_level
attributes.description: The voltage level of the distribution network at the assessed location: low voltage (secondary, typically <1 kV), medium voltage (primary distribution, typically 4-35 kV), or high voltage (sub-transmission, typically >35 kV).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this hosting capacity assessment record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: minimum_hosting_capacity_kw
attributes.description: The binding (minimum) hosting capacity in kilowatts (kW) across all constraint types (thermal, voltage, protection). This is the effective maximum DER capacity that can be interconnected without network upgrades.

attributes.name: nem_agreement_applicable_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Agreement Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether Net Energy Metering (NEM) agreements are applicable for DER interconnections at this location, based on hosting capacity and tariff rules.

attributes.name: next_reassessment_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next hosting capacity reassessment at this location. Reassessments are triggered by major network reconfigurations, significant DER additions, or load changes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, assumptions, limitations, or special conditions related to the hosting capacity assessment.

attributes.name: phase_configuration
attributes.description: The electrical phase configuration at the assessed location: single-phase, three-phase, or split-phase. Impacts the hosting capacity calculation and interconnection requirements.

attributes.name: poi_location_code
attributes.description: Geographic or network location code identifying the Point of Interconnection (POI) where DER capacity is being assessed.

attributes.name: protection_hosting_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Maximum additional DER capacity in kilowatts (kW) that can be interconnected at this location without requiring protection coordination upgrades (relay settings, fuse coordination, or fault current impacts).

attributes.name: public_map_url
attributes.description: URL link to the public-facing hosting capacity map where this assessment is displayed, enabling applicant self-screening and pre-screening of POI feasibility.

attributes.name: publication_status
attributes.description: Current publication status of the hosting capacity assessment. Indicates whether the assessment is available on public hosting capacity maps per CPUC Rule 21 or equivalent state requirements.

attributes.name: queued_der_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Total DER capacity in kilowatts (kW) currently in the interconnection queue (pending applications) for this location or circuit segment. Reduces the available hosting capacity for new applicants.

attributes.name: sgip_eligible_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether DER projects at this location are eligible for Self-Generation Incentive Program (SGIP) incentives based on hosting capacity availability and program rules.

attributes.name: thermal_hosting_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Maximum additional Distributed Energy Resource (DER) capacity in kilowatts (kW) that can be interconnected at this location without exceeding thermal (conductor or transformer) limits.

attributes.name: upgrade_cost_estimate_usd
attributes.description: Estimated cost in US dollars (USD) for network upgrades required to increase hosting capacity beyond the current binding constraint. Provided for applicant planning purposes.

attributes.name: upgrade_description
attributes.description: Textual description of the network upgrades (e.g., conductor reconductoring, transformer replacement, voltage regulator installation, protection relay upgrades) that would be required to increase hosting capacity.

attributes.name: voltage_hosting_capacity_kw
attributes.description: Maximum additional DER capacity in kilowatts (kW) that can be interconnected at this location without causing voltage regulation violations (overvoltage or undervoltage conditions).

products.name: inspection_milestone
products.description: Record of a required inspection, field verification, or authorization milestone in the DER interconnection process. Captures milestone type (utility pre-installation site visit, electrical rough-in inspection, final interconnection inspection, witness test, meter installation verification, Permission to Operate — PTO authorization), scheduled date, actual completion date, inspector identity, inspection result (pass, fail, conditional pass), deficiencies identified, corrective actions required, re-inspection date, and PTO-specific attributes when milestone type is PTO (authorized export capacity kW, operating mode restrictions, metering configuration confirmed, protective relay settings verified, as-built drawing accepted). This entity now also serves as the SSOT for PTO issuance — the PTO milestone record marks the definitive transition from the interconnection application process to active DER operation and triggers NEM enrollment activation and SGIP incentive payment.
products.reference: DER Interconnection Inspection / Permission to Operate (PTO)

attributes.name: inspection_milestone_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the inspection milestone record in the DER interconnection process.

attributes.name: application_id
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.application.application_id — Inspections and PTO milestones are conducted for a specific application. The PTO milestone marks the transition from application to active operation.

attributes.name: audit_finding_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to compliance.audit_finding. Business justification: Failed inspections revealing non-compliance with interconnection standards (protection settings, equipment certification, safety violations) generate audit findings requiring corrective action plans a

attributes.name: created_by_user_employee_id

attributes.name: employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the utility employee or contractor who performed the inspection or milestone verification.

attributes.name: inspection_application_id
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.interconnection_application.interconnection_application_id — Inspections and milestones (including PTO) are performed for a specific application. This FK links field verification steps back to the application, enabling milestone tracking and PTO issuance.

attributes.name: inspection_interconnection_application_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent DER interconnection application that this inspection milestone belongs to.

attributes.name: last_modified_by_user_employee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the system user who last modified this inspection milestone record.

attributes.name: premise_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to customer.premise. Business justification: Field inspections for permission-to-operate occur at physical premises; inspectors require premise address, access instructions, site characteristics, and service territory for scheduling and safety c

attributes.name: actual_completion_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which the inspection or milestone was completed.

attributes.name: actual_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise timestamp when the inspection or milestone was completed, used for SLA tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: contractor_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the installation contractor or electrician was present during the inspection. True if present, False otherwise.

attributes.name: corrective_action_due_date
attributes.description: The deadline by which corrective actions must be completed and verified, typically set by the inspector or regulatory timeline.

attributes.name: corrective_actions_required
attributes.description: Specific corrective actions or remediation steps required to address identified deficiencies before the milestone can be marked as passed.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inspection milestone record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: customer_present_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the customer or their authorized representative was present during the inspection. True if present, False otherwise.

attributes.name: deficiencies_identified
attributes.description: Detailed description of any deficiencies, non-compliance issues, or corrective actions identified during the inspection. Null if inspection passed without issues.

attributes.name: document_repository_path
attributes.description: File path or URI to the document repository location where inspection photos, reports, and supporting documentation are stored.

attributes.name: inspection_checklist_template_code
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized inspection checklist template used for this milestone type, ensuring consistent evaluation criteria across inspections.

attributes.name: inspection_duration_minutes
attributes.description: The total duration of the inspection or site visit in minutes, used for resource planning and efficiency analysis.

attributes.name: inspection_location_address
attributes.description: The physical address where the inspection or site visit was conducted, typically the customer's service address or DER installation site.

attributes.name: inspection_location_gis_coordinates
attributes.business_glossary_term: Inspection Location Geographic Information System (GIS) Coordinates
attributes.description: The GIS coordinates (latitude, longitude) of the inspection site, used for mapping, routing, and spatial analysis. Typically stored as a comma-separated string or WKT format.

attributes.name: inspection_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for inspector notes, observations, and additional context captured during the inspection or milestone verification.

attributes.name: inspection_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the inspection milestone. Values: pass (all requirements met), fail (deficiencies identified, corrective action required), conditional_pass (passed with minor conditions or follow-up required), not_applicable (milestone waived or not required for this application).
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard, State PUC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: inspector_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the inspector, required for regulatory compliance and quality assurance.
attributes.references: State Licensing Board, NERC Personnel Certification

attributes.name: inspector_name
attributes.description: Full name of the inspector who performed the milestone verification, captured for audit and accountability purposes.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this inspection milestone record was last updated or modified.

attributes.name: milestone_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the inspection milestone, typically a sequential or hierarchical number within the interconnection application workflow.

attributes.name: milestone_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the inspection milestone. Values: scheduled (appointment set), in_progress (inspection underway), completed (passed successfully), failed (did not pass), conditional_pass (passed with conditions or corrective actions required), cancelled (milestone no longer required), pending_reschedule (awaiting new appointment after failure or cancellation). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: scheduled|in_progress|completed|failed|conditional_pass|cancelled|pending_reschedule — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: milestone_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inspection milestone. Values: pre_installation_site_visit (utility site assessment before installation), electrical_rough_in_inspection (inspection of electrical work before final connection), final_interconnection_inspection (final verification before energization), witness_test (utility-witnessed commissioning test), meter_installation_verification (confirmation of metering equipment), pto_authorization (Permission to Operate issuance), other (additional milestone types). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: pre_installation_site_visit|electrical_rough_in_inspection|final_interconnection_inspection|witness_test|meter_installation_verification|pto_authorization|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard, State PUC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: nem_enrollment_triggered_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Energy Metering (NEM) Enrollment Triggered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issuance of this PTO milestone has triggered the activation of the customer's NEM enrollment. True if NEM enrollment was activated as a result of this PTO, False otherwise.
attributes.references: State PUC Net Energy Metering (NEM) Rules

attributes.name: photos_attached_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether inspection photos or documentation have been attached to this milestone record. True if photos attached, False otherwise.

attributes.name: pto_as_built_drawing_accepted_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permission to Operate (PTO) As-Built Drawing Accepted Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the as-built electrical drawings and single-line diagrams have been submitted, reviewed, and accepted by the utility. Populated only for PTO milestone records. True if accepted, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard, State PUC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: pto_authorization_date
attributes.description: The official date on which Permission to Operate was granted, marking the customer's authorization to energize and operate the DER system. Populated only when milestone_type is pto_authorization and inspection_result is pass.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard, State PUC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: pto_authorized_export_capacity_kw
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permission to Operate (PTO) Authorized Export Capacity Kilowatts (kW)
attributes.description: The maximum export capacity in kilowatts (kW) authorized for the DER system under the PTO. This value may differ from the applied-for capacity based on technical review and grid constraints. Populated only for PTO milestone records.

attributes.name: pto_issued_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this milestone represents the issuance of Permission to Operate authorization. True if this is the PTO milestone and PTO has been granted, False otherwise. This flag marks the definitive transition from interconnection application to active DER operation.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard, State PUC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: pto_metering_configuration_confirmed_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permission to Operate (PTO) Metering Configuration Confirmed Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the metering configuration (bidirectional meter, net meter, or production meter) has been verified and confirmed as compliant with NEM and interconnection requirements. Populated only for PTO milestone records. True if confirmed, False otherwise.
attributes.references: State PUC Net Energy Metering (NEM) Rules, IEEE 1547

attributes.name: pto_operating_mode_restrictions
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permission to Operate (PTO) Operating Mode Restrictions
attributes.description: Any operating mode restrictions or limitations imposed on the DER system as a condition of PTO issuance, such as export limitations, time-of-use restrictions, or voltage support requirements. Populated only for PTO milestone records.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard, State PUC Interconnection Rules

attributes.name: pto_protective_relay_settings_verified_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Permission to Operate (PTO) Protective Relay Settings Verified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the protective relay settings and anti-islanding protection have been verified and meet IEEE 1547 and utility interconnection standards. Populated only for PTO milestone records. True if verified, False otherwise.
attributes.references: IEEE 1547 Interconnection Standard, NERC Reliability Standards

attributes.name: reinspection_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the follow-up reinspection after corrective actions have been completed. Null if no reinspection is required.

attributes.name: reinspection_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a follow-up reinspection is required after corrective actions are completed. True if reinspection needed, False otherwise.

attributes.name: safety_incident_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether any safety incident or near-miss occurred during the inspection. True if incident occurred, False otherwise. Triggers incident reporting workflow.
attributes.references: OSHA Safety Standards, Internal Safety Policy

attributes.name: scheduled_date
attributes.description: The date on which the inspection or milestone activity is scheduled to occur.

attributes.name: scheduled_time_window_end
attributes.description: The end timestamp of the scheduled time window for the inspection or site visit.

attributes.name: scheduled_time_window_start
attributes.description: The start timestamp of the scheduled time window for the inspection or site visit.

attributes.name: sgip_incentive_payment_triggered_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: Self-Generation Incentive Program (SGIP) Incentive Payment Triggered Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the issuance of this PTO milestone has triggered the release of SGIP incentive payment to the customer. True if SGIP payment was triggered, False otherwise.
attributes.references: California SGIP Program Rules, State Energy Commission Incentive Programs

attributes.name: sla_compliance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the milestone was completed within the SLA target timeline. True if compliant, False if SLA was missed.

attributes.name: sla_target_completion_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Service Level Agreement (SLA) Target Completion Date
attributes.description: The target date by which this milestone should be completed per the utility's interconnection SLA or regulatory timeline requirements.
attributes.references: State PUC Interconnection Rules, Internal SLA Policy

attributes.name: weather_conditions
attributes.description: Description of weather conditions at the time of the inspection, relevant for outdoor site visits and safety considerations.

products.name: sgip_enrollment
products.description: Self-Generation Incentive Program (SGIP) enrollment record for a DER system applying for California SGIP incentives (or equivalent state battery storage incentive program). Captures SGIP program year, technology category (residential battery, non-residential battery, fuel cell, wind), incentive tier, reservation amount ($), incentive rate ($/Wh or $/W), system capacity (kWh/kW), equity budget flag, equity resiliency flag, application submission date, reservation confirmation date, installation completion date, incentive payment status, and program administrator (CPUC-designated). Tracks the incentive lifecycle from reservation through final payment.
products.reference: SGIP (Self-Generation Incentive Program) — CPUC

attributes.name: sgip_der_system_id
attributes.description: FK to interconnection.der_system.der_system_id — SGIP incentives are tied to a specific DER system (battery, fuel cell, etc.). This FK links the incentive enrollment to the physical system it subsidizes. Required for incentive payment verification a

attributes.name: cancellation_reason

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.references: SOX Internal Controls for Data Audit Trail

attributes.name: critical_facility_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the DER system is installed at a critical facility (True) such as a hospital, fire station, water treatment plant, or emergency shelter, qualifying for equity resiliency incentives. False if not a critical facility.
attributes.references: CPUC SGIP Handbook Section 2.3 - Critical Facility Definition

attributes.name: disadvantaged_community_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the installation site is located in a CalEnviroScreen-designated disadvantaged community (True), qualifying for equity budget incentives. False if not in a disadvantaged community.

attributes.name: equipment_manufacturer

attributes.name: equipment_model
attributes.description: The specific model number of the DER system equipment. Must match CPUC-approved equipment list for SGIP eligibility.

attributes.name: equipment_serial_number

attributes.name: equity_budget_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this enrollment is funded from the SGIP equity budget (True) or general market budget (False). Equity budget is reserved for low-income customers and disadvantaged communities.

attributes.name: greenhouse_gas_reduction_metric_tons

attributes.description: The estimated annual greenhouse gas emissions reduction in metric tons of CO2 equivalent achieved by the DER system. Used for SGIP program impact reporting.
attributes.references: California Air Resources Board (CARB) GHG Calculation Methodology

attributes.name: high_fire_threat_district_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the installation site is located in a CPUC-designated high fire-threat district (True), qualifying for equity resiliency incentives. False if not in a high fire-threat district.
attributes.references: CPUC Fire-Threat Map and SGIP Equity Resiliency Criteria

attributes.name: incentive_claim_submission_date
attributes.description: The date the customer or installer submitted the incentive payment claim to the program administrator after installation completion. Triggers payment processing.

attributes.name: incentive_payment_amount_usd

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_w

attributes.name: incentive_rate_per_wh

attributes.name: incentive_tier

attributes.name: installation_completion_date

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp

attributes.name: low_income_flag

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes and comments related to this SGIP enrollment. Used for documenting special circumstances, program administrator communications, or processing exceptions.

products.name: fee
products.description: Master record for all financial obligations, fee transactions, and cost responsibility allocations between the utility and a DER interconnection applicant throughout the application lifecycle. Captures fee type (application fee, study deposit, supplemental study fee, inspection fee, facilities charge, standby charge), fee amount, invoice date, due date, payment received date, payment method, payment status (invoiced, paid, overdue, refunded), and applicable tariff schedule reference. Also serves as the SSOT for cost responsibility allocation — defining how interconnection-related costs (impact study costs, network upgrade costs, interconnection facilities costs) are split between applicant and utility, including cost category, total estimated cost, applicant share ($ and %), utility share ($ and %), cost allocation methodology (beneficiary pays, socialized, pro-rata), payment schedule, deposit amount collected, refund eligibility, and final settled cost. This is the single authoritative source for all interconnection-related monetary transactions, cost allocations, applicant invoicing, deposit tracking, refund processing, and capital cost recovery reporting.

products.name: cluster_study_group
products.description: Record of a cluster or group study cohort formed under FERC Order 2023 cluster interconnection study rules, grouping multiple DER applications in the same geographic area for simultaneous impact study processing. Captures study group identifier, geographic study area (feeder, substation zone, planning area), study group formation date, number of applications in group, study type (cluster feasibility, cluster system impact, cluster facilities), study contractor, study start date, estimated completion date, and group study cost allocation methodology. Enables efficient processing of high-volume DER interconnection queues.

domains.name: forecast
domains.description: Load forecasting, generation forecasting, renewable intermittency prediction, peak demand planning, weather correlation analysis, and long-term capacity planning. Manages short-term operational forecasts, seasonal planning, and IRP scenario modeling for resource adequacy and grid reliability. Supports operational decision-making for dispatch, procurement, and infrastructure investment.

products.name: load
products.description: Core master entity representing a load forecast run and its interval-level forecast values for a specific horizon (short-term, day-ahead, seasonal, or long-term). Captures forecast type, target period, geographic scope (system-wide, zone, feeder), model version, weather scenario, and approval status at the header level. Stores forecasted MW demand at each time interval (hourly, 15-minute, or 5-minute resolution) with point forecast, confidence interval bounds (P10/P50/P90), and weather-adjusted values. Serves as the authoritative record for all load forecasting activity used in dispatch planning, procurement, and IRP. Sourced from EMS/ADMS load forecasting modules and integrated with OSIsoft PI historian data. Enables comparison against actual metered load from MDM for forecast accuracy tracking.
products.reference: NERC Load Forecasting Standard; IRP Load Forecast

attributes.description: Forecasted load contribution from electric vehicle charging during this interval. Tracked separately due to rapid EV adoption growth and managed charging program impacts.

attributes.name: forecast_error_mw
attributes.description: Calculated forecast error when actual metered load becomes available. Computed as (actual_load_mw - point_forecast_mw). Used for forecast accuracy tracking and model tuning.

attributes.name: forecast_error_percent
attributes.description: Forecast error expressed as a percentage of actual load. Calculated as ((actual_load_mw - point_forecast_mw) / actual_load_mw) * 100. Enables normalized accuracy comparison across different load levels.

attributes.name: forecast_generation_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this forecast interval was generated by the forecasting system. Used for forecast lead time analysis and model performance evaluation.

attributes.name: forecast_horizon_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours between forecast generation time and the forecasted interval. Used for lead-time-based accuracy analysis, as forecast accuracy typically degrades with longer horizons.

attributes.name: forecast_status
attributes.description: Current status of this forecast interval record. Preliminary forecasts may be updated as weather forecasts improve; final forecasts are locked for operational use; revised forecasts incorporate corrections; superseded forecasts have been replaced by newer runs.

attributes.name: forecast_timestamp
attributes.description: The specific date and time for which this load forecast applies. Represents the start of the forecast interval (hourly, 15-minute, or 5-minute resolution depending on forecast granularity).

attributes.name: forecast_type
attributes.description: Classification of the forecast horizon. Short-term supports real-time operations, day-ahead supports market bidding, week-ahead supports unit commitment, seasonal supports resource planning, and long-term supports IRP and capacity expansion.

attributes.name: humidity_forecast_percent
attributes.description: Forecasted relative humidity as a percentage. Impacts cooling load and heat index calculations for demand forecasting.

attributes.name: interval_duration_minutes
attributes.description: Duration of the forecast interval in minutes. Common values include 60 (hourly), 15 (quarter-hourly), or 5 (five-minute) to support different operational and market requirements.

attributes.name: model_name
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the forecasting model or algorithm used to generate this interval forecast (e.g., ARIMA, neural network, ensemble model). Enables model performance comparison and audit trail.

attributes.name: model_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the forecasting model used. Tracks model evolution and enables reproducibility of forecast results.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments about this forecast interval. May include explanations for unusual forecasts, data quality issues, special events, or operational context.

attributes.name: p10_forecast_mw
attributes.description: Lower bound of the 80% confidence interval (10th percentile). Represents a conservative low-load scenario used for minimum generation planning and reserve margin calculations.

attributes.name: p90_forecast_mw
attributes.description: Upper bound of the 80% confidence interval (90th percentile). Represents a high-load scenario used for capacity adequacy assessment and peak demand planning.

attributes.name: peak_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this interval falls within a defined peak demand period. Used for peak demand planning, capacity market obligations, and critical peak pricing programs.

attributes.name: point_forecast_mw
attributes.description: The primary forecasted load demand value in megawatts for this interval. Represents the expected (P50 or median) load level used for operational dispatch and resource scheduling.

attributes.name: season
attributes.description: Meteorological or operational season classification. Used for seasonal load pattern analysis and rate period determination.

attributes.name: substation_code
attributes.description: Specific substation identifier when forecast is at substation-level granularity. Null for zone-level or system-level forecasts.

attributes.name: temperature_forecast_f
attributes.description: Forecasted ambient temperature in degrees Fahrenheit for this interval. Key weather driver for load forecasting, particularly for heating and cooling demand.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this load forecast interval record was last modified. Tracks revisions to forecasts and actual load population for accuracy tracking.

attributes.name: weather_adjusted_forecast_mw
attributes.description: Load forecast adjusted for actual or forecasted weather conditions including temperature, humidity, wind speed, and cloud cover. Used when weather deviates significantly from normal patterns.

attributes.name: weather_station_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary weather station or weather forecast grid point used for this forecast. Enables traceability of weather data sources and regional weather correlation analysis.

attributes.name: wind_speed_forecast_mph
attributes.business_glossary_term: Wind Speed Forecast in Miles Per Hour (MPH)
attributes.description: Forecasted wind speed in miles per hour. Relevant for wind chill calculations and renewable generation correlation analysis.

attributes.name: zone_code

products.name: forecast_generation
products.description: Core master entity representing a generation output forecast run and its interval-level forecast values for a specific generation asset, portfolio, or system total. Captures forecast horizon (intraday, day-ahead, week-ahead), generation technology type (CCGT, wind, solar, hydro, nuclear), fuel availability assumptions, and scheduled maintenance constraints at the header level. Stores forecasted MW output per generation unit or portfolio at each time interval, including probabilistic bounds (P10/P50/P90), ramp rate constraints, and fuel-adjusted capacity. Used by dispatch schedulers and energy traders for unit commitment, market bidding, AGC setpoint planning, and real-time dispatch scheduling. Integrates with ABB Symphony Plus and OpenLink Endur. Compared against actual generation telemetry from OSIsoft PI for model accuracy assessment.
